## scripts/empacotar.py

```python
"""Empacota o projeto em um .zip pronto para enviar (sem assets, sem builds), apos regenerar os .md de codigo.

Uso (na raiz do projeto):  py -3 scripts\\empacotar.py v12
Gera ..\\f3vb-starter-v12.zip (ao lado da pasta do projeto). Aborta se achar dados do jogo (verificar_sem_assets.py).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

RAIZ = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import verificar_sem_assets as vsa  # noqa: E402

PULAR = {".git", "__pycache__", "build", "original_assets", "private", "logs"}


def main() -> int:
    versao = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "vX"
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(RAIZ / "scripts" / "gerar_codigo_md.py")], check=True)
    achados = vsa.varrer()
    if achados:
        print("Abortado: dados do jogo no projeto:")
        for a in achados:
            print("  -", a)
        return 1
    destino = RAIZ.parent / f"f3vb-starter-{versao}.zip"
    n = 0
    with zipfile.ZipFile(destino, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for p in sorted(RAIZ.rglob("*")):
            rel = p.relative_to(RAIZ.parent)
            if not p.is_file() or any(x in PULAR for x in p.relative_to(RAIZ).parts):
                continue
            z.write(p, rel.as_posix())
            n += 1
    print(f"{destino}  ({n} arquivos)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

## scripts/gerar_codigo_md.py

```python
"""Gera CODIGO_COMPLETO.md (e CODIGO_THIRD_PARTY.md) com todo o texto do projeto, para ler/enviar.

Uso (na raiz do projeto):  py -3 scripts\\gerar_codigo_md.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

RAIZ = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
EXT = {".py": "python", ".ps1": "powershell", ".md": "markdown", ".txt": "text", ".hpp": "cpp",
       ".cpp": "cpp", ".h": "cpp", ".pyw": "python", ".bat": "bat", ".toml": "toml", ".cfg": "ini"}
NOMES = {"CMakeLists.txt": "cmake", ".gitignore": "text", "LICENSE": "text"}
IGNORAR = {"private", "__pycache__", "build", ".git"}
SAIDAS = {"CODIGO_COMPLETO.md", "CODIGO_THIRD_PARTY.md"}


def lang(p: Path) -> str | None:
    return NOMES.get(p.name) or EXT.get(p.suffix.lower())


def cerca(texto: str) -> str:
    runs = [len(m.group(0)) for m in re.finditer(r"`+", texto)]
    return "`" * max(3, (max(runs) if runs else 0) + 1)


def coletar(base: Path, so_third_party: bool) -> list[Path]:
    arquivos = []
    for p in sorted(base.rglob("*")):
        rel = p.relative_to(RAIZ)
        if not p.is_file() or any(part in IGNORAR for part in rel.parts) or p.name in SAIDAS:
            continue
        in_tp = rel.parts[0] == "third_party"
        if in_tp != so_third_party or lang(p) is None:
            continue
        arquivos.append(p)
    return arquivos


def escrever(destino: Path, titulo: str, arquivos: list[Path]) -> None:
    linhas = [f"# {titulo}", "", f"{len(arquivos)} arquivos. Gerado por `scripts/gerar_codigo_md.py`.", "", "## Índice", ""]
    for p in arquivos:
        linhas.append(f"- `{p.relative_to(RAIZ).as_posix()}`")
    for p in arquivos:
        texto = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        c = cerca(texto)
        linhas += ["", f"## {p.relative_to(RAIZ).as_posix()}", "", f"{c}{lang(p)}", texto.rstrip("\n"), c]
    destino.write_text("\n".join(linhas) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"{destino.name}: {len(arquivos)} arquivos, {destino.stat().st_size} bytes")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    escrever(RAIZ / "CODIGO_COMPLETO.md", "F3VB: código completo do projeto", coletar(RAIZ, False))
    escrever(RAIZ / "CODIGO_THIRD_PARTY.md",
             "F3VB: código de terceiros vendorizado (blendergranny, MIT)", coletar(RAIZ, True))
```

## scripts/gerar_natives_md.py

```python
"""Gera docs/NATIVES.md (a API que o jogo oferece aos scripts) a partir do 03_report.json.

Uso:  py -3 scripts\\gerar_natives_md.py private\\relatorio\\03_report.json
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

RAIZ = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

GRUPOS = [
    ("Ações de personagem (A_*)", lambda n: n.startswith("A_")),
    ("Diálogo e texto", lambda n: n in {
        "RegisterReply", "RegisterNodeText", "SetNodeTextFunction", "SetCurrentNodeName", "PCSpeaker",
        "FloatingSpeechText", "FloatingDamageText", "DisplayStringRef", "MessageGetArg", "AddEntry", "CloseTask"}),
    ("Biblioteca de ponto flutuante do Pawn", lambda n: n.startswith("float") or n in {"strfloat", "fround", "strlen"}),
    ("Leitura de estado (Get*, Is*, Has*, Find*, Distance...)", lambda n: n.startswith(
        ("Get", "Is", "Has", "Find", "Distance", "Myself", "Protagonist", "Hour", "Minute", "Day"))),
    ("Alteração de estado (Set*, Add*, Remove*, Create*, Destroy*...)", lambda n: n.startswith(
        ("Set", "Add", "Remove", "Create", "Destroy", "Attach", "Clear", "Equip", "Activate", "Deactivate", "Kill"))),
]


def main(path: str) -> None:
    rep = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    nat: dict = {}
    publics = set()
    ndec = ncand = 0
    for g in rep["grps"]:
        m = (g.get("aggregates") or {}).get("amx") or {}
        if m.get("candidates"):
            nat = m["natives_called"]
            publics = set(m.get("publics", []))
            ndec, ncand = m["decoded_ok"], m["candidates"]
    if not nat:
        sys.exit("Nenhum dado de AMX no relatório.")
    usados, linhas = set(), []
    linhas += ["# API de scripts (natives) do jogo", "",
               f"Fonte: relatório da demo real ({ndec}/{ncand} scripts decodificados por completo). "
               f"São **{len(nat)} funções nativas** que a engine precisa oferecer à VM; a coluna de chamadas é a contagem de "
               "pontos de chamada no código de todos os scripts (indica prioridade).", ""]
    for titulo, pred in GRUPOS:
        itens = [(n, c) for n, c in nat.items() if n not in usados and pred(n)]
        if not itens:
            continue
        usados.update(n for n, _ in itens)
        linhas += [f"## {titulo} ({len(itens)})", "", "| Função | Chamadas |", "|---|---:|"]
        linhas += [f"| `{n}` | {c} |" for n, c in sorted(itens, key=lambda x: -x[1])]
        linhas.append("")
    resto = [(n, c) for n, c in nat.items() if n not in usados]
    if resto:
        linhas += [f"## Outras ({len(resto)})", "", "| Função | Chamadas |", "|---|---:|"]
        linhas += [f"| `{n}` | {c} |" for n, c in sorted(resto, key=lambda x: -x[1])]
        linhas.append("")
    linhas += ["## Como implementar", "",
               "1. Registre cada função em `f3vb::amx::Machine::register_native(nome, callback)`; `params[0]` é o nº de bytes de argumentos e `params[1..]` os argumentos (inteiros de 32 bits; floats do Pawn são o mesmo padrão de bits).",
               "2. Comece pelas mais chamadas e pelo grupo de diálogo; as de ponto flutuante são triviais.",
               "3. Strings chegam como endereços na memória do script (`read_string`).", ""]
    destino = RAIZ / "docs" / "NATIVES.md"
    destino.write_text("\n".join(linhas), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"{destino.name}: {len(nat)} natives, {len(publics)} publics distintas")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else str(RAIZ / "private" / "relatorio" / "03_report.json"))
```

## scripts/rodar_tudo.ps1

```powershell
<#
  F3VB - roda toda a analise e junta os relatorios em .txt (PowerShell 5.1 ou 7+).

  Uso (na pasta do projeto):
    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\rodar_tudo.ps1 -PastaDemo "C:\caminho\da\demo"
  Com amostras binarias (gr2/b3d/tga/amx) e analise profunda dos arquivos:
    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\rodar_tudo.ps1 -PastaDemo "C:\caminho\da\demo" -IncluirAmostras

  Saidas (tudo em private\, que o git ignora):
    private\relatorio\*.txt           relatorios de texto
    private\ENVIAR_PARA_ANALISE.zip   zip com os .txt (e, com -IncluirAmostras, os binarios das amostras)
#>
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string] $PastaDemo,
    [switch] $IncluirAmostras,
    [int] $PorClasse = 2
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$Raiz     = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$PyDir    = Join-Path $Raiz 'tools\py'
$Saida    = Join-Path $Raiz 'private\relatorio'
$Amostra  = Join-Path $Raiz 'private\amostra'
$ZipFinal = Join-Path $Raiz 'private\ENVIAR_PARA_ANALISE.zip'

# Acentos corretos nos .txt: o PowerShell precisa ler a saida do Python como UTF-8
[Console]::OutputEncoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false
$OutputEncoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false

function Passo([string] $Texto) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host "==> $Texto" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
function Nome-Seguro([string] $Texto) { return ($Texto -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]', '_') }

# ---- 1) achar o Python (3.10+) ------------------------------------------------
$PyExe = $null
$PyArgs = @()
foreach ($tentativa in @('py', 'python', 'python3')) {
    $cmd = Get-Command $tentativa -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -eq $cmd) { continue }
    $extra = @()
    if ($tentativa -eq 'py') { $extra = @('-3') }
    $versao = & $cmd.Source @extra --version 2>&1
    if (($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) -and ("$versao" -match 'Python 3\.(\d+)') -and ([int]$Matches[1] -ge 10)) {
        $PyExe = $cmd.Source
        $PyArgs = $extra
        Write-Host "Python encontrado: $versao ($PyExe)"
        break
    }
}
if ($null -eq $PyExe) {
    Write-Host 'Python 3.10+ nao encontrado. Instale com:  winget install Python.Python.3.12' -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host 'Depois feche e abra o PowerShell de novo e rode este script outra vez.'
    exit 1
}
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $PastaDemo -PathType Container)) {
    Write-Host "Pasta da demo nao encontrada: $PastaDemo" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}
$PastaDemo = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $PastaDemo).Path

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Saida | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Amostra | Out-Null
$env:PYTHONUTF8 = '1'
$env:F3VB_GAME_DIR = $PastaDemo

# Roda o Python com os argumentos dados e grava a saida (stdout+stderr) num .txt. Devolve o codigo de saida.
function Invoke-Py([string] $Arquivo, [string[]] $Argumentos) {
    $todos = @() + $PyArgs + $Argumentos
    $linhas = & $PyExe @todos 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" } | Where-Object { $_ -ne 'System.Management.Automation.RemoteException' }
    $codigo = $LASTEXITCODE
    $linhas | Out-File -FilePath $Arquivo -Encoding utf8
    return $codigo
}
function Invoke-F3([string] $Arquivo, [string[]] $Argumentos) {
    return (Invoke-Py $Arquivo (@('-m', 'f3vb') + $Argumentos))
}

Push-Location $PyDir
try {
    # ---- 2) testes automaticos (confirma que o ambiente esta ok) ----------------
    Passo 'Testes automaticos'
    $c = Invoke-Py (Join-Path $Saida '00_testes.txt') @('-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-t', '.')
    Write-Host "   codigo de saida: $c (0 = tudo certo)"

    # ---- 3) inventario da pasta ---------------------------------------------------
    Passo 'Inventario da pasta da demo'
    $c = Invoke-F3 (Join-Path $Saida '01_inventario.txt') @('inventory', $PastaDemo)
    Write-Host "   codigo: $c"

    # ---- 4) resource.rht ------------------------------------------------------------
    Passo 'resource.rht'
    $rht = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $PastaDemo -Recurse -Filter 'resource.rht' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
    if ($null -ne $rht) {
        $c = Invoke-F3 (Join-Path $Saida '02_rht.txt') @('rht', $rht.FullName, '--entries', '60')
        Write-Host "   $($rht.FullName)  codigo: $c"
    } else {
        'resource.rht NAO encontrado na pasta (procure por outro nome/extensao .rht).' | Out-File (Join-Path $Saida '02_rht.txt') -Encoding utf8
        Write-Host '   resource.rht nao encontrado' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }

    # ---- 5) catalogo: cruza o .rht com os .grp (nomes e tipos de cada recurso) -------------
    Passo 'Catalogo de recursos (rht x grp)'
    $c = Invoke-F3 (Join-Path $Saida '02b_catalogo_log.txt') @('catalog', $PastaDemo, '--out', (Join-Path $Saida 'catalogo'))
    Write-Host "   codigo: $c"

    # ---- 6) relatorio geral + resumo curto ----------------------------------------------
    Passo 'Relatorio geral (le todos os .grp; pode demorar alguns minutos)'
    $c = Invoke-F3 (Join-Path $Saida '03_log_report.txt') @('report', $PastaDemo, '-o', (Join-Path $Saida '03_report.json'), '--resumo', (Join-Path $Saida '03_resumo.txt'))
    Write-Host "   codigo: $c"

    # ---- 7) lista de lumps de cada .grp (ignora copias identicas: mesmo nome e tamanho) ------
    $todosGrps = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $PastaDemo -Recurse -Filter '*.grp' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object { $_.FullName.Length })
    $vistos = @{}
    $grps = @()
    foreach ($g in $todosGrps) {
        $k = "$($g.Name.ToLower())|$($g.Length)"
        if ($vistos.ContainsKey($k)) {
            Write-Host "   duplicata ignorada: $($g.FullName)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            continue
        }
        $vistos[$k] = $true
        $grps += $g
    }
    Passo "Lumps de cada .grp ($($grps.Count) arquivo(s) unicos)"
    foreach ($g in $grps) {
        $rel = $g.FullName.Substring($PastaDemo.Length).TrimStart('\', '/')
        $n = Nome-Seguro ([System.IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($rel, $null))
        $c = Invoke-F3 (Join-Path $Saida "04_grp_$n.txt") @('grp', $g.FullName, '--list')
        Write-Host "   $rel  codigo: $c"
    }

    # ---- 8) amostras ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Passo 'Amostras (gr2, b3d, tga, amx) de cada .grp'
    $dirsAmostra = @()
    foreach ($g in $grps) {
        $rel = $g.FullName.Substring($PastaDemo.Length).TrimStart('\', '/')
        $n = Nome-Seguro ([System.IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($rel, $null))
        $dest = Join-Path $Amostra $n
        $args2 = @('sample', $g.FullName, '--out', $dest, '--classes', 'gr2,b3d,tga,amx', '--per-class', "$PorClasse")
        if (-not $IncluirAmostras) { $args2 += '--so-texto' }
        $c = Invoke-F3 (Join-Path $Saida "05_sample_$n.txt") $args2
        Write-Host "   $rel  codigo: $c"
        $dirsAmostra += $dest
    }

    # ---- 8b) falhas do B3D em texto (hexdump do menor arquivo de cada motivo): permite decifrar sem enviar binarios ----
    Passo 'Falhas do B3D (texto)'
    $rhtArg = @()
    if ($null -ne $rht) { $rhtArg = @('--rht', $rht.FullName) }
    foreach ($g in $grps) {
        if (@('Tiles', 'Critters', 'Props', 'Items', 'Effects') -notcontains $g.BaseName) { continue }
        $n = Nome-Seguro $g.BaseName
        $c = Invoke-F3 (Join-Path $Saida "07_b3d_falhas_$n.txt") (@('b3dfail', $g.FullName, '--per-reason', '2') + $rhtArg)
        Write-Host "   $($g.Name)  codigo: $c"
    }

    # ---- 9) analise profunda dos arquivos amostrados (so com -IncluirAmostras) -----------------------------
    if ($IncluirAmostras) {
        Passo 'Analise profunda dos arquivos amostrados'
        foreach ($d in $dirsAmostra) {
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d)) { continue }
            $pasta = Nome-Seguro (Split-Path $d -Leaf)
            foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -File)) {
                $n = Nome-Seguro $f.BaseName
                if ($f.Extension -eq '.gr2') {
                    $c = Invoke-F3 (Join-Path $Saida "06_gr2_${pasta}_$n.txt") @('gr2', $f.FullName)
                    Write-Host "   gr2 $($f.Name) codigo: $c"
                } elseif (@('.b3d', '.tga', '.amx', '.bmp') -contains $f.Extension) {
                    $c = Invoke-F3 (Join-Path $Saida "06_inspect_${pasta}_$n.txt") @('inspect', $f.FullName)
                    Write-Host "   inspect $($f.Name) codigo: $c"
                }
            }
        }
    }

    # ---- 10) juntar tudo num zip (feito pelo Python: barras normais nos nomes) --------------------------------
    Passo 'Montando o zip para analise'
    $destAm = Join-Path $Saida 'amostras'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $destAm | Out-Null
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Amostra -Filter '*.zip' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Copy-Item -Destination $destAm -Force
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ZipFinal) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $ZipFinal -Force }
    $c = Invoke-Py (Join-Path $Saida '99_zip_log.txt') @('-m', 'f3vb', 'zipdir', $Saida, $ZipFinal)
    $mb = [math]::Round((Get-Item -LiteralPath $ZipFinal).Length / 1MB, 2)
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host "PRONTO. Envie: $ZipFinal  ($mb MB)" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "Se for grande, envie so: $(Join-Path $Saida '03_resumo.txt') e $(Join-Path $Saida 'catalogo\catalogo_resumo.txt')"
}
finally {
    Pop-Location
}
```

## scripts/verificar_sem_assets.py

```python
"""Verifica que o projeto NAO contem dados do jogo (nem derivados) antes de empacotar ou publicar.

Uso (na raiz do projeto):  py -3 scripts\\verificar_sem_assets.py
Codigo de saida 0 = limpo; 1 = achou algo suspeito (a lista e impressa). Tambem e chamado por empacotar.py.

O que e considerado conteudo do jogo (ou derivado dele):
  - extensoes de formatos do jogo e de saidas convertidas: .grp .rht .gr2 .skl .b3d .tga .bmp .amx .f3m .glb .mve .rle .stf .wav .ogg .mp3
  - qualquer coisa dentro de original_assets/ (exceto os arquivos de protecao que o proprio projeto cria) e de private/
  - arquivos grandes (> 5 MB) fora de third_party/
Pastas ignoradas na varredura: .git, __pycache__, build.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

RAIZ = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
EXT_JOGO = {".grp", ".rht", ".gr2", ".skl", ".b3d", ".tga", ".bmp", ".amx", ".f3m", ".glb", ".mve", ".rle", ".stf", ".wav", ".ogg", ".mp3"}
IGNORAR = {".git", "__pycache__", "build"}
PERMITIDOS_EM_ASSETS = {".gitignore", "LEIA-ME.txt"}
LIMITE = 5 * 1024 * 1024


def varrer(raiz: Path = RAIZ) -> list[str]:
    achados: list[str] = []
    for p in sorted(raiz.rglob("*")):
        rel = p.relative_to(raiz)
        partes = rel.parts
        if any(x in IGNORAR for x in partes) or not p.is_file():
            continue
        if partes[0] == "original_assets":
            if rel.name not in PERMITIDOS_EM_ASSETS or len(partes) > 2:
                achados.append(f"{rel}  (dentro de original_assets/)")
            continue
        if partes[0] == "private":
            achados.append(f"{rel}  (dentro de private/)")
            continue
        if p.suffix.lower() in EXT_JOGO:
            achados.append(f"{rel}  (extensao {p.suffix.lower()} de dado do jogo ou derivado)")
        elif partes[0] != "third_party" and p.stat().st_size > LIMITE:
            achados.append(f"{rel}  (arquivo grande: {p.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
    return achados


def main() -> int:
    achados = varrer()
    if achados:
        print("ATENCAO: possiveis dados do jogo no projeto. NAO empacote nem publique assim:")
        for a in achados:
            print("  -", a)
        return 1
    print("OK: nenhum dado do jogo encontrado no projeto.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

## src/amx/amx_run.cpp

```cpp
// Ferramenta de linha de comando: carrega um .amx da demo, lista publics/natives e executa publics
// com nativas "de log" (registram nome e argumentos e devolvem 0). Serve para validar a VM com scripts reais.
//   amx_run ARQ.amx               -> resumo + executa todas as publics sem argumentos
//   amx_run ARQ.amx --call NOME [arg ...]
//   amx_run ARQ.amx --list
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "amx_vm.hpp"

using namespace f3vb::amx;

static std::vector<std::uint8_t> read_file(const char* path) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    return {std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>()};
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) { std::puts("uso: amx_run ARQ.amx [--list | --call NOME [args...]]"); return 2; }
    auto bytes = read_file(argv[1]);
    std::string error;
    auto prog = Program::load(bytes, &error);
    if (!prog) { std::printf("ERRO ao carregar: %s\n", error.c_str()); return 1; }
    const auto& h = prog->header();
    std::printf("%s: file_v=%d amx_v=%d magic=%#x flags=%#x defsize=%d code=%zu cel, data=%zu B, mem=%d B\n", argv[1],
                h.file_version, h.amx_version, h.magic, h.flags, h.defsize, prog->code().size(),
                prog->initial_data().size(), prog->memory_size());
    std::printf("publics=%zu natives=%zu\n", prog->publics().size(), prog->natives().size());
    if (argc > 2 && !std::strcmp(argv[2], "--list")) {
        for (auto& f : prog->publics()) std::printf("  public  %-28s @%u\n", f.name.c_str(), f.address);
        for (auto& f : prog->natives()) std::printf("  native  %s\n", f.name.c_str());
        return 0;
    }

    Machine m(*prog);
    bool verbose = true;
    for (const auto& n : prog->natives()) {
        const std::string name = n.name;
        m.register_native(name, [name, &verbose](Machine& vm, const std::int32_t* p) -> std::int32_t {
            if (verbose) {
                std::printf("      > %s(", name.c_str());
                const int n = p[0] / 4;
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                    // tenta mostrar strings quando o argumento parece um endereco de texto
                    std::printf("%s%d", i > 1 ? ", " : "", p[i]);
                }
                std::printf(")\n");
            }
            (void)vm;
            return 0;
        });
    }

    auto run_one = [&](int idx, std::vector<std::int32_t> args) {
        std::int32_t result = 0;
        const auto before = m.instructions_executed();
        const Err e = m.call(idx, args, &result);
        std::printf("  %-26s -> %s (retorno %d, %llu instrucoes)\n", prog->publics()[static_cast<std::size_t>(idx)].name.c_str(),
                    err_name(e), result, static_cast<unsigned long long>(m.instructions_executed() - before));
        return e;
    };

    int failures = 0;
    if (argc > 3 && !std::strcmp(argv[2], "--call")) {
        std::vector<std::int32_t> args;
        for (int i = 4; i < argc; ++i) args.push_back(std::atoi(argv[i]));
        const int idx = prog->find_public(argv[3]);
        if (idx < 0) { std::puts("public nao encontrada"); return 1; }
        failures += run_one(idx, args) != Err::None;
    } else {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < prog->publics().size(); ++i)
            failures += run_one(static_cast<int>(i), {}) != Err::None;
    }
    std::printf("falhas: %d\n", failures);
    return failures ? 1 : 0;
}
```

```cpp
constexpr std::int32_t kCell = 4;

template <class T>
T rd(const std::uint8_t* p) {
    T v;
    std::memcpy(&v, p, sizeof v);
    return v;
}

bool fail(std::string* e, const std::string& m) {
    if (e) *e = m;
    return false;
}

std::string cstr(std::span<const std::uint8_t> b, std::size_t off, std::size_t max) {
    std::string s;
    for (std::size_t i = off; i < b.size() && i < off + max && b[i]; ++i) s.push_back(static_cast<char>(b[i]));
    return s;
}
}  // namespace

const std::vector<OpInfo>& opcode_table() { return kTable; }

const char* err_name(Err e) {
    switch (e) {
        case Err::None: return "ok";
        case Err::Exit: return "saida forcada";
        case Err::Assert: return "assert falhou";
        case Err::StackErr: return "colisao pilha/heap";
        case Err::Bounds: return "indice fora dos limites";
        case Err::MemAccess: return "acesso invalido a memoria";
        case Err::InvInstr: return "instrucao invalida";
        case Err::StackLow: return "pilha abaixo do inicio";
        case Err::HeapLow: return "heap abaixo do inicio";
        case Err::Callback: return "nativa nao registrada";
        case Err::Native: return "nativa falhou";
        case Err::Divide: return "divisao por zero";
        case Err::Sleep: return "sleep";
        case Err::InvState: return "estado invalido";
        case Err::Memory: return "sem memoria";
        case Err::Format: return "formato invalido";
        case Err::Version: return "versao nao suportada";
        case Err::NotFound: return "funcao nao encontrada";
        case Err::Params: return "parametros invalidos";
        case Err::Limit: return "limite de instrucoes";
    }
    return "?";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Program
std::optional<Program> Program::load(std::span<const std::uint8_t> b, std::string* error) {
    constexpr std::size_t kHdr = 52;    // file_version 6: sem o campo 'nametable' (surgiu na versao 7)
    if (b.size() < kHdr) return fail(error, "arquivo menor que o cabecalho AMX"), std::nullopt;
    Program p;
    Header& h = p.hdr_;
    h.size = rd<std::int32_t>(&b[0]);
    h.magic = rd<std::uint16_t>(&b[4]);
    h.file_version = static_cast<std::int8_t>(b[6]);
    h.amx_version = static_cast<std::int8_t>(b[7]);
    h.flags = rd<std::int16_t>(&b[8]);
    h.defsize = rd<std::int16_t>(&b[10]);
    h.cod = rd<std::int32_t>(&b[12]); h.dat = rd<std::int32_t>(&b[16]); h.hea = rd<std::int32_t>(&b[20]);
    h.stp = rd<std::int32_t>(&b[24]); h.cip = rd<std::int32_t>(&b[28]); h.publics = rd<std::int32_t>(&b[32]);
    h.natives = rd<std::int32_t>(&b[36]); h.libraries = rd<std::int32_t>(&b[40]);
    h.pubvars = rd<std::int32_t>(&b[44]); h.tags = rd<std::int32_t>(&b[48]); h.nametable = 0;

    if (h.magic != 0xF1E0) return fail(error, "magic != 0xF1E0 (so celulas de 32 bits)"), std::nullopt;
    if (h.file_version != 6) {
        if (error) *error = "file_version " + std::to_string(h.file_version) + " (esta VM so aceita 6)";
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    if (h.defsize < 8) return fail(error, "defsize invalido"), std::nullopt;
    const auto sz = static_cast<std::int64_t>(b.size());
    if (h.size > sz) return fail(error, "tamanho declarado maior que o arquivo"), std::nullopt;
    if (!(static_cast<std::int64_t>(kHdr) <= h.cod && h.cod <= h.dat && h.dat <= h.hea && h.hea <= h.stp &&
          h.hea <= sz && (h.dat - h.cod) % kCell == 0))
        return fail(error, "cod/dat/hea/stp fora de ordem ou fora do arquivo"), std::nullopt;
    if (!(h.publics <= h.natives && h.natives <= h.libraries && h.libraries <= h.pubvars && h.pubvars <= h.tags &&
          h.tags <= h.cod && h.publics >= static_cast<std::int32_t>(kHdr) && h.libraries <= h.cod))
        return fail(error, "tabelas de funcoes fora de ordem"), std::nullopt;

    auto read_table = [&](std::int32_t start, std::int32_t end, std::vector<FuncStub>& out) -> bool {
        if ((end - start) % h.defsize != 0) return false;
        for (std::int32_t o = start; o < end; o += h.defsize) {
            if (o + h.defsize > sz) return false;
            FuncStub f;
            f.address = rd<std::uint32_t>(&b[static_cast<std::size_t>(o)]);
            if (h.defsize == 8) {                                   // formato novo: nome na tabela de nomes
                const auto ofs = rd<std::uint32_t>(&b[static_cast<std::size_t>(o) + 4]);
                if (ofs >= b.size()) return false;
                f.name = cstr(b, ofs, 64);
            } else {                                                // formato antigo: nome embutido
                f.name = cstr(b, static_cast<std::size_t>(o) + 4, static_cast<std::size_t>(h.defsize) - 4);
            }
            out.push_back(std::move(f));
        }
        return true;
    };
    if (!read_table(h.publics, h.natives, p.publics_) || !read_table(h.natives, h.libraries, p.natives_))
        return fail(error, "tabela de publics/natives invalida"), std::nullopt;

    // Código: decodifica tudo, marcando o início de cada instrução.
    const std::size_t cells = static_cast<std::size_t>(h.dat - h.cod) / kCell;
    p.code_.resize(cells);
    if (cells) std::memcpy(p.code_.data(), &b[static_cast<std::size_t>(h.cod)], cells * kCell);
    p.starts_.assign(cells, false);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < cells;) {
        p.starts_[i] = true;
        const std::int32_t op = p.code_[i];
        if (op < 0 || op >= static_cast<std::int32_t>(kTable.size()))
            return fail(error, "opcode invalido " + std::to_string(op) + " na celula " + std::to_string(i)), std::nullopt;
        std::int64_t np = kTable[static_cast<std::size_t>(op)].params;
        if (np == -1) {                                              // FILE / SYMBOL: size (bytes de payload)
            if (i + 1 >= cells) return fail(error, "FILE/SYMBOL truncado"), std::nullopt;
            const std::int32_t s = p.code_[i + 1];
            if (s < 0 || s % kCell != 0) return fail(error, "FILE/SYMBOL com size invalido"), std::nullopt;
            np = 1 + s / kCell;
        } else if (np == -2) {                                       // CASETBL: num, default, num pares
            if (i + 1 >= cells) return fail(error, "CASETBL truncado"), std::nullopt;
            const std::int32_t n = p.code_[i + 1];
            if (n < 0 || n > 100000) return fail(error, "CASETBL absurdo"), std::nullopt;
            np = 2 + 2 * static_cast<std::int64_t>(n);
        }
        if (i + 1 + static_cast<std::size_t>(np) > cells)
            return fail(error, std::string("instrucao ") + kTable[static_cast<std::size_t>(op)].name + " ultrapassa o codigo"), std::nullopt;
        i += 1 + static_cast<std::size_t>(np);
    }
    for (const auto& f : p.publics_)
        if (f.address % kCell != 0 || !p.is_instruction_start(f.address / kCell))
            return fail(error, "public '" + f.name + "' nao aponta para uma instrucao"), std::nullopt;

    p.data_.assign(b.begin() + h.dat, b.begin() + h.hea);
    return p;
}

int Program::find_public(std::string_view n) const {
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < publics_.size(); ++i) if (publics_[i].name == n) return static_cast<int>(i);
    return -1;
}
int Program::find_native(std::string_view n) const {
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < natives_.size(); ++i) if (natives_[i].name == n) return static_cast<int>(i);
    return -1;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Machine
Machine::Machine(const Program& p) : prog_(p), mem_(static_cast<std::size_t>(p.memory_size()), 0),
                                      natives_(p.natives().size()), op_counts_(OP_COUNT, 0) {
    std::copy(p.initial_data().begin(), p.initial_data().end(), mem_.begin());
    hea_ = p.heap_start();
    stk_ = p.memory_size();
}

bool Machine::register_native(std::string_view name, NativeFn fn) {
    // Um script pode importar o mesmo nome mais de uma vez (include repetido): registra TODAS as entradas com esse nome (v17).
    bool any = false;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < prog_.natives().size(); ++i) {
        if (prog_.natives()[i].name != name) continue;
        natives_[i] = fn;
        any = true;
    }
    return any;
}

std::vector<std::string> Machine::unresolved_natives() const {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < natives_.size(); ++i) if (!natives_[i]) out.push_back(prog_.natives()[i].name);
    return out;
}

bool Machine::valid(std::int64_t addr, std::int64_t len) const {
    if (addr < 0 || len < 0) return false;
    const std::int64_t end = addr + len;
    if (end > static_cast<std::int64_t>(mem_.size())) return false;
    return !(addr < stk_ && end > hea_);          // a faixa entre o heap e a pilha é inválida
}

std::optional<std::int32_t> Machine::read_cell(std::int32_t addr) const {
    if (!valid(addr, kCell)) return std::nullopt;
    return rd<std::int32_t>(&mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(addr)]);
}
bool Machine::write_cell(std::int32_t addr, std::int32_t v) {
    if (!valid(addr, kCell)) return false;
    std::memcpy(&mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(addr)], &v, kCell);
    return true;
}

std::string Machine::read_string(std::int32_t addr, std::size_t max_len) const {
    std::string s;
    const auto first = read_cell(addr);
    if (!first) return s;
    const bool packed = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(*first) > 0xFFu;
    for (std::int32_t a = addr; s.size() < max_len; a += kCell) {
        const auto c = read_cell(a);
        if (!c) break;
        const auto u = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(*c);
        if (!packed) {
            if (u == 0) break;
            s.push_back(static_cast<char>(u & 0xFF));
        } else {
            bool end = false;
            for (int sh = 24; sh >= 0 && s.size() < max_len; sh -= 8) {
                const char ch = static_cast<char>((u >> sh) & 0xFF);
                if (ch == 0) { end = true; break; }
                s.push_back(ch);
            }
            if (end) break;
        }
    }
    return s;
}

bool Machine::write_string(std::int32_t addr, std::string_view text, std::size_t max_cells) {
    if (max_cells == 0) return false;
    const std::size_t n = std::min(text.size(), max_cells - 1);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        if (!write_cell(addr + static_cast<std::int32_t>(i) * kCell, static_cast<unsigned char>(text[i]))) return false;
    return write_cell(addr + static_cast<std::int32_t>(n) * kCell, 0);
}

std::optional<std::int32_t> Machine::heap_alloc(std::int32_t cells) {
    if (cells <= 0) return std::nullopt;
    const std::int32_t bytes = cells * kCell;
    if (hea_ + bytes > stk_) return std::nullopt;
    const std::int32_t at = hea_;
    hea_ += bytes;
    return at;
}

Err Machine::call(std::string_view name, std::span<const std::int32_t> args, std::int32_t* result) {
    const int i = prog_.find_public(name);
    return i < 0 ? Err::NotFound : call(i, args, result);
}

Err Machine::call(int idx, std::span<const std::int32_t> args, std::int32_t* result) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= static_cast<int>(prog_.publics().size())) return Err::NotFound;
    // Estado limpo a cada chamada (os dados globais do script são preservados entre chamadas).
    stk_ = prog_.memory_size();
    hea_ = prog_.heap_start();
    frm_ = stk_;
    pending_error_ = Err::None;
    call_start_ = executed_;
    auto push = [&](std::int32_t v) -> bool {
        stk_ -= kCell;
        if (stk_ < hea_) return false;
        std::memcpy(&mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(stk_)], &v, kCell);
        return true;
    };
    for (std::size_t i = args.size(); i-- > 0;) if (!push(args[i])) return Err::StackErr;
    if (!push(static_cast<std::int32_t>(args.size() * kCell)) || !push(0)) return Err::StackErr;   // nº de bytes + retorno 0 (HALT)
    return run(static_cast<std::int32_t>(prog_.publics()[static_cast<std::size_t>(idx)].address / kCell), result);
}

Err Machine::run(std::int32_t cip, std::int32_t* result) {
    const auto& code = prog_.code();
    const auto ncode = static_cast<std::int64_t>(code.size());
    const std::int32_t stp = prog_.memory_size();
    const std::int32_t hea0 = prog_.heap_start();
    std::int32_t pri = 0, alt = 0, frm = frm_, stk = stk_, hea = hea_;
    auto sync = [&] { stk_ = stk; hea_ = hea; frm_ = frm; pri_ = pri; alt_ = alt; };
    auto stop = [&](Err e) -> Err {
        sync();
        if (result) *result = pri;
        return e;
    };
    auto rd32 = [&](std::int64_t a, std::int32_t& v) -> bool {
        stk_ = stk; hea_ = hea;
        if (!valid(a, kCell)) return false;
        std::memcpy(&v, &mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(a)], kCell);
        return true;
    };
    auto wr32 = [&](std::int64_t a, std::int32_t v) -> bool {
        stk_ = stk; hea_ = hea;
        if (!valid(a, kCell)) return false;
        std::memcpy(&mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(a)], &v, kCell);
        return true;
    };
    auto W = [](std::int64_t x) { return static_cast<std::int32_t>(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(x)); };   // soma com wrap
    auto push = [&](std::int32_t v) -> bool {
        const std::int64_t ns = std::int64_t{stk} - kCell;
        if (ns < 0 || ns < hea || ns + kCell > stp) return false;
        stk = static_cast<std::int32_t>(ns);
        std::memcpy(&mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(stk)], &v, kCell);
        return true;
    };
    auto pop = [&](std::int32_t& v) -> bool {
        if (stk < 0 || std::int64_t{stk} + kCell > stp) return false;
        std::memcpy(&v, &mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(stk)], kCell);
        stk += kCell;
        return true;
    };
    auto jump_to = [&](std::int64_t byte_addr, std::int32_t& out) -> bool {
        if (byte_addr < 0 || byte_addr % kCell != 0) return false;
        const std::int64_t c = byte_addr / kCell;
        if (c >= ncode || !prog_.is_instruction_start(static_cast<std::size_t>(c))) return false;
        out = static_cast<std::int32_t>(c);
        return true;
    };
    auto floor_div = [](std::int32_t num, std::int32_t den, std::int32_t& q, std::int32_t& r) {
        if (num == std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::min() && den == -1) { q = num; r = 0; return; }
        q = num / den; r = num % den;
        if (r != 0 && ((r ^ den) < 0)) { --q; r += den; }
    };

    while (true) {
        if (++executed_ - call_start_ > limit_) return stop(Err::Limit);
        if (cip < 0 || cip >= ncode) return stop(Err::InvInstr);
        const std::int32_t op = code[static_cast<std::size_t>(cip)];
        if (op < 0 || op >= OP_COUNT) return stop(Err::InvInstr);
        ++op_counts_[static_cast<std::size_t>(op)];
        const std::int32_t* P = &code[static_cast<std::size_t>(cip) + 1];   // parâmetros (com checagem no carregamento)
        std::int32_t next = cip + 1 + std::max(0, kTable[static_cast<std::size_t>(op)].params);
        if (kTable[static_cast<std::size_t>(op)].params == -1) {         // FILE / SYMBOL (scripts compilados com simbolos de depuracao): [size][size bytes de payload]
            // O tamanho foi validado em Program::load. SEM isto o payload (nomes de simbolos, numeros de linha) era executado como se fosse codigo
            // e TODA public de um script compilado com -d falhava com "instrucao invalida" (v17).
            next = cip + 2 + P[0] / kCell;
        }
        const std::int32_t p0 = (kTable[static_cast<std::size_t>(op)].params >= 1 || kTable[static_cast<std::size_t>(op)].params < 0) ? P[0] : 0;
        std::int32_t t = 0;
        auto bad = [&](Err e) { return stop(e); };
        auto jcond = [&](bool c) -> bool {                // devolve false se o salto é inválido
            if (!c) return true;
            return jump_to(p0, next);
        };
        switch (op) {
            case NONE: return bad(Err::InvInstr);
            case LOAD_PRI: if (!rd32(p0, pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case LOAD_ALT: if (!rd32(p0, alt)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case LOAD_S_PRI: if (!rd32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case LOAD_S_ALT: if (!rd32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, alt)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case LREF_PRI: if (!rd32(p0, t) || !rd32(t, pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case LREF_ALT: if (!rd32(p0, t) || !rd32(t, alt)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case LREF_S_PRI: if (!rd32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, t) || !rd32(t, pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case LREF_S_ALT: if (!rd32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, t) || !rd32(t, alt)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case LOAD_I: if (!rd32(pri, pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case LODB_I: {
                if (p0 != 1 && p0 != 2 && p0 != 4) return bad(Err::InvInstr);
                stk_ = stk; hea_ = hea;
                if (!valid(pri, p0)) return bad(Err::MemAccess);
                std::uint32_t v = 0;
                std::memcpy(&v, &mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(pri)], static_cast<std::size_t>(p0));
                pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(v);
                break;
            }
            case CONST_PRI: pri = p0; break;
            case CONST_ALT: alt = p0; break;
            case ADDR_PRI: pri = W(std::int64_t{frm} + p0); break;
            case ADDR_ALT: alt = W(std::int64_t{frm} + p0); break;
            case STOR_PRI: if (!wr32(p0, pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case STOR_ALT: if (!wr32(p0, alt)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case STOR_S_PRI: if (!wr32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case STOR_S_ALT: if (!wr32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, alt)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case SREF_PRI: if (!rd32(p0, t) || !wr32(t, pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case SREF_ALT: if (!rd32(p0, t) || !wr32(t, alt)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case SREF_S_PRI: if (!rd32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, t) || !wr32(t, pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case SREF_S_ALT: if (!rd32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, t) || !wr32(t, alt)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case STOR_I: if (!wr32(alt, pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case STRB_I: {
                if (p0 != 1 && p0 != 2 && p0 != 4) return bad(Err::InvInstr);
                stk_ = stk; hea_ = hea;
                if (!valid(alt, p0)) return bad(Err::MemAccess);
                std::memcpy(&mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(alt)], &pri, static_cast<std::size_t>(p0));
                break;
            }
            case LIDX: if (!rd32(std::int64_t{alt} + std::int64_t{pri} * kCell, pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case LIDX_B: if (!rd32(std::int64_t{alt} + (std::int64_t{pri} << (p0 & 31)), pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case IDXADDR: pri = W(std::int64_t{alt} + std::int64_t{pri} * kCell); break;
            case IDXADDR_B: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(alt) + (std::uint32_t(pri) << (p0 & 31))); break;
            case ALIGN_PRI: if (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p0) < kCell) pri ^= kCell - p0; break;
            case ALIGN_ALT: if (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p0) < kCell) alt ^= kCell - p0; break;
            case LCTRL:
                switch (p0) {
                    case 0: pri = prog_.header().cod; break;
                    case 1: pri = prog_.header().dat; break;
                    case 2: pri = hea; break;
                    case 3: pri = stp; break;
                    case 4: pri = stk; break;
                    case 5: pri = frm; break;
                    case 6: pri = next * kCell; break;
                    default: break;
                }
                break;
            case SCTRL:
                switch (p0) {
                    case 2: if (pri < hea0 || pri > stk) return bad(Err::InvInstr); hea = pri; break;
                    case 4: if (pri < hea || pri > stp) return bad(Err::InvInstr); stk = pri; break;
                    case 5: frm = pri; break;
                    case 6: if (!jump_to(pri, next)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
                    default: break;
                }
                break;
            case MOVE_PRI: pri = alt; break;
            case MOVE_ALT: alt = pri; break;
            case XCHG: std::swap(pri, alt); break;
            case PUSH_PRI: if (!push(pri)) return bad(Err::StackErr); break;
            case PUSH_ALT: if (!push(alt)) return bad(Err::StackErr); break;
            case PUSH_R: if (p0 < 0 || p0 > 65536) return bad(Err::InvInstr); for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < p0; ++i) if (!push(pri)) return bad(Err::StackErr); break;
            case PUSH_C: if (!push(p0)) return bad(Err::StackErr); break;
            case PUSH: if (!rd32(p0, t)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); if (!push(t)) return bad(Err::StackErr); break;
            case PUSH_S: if (!rd32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, t)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); if (!push(t)) return bad(Err::StackErr); break;
            case POP_PRI: if (!pop(pri)) return bad(Err::StackLow); break;
            case POP_ALT: if (!pop(alt)) return bad(Err::StackLow); break;
            case STACK: {
                const std::int64_t ns = std::int64_t{stk} + p0;
                if (ns > stp) return bad(Err::StackLow);
                if (ns < hea) return bad(Err::StackErr);
                alt = stk;
                stk = static_cast<std::int32_t>(ns);
                break;
            }
            case HEAP: {
                const std::int64_t nh = std::int64_t{hea} + p0;
                if (nh < hea0) return bad(Err::HeapLow);
                if (nh > stk) return bad(Err::StackErr);
                alt = hea;
                hea = static_cast<std::int32_t>(nh);
                break;
            }
            case PROC: if (!push(frm)) return bad(Err::StackErr); frm = stk; break;
            case RET: {
                std::int32_t ra = 0;
                if (!pop(frm) || !pop(ra)) return bad(Err::StackLow);
                if (!jump_to(ra, next)) return bad(Err::InvInstr);
                break;
            }
            case RETN: {
                std::int32_t ra = 0, nbytes = 0;
                if (!pop(frm) || !pop(ra)) return bad(Err::StackLow);
                if (!rd32(stk, nbytes)) return bad(Err::StackLow);
                const std::int64_t ns = std::int64_t{stk} + nbytes + kCell;
                if (nbytes < 0 || ns > stp) return bad(Err::StackLow);
                stk = static_cast<std::int32_t>(ns);
                if (!jump_to(ra, next)) return bad(Err::InvInstr);
                break;
            }
            case CALL: if (!push(next * kCell)) return bad(Err::StackErr); if (!jump_to(p0, next)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case CALL_PRI: if (!push(next * kCell)) return bad(Err::StackErr); if (!jump_to(pri, next)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JUMP: if (!jump_to(p0, next)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JREL: {                                    // relativo ao endereço do parâmetro (a confirmar em scripts reais)
                const std::int64_t target = (std::int64_t{cip} + 1) * kCell + p0;
                if (!jump_to(target, next)) return bad(Err::InvInstr);
                break;
            }
            case JZER: if (!jcond(pri == 0)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JNZ: if (!jcond(pri != 0)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JEQ: if (!jcond(pri == alt)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JNEQ: if (!jcond(pri != alt)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JLESS: if (!jcond(std::uint32_t(pri) < std::uint32_t(alt))) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JLEQ: if (!jcond(std::uint32_t(pri) <= std::uint32_t(alt))) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JGRTR: if (!jcond(std::uint32_t(pri) > std::uint32_t(alt))) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JGEQ: if (!jcond(std::uint32_t(pri) >= std::uint32_t(alt))) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JSLESS: if (!jcond(pri < alt)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JSLEQ: if (!jcond(pri <= alt)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JSGRTR: if (!jcond(pri > alt)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case JSGEQ: if (!jcond(pri >= alt)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case SHL: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(pri) << (alt & 31)); break;
            case SHR: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(pri) >> (alt & 31)); break;
            case SSHR: pri >>= (alt & 31); break;
            case SHL_C_PRI: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(pri) << (p0 & 31)); break;
            case SHL_C_ALT: alt = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(alt) << (p0 & 31)); break;
            case SHR_C_PRI: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(pri) >> (p0 & 31)); break;
            case SHR_C_ALT: alt = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(alt) >> (p0 & 31)); break;
            case SMUL: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(pri) * std::uint32_t(alt)); break;
            case SDIV: {                                    // PRI = PRI / ALT (arredondado para baixo), ALT = resto
                if (alt == 0) return bad(Err::Divide);
                std::int32_t q, r;
                floor_div(pri, alt, q, r);
                pri = q; alt = r;
                break;
            }
            case SDIV_ALT: {                                // PRI = ALT / PRI, ALT = resto
                if (pri == 0) return bad(Err::Divide);
                std::int32_t q, r;
                floor_div(alt, pri, q, r);
                pri = q; alt = r;
                break;
            }
            case UMUL: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(pri) * std::uint32_t(alt)); break;
            case UDIV: {
                if (alt == 0) return bad(Err::Divide);
                const std::uint32_t a = std::uint32_t(pri), b = std::uint32_t(alt);
                pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(a / b); alt = static_cast<std::int32_t>(a % b);
                break;
            }
            case UDIV_ALT: {
                if (pri == 0) return bad(Err::Divide);
                const std::uint32_t a = std::uint32_t(alt), b = std::uint32_t(pri);
                pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(a / b); alt = static_cast<std::int32_t>(a % b);
                break;
            }
            case ADD: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(pri) + std::uint32_t(alt)); break;
            case SUB: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(pri) - std::uint32_t(alt)); break;
            case SUB_ALT: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(alt) - std::uint32_t(pri)); break;
            case AND: pri &= alt; break;
            case OR: pri |= alt; break;
            case XOR: pri ^= alt; break;
            case NOT: pri = !pri; break;
            case NEG: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(0u - std::uint32_t(pri)); break;
            case INVERT: pri = ~pri; break;
            case ADD_C: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(pri) + std::uint32_t(p0)); break;
            case SMUL_C: pri = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::uint32_t(pri) * std::uint32_t(p0)); break;
            case ZERO_PRI: pri = 0; break;
            case ZERO_ALT: alt = 0; break;
            case ZERO: if (!wr32(p0, 0)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case ZERO_S: if (!wr32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, 0)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case SIGN_PRI: pri = static_cast<std::int8_t>(pri); break;
            case SIGN_ALT: alt = static_cast<std::int8_t>(alt); break;
            case EQ: pri = pri == alt; break;
            case NEQ: pri = pri != alt; break;
            case LESS: pri = std::uint32_t(pri) < std::uint32_t(alt); break;
            case LEQ: pri = std::uint32_t(pri) <= std::uint32_t(alt); break;
            case GRTR: pri = std::uint32_t(pri) > std::uint32_t(alt); break;
            case GEQ: pri = std::uint32_t(pri) >= std::uint32_t(alt); break;
            case SLESS: pri = pri < alt; break;
            case SLEQ: pri = pri <= alt; break;
            case SGRTR: pri = pri > alt; break;
            case SGEQ: pri = pri >= alt; break;
            case EQ_C_PRI: pri = pri == p0; break;
            case EQ_C_ALT: pri = alt == p0; break;
            case INC_PRI: pri = W(std::int64_t{pri} + 1); break;
            case INC_ALT: alt = W(std::int64_t{alt} + 1); break;
            case INC: if (!rd32(p0, t) || !wr32(p0, W(std::int64_t{t} + 1))) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case INC_S: if (!rd32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, t) || !wr32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, W(std::int64_t{t} + 1))) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case INC_I: if (!rd32(pri, t) || !wr32(pri, W(std::int64_t{t} + 1))) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case DEC_PRI: pri = W(std::int64_t{pri} - 1); break;
            case DEC_ALT: alt = W(std::int64_t{alt} - 1); break;
            case DEC: if (!rd32(p0, t) || !wr32(p0, W(std::int64_t{t} - 1))) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case DEC_S: if (!rd32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, t) || !wr32(std::int64_t{frm} + p0, W(std::int64_t{t} - 1))) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case DEC_I: if (!rd32(pri, t) || !wr32(pri, W(std::int64_t{t} - 1))) return bad(Err::MemAccess); break;
            case MOVS: {
                stk_ = stk; hea_ = hea;
                if (p0 < 0 || !valid(pri, p0) || !valid(alt, p0)) return bad(Err::MemAccess);
                std::memmove(&mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(alt)], &mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(pri)], static_cast<std::size_t>(p0));
                break;
            }
            case CMPS: {                                    // PRI = comparacao do bloco em ALT com o bloco em PRI
                stk_ = stk; hea_ = hea;
                if (p0 < 0 || !valid(pri, p0) || !valid(alt, p0)) return bad(Err::MemAccess);
                const int c = std::memcmp(&mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(alt)], &mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(pri)], static_cast<std::size_t>(p0));
                pri = c;
                break;
            }
            case FILL: {
                stk_ = stk; hea_ = hea;
                if (p0 < 0 || !valid(alt, p0)) return bad(Err::MemAccess);
                for (std::int32_t i = 0; i + kCell <= p0; i += kCell) std::memcpy(&mem_[static_cast<std::size_t>(alt) + static_cast<std::size_t>(i)], &pri, kCell);
                break;
            }
            case HALT: return stop(static_cast<Err>(p0));
            case BOUNDS: if (std::uint32_t(pri) > std::uint32_t(p0)) return bad(Err::Bounds); break;
            case SYSREQ_PRI:
            case SYSREQ_C: {
                const std::int32_t index = op == SYSREQ_C ? p0 : pri;
                if (index < 0 || index >= static_cast<std::int32_t>(natives_.size()) || !natives_[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)])
                    return bad(Err::Callback);
                std::int32_t params[66] = {0};
                std::int32_t nbytes = 0;
                if (!rd32(stk, nbytes)) return bad(Err::MemAccess);
                const std::int32_t ncells = std::min<std::int32_t>(std::max<std::int32_t>(nbytes / kCell, 0), 64);
                for (std::int32_t i = 0; i <= ncells; ++i) if (!rd32(stk + i * kCell, params[i])) return bad(Err::MemAccess);
                sync();
                pending_error_ = Err::None;
                pri = natives_[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)](*this, params);
                // a nativa pode ter mexido no heap (heap_alloc) e na memória; recarrega o heap
                hea = hea_;
                if (pending_error_ != Err::None) { const Err e = pending_error_; pending_error_ = Err::None; return stop(e); }
                break;
            }
            case SYSREQ_D: return bad(Err::InvInstr);
            case FILE: case SYMBOL: case LINE: case SRANGE: case SYMTAG: case BREAK: case NOP: break;
            case JUMP_PRI: if (!jump_to(pri, next)) return bad(Err::InvInstr); break;
            case SWITCH: {
                std::int64_t tc = p0;
                if (tc < 0 || tc % kCell != 0 || tc / kCell >= ncode) return bad(Err::InvInstr);
                const std::size_t ti = static_cast<std::size_t>(tc / kCell);
                if (!prog_.is_instruction_start(ti) || code[ti] != CASETBL) return bad(Err::InvInstr);
                const std::int32_t num = code[ti + 1];
                std::int32_t target = code[ti + 2];
                for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < num; ++i) {
                    if (code[ti + 3 + 2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] == pri) { target = code[ti + 4 + 2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i)]; break; }
                }
                if (!jump_to(target, next)) return bad(Err::InvInstr);
                break;
            }
            case CASETBL: return bad(Err::InvInstr);
            case SWAP_PRI: { if (!rd32(stk, t) || !wr32(stk, pri)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); pri = t; break; }
            case SWAP_ALT: { if (!rd32(stk, t) || !wr32(stk, alt)) return bad(Err::MemAccess); alt = t; break; }
            case PUSH_ADR: if (!push(W(std::int64_t{frm} + p0))) return bad(Err::StackErr); break;
            default: return bad(Err::InvInstr);
        }
        cip = next;
    }
}

}  // namespace f3vb::amx
```

## src/amx/amx_vm.hpp

```cpp
// Máquina abstrata Pawn/Small, instruction set CLÁSSICO (AMX file_version 6, células de 32 bits).
//
// Por que existe: o Pawn 4.x recusa estes arquivos (exige file_version >= 11 e mudou o conjunto de
// instruções na versão 4.0). Esta VM roda os scripts de 2003 da demo do Van Buren como estão.
// A tabela de opcodes foi VALIDADA decodificando por completo o código dos scripts reais (ver
// docs/ACHADOS_DEMO.md). Referência de semântica: Pawn 4.1 (Apache-2.0, CompuPhase), ver NOTICE-PAWN.md.
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace f3vb::amx {

enum class Err : int {
    None = 0, Exit = 1, Assert = 2, StackErr = 3, Bounds = 4, MemAccess = 5, InvInstr = 6, StackLow = 7,
    HeapLow = 8, Callback = 9, Native = 10, Divide = 11, Sleep = 12, InvState = 13,
    Memory = 16, Format = 17, Version = 18,
    NotFound = 19, Params = 20, Limit = 21
};
const char* err_name(Err e);

struct Header {
    std::int32_t size = 0;
    std::uint16_t magic = 0;
    std::int8_t file_version = 0, amx_version = 0;
    std::int16_t flags = 0, defsize = 0;
    std::int32_t cod = 0, dat = 0, hea = 0, stp = 0, cip = -1;
    std::int32_t publics = 0, natives = 0, libraries = 0, pubvars = 0, tags = 0, nametable = 0;   // nametable: so a partir da versao 7
};

struct FuncStub {
    std::uint32_t address = 0;
    std::string name;
};

class Program {
public:
    // Carrega e valida (cabeçalho, tabelas, e a decodificação completa do código). Em erro devolve nullopt.
    static std::optional<Program> load(std::span<const std::uint8_t> bytes, std::string* error = nullptr);

    const Header& header() const { return hdr_; }
    const std::vector<std::int32_t>& code() const { return code_; }
    const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& initial_data() const { return data_; }
    const std::vector<FuncStub>& publics() const { return publics_; }
    const std::vector<FuncStub>& natives() const { return natives_; }
    bool is_instruction_start(std::size_t cell) const { return cell < starts_.size() && starts_[cell]; }
    int find_public(std::string_view name) const;
    int find_native(std::string_view name) const;
    std::int32_t memory_size() const { return hdr_.stp - hdr_.dat; }   // dados + heap + pilha
    std::int32_t heap_start() const { return hdr_.hea - hdr_.dat; }

private:
    Header hdr_{};
    std::vector<std::int32_t> code_;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> data_;
    std::vector<FuncStub> publics_, natives_;
    std::vector<bool> starts_;
};

class Machine;
// params[0] = bytes de argumentos; params[1..] = argumentos (cópia: seguro para ler/escrever).
using NativeFn = std::function<std::int32_t(Machine&, const std::int32_t* params)>;

class Machine {
public:
    explicit Machine(const Program& program);

    // Associa uma função nativa pelo nome (devolve false se o script não importa esse nome).
    bool register_native(std::string_view name, NativeFn fn);
    std::vector<std::string> unresolved_natives() const;

    // Executa uma função pública. Argumentos na ordem de declaração.
    Err call(int public_index, std::span<const std::int32_t> args, std::int32_t* result = nullptr);
    Err call(std::string_view name, std::span<const std::int32_t> args, std::int32_t* result = nullptr);

    // Acesso à memória do script (para as nativas). Endereços são relativos ao início dos dados.
    std::optional<std::int32_t> read_cell(std::int32_t addr) const;
    bool write_cell(std::int32_t addr, std::int32_t value);
    // Strings Pawn: desempacotadas (1 caractere por célula) ou empacotadas (4 por célula, o primeiro no byte alto).
    std::string read_string(std::int32_t addr, std::size_t max_len = 1024) const;
    bool write_string(std::int32_t addr, std::string_view text, std::size_t max_cells);
    // Reserva espaço no heap do script (para as nativas devolverem dados); devolve o endereço ou nullopt.
    std::optional<std::int32_t> heap_alloc(std::int32_t cells);

    // Uma nativa chama isto para abortar a execução com um erro.
    void abort(Err e) { pending_error_ = e; }

    void set_instruction_limit(std::uint64_t n) { limit_ = n; }   // por chamada a call()
    std::uint64_t instructions_executed() const { return executed_; }
    const Program& program() const { return prog_; }
    // Estatística: quantas vezes cada opcode foi executado (índice = opcode).
    const std::vector<std::uint64_t>& opcode_counts() const { return op_counts_; }

private:
    bool valid(std::int64_t addr, std::int64_t len) const;
    Err run(std::int32_t start_cip, std::int32_t* result);

    const Program& prog_;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> mem_;
    std::vector<NativeFn> natives_;
    std::int32_t pri_ = 0, alt_ = 0, frm_ = 0, stk_ = 0, hea_ = 0;
    Err pending_error_ = Err::None;
    std::uint64_t limit_ = 50'000'000, executed_ = 0, call_start_ = 0;   // limite por chamada
    std::vector<std::uint64_t> op_counts_;
};

// Tabela de opcodes (nome e número de parâmetros; -1 = FILE/SYMBOL de tamanho variável; -2 = CASETBL).
struct OpInfo { const char* name; int params; };
const std::vector<OpInfo>& opcode_table();

}  // namespace f3vb::amx
```

## src/formats/archive.hpp

```cpp
// Leitores de cabeçalho/tabela de .grp e resource.rht (layouts em docs/specs, a confirmar
// em arquivos reais). Somente validação e acesso; sem alocar os dados dos lumps.
// Espelha tools/py/f3vb/grp.py e rht.py.
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "chunk.hpp"  // read_le32

namespace f3vb {

struct GrpLump {
    std::uint32_t offset;
    std::uint32_t length;
    std::uint64_t end() const { return std::uint64_t{offset} + length; }
};

struct GrpArchive {
    std::uint32_t v_major = 0, v_minor = 0, n_files = 0;
    std::size_t file_size = 0;
    std::vector<GrpLump> lumps;
    std::vector<std::string> issues;
};

// Retorna nullopt se o buffer não puder ser um .grp (cabeçalho ou tabela não cabem).
inline std::optional<GrpArchive> parse_grp(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size) {
    constexpr std::size_t kHeader = 12, kLump = 8;
    if (size < kHeader) return std::nullopt;
    GrpArchive a;
    a.v_major = read_le32(data);
    a.v_minor = read_le32(data + 4);
    a.n_files = read_le32(data + 8);
    a.file_size = size;
    const std::uint64_t table_end = kHeader + std::uint64_t{kLump} * a.n_files;
    if (table_end > size) return std::nullopt;
    a.lumps.reserve(a.n_files);
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < a.n_files; ++i) {
        const std::uint8_t* p = data + kHeader + std::size_t{kLump} * i;
        GrpLump l{read_le32(p), read_le32(p + 4)};
        if (l.end() > size) {
            a.issues.push_back("lump " + std::to_string(i) + ": fora do arquivo");
        } else if (l.length != 0 && l.offset < table_end) {
            a.issues.push_back("lump " + std::to_string(i) + ": começa dentro da tabela");
        }
        a.lumps.push_back(l);
    }
    return a;
}

struct RhtEntry {
    std::uint32_t one, number, type, offset, pack;
};

struct RhtFile {
    std::uint32_t v_major = 0, v_minor = 0, n_entries = 0, offset_packs = 0, offset_resources = 0;
    std::vector<RhtEntry> entries;
};

inline std::optional<RhtFile> parse_rht(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size) {
    constexpr std::size_t kHeader = 20, kEntry = 20;
    if (size < kHeader) return std::nullopt;
    RhtFile f;
    f.v_major = read_le32(data);
    f.v_minor = read_le32(data + 4);
    f.n_entries = read_le32(data + 8);
    f.offset_packs = read_le32(data + 12);
    f.offset_resources = read_le32(data + 16);
    if (kHeader + std::uint64_t{kEntry} * f.n_entries > size) return std::nullopt;
    f.entries.reserve(f.n_entries);
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < f.n_entries; ++i) {
        const std::uint8_t* p = data + kHeader + std::size_t{kEntry} * i;
        f.entries.push_back({read_le32(p), read_le32(p + 4), read_le32(p + 8), read_le32(p + 12),
                             read_le32(p + 16)});
    }
    return f;
}

}  // namespace f3vb
```

## src/formats/chunk.hpp

```cpp
// Cabeçalho de chunk: tag[4] + version(u32) + size(u32, inclui os 12 bytes).
// Little-endian lido byte a byte (independe da plataforma). Espelha tools/py/f3vb/chunk.py.
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <optional>
#include <string_view>

namespace f3vb {

inline constexpr std::size_t kChunkHeaderSize = 12;

struct ChunkHeader {
    char tag[4];
    std::uint32_t version;
    std::uint32_t size;  // total, inclui o cabeçalho

    std::string_view tag_view() const { return {tag, 4}; }
    std::size_t payload_size() const { return size - kChunkHeaderSize; }
};

inline std::uint32_t read_le32(const std::uint8_t* p) {
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[0]) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[1]) << 8) |
           (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[2]) << 16) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[3]) << 24);
}

// Lê e valida um cabeçalho. `avail` = bytes disponíveis a partir de `data`.
inline std::optional<ChunkHeader> read_chunk_header(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t avail) {
    if (avail < kChunkHeaderSize) return std::nullopt;
    ChunkHeader h{};
    std::memcpy(h.tag, data, 4);
    for (char c : h.tag) {
        if (c < 32 || c > 126) return std::nullopt;
    }
    h.version = read_le32(data + 4);
    h.size = read_le32(data + 8);
    if (h.size < kChunkHeaderSize || h.size > avail) return std::nullopt;
    return h;
}

}  // namespace f3vb
```

## src/host/dialog_dump.cpp

```cpp
// Executa um script AMX real com a camada de natives e imprime: o log de cada public, a arvore de dialogo
// (nos e respostas) e as natives que ainda faltam implementar.
//   dialog_dump ARQ.amx [--seed N] [--quiet]
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "game_host.hpp"

using namespace f3vb;

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) { std::puts("uso: dialog_dump ARQ.amx [--seed N] [--quiet]"); return 2; }
    std::ifstream f(argv[1], std::ios::binary);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    std::uint32_t seed = 1;
    bool quiet = false;
    for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (!std::strcmp(argv[i], "--seed") && i + 1 < argc) seed = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::atoi(argv[++i]));
        if (!std::strcmp(argv[i], "--quiet")) quiet = true;
    }
    std::string err;
    auto prog = amx::Program::load(bytes, &err);
    if (!prog) { std::printf("ERRO ao carregar: %s\n", err.c_str()); return 1; }
    amx::Machine m(*prog);
    host::GameHost h(m, seed);
    h.install();
    std::printf("script: %zu publics, %zu natives\n\n", prog->publics().size(), prog->natives().size());
    int failures = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < prog->publics().size(); ++i) {
        h.clear_events();
        std::int32_t r = 0;
        const amx::Err e = m.call(static_cast<int>(i), {}, &r);
        if (e != amx::Err::None) ++failures;
        if (!quiet) {
            std::printf("%-22s -> %s (ret %d)\n", prog->publics()[i].name.c_str(), amx::err_name(e), r);
            for (const auto& ev : h.events()) {
                std::printf("    %s%s(", ev.implemented ? "" : "[so-log] ", ev.native.c_str());
                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < ev.args.size(); ++k) {
                    std::printf("%s%d", k ? ", " : "", ev.args[k]);
                    if (k < ev.strings.size() && !ev.strings[k].empty()) std::printf(" \"%s\"", ev.strings[k].c_str());
                }
                std::printf(")\n");
            }
        }
    }
    std::puts("\n=== Arvore de dialogo ===");
    for (const auto& n : h.nodes()) {
        std::printf("no \"%s\"  (funcao de texto: \"%s\")\n", n.name.c_str(), n.text_fn.c_str());
        for (const auto& r : n.replies)
            std::printf("   resposta #%d  texto(id)=%d  condicao=\"%s\"  resultado=\"%s\"\n", r.id, r.text_id,
                        r.action_fn.c_str(), r.link_fn.c_str());
    }
    std::printf("\nfalhas de execucao: %d\n", failures);
    return failures ? 1 : 0;
}
```

## src/host/game_host.cpp

```cpp
#include "game_host.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>

namespace f3vb::host {

using f3vb::amx::Machine;

float GameHost::as_float(std::int32_t c) {
    float f;
    std::memcpy(&f, &c, sizeof f);
    return f;
}
std::int32_t GameHost::from_float(float f) {
    std::int32_t c;
    std::memcpy(&c, &f, sizeof c);
    return c;
}

static std::int32_t arg(const std::int32_t* p, int i) {          // argumento i (1-based); 0 se ausente
    return i <= p[0] / 4 ? p[i] : 0;
}

void GameHost::log(const std::string& name, const std::int32_t* p, bool implemented, bool decode_strings) {
    Event e;
    e.native = name;
    e.implemented = implemented;
    const int n = std::min(p[0] / 4, 16);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        e.args.push_back(p[i]);
        if (decode_strings) {
            std::string s;
            if (p[i] >= 4 && p[i] % 4 == 0) s = vm_.read_string(p[i], 64);       // endereco de texto plausivel
            const bool printable = s.size() >= 2 && std::all_of(s.begin(), s.end(), [](unsigned char c) { return c >= 32 && c < 127; });
            e.strings.push_back(printable ? s : std::string());
        }
    }
    events_.push_back(std::move(e));
}

DialogNode& GameHost::current_node() {
    if (nodes_.empty()) nodes_.push_back(DialogNode{"(sem nome)", "", {}});
    return nodes_.back();
}

std::map<std::string, int> GameHost::unimplemented_calls() const {
    std::map<std::string, int> out;
    for (const auto& e : events_) if (!e.implemented) ++out[e.native];
    return out;
}

void GameHost::install() {
    // ---- implementadas: ponto flutuante (semantica do float.inc do Pawn) ----
    auto bin = [&](const char* name, float (*f)(float, float)) {
        vm_.register_native(name, [f](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) {
            return from_float(f(as_float(arg(p, 1)), as_float(arg(p, 2))));
        });
    };
    bin("floatadd", [](float a, float b) { return a + b; });
    bin("floatsub", [](float a, float b) { return a - b; });
    bin("floatmul", [](float a, float b) { return a * b; });
    bin("floatdiv", [](float a, float b) { return a / b; });
    vm_.register_native("float", [](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) { return from_float(static_cast<float>(arg(p, 1))); });
    vm_.register_native("floatcmp", [](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) {
        const float a = as_float(arg(p, 1)), b = as_float(arg(p, 2));
        return a == b ? 0 : (a > b ? 1 : -1);
    });
    vm_.register_native("floatround", [](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) {
        const float v = as_float(arg(p, 1));
        switch (arg(p, 2)) {
            case 1: return static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::floor(v));
            case 2: return static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::ceil(v));
            case 3: return static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::trunc(v));
            default: return static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::floor(v + 0.5f));
        }
    });
    vm_.register_native("floatfract", [](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) {
        const float v = as_float(arg(p, 1));
        return from_float(v - std::floor(v));
    });

    // ---- implementadas: utilitarios e estado ----
    vm_.register_native("RandomNumber", [this](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) {
        std::int32_t lo = arg(p, 1), hi = arg(p, 2);
        if (hi < lo) std::swap(lo, hi);
        std::uniform_int_distribution<std::int32_t> d(lo, hi);
        const auto v = d(rng_);
        log("RandomNumber", p, true);
        return v;
    });
    vm_.register_native("Myself", [this](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) { log("Myself", p, true); return self_id; });
    vm_.register_native("GetGlobal", [this](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) {
        log("GetGlobal", p, true);
        const auto it = globals.find(arg(p, 1));
        return it == globals.end() ? 0 : it->second;
    });
    vm_.register_native("SetGlobal", [this](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) {
        log("SetGlobal", p, true);
        globals[arg(p, 1)] = arg(p, 2);
        return 0;
    });

    // ---- implementadas: dialogo (observadas em scripts reais) ----
    vm_.register_native("SetCurrentNodeName", [this](Machine& m, const std::int32_t* p) {
        log("SetCurrentNodeName", p, true, true);
        nodes_.push_back(DialogNode{m.read_string(arg(p, 1)), "", {}});
        return 0;
    });
    vm_.register_native("SetNodeTextFunction", [this](Machine& m, const std::int32_t* p) {
        log("SetNodeTextFunction", p, true, true);
        current_node().text_fn = m.read_string(arg(p, 1));
        return 0;
    });
    vm_.register_native("RegisterReply", [this](Machine& m, const std::int32_t* p) {
        log("RegisterReply", p, true, true);
        current_node().replies.push_back(Reply{arg(p, 1), arg(p, 2), m.read_string(arg(p, 3)), m.read_string(arg(p, 4))});
        return 0;
    });
    // v19: fala do NPC no no atual (medido: "00 Corporal Armstrong" -> RegisterNodeText(850) = "How can I help you, citizen?", id 1-based no .stf)
    vm_.register_native("RegisterNodeText", [this](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) {
        log("RegisterNodeText", p, true);
        speeches_.push_back(Speech{"RegisterNodeText", self_id, arg(p, 1), 255, 255, 255});
        return 0;
    });
    vm_.register_native("FloatingSpeechText", [this](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) {
        log("FloatingSpeechText", p, true);
        speeches_.push_back(Speech{"FloatingSpeechText", arg(p, 1), arg(p, 2), arg(p, 4), arg(p, 5), arg(p, 6)});   // (entidade, id do texto, 0, R, G, B)
        return 0;
    });
    // PCSpeaker: fala do jogador. PROVISORIO: assume (id do texto) como 1o argumento; continua contada como "nao implementada" no relatorio.
    vm_.register_native("PCSpeaker", [this](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) {
        log("PCSpeaker", p, false);
        speeches_.push_back(Speech{"PCSpeaker", 0, arg(p, 1), 255, 255, 255});
        return 0;
    });

    // ---- todas as demais: somente log ----
    for (const auto& n : vm_.program().natives()) {
        const std::string name = n.name;
        if (vm_.program().find_native(name) >= 0) {
            bool registered = true;
            for (const auto& u : vm_.unresolved_natives()) if (u == name) registered = false;
            if (registered) continue;
        }
        vm_.register_native(name, [this, name](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) {
            log(name, p, false, true);                  // v17: decodifica argumentos que parecem texto (ajuda a entender natives de UI/menus)
            return 0;
        });
    }
}

}  // namespace f3vb::host
```

## src/host/game_host.hpp

```cpp
// Camada de "funcoes dos scripts" (natives) para a VM AMX da F3VB.
//
// Estado da implementacao (honesto):
//  - Implementadas de verdade: biblioteca de ponto flutuante (float, floatadd, floatsub, floatmul, floatdiv, floatcmp,
//    floatround, floatfract), RandomNumber, Myself, GetGlobal/SetGlobal e as de dialogo observadas em scripts reais
//    (SetCurrentNodeName, SetNodeTextFunction, RegisterReply, FloatingSpeechText). v17: FloatingSpeechText e PCSpeaker tambem guardam a fala em speeches().
//  - TODAS as outras natives importadas pelo script sao registradas como "somente log": registram nome e argumentos
//    em events() e devolvem 0. Assim qualquer script roda ate o fim e sabemos exatamente o que falta implementar.
//  - Semantica dos argumentos e PROVISORIA (deduzida dos nomes e de scripts reais); ver docs/NATIVES.md.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <random>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "../amx/amx_vm.hpp"

namespace f3vb::host {

struct Event {
    std::string native;
    std::vector<std::int32_t> args;
    std::vector<std::string> strings;       // argumentos que parecem enderecos de texto, ja decodificados
    bool implemented = false;
};

// Fala registrada por FloatingSpeechText (entidade, id do texto, cor RGB) ou PCSpeaker (entidade 0 = jogador; semantica PROVISORIA).
struct Speech {
    std::string native;
    std::int32_t entity = 0, text_id = 0;
    std::int32_t r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
};

// v19: RegisterReply(id, texto, ACAO, DESTINO). Medido no "00 Corporal Armstrong": a funcao de texto do no (NU2_N2) ja testa as condicoes (RCn_N2)
// ANTES de registrar cada resposta; o 3o argumento e a acao ao escolher (RAn_N2, ex. "ZERO.pri; RETN") e o 4o decide o proximo no (RLn_N2).
// Ate o v18 o 3o era tratado como "condicao" e, como devolve 0, TODAS as respostas sumiam. Os nomes antigos ficam como apelidos.
struct Reply {
    std::int32_t id = 0, text_id = 0;
    std::string action_fn, link_fn;
};

struct DialogNode {
    std::string name, text_fn;
    std::vector<Reply> replies;
};

class GameHost {
public:
    explicit GameHost(f3vb::amx::Machine& m, std::uint32_t seed = 1) : vm_(m), rng_(seed) {}

    // Registra todas as natives importadas pelo programa (implementadas ou "somente log").
    void install();

    const std::vector<Event>& events() const { return events_; }
    void clear_events() { events_.clear(); }
    const std::vector<DialogNode>& nodes() const { return nodes_; }
    std::vector<DialogNode>& nodes_rw() { return nodes_; }              // v17: a sessao de dialogo reconstroi as respostas a cada passo
    void reset_dialog() { nodes_.clear(); }
    const std::vector<Speech>& speeches() const { return speeches_; }
    void clear_speeches() { speeches_.clear(); }
    std::map<std::string, int> unimplemented_calls() const;

    std::int32_t self_id = 1000;
    std::map<std::int32_t, std::int32_t> globals;

    static float as_float(std::int32_t c);
    static std::int32_t from_float(float f);

private:
    void log(const std::string& name, const std::int32_t* p, bool implemented, bool decode_strings = false);
    DialogNode& current_node();

    f3vb::amx::Machine& vm_;
    std::mt19937 rng_;
    std::vector<Event> events_;
    std::vector<DialogNode> nodes_;
    std::vector<Speech> speeches_;
};

}  // namespace f3vb::host
```

## tests_cpp/fuzz_amx.cpp

```cpp
// Fuzz simples da VM: muta bytes de um .amx real e confere que carregar/executar nunca derruba o programa
// (rode com -fsanitize=address,undefined). Uso: fuzz_amx ARQ.amx [iteracoes]
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <random>
#include <vector>

#include "../src/amx/amx_vm.hpp"

using namespace f3vb::amx;

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) return 2;
    std::ifstream f(argv[1], std::ios::binary);
    const std::vector<std::uint8_t> orig((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    const int iters = argc > 2 ? std::atoi(argv[2]) : 20000;
    std::mt19937 rng(12345);
    int loaded = 0, ran = 0, errors = 0;
    for (int it = 0; it < iters; ++it) {
        auto b = orig;
        const int muts = 1 + static_cast<int>(rng() % 6);
        for (int k = 0; k < muts; ++k) b[rng() % b.size()] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(rng());
        if (rng() % 8 == 0) b.resize(rng() % b.size());
        auto prog = Program::load(b);
        if (!prog) continue;
        ++loaded;
        Machine m(*prog);
        m.set_instruction_limit(20000);
        for (const auto& n : prog->natives()) m.register_native(n.name, [](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) { return p[0]; });
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < prog->publics().size(); ++i) {
            std::int32_t r = 0;
            if (m.call(static_cast<int>(i), {}, &r) != Err::None) ++errors;
            ++ran;
        }
    }
    std::printf("fuzz: %d iteracoes, %d carregaram, %d execucoes (%d terminaram com erro controlado)\n", iters, loaded, ran, errors);
    return 0;
}
```
