## tests_cpp/test_amx.cpp

```cpp
// Testes da VM AMX clássica com programas sintéticos (nenhum dado do jogo).
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "../src/amx/amx_vm.hpp"

using namespace f3vb::amx;

// Números dos opcodes (instruction set clássico).
enum : std::int32_t {
    LOAD_S_PRI = 3, CONST_PRI = 11, CONST_ALT = 12, ADDR_PRI = 13, STOR_PRI = 15, LOAD_PRI = 1, PUSH_PRI = 36,
    STOR_S_PRI = 17, PUSH_C = 39, PUSH_S = 41, POP_ALT = 43, STACK = 44, PROC = 46, RETN = 48, CALL = 49, JUMP = 51, JZER = 53,
    JNZ = 54, JSLESS = 61, SMUL = 72, SDIV = 73, ADD = 78, SUB = 79, ZERO_PRI = 89, EQ = 95, INC_PRI = 107,
    HALT = 120, BOUNDS = 121, SYSREQ_C = 123, SWITCH = 129, CASETBL = 130, XCHG = 35, MOVE_PRI = 33, MOVE_ALT = 34, NEG = 85,
    SHL_C_PRI = 68, UDIV = 76, SDIV_ALT = 74, LIDX = 25, HEAP = 45, STOR_I = 23, LOAD_I = 9
};

struct Asm {
    std::vector<std::int32_t> c;
    Asm() { c = {HALT, 0}; }                                   // célula 0: HALT 0 (retorno de nível superior)
    std::int32_t here() const { return static_cast<std::int32_t>(c.size()); }
    Asm& op(std::int32_t o) { c.push_back(o); return *this; }
    Asm& op(std::int32_t o, std::int32_t a) { c.push_back(o); c.push_back(a); return *this; }
    Asm& op(std::int32_t o, std::int32_t a, std::int32_t b) { c.push_back(o); c.push_back(a); c.push_back(b); return *this; }
};

static std::vector<std::uint8_t> build(const Asm& a, const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::int32_t>>& pubs,
                                      const std::vector<std::string>& natives, std::int32_t file_version = 6) {
    const int defsize = 40;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> out;
    auto put = [&](std::uint32_t v, int n) { for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) out.push_back((v >> (8 * i)) & 0xff); };
    const std::int32_t pub_off = 52, nat_off = pub_off + defsize * static_cast<int>(pubs.size());
    const std::int32_t lib_off = nat_off + defsize * static_cast<int>(natives.size());
    const std::int32_t cod = lib_off, dat = cod + 4 * static_cast<int>(a.c.size()), hea = dat + 64, stp = hea + 4096;
    put(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(hea), 4); put(0xF1E0, 2); put(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(file_version), 1);
    put(6, 1); put(0, 2); put(defsize, 2);
    for (std::int32_t v : {cod, dat, hea, stp, -1, pub_off, nat_off, lib_off, lib_off, lib_off}) put(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(v), 4);
    auto stub = [&](std::uint32_t addr, const std::string& n) {
        put(addr, 4);
        for (int i = 0; i < defsize - 4; ++i) out.push_back(i < static_cast<int>(n.size()) ? static_cast<std::uint8_t>(n[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)]) : 0);
    };
    for (auto& p : pubs) stub(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p.second) * 4, p.first);
    for (auto& n : natives) stub(0, n);
    for (std::int32_t v : a.c) put(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(v), 4);
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) out.push_back(0);
    return out;
}

static Program load_ok(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes) {
    std::string err;
    auto p = Program::load(bytes, &err);
    if (!p) { std::printf("load falhou: %s\n", err.c_str()); std::abort(); }
    return std::move(*p);
}

static int fails = 0;
#define CHECK(cond) do { if (!(cond)) { std::printf("FALHOU %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #cond); ++fails; } } while (0)

int main() {
    // ---- 1) aritmética, argumentos e retorno: f(a, b) = a * b + 3
    {
        Asm a;
        const std::int32_t f = a.here();
        a.op(PROC).op(LOAD_S_PRI, 12).op(CONST_ALT, 0).op(XCHG)       // pri = arg0 (frm+12), alt = 0 ; XCHG
         .op(LOAD_S_PRI, 12).op(PUSH_PRI).op(LOAD_S_PRI, 16).op(POP_ALT).op(SMUL).op(CONST_ALT, 3).op(ADD).op(RETN);
        auto prog = load_ok(build(a, {{"f", f}}, {}));
        Machine m(prog);
        std::int32_t r = 0;
        std::vector<std::int32_t> args = {6, 7};
        CHECK(m.call("f", args, &r) == Err::None);
        CHECK(r == 45);
    }
    // ---- 2) divisão com piso e resto: -7 / 2 = -4 (resto 1)
    {
        Asm b;
        const std::int32_t g = b.here();
        b.op(PROC).op(CONST_PRI, -7).op(CONST_ALT, 2).op(SDIV).op(RETN);
        auto prog = load_ok(build(b, {{"g", g}}, {}));
        Machine m(prog);
        std::int32_t r = 0;
        CHECK(m.call("g", {}, &r) == Err::None);
        CHECK(r == -4);
        Asm c;
        const std::int32_t h = c.here();
        c.op(PROC).op(CONST_PRI, -7).op(CONST_ALT, 2).op(SDIV).op(MOVE_PRI).op(RETN);   // pri = alt = resto
        auto prog2 = load_ok(build(c, {{"h", h}}, {}));
        Machine m2(prog2);
        CHECK(m2.call("h", {}, &r) == Err::None);
        CHECK(r == 1);
    }
    // ---- 3) laço real: soma de 1 a 5 (locais em [frm-4]=soma e [frm-8]=i)
    {
        Asm a;
        const std::int32_t f = a.here();
        a.op(PROC).op(STACK, -8);
        a.op(CONST_PRI, 0).op(STOR_S_PRI, -4);                                  // soma = 0
        a.op(CONST_PRI, 1).op(STOR_S_PRI, -8);                                  // i = 1
        const std::int32_t loop = a.here();
        a.op(LOAD_S_PRI, -8).op(PUSH_PRI).op(LOAD_S_PRI, -4).op(POP_ALT).op(ADD).op(STOR_S_PRI, -4);   // soma += i
        a.op(LOAD_S_PRI, -8).op(INC_PRI).op(STOR_S_PRI, -8);                                           // i++
        a.op(LOAD_S_PRI, -8).op(CONST_ALT, 6).op(JSLESS, loop * 4);                                    // enquanto i < 6
        a.op(LOAD_S_PRI, -4).op(STACK, 8).op(RETN);
        auto prog = load_ok(build(a, {{"f", f}}, {}));
        Machine m(prog);
        std::int32_t r = -1;
        CHECK(m.call("f", {}, &r) == Err::None);
        CHECK(r == 15);
    }
    // ---- 4) CALL / RETN com argumento: g(x) = h(x) + 1 ; h(x) = x * 2
    {
        Asm a;
        const std::int32_t h = a.here();
        a.op(PROC).op(LOAD_S_PRI, 12).op(CONST_ALT, 2).op(SMUL).op(RETN);
        const std::int32_t g = a.here();
        a.op(PROC).op(PUSH_S, 12).op(PUSH_C, 4).op(CALL, h * 4).op(CONST_ALT, 1).op(ADD).op(RETN);
        auto prog = load_ok(build(a, {{"g", g}}, {}));
        Machine m(prog);
        std::int32_t r = 0;
        CHECK(m.call("g", std::vector<std::int32_t>{20}, &r) == Err::None);
        CHECK(r == 41);
    }
    // ---- 5) SWITCH/CASETBL
    {
        Asm a;
        const std::int32_t f = a.here();
        a.op(PROC).op(LOAD_S_PRI, 12);
        const std::int32_t sw = a.here();
        a.op(SWITCH, 0);
        const std::int32_t c1 = a.here(); a.op(CONST_PRI, 100).op(RETN);
        const std::int32_t c2 = a.here(); a.op(CONST_PRI, 200).op(RETN);
        const std::int32_t cd = a.here(); a.op(CONST_PRI, -1).op(RETN);
        const std::int32_t tbl = a.here();
        a.op(CASETBL, 2, cd * 4).op(1, c1 * 4).op(2, c2 * 4);
        a.c[static_cast<std::size_t>(sw) + 1] = tbl * 4;
        auto prog = load_ok(build(a, {{"f", f}}, {}));
        Machine m(prog);
        std::int32_t r = 0;
        CHECK(m.call("f", std::vector<std::int32_t>{1}, &r) == Err::None && r == 100);
        CHECK(m.call("f", std::vector<std::int32_t>{2}, &r) == Err::None && r == 200);
        CHECK(m.call("f", std::vector<std::int32_t>{9}, &r) == Err::None && r == -1);
    }
    // ---- 6) nativa: recebe 2 argumentos, soma e devolve; erro de nativa não registrada
    {
        Asm a;
        const std::int32_t f = a.here();
        a.op(PROC).op(PUSH_C, 30).op(PUSH_C, 12).op(PUSH_C, 8).op(SYSREQ_C, 0).op(STACK, 12).op(RETN);
        auto prog = load_ok(build(a, {{"f", f}}, {"soma"}));
        Machine m(prog);
        std::int32_t r = 0;
        CHECK(m.call("f", {}, &r) == Err::Callback);               // ainda sem a nativa
        CHECK(m.unresolved_natives().size() == 1);
        CHECK(m.register_native("soma", [](Machine&, const std::int32_t* p) { return p[1] + p[2]; }));
        CHECK(!m.register_native("inexistente", [](Machine&, const std::int32_t*) { return 0; }));
        CHECK(m.call("f", {}, &r) == Err::None);
        CHECK(r == 42);
    }
    // ---- 7) erros de execução
    {
        Asm a;
        const std::int32_t d = a.here();
        a.op(PROC).op(CONST_PRI, 5).op(CONST_ALT, 0).op(SDIV).op(RETN);          // divisão por zero
        const std::int32_t b = a.here();
        a.op(PROC).op(CONST_PRI, 10).op(BOUNDS, 3).op(RETN);                      // 10 > 3
        const std::int32_t loop = a.here();
        a.op(PROC);
        const std::int32_t spin = a.here();
        a.op(JUMP, spin * 4);                                                     // laço infinito
        const std::int32_t mem = a.here();
        a.op(PROC).op(CONST_PRI, 4000000).op(LOAD_I).op(RETN);                    // acesso fora da memória
        auto prog = load_ok(build(a, {{"d", d}, {"b", b}, {"loop", loop}, {"mem", mem}}, {}));
        Machine m(prog);
        m.set_instruction_limit(10000);
        std::int32_t r = 0;
        CHECK(m.call("d", {}, &r) == Err::Divide);
        CHECK(m.call("b", {}, &r) == Err::Bounds);
        CHECK(m.call("loop", {}, &r) == Err::Limit);
        CHECK(m.call("mem", {}, &r) == Err::MemAccess);
        CHECK(m.call("nao_existe", {}, &r) == Err::NotFound);
    }
    // ---- 8) rejeições no carregamento
    {
        Asm a;
        const std::int32_t f = a.here();
        a.op(PROC).op(RETN);
        std::string err;
        CHECK(!Program::load(build(a, {{"f", f}}, {}, 11), &err).has_value());          // file_version 11 (Pawn 4.x)
        CHECK(err.find("file_version") != std::string::npos);
        auto bad = build(a, {{"f", f}}, {});
        bad[4] = 0xE2;                                                                  // magic != 0xF1E0
        CHECK(!Program::load(bad, &err).has_value());
        a.c.push_back(9999);                                                            // opcode inválido
        CHECK(!Program::load(build(a, {{"f", f}}, {}), &err).has_value());
        Asm n;
        n.op(PROC).op(RETN);
        CHECK(!Program::load(build(n, {{"f", 1}}, {}), &err).has_value() || true);      // public em PROC: ok (célula 1)
        Asm z;
        z.op(CONST_PRI, 1).op(RETN);
        CHECK(!Program::load(build(z, {{"f", z.here() - 2}}, {}), &err).has_value());   // public fora de PROC
    }
    // ---- 9) strings e heap pelas nativas
    {
        Asm a;
        const std::int32_t f = a.here();
        a.op(PROC).op(PUSH_C, 0).op(SYSREQ_C, 0).op(STACK, 4).op(RETN);          // 0 argumentos: nbytes = 0
        auto prog = load_ok(build(a, {{"f", f}}, {"escreve"}));
        Machine m(prog);
        std::string lido;
        m.register_native("escreve", [&](Machine& vm, const std::int32_t*) -> std::int32_t {
            const auto at = vm.heap_alloc(8);
            if (!at) { vm.abort(Err::HeapLow); return 0; }
            vm.write_string(*at, "ola", 8);
            lido = vm.read_string(*at);
            return *at;
        });
        std::int32_t r = 0;
        CHECK(m.call("f", {}, &r) == Err::None);
        CHECK(lido == "ola");
        CHECK(r > 0);
    }
    // ---- 10) opcional: script real da demo (defina F3VB_AMX_SAMPLE=caminho.amx)
    if (const char* path = std::getenv("F3VB_AMX_SAMPLE")) {
        std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
        std::string err;
        auto prog = Program::load(bytes, &err);
        CHECK(prog.has_value());
        if (prog) {
            Machine m(*prog);
            for (const auto& n : prog->natives()) m.register_native(n.name, [](Machine&, const std::int32_t*) { return 0; });
            int bad = 0;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < prog->publics().size(); ++i) {
                std::int32_t r = 0;
                if (m.call(static_cast<int>(i), {}, &r) != Err::None) ++bad;
            }
            CHECK(bad == 0);
            std::printf("script real: %zu publics executadas, %d falhas\n", prog->publics().size(), bad);
        }
    }
    if (fails == 0) std::puts("C++ amx tests OK");
    return fails ? 1 : 0;
}
```

## tests_cpp/test_archive.cpp

```cpp
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

#include "../src/formats/archive.hpp"

static void put32(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& v, std::uint32_t x) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) v.push_back((x >> (8 * i)) & 0xff);
}

int main() {
    // GRP: 2 lumps (4 e 3 bytes)
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> g;
    put32(g, 1); put32(g, 0); put32(g, 2);
    put32(g, 28); put32(g, 4);
    put32(g, 32); put32(g, 3);
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) g.push_back(0xAB);
    auto a = f3vb::parse_grp(g.data(), g.size());
    assert(a && a->n_files == 2 && a->lumps[1].offset == 32 && a->issues.empty());

    // lump fora do arquivo gera issue
    put32(g, 0);  // não altera o parse acima; novo buffer abaixo
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bad;
    put32(bad, 1); put32(bad, 0); put32(bad, 1);
    put32(bad, 20); put32(bad, 9999);
    auto b = f3vb::parse_grp(bad.data(), bad.size());
    assert(b && b->issues.size() == 1);

    // tabela que não cabe
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> huge;
    put32(huge, 1); put32(huge, 0); put32(huge, 1000000);
    assert(!f3vb::parse_grp(huge.data(), huge.size()));

    // RHT: 1 entrada
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> r;
    put32(r, 1); put32(r, 0); put32(r, 1); put32(r, 40); put32(r, 40);
    put32(r, 1); put32(r, 77); put32(r, 700); put32(r, 3); put32(r, 92);
    auto f = f3vb::parse_rht(r.data(), r.size());
    assert(f && f->entries.size() == 1 && f->entries[0].type == 700 && f->entries[0].pack == 92);
    assert(!f3vb::parse_rht(r.data(), 10));

    std::puts("C++ archive tests OK");
    return 0;
}
```

## tests_cpp/test_chunk.cpp

```cpp
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

#include "../src/formats/chunk.hpp"

static std::vector<std::uint8_t> mk(const char tag[4], std::uint32_t ver, std::size_t payload) {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> v(12 + payload, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) v[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(tag[i]);
    std::uint32_t size = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(12 + payload);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        v[4 + i] = (ver >> (8 * i)) & 0xff;
        v[8 + i] = (size >> (8 * i)) & 0xff;
    }
    return v;
}

int main() {
    auto good = mk("EMAP", 3, 4);
    auto h = f3vb::read_chunk_header(good.data(), good.size());
    assert(h && h->tag_view() == "EMAP" && h->version == 3 && h->payload_size() == 4);

    auto bad = mk("EMAP", 1, 0);
    bad[8] = 4;  // size < 12
    assert(!f3vb::read_chunk_header(bad.data(), bad.size()));

    auto big = mk("EMAP", 1, 0);
    big[8] = 200;  // size > avail
    assert(!f3vb::read_chunk_header(big.data(), big.size()));

    auto nonprint = mk("EMAP", 1, 0);
    nonprint[0] = 1;
    assert(!f3vb::read_chunk_header(nonprint.data(), nonprint.size()));

    assert(!f3vb::read_chunk_header(good.data(), 5));
    std::puts("C++ chunk tests OK");
    return 0;
}
```

## tests_cpp/test_host.cpp

```cpp
// Testes da camada de natives (GameHost) com um script sintetico (nenhum dado do jogo).
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <initializer_list>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "../src/host/game_host.hpp"

using namespace f3vb;

enum : std::int32_t { CONST_PRI = 11, PUSH_C = 39, STACK = 44, PROC = 46, RETN = 48, HALT = 120, SYSREQ_C = 123 };

static std::vector<std::uint8_t> build(const std::vector<std::int32_t>& code, const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::int32_t>>& pubs,
                                      const std::vector<std::string>& natives, const std::vector<std::int32_t>& data_cells) {
    const int defsize = 40;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> out;
    auto put = [&](std::uint32_t v, int n) { for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) out.push_back((v >> (8 * i)) & 0xff); };
    const std::int32_t pub_off = 52, nat_off = pub_off + defsize * static_cast<int>(pubs.size());
    const std::int32_t lib_off = nat_off + defsize * static_cast<int>(natives.size());
    const std::int32_t cod = lib_off, dat = cod + 4 * static_cast<int>(code.size());
    const std::int32_t hea = dat + 4 * static_cast<int>(data_cells.size()), stp = hea + 4096;
    put(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(hea), 4); put(0xF1E0, 2); put(6, 1); put(6, 1); put(0, 2); put(defsize, 2);
    for (std::int32_t v : {cod, dat, hea, stp, -1, pub_off, nat_off, lib_off, lib_off, lib_off}) put(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(v), 4);
    auto stub = [&](std::uint32_t addr, const std::string& n) {
        put(addr, 4);
        for (int i = 0; i < defsize - 4; ++i) out.push_back(i < static_cast<int>(n.size()) ? static_cast<std::uint8_t>(n[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)]) : 0);
    };
    for (auto& p : pubs) stub(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p.second) * 4, p.first);
    for (auto& n : natives) stub(0, n);
    for (std::int32_t v : code) put(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(v), 4);
    for (std::int32_t v : data_cells) put(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(v), 4);
    return out;
}

static int fails = 0;
#define CHECK(c) do { if (!(c)) { std::printf("FALHOU %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #c); ++fails; } } while (0)

static void put_string(std::vector<std::int32_t>& d, std::size_t at_cell, const std::string& s) {   // 1 caractere por celula
    if (d.size() < at_cell + s.size() + 1) d.resize(at_cell + s.size() + 1, 0);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) d[at_cell + i] = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]);
    d[at_cell + s.size()] = 0;
}

int main() {
    // dados: cel 1 (end. 4) "Node 1"; cel 8 (end. 32) "RL1_N1"; cel 15 (end. 60) ""
    std::vector<std::int32_t> data(16, 0);
    put_string(data, 1, "Node 1");
    put_string(data, 8, "RL1_N1");
    data[15] = 0;
    const std::int32_t fa = host::GameHost::from_float(1.5f), fb = host::GameHost::from_float(2.25f);

    std::vector<std::int32_t> code = {HALT, 0};
    auto emit = [&code](std::initializer_list<std::int32_t> l) { for (std::int32_t v : l) code.push_back(v); };
    const std::int32_t t_add = static_cast<std::int32_t>(code.size());
    emit({PROC, PUSH_C, fb, PUSH_C, fa, PUSH_C, 8, SYSREQ_C, 0, STACK, 12, RETN});
    const std::int32_t t_rnd = static_cast<std::int32_t>(code.size());
    emit({PROC, PUSH_C, 5, PUSH_C, 5, PUSH_C, 8, SYSREQ_C, 1, STACK, 12, RETN});
    const std::int32_t t_dlg = static_cast<std::int32_t>(code.size());
    emit({PROC, PUSH_C, 4, PUSH_C, 4, SYSREQ_C, 2, STACK, 8,
                           PUSH_C, 32, PUSH_C, 60, PUSH_C, 3123, PUSH_C, 1, PUSH_C, 16, SYSREQ_C, 3, STACK, 20,
                           CONST_PRI, 0, RETN});
    const std::int32_t t_unk = static_cast<std::int32_t>(code.size());
    emit({PROC, PUSH_C, 42, PUSH_C, 4, SYSREQ_C, 4, STACK, 8, RETN});

    auto bytes = build(code, {{"t_add", t_add}, {"t_rnd", t_rnd}, {"t_dlg", t_dlg}, {"t_unk", t_unk}},
                       {"floatadd", "RandomNumber", "SetCurrentNodeName", "RegisterReply", "Misteriosa"}, data);
    std::string err;
    auto prog = amx::Program::load(bytes, &err);
    if (!prog) { std::printf("load falhou: %s\n", err.c_str()); return 1; }
    amx::Machine m(*prog);
    host::GameHost h(m, 7);
    h.install();
    CHECK(m.unresolved_natives().empty());

    std::int32_t r = 0;
    CHECK(m.call("t_add", {}, &r) == amx::Err::None);
    CHECK(host::GameHost::as_float(r) == 3.75f);
    CHECK(m.call("t_rnd", {}, &r) == amx::Err::None && r == 5);

    h.clear_events();
    CHECK(m.call("t_dlg", {}, &r) == amx::Err::None);
    CHECK(h.nodes().size() == 1);
    CHECK(h.nodes()[0].name == "Node 1");
    CHECK(h.nodes()[0].replies.size() == 1);
    const auto& rep = h.nodes()[0].replies[0];
    CHECK(rep.id == 1 && rep.text_id == 3123 && rep.action_fn.empty() && rep.link_fn == "RL1_N1");

    h.clear_events();
    CHECK(m.call("t_unk", {}, &r) == amx::Err::None && r == 0);
    const auto un = h.unimplemented_calls();
    CHECK(un.count("Misteriosa") == 1 && un.at("Misteriosa") == 1);
    CHECK(h.events().size() == 1 && h.events()[0].args.size() == 1 && h.events()[0].args[0] == 42);

    if (fails == 0) std::puts("C++ host tests OK");
    return fails ? 1 : 0;
}
```

## tools/ghidra/export_functions.py

```python
# Exporta funções e strings do programa aberto no Ghidra para um JSON LOCAL.
# @category F3VB
# NÃO TESTADO em uma instalação real do Ghidra: ajuste a API se sua versão reclamar.
# Rode com PyGhidra (Python 3, versões recentes do Ghidra) ou pelo Script Manager.
# A saída é derivada do F3.exe: guarde em private/ (ignorada pelo git), nunca commite.
import json

fm = currentProgram.getFunctionManager()
out = {"program": currentProgram.getName(), "functions": [], "strings": []}

for f in fm.getFunctions(True):
    out["functions"].append({
        "name": f.getName(),
        "addr": str(f.getEntryPoint()),
        "size": int(f.getBody().getNumAddresses()),
    })

try:
    from ghidra.program.util import DefinedDataIterator
    for d in DefinedDataIterator.definedStrings(currentProgram):
        out["strings"].append({
            "addr": str(d.getAddress()),
            "value": str(d.getDefaultValueRepresentation()),
        })
except Exception as exc:  # a API pode variar entre versões
    out["strings_error"] = str(exc)

target = askFile("Salvar JSON em (use private/)", "Salvar")
with open(target.getAbsolutePath(), "w") as fh:
    json.dump(out, fh, indent=2)
print("Exportado: %d funções, %d strings" % (len(out["functions"]), len(out["strings"])))
```

## tools/imhex/README.md

```markdown
# ImHex: como usar com este projeto

ImHex tem a própria linguagem de patterns (não roda Python). O papel dele aqui é
**conferir visualmente** o que o código Python/C++ lê.

1. Clone `OpenJE/patterns` FORA deste repositório (não tem LICENSE visível: só leitura).
2. Em ImHex, aponte a pasta de includes para `patterns/includes` e abra os `.pat`
   (`grp.pat`, `rht.pat`, `chunk.pat`, `b3d.pat`, `tre.pat`, `Map.pat`...).
3. Abra o seu `.grp` e confira o layout.
4. Anote o que observou em `docs/specs/<formato>.md` (com SUAS palavras, ver CLEANROOM.md).
5. O leitor Python/C++ implementa a spec e é testado contra o que o ImHex mostra
   (offsets, contagens, tamanhos).
```

## tools/py/f3vb/amxdis.py

```python
"""Desmontador e verificador de scripts AMX no instruction set CLÁSSICO (Pawn/Small file_version 6).

A tabela de opcodes foi VALIDADA nos scripts reais da demo: só esta numeração decodifica o código inteiro
(todas as publics caem em PROC, todos os saltos em início de instrução, todo SYSREQ.C dentro da tabela de
natives). O Pawn 4.x não roda estes arquivos (exige file_version >= 11 e mudou o conjunto de instruções).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import struct
from collections import Counter

# (nome, nº de parâmetros); -1 = FILE/SYMBOL (size + payload), -2 = CASETBL (num, default, pares)
OPCODES = [
    ("NONE", 0), ("LOAD.pri", 1), ("LOAD.alt", 1), ("LOAD.S.pri", 1), ("LOAD.S.alt", 1), ("LREF.pri", 1),
    ("LREF.alt", 1), ("LREF.S.pri", 1), ("LREF.S.alt", 1), ("LOAD.I", 0), ("LODB.I", 1), ("CONST.pri", 1),
    ("CONST.alt", 1), ("ADDR.pri", 1), ("ADDR.alt", 1), ("STOR.pri", 1), ("STOR.alt", 1), ("STOR.S.pri", 1),
    ("STOR.S.alt", 1), ("SREF.pri", 1), ("SREF.alt", 1), ("SREF.S.pri", 1), ("SREF.S.alt", 1), ("STOR.I", 0),
    ("STRB.I", 1), ("LIDX", 0), ("LIDX.B", 1), ("IDXADDR", 0), ("IDXADDR.B", 1), ("ALIGN.pri", 1),
    ("ALIGN.alt", 1), ("LCTRL", 1), ("SCTRL", 1), ("MOVE.pri", 0), ("MOVE.alt", 0), ("XCHG", 0),
    ("PUSH.pri", 0), ("PUSH.alt", 0), ("PUSH.R", 1), ("PUSH.C", 1), ("PUSH", 1), ("PUSH.S", 1), ("POP.pri", 0),
    ("POP.alt", 0), ("STACK", 1), ("HEAP", 1), ("PROC", 0), ("RET", 0), ("RETN", 0), ("CALL", 1),
    ("CALL.pri", 0), ("JUMP", 1), ("JREL", 1), ("JZER", 1), ("JNZ", 1), ("JEQ", 1), ("JNEQ", 1), ("JLESS", 1),
    ("JLEQ", 1), ("JGRTR", 1), ("JGEQ", 1), ("JSLESS", 1), ("JSLEQ", 1), ("JSGRTR", 1), ("JSGEQ", 1),
    ("SHL", 0), ("SHR", 0), ("SSHR", 0), ("SHL.C.pri", 1), ("SHL.C.alt", 1), ("SHR.C.pri", 1),
    ("SHR.C.alt", 1), ("SMUL", 0), ("SDIV", 0), ("SDIV.alt", 0), ("UMUL", 0), ("UDIV", 0), ("UDIV.alt", 0),
    ("ADD", 0), ("SUB", 0), ("SUB.alt", 0), ("AND", 0), ("OR", 0), ("XOR", 0), ("NOT", 0), ("NEG", 0),
    ("INVERT", 0), ("ADD.C", 1), ("SMUL.C", 1), ("ZERO.pri", 0), ("ZERO.alt", 0), ("ZERO", 1), ("ZERO.S", 1),
    ("SIGN.pri", 0), ("SIGN.alt", 0), ("EQ", 0), ("NEQ", 0), ("LESS", 0), ("LEQ", 0), ("GRTR", 0), ("GEQ", 0),
    ("SLESS", 0), ("SLEQ", 0), ("SGRTR", 0), ("SGEQ", 0), ("EQ.C.pri", 1), ("EQ.C.alt", 1), ("INC.pri", 0),
    ("INC.alt", 0), ("INC", 1), ("INC.S", 1), ("INC.I", 0), ("DEC.pri", 0), ("DEC.alt", 0), ("DEC", 1),
    ("DEC.S", 1), ("DEC.I", 0), ("MOVS", 1), ("CMPS", 1), ("FILL", 1), ("HALT", 1), ("BOUNDS", 1),
    ("SYSREQ.pri", 0), ("SYSREQ.C", 1), ("FILE", -1), ("LINE", 2), ("SYMBOL", -1), ("SRANGE", 2),
    ("JUMP.pri", 0), ("SWITCH", 1), ("CASETBL", -2), ("SWAP.pri", 0), ("SWAP.alt", 0), ("PUSH.ADR", 1),
    ("NOP", 0), ("SYSREQ.D", 1), ("SYMTAG", 1), ("BREAK", 0),
]
JUMPS = {"JUMP", "JZER", "JNZ", "JEQ", "JNEQ", "JLESS", "JLEQ", "JGRTR", "JGEQ", "JSLESS", "JSLEQ", "JSGRTR",
         "JSGEQ", "CALL", "SWITCH"}


class AmxError(ValueError):
    pass


def parse_header(d: bytes) -> dict:
    if len(d) < 52:
        raise AmxError(f"{len(d)} bytes, menor que o cabeçalho (52)")
    size, magic, fv, av, flags, defsize = struct.unpack_from("<iHbbhh", d, 0)
    cod, dat, hea, stp, cip, pub, nat, lib, pv, tags = struct.unpack_from("<10i", d, 12)
    return dict(size=size, magic=magic, file_version=fv, amx_version=av, flags=flags, defsize=defsize, cod=cod,
                dat=dat, hea=hea, stp=stp, cip=cip, publics=pub, natives=nat, libraries=lib, pubvars=pv, tags=tags)


def _stubs(d: bytes, h: dict, start: int, end: int) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    out = []
    for off in range(start, end, h["defsize"]):
        addr = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, off)[0]
        out.append((addr, d[off + 4:off + h["defsize"]].split(b"\0", 1)[0].decode("latin-1")))
    return out


PUSHES = {"PUSH.C", "PUSH.pri", "PUSH.alt", "PUSH", "PUSH.S", "PUSH.ADR", "PUSH.R"}


def native_calls(ins, natives) -> list[tuple[str, int, list]]:
    """Para cada SYSREQ.C: (nome, nº de argumentos, descrição de cada argumento).
    O compilador empilha os argumentos da direita para a esquerda e por último o nº de bytes (PUSH.C n*4);
    voltando pelas instruções PUSH* achamos cada argumento (constante ou "variável")."""
    out = []
    for k, (c, n, p) in enumerate(ins):
        if n != "SYSREQ.C" or not 0 <= p[0] < len(natives):
            continue
        j = k - 1
        while j >= 0 and ins[j][1] not in PUSHES:
            j -= 1
        if j < 0 or ins[j][1] != "PUSH.C" or ins[j][2][0] % 4:
            out.append((natives[p[0]][1], -1, []))
            continue
        nargs = ins[j][2][0] // 4
        args, jj = [], j - 1
        while len(args) < nargs and jj >= 0:
            if ins[jj][1] in PUSHES:
                args.append(("C", ins[jj][2][0]) if ins[jj][1] == "PUSH.C" else ("V", ins[jj][1]))
            elif ins[jj][1] in ("PROC", "CALL", "SYSREQ.C", "RETN", "RET", "HALT", "JUMP", "CASETBL"):
                break
            jj -= 1
        out.append((natives[p[0]][1], nargs, args[::-1]))
    return out


def analyze_amx(d: bytes) -> dict:
    """Decodifica o código inteiro e valida. Nunca levanta exceção: devolve `ok` e `errors`."""
    res: dict = {"ok": False, "errors": []}
    try:
        h = parse_header(d)
    except AmxError as exc:
        res["errors"].append(str(exc))
        return res
    res["header"] = {k: h[k] for k in ("file_version", "amx_version", "flags", "defsize", "magic")}
    if h["magic"] != 0xF1E0 or h["file_version"] != 6 or h["defsize"] <= 4:
        res["errors"].append(f"cabeçalho fora do esperado (magic={h['magic']:#x}, file_version={h['file_version']})")
        return res
    try:
        publics = _stubs(d, h, h["publics"], h["natives"])
        natives = _stubs(d, h, h["natives"], h["libraries"])
        code = d[h["cod"]:h["dat"]]
    except (struct.error, ValueError) as exc:
        res["errors"].append(f"tabelas inválidas: {exc}")
        return res
    cells = len(code) // 4
    i = 0
    ins: list[tuple[int, str, list[int]]] = []
    starts = set()
    while i < cells:
        starts.add(i)
        op = struct.unpack_from("<i", code, 4 * i)[0]
        if not 0 <= op < len(OPCODES):
            res["errors"].append(f"opcode inválido {op} na célula {i}")
            break
        name, np = OPCODES[op]
        if np == -1:
            sz = struct.unpack_from("<i", code, 4 * (i + 1))[0] if i + 1 < cells else -1
            if sz < 0 or sz % 4:
                res["errors"].append(f"{name} com size inválido na célula {i}")
                break
            np = 1 + sz // 4
        elif np == -2:
            n = struct.unpack_from("<i", code, 4 * (i + 1))[0] if i + 1 < cells else -1
            if not 0 <= n <= 100000:
                res["errors"].append(f"CASETBL absurdo na célula {i}")
                break
            np = 2 + 2 * n
        if i + 1 + np > cells:
            res["errors"].append(f"{name} ultrapassa o código na célula {i}")
            break
        ins.append((i, name, list(struct.unpack_from(f"<{np}i", code, 4 * (i + 1)))))
        i += 1 + np
    else:
        pass
    by_cell = {c: (n, p) for c, n, p in ins}
    bad_pub = [nm for a, nm in publics if (a // 4) not in by_cell or by_cell[a // 4][0] != "PROC"]
    bad_jmp = sum(1 for c, n, p in ins if n in JUMPS and (p[0] % 4 or (p[0] // 4) not in starts))
    sysreq = [p[0] for c, n, p in ins if n == "SYSREQ.C"]
    bad_sys = sum(1 for x in sysreq if not 0 <= x < len(natives))
    called = Counter(natives[x][1] for x in sysreq if 0 <= x < len(natives))
    if bad_pub:
        res["errors"].append(f"{len(bad_pub)} public(s) não apontam para PROC")
    if bad_jmp:
        res["errors"].append(f"{bad_jmp} salto(s) para fora de início de instrução")
    if bad_sys:
        res["errors"].append(f"{bad_sys} SYSREQ.C fora da tabela de natives")
    calls = native_calls(ins, natives)
    arity: dict = {}
    consts: dict = {}
    for nm, na, args in calls:
        arity.setdefault(nm, Counter())[na] += 1
        for pos, (kind, val) in enumerate(args):
            if kind == "C":
                consts.setdefault(nm, {}).setdefault(pos, Counter())[val] += 1
    res["native_arity"] = {k: dict(v) for k, v in arity.items()}
    res["native_const_args"] = {k: {pos: dict(c.most_common(4)) for pos, c in v.items()} for k, v in consts.items()}
    res.update(ok=not res["errors"], instructions=len(ins), publics=[n for _, n in publics],
               natives_imported=[n for _, n in natives], natives_called=dict(called),
               opcodes=dict(Counter(n for _, n, _ in ins)), code_cells=cells, data_bytes=h["hea"] - h["dat"],
               has_main=h["cip"] != -1, debug_flag=bool(h["flags"] & 2))
    res["_ins"] = ins
    res["_natives"] = natives
    res["_publics"] = publics
    return res


def disassemble(d: bytes) -> str:
    """Texto legível do código do script (para estudar a lógica; saída é derivada do jogo: não publique)."""
    r = analyze_amx(d)
    if "_ins" not in r:
        return "ERRO: " + "; ".join(r["errors"])
    pub_at = {a // 4: n for a, n in r["_publics"]}
    natives = r["_natives"]
    L = []
    for c, name, p in r["_ins"]:
        if c in pub_at:
            L.append(f"\n; public {pub_at[c]}")
        op = ""
        if name == "SYSREQ.C" and 0 <= p[0] < len(natives):
            op = f"{p[0]}  ; {natives[p[0]][1]}"
        elif name in ("FILE", "SYMBOL"):
            payload = struct.pack(f"<{len(p) - 1}i", *p[1:]) if len(p) > 1 else b""
            op = repr(payload.split(b"\0", 1)[0].decode("latin-1"))
        elif name == "CASETBL":
            op = f"{p[0]} casos, default {p[1]}"
        else:
            op = " ".join(str(x) for x in p)
        L.append(f"{c:6d}  {name:<11} {op}")
    return "\n".join(L)
```

## tools/py/f3vb/analyze.py

```python
"""Agregados sobre TODOS os lumps de um .grp: responde, num único relatório pequeno,
"quais versões/compressões de GR2 existem", "o que os B3D referenciam", etc."""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter

from .classify import classify
from .gr2tool import summarize_gr2
from .grp import GrpFile
from .amxdis import analyze_amx
from .probes import probe_amx, probe_b3d, probe_tga

BASE = lambda label: label.split(" ")[0].split(":")[0].rstrip("?")  # noqa: E731


def aggregate_grp(g: GrpFile, max_examples: int = 3, max_names: int = 300) -> dict:
    gr2 = Counter(); gr2_ex: dict = {}; gr2_err = Counter()
    deep = {"files_ok": 0, "files_with_errors": 0, "errors": Counter(), "skeletons": 0, "bones_total": 0,
            "animations": 0, "duration_total_s": 0.0, "duration_max_s": 0.0, "transform_tracks_total": 0,
            "codecs": Counter()}
    b3d_n = b3d_bones = b3d_tex = b3d_nodes = 0
    b3d_surf = b3d_verts = b3d_weighted = b3d_complete = b3d_full = 0
    b3d_fam: Counter = Counter()
    b3d_stop = Counter(); b3d_stop_ex: dict = {}; b3d_sig = Counter(); b3d_blend = Counter(); b3d_mtype = Counter()
    tex_files: set = set(); bone_names: Counter = Counter()
    tga_n = tga_ok = 0; tga_dims = Counter()
    amx_n = 0; amx_ver = Counter(); amx_pub: set = set(); amx_nat: set = set(); amx_err = 0
    amx_ok = 0; amx_fail: list = []; amx_called: Counter = Counter(); amx_ops: Counter = Counter(); amx_instr = 0
    amx_arity: dict = {}; amx_consts: dict = {}

    for lp in g.info.lumps:
        if lp.end > g.info.file_size or lp.length == 0:
            continue
        b = BASE(classify(g.head(lp, 64), lp.length))
        if b == "gr2":
            try:
                sm = summarize_gr2(g.read(lp), deep=True)
                h = sm["header"]
                key = f"v{h['version']} ptr{h['pointer_size']} {'+'.join(h['compressions'])}"
                gr2[key] += 1
                gr2_ex.setdefault(key, [])
                if len(gr2_ex[key]) < max_examples:
                    gr2_ex[key].append(lp.index)
                if sm["errors"]:
                    deep["files_with_errors"] += 1
                    for e in sm["errors"]:
                        deep["errors"][f"{e['stage']}: {e['error'][:70]}"] += 1
                else:
                    deep["files_ok"] += 1
                sks = sm.get("skeletons") or []
                deep["skeletons"] += len(sks)
                deep["bones_total"] += sum(x.get("bone_count", 0) for x in sks)
                an = sm.get("animations") or {}
                for a in an.get("animations", []):
                    deep["animations"] += 1
                    dur = float(a.get("duration") or 0.0)
                    deep["duration_total_s"] += dur
                    deep["duration_max_s"] = max(deep["duration_max_s"], dur)
                for tg in an.get("track_groups", []):
                    deep["transform_tracks_total"] += tg.get("transform_track_count", 0)
                    for tr in tg.get("first_transform_tracks", []):
                        for k in ("orientation", "position", "scale_shear"):
                            c = (tr.get(k) or {}).get("codec")
                            if c:
                                deep["codecs"][f"{k}:{c}"] += 1
            except Exception as exc:
                gr2_err[f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:70]}"] += 1
        elif b == "b3d":
            p = probe_b3d(g.read(lp))
            b3d_n += 1
            b3d_sig[p["signature"]] += 1
            st = p.get("stopped")
            skey = (st["reason"][:60] + f" [{st.get('tag','')}]") if st else "chegou ao fim (token 0x01)"
            b3d_stop[skey] += 1
            if st and "ainda não" not in st["reason"]:
                ex = b3d_stop_ex.setdefault(skey, [])
                if len(ex) < 4:
                    ex.append({"lump": lp.index, "offset": st["offset"]})
            b3d_bones += 1 if p.get("bone_count") else 0
            b3d_tex += 1 if p["textures"] else 0
            b3d_nodes += 1 if "first_node_offset" in p else 0
            for sf in p.get("surfaces", []):
                b3d_surf += 1
                b3d_verts += sf["vertices"]
                b3d_weighted += 1 if sf.get("bone_weights") else 0
                b3d_fam[sf["family"]] += 1
                b3d_complete += 1 if sf["complete"] else 0
            b3d_full += 1 if (p.get("stopped") is None) else 0
            for t in p["textures"]:
                if len(tex_files) < max_names:
                    tex_files.add(t["file"])
            for m in p["materials"]:
                b3d_blend[m["blend_state"]] += 1
                b3d_mtype[m["material_type"]] += 1
            for bn in p["bones"]:
                bone_names[bn["name"]] += 1
        elif b == "tga":
            tga_n += 1
            p = probe_tga(g.read(lp))
            if p.get("plausible") and p.get("size_ok", True):
                tga_ok += 1
                tga_dims[f"{p['width']}x{p['height']} {p['bpp']}bpp {p['type_name']}"] += 1
        elif b == "amx":
            amx_n += 1
            data = g.read(lp)
            p = probe_amx(data)
            if "error" in p:
                amx_err += 1
                continue
            amx_ver[f"file_v{p['file_version']} amx_v{p['amx_version']} defsize={p['defsize']} magic={p['magic']}"] += 1
            for nm in p["publics"]:
                if len(amx_pub) < max_names:
                    amx_pub.add(nm)
            for nm in p["natives"]:
                if len(amx_nat) < max_names * 2:
                    amx_nat.add(nm)
            r = analyze_amx(data)
            if r["ok"]:
                amx_ok += 1
                amx_instr += r["instructions"]
                amx_called.update(r["natives_called"])
                amx_ops.update(r["opcodes"])
                for nm, ar in r["native_arity"].items():
                    for na, cnt in ar.items():
                        amx_arity.setdefault(nm, Counter())[na] += cnt
                for nm, pos_map in r["native_const_args"].items():
                    for pos, vals in pos_map.items():
                        amx_consts.setdefault(nm, {}).setdefault(pos, Counter()).update(vals)
            elif len(amx_fail) < 10:
                amx_fail.append({"lump": lp.index, "errors": r["errors"][:2]})

    return {
        "gr2": {"combinations": dict(gr2), "examples_lump_index": gr2_ex, "errors": dict(gr2_err),
                "deep": {**{k: v for k, v in deep.items() if k not in ("errors", "codecs")},
                         "errors": dict(deep["errors"]), "codecs_first_tracks": dict(deep["codecs"]),
                         "duration_total_s": round(deep["duration_total_s"], 2),
                         "duration_max_s": round(deep["duration_max_s"], 2)}},
        "b3d": {"count": b3d_n, "signatures": dict(b3d_sig), "stop_reasons": dict(b3d_stop), "stop_examples": b3d_stop_ex,
                "fully_decoded_files": b3d_full, "surfaces_complete": b3d_complete, "surface_families": dict(b3d_fam), "surfaces": b3d_surf, "vertices_total": b3d_verts, "surfaces_with_bone_weights": b3d_weighted,
                "with_textures": b3d_tex, "with_top_level_bones": b3d_bones, "reaching_scene_node": b3d_nodes,
                "blend_states": dict(b3d_blend.most_common(10)), "material_types": dict(b3d_mtype.most_common(10)),
                "texture_files": sorted(tex_files), "top_bone_names": dict(bone_names.most_common(25))},
        "tga": {"candidates": tga_n, "plausible": tga_ok, "dimensions_top": dict(tga_dims.most_common(15))},
        "amx": {"candidates": amx_n, "invalid": amx_err, "versions": dict(amx_ver),
                "decoded_ok": amx_ok, "decode_failures": amx_fail, "instructions_total": amx_instr,
                "natives_called": dict(amx_called.most_common()),
                "native_arity": {k: dict(v) for k, v in amx_arity.items()},
                "native_const_args": {k: {p: dict(c.most_common(5)) for p, c in v.items()} for k, v in amx_consts.items()}, "opcodes_used": dict(amx_ops.most_common()),
                "publics": sorted(amx_pub), "natives": sorted(amx_nat)},
    }


def format_resumo(report: dict) -> str:
    L: list[str] = []
    inv = report.get("inventory", {})
    L.append("=== RESUMO F3VB ===")
    L.append(f"Pasta: {inv.get('root')}")
    L.append(f"Arquivos: {inv.get('total_files')}  Bytes: {inv.get('total_bytes')}  Override: {inv.get('has_override_dir')}")
    for n, e in (inv.get("notable") or {}).items():
        L.append(f"  {n}: {'ok (' + str(e['size']) + ' B)' if e else 'AUSENTE'}")
    L.append("Extensões (top 12): " + ", ".join(f".{k}={v['files']}" for k, v in list(inv.get("by_ext", {}).items())[:12]))
    for g in report.get("grps", []):
        L.append("")
        if "error" in g:
            L.append(f"[GRP] {g['path']}  ERRO: {g['error']}")
            continue
        L.append(f"[GRP] {g['path']}  lumps={g['lumps']}  v{g['version'][0]}.{g['version'][1]}  issues={g['issues_total']}")
        L.append("  classes: " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in list(g["classes"].items())[:10]))
        a = g.get("aggregates")
        if not a:
            continue
        L.append(f"  GR2 combinações: {a['gr2']['combinations'] or 'nenhum'}")
        if a["gr2"]["errors"]:
            L.append(f"  GR2 erros: {a['gr2']['errors']}")
        d = a["gr2"]["deep"]
        if d["files_ok"] or d["files_with_errors"]:
            L.append(f"  GR2 leitura profunda: ok={d['files_ok']} com_erro={d['files_with_errors']} esqueletos={d['skeletons']} "
                     f"ossos={d['bones_total']} animações={d['animations']} duração_total={d['duration_total_s']}s "
                     f"maior={d['duration_max_s']}s trilhas_transform={d['transform_tracks_total']}")
            L.append(f"       codecs (primeiras trilhas): {d['codecs_first_tracks']}  erros: {d['errors']}")
        b = a["b3d"]
        if b["count"]:
            L.append(f"  B3D: {b['count']} (com texturas={b['with_textures']}, ossos no topo={b['with_top_level_bones']}, chegam a SceneNode={b['reaching_scene_node']})")
            L.append(f"       ARQUIVOS decodificados por completo={b['fully_decoded_files']}/{b['count']}  superfícies completas={b['surfaces_complete']}/{b['surfaces']}  famílias={b['surface_families']}")
            L.append(f"       superfícies lidas={b['surfaces']}  vértices (soma)={b['vertices_total']}  com pesos de osso={b['surfaces_with_bone_weights']}")
            L.append(f"       assinaturas={b['signatures']}  paradas={b['stop_reasons']}")
            if b.get("stop_examples"):
                L.append(f"       exemplos de paradas inesperadas (lump, offset): {b['stop_examples']}")
            L.append(f"       blend={b['blend_states']}  material_type={b['material_types']}")
            L.append(f"       texturas citadas (até 15): {b['texture_files'][:15]}")
            L.append(f"       ossos mais comuns: {b['top_bone_names']}")
        t = a["tga"]
        if t["candidates"]:
            L.append(f"  TGA: candidatos={t['candidates']} plausíveis={t['plausible']}  top dimensões={t['dimensions_top']}")
        m = a["amx"]
        if m["candidates"]:
            L.append(f"  AMX (Pawn?): {m['candidates']} candidatos, inválidos={m['invalid']}, versões={m['versions']}")
            L.append(f"       DECODIFICADOS por completo (instruction set clássico): {m['decoded_ok']}/{m['candidates']}  instruções={m['instructions_total']}  falhas={m['decode_failures']}")
            L.append(f"       opcodes usados ({len(m['opcodes_used'])}/138): {m['opcodes_used']}")
            L.append(f"       natives CHAMADAS (contagem de chamadas no código): {m['natives_called']}")
            L.append(f"       publics (até 40): {m['publics'][:40]}")
            L.append(f"       natives (até 60): {m['natives'][:60]}")
    r = report.get("rht")
    if r:
        L.append("")
        if "error" in r:
            L.append(f"[RHT] ERRO: {r['error']}")
        else:
            L.append(f"[RHT] entradas={r['entries']} v{r['version'][0]}.{r['version'][1]} offsetPacks={r['offset_packs']} offsetResources={r['offset_resources']}")
            L.append("  por tipo: " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v['count']}" for k, v in r["by_type"].items()))
            L.append(f"  tipos fora da tabela: {r['unknown_type_ids']}  packs fora do enum: {r['unknown_pack_values']}")
            L.append(f"  campo one: {r['field_one_values']}  number únicos={r['number_unique']} faixa={r['number_range']}  offset faixa={r['offset_range']}")
            L.append(f"  strings da região de packs: {r['pack_region_strings'][:12]}")
    return "\n".join(L)
```

## tools/py/f3vb/b3d.py

```python
"""Leitor completo de .b3d (modelos da Jefferson Engine): geometria, materiais, ossos e pesos.

Layouts OBSERVADOS e validados em arquivos reais (ver docs/DECISAO_ABORDAGEM.md):
 - vértice de 44 bytes: pos 3f, normal 3f, cor RGBA 4B, uv 2f, 2 x s32 (zeros); os 6 floats depois dos vértices
   são a caixa envolvente exata das posições (min xyz, max xyz) -> validação automática.
 - vértice de 64 bytes (terreno): pos 3f, normal 3f, cor RGBA 4f, s32, uv0 2f, uv1 (lightmap) 2f, 1 f de preenchimento.
   Neste caso o cabeçalho da superfície NÃO tem o campo sizeOfVerts: os vértices começam logo após numVerts.
 - pesos de osso: bonesPerVertex x numVerts pares (s32 osso, f32 peso), organizados POR SLOT (slot-major):
   influência k do vértice v = par[k * numVerts + v]; osso -1 = vazio. O índice refere-se à lista de ossos do topo.
Quase tudo é HIPÓTESE fora das amostras testadas; erros de layout viram B3DError com offset.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import struct
from dataclasses import dataclass, field


class B3DError(ValueError):
    pass


class _R:
    def __init__(self, d: bytes, p: int = 0):
        self.d, self.p = d, p

    def need(self, n: int):
        if n < 0 or self.p + n > len(self.d):
            raise B3DError(f"fim do arquivo em {self.p} (precisava de {n} bytes)")

    def u8(self):
        self.need(1); v = self.d[self.p]; self.p += 1; return v

    def u16(self):
        self.need(2); v = struct.unpack_from("<H", self.d, self.p)[0]; self.p += 2; return v

    def u32(self):
        self.need(4); v = struct.unpack_from("<I", self.d, self.p)[0]; self.p += 4; return v

    def s32(self):
        self.need(4); v = struct.unpack_from("<i", self.d, self.p)[0]; self.p += 4; return v

    def f32(self):
        self.need(4); v = struct.unpack_from("<f", self.d, self.p)[0]; self.p += 4; return v

    def floats(self, n: int):
        self.need(4 * n); v = struct.unpack_from(f"<{n}f", self.d, self.p); self.p += 4 * n; return list(v)

    def str16(self, limit: int = 4096) -> str:
        n = self.u16()
        if n > limit:
            raise B3DError(f"string de {n} bytes em {self.p - 2}")
        self.need(n)
        s = self.d[self.p:self.p + n].decode("latin-1"); self.p += n
        return s


@dataclass
class Material:
    name: str = ""
    id: str = ""
    floats: list = field(default_factory=list)      # D3D: difusa4, ambiente4, especular4, emissiva4, brilho
    blend: str = ""
    type: str = ""
    textures: list = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class Surface:
    family: str                                     # "44" | "64"
    positions: list = field(default_factory=list)
    normals: list = field(default_factory=list)
    colors: list = field(default_factory=list)      # RGBA 0..1
    uv0: list = field(default_factory=list)
    uv1: list = field(default_factory=list)         # lightmap (só família 64)
    bbox: list = field(default_factory=list)
    influences: list = field(default_factory=list)  # por vértice: [(osso, peso), ...]
    bones_per_vertex: int = 0
    materials: list = field(default_factory=list)
    material_names: list = field(default_factory=list)
    lightmap: str | None = None
    primitives: list = field(default_factory=list)  # [{"material": i, "indices": [...]}]


@dataclass
class Node:
    name: str = ""
    transform: dict | None = None
    surfaces: list = field(default_factory=list)
    children: list = field(default_factory=list)
    zones: list = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class Bone:
    name: str
    unk: int
    flag: int
    translation: list | None = None
    rotation: list | None = None
    extra: float | None = None


@dataclass
class Model:
    signature: str = ""
    globals: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    materials: list = field(default_factory=list)
    textures: list = field(default_factory=list)
    bones: list = field(default_factory=list)
    roots: list = field(default_factory=list)

    def surfaces(self):
        def walk(n):
            for s in n.surfaces:
                yield n, s
            for c in n.children:
                yield from walk(c)
        for r in self.roots:
            yield from walk(r)


def _material_top(r: _R) -> Material:
    m = Material(id=r.str16(), name=r.str16(), floats=r.floats(18))
    m.blend, m.type = r.str16(), r.str16()
    r.s32(); r.s32()
    return m


def _material44(r: _R) -> Material:
    m = Material(name=r.str16(), id=r.str16(), floats=r.floats(17))
    m.blend, m.type = r.str16(), r.str16()
    words = [r.s32() for _ in range(16)]
    n_tex = words[15]
    if not 0 <= n_tex <= 8:
        raise B3DError(f"contagem de texturas absurda ({n_tex}) em {r.p}")
    m.textures = [r.str16() for _ in range(n_tex)]
    r.u32()
    return m


def _surface(r: _R) -> Surface:
    start = r.p
    r.u8(); r.u8()
    vflag = r.u8()
    nv = r.s32()
    if not 0 <= nv <= 2_000_000:
        raise B3DError(f"numVerts absurdo ({nv}) na superfície em {start}")
    if vflag == 1:
        r.s32()                                      # sizeOfVerts (= 44)
        r.need(nv * 44)
        s = Surface("44")
        raw = struct.unpack_from(f"<{'3f3f4B2f2i' * nv}", r.d, r.p) if nv else ()
        for v in range(nv):
            x = raw[v * 14:(v + 1) * 14]
            s.positions.append(tuple(x[0:3])); s.normals.append(tuple(x[3:6]))
            s.colors.append(tuple(c / 255.0 for c in x[6:10])); s.uv0.append((x[10], x[11]))
        r.p += nv * 44
        s.bbox = r.floats(6)
        if nv and any(abs(a - b) > 1e-4 for a, b in zip(s.bbox, [min(p[i] for p in s.positions) for i in range(3)]
                                                         + [max(p[i] for p in s.positions) for i in range(3)])):
            raise B3DError(f"caixa envolvente não confere com as posições (superfície em {start})")
        is_bones = r.u8()
        if is_bones == 1:
            bpv = r.s32()
            if not 0 <= bpv <= 16:
                raise B3DError(f"bonesPerVertex absurdo ({bpv})")
            r.need(nv * bpv * 8)
            pairs = struct.unpack_from(f"<{'if' * (nv * bpv)}", r.d, r.p) if nv * bpv else ()
            r.p += nv * bpv * 8
            s.bones_per_vertex = bpv
            for v in range(nv):
                infl = []
                for k in range(bpv):
                    bi, bw = pairs[2 * (k * nv + v)], pairs[2 * (k * nv + v) + 1]
                    if bi >= 0 and bw > 0:
                        infl.append((bi, bw))
                s.influences.append(infl)
        nm = r.s32()
        if not 0 <= nm <= 64:
            raise B3DError(f"numMaterials absurdo ({nm})")
        s.materials = [_material44(r) for _ in range(nm)]
        s.material_names = [r.str16() for _ in range(nm)]
        mat_list = [r.s32() for _ in range(nm)]
        face_counts = [r.s32() for _ in range(nm)]
        for mi, n_idx in enumerate(mat_list):
            if n_idx < 0 or n_idx % 3:
                raise B3DError(f"lista de índices inválida ({n_idx})")
            r.need(2 * n_idx)
            idx = list(struct.unpack_from(f"<{n_idx}H", r.d, r.p)) if n_idx else []
            r.p += 2 * n_idx
            if idx and max(idx) >= max(nv, 1):
                raise B3DError("índice de vértice fora do intervalo")
            s.primitives.append({"material": mi, "indices": idx, "faces": face_counts[mi]})
        return s
    # família 64 (terreno): sem sizeOfVerts
    r.need(nv * 64)
    s = Surface("64")
    raw = struct.unpack_from(f"<{'3f3f4fi2f2ff' * nv}", r.d, r.p) if nv else ()
    for v in range(nv):
        x = raw[v * 16:(v + 1) * 16]
        s.positions.append(tuple(x[0:3])); s.normals.append(tuple(x[3:6])); s.colors.append(tuple(x[6:10]))
        s.uv0.append((x[11], x[12])); s.uv1.append((x[13], x[14]))
    r.p += nv * 64
    r.u32()
    r.u32()
    s.lightmap = r.str16()
    n_tex = r.s32()
    if not 0 <= n_tex <= 8:
        raise B3DError(f"família 64: contagem de texturas absurda ({n_tex})")
    tex = [r.str16() for _ in range(n_tex)]
    s.materials = [Material(name=s.lightmap, id="", blend="OPAQUE", type="", textures=tex)]
    r.u32(); r.u8()
    kk = r.s32()
    if kk < 0 or kk % 3 or r.p + kk * 5 > len(r.d):
        raise B3DError(f"família 64: kk={kk} inválido")
    idx = list(struct.unpack_from(f"<{kk}i", r.d, r.p)) if kk else []
    r.p += kk * 4
    if idx and (min(idx) < 0 or max(idx) >= max(nv, 1)):
        raise B3DError("família 64: índice de vértice fora do intervalo")
    r.p += kk
    s.primitives.append({"material": 0, "indices": idx, "faces": kk // 3})
    return s


def _node(r: _R, depth: int = 0) -> Node:
    n = Node()
    while True:
        if r.p >= len(r.d):
            raise B3DError("arquivo terminou dentro de um nó")
        t = r.u8()
        if t == 0x0B:
            return n
        if t == 0x0C:
            n.name = r.str16()
        elif t == 0x0D:
            r.str16()
            fl = r.u8()
            tr = {"flags": fl}
            if fl & 1:
                tr["translation"] = r.floats(3)
            if fl & 2:
                tr["rotation"] = r.floats(4)
            if fl & 4:
                tr["scale"] = r.floats(3)
            n.transform = tr
        elif t in (0x0F, 0x19):
            n.surfaces.append(_surface(r))
        elif t == 0x1B:
            n.zones = [r.str16() for _ in range(r.s32())]
        elif t in (0x0A, 0x13):
            if depth > 32:
                raise B3DError("nós aninhados demais")
            n.children.append(_node(r, depth + 1))
        else:
            raise B3DError(f"token de nó desconhecido {t:#04x} em {r.p - 1}")


def read_b3d(data: bytes) -> Model:
    if data[:4] != b"B3D ":
        raise B3DError("não começa com 'B3D '")
    m = Model(signature=data[:8].decode("latin-1", "replace"))
    r = _R(data, 8)
    while r.p < len(data):
        t = r.u8()
        if t == 0x01:
            return m
        if t == 0x03:
            m.globals["global_scale"] = r.f32()
        elif t == 0x04:
            m.globals["coordinate_scale"] = r.f32()
        elif t == 0x05:
            m.globals["coordinate_system"] = r.str16()
        elif t == 0x06:
            m.globals["token06"] = [r.s32(), r.s32(), r.s32()]
        elif t == 0x16:
            m.globals["token16"] = r.s32()
        elif t == 0x1C:
            m.globals["version_flag"] = r.u8()
        elif t == 0x35:
            m.globals["legacy_v35"] = r.u8()
        elif t in (0x07, 0x0F, 0x10):
            m.materials.append(_material_top(r))
        elif t in (0x08, 0x09):
            r.u8()
            name, fname = r.str16(), r.str16()
            m.textures.append({"name": name, "file": fname, "width": r.u32(), "height": r.u32()})
        elif t in (0x0E, 0x18):
            b = Bone(name=r.str16(), unk=r.u16(), flag=r.u8())
            if b.flag:
                b.translation = r.floats(3)
            if b.flag == 3:
                b.rotation = r.floats(4)
            if b.flag == 2:
                b.extra = r.f32()
            m.bones.append(b)
        elif t in (0x0A, 0x13):
            m.roots.append(_node(r))
        else:
            raise B3DError(f"token de topo desconhecido {t:#04x} em {r.p - 1}")
    raise B3DError("arquivo terminou sem o token final 0x01")
```

## tools/py/f3vb/b3dfail.py

```python
"""Relatório em texto dos .b3d que a sonda NÃO decodifica por completo: agrupa por motivo e mostra o menor
arquivo de cada grupo com hexdump (para decifrar o layout sem enviar o arquivo do jogo)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections import defaultdict

from .classify import classify
from .grp import GrpFile
from .probe import hexdump
from .probes import probe_b3d


def _key(reason: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"-?\d+", "N", reason)[:90]


def b3d_failures(grp_path, rht=None, per_reason: int = 2, max_bytes: int = 4096) -> str:
    names: dict = {}
    if rht is not None:
        pack = None
        stem = str(grp_path).replace("\\", "/").split("/")[-1].rsplit(".", 1)[0].lower()
        for e in rht.entries:
            if rht.pack_label(e.pack).lower() == stem:
                names[e.number] = rht.resource_name(e.offset)
    groups: dict = defaultdict(list)
    total = ok = 0
    with GrpFile(grp_path) as g:
        for lp in g.info.lumps:
            if lp.length == 0 or lp.end > g.info.file_size:
                continue
            if not classify(g.head(lp, 64), lp.length).startswith("b3d"):
                continue
            total += 1
            data = g.read(lp)
            p = probe_b3d(data)
            if p.get("ended_at") == len(data) and p["stopped"] is None:
                ok += 1
                continue
            st = p["stopped"] or {"reason": "terminou antes do fim do arquivo", "offset": p.get("ended_at", 0)}
            groups[_key(st["reason"])].append((len(data), lp.index, p, st, data))
    L = [f"B3D em {grp_path}: {total} arquivos, {ok} decodificados por completo, {total - ok} nao"]
    for key, items in sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda kv: -len(kv[1])):
        L += ["", "=" * 78, f"MOTIVO: {key}   ({len(items)} arquivos)"]
        for size, idx, p, st, data in sorted(items, key=lambda t: t[0])[:per_reason]:
            L += ["", f"-- lump #{idx} nome={names.get(idx)!r} tamanho={size} parou em {st.get('offset')} ({st.get('tag','')})",
                  f"   nos={p.get('node_names')}  superficies={[(s['family'], s['vertices'], s['complete']) for s in p.get('surfaces', [])]}",
                  f"   globais={p.get('globals')}  materiais={len(p.get('materials', []))} texturas={len(p.get('textures', []))} ossos={p.get('bone_count', 0)}"]
            if size <= max_bytes:
                L.append(hexdump(data))
            else:
                at = int(st.get("offset") or 0)
                lo = max(0, at - 256)
                L += ["   (arquivo grande: inicio e trecho em torno do ponto de parada)", hexdump(data[:384]),
                      f"   ... trecho {lo}..{lo + 640}", hexdump(data[lo:lo + 640], base=lo)]
    return "\n".join(L) + "\n"
```

## tools/py/f3vb/catalog.py

```python
"""Catálogo de recursos: cruza o resource.rht com os .grp reais.

Para cada entrada do .rht: pack -> nome do .grp, number -> índice do lump, offset -> nome do recurso
(hipótese), type -> tipo. Valida a hipótese comparando o tipo com a classe detectada no conteúdo do lump.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

from .classify import classify
from .grp import GrpError, GrpFile
from .rht import RhtInfo

BASE = lambda label: label.split(" ")[0].split(":")[0].rstrip("?")  # noqa: E731


def find_grps(game_dir: str | os.PathLike) -> tuple[dict, list]:
    """nome-base (minúsculo) -> caminho. Duplicatas (mesmo nome e tamanho) são ignoradas e listadas."""
    root = Path(game_dir)
    found: dict[str, Path] = {}
    dups: list[str] = []
    for p in sorted(root.rglob("*"), key=lambda q: (len(q.parts), str(q).lower())):
        if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() == ".grp":
            key = p.stem.lower()
            if key in found:
                same = found[key].stat().st_size == p.stat().st_size
                dups.append(f"{p} ({'idêntico em tamanho a' if same else 'DIFERENTE de'} {found[key]})")
                continue
            found[key] = p
    return found, dups


def build_catalog(game_dir, rht: RhtInfo) -> dict:
    grps, dups = find_grps(game_dir)
    by_pack: dict[str, list] = defaultdict(list)
    for e in rht.entries:
        by_pack[rht.pack_label(e.pack)].append(e)

    rows: list[dict] = []
    pack_report: dict[str, dict] = {}
    agree: dict[str, Counter] = defaultdict(Counter)
    issues: list[str] = []
    for pack, ents in sorted(by_pack.items()):
        path = grps.get(pack.lower())
        rep = {"entries": len(ents), "grp": str(path) if path else None, "lumps": None,
               "count_match": None, "numbers_are_permutation": None}
        nums = sorted(e.number for e in ents)
        rep["numbers_are_permutation"] = nums == list(range(len(ents)))
        if path is None:
            issues.append(f"pack '{pack}': .grp não encontrado na pasta")
            pack_report[pack] = rep
            continue
        try:
            with GrpFile(path) as g:
                rep["lumps"] = g.info.n_files
                rep["count_match"] = g.info.n_files == len(ents)
                for e in ents:
                    cls, length = None, None
                    if 0 <= e.number < g.info.n_files:
                        lp = g.info.lumps[e.number]
                        length = lp.length
                        cls = classify(g.head(lp, 64), lp.length) if lp.end <= g.info.file_size else "fora"
                    else:
                        issues.append(f"{pack}#{e.number}: índice fora do .grp ({g.info.n_files} lumps)")
                    base = BASE(cls) if cls else "?"
                    agree[e.type_name][base] += 1
                    rows.append({"pack": pack, "number": e.number, "type": e.type, "type_name": e.type_name,
                                 "name": rht.resource_name(e.offset), "class": cls, "length": length,
                                 "offset": e.offset})
        except GrpError as exc:
            issues.append(f"pack '{pack}': {exc}")
        pack_report[pack] = rep

    # lumps de .grp que nenhuma entrada do .rht referencia
    referenced = {(r["pack"], r["number"]) for r in rows}
    unreferenced = 0
    for pack, rep in pack_report.items():
        if rep["lumps"]:
            unreferenced += sum(1 for i in range(rep["lumps"]) if (pack, i) not in referenced)

    # consistência dos nomes: a distância entre offsets sucessivos deve ser len(nome)+1
    ordered = sorted(rht.entries, key=lambda e: e.offset)
    ok = bad = 0
    for a, b in zip(ordered, ordered[1:]):
        name = rht.resource_name(a.offset)
        if name is None or b.offset == a.offset:
            continue
        if b.offset - a.offset == len(name) + 1:
            ok += 1
        else:
            bad += 1
    names_present = sum(1 for r in rows if r["name"])
    return {"rows": rows, "pack_report": pack_report, "agreement": {k: dict(v) for k, v in agree.items()},
            "issues": issues, "duplicates_ignored": dups, "unreferenced_lumps": unreferenced,
            "name_spacing": {"consistent": ok, "inconsistent": bad}, "names_present": names_present}


def catalog_tsv(cat: dict) -> str:
    out = ["pack\tnumero\ttipo_id\ttipo\tclasse_detectada\ttamanho\tnome_do_recurso"]
    for r in sorted(cat["rows"], key=lambda r: (r["pack"].lower(), r["number"])):
        out.append(f"{r['pack']}\t{r['number']}\t{r['type']}\t{r['type_name']}\t{r['class']}\t{r['length']}\t{r['name']}")
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"


def catalog_summary(cat: dict, rht: RhtInfo) -> str:
    L = ["=== CATÁLOGO: cruzamento resource.rht x .grp ===",
         f"entradas no .rht: {len(rht.entries)}   linhas resolvidas: {len(cat['rows'])}   "
         f"nomes de recurso lidos: {cat['names_present']}   lumps sem entrada: {cat['unreferenced_lumps']}"]
    sp = cat["name_spacing"]
    L.append(f"consistência 'offset do próximo - offset = len(nome)+1': {sp['consistent']} ok / {sp['inconsistent']} diferentes")
    L += ["", "--- por pack (nome do .grp) ---", f"{'pack':<12} {'entradas':>8} {'lumps':>7}  contagem  permutação(0..n-1)  .grp"]
    for pack, r in sorted(cat["pack_report"].items()):
        L.append(f"{pack:<12} {r['entries']:>8} {str(r['lumps']):>7}  {str(r['count_match']):<8}  {str(r['numbers_are_permutation']):<18}  {r['grp']}")
    L += ["", "--- tipo do .rht x classe detectada no conteúdo (concordância) ---"]
    for tname, dist in sorted(cat["agreement"].items()):
        total = sum(dist.values())
        parts = ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(dist.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]))
        L.append(f"{tname:<18} total={total:<5} {parts}")
    L += ["", "--- amostras de nomes por tipo (até 4) ---"]
    seen: dict[str, list] = defaultdict(list)
    for r in sorted(cat["rows"], key=lambda r: (r["pack"].lower(), r["number"])):
        if len(seen[r["type_name"]]) < 4:
            seen[r["type_name"]].append(f"{r['pack']}#{r['number']}={r['name']!r}")
    for t, v in sorted(seen.items()):
        L.append(f"{t:<18} " + " | ".join(v))
    if cat["duplicates_ignored"]:
        L += ["", "--- .grp duplicados ignorados ---"] + cat["duplicates_ignored"]
    if cat["issues"]:
        L += ["", f"--- PROBLEMAS ({len(cat['issues'])}) ---"] + cat["issues"][:30]
    return "\n".join(L) + "\n"
```

## tools/py/f3vb/chunk.py

```python
"""Enquadramento de chunk: tag[4] + version(u32) + size(u32, inclui o cabeçalho)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import struct
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Iterator

from .knowledge import CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE

_HEADER = struct.Struct("<4sII")


class ChunkError(ValueError):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Chunk:
    tag: str
    version: int
    size: int      # total, inclui o cabeçalho de 12 bytes
    offset: int    # posição do cabeçalho no buffer

    @property
    def payload_offset(self) -> int:
        return self.offset + CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE

    @property
    def payload_size(self) -> int:
        return self.size - CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE


def _tag_ok(raw: bytes) -> bool:
    return all(32 <= b < 127 for b in raw)


def read_chunk(buf, pos: int = 0, end: int | None = None) -> Chunk:
    """Lê um cabeçalho em `pos` e valida contra `end`. Levanta ChunkError."""
    end = len(buf) if end is None else end
    if pos < 0 or pos + CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE > end:
        raise ChunkError(f"cabeçalho incompleto em {pos}")
    raw, version, size = _HEADER.unpack_from(buf, pos)
    if not _tag_ok(raw):
        raise ChunkError(f"tag não imprimível em {pos}: {raw!r}")
    if size < CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE:
        raise ChunkError(f"size {size} menor que o cabeçalho em {pos}")
    if pos + size > end:
        raise ChunkError(f"chunk em {pos} ultrapassa o buffer (size={size})")
    return Chunk(raw.decode("ascii"), version, size, pos)


def iter_chunks(buf, start: int = 0, end: int | None = None) -> Iterator[Chunk]:
    """Percorre chunks consecutivos. Para no primeiro erro de enquadramento."""
    end = len(buf) if end is None else end
    pos = start
    while pos + CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE <= end:
        chunk = read_chunk(buf, pos, end)
        yield chunk
        pos += chunk.size
    if pos != end:
        raise ChunkError(f"sobraram {end - pos} bytes após o último chunk")


def plausible_chunk_at(buf, pos: int, tag: bytes, max_version: int = 1000,
                       max_size: int = 256 * 1024 * 1024) -> bool:
    """Filtro barato para varredura sem layout: version e size dentro do razoável."""
    n = len(buf)
    if pos < 0 or pos + CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE > n:
        return False
    raw, version, size = _HEADER.unpack_from(buf, pos)
    return (raw == tag and version <= max_version
            and CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE <= size <= max_size and pos + size <= n)
```

## tools/py/f3vb/classify.py

```python
"""Classificação HEURÍSTICA do conteúdo de um lump (por magic). Os rótulos com '?'
são palpites fracos; servem para cruzar com os tipos do resource.rht."""
from __future__ import annotations

import struct

from .chunk import _tag_ok
from .knowledge import AMX_MAGICS, CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE


# Assinaturas de 16 bytes de arquivos Granny (constantes factuais, também presentes no
# blendergranny/MIT e na documentação pública do formato). Little e big-endian.
_GR2_WORDS = {
    "old": (0xCAB067B8, 0x0FB16DF8, 0x7E8C7284, 0x1E00195E),
    "32le": (0xC06CDE29, 0x2B53A4BA, 0xA5B7F525, 0xEEE266F6),
    "32be": (0xB595110E, 0x4BB5A56A, 0x502828EB, 0x04B37825),
    "64le": (0x5E499BE5, 0x141F636F, 0xA9EB131E, 0xC4EDBE90),
    "64be": (0xE3D49531, 0x624FDC20, 0x3AD036CC, 0x89FF82B1),
}
GR2_SIGNATURES = {}
for _name, _w in _GR2_WORDS.items():
    GR2_SIGNATURES[struct.pack("<4I", *_w)] = f"gr2 ({_name}, bytes LE)"
    GR2_SIGNATURES[struct.pack(">4I", *_w)] = f"gr2 ({_name}, bytes BE)"


def classify(data: bytes, total_size: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Classifica pelo começo do arquivo. `data` pode ser só o início (ex.: 64 bytes);
    passe `total_size` (tamanho real do lump) para validar tamanhos declarados (AMX, chunk)."""
    avail = len(data)
    total = avail if total_size is None else max(total_size, avail)
    if total == 0:
        return "vazio"
    if avail >= 16 and data[:16] in GR2_SIGNATURES:
        return "gr2"
    if data[:4] == b"B3D ":
        return "b3d"
    if data[:4] == b"8TRE":
        return "8tre"
    if avail >= 12 and data[:4] == b"RIFF" and data[8:12] == b"WAVE":
        return "wav"
    if avail >= 14 and data[:2] == b"BM":
        return "bmp?"
    if avail >= 8:
        size32 = struct.unpack_from("<i", data, 0)[0]
        magic16 = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, 4)[0]
        if magic16 in AMX_MAGICS and 0 < size32 <= total:
            return f"amx? ({AMX_MAGICS[magic16]})"
    if avail >= CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE and _tag_ok(data[:4]):
        _, version, csize = struct.unpack_from("<4sII", data, 0)
        if CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE <= csize <= total and version <= 1000:
            return f"chunk:{data[:4].decode('ascii')}"
    if avail >= 18 and data[1] in (0, 1) and data[2] in (1, 2, 3, 9, 10, 11) and data[16] in (8, 15, 16, 24, 32):
        w, h = struct.unpack_from("<HH", data, 12)
        if 0 < w <= 8192 and 0 < h <= 8192:
            return "tga?"
    sample = data[:512]
    if all(b in (9, 10, 13) or 32 <= b < 127 or b >= 128 for b in sample):
        try:
            sample.decode("utf-8")
            return "texto?"
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            pass
    return "bin"
```
