```python
"""CLI: python -m f3vb {inventory|probe|report} ..."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from collections import Counter

from .amxdis import analyze_amx, disassemble
from .analyze import aggregate_grp, format_resumo
from .b3dfail import b3d_failures
from .export import DEFAULT_MESH_SCALE, Exporter, export_b3d_to_glb
from .extractor import ExtractOptions, convert_retail, extract_all, fmt_bytes as _fb, plan as _plan
from .layout import AssetsLayout, default_assets_dir
from .f3m import write_f3m
from .gr2export import read_clips, read_skeleton
from .index import ResourceIndex
from .stf import StfError, parse_stf
from .catalog import build_catalog, catalog_summary, catalog_tsv
from .classify import classify
from .extract import base_class, extract, sample
from .gr2tool import summarize_gr2
from .probes import probe_amx, probe_b3d, probe_bmp, probe_tga
from .grp import GrpError, GrpFile
from .inventory import inventory
from .knowledge import RESOURCE_EXT
from .probe import probe_file
from .rht import RhtError, read_rht


def _game_dir(arg: str | None) -> str:
    d = arg or os.environ.get("F3VB_GAME_DIR")
    if not d:
        sys.exit("Informe a pasta da demo (argumento ou variável F3VB_GAME_DIR).")
    return d


def _fmt_bytes(n: int) -> str:
    for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB"):
        if n < 1024 or unit == "GB":
            return f"{n:.1f} {unit}" if unit != "B" else f"{n} B"
        n /= 1024
    return f"{n} B"


def cmd_inventory(a) -> None:
    inv = inventory(_game_dir(a.game_dir), with_hash=a.hash)
    print(f"Pasta: {inv['root']}")
    print(f"Arquivos: {inv['total_files']}  Total: {_fmt_bytes(inv['total_bytes'])}")
    print(f"Pasta Override presente: {inv['has_override_dir']}")
    print("\nPor extensão (maiores primeiro):")
    for ext, v in inv["by_ext"].items():
        print(f"  .{ext:<14} {v['files']:>6} arquivos  {_fmt_bytes(v['bytes']):>10}")
    if inv["duplicates"]:
        print(f"\nDUPLICATAS (mesmo nome e tamanho): {len(inv['duplicates'])} grupo(s), {_fmt_bytes(inv['duplicate_bytes'])} repetidos")
        for grupo in inv["duplicates"]:
            print("  -", " = ".join(grupo))
    print("\nArquivos .grp:")
    for e in inv["grp_files"]:
        print(f"  {e['path']}  ({_fmt_bytes(e['size'])})")
    print("\nArquivos notáveis:")
    for n, e in inv["notable"].items():
        print(f"  {n:<14} {'ok  ' + _fmt_bytes(e['size']) if e else 'AUSENTE'}")
    if a.json:
        Path(a.json).write_text(json.dumps(inv, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"\nJSON salvo em {a.json}")


def cmd_probe(a) -> None:
    r = probe_file(a.file, head_bytes=a.head)
    print(f"{r['path']}  ({_fmt_bytes(r['size'])})")
    print(f"Primeiros 16 bytes em ASCII: {r.get('head_ascii_16', '')!r}\n")
    print(r["head_hex"])
    print("\nMagics (contagem aproximada):")
    for k, v in r["magics"].items():
        print(f"  {k:<28} {v['count']:>8}  offsets: {v['first_offsets']}")
    print("\nChunks plausíveis (tags deduzidas dos patterns, NÃO verificadas):")
    for tag, v in r["chunks"].items():
        print(f"  {tag}  [{v['group']}]  {v['plausible']:>6}  offsets: {v['first_offsets']}")


def _grp_summary(path, with_classes: bool = True, aggregates: bool = False) -> dict:
    with GrpFile(path) as g:
        info = g.info
        classes: Counter = Counter()
        sizes = [lp.length for lp in info.lumps]
        if with_classes:
            for lp in info.lumps:
                classes[classify(g.head(lp, 64), lp.length)] += 1
        return {
            "path": str(path),
            "version": [info.v_major, info.v_minor],
            "lumps": info.n_files,
            "file_size": info.file_size,
            "payload_bytes": sum(sizes),
            "largest_lump": max(sizes, default=0),
            "classes": dict(classes.most_common()),
            "issues": info.issues[:20],
            "issues_total": len(info.issues),
            "aggregates": aggregate_grp(g) if aggregates else None,
        }


def cmd_grp(a) -> None:
    try:
        summ = _grp_summary(a.file)
    except GrpError as exc:
        sys.exit(f"Não parece um .grp neste layout: {exc}")
    print(f"{summ['path']}  ({_fmt_bytes(summ['file_size'])})")
    print(f"Versão {summ['version'][0]}.{summ['version'][1]}  lumps: {summ['lumps']}  "
          f"dados: {_fmt_bytes(summ['payload_bytes'])}  maior: {_fmt_bytes(summ['largest_lump'])}")
    print("Conteúdo por heurística de magic (palpites, '?' = fraco):")
    for k, v in summ["classes"].items():
        print(f"  {k:<22} {v:>7}")
    if summ["issues_total"]:
        print(f"\nPROBLEMAS ({summ['issues_total']}):")
        for i in summ["issues"]:
            print("  -", i)
    if a.list or a.extract:
        out = Path(a.extract) if a.extract else None
        if out:
            out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with GrpFile(a.file) as g:
            for lp in g.info.lumps:
                head = g.head(lp, 64)
                cls = classify(head, lp.length)
                if a.list:
                    print(f"  #{lp.index:<6} off={lp.offset:<10} len={lp.length:<10} {cls}")
                if out and lp.end <= g.info.file_size:
                    ext = cls.split(":")[0].split(" ")[0].rstrip("?") or "bin"
                    (out / f"lump_{lp.index:05d}.{ext if ext.isalnum() else 'bin'}").write_bytes(g.read(lp))
        if out:
            print(f"\nLumps extraídos em {out} (guarde em private/, nunca commite)")


def cmd_rht(a) -> None:
    try:
        info = read_rht(a.file)
    except RhtError as exc:
        sys.exit(f"Não parece um resource.rht neste layout: {exc}")
    s = info.summary()
    print(f"{a.file}  ({_fmt_bytes(s['file_size'])})  versão {s['version'][0]}.{s['version'][1]}")
    print(f"Entradas: {s['entries']}  offsetPacks={s['offset_packs']}  offsetResources={s['offset_resources']}  "
          f"(fim da tabela de entradas={s['entries_end']})")
    print("\nPor tipo:")
    for name, v in s["by_type"].items():
        ext = RESOURCE_EXT.get(v["type_id"], "?")
        print(f"  {v['type_id']:>5} {name:<18} .{ext:<5} {v['count']:>7}")
    if s["unknown_type_ids"]:
        print("\nTIPOS NÃO CATALOGADOS nos patterns:", s["unknown_type_ids"])
    print("\nPor pack:", s["by_pack"])
    if s["unknown_pack_values"]:
        print("Valores de pack fora do enum:", s["unknown_pack_values"])
    print(f"\nCampo 'one': {s['field_one_values']}")
    print(f"'number': {s['number_unique']} únicos, faixa {s['number_range']}")
    print(f"'offset': faixa {s['offset_range']}")
    print("\nStrings da região de packs (offset relativo, texto):")
    for off, txt in s["pack_region_strings"]:
        print(f"  {off:>5}  {txt!r}")
    if s["issues"]:
        print("\nPROBLEMAS:", *s["issues"][:10], sep="\n  - ")
    if a.entries:
        print("\nPrimeiras entradas:")
        for e in info.entries[:a.entries]:
            print(f"  #{e.index:<6} pack={info.pack_label(e.pack):<10} lump={e.number:<6} type={e.type_name:<18} "
                  f"name={info.resource_name(e.offset)!r}")


def _print_manifest(m: dict) -> None:
    print(f"{m['count']} arquivo(s) de {m['source_grp']}")
    for e in m["files"]:
        pr = e.get("probe") or {}
        extra = ""
        if e["class"].startswith("gr2") and "version" in pr:
            extra = f"  v{pr['version']} {pr['compressions']}"
        elif e["class"].startswith("tga") and "width" in pr:
            extra = f"  {pr['width']}x{pr['height']} {pr['bpp']}bpp {pr['type_name']}"
        elif e["class"].startswith("b3d"):
            extra = f"  tex={len(pr.get('textures', []))} mat={len(pr.get('materials', []))} bones={pr.get('bone_count', 0)}"
        print(f"  {e['file']:<22} lump #{e['lump']:<6} {e['length']:>10} B  {e['class']}{extra}")
    for c in m.get("not_found", []):
        print(f"  (nenhum lump '{c}' encontrado no intervalo de tamanho pedido)")


def cmd_extract(a) -> None:
    classes = a.classes.split(",") if a.classes else None
    indices = [int(x) for x in a.indices.split(",")] if a.indices else None
    m = extract(a.file, a.out, classes=classes, indices=indices, limit=a.limit)
    _print_manifest(m)
    print(f"\nSaída em {a.out} (guarde em private/, nunca commite)")


def cmd_sample(a) -> None:
    m = sample(a.file, a.out, classes=tuple(a.classes.split(",")), per_class=a.per_class,
               min_bytes=a.min_bytes, max_bytes=a.max_bytes, strategy=a.strategy, make_zip=not a.no_zip,
               text_only=a.so_texto)
    _print_manifest(m)
    if m.get("zip"):
        print(f"\nZIP para enviar à análise: {m['zip']}")


def cmd_gr2(a) -> None:
    data = Path(a.file).read_bytes()
    print(json.dumps(summarize_gr2(data, deep=not a.no_deep), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))


def cmd_inspect(a) -> None:
    if a.grp is not None:
        with GrpFile(a.grp) as g:
            data = g.read(int(a.file))
    else:
        data = Path(a.file).read_bytes()
    cls = classify(data[:64], len(data))
    b = base_class(cls)
    print(f"classe: {cls}  tamanho: {len(data)}")
    if b == "gr2":
        res = summarize_gr2(data, deep=not a.no_deep)
    elif b == "b3d":
        res = probe_b3d(data)
    elif b == "tga":
        res = probe_tga(data)
    elif b == "bmp":
        res = probe_bmp(data)
    elif b == "amx":
        res = probe_amx(data)
    else:
        res = {"nota": "sem sonda específica para esta classe"}
    print(json.dumps(res, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))


def cmd_catalog(a) -> None:
    game = _game_dir(a.game_dir)
    rht_path = a.rht
    if not rht_path:
        found = next(Path(game).rglob("resource.rht"), None)
        if not found:
            sys.exit("resource.rht não encontrado; use --rht CAMINHO")
        rht_path = str(found)
    info = read_rht(rht_path)
    cat = build_catalog(game, info)
    out = Path(a.out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (out / "catalogo.txt").write_text(catalog_tsv(cat), encoding="utf-8")
    text = catalog_summary(cat, info)
    (out / "catalogo_resumo.txt").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    print(text)
    print(f"Arquivos: {out / 'catalogo.txt'} e {out / 'catalogo_resumo.txt'}")


def cmd_amxdis(a) -> None:
    if a.grp is not None:
        with GrpFile(a.grp) as g:
            data = g.read(int(a.file))
    else:
        data = Path(a.file).read_bytes()
    if a.check:
        r = analyze_amx(data)
        r = {k: v for k, v in r.items() if not k.startswith("_")}
        print(json.dumps(r, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    else:
        print(disassemble(data))


def cmd_b3dmat(a) -> None:
    """Materiais, texturas, UVs e ossos de um modelo B3D (le de original_assets/RETAIL; nao imprime nada do conteudo do jogo alem de nomes e numeros)."""
    from .b3d import read_b3d
    from .export import resolve_bone_aliases
    from .gr2export import read_skeleton
    from .imagecodec import decode_bmp, decode_tga
    from .index import RetailIndex
    ix = RetailIndex.from_csv(a.assets) if a.assets else RetailIndex.from_csv(default_assets_dir())
    raw = ix.read_named(a.name, "G3D_Model")
    if raw is None:
        sys.exit(f"modelo '{a.name}' nao encontrado em RETAIL (use 'py -3 -m f3vb export-list G3D_Model --prefix {a.name[:4]}' para ver nomes)")
    model = read_b3d(raw)
    lines = [f"MODELO {a.name}: {len(list(model.surfaces()))} superficie(s), {len(model.bones)} osso(s) citados"]
    sraw = ix.read_named(a.name, "SKEL_Skeleton")
    joints = read_skeleton(sraw)[0] if sraw else None
    bone_names = [b.name for b in model.bones]
    if joints:
        res, aliased = resolve_bone_aliases(bone_names, joints)
        jn = {j.name for j in joints}
        lines.append(f"esqueleto '{a.name}': {len(joints)} juntas; ossos do B3D sem junta (mesmo com apelidos): {[b for b in res if b not in jn]}")
        lines.append(f"ossos casados por sufixo: {aliased}")
    else:
        lines.append(f"esqueleto '{a.name}' nao encontrado em RETAIL")
    lines.append("ossos do B3D: " + ", ".join(bone_names))
    seen_tex = {}
    for ni, (node, surf) in enumerate(model.surfaces()):
        us = [p[0] for p in surf.uv0]; vs = [p[1] for p in surf.uv0]
        lines.append(f"--- superficie #{ni} no '{getattr(node, 'name', '')}': {len(surf.positions)} vertices, familia {surf.family}, "
                     f"uv0 u[{min(us, default=0):.3f},{max(us, default=0):.3f}] v[{min(vs, default=0):.3f},{max(vs, default=0):.3f}], "
                     f"uv1 {'sim' if surf.uv1 else 'nao'}, cor de vertice {'sim' if surf.colors else 'nao'}, lightmap {surf.lightmap}")
        for mi, m in enumerate(surf.materials):
            lines.append(f"    material #{mi} '{m.name}' blend={m.blend} tipo={m.type} floats={[round(x, 3) for x in m.floats[:13]]}")
            for t in m.textures:
                stem = t.rsplit('.', 1)[0]
                if stem not in seen_tex:
                    tr = ix.read_named(stem, "TGA_Image")
                    info = "NAO encontrada em RETAIL"
                    if tr is not None:
                        try:
                            w, h, _ = decode_bmp(tr) if tr[:2] == b"BM" else decode_tga(tr)
                            info = f"{w}x{h}"
                        except Exception as exc:
                            info = f"erro: {exc}"
                    seen_tex[stem] = info
                lines.append(f"        textura '{t}': {seen_tex[stem]}")
    text = "\n".join(lines)
    print(text)
    if a.out:
        Path(a.out).write_text(text + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"\nRelatorio em {a.out}")


def cmd_pack_sample(a) -> None:
    from .index import RetailIndex
    from .sample import write_sample_zip
    root = Path(a.assets) if a.assets else default_assets_dir()
    ix = RetailIndex.from_csv(root)
    out = Path(a.out) if a.out else root.parent / "private" / ("amostra_" + "_".join(a.names[:3]) + ".zip")
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    n, total, warns = write_sample_zip(ix, a.names, out, a.anims)
    for w in warns:
        print("aviso:", w)
    print(f"{n} arquivos ({total // 1024} KB sem compressao) em {out}")
    print("Este zip tem conteudo do jogo: so para enviar a quem esta depurando, nunca publicar.")


def _find_resource(ix, name: str, type_name: str):
    """Procura por nome exato e depois por trecho (precisa ser unico)."""
    hit = ix.find(name, type_name)
    if hit:
        return hit
    cands = [(n, pk, num) for n, pk, num in ix.entries.get(type_name, []) if name.lower() in n.lower()]
    if len(cands) == 1:
        return cands[0][1], cands[0][2]
    if not cands:
        sys.exit(f"'{name}' nao encontrado em RETAIL (tipo {type_name}).")
    sys.exit(f"'{name}' e ambiguo em {type_name}: " + ", ".join(sorted(c[0] for c in cands)[:12]))


def cmd_map_info(a) -> None:
    from .index import RetailIndex
    from .mapreport import analyze_map
    if Path(a.name).is_file():                       # arquivo avulso .map (+ --rle)
        data = Path(a.name).read_bytes()
        rle = Path(a.rle).read_bytes() if a.rle else None
        label = Path(a.name).stem
    else:
        ix = RetailIndex.from_csv(a.assets) if a.assets else RetailIndex.from_csv(default_assets_dir())
        pk, num = _find_resource(ix, a.name, "MAP_Map")
        data = ix.read(pk, num)
        label = a.name
        from .mapfile import read_map
        hdr = read_map(data).header
        stem = hdr.get("rle", "").rsplit(".", 1)[0]
        rle = ix.read_named(stem, "RLE") if stem else None
        tstem = hdr.get("tre", "").rsplit(".", 1)[0]
        tre_raw = ix.read_named(tstem, "TRE_Octree") if tstem else None
    if Path(a.name).is_file():
        tre_raw = Path(a.tre).read_bytes() if a.tre else None
    m, grid, info, txt, js, png, f3 = analyze_map(label, data, rle, tre_raw)
    print(txt)
    if a.out:
        Path(a.out).write_text(txt, encoding="utf-8")
    if a.json:
        Path(a.json).write_text(js, encoding="utf-8")
    if a.png and png:
        Path(a.png).write_bytes(png)
        print(f"imagem: {a.png}")
    if a.f3map and f3:
        Path(a.f3map).write_bytes(f3)
        print(f"mapa para o F3VBMapViewer: {a.f3map} ({len(f3) // 1024} KB)")


def cmd_tre_info(a) -> None:
    from .index import RetailIndex
    from .tre import read_tre
    if Path(a.name).is_file():
        data = Path(a.name).read_bytes()
    else:
        ix = RetailIndex.from_csv(a.assets) if a.assets else RetailIndex.from_csv(default_assets_dir())
        pk, num = _find_resource(ix, a.name, "TRE_Octree")
        data = ix.read(pk, num)
    t = read_tre(data)
    tris, st = t.triangles()
    b = t.bounds()
    print(f"8TRE {len(data)} bytes; HEAD {t.head}; LVLD info {t.level_info}")
    print(f"blocos de vertices: {[x.count for x in t.blocks]}; nos {sum(1 for n in t.nodes if n.kind == 'NODE')}, folhas {sum(1 for n in t.nodes if n.kind == 'LEAF')}; triangulos {len(tris)}")
    print(f"caixa: x[{b[0]:.1f},{b[3]:.1f}] y[{b[1]:.1f},{b[4]:.1f}] z[{b[2]:.1f},{b[5]:.1f}]")
    print(f"materiais: {[(m['name'], m['blend'], m['surface']) for m in t.materials]}")
    print(f"texturas: {t.textures}; luzes: {len(t.lights)}")
    print(f"indices: {st['indices']}, fora da caixa da folha {st['outside_bbox']} ({100 * st['outside_bbox'] / max(1, st['indices']):.2f}%), corrigidos por mascara {st['masked']}, invalidos {st['bad']}")
    bs = t.batch_stats()
    print(f"lotes (v16): nos com indices {bs['nodes']}, que nao fecharam {bs['unparsed']}; materiais usados {len(bs['materials'])}, paginas de lightmap {len([x for x in bs['pages'] if x])}, texturas difusas {len([x for x in bs['textures'] if x])}")
    for mid, nt in sorted(bs["materials"].items()):
        mt = t.materials[mid] if mid < len(t.materials) else None
        print(f"  material #{mid} {mt['name'] if mt else '(fora da tabela)'} ({mt['blend'] + ', ' + mt['surface'] if mt else '?'}): {nt} triangulos")
    for k, nt in sorted(bs["textures"].items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:12]:
        names = [x for x in t.textures if x.lower().endswith('.tga')]
        print(f"  textura difusa {k}: {names[k - 1] if 1 <= k <= len(names) else '(nenhuma)'}: {nt} triangulos")


def cmd_tre_check(a) -> None:
    """Confere o parser de lotes em TODOS os .8tre de uma pasta (ou do RETAIL): nos que nao fecham, indices fora da caixa da folha, triangulos."""
    from .tre import read_tre
    if a.folder:
        files = sorted(Path(a.folder).rglob("*.8tre"))
        reader = lambda f: f.read_bytes()                                    # noqa: E731
    else:
        from .index import RetailIndex
        ix = RetailIndex.from_csv(a.assets) if a.assets else RetailIndex.from_csv(default_assets_dir())
        files = sorted(ix.entries.get("TRE_Octree", []))                     # (nome, pack, numero)
        reader = lambda r: ix.read(r[1], r[2])                               # noqa: E731
    tot = {"arquivos": 0, "nos": 0, "gramatica_completa": 0, "nao_fechados": 0, "fora_bbox": 0, "triangulos": 0, "sem_estado": 0, "erros": 0}
    for f in files:
        name = f.name if hasattr(f, "name") else f[0]
        try:
            t = read_tre(reader(f))
        except Exception as e:                                               # noqa: BLE001
            tot["erros"] += 1
            print(f"ERRO {name}: {e}")
            continue
        bs = t.batch_stats()
        tris, st = t.triangles_ex()
        tot["arquivos"] += 1
        tot["nos"] += bs["nodes"]
        tot["nao_fechados"] += bs["unparsed"]
        tot["fora_bbox"] += st["outside_bbox"]
        tot["triangulos"] += len(tris)
        tot["gramatica_completa"] += bs["full_grammar"]
        sem = sum(1 for tr in tris if tr[2] == 0 and tr[3] == 0 and tr[4] == 0)       # v19: deve ser 0 (era o "lote inicial" sem textura nem lightmap)
        tot["sem_estado"] += sem
        flag = "" if not bs["unparsed"] and not st["outside_bbox"] and bs["full_grammar"] == bs["nodes"] else "  <== atencao"
        print(f"{name:40s} nos {bs['nodes']:5d} gramatica {bs['full_grammar']:5d} nao-fechados {bs['unparsed']:3d} fora-da-caixa {st['outside_bbox']:6d} "
              f"triangulos {len(tris):8d} sem-estado {sem:6d}{flag}")
    print(f"TOTAL: {tot}")
    print("Esperado (v19, 38 arquivos): nos=5925 gramatica_completa=5925 nao_fechados=0 fora_bbox=0 triangulos=1928117 sem_estado=0")
    print("(sem_estado = triangulos com material 0, sem pagina e sem textura: no v16-v18 eram o 'lote inicial' e saiam brancos)")

def cmd_export_glb(a) -> None:
    game = _game_dir(a.game_dir)
    with ResourceIndex(game) as ix:
        data = ix.read_named(a.name, "G3D_Model")
        if data is None:
            close = [n for n, _, _ in ix.search("G3D_Model", a.name[:4])][:8]
            sys.exit(f"modelo '{a.name}' não encontrado. Parecidos: {close}. Use: export-list G3D_Model --prefix XX")
        joints, clips = None, []
        skel_name = a.skeleton if a.skeleton is not None else a.name
        if skel_name:
            sdata = ix.read_named(skel_name, "SKEL_Skeleton")
            if sdata is not None:
                joints, _ = read_skeleton(sdata)
                print(f"esqueleto '{skel_name}': {len(joints)} ossos")
            elif a.skeleton:
                sys.exit(f"esqueleto '{a.skeleton}' não encontrado")
        if joints and not a.no_anim:
            prefix = a.anim if a.anim is not None else a.name + "_"
            rows = ix.search("GR2_Animation", prefix)
            if a.max_anims and len(rows) > a.max_anims:
                print(f"{len(rows)} animações com prefixo '{prefix}': exportando as {a.max_anims} primeiras (use --max-anims 0 para todas)")
                rows = rows[:a.max_anims]
            names = {j.name for j in joints}
            for nm, pack, num in rows:
                try:
                    clips += read_clips(ix.read(pack, num), names, clip_name=nm)
                except Exception as exc:
                    print(f"  aviso: animação {nm}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
        def loader(stem):
            raw = ix.read_named(stem, "TGA_Image")
            return raw
        glb, rep = export_b3d_to_glb(data, a.name, texture_loader=loader, joints=joints, clips=clips,
                                     unit_scale=a.scale, convert=not a.no_convert, mesh_scale=a.mesh_scale)
    out = Path(a.out) if a.out else Path("private/glb") / f"{a.name}.glb"
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_bytes(glb)
    st = rep["stats"]
    print(f"GLB salvo em {out} ({len(glb)} bytes): {st['surfaces']} superfícies, {st['vertices']} vértices, "
          f"{st['triangles']} triângulos, {st['textures']} texturas, {st['joints']} ossos, {st['animations']} animações")
    for w in rep["warnings"][:15]:
        print("  aviso:", w)
    from .glb import validate_glb
    probs = validate_glb(glb)
    print("validação estrutural:", "OK" if not probs else probs)


def cmd_stf(a) -> None:
    data = Path(a.file).read_bytes()
    try:
        stf = parse_stf(data)
    except StfError as exc:
        sys.exit(f"Não parece um .stf neste layout: {exc}\nPrimeiros 32 bytes: {data[:32].hex(' ')}")
    print(f"{a.file}: magic={stf.magic!r} entradas={stf.count} tamanho={len(data)}")
    for i in (a.id or []):
        try:
            print(f"  [{i}] {stf.text(data, i)!r}")
        except StfError as exc:
            print(f"  [{i}] erro: {exc}")
    if a.info or not a.id:
        for i in range(min(5, stf.count)):
            off, ln, const = stf.entries[i]
            print(f"  entrada {i}: offset={off} length={ln} constante={const.hex(' ')} texto={stf.text(data, i)[:60]!r}")


def cmd_extract_all(a) -> None:
    game = _game_dir(a.game_dir)
    if a.plan_only:
        p = _plan(game)
        print(f"{p['files']} arquivos, {_fb(p['bytes'])} no tamanho real")
        return
    opts = ExtractOptions(raw=not a.no_raw, png=a.png, glb=a.glb, f3m=a.f3m, maps=a.maps, anims_per_model=a.anims)
    last = [0.0]

    def prog(d, t, m):
        import time as _t
        if _t.time() - last[0] > 0.5 or d == t:
            last[0] = _t.time()
            print(f"\r{d}/{t}  {m[:60]:<60}", end="", flush=True)

    layout = AssetsLayout(a.out)
    print(f"Destino: {layout.root}  (RETAIL = originais, CONVERTED = convertidos)")
    try:
        log = extract_all(game, a.out, opts, progress=prog)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        sys.exit(f"\nErro: {exc}. Confira se a pasta da demo é a que tem o resource.rht e a pasta data com os .grp.")
    print(f"\nConcluído em {log['seconds']} s: {log['written']} arquivos ({_fb(log['bytes'])}), PNG {log['png']}, "
          f"F3M {log['f3m_models']}+{log['f3m_skeletons']}, GLB {log['glb']}, falhas {len(log['failures'])}")
    print(f"Relatório: {layout.report}")
    # v19: as fontes e o English.stf ficam SOLTOS na pasta da demo (fora dos .grp); traz junto
    from .loose import import_loose
    try:
        r = import_loose(Path(game), layout.root)
        print(f"Arquivos soltos (v19): {r['fonts']} fonte(s), English.stf {'ok' if not any('English.stf' in m for m in r['missing']) else 'NAO ACHADO'}")
    except OSError as exc:
        print(f"Arquivos soltos (v19): nao copiados ({exc}); rode  py -3 -m f3vb import-loose <pasta da demo>")


def cmd_convert_retail(a) -> None:
    layout = AssetsLayout(a.out)
    if not (a.png or a.glb or a.f3m or a.maps):
        a.png = a.f3m = a.maps = True
    if layout.converted_is_stale():
        print("Aviso: CONVERTED veio de um conversor antigo (v11 ou sem registro); será refeita agora.")
    opts = ExtractOptions(png=a.png, glb=a.glb, f3m=a.f3m, maps=a.maps, anims_per_model=a.anims)
    last = [0.0]

    def prog(d, t, m):
        import time as _t
        if _t.time() - last[0] > 0.5 or d == t:
            last[0] = _t.time()
            print(f"\r{d}/{t}  {m[:60]:<60}", end="", flush=True)

    try:
        log = convert_retail(a.out, opts, progress=prog)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        sys.exit(str(exc))
    print(f"\nConcluído em {log['seconds']} s: PNG {log['png']}, F3M {log['f3m_models']}+{log['f3m_skeletons']}, "
          f"GLB {log['glb']}, mapas {log['maps']}, scripts {log.get('scripts', 0)}, texturas {log.get('textures', 0)}, falhas {len(log['failures'])}")

def _stf_lookup(layout):
    """v19: acha o English.stf (CONVERTED/scripts, F3VB_STF ou a pasta da demo) e devolve id(1-based) -> texto; None se nao achar."""
    import os
    cands = [os.environ.get("F3VB_STF", ""), str(layout.converted / "scripts" / "English.stf"), str(layout.root / "English.stf")]
    for c in cands:
        if c and Path(c).is_file():
            data = Path(c).read_bytes()
            try:
                st = parse_stf(data)
            except StfError:
                continue
            return lambda i, st=st, data=data: st.text_id(data, i)
    return None

        print("Confira se a pasta e a da demo (a que tem F3.exe, Fonts e English.stf).")

def cmd_export_f3m(a) -> None:
    game = _game_dir(a.game_dir)
    with ResourceIndex(game) as ix:
        data = ix.read_named(a.name, "G3D_Model")
        if data is None:
            sys.exit(f"modelo '{a.name}' não encontrado (use export-list G3D_Model)")
        joints, clips = None, []
        sk = a.skeleton if a.skeleton is not None else a.name
        if sk:
            sd = ix.read_named(sk, "SKEL_Skeleton")
            if sd is not None:
                joints, _ = read_skeleton(sd)
        if joints:
            rows = ix.search("GR2_Animation", (a.anim if a.anim is not None else a.name + "_"))
            if a.max_anims:
                rows = rows[:a.max_anims]
            names = {j.name for j in joints}
            for nm, pk, num in rows:
                try:
                    clips += read_clips(ix.read(pk, num), names, clip_name=nm)
                except Exception as exc:
                    print(f"  aviso: {nm}: {exc}")
        from .b3d import read_b3d as _rb
        ex = Exporter(unit_scale=a.scale, convert=not a.no_convert, mesh_scale=a.mesh_scale)
        sc = ex.scene(_rb(data), a.name, texture_loader=lambda stem: ix.read_named(stem, "TGA_Image"), joints=joints, clips=clips)
    out = Path(a.out) if a.out else Path("private/f3m") / f"{a.name}.f3m"
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_bytes(write_f3m(sc))
    st = ex.stats
    print(f"F3M salvo em {out}: {st['vertices']} vértices, {st['triangles']} triângulos, {st['textures']} texturas, "
          f"{st['joints']} ossos, {st['animations']} animações")
    for w in ex.warnings[:10]:
        print("  aviso:", w)


def cmd_zipdir(a) -> None:
    import zipfile
    src = Path(a.dir)
    dest = Path(a.zip)
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    n = 0
    with zipfile.ZipFile(dest, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for p in sorted(src.rglob("*")):
            if p.is_file() and p.resolve() != dest.resolve():
                z.write(p, p.relative_to(src).as_posix())   # barras normais (o Compress-Archive do PS 5.1 usa \\)
                n += 1
    print(f"{n} arquivo(s) em {dest}")


def cmd_report(a) -> None:
    game = _game_dir(a.game_dir)
    inv = inventory(game, with_hash=a.hash)
    report = {"schema": 1, "inventory": {k: v for k, v in inv.items() if k != "files"},
              "probes": []}
    report["grps"] = []
    vistos = set()
    for e in sorted(inv["grp_files"], key=lambda x: (len(x["path"]), x["path"].lower())):
        chave = (e["path"].split("/")[-1].lower(), e["size"])
        if chave in vistos:
            print(f"Duplicata ignorada: {e['path']}", file=sys.stderr)
            report.setdefault("duplicate_grps_ignored", []).append(e["path"])
            continue
        vistos.add(chave)
        print(f"Sondando {e['path']} ...", file=sys.stderr)
        if a.raw_probe:
            report["probes"].append(probe_file(Path(game) / e["path"]))
        try:
            report["grps"].append(_grp_summary(Path(game) / e["path"], aggregates=True))
        except GrpError as exc:
            report["grps"].append({"path": e["path"], "error": str(exc)})
    rht_entry = inv["notable"].get("resource.rht")
    if rht_entry:
        try:
            report["rht"] = read_rht(Path(game) / rht_entry["path"]).summary()
        except RhtError as exc:
            report["rht"] = {"error": str(exc)}
    report = json.loads(json.dumps(report))  # normaliza chaves (int -> str), igual ao que `resumo` relê
    Path(a.out).write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Relatório salvo em {a.out}")
    if a.resumo:
        Path(a.resumo).write_text(format_resumo(report), encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"Resumo salvo em {a.resumo}")


def cmd_resumo(a) -> None:
    report = json.loads(Path(a.report).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    print(format_resumo(report))


def main(argv=None) -> None:
```

## tools/py/f3vb/export.py

```python
"""Exportador B3D (+ esqueleto/animações GR2 + texturas) -> GLB.

Convenções (decisões do exportador; ver docs/EXPORTADOR_GLB.md):
 - O jogo é mão-esquerda, Y para cima (confirmado: `coordinate_system LEFT_HANDED`, cabeça em y ~ 5). O glTF é
   mão-direita, Y para cima: invertemos o eixo Z (posição, normal; quaternion (x,y,z,w) -> (-x,-y,z,w)).
 - O sentido dos triângulos é decidido POR DADOS: comparamos a normal geométrica com as normais dos vértices.
 - Unidade: 1 unidade do jogo = `unit_scale` (padrão 1.0). Sem referência oficial de escala.
 - Rotações de osso/nó do B3D são eixo-ângulo em GRAUS (observado: (0, .71, -.70, 179.99)).
 - Matrizes inversas de bind vêm do GR2 (InverseWorld4x4); no glTF o mesmo vetor de 16 floats serve (Granny usa a
   convenção linha-vetor; ler linha a linha equivale à coluna-major do glTF).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace

import math
import re

from .b3d import Model, read_b3d
from .gr2export import Clip, Joint
from .glb import FLOAT, Glb, UINT, USHORT, ARRAY_BUFFER, ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, quat_normalize
from .imagecodec import ImageError, image_to_png

# Escala da geometria do B3D em relação ao esqueleto do GR2 (MEDIDO em CR_Dog e CR_FloatingEyeBot: a melhor correspondência
# entre vértices de peso ~1 e o osso dono deles dá k = 10,2 a 10,4; 10,24 = coordinate_scale (1024) / 100 é HIPÓTESE).
# Sem isto, a pose de bind parece certa (W * IBM = identidade), mas qualquer animação gira os vértices em torno de pivôs errados.
DEFAULT_MESH_SCALE = 100.0 / 1024.0

ALPHA_MODES = {"OPAQUE": "OPAQUE", "ALPHABLEND": "BLEND", "ADD": "BLEND"}


def _axis_angle_to_quat(v):
    x, y, z, deg = v
    n = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z)
    if n < 1e-9:
        return (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    s = math.sin(math.radians(deg) / 2) / n
    return quat_normalize((x * s, y * s, z * s, math.cos(math.radians(deg) / 2)))


def _quat_to_mat3(q):
    x, y, z, w = q
    n = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z + w * w) or 1.0
    x, y, z, w = x / n, y / n, z / n, w / n
    return [[1 - 2 * (y * y + z * z), 2 * (x * y - z * w), 2 * (x * z + y * w)],
            [2 * (x * y + z * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + z * z), 2 * (y * z - x * w)],
            [2 * (x * z - y * w), 2 * (y * z + x * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + y * y)]]


def _mat4_mul(a, b):
    return [[sum(a[i][k] * b[k][j] for k in range(4)) for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]


def _joint_local(j):
    r = _quat_to_mat3(j.orientation)
    s = j.scale
    return [[r[i][c] * s[c] for c in range(3)] + [j.position[i]] for i in range(3)] + [[0, 0, 0, 1]]


def detect_initial_placement(joints, tol=1e-3):
    """Deslocamento constante entre o esqueleto (TRS locais) e o InverseWorld4x4 das juntas.

    Mede P_i = mundo_i * IBM_i (forma coluna) para cada junta. Se TODAS as juntas dão a MESMA translação pura T0
    (sem rotação), o IBM foi calculado com um 'posicionamento inicial' do modelo (Granny: InitialPlacement) que a
    hierarquia de TRS locais não inclui. Para a pose de bind reproduzir a malha, a raiz precisa de T = -T0 aplicado
    à esquerda. Devolve (-T0x, -T0y, -T0z) ou None se não há deslocamento (ex.: CR_Dog) ou se não é constante.
    Medido em CR_FloatingEyeBot: T0 = (0.0117, 0, 0.0087) em todas as 8 juntas.
    """
    if not joints:
        return None
    world = []
    for j in joints:
        loc = _joint_local(j)
        world.append(loc if j.parent < 0 else _mat4_mul(world[j.parent], loc))
    t0 = None
    for w, j in zip(world, joints):
        ibm = [[j.inverse_world[r * 4 + c] for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
        ibm_col = [[ibm[c][r] for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
        p = _mat4_mul(w, ibm_col)
        rot_dev = max(abs(p[r][c] - (1.0 if r == c else 0.0)) for r in range(3) for c in range(3))
        if rot_dev > tol:
            return None
        t = (p[0][3], p[1][3], p[2][3])
        if t0 is None:
            t0 = t
        elif max(abs(t[i] - t0[i]) for i in range(3)) > tol:
            return None
    if t0 is None or max(abs(v) for v in t0) < 1e-5:
        return None
    return (-t0[0], -t0[1], -t0[2])


def apply_initial_placement(joints, clips):
    """Aplica o posicionamento inicial às raízes (e às chaves de translação delas). Devolve (juntas, clipes, T|None)."""
    place = detect_initial_placement(joints)
    if place is None:
        return joints, clips, None
    new_joints = [replace(j, position=tuple(j.position[i] + place[i] for i in range(3))) if j.parent < 0 else j
                  for j in joints]
    roots = {j.name for j in joints if j.parent < 0}
    new_clips = []
    for c in clips or []:
        tracks = {}
        for bone, tr in c.tracks.items():
            if bone in roots and "translation" in tr:
                t, v = tr["translation"]
                tr = dict(tr)
                tr["translation"] = (t, [tuple(x[i] + place[i] for i in range(3)) for x in v])
            tracks[bone] = tr
        new_clips.append(replace(c, tracks=tracks))
    return new_joints, new_clips, place


def resolve_bone_aliases(bone_names, joints):
    """Casa os nomes de osso do B3D com as juntas do esqueleto do GR2 quando os nomes diferem só por sufixo.

    Medido em HumFSkl/HumMNor: o B3D diz "L Clavicle", "L Fingers", "R Handle" e o GR2 tem "L Clavicle_1", "L Fingers_1",
    "R Handle_1" (o exportador de origem acrescentou "_1" para desfazer nomes repetidos). Sem o casamento, os vértices
    presos a esses ossos ficam sem junta e a malha desmonta (braços viram "lâminas" esticadas).
    Ordem: nome exato, depois nome+"_1".."_9", depois sem o sufixo "_N", depois sem diferenciar maiúsculas.
    Devolve (lista de nomes já resolvidos, {nome do B3D: nome da junta} só dos que foram trocados).
    """
    if not joints:
        return list(bone_names), {}
    jn = {j.name for j in joints}
    lower = {}
    for n in sorted(jn):
        lower.setdefault(n.lower(), n)
    out, aliased = [], {}
    for b in bone_names:
        pick = b if b in jn else None
        if pick is None:
            for k in range(1, 10):
                if f"{b}_{k}" in jn:
                    pick = f"{b}_{k}"
                    break
        if pick is None:
            m = re.match(r"^(.*)_(\d+)$", b)
            if m and m.group(1) in jn:
                pick = m.group(1)
        if pick is None and b.lower() in lower:
            pick = lower[b.lower()]
        if pick is not None and pick != b:
            aliased[b] = pick
        out.append(pick if pick is not None else b)
    return out, aliased


class Exporter:
    def __init__(self, unit_scale: float = 1.0, convert: bool = True, mesh_scale: float = DEFAULT_MESH_SCALE):
        self.k = unit_scale
        self.initial_placement = None
        self.ms = mesh_scale          # geometria do B3D -> unidades do esqueleto do GR2 (ver nota no topo do arquivo)
        self.convert = convert
        self.g = Glb()
        self.warnings: list[str] = []
        self.stats = {"surfaces": 0, "vertices": 0, "triangles": 0, "textures": 0, "joints": 0, "animations": 0}

    # ---- conversões de espaço ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def p(self, v):
        return (v[0] * self.k, v[1] * self.k, (-v[2] if self.convert else v[2]) * self.k)

    def pm(self, v):
        """Posição de GEOMETRIA do B3D (vértices, transformações de nós): aplica a escala malha->esqueleto."""
        k = self.k * self.ms
        return (v[0] * k, v[1] * k, (-v[2] if self.convert else v[2]) * k)

    def n(self, v):
        return (v[0], v[1], -v[2] if self.convert else v[2])

    def q(self, q):
        q = quat_normalize(q)
        return (-q[0], -q[1], q[2], q[3]) if self.convert else q

    def m4(self, m):
        """16 floats do GR2 (linha-vetor) -> glTF coluna-major no espaço convertido (M' = S M S, translação escalada)."""
        if len(m) != 16:
            return tuple(float(i == j) for i in range(4) for j in range(4))
        a = [list(m[r * 4:(r + 1) * 4]) for r in range(4)]          # a[r][c] = M[c][r] (transposta implícita)
        out = [[a[r][c] for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
        if self.convert:
            s = (1, 1, -1, 1)
            out = [[out[r][c] * s[r] * s[c] for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
        for r in range(3):
            out[3][r] *= self.k                                      # translação está na última "linha" do vetor-linha
        return tuple(x for row in out for x in row)

    # ---- texturas / materiais -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _texture(self, file_name: str, loader):
        key = file_name.lower()
        if key in self.g._img_cache:
            return self.g._img_cache[key]
        stem = file_name.rsplit(".", 1)[0]
        raw = loader(stem) if loader else None
        if raw is None:
            self.warnings.append(f"textura '{file_name}' não encontrada")
            self.g._img_cache[key] = None
            return None
        try:
            _w, _h, png = image_to_png(raw)
        except (ImageError, ValueError) as exc:
            self.warnings.append(f"textura '{file_name}': {exc}")
            self.g._img_cache[key] = None
            return None
        self.stats["textures"] += 1
        return self.g.texture(png, key=key, name=stem)

    def _material(self, mat, loader):
        f = mat.floats if len(mat.floats) >= 4 else [1, 1, 1, 1]
        tex = self._texture(mat.textures[0], loader) if mat.textures else None
        mode = ALPHA_MODES.get(mat.blend, "OPAQUE")
        extras = {"f3vb_blend": mat.blend, "f3vb_surface_type": mat.type, "f3vb_material_id": mat.id,
                  "f3vb_d3d_material": [round(x, 5) for x in mat.floats]}
        return self.g.material(mat.name or "material", base_color=(f[0], f[1], f[2], f[3] if mode == "BLEND" else 1.0),
                               texture=tex, alpha_mode=mode, double_sided=False, extras=extras)

    # ---- geometria -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _prep_surface(self, name: str, surf, joint_by_name: dict | None, bone_names: list) -> dict:
        """Dados da superfície já no espaço de saída (convertido/escalado): usados pelo GLB e pelo F3M."""
        pos = [self.pm(v) for v in surf.positions]
        nor = [self.n(v) for v in surf.normals]
        out = {"pos": pos, "nor": nor, "uv0": list(surf.uv0), "uv1": list(surf.uv1), "col": list(surf.colors),
               "joints": None, "weights": None, "prims": [], "bone_refs": None}
        if surf.influences:
            j_all, w_all, missing = [], [], 0
            for infl in surf.influences:
                js, ws = [], []
                for bi, bw in infl:
                    if joint_by_name is not None:                      # GLB: índice de junta do esqueleto
                        nm = bone_names[bi] if 0 <= bi < len(bone_names) else None
                        j = joint_by_name.get(nm) if nm is not None else None
                        if j is None:
                            missing += 1
                            continue
                    else:                                              # F3M: índice na lista de nomes de ossos do B3D
                        j = bi if 0 <= bi < len(bone_names) else None
                        if j is None:
                            missing += 1
                            continue
                    js.append(j); ws.append(bw)
                js, ws = (js + [0] * 4)[:4], (ws + [0.0] * 4)[:4]
                tot = sum(ws)
                ws = [w / tot for w in ws] if tot > 0 else [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
                j_all.append(tuple(js)); w_all.append(tuple(ws))
            if missing:
                self.warnings.append(f"{name}: {missing} influências de osso sem correspondência")
            out["joints"], out["weights"] = j_all, w_all
        for pr in surf.primitives:
            idx = list(pr["indices"])
            if idx:
                out["prims"].append((pr["material"], self._fix_winding(idx, pos, nor)))
        return out

    def _surface_mesh(self, name: str, surf, loader, joint_by_name: dict | None, bone_names: list):
        g = self.g
        d = self._prep_surface(name, surf, joint_by_name, bone_names)
        attrs = {"POSITION": g.accessor(d["pos"], FLOAT, "VEC3", ARRAY_BUFFER, minmax=True),
                 "NORMAL": g.accessor(d["nor"], FLOAT, "VEC3", ARRAY_BUFFER),
                 "TEXCOORD_0": g.accessor(d["uv0"], FLOAT, "VEC2", ARRAY_BUFFER)}
        if d["uv1"]:
            attrs["TEXCOORD_1"] = g.accessor(d["uv1"], FLOAT, "VEC2", ARRAY_BUFFER)
        if d["col"]:
            attrs["COLOR_0"] = g.accessor(d["col"], FLOAT, "VEC4", ARRAY_BUFFER)
        skinned = bool(joint_by_name) and d["joints"] is not None
        if skinned:
            attrs["JOINTS_0"] = g.accessor(d["joints"], USHORT, "VEC4", ARRAY_BUFFER)
            attrs["WEIGHTS_0"] = g.accessor(d["weights"], FLOAT, "VEC4", ARRAY_BUFFER)
        prims = []
        for mat_i, idx in d["prims"]:
            ctype = USHORT if max(idx) < 65535 else UINT
            mat = surf.materials[mat_i] if mat_i < len(surf.materials) else None
            prim = {"attributes": dict(attrs), "indices": g.accessor(idx, ctype, "SCALAR", ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER), "mode": 4}
            if mat is not None:
                prim["material"] = self._material(mat, loader)
            prims.append(prim)
            self.stats["triangles"] += len(idx) // 3
        self.stats["surfaces"] += 1
        self.stats["vertices"] += len(d["pos"])
        return g.mesh(name, prims, extras={"f3vb_lightmap": surf.lightmap} if surf.lightmap else None), skinned

    @staticmethod
    def _fix_winding(idx, pos, nor):
        """glTF: face frontal = anti-horário. Decide pelos dados: a normal geométrica deve concordar com as normais."""
        agree = 0
        total = 0
        for i in range(0, len(idx) - 2, 3):
            a, b, c = pos[idx[i]], pos[idx[i + 1]], pos[idx[i + 2]]
            u = (b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]); v = (c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1], c[2] - a[2])
            cr = (u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0])
            nn = [sum(nor[j][k] for j in (idx[i], idx[i + 1], idx[i + 2])) for k in range(3)]
            d = cr[0] * nn[0] + cr[1] * nn[1] + cr[2] * nn[2]
            if abs(d) > 1e-12:
                total += 1
                agree += d > 0
        if total and agree < total / 2:                       # maioria discorda -> inverte a ordem
            out = list(idx)
            for i in range(0, len(out) - 2, 3):
                out[i + 1], out[i + 2] = out[i + 2], out[i + 1]
            return out
        return idx

    # ---- cena ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def build(self, model: Model, name: str, texture_loader=None, joints: list[Joint] | None = None,
              clips: list[Clip] | None = None) -> bytes:
        g = self.g
        joints, clips, self.initial_placement = apply_initial_placement(joints, clips) if joints else (joints, clips, None)
        joint_nodes, joint_by_name = [], {}
        root_children = []
        if joints:
            for jt in joints:
                tr = self.p(jt.position)
                node = g.node(jt.name, translation=tr, rotation=self.q(jt.orientation), scale=jt.scale,
                              extras={"f3vb_bone": True})
                joint_nodes.append(node)
                joint_by_name.setdefault(jt.name, len(joint_nodes) - 1)
            for i, jt in enumerate(joints):
                if jt.parent >= 0:
                    g.j["nodes"][joint_nodes[jt.parent]].setdefault("children", []).append(joint_nodes[i])
                else:
                    root_children.append(joint_nodes[i])
            self.stats["joints"] = len(joints)
        bone_names, aliased = resolve_bone_aliases([b.name for b in model.bones], joints)
        self.stats["bone_aliases"] = aliased
        if aliased:
            self.warnings.append(f"{name}: {len(aliased)} ossos casados por sufixo ({', '.join(f'{a}->{b}' for a, b in list(aliased.items())[:4])})")
        skin_idx = None
        if joints:
            skin_idx = g.skin(name + "_skin", joint_nodes, [self.m4(j.inverse_world) for j in joints],
                              skeleton=root_children[0] if root_children else None)

        def convert_node(bn, parent_name=""):
            kids = []
            for s_node, surf in [(bn, s) for s in bn.surfaces]:
                mesh_name = bn.name or name
                mi, skinned = self._surface_mesh(mesh_name, surf, texture_loader, joint_by_name if joints else None, bone_names)
                kids.append(g.node(mesh_name, mesh=mi, skin=skin_idx if skinned else None))
            for c in bn.children:
                kids.append(convert_node(c, bn.name))
            tr = bn.transform or {}
            return g.node(bn.name or "node", children=kids or None,
                          translation=self.pm(tr["translation"]) if "translation" in tr else None,
                          rotation=self.q(_axis_angle_to_quat(tr["rotation"])) if "rotation" in tr else None,
                          scale=tr.get("scale"))

        for r in model.roots:
            root_children.append(convert_node(r))
        g.node(name, children=root_children, root=True,
               extras={"f3vb_source": "B3D", "f3vb_coordinate_system": model.globals.get("coordinate_system"),
                       "f3vb_coordinate_scale": model.globals.get("coordinate_scale"), "f3vb_unit_scale": self.k,
                       "f3vb_converted_lh_to_rh": self.convert})

        for clip in clips or []:
            chans = []
            for bone, tracks in clip.tracks.items():
                j = joint_by_name.get(bone)
                if j is None:
                    continue
                node = joint_nodes[j]
                if "translation" in tracks:
                    t, v = tracks["translation"]; chans.append((node, "translation", t, [self.p(x) for x in v]))
                if "rotation" in tracks:
                    t, v = tracks["rotation"]; chans.append((node, "rotation", t, [self.q(x) for x in v]))
                if "scale" in tracks:
                    t, v = tracks["scale"]; chans.append((node, "scale", t, list(v)))
            if chans:
                g.animation(clip.name, chans)
                self.stats["animations"] += 1
            else:
                self.warnings.append(f"clipe '{clip.name}' sem trilhas aproveitáveis")
            self.warnings += [f"{clip.name}: {w}" for w in clip.warnings[:3]]
        return g.to_bytes()


    # ---- cena neutra (usada pelo formato F3M do visualizador) ----------------------------------------------
    def scene(self, model: Model, name: str, texture_loader=None, joints=None, clips=None) -> dict:
        joints, clips, self.initial_placement = apply_initial_placement(joints, clips) if joints else (joints, clips, None)
        from .imagecodec import decode_bmp, decode_tga
        bone_names, aliased = resolve_bone_aliases([b.name for b in model.bones], joints)
        self.stats["bone_aliases"] = aliased
        if aliased:
            self.warnings.append(f"{name}: {len(aliased)} ossos casados por sufixo ({', '.join(f'{a}->{b}' for a, b in list(aliased.items())[:4])})")
        sc = {"name": name, "textures": [], "materials": [], "meshes": [], "joints": [], "clips": [],
              "bone_names": bone_names}
        tex_idx: dict = {}

        def texture(file_name):
            key = file_name.lower()
            if key in tex_idx:
                return tex_idx[key]
            raw = texture_loader(file_name.rsplit(".", 1)[0]) if texture_loader else None
            idx = None
            if raw is None:
                self.warnings.append(f"textura '{file_name}' não encontrada")
            else:
                try:
                    w, h, rgba = decode_bmp(raw) if raw[:2] == b"BM" else decode_tga(raw)
                    sc["textures"].append({"name": file_name.rsplit(".", 1)[0], "w": w, "h": h, "rgba": rgba})
                    idx = len(sc["textures"]) - 1
                    self.stats["textures"] += 1
                except (ImageError, ValueError) as exc:
                    self.warnings.append(f"textura '{file_name}': {exc}")
            tex_idx[key] = idx
            return idx

        mat_idx: dict = {}

        def material(m):
            key = (m.name, m.blend, tuple(m.textures[:1]), tuple(m.floats[:4]))
            if key in mat_idx:
                return mat_idx[key]
            f = m.floats if len(m.floats) >= 4 else [1, 1, 1, 1]
            mode = {"OPAQUE": 0, "ALPHABLEND": 1, "ADD": 2}.get(m.blend, 0)
            sc["materials"].append({"name": m.name or "material", "texture": texture(m.textures[0]) if m.textures else None,
                                    "color": tuple(float(x) for x in f[:4]), "alpha_mode": mode, "double_sided": 0})
            mat_idx[key] = len(sc["materials"]) - 1
            return mat_idx[key]

        bone_names = sc["bone_names"]
        for node, surf in model.surfaces():
            d = self._prep_surface(node.name or name, surf, None, bone_names)
            for mat_i, idx in d["prims"]:
                mat = surf.materials[mat_i] if mat_i < len(surf.materials) else None
                sc["meshes"].append({"name": node.name or name, "material": material(mat) if mat else None,
                                     "pos": d["pos"], "nor": d["nor"], "uv": d["uv0"], "col": d["col"] or [(1, 1, 1, 1)] * len(d["pos"]),
                                     "joints": d["joints"], "weights": d["weights"], "idx": idx})
                self.stats["triangles"] += len(idx) // 3
            self.stats["surfaces"] += 1
            self.stats["vertices"] += len(d["pos"])
        for jt in joints or []:
            sc["joints"].append({"name": jt.name, "parent": jt.parent, "t": self.p(jt.position), "q": self.q(jt.orientation),
                                 "s": tuple(jt.scale), "ibm": self.m4(jt.inverse_world)})
        self.stats["joints"] = len(sc["joints"])
        for clip in clips or []:
            chans = []
            for bone, tracks in clip.tracks.items():
                if "translation" in tracks:
                    t, v = tracks["translation"]; chans.append((bone, 0, list(t), [self.p(x) for x in v]))
                if "rotation" in tracks:
                    t, v = tracks["rotation"]; chans.append((bone, 1, list(t), [self.q(x) for x in v]))
                if "scale" in tracks:
                    t, v = tracks["scale"]; chans.append((bone, 2, list(t), [tuple(x) for x in v]))
            if chans:
                sc["clips"].append({"name": clip.name, "duration": float(clip.duration), "channels": chans})
                self.stats["animations"] += 1
        return sc


def export_b3d_to_glb(b3d_bytes: bytes, name: str, *, texture_loader=None, joints=None, clips=None,
                      unit_scale: float = 1.0, convert: bool = True, mesh_scale: float = DEFAULT_MESH_SCALE) -> tuple[bytes, dict]:
    model = read_b3d(b3d_bytes)
    ex = Exporter(unit_scale=unit_scale, convert=convert, mesh_scale=mesh_scale)
    data = ex.build(model, name, texture_loader=texture_loader, joints=joints, clips=clips)
    return data, {"stats": ex.stats, "warnings": ex.warnings}
```

## tools/py/f3vb/extract.py

```python
"""Extração e amostragem de lumps de um .grp, com manifesto (sha256, classe, sonda)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from .classify import classify
from .gr2tool import gr2_header
from .grp import GrpFile
from .probe import hexdump
from .probes import probe_amx, probe_b3d, probe_bmp, probe_tga

SAMPLE_README = """Amostra extraída para análise técnica de formatos (interoperabilidade/preservação).
manifest.txt: índice, offset, tamanho, sha256 e sonda de cabeçalho de cada arquivo.
hexdump_*.txt: primeiros 256 bytes de cada arquivo (texto puro).
Arquivos binários (.gr2/.b3d/.tga...) só vêm se você NÃO usou --so-texto.
Não redistribua e não commite estes arquivos.
"""


def manifest_text(manifest: dict) -> str:
    L = [f"MANIFESTO  grp={manifest['source_grp']}  arquivos={manifest['count']}"]
    if manifest.get("strategy"):
        L.append(f"estratégia={manifest['strategy']}")
    for e in manifest["files"]:
        L += ["", f"[{e['file']}]", f"  lump={e['lump']} offset={e['offset']} tamanho={e['length']} classe={e['class']}",
              f"  sha256={e['sha256']}", "  sonda:",
              "    " + json.dumps(e.get("probe"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).replace("\n", "\n    ")]
    for c in manifest.get("not_found", []):
        L.append(f"\n(nenhum lump '{c}' no intervalo de tamanho pedido)")
    return "\n".join(L) + "\n"


def _write_texts(out: Path, manifest: dict, datas: dict) -> list:
    """Escreve manifest.txt e hexdump_<arquivo>.txt; devolve a lista de nomes criados."""
    names = []
    (out / "manifest.txt").write_text(manifest_text(manifest), encoding="utf-8")
    names.append("manifest.txt")
    for fname, data in datas.items():
        hn = f"hexdump_{fname}.txt"
        (out / hn).write_text(f"{fname}  (primeiros {min(256, len(data))} de {len(data)} bytes)\n\n"
                              + hexdump(data[:256]) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        names.append(hn)
    return names


def base_class(label: str) -> str:
    return label.split(" ")[0].split(":")[0].rstrip("?")


def _ext(cls: str) -> str:
    return {"tga": "tga", "bmp": "bmp", "b3d": "b3d", "gr2": "gr2", "8tre": "8", "wav": "wav",
            "amx": "amx", "chunk": "chunk", "texto": "txt"}.get(cls, "bin")


def probe_lump(cls: str, data: bytes) -> dict | None:
    try:
        if cls == "gr2":
            return gr2_header(data)
        if cls == "b3d":
            return probe_b3d(data)
        if cls == "tga":
            return probe_tga(data)
        if cls == "bmp":
            return probe_bmp(data)
        if cls == "amx":
            return probe_amx(data)
    except Exception as exc:  # a sonda nunca deve derrubar a extração
        return {"probe_error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"}
    return None


def _entry(grp_name: str, lp, cls: str, data: bytes, file_name: str) -> dict:
    return {"file": file_name, "grp": grp_name, "lump": lp.index, "offset": lp.offset, "length": lp.length,
            "class": cls, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "probe": probe_lump(base_class(cls), data)}


def _valid_for_class(cls: str, data: bytes) -> bool:
    """TGA não tem magic: só aceita se a sonda achar o cabeçalho plausível e o tamanho coerente."""
    if cls != "tga":
        return True
    p = probe_tga(data)
    return bool(p.get("plausible")) and p.get("size_ok", True)


def extract(grp_path, out_dir, classes=None, indices=None, limit=None) -> dict:
    grp_path, out = Path(grp_path), Path(out_dir)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    want = {c.lower().rstrip("?") for c in classes} if classes else None
    idx = set(indices) if indices else None
    entries = []
    datas: dict = {}
    with GrpFile(grp_path) as g:
        for lp in g.info.lumps:
            if limit is not None and len(entries) >= limit:
                break
            if idx is not None and lp.index not in idx:
                continue
            if lp.end > g.info.file_size:
                continue
            data = g.read(lp)
            cls = classify(data[:64], len(data))
            b = base_class(cls)
            if want is not None and b not in want:
                continue
            if not _valid_for_class(b, data):
                continue
            name = f"{lp.index:06d}.{_ext(b)}"
            (out / name).write_bytes(data)
            datas[name] = data
            entries.append(_entry(grp_path.name, lp, cls, data, name))
    manifest = {"source_grp": grp_path.name, "count": len(entries), "files": entries}
    (out / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    _write_texts(out, manifest, datas)
    return manifest


def sample(grp_path, out_dir, classes=("gr2", "b3d", "tga"), per_class=2, min_bytes=1024,
           max_bytes=3_000_000, strategy="smallest", make_zip=True, text_only=False) -> dict:
    """Escolhe poucos lumps por classe (dentro de [min_bytes, max_bytes]) para análise."""
    grp_path, out = Path(grp_path), Path(out_dir)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    chosen: dict[str, list] = {c: [] for c in classes}
    with GrpFile(grp_path) as g:
        for lp in g.info.lumps:
            if lp.end > g.info.file_size or not (min_bytes <= lp.length <= max_bytes):
                continue
            head = g.head(lp, 64)
            b = base_class(classify(head, lp.length))
            if b in chosen:
                chosen[b].append(lp)
        entries = []
        datas: dict = {}
        for cls, lumps in chosen.items():
            lumps.sort(key=lambda l: l.length)
            if strategy == "largest":
                lumps = lumps[::-1]
            elif strategy == "median" and lumps:
                mid = len(lumps) // 2
                lumps = lumps[mid:] + lumps[:mid][::-1]
            picked = 0
            for lp in lumps:
                if picked >= per_class:
                    break
                data = g.read(lp)
                if not _valid_for_class(cls, data):
                    continue
                name = f"{cls}_{lp.index:06d}.{_ext(cls)}"
                (out / name).write_bytes(data)
                datas[name] = data
                entries.append(_entry(grp_path.name, lp, classify(data[:64], len(data)), data, name))
                picked += 1
    manifest = {"source_grp": grp_path.name, "strategy": strategy, "count": len(entries), "files": entries,
                "not_found": [c for c in classes if not any(base_class(e["class"]) == c for e in entries)]}
    (out / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    text_names = _write_texts(out, manifest, datas)
    if make_zip:
        zpath = out.with_suffix(".zip") if out.suffix == "" else out.parent / (out.name + ".zip")
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zpath, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
            for tn in text_names:
                z.write(out / tn, tn)
            z.writestr("LEIA-ME.txt", SAMPLE_README)
            if not text_only:
                z.write(out / "manifest.json", "manifest.json")
                for e in entries:
                    z.write(out / e["file"], e["file"])
        manifest["zip"] = str(zpath)
    return manifest
```

## tools/py/f3vb/extractor.py

```python
"""Extrator: grava TODOS os recursos dos .grp em original_assets/ (ver layout.py) e converte para formatos abertos.

  original_assets/RETAIL/<Pack>/<Tipo>/<Nome>.<ext>   originais, byte a byte (ex.: Critters/G3D_Model/CR_Ant.b3d)
  original_assets/CONVERTED/png/<Pack>/<Nome>.png      texturas
  original_assets/CONVERTED/glb/<Pack>/<Nome>.glb      modelos para o Blender
  original_assets/CONVERTED/f3m/models/<Nome>.f3m      modelos para o visualizador F3VB
  original_assets/CONVERTED/f3m/skeletons/<Nome>.f3m   esqueleto + animacoes ("Adicionar animacoes" no visualizador)
  original_assets/index.csv, EXTRACAO_RELATORIO.txt, LEIA-ME.txt, .gitignore
As conversoes leem de RETAIL (nao dos .grp): refazer so CONVERTED = convert_retail().
Nada disso deve ser publicado: e conteudo do jogo.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import re
import struct
import shutil
import threading
import time
import queue
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from .b3d import B3DError, read_b3d
from .classify import classify
from .export import Exporter
from .f3m import write_f3m
from .gr2export import read_clips, read_skeleton
from .imagecodec import ImageError, image_to_png
from .index import ResourceIndex, RetailIndex
from .layout import CONVERTER_VERSION, AssetsLayout
from .knowledge import RESOURCE_EXT

_BAD = re.compile(r'[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1f]')
_RESERVED = {"con", "prn", "aux", "nul", *(f"com{i}" for i in range(1, 10)), *(f"lpt{i}" for i in range(1, 10))}
EXT_OVERRIDE = {300: "amx", 400: "8tre", 3700: "tok"}


@dataclass
class ExtractOptions:
    raw: bool = True
    png: bool = False
    glb: bool = False
    f3m: bool = False
    maps: bool = False       # v14: .map + .rle -> CONVERTED/maps (txt, json, png)
    anims_per_model: int = 8          # 0 = todas
    skeleton_packs: bool = True       # com f3m: um arquivo esqueleto+animações por esqueleto


def safe_name(name: str, fallback: str = "sem_nome") -> str:
    s = _BAD.sub("_", name).strip(" .")
    if not s:
        s = fallback
    if s.lower().split(".")[0] in _RESERVED:
        s = "_" + s
    return s[:120]


def pick_ext(type_id: int, head: bytes, length: int) -> str:
    if type_id == 200:
        return "bmp" if classify(head, length).startswith("bmp") else "tga"
    return EXT_OVERRIDE.get(type_id) or RESOURCE_EXT.get(type_id) or "bin"


def plan(game_dir) -> dict:
    """Quantos arquivos e bytes serão gravados (sem gravar nada)."""
    with ResourceIndex(game_dir) as ix:
        total, count = 0, 0
        by_type: dict = {}
        for e in ix.rht.entries:
            pack = ix.rht.pack_label(e.pack)
            g = ix._grp(pack) if pack.lower() in ix.grps else None
            if g is None or not 0 <= e.number < g.info.n_files:
                continue
            ln = g.info.lumps[e.number].length
            total += ln
            count += 1
            t = by_type.setdefault(e.type_name, [0, 0])
            t[0] += 1
            t[1] += ln
        return {"files": count, "bytes": total, "by_type": by_type,
                "packs": sorted({ix.rht.pack_label(e.pack) for e in ix.rht.entries})}


def fmt_bytes(n: float) -> str:
    for u in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB"):
        if n < 1024 or u == "GB":
            return f"{n:.1f} {u}" if u != "B" else f"{int(n)} B"
        n /= 1024
    return str(n)


class _Steps:
    """Contador de progresso compartilhado entre as fases (extracao -> PNG -> modelos -> esqueletos)."""

    def __init__(self, tick, total):
        self.tick, self.total, self.n = tick, total, 0

    def __call__(self, msg):
        self.n += 1
        if self.tick:
            self.tick(self.n, self.total, msg)


def anim_prefixes(name: str) -> list:
    """Prefixos de busca das animacoes de um modelo/esqueleto: o proprio nome e, para humanos, a familia (HumM_ / HumF_).
    Medido na demo: HumMNor/HumMFat/HumMWir nao tem "HumMNor_*"; as animacoes se chamam "HumM_Com_Una_Walk_01" etc."""
    out = [name + "_"]
    m = re.match(r"^(Hum[MF])", name)
    if m and m.group(1) + "_" not in out:
        out.append(m.group(1) + "_")
    return out


def _new_log() -> dict:
    return {"written": 0, "bytes": 0, "skipped": [], "failures": [], "png": 0, "glb": 0, "f3m_models": 0,
            "f3m_skeletons": 0, "maps": 0, "scripts": 0, "textures": 0, "textures_missing": [], "cancelled": False}


def _convert_steps(rows, opts) -> int:
    n = 0
    if getattr(opts, "maps", False):
        n += sum(1 for r in rows if r[2] == "MAP_Map")
    if opts.png:
        n += sum(1 for r in rows if r[2] == "TGA_Image")
    if opts.glb or opts.f3m:
        n += sum(1 for r in rows if r[2] == "G3D_Model")
        if opts.f3m and opts.skeleton_packs:
            n += sum(1 for r in rows if r[2] == "SKEL_Skeleton")
    return n


def _convert(layout: AssetsLayout, rows, opts: ExtractOptions, log: dict, step, cancelled) -> None:
    """Converte a partir de RETAIL (nao precisa dos .grp): PNG, GLB e F3M em CONVERTED."""
    conv = layout.converted
    ix = RetailIndex(layout.retail, rows)

    def texture_loader(stem):
        return ix.read_named(stem, "TGA_Image")

    if opts.png and not log["cancelled"]:
        for pack, number, type_name, name, _rel, _size in rows:
            if type_name != "TGA_Image":
                continue
            if cancelled():
                break
            step(f"PNG {name}")
            try:
                _w, _h, png = image_to_png(ix.read(pack, number))
                dest = conv / "png" / safe_name(pack) / f"{safe_name(name)}.png"
                dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                dest.write_bytes(png)
                log["png"] += 1
            except (ImageError, ValueError, KeyError, OSError) as exc:
                log["failures"].append(f"PNG {pack}/{name}: {exc}")

    if (opts.glb or opts.f3m) and not log["cancelled"]:
        skeleton_cache: dict = {}

        def get_skeleton(name):
            if name in skeleton_cache:
                return skeleton_cache[name]
            raw = ix.read_named(name, "SKEL_Skeleton")
            res = (None, None)
            if raw is not None:
                try:
                    res = (read_skeleton(raw)[0], None)
                except Exception as exc:
                    res = (None, str(exc))
            skeleton_cache[name] = res
            return res

        def get_clips(name, joints, limit="default"):
            """Animacoes de um modelo/esqueleto. Cada animal tem as suas ("CR_Dog_*"); os HUMANOS compartilham as da familia
            ("HumM_*" para HumMNor/HumMFat/HumMWir..., "HumF_*" para HumFStr/HumFSkl...). limit: "default" = anims_per_model;
            None = todas (usado no F3M de esqueleto, que serve para "Adicionar animacoes" no visualizador)."""
            lim = opts.anims_per_model if limit == "default" else limit
            rows_ = []
            for pre in anim_prefixes(name):
                rows_ += [r for r in ix.search("GR2_Animation", pre) if r not in rows_]
            if lim and len(rows_) > lim:
                rows_ = sorted(rows_, key=lambda r: (0 if any(k in r[0] for k in ("Idle_01", "Walk_01", "Run_01")) else 1, r[0]))[:lim]
            clips = []
            names = {j.name for j in joints}
            for nm, pk, num in rows_:
                try:
                    clips += read_clips(ix.read(pk, num), names, clip_name=nm)
                except Exception as exc:
                    log["failures"].append(f"animação {nm}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
            return clips

        for pack, number, type_name, name, _rel, _size in rows:
            if type_name != "G3D_Model":
                continue
            if cancelled():
                break
            step(f"modelo {name}")
            try:
                model = read_b3d(ix.read(pack, number))
            except B3DError as exc:
                log["failures"].append(f"B3D {pack}/{name}: {exc}")
                continue
            joints, _err = get_skeleton(name)
            clips = get_clips(name, joints) if joints else []
            try:
                if opts.glb:
                    glb = Exporter().build(model, name, texture_loader=texture_loader, joints=joints, clips=clips)
                    dest = conv / "glb" / safe_name(pack) / f"{safe_name(name)}.glb"
                    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    dest.write_bytes(glb)
                    log["glb"] += 1
                if opts.f3m:
                    sc = Exporter().scene(model, name, texture_loader=texture_loader, joints=joints, clips=clips)
                    dest = conv / "f3m" / "models" / f"{safe_name(name)}.f3m"
                    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    dest.write_bytes(write_f3m(sc))
                    log["f3m_models"] += 1
            except Exception as exc:
                log["failures"].append(f"exportar {pack}/{name}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")

        if opts.f3m and opts.skeleton_packs and not log["cancelled"]:
            from .b3d import Model
            for pack, number, type_name, name, _rel, _size in rows:
                if type_name != "SKEL_Skeleton":
                    continue
                if cancelled():
                    break
                step(f"esqueleto {name}")
                joints, err = get_skeleton(name)
                if not joints:
                    if err:
                        log["failures"].append(f"esqueleto {name}: {err}")
                    continue
                try:
                    clips = get_clips(name, joints, limit=None)
                    sc = Exporter().scene(Model(), name, joints=joints, clips=clips)
                    dest = conv / "f3m" / "skeletons" / f"{safe_name(name)}.f3m"
                    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    dest.write_bytes(write_f3m(sc))
                    log["f3m_skeletons"] += 1
                except Exception as exc:
                    log["failures"].append(f"esqueleto {name}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")

    if getattr(opts, "maps", False) and not log["cancelled"]:
        from .mapreport import analyze_map
        from .mapfile import read_map
        mdir = conv / "maps"
        summary = ["RESUMO DOS MAPAS (v14)"]
        for pack, number, type_name, name, _rel, _size in rows:
            if type_name != "MAP_Map":
                continue
            if cancelled():
                break
            step(f"mapa {name}")
            try:
                data = ix.read(pack, number)
                rle_stem = read_map(data).header.get("rle", "").rsplit(".", 1)[0]
                rle = ix.read_named(rle_stem, "RLE") if rle_stem else None
                tre_stem = read_map(data).header.get("tre", "").rsplit(".", 1)[0]
                tre_raw = ix.read_named(tre_stem, "TRE_Octree") if tre_stem else None
                m, grid, info, txt, js, png, f3 = analyze_map(name, data, rle, tre_raw)
                mdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                base = safe_name(name)
                (mdir / f"{base}.txt").write_text(txt, encoding="utf-8")
                (mdir / f"{base}.json").write_text(js, encoding="utf-8")
                if png:
                    (mdir / f"{base}.png").write_bytes(png)
                if f3:
                    (mdir / f"{base}.f3map").write_bytes(f3)
                log["maps"] += 1
                summary.append(f"{name:44s} chunks {len(m.chunks):3d}  entidades {len(m.entities):3d}  nos de navegacao {len(m.nav_nodes):3d}  "
                               f"gatilhos {len(m.triggers):2d}  grade {('%dx%d' % (grid.width, grid.rows)) if grid else '-':>9s}  "
                               f"escala x{info[0]:g}  nao explicados {m.unexplained_bytes}")
            except Exception as exc:
                log["failures"].append(f"mapa {pack}/{name}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
        if log["maps"]:
            (mdir / "maps_summary.txt").write_text("\n".join(summary) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        if not log["cancelled"]:
            _write_scripts(ix, rows, conv, log)                       # v17: scripts ao lado dos mapas (o viewer liga entidade -> script pelo nome)
            _write_textures(ix, conv, log)                            # v18: texturas citadas pelos mapas (difusas e lightmaps) em CONVERTED/textures


SCRIPT_TYPES = ("AMX", "SMA_Script")


def _write_scripts(ix, rows, conv: Path, log: dict) -> int:
    """v17: copia os scripts (.amx, tipos AMX e SMA_Script) para CONVERTED/scripts/<nome>.amx; o F3VBMapViewer os acha pelo nome citado nas entidades do mapa."""
    sdir = conv / "scripts"
    used: set = set()
    n = 0
    for pack, number, type_name, name, _rel, _size in rows:
        if type_name not in SCRIPT_TYPES:
            continue
        try:
            base = safe_name(name)
            if base.lower() in used:                                   # mesmo nome nos dois tipos: nao sobrescrever
                base = f"{base}_{number}"
            used.add(base.lower())
            sdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (sdir / f"{base}.amx").write_bytes(ix.read(pack, number))
            n += 1
        except Exception as exc:                                       # noqa: BLE001
            log["failures"].append(f"script {pack}/{name}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
    log["scripts"] = log.get("scripts", 0) + n
    return n


F3TEX_MAGIC = b"F3TX"


def encode_f3tex(w: int, h: int, rgba: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Textura crua para o F3VBMapViewer: "F3TX" + u32 largura + u32 altura + RGBA8 (linhas de CIMA para BAIXO, como no TGA da demo)."""
    if len(rgba) != w * h * 4:
        raise ValueError("RGBA com tamanho errado")
    return F3TEX_MAGIC + struct.pack("<II", w, h) + rgba


def _texture_stems_from_f3maps(maps_dir: Path) -> dict:
    """Nomes de textura (sem extensao) citados pelos .f3map ja convertidos: {minusculo: (nome, 'difusa'|'lightmap')}."""
    from .mapexport import read_f3map
    out: dict = {}
    for f in sorted(maps_dir.glob("*.f3map")):
        try:
            d = read_f3map(f.read_bytes())
        except Exception:                                                  # noqa: BLE001
            continue
        for name in d.get("textures", []):
            low = name.lower()
            if low.endswith(".tga"):
                out.setdefault(low[:-4], (name[:-4], "difusa"))
            elif low.endswith(".ctx"):
                out.setdefault(low[:-4], (name[:-4], "lightmap"))
    return out


def _write_textures(ix, conv: Path, log: dict, overwrite: bool = False) -> int:
    """v18: converte as texturas citadas pelos mapas (CONVERTED/textures/<nome>.f3tex). Tenta o recurso TGA_Image pelo nome sem extensao e com '.tga'."""
    from .imagecodec import ImageError, decode_tga
    stems = _texture_stems_from_f3maps(conv / "maps")
    tdir = conv / "textures"
    n = 0
    missing: list = []
    for low, (name, kind) in sorted(stems.items()):
        dest = tdir / f"{safe_name(name)}.f3tex"
        if dest.exists() and not overwrite:
            n += 1
            continue
        data = ix.read_named(name, "TGA_Image") or ix.read_named(name + ".tga", "TGA_Image")
        if data is None:
            missing.append(f"{name} ({kind})")
            continue
        try:
            w, h, rgba = decode_tga(data)
            tdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes(encode_f3tex(w, h, rgba))
            n += 1
        except (ImageError, ValueError, struct.error) as exc:
            log["failures"].append(f"textura {name}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
            missing.append(f"{name} ({kind}; nao decodificou)")
    log["textures"] = log.get("textures", 0) + n
    log.setdefault("textures_missing", []).extend(missing)
    if stems:
        tdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        lines = [f"TEXTURAS CITADAS PELOS MAPAS: {len(stems)}; convertidas (ou ja existiam): {n}; nao encontradas/falharam: {len(missing)}", ""] + [f"  faltando: {m}" for m in missing]
        (tdir / "textures_summary.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return n


def export_textures(out_dir=None, overwrite: bool = False) -> dict:
    """So as texturas (usa os .f3map ja convertidos para saber quais): py -3 -m f3vb export-textures"""
    layout = AssetsLayout(out_dir).ensure()
    if not layout.index_csv.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{layout.index_csv} nao existe: rode extract-all antes (precisa da pasta do jogo uma vez).")
    if not (layout.converted / "maps").exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError("CONVERTED/maps nao existe: rode antes  py -3 -m f3vb convert-retail --maps")
    log = _new_log()
    ix = RetailIndex.from_csv(layout.root)
    _write_textures(ix, layout.converted, log, overwrite)
    return log


def export_scripts(out_dir=None) -> dict:
    """So os scripts (rapido), sem refazer mapas/PNG/F3M: py -3 -m f3vb export-scripts"""
    layout = AssetsLayout(out_dir).ensure()
    if not layout.index_csv.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{layout.index_csv} nao existe: rode extract-all antes (precisa da pasta do jogo uma vez).")
    log = _new_log()
    ix = RetailIndex.from_csv(layout.root)
    _write_scripts(ix, ix.rows, layout.converted, log)
    return log


def failure_summary(failures: list) -> list:
    """Agrupa as falhas por CAUSA (mensagem sem os numeros) e por pack, para dar para ler 2.400 falhas de uma vez."""
    cause: dict = {}
    pack: dict = {}
    for f in failures:
        m = re.match(r"(\S+) ([^/:]+)/[^:]*: (.*)", f)
        kind, pk, msg = (m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)) if m else ("?", "?", f)
        key = (kind, re.sub(r"0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|-?\d+", lambda mm: "0xN" if mm.group(0).startswith("0x") else "N", msg)[:100])
        cause[key] = cause.get(key, 0) + 1
        pack[(kind, pk)] = pack.get((kind, pk), 0) + 1
    out = ["RESUMO DAS FALHAS POR CAUSA (numeros trocados por N):"]
    out += [f"  {n:5d}  {k}: {msg}" for (k, msg), n in sorted(cause.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:25]]
    out += ["", "RESUMO DAS FALHAS POR PACK:"]
    out += [f"  {n:5d}  {k} em {pk}" for (k, pk), n in sorted(pack.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:25]]
    return out


def _write_report(layout: AssetsLayout, log: dict, mode: str) -> None:
```
