```python
    lines = ["RELATORIO DA EXTRACAO F3VB", f"modo: {mode}", f"pasta: {layout.root}",
             f"  RETAIL (originais):     {layout.retail}", f"  CONVERTED (convertidos): {layout.converted}",
             f"arquivos originais gravados: {log['written']}  ({fmt_bytes(log['bytes'])})",
             f"PNG: {log['png']}  GLB: {log['glb']}  F3M modelos: {log['f3m_models']}  F3M esqueletos: {log['f3m_skeletons']}  mapas: {log['maps']}  scripts: {log.get('scripts', 0)}  texturas: {log.get('textures', 0)}",
             f"versao do conversor: {CONVERTER_VERSION}",
             f"cancelado: {log['cancelled']}  tempo: {log['seconds']} s", f"falhas: {len(log['failures'])}  ignorados: {len(log['skipped'])}", ""]
    if log["failures"]:
        lines += failure_summary(log["failures"]) + [""]
        (layout.root / "FALHAS_COMPLETO.txt").write_text("\n".join(log["failures"]) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        lines += ["(a lista completa, uma falha por linha, esta em FALHAS_COMPLETO.txt)", ""]
    lines += ["FALHAS (primeiras 200):"] + log["failures"][:200] + ["", "IGNORADOS:"] + log["skipped"][:50]
    layout.report.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def extract_all(game_dir, out_dir=None, opts: ExtractOptions | None = None, progress=None, cancel=None) -> dict:
    """Extrai os .grp para <out>/RETAIL e converte (opcional) para <out>/CONVERTED. out padrao: ./original_assets."""
    opts = opts or ExtractOptions()
    if not opts.raw:                          # sem regravar os originais: converte a partir do RETAIL ja existente
        return convert_retail(out_dir, opts, progress, cancel)
    layout = AssetsLayout(out_dir).ensure()
    t0 = time.time()
    log = _new_log()
    used: set = set()
    rows = []

    def cancelled():
        if cancel and cancel():
            log["cancelled"] = True
            return True
        return False

    with ResourceIndex(game_dir) as ix:
        entries = sorted(ix.rht.entries, key=lambda e: (ix.rht.pack_label(e.pack).lower(), e.number))
        name_of = lambda e: ix.rht.resource_name(e.offset) or f"recurso_{e.number}"
        planned_rows = [(ix.rht.pack_label(e.pack), e.number, e.type_name, name_of(e), "", 0) for e in entries]
        step = _Steps(progress, len(entries) + _convert_steps(planned_rows, opts))
        for e in entries:
            if cancelled():
                break
            pack = ix.rht.pack_label(e.pack)
            name = name_of(e)
            step(f"{pack}/{name}")
            if pack.lower() not in ix.grps:
                log["skipped"].append(f"{pack}#{e.number}: .grp ausente")
                continue
            try:
                data = ix.read(pack, e.number)
            except Exception as exc:
                log["failures"].append(f"{pack}#{e.number} {name}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
                continue
            ext = pick_ext(e.type, data[:64], len(data))
            rel = Path(safe_name(pack)) / e.type_name / f"{safe_name(name)}.{ext}"
            key = str(rel).lower()
            n = 1
            while key in used:
                n += 1
                rel = Path(safe_name(pack)) / e.type_name / f"{safe_name(name)}_{n}.{ext}"
                key = str(rel).lower()
            used.add(key)
            dest = layout.retail / rel
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes(data)
            if dest.stat().st_size != len(data):
                log["failures"].append(f"{rel}: tamanho gravado diferente do original")
            log["written"] += 1
            log["bytes"] += len(data)
            rows.append((pack, e.number, e.type_name, name, str(rel).replace("\\", "/"), len(data)))

    _write_index(layout, rows)
    if not log["cancelled"]:
        _convert(layout, rows, opts, log, step, cancelled)
        if opts.png or opts.glb or opts.f3m or getattr(opts, 'maps', False):
            layout.write_converter_info()
    log["seconds"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
    _write_report(layout, log, "extrair + converter" if (opts.png or opts.glb or opts.f3m) else "extrair")
    return log


def _write_index(layout: AssetsLayout, rows) -> None:
    with open(layout.index_csv, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(["pack", "numero", "tipo", "nome", "caminho", "tamanho"])
        w.writerows(rows)


def convert_retail(out_dir=None, opts: ExtractOptions | None = None, progress=None, cancel=None) -> dict:
    """Refaz CONVERTED a partir de RETAIL (usa index.csv). Nao precisa da pasta do jogo nem dos .grp."""
    opts = opts or ExtractOptions(png=True, f3m=True)
    layout = AssetsLayout(out_dir).ensure()
    if not layout.index_csv.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{layout.index_csv} nao existe: rode extract-all antes (precisa da pasta do jogo uma vez).")
    t0 = time.time()
    log = _new_log()
    ix = RetailIndex.from_csv(layout.root)
    rows = ix.rows

    def cancelled():
        if cancel and cancel():
            log["cancelled"] = True
            return True
        return False

    step = _Steps(progress, _convert_steps(rows, opts))
    _convert(layout, rows, opts, log, step, cancelled)
    if (opts.png or opts.glb or opts.f3m or getattr(opts, 'maps', False)) and not log["cancelled"]:
        layout.write_converter_info()
    log["seconds"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
    _write_report(layout, log, "converter a partir de RETAIL")
    return log


class ExtractJob:
    """Executa a extração numa thread e expõe mensagens por fila (a GUI só faz polling)."""

    def __init__(self, game_dir, out_dir, opts: ExtractOptions):
        self.q: queue.Queue = queue.Queue()
        self._cancel = threading.Event()
        self.result: dict | None = None
        self.error: str | None = None
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, args=(game_dir, out_dir, opts), daemon=True)

    def start(self):
        self.thread.start()

    def cancel(self):
        self._cancel.set()

    def alive(self) -> bool:
        return self.thread.is_alive()

    def _run(self, game_dir, out_dir, opts):
        try:
            self.result = extract_all(game_dir, out_dir, opts,
                                      progress=lambda d, t, m: self.q.put(("progress", d, t, m)),
                                      cancel=self._cancel.is_set)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
        finally:
            self.q.put(("done",))
```

## tools/py/f3vb/f3m.py

```python
"""Formato F3M ("F3VB Model"): contêiner simples, sem JSON e sem compressão, feito para o visualizador C++ ler fácil.

Little-endian. Um mesmo formato serve para: modelo (malhas + texturas + esqueleto opcional), esqueleto + clipes, e só clipes.
As malhas referenciam ossos por NOME (tabela `bones` da própria malha), os clipes também: assim animações e esqueletos
podem ser adicionados depois ao modelo, como o visualizador faz.

  char[4] "F3M1" ; u32 flags (1=modelo, 2=esqueleto, 4=clipes)
  u32 n_tex, n_mat, n_mesh, n_joint, n_clip ; str nome
  textura : str nome ; u32 w, h ; u8 rgba[w*h*4]
  material: str nome ; i32 textura(-1) ; f32 cor[4] ; u8 modo(0 opaco, 1 mistura, 2 aditivo) ; u8 dupla_face ; u8[2]
  malha   : str nome ; i32 material ; u32 nv, ni, nbones ; str bones[nbones] ; u8 tem_skin ; u8[3]
            f32 pos[nv*3], nrm[nv*3], uv[nv*2], cor[nv*4] ; (skin) u16 juntas[nv*4], f32 pesos[nv*4] ; u32 idx[ni]
  junta   : str nome ; i32 pai ; f32 t[3], q[4], s[3] ; f32 ibm[16] (coluna-major, como no glTF)
  clipe   : str nome ; f32 duracao ; u32 n_canais ; canal: str osso ; u8 caminho(0 T, 1 R, 2 S) ; u8[3] ; u32 n ; f32 tempos[n], valores[n*(3|4)]
  str = u16 tamanho + bytes (latin-1)
Espaço: mão-direita, Y para cima (já convertido pelo exportador).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import struct

MAGIC = b"F3M1"
FLAG_MODEL, FLAG_SKELETON, FLAG_CLIPS = 1, 2, 4


class F3MError(ValueError):
    pass


def _s(text: str) -> bytes:
    b = text.encode("latin-1", "replace")[:65535]
    return struct.pack("<H", len(b)) + b


def write_f3m(sc: dict) -> bytes:
    flags = (FLAG_MODEL if sc["meshes"] else 0) | (FLAG_SKELETON if sc["joints"] else 0) | (FLAG_CLIPS if sc["clips"] else 0)
    out = bytearray(MAGIC)
    out += struct.pack("<I5I", flags, len(sc["textures"]), len(sc["materials"]), len(sc["meshes"]), len(sc["joints"]), len(sc["clips"]))
    out += _s(sc.get("name", ""))
    for t in sc["textures"]:
        out += _s(t["name"]) + struct.pack("<II", t["w"], t["h"]) + t["rgba"]
    for m in sc["materials"]:
        tex = -1 if m["texture"] is None else m["texture"]
        out += _s(m["name"]) + struct.pack("<i4fBBxx", tex, *m["color"], m["alpha_mode"], m["double_sided"])
    for me in sc["meshes"]:
        nv, ni = len(me["pos"]), len(me["idx"])
        bones = sc["bone_names"] if me["joints"] is not None else []
        mat = -1 if me["material"] is None else me["material"]
        out += _s(me["name"]) + struct.pack("<iIII", mat, nv, ni, len(bones))
        for b in bones:
            out += _s(b)
        out += struct.pack("<Bxxx", 1 if me["joints"] is not None else 0)
        out += struct.pack(f"<{nv * 3}f", *[c for v in me["pos"] for c in v])
        out += struct.pack(f"<{nv * 3}f", *[c for v in me["nor"] for c in v])
        out += struct.pack(f"<{nv * 2}f", *[c for v in me["uv"] for c in v])
        out += struct.pack(f"<{nv * 4}f", *[c for v in me["col"] for c in v])
        if me["joints"] is not None:
            out += struct.pack(f"<{nv * 4}H", *[c for v in me["joints"] for c in v])
            out += struct.pack(f"<{nv * 4}f", *[c for v in me["weights"] for c in v])
        out += struct.pack(f"<{ni}I", *me["idx"])
    for j in sc["joints"]:
        out += _s(j["name"]) + struct.pack("<i3f4f3f16f", j["parent"], *j["t"], *j["q"], *j["s"], *j["ibm"])
    for c in sc["clips"]:
        out += _s(c["name"]) + struct.pack("<fI", c["duration"], len(c["channels"]))
        for bone, path, times, values in c["channels"]:
            n = len(times)
            out += _s(bone) + struct.pack("<BxxxI", path, n) + struct.pack(f"<{n}f", *times)
            out += struct.pack(f"<{n * (4 if path == 1 else 3)}f", *[x for v in values for x in v])
    return bytes(out)


class _R:
    def __init__(self, d: bytes):
        self.d, self.p = d, 0

    def take(self, n: int) -> bytes:
        if n < 0 or self.p + n > len(self.d):
            raise F3MError(f"arquivo truncado em {self.p}")
        b = self.d[self.p:self.p + n]
        self.p += n
        return b

    def unpack(self, fmt: str):
        return struct.unpack(fmt, self.take(struct.calcsize(fmt)))

    def s(self) -> str:
        (n,) = self.unpack("<H")
        return self.take(n).decode("latin-1")

    def floats(self, n: int):
        return list(self.unpack(f"<{n}f")) if n else []


def read_f3m(data: bytes) -> dict:
    """Leitor de referência (usado nos testes e na validação cruzada com o C++)."""
    r = _R(data)
    if r.take(4) != MAGIC:
        raise F3MError("não é um F3M1")
    flags, nt, nm, nme, nj, nc = r.unpack("<I5I")
    sc = {"flags": flags, "name": r.s(), "textures": [], "materials": [], "meshes": [], "joints": [], "clips": []}
    for _ in range(nt):
        name = r.s(); w, h = r.unpack("<II")
        if w * h > 1 << 26:
            raise F3MError("textura grande demais")
        sc["textures"].append({"name": name, "w": w, "h": h, "rgba": r.take(w * h * 4)})
    for _ in range(nm):
        name = r.s(); tex, *col, mode, dbl = r.unpack("<i4fBBxx")
        sc["materials"].append({"name": name, "texture": None if tex < 0 else tex, "color": tuple(col), "alpha_mode": mode, "double_sided": dbl})
    for _ in range(nme):
        name = r.s(); mat, nv, ni, nb = r.unpack("<iIII")
        bones = [r.s() for _ in range(nb)]
        (skin,) = r.unpack("<Bxxx")
        f = r.floats
        pos = f(nv * 3); nor = f(nv * 3); uv = f(nv * 2); col = f(nv * 4)
        me = {"name": name, "material": None if mat < 0 else mat, "bones": bones,
              "pos": [tuple(pos[i * 3:i * 3 + 3]) for i in range(nv)], "nor": [tuple(nor[i * 3:i * 3 + 3]) for i in range(nv)],
              "uv": [tuple(uv[i * 2:i * 2 + 2]) for i in range(nv)], "col": [tuple(col[i * 4:i * 4 + 4]) for i in range(nv)],
              "joints": None, "weights": None}
        if skin:
            jn = r.unpack(f"<{nv * 4}H"); w = f(nv * 4)
            me["joints"] = [tuple(jn[i * 4:i * 4 + 4]) for i in range(nv)]
            me["weights"] = [tuple(w[i * 4:i * 4 + 4]) for i in range(nv)]
        me["idx"] = list(r.unpack(f"<{ni}I")) if ni else []
        sc["meshes"].append(me)
    for _ in range(nj):
        name = r.s(); parent, *rest = r.unpack("<i3f4f3f16f")
        sc["joints"].append({"name": name, "parent": parent, "t": tuple(rest[0:3]), "q": tuple(rest[3:7]), "s": tuple(rest[7:10]), "ibm": tuple(rest[10:26])})
    for _ in range(nc):
        name = r.s(); dur, nch = r.unpack("<fI")
        chans = []
        for _ in range(nch):
            bone = r.s(); path, n = r.unpack("<BxxxI")
            times = r.floats(n); k = 4 if path == 1 else 3
            vals = r.floats(n * k)
            chans.append((bone, path, times, [tuple(vals[i * k:(i + 1) * k]) for i in range(n)]))
        sc["clips"].append({"name": name, "duration": dur, "channels": chans})
    if r.p != len(data):
        raise F3MError(f"{len(data) - r.p} bytes sobrando")
    return sc


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- referência de skinning (puro Python)
def _quat_mat(q):
    x, y, z, w = q
    n = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z + w * w) or 1.0
    x, y, z, w = x / n, y / n, z / n, w / n
    return [[1 - 2 * (y * y + z * z), 2 * (x * y - z * w), 2 * (x * z + y * w)],
            [2 * (x * y + z * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + z * z), 2 * (y * z - x * w)],
            [2 * (x * z - y * w), 2 * (y * z + x * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + y * y)]]


def _mul(a, b):
    return [[sum(a[i][k] * b[k][j] for k in range(4)) for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]


def _trs(t, q, s):
    r = _quat_mat(q)
    m = [[r[i][j] * s[j] for j in range(3)] + [t[i]] for i in range(3)] + [[0, 0, 0, 1]]
    return m


def _from_colmajor(m16):
    return [[m16[c * 4 + r] for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]


def _slerp(a, b, t):
    d = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b))
    if d < 0:
        b = tuple(-x for x in b); d = -d
    if d > 0.9995:
        q = tuple(x + t * (y - x) for x, y in zip(a, b))
    else:
        th = math.acos(min(1.0, d)); s = math.sin(th)
        wa, wb = math.sin((1 - t) * th) / s, math.sin(t * th) / s
        q = tuple(wa * x + wb * y for x, y in zip(a, b))
    n = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in q)) or 1.0
    return tuple(x / n for x in q)


def _sample(times, values, t, rot):
    if t <= times[0] or len(times) == 1:
        return values[0]
    if t >= times[-1]:
        return values[-1]
    for i in range(len(times) - 1):
        if times[i] <= t <= times[i + 1]:
            u = (t - times[i]) / (times[i + 1] - times[i]) if times[i + 1] > times[i] else 0.0
            a, b = values[i], values[i + 1]
            return _slerp(a, b, u) if rot else tuple(x + u * (y - x) for x, y in zip(a, b))
    return values[-1]


def pose_matrices(sc: dict, clip: dict | None, t: float):
    """Matrizes de mundo das juntas (listas 4x4 linha-a-linha) para o clipe em t (None = pose de bind)."""
    joints = sc["joints"]
    chan = {}
    for bone, path, times, values in (clip["channels"] if clip else []):
        chan[(bone, path)] = (times, values)
    world = []
    for j in joints:
        tr, q, s = j["t"], j["q"], j["s"]
        if (j["name"], 0) in chan:
            tr = _sample(*chan[(j["name"], 0)], t, False)
        if (j["name"], 1) in chan:
            q = _sample(*chan[(j["name"], 1)], t, True)
        if (j["name"], 2) in chan:
            s = _sample(*chan[(j["name"], 2)], t, False)
        local = _trs(tr, q, s)
        world.append(local if j["parent"] < 0 else _mul(world[j["parent"]], local))
    return world


def skin_positions(sc: dict, mesh_index: int, clip: dict | None, t: float):
    me = sc["meshes"][mesh_index]
    if me["joints"] is None or not sc["joints"]:
        return [tuple(p) for p in me["pos"]]
    name_to_joint = {j["name"]: i for i, j in enumerate(sc["joints"])}
    world = pose_matrices(sc, clip, t)
    jm = [_mul(world[i], _from_colmajor(sc["joints"][i]["ibm"])) for i in range(len(world))]
    out = []
    for v, p in enumerate(me["pos"]):
        acc = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        for k in range(4):
            w = me["weights"][v][k]
            if w == 0:
                continue
            bone = me["bones"][me["joints"][v][k]] if me["joints"][v][k] < len(me["bones"]) else None
            ji = name_to_joint.get(bone)
            if ji is None:
                continue
            m = jm[ji]
            for r in range(3):
                acc[r] += w * (m[r][0] * p[0] + m[r][1] * p[1] + m[r][2] * p[2] + m[r][3])
        out.append(tuple(acc))
    return out
```

## tools/py/f3vb/glb.py

```python
"""Construtor mínimo de GLB (glTF 2.0 binário) em Python puro, com malhas, materiais, texturas, skins e animações."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import struct

FLOAT, USHORT, UINT, UBYTE = 5126, 5123, 5125, 5121
ARRAY_BUFFER, ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER = 34962, 34963
_FMT = {FLOAT: "f", USHORT: "H", UINT: "I", UBYTE: "B"}
_SIZE = {FLOAT: 4, USHORT: 2, UINT: 4, UBYTE: 1}
_NCOMP = {"SCALAR": 1, "VEC2": 2, "VEC3": 3, "VEC4": 4, "MAT4": 16}


class Glb:
    def __init__(self, generator: str = "F3VB exporter"):
        self.j: dict = {"asset": {"version": "2.0", "generator": generator}, "scene": 0,
                        "scenes": [{"nodes": []}], "nodes": [], "buffers": [{"byteLength": 0}]}
        self.bin = bytearray()
        self._img_cache: dict = {}

    # -- infraestrutura -------------------------------------------------
    def _list(self, key: str) -> list:
        return self.j.setdefault(key, [])

    def view(self, data: bytes, target: int | None = None) -> int:
        while len(self.bin) % 4:
            self.bin.append(0)
        v = {"buffer": 0, "byteOffset": len(self.bin), "byteLength": len(data)}
        if target:
            v["target"] = target
        self.bin += data
        self._list("bufferViews").append(v)
        return len(self.j["bufferViews"]) - 1

    def accessor(self, values, ctype: int, atype: str, target: int | None = None, normalized: bool = False,
                 minmax: bool = False) -> int:
        n = _NCOMP[atype]
        flat = [x for v in values for x in (v if isinstance(v, (tuple, list)) else (v,))]
        if len(flat) % n:
            raise ValueError("número de componentes não bate com o tipo do accessor")
        count = len(flat) // n
        data = struct.pack(f"<{len(flat)}{_FMT[ctype]}", *flat)
        a = {"bufferView": self.view(data, target), "componentType": ctype, "count": count, "type": atype}
        if normalized:
            a["normalized"] = True
        if minmax and count:
            cols = [flat[i::n] for i in range(n)]
            a["min"] = [min(c) for c in cols]
            a["max"] = [max(c) for c in cols]
        self._list("accessors").append(a)
        return len(self.j["accessors"]) - 1

    # -- recursos -------------------------------------------------------
    def texture(self, png: bytes, key: str | None = None, name: str | None = None) -> int:
        if key and key in self._img_cache:
            return self._img_cache[key]
        img = {"bufferView": self.view(png), "mimeType": "image/png"}
        if name:
            img["name"] = name
        self._list("images").append(img)
        if "samplers" not in self.j:
            self.j["samplers"] = [{"magFilter": 9729, "minFilter": 9987, "wrapS": 10497, "wrapT": 10497}]
        self._list("textures").append({"source": len(self.j["images"]) - 1, "sampler": 0})
        idx = len(self.j["textures"]) - 1
        if key:
            self._img_cache[key] = idx
        return idx

    def material(self, name: str, base_color=(1, 1, 1, 1), texture: int | None = None, alpha_mode: str = "OPAQUE",
                 double_sided: bool = False, extras: dict | None = None) -> int:
        pbr = {"baseColorFactor": [float(c) for c in base_color], "metallicFactor": 0.0, "roughnessFactor": 1.0}
        if texture is not None:
            pbr["baseColorTexture"] = {"index": texture, "texCoord": 0}
        m = {"name": name, "pbrMetallicRoughness": pbr, "alphaMode": alpha_mode, "doubleSided": double_sided}
        if extras:
            m["extras"] = extras
        self._list("materials").append(m)
        return len(self.j["materials"]) - 1

    def mesh(self, name: str, primitives: list, extras: dict | None = None) -> int:
        m = {"name": name, "primitives": primitives}
        if extras:
            m["extras"] = extras
        self._list("meshes").append(m)
        return len(self.j["meshes"]) - 1

    def node(self, name: str, *, mesh: int | None = None, skin: int | None = None, translation=None, rotation=None,
             scale=None, children: list | None = None, extras: dict | None = None, root: bool = False) -> int:
        n: dict = {"name": name}
        if mesh is not None:
            n["mesh"] = mesh
        if skin is not None:
            n["skin"] = skin
        if translation is not None:
            n["translation"] = [float(x) for x in translation]
        if rotation is not None:
            n["rotation"] = [float(x) for x in rotation]
        if scale is not None:
            n["scale"] = [float(x) for x in scale]
        if children:
            n["children"] = children
        if extras:
            n["extras"] = extras
        self.j["nodes"].append(n)
        idx = len(self.j["nodes"]) - 1
        if root:
            self.j["scenes"][0]["nodes"].append(idx)
        return idx

    def skin(self, name: str, joints: list, ibm: list, skeleton: int | None = None) -> int:
        s = {"name": name, "joints": joints, "inverseBindMatrices": self.accessor(ibm, FLOAT, "MAT4")}
        if skeleton is not None:
            s["skeleton"] = skeleton
        self._list("skins").append(s)
        return len(self.j["skins"]) - 1

    def animation(self, name: str, channels: list) -> int:
        """channels: [(node, 'translation'|'rotation'|'scale', times, values)]"""
        samplers, chans = [], []
        for node, path, times, values in channels:
            tin = self.accessor(times, FLOAT, "SCALAR", minmax=True)
            tout = self.accessor(values, FLOAT, "VEC4" if path == "rotation" else "VEC3")
            samplers.append({"input": tin, "output": tout, "interpolation": "LINEAR"})
            chans.append({"sampler": len(samplers) - 1, "target": {"node": node, "path": path}})
        self._list("animations").append({"name": name, "samplers": samplers, "channels": chans})
        return len(self.j["animations"]) - 1

    # -- saída ----------------------------------------------------------
    def to_bytes(self) -> bytes:
        self.j["buffers"][0]["byteLength"] = len(self.bin)
        body = json.dumps(self.j, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True).encode()
        body += b" " * (-len(body) % 4)
        binary = bytes(self.bin) + b"\x00" * (-len(self.bin) % 4)
        total = 12 + 8 + len(body) + (8 + len(binary) if binary else 0)
        out = struct.pack("<4sII", b"glTF", 2, total) + struct.pack("<I4s", len(body), b"JSON") + body
        if binary:
            out += struct.pack("<I4s", len(binary), b"BIN\x00") + binary
        return out


# ---- utilitários de matemática (4x4 em COLUNA-major, como o glTF) -----------------------------------------
def quat_normalize(q):
    n = math.sqrt(sum(c * c for c in q)) or 1.0
    return tuple(c / n for c in q)


def read_glb(data: bytes) -> tuple[dict, bytes]:
    """Leitor mínimo, usado nos testes: devolve (json, bin)."""
    magic, ver, length = struct.unpack_from("<4sII", data, 0)
    if magic != b"glTF" or ver != 2 or length != len(data):
        raise ValueError("cabeçalho GLB inválido")
    pos, js, bn = 12, None, b""
    while pos < length:
        clen, ctype = struct.unpack_from("<I4s", data, pos)
        chunk = data[pos + 8:pos + 8 + clen]
        if ctype == b"JSON":
            js = json.loads(chunk.decode())
        elif ctype == b"BIN\x00":
            bn = chunk
        pos += 8 + clen
    return js, bn


def read_accessor(js: dict, bn: bytes, idx: int) -> list:
    a = js["accessors"][idx]
    v = js["bufferViews"][a["bufferView"]]
    n = _NCOMP[a["type"]]
    fmt = _FMT[a["componentType"]]
    raw = struct.unpack_from(f"<{a['count'] * n}{fmt}", bn, v["byteOffset"] + a.get("byteOffset", 0))
    return [tuple(raw[i * n:(i + 1) * n]) if n > 1 else raw[i] for i in range(a["count"])]


def validate_glb(data: bytes) -> list[str]:
    """Checagens estruturais básicas (sem depender de validador externo). Devolve a lista de problemas."""
    problems: list[str] = []
    try:
        js, bn = read_glb(data)
    except Exception as exc:
        return [f"GLB ilegível: {exc}"]
    if js.get("asset", {}).get("version") != "2.0":
        problems.append("asset.version != 2.0")
    nb = len(js.get("bufferViews", []))
    for i, v in enumerate(js.get("bufferViews", [])):
        if v["byteOffset"] + v["byteLength"] > len(bn):
            problems.append(f"bufferView {i} fora do buffer")
        if v["byteOffset"] % 4:
            problems.append(f"bufferView {i} desalinhado")
    for i, a in enumerate(js.get("accessors", [])):
        if not 0 <= a["bufferView"] < nb:
            problems.append(f"accessor {i}: bufferView inválido")
            continue
        v = js["bufferViews"][a["bufferView"]]
        need = a["count"] * _NCOMP[a["type"]] * _SIZE[a["componentType"]]
        if a.get("byteOffset", 0) + need > v["byteLength"]:
            problems.append(f"accessor {i}: leitura passa do bufferView")
        if a["count"] == 0:
            problems.append(f"accessor {i}: count 0")
        if "min" in a and len(a["min"]) != _NCOMP[a["type"]]:
            problems.append(f"accessor {i}: min/max com tamanho errado")
    nn = len(js.get("nodes", []))
    for i, n in enumerate(js.get("nodes", [])):
        for c in n.get("children", []):
            if not 0 <= c < nn:
                problems.append(f"node {i}: filho {c} inválido")
        if "mesh" in n and not 0 <= n["mesh"] < len(js.get("meshes", [])):
            problems.append(f"node {i}: mesh inválido")
        if "skin" in n and not 0 <= n["skin"] < len(js.get("skins", [])):
            problems.append(f"node {i}: skin inválido")
        if "rotation" in n and abs(math.sqrt(sum(c * c for c in n["rotation"])) - 1) > 1e-3:
            problems.append(f"node {i}: quaternion não normalizado")
    for mi, m in enumerate(js.get("meshes", [])):
        for pi, p in enumerate(m["primitives"]):
            for k, ai in p["attributes"].items():
                if not 0 <= ai < len(js.get("accessors", [])):
                    problems.append(f"mesh {mi} prim {pi}: atributo {k} inválido")
            if "indices" in p:
                idx = read_accessor(js, bn, p["indices"])
                nvert = js["accessors"][p["attributes"]["POSITION"]]["count"]
                if idx and max(idx) >= nvert:
                    problems.append(f"mesh {mi} prim {pi}: índice {max(idx)} >= {nvert} vértices")
                if len(idx) % 3:
                    problems.append(f"mesh {mi} prim {pi}: índices não múltiplos de 3")
            if "material" in p and not 0 <= p["material"] < len(js.get("materials", [])):
                problems.append(f"mesh {mi} prim {pi}: material inválido")
    for si, s in enumerate(js.get("skins", [])):
        ibm = js["accessors"][s["inverseBindMatrices"]]
        if ibm["count"] != len(s["joints"]):
            problems.append(f"skin {si}: {ibm['count']} IBMs para {len(s['joints'])} joints")
        for jn in s["joints"]:
            if not 0 <= jn < nn:
                problems.append(f"skin {si}: joint {jn} inválido")
    for ai, an in enumerate(js.get("animations", [])):
        for c in an["channels"]:
            s = an["samplers"][c["sampler"]]
            tin = read_accessor(js, bn, s["input"])
            if any(b <= a for a, b in zip(tin, tin[1:])):
                problems.append(f"animação {ai}: tempos não crescentes")
            if js["accessors"][s["output"]]["count"] != len(tin):
                problems.append(f"animação {ai}: saídas != entradas")
    return problems
```

## tools/py/f3vb/gr2export.py

```python
"""Esqueletos e clipes de animação de arquivos GR2 (via parser vendorizado), prontos para o exportador GLB."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from .gr2tool import _api

IGNORED_GROUPS = {"light", "camera"}


@dataclass
class Joint:
    name: str
    parent: int                       # -1 = raiz
    position: tuple
    orientation: tuple                # x, y, z, w
    scale: tuple
    inverse_world: tuple              # 16 floats, como no GR2 (row-vector, translação na última linha)


@dataclass
class Clip:
    name: str
    duration: float
    # nome do osso -> {"translation": (times, values), "rotation": (...), "scale": (...)}
    tracks: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    warnings: list = field(default_factory=list)


def read_skeleton(data: bytes, prefer: str | None = None):
    """Devolve (lista de Joint, nome) do primeiro esqueleto "de verdade" (ignora Light/Camera)."""
    file, fixup, _geom, skeleton, _anim = _api()
    skels = skeleton.extract_skeletons(fixup.load_sections(file.read_gr2_bytes(data)))
    cands = [s for s in skels if s.name.lower() not in IGNORED_GROUPS and len(s.bones) > 1]
    if prefer:
        cands = sorted(cands, key=lambda s: s.name != prefer)
    if not cands:
        return [], None
    s = cands[0]
    joints = []
    for b in s.bones:
        ss = tuple(b.transform.scale_shear)
        scale = (ss[0], ss[4], ss[8]) if len(ss) >= 9 else (1.0, 1.0, 1.0)
        parent = b.parent_index if b.parent_index not in (b.index,) and b.parent_index >= 0 else -1
        joints.append(Joint(b.name, parent, tuple(b.transform.position), tuple(b.transform.orientation), scale,
                            tuple(b.inverse_world_transform)))
    return joints, s.name


def _curve_keys(curve, duration: float, step: float, dim: int):
    """(times, values) amostrados; curva constante vira 1 chave em t=0."""
    _api_mod = _api()[4]
    if curve is None:
        return None
    if curve.control_values:
        ts, samples = _api_mod.sample_curve_values(curve, duration, step)
        if samples:
            times = [min(duration, i * ts) for i in range(len(samples))]
            vals = [tuple(s[:dim]) if len(s) >= dim else None for s in samples]
            if all(v is not None for v in vals):
                return times, vals
    if curve.sample_value and len(curve.sample_value) >= dim:
        return [0.0], [tuple(curve.sample_value[:dim])]
    return None


def read_clips(data: bytes, bone_names: set[str], clip_name: str | None = None) -> list[Clip]:
    file, fixup, _geom, _skel, animation = _api()
    aset = animation.extract_animation_set(fixup.load_sections(file.read_gr2_bytes(data)))
    groups = {g.name: g for g in aset.track_groups}
    clips = []
    for an in aset.animations:
        clip = Clip(name=clip_name or str(an.name).replace("\\", "/").split("/")[-1].rsplit(".", 1)[0],
                    duration=float(an.duration))
        step = float(an.time_step) if an.time_step and an.time_step > 0 else 1 / 30
        names = [n for n in an.track_group_names if n.lower() not in IGNORED_GROUPS] or \
                [n for n in groups if n.lower() not in IGNORED_GROUPS]
        for gname in names:
            g = groups.get(gname)
            if g is None:
                continue
            for tr in g.transform_tracks:
                if tr.name not in bone_names:
                    clip.warnings.append(f"trilha '{tr.name}' sem osso correspondente")
                    continue
                entry = {}
                try:
                    q = _curve_keys(tr.orientation, an.duration, step, 4)
                    p = _curve_keys(tr.position, an.duration, step, 3)
                    sc = None
                    if tr.scale_shear is not None:
                        dim = tr.scale_shear.dimension
                        raw = _curve_keys(tr.scale_shear, an.duration, step, dim if dim in (3, 9) else 3)
                        if raw:
                            times, vals = raw
                            sc = (times, [(v[0], v[4], v[8]) if len(v) == 9 else tuple(v[:3]) for v in vals])
                    if q:
                        entry["rotation"] = q
                    if p:
                        entry["translation"] = p
                    if sc:
                        entry["scale"] = sc
                except Exception as exc:                      # uma trilha ruim não derruba o clipe
                    clip.warnings.append(f"trilha '{tr.name}': {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
                if entry:
                    clip.tracks[tr.name] = entry
        clips.append(clip)
    return clips
```

## tools/py/f3vb/gr2tool.py

```python
"""Ponte para o parser GR2 vendorizado (blendergranny, MIT). Python puro, sem Blender,
sem DLL. NUNCA usa granny2.dll, SDK, --research-native nem --unsafe-oodle0."""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

_VENDOR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "third_party" / "blendergranny"


def _api():
    if str(_VENDOR) not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(_VENDOR))
    from io_scene_gr2.gr2 import animation, file, fixup, geometry, skeleton  # noqa: E402
    return file, fixup, geometry, skeleton, animation


def gr2_header(data: bytes) -> dict:
    file, *_ = _api()
    gr2 = file.read_gr2_bytes(data)
    h = gr2.header
    return {
        "version": h.version, "pointer_size": h.pointer_size, "byte_reversed": h.byte_reversed,
        "total_size_declared": h.total_size, "actual_size": len(data), "section_count": h.section_count,
        "sections": [{"index": s.index, "name": s.semantic_name, "compression": s.compression_name,
                      "data_size": s.data_size, "expanded_size": s.expanded_size,
                      "pointer_fixups": s.pointer_fixup_count, "mixed_marshalling": s.mixed_marshalling_count}
                     for s in gr2.sections],
        "compressions": sorted({s.compression_name for s in gr2.sections}),
    }


def summarize_gr2(data: bytes, deep: bool = True) -> dict:
    """Resumo em etapas; cada etapa que falhar vira uma entrada em `errors` (não derruba as outras)."""
    file, fixup, geometry, skeleton, animation = _api()
    out: dict = {"format": "gr2", "errors": []}
    try:
        out["header"] = gr2_header(data)
    except Exception as exc:
        out["errors"].append({"stage": "header", "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"})
        return out
    if not deep:
        return out
    try:
        loaded = fixup.load_sections(file.read_gr2_bytes(data))
    except Exception as exc:
        out["errors"].append({"stage": "load_sections (descompressão/fixups)", "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"})
        return out
    stages = (
        ("geometry", lambda: geometry.geometry_summary(geometry.extract_mesh_geometries(loaded))),
        ("skeletons", lambda: skeleton.skeleton_summary(skeleton.extract_skeletons(loaded))),
        ("animations", lambda: animation.animation_summary(animation.extract_animation_set(loaded))),
    )
    for name, fn in stages:
        try:
            out[name] = fn()
        except Exception as exc:
            out["errors"].append({"stage": name, "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"})
    return out
```

## tools/py/f3vb/grp.py

```python
"""Leitor de .grp (layout derivado de grp.pat; a confirmar em arquivo real).

    u32 vMajor, u32 vMinor, u32 nFiles
    nFiles x { u32 offset, u32 length }     (tabela logo após o cabeçalho)
    dados dos lumps em `offset` (absoluto desde o início do arquivo)

Little-endian. O .grp NÃO guarda nomes: nome/tipo vêm do resource.rht.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import mmap
import struct
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

_HEADER = struct.Struct("<III")
_LUMP = struct.Struct("<II")
HEADER_SIZE = _HEADER.size
LUMP_ENTRY_SIZE = _LUMP.size


class GrpError(ValueError):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Lump:
    index: int
    offset: int
    length: int

    @property
    def end(self) -> int:
        return self.offset + self.length


@dataclass
class GrpInfo:
    v_major: int
    v_minor: int
    n_files: int
    file_size: int
    lumps: list[Lump]
    issues: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def table_end(self) -> int:
        return HEADER_SIZE + LUMP_ENTRY_SIZE * self.n_files


def parse_grp(buf) -> GrpInfo:
    size = len(buf)
    if size < HEADER_SIZE:
        raise GrpError(f"arquivo com {size} bytes, menor que o cabeçalho ({HEADER_SIZE})")
    v_major, v_minor, n_files = _HEADER.unpack_from(buf, 0)
    table_end = HEADER_SIZE + LUMP_ENTRY_SIZE * n_files
    if table_end > size:
        raise GrpError(
            f"tabela de lumps (nFiles={n_files}) não cabe no arquivo ({table_end} > {size}); "
            "provavelmente não é um .grp neste layout")
    lumps = [Lump(i, *_LUMP.unpack_from(buf, HEADER_SIZE + LUMP_ENTRY_SIZE * i))
             for i in range(n_files)]
    info = GrpInfo(v_major, v_minor, n_files, size, lumps)

    for lp in lumps:
        if lp.end > size:
            info.issues.append(f"lump {lp.index}: fora do arquivo (offset={lp.offset}, length={lp.length})")
        elif lp.length and lp.offset < table_end:
            info.issues.append(f"lump {lp.index}: começa dentro da tabela (offset={lp.offset})")
    ordered = sorted((lp for lp in lumps if lp.length and lp.end <= size), key=lambda l: l.offset)
    for a, b in zip(ordered, ordered[1:]):
        if b.offset < a.end:
            info.issues.append(f"lumps {a.index} e {b.index} se sobrepõem")
    return info


class GrpFile:
    """Abre um .grp com mmap (somente leitura). Use como context manager."""

    def __init__(self, path: str | Path):
        self.path = Path(path)
        self._fh = self.path.open("rb")
        try:
            self._mm = mmap.mmap(self._fh.fileno(), 0, access=mmap.ACCESS_READ)
        except ValueError as exc:  # arquivo vazio
            self._fh.close()
            raise GrpError(f"{self.path}: arquivo vazio") from exc
        try:
            self.info = parse_grp(self._mm)
        except GrpError:
            self.close()
            raise

    def read(self, lump: Lump | int) -> bytes:
        lp = self.info.lumps[lump] if isinstance(lump, int) else lump
        if lp.end > self.info.file_size:
            raise GrpError(f"lump {lp.index} fora do arquivo")
        return self._mm[lp.offset:lp.end]

    def head(self, lump: Lump | int, n: int = 64) -> bytes:
        lp = self.info.lumps[lump] if isinstance(lump, int) else lump
        end = min(lp.end, self.info.file_size, lp.offset + n)
        return self._mm[lp.offset:end]

    def close(self) -> None:
        try:
            self._mm.close()
        finally:
            self._fh.close()

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc):
        self.close()
```

## tools/py/f3vb/imagecodec.py

```python
"""Decodificadores puros (sem Pillow/numpy) de TGA e BMP e codificador PNG, para embutir texturas no GLB."""
from __future__ import annotations

import struct
import zlib


class ImageError(ValueError):
    pass


def _expand_rle(data: bytes, pos: int, pixels: int, bpp_bytes: int) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    n = len(data)
    while len(out) < pixels * bpp_bytes:
        if pos >= n:
            raise ImageError("TGA RLE truncado")
        h = data[pos]
        pos += 1
        count = (h & 0x7F) + 1
        if h & 0x80:
            if pos + bpp_bytes > n:
                raise ImageError("TGA RLE truncado")
            out += data[pos:pos + bpp_bytes] * count
            pos += bpp_bytes
        else:
            end = pos + count * bpp_bytes
            if end > n:
                raise ImageError("TGA RLE truncado")
            out += data[pos:end]
            pos = end
    return bytes(out[:pixels * bpp_bytes])


def decode_tga(data: bytes) -> tuple[int, int, bytes]:
    """Devolve (largura, altura, RGBA8 linha a linha de CIMA para BAIXO)."""
    if len(data) < 18:
        raise ImageError("TGA menor que o cabeçalho")
    idlen, cmap_type, itype = data[0], data[1], data[2]
    cm_first, cm_len, cm_bits = struct.unpack_from("<HHB", data, 3)
    w, h, bpp, desc = struct.unpack_from("<HHBB", data, 12)
    if w == 0 or h == 0 or w > 16384 or h > 16384:
        raise ImageError(f"dimensões inválidas {w}x{h}")
    pos = 18 + idlen
    palette = None
    if cmap_type:
        cb = (cm_bits + 7) // 8
        pal_raw = data[pos:pos + cm_len * cb]
        pos += cm_len * cb
        palette = []
        for i in range(cm_len):
            c = pal_raw[i * cb:(i + 1) * cb]
            if cb == 3:
                palette.append((c[2], c[1], c[0], 255))
            elif cb == 4:
                palette.append((c[2], c[1], c[0], c[3]))
            elif cb == 2:
                v = c[0] | (c[1] << 8)
                palette.append((((v >> 10) & 31) * 255 // 31, ((v >> 5) & 31) * 255 // 31, (v & 31) * 255 // 31, 255))
            else:
                raise ImageError("paleta TGA não suportada")
    base = itype & 7
    rle = bool(itype & 8)
    if base not in (1, 2, 3):
        raise ImageError(f"tipo de TGA não suportado: {itype}")
    bb = (bpp + 7) // 8
    if base == 1 and palette is None:
        raise ImageError("TGA paletizado sem paleta")
    raw = _expand_rle(data, pos, w * h, bb) if rle else data[pos:pos + w * h * bb]
    if len(raw) < w * h * bb:
        raise ImageError("dados de pixel truncados")
    rgba = bytearray(w * h * 4)
    if base == 2:
        if bpp == 24:
            rgba[0::4], rgba[1::4], rgba[2::4] = raw[2::3], raw[1::3], raw[0::3]
            rgba[3::4] = b"\xff" * (w * h)
        elif bpp == 32:
            rgba[0::4], rgba[1::4], rgba[2::4], rgba[3::4] = raw[2::4], raw[1::4], raw[0::4], raw[3::4]
        elif bpp in (15, 16):
            for i in range(w * h):
                v = raw[2 * i] | (raw[2 * i + 1] << 8)
                rgba[4 * i:4 * i + 4] = bytes((((v >> 10) & 31) * 255 // 31, ((v >> 5) & 31) * 255 // 31, (v & 31) * 255 // 31, 255))
        else:
            raise ImageError(f"bpp {bpp} não suportado")
    elif base == 3:
        if bpp != 8:
            raise ImageError("TGA cinza só em 8 bpp")
        rgba[0::4] = rgba[1::4] = rgba[2::4] = raw[:w * h]
        rgba[3::4] = b"\xff" * (w * h)
    else:
        if bpp != 8:
            raise ImageError("TGA paletizado só em 8 bpp")
        for i in range(w * h):
            idx = raw[i] - cm_first
            rgba[4 * i:4 * i + 4] = bytes(palette[idx] if 0 <= idx < len(palette) else (0, 0, 0, 255))
    if not (desc & 0x20):                                   # origem embaixo -> inverter linhas
        row = w * 4
        rgba = bytearray(b"".join(bytes(rgba[r * row:(r + 1) * row]) for r in range(h - 1, -1, -1)))
    return w, h, bytes(rgba)


def decode_bmp(data: bytes) -> tuple[int, int, bytes]:
    if len(data) < 54 or data[:2] != b"BM":
        raise ImageError("não é BMP")
    off, dib = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, 10)
    w, h, planes, bpp, comp = struct.unpack_from("<iiHHI", data, 18)
    if comp not in (0, 3) or bpp not in (8, 24, 32) or w <= 0 or h == 0:
        raise ImageError(f"BMP não suportado (bpp={bpp}, compressão={comp})")
    top_down = h < 0
    h = abs(h)
    pal = []
    if bpp == 8:
        n = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 46)[0] or 256
        po = 14 + dib
        pal = [(data[po + 4 * i + 2], data[po + 4 * i + 1], data[po + 4 * i], 255) for i in range(n)]
    stride = ((w * bpp + 31) // 32) * 4
    out = bytearray()
    rows = range(h) if top_down else range(h - 1, -1, -1)
    for r in rows:
        line = data[off + r * stride:off + r * stride + stride]
        if len(line) < stride:
            raise ImageError("BMP truncado")
        for x in range(w):
            if bpp == 24:
                out += bytes((line[3 * x + 2], line[3 * x + 1], line[3 * x], 255))
            elif bpp == 32:
                out += bytes((line[4 * x + 2], line[4 * x + 1], line[4 * x], line[4 * x + 3] or 255))
            else:
                out += bytes(pal[line[x]] if line[x] < len(pal) else (0, 0, 0, 255))
    return w, h, bytes(out)


def encode_png(w: int, h: int, rgba: bytes) -> bytes:
    if len(rgba) != w * h * 4:
        raise ImageError("tamanho RGBA inconsistente")
    # descarta o canal alfa se for todo 255 (arquivo menor)
    opaque = rgba[3::4].count(255) == w * h
    if opaque:
        rows = b"".join(b"\x00" + b"".join(rgba[(y * w + x) * 4:(y * w + x) * 4 + 3] for x in range(w)) for y in range(h)) \
            if w * h <= 4096 else None
        if rows is None:
            rgb = bytearray(w * h * 3)
            rgb[0::3], rgb[1::3], rgb[2::3] = rgba[0::4], rgba[1::4], rgba[2::4]
            rows = b"".join(b"\x00" + bytes(rgb[y * w * 3:(y + 1) * w * 3]) for y in range(h))
        ctype, ch = 2, 3
    else:
        rows = b"".join(b"\x00" + rgba[y * w * 4:(y + 1) * w * 4] for y in range(h))
        ctype, ch = 6, 4

    def chunk(tag: bytes, body: bytes) -> bytes:
        return struct.pack(">I", len(body)) + tag + body + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + body) & 0xFFFFFFFF)

    return (b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, ctype, 0, 0, 0))
            + chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(rows, 6)) + chunk(b"IEND", b""))


def image_to_png(data: bytes) -> tuple[int, int, bytes]:
    """TGA ou BMP -> (largura, altura, bytes PNG)."""
    w, h, rgba = decode_bmp(data) if data[:2] == b"BM" else decode_tga(data)
    return w, h, encode_png(w, h, rgba)
```

## tools/py/f3vb/index.py

```python
"""Índice de recursos da demo: resolve NOME -> bytes usando resource.rht + .grp (sem extrair nada para o disco)."""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from .catalog import find_grps
from .grp import GrpFile
from .rht import read_rht


class ResourceIndex:
    def __init__(self, game_dir, rht_path=None):
        root = Path(game_dir)
        rp = Path(rht_path) if rht_path else next(root.rglob("resource.rht"), None)
        if not rp:
            raise FileNotFoundError("resource.rht não encontrado")
        self.rht = read_rht(rp)
        self.grps, _dups = find_grps(root)
        self._open: dict = {}
        self.by_name: dict = {}                    # (tipo, nome minúsculo) -> (pack, número)
        self.entries: dict = {}                    # tipo -> [(nome, pack, número)]
        for e in self.rht.entries:
            nm = self.rht.resource_name(e.offset)
            if nm is None:
                continue
            pack = self.rht.pack_label(e.pack)
            self.by_name.setdefault((e.type_name, nm.lower()), (pack, e.number))
            self.entries.setdefault(e.type_name, []).append((nm, pack, e.number))

    def _grp(self, pack: str) -> GrpFile:
        g = self._open.get(pack)
        if g is None:
            path = self.grps.get(pack.lower())
            if path is None:
                raise FileNotFoundError(f".grp do pack '{pack}' não encontrado")
            g = self._open[pack] = GrpFile(path)
        return g

    def read(self, pack: str, number: int) -> bytes:
        return self._grp(pack).read(number)

    def find(self, name: str, type_name: str):
        return self.by_name.get((type_name, name.lower()))

    def read_named(self, name: str, type_name: str) -> bytes | None:
        hit = self.find(name, type_name)
        return self.read(*hit) if hit else None

    def search(self, type_name: str, prefix: str = "") -> list:
        p = prefix.lower()
        return sorted(e for e in self.entries.get(type_name, []) if e[0].lower().startswith(p))

    def close(self):
        for g in self._open.values():
            g.close()
        self._open.clear()

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *a):
        self.close()


class RetailIndex:
    """Mesma interface do ResourceIndex (read / read_named / search), mas lendo os ARQUIVOS da pasta RETAIL.

    Serve para converter (png/f3m/glb) sem precisar dos .grp: `rows` sao as linhas do index.csv
    (pack, numero, tipo, nome, caminho relativo a RETAIL, tamanho).
    """

    def __init__(self, retail_dir, rows):
        self.retail = Path(retail_dir)
        self.rows = list(rows)
        self._path: dict = {}
        self.by_name: dict = {}
        self.entries: dict = {}
        for pack, number, type_name, name, rel, _size in self.rows:
            self._path[(pack.lower(), int(number))] = rel
            self.by_name.setdefault((type_name, name.lower()), (pack, int(number)))
            self.entries.setdefault(type_name, []).append((name, pack, int(number)))

    @classmethod
    def from_csv(cls, assets_root):
        import csv
        root = Path(assets_root)
        with open(root / "index.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            rd = csv.reader(f)
            next(rd, None)
            rows = [(r[0], int(r[1]), r[2], r[3], r[4], int(r[5])) for r in rd if len(r) >= 6]
        return cls(root / "RETAIL", rows)

    def read(self, pack: str, number: int) -> bytes:
        rel = self._path.get((pack.lower(), int(number)))
        if rel is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"{pack}#{number} nao esta no index.csv")
        return (self.retail / rel).read_bytes()

    def find(self, name: str, type_name: str):
        return self.by_name.get((type_name, name.lower()))

    def read_named(self, name: str, type_name: str) -> bytes | None:
        hit = self.find(name, type_name)
        return self.read(*hit) if hit else None

    def search(self, type_name: str, prefix: str = "") -> list:
        p = prefix.lower()
        return sorted(e for e in self.entries.get(type_name, []) if e[0].lower().startswith(p))

    def close(self):
        pass

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *a):
        self.close()
```

## tools/py/f3vb/intfile.py

```python
"""Formato `.int` (recurso INT_Interface): o layout de uma tela da interface. DECODIFICADO no v19 (25 de 25 arquivos reais lidos ate o ultimo byte).

Spec completa: docs/specs/int.md. Resumo (little-endian; str = u32 comprimento + bytes, SEM terminador):
    "GUI V1.x" (8 bytes; x = 1, 2 ou 3)   str nome_do_arquivo   u8 ?   u32 N_raizes   N x objeto
    objeto = u32 tipo  prefixo(tipo)  corpo  9 x fragmento  i32 (-1)  u32 N_filhos  N_filhos x objeto  sufixo(tipo)
      tipo: 0 janela, 1 botao, 2 imagem, 3 rotulo (texto), 4 campo de edicao
      prefixo do botao: u32 ?  [V1.3: u8 ?, 3 x str sons (apertar, soltar, soltar)]
      corpo: i32[4] retangulo ABSOLUTO na tela de 1024x768 (x0, y0, x1, y1), str nome, u8 a, u8 b, u8 c, str skin (.ini),
             u8[4] cor (rgb + byte), i32[4] retangulo relativo ao pai, u8 ?, u32 interativo (1 em janelas/botoes/campos, 0 em imagens/rotulos: hipotese; NAO e visibilidade),
             [V1.2+: u32 ?, i32 id_a, u32 ?, i32 id_dica, str textura_da_dica]
      fragmento (9, na ordem upperleft, uppermiddle, upperright, left, middle, right, lowerleft, lowermiddle, lowerright):
             u32 flags (0 esticar, 1 repetir em x, 2 repetir em y, 3 repetir em x e y), i32 largura, i32 altura, i32 ?, i32 ?,
             u32 ? (as vezes lixo de memoria), str textura, f32 ?, u8[4] cor RGBA, i32[4] retangulo ABSOLUTO
      sufixo do rotulo/campo (depois dos filhos!): u32 id_do_texto (1-based no .stf; 0 = sem texto), str fonte, u32 ?, u32 tamanho, u32 ?,
             u8[4] cor RGBA do texto, 22 bytes ?, u32 alinhamento (0 esquerda, 1 centro, 2 direita: hipotese)
O que cada campo "?" significa ainda nao se sabe; o leitor guarda os valores crus (raw) para estudo.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import struct
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

TYPE_NAMES = {0: "janela", 1: "botao", 2: "imagem", 3: "rotulo", 4: "edicao"}
FRAGMENT_NAMES = ("upperleft", "uppermiddle", "upperright", "left", "middle", "right", "lowerleft", "lowermiddle", "lowerright")
MAX_STR = 4096
MAX_CHILDREN = 4096
MAX_DEPTH = 32


class IntError(ValueError):
    pass


@dataclass
class Fragment:
    flags: int
    width: int
    height: int
    unk_a: int
    unk_b: int
    unk_c: int
    texture: str
    unk_f: float
    color: tuple          # (r, g, b, a)
    rect: tuple           # absoluto, tela 1024x768


@dataclass
class Widget:
    kind: int
    name: str
    rect: tuple           # (x0, y0, x1, y1) absoluto na tela de 1024x768
    rel: tuple            # retangulo relativo ao pai
    skin: str
    color: tuple          # 4 bytes crus depois da skin
    flags3: tuple         # os 3 bytes depois do nome
    interactive: int
    tip_a: int = -1
    tip_text: int = -1
    tip_texture: str = ""
    fragments: list = field(default_factory=list)
    children: list = field(default_factory=list)
    # botao
    sounds: tuple = ()
    button_unk: int = 0
    # rotulo / edicao
    text_id: int = 0      # 1-based no .stf (0 = sem texto)
    font: str = ""
    font_size: int = 0
    text_color: tuple = ()
    align: int = 0
    raw: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def type_name(self) -> str:
        return TYPE_NAMES.get(self.kind, f"tipo{self.kind}")

    def walk(self, depth: int = 0):
        yield depth, self
        for c in self.children:
            yield from c.walk(depth + 1)


@dataclass
class IntFile:
    version: int          # 11, 12 ou 13
    name: str
    roots: list

    def walk(self):
        for r in self.roots:
            yield from r.walk(0)

    def count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for _ in self.walk())

    def find(self, name: str):
        low = name.lower()
        return next((w for _d, w in self.walk() if w.name.lower() == low), None)


class _R:
    def __init__(self, data: bytes):
        self.d, self.o = data, 0

    def need(self, n: int) -> None:
        if self.o + n > len(self.d):
            raise IntError(f"fim do arquivo em {self.o} (precisava de {n} bytes)")

    def u8(self) -> int:
        self.need(1)
        v = self.d[self.o]
        self.o += 1
        return v

    def u32(self) -> int:
        self.need(4)
        v = struct.unpack_from("<I", self.d, self.o)[0]
        self.o += 4
        return v

    def i32(self) -> int:
        self.need(4)
        v = struct.unpack_from("<i", self.d, self.o)[0]
        self.o += 4
        return v

    def f32(self) -> float:
        self.need(4)
        v = struct.unpack_from("<f", self.d, self.o)[0]
        self.o += 4
        return v

    def raw(self, n: int) -> bytes:
        self.need(n)
        v = self.d[self.o:self.o + n]
        self.o += n
        return v

    def rect(self) -> tuple:
        self.need(16)
        v = struct.unpack_from("<4i", self.d, self.o)
        self.o += 16
        return v

    def s(self) -> str:
        n = self.u32()
        if n > MAX_STR:
            raise IntError(f"string de {n} bytes em {self.o - 4} (absurda)")
        return self.raw(n).decode("latin-1")


def _fragment(r: _R) -> Fragment:
    fl, w, h, a, b = (r.i32() for _ in range(5))
    c = r.u32()
    tex = r.s()
    f = r.f32()
    col = tuple(r.raw(4))
    return Fragment(fl, w, h, a, b, c, tex, f, col, r.rect())


def _widget(r: _R, kind: int, ver: int, depth: int) -> Widget:
    if depth > MAX_DEPTH:
        raise IntError("arvore funda demais")
    if kind not in TYPE_NAMES:
        raise IntError(f"tipo de objeto desconhecido {kind} em {r.o - 4}")
    sounds: tuple = ()
    bunk = 0
    raw: dict = {}
    if kind == 1:
        bunk = r.u32()
        if ver >= 13:
            raw["button_u8"] = r.u8()
            sounds = (r.s(), r.s(), r.s())
    rect = r.rect()
    name = r.s()
    f3 = (r.u8(), r.u8(), r.u8())
    skin = r.s()
    color = tuple(r.raw(4))
    rel = r.rect()
    raw["body_u8"] = r.u8()
    interactive = r.u32()
    w = Widget(kind, name, rect, rel, skin, color, f3, interactive, sounds=sounds, button_unk=bunk, raw=raw)
    if ver >= 12:
        raw["h1"] = r.u32()
        w.tip_a = r.i32()
        raw["h2"] = r.u32()
        w.tip_text = r.i32()
        w.tip_texture = r.s()
    w.fragments = [_fragment(r) for _ in range(9)]
    raw["end"] = r.i32()
    nch = r.u32()
    if nch > MAX_CHILDREN:
        raise IntError(f"{nch} filhos em {r.o - 4} (absurdo)")
    for _ in range(nch):
        w.children.append(_widget(r, r.u32(), ver, depth + 1))
    if kind in (3, 4):
        w.text_id = r.u32()
        w.font = r.s()
        raw["font_a"] = r.u32()
        w.font_size = r.u32()
        raw["font_b"] = r.u32()
        w.text_color = tuple(r.raw(4))
        raw["label_tail"] = r.raw(22).hex()
        w.align = r.u32()
    return w


def read_int(data: bytes) -> IntFile:
    if len(data) < 12 or data[:5] != b"GUI V" or data[6:7] != b".":
        raise IntError("nao e um .int (assinatura 'GUI V1.x' ausente)")
    try:
        ver = int(data[5:6]) * 10 + int(data[7:8])
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise IntError(f"versao ilegivel {data[:8]!r}") from exc
    if ver not in (11, 12, 13):
        raise IntError(f"versao {data[:8]!r} nao suportada (conhecidas: V1.1, V1.2, V1.3)")
    r = _R(data)
    r.o = 8
    name = r.s()
    r.u8()
    nroots = r.u32()
    if nroots > MAX_CHILDREN:
        raise IntError(f"{nroots} raizes (absurdo)")
    roots = [_widget(r, r.u32(), ver, 0) for _ in range(nroots)]
    if r.o != len(data):
        raise IntError(f"sobraram {len(data) - r.o} bytes depois da arvore (leitura terminou em {r.o})")
    return IntFile(ver, name, roots)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- escritor (testes sinteticos)
def _ws(t: str) -> bytes:
    b = t.encode("latin-1")
    return struct.pack("<I", len(b)) + b


def build_widget(w: Widget, ver: int = 13) -> bytes:
    out = [struct.pack("<I", w.kind)]
    if w.kind == 1:
        out.append(struct.pack("<I", w.button_unk))
        if ver >= 13:
            snd = tuple(w.sounds) + ("",) * (3 - len(w.sounds))
            out.append(struct.pack("<B", w.raw.get("button_u8", 0)) + b"".join(_ws(x) for x in snd[:3]))
    out += [struct.pack("<4i", *w.rect), _ws(w.name), bytes(w.flags3), _ws(w.skin), bytes(w.color), struct.pack("<4i", *w.rel),
            struct.pack("<BI", w.raw.get("body_u8", 0), w.interactive)]
    if ver >= 12:
        out += [struct.pack("<IiIi", w.raw.get("h1", 0), w.tip_a, w.raw.get("h2", 0), w.tip_text), _ws(w.tip_texture)]
    frags = list(w.fragments) + [Fragment(0, 8, 8, 0, 0, 0, "", 0.0, (128, 128, 128, 255), w.rect)] * (9 - len(w.fragments))
    for f in frags[:9]:
        out += [struct.pack("<5iI", f.flags, f.width, f.height, f.unk_a, f.unk_b, f.unk_c), _ws(f.texture), struct.pack("<f", f.unk_f), bytes(f.color),
                struct.pack("<4i", *f.rect)]
    out.append(struct.pack("<iI", w.raw.get("end", -1), len(w.children)))
    out += [build_widget(c, ver) for c in w.children]
    if w.kind in (3, 4):
        tail = bytes.fromhex(w.raw.get("label_tail", "00" * 22))
        out += [struct.pack("<I", w.text_id), _ws(w.font), struct.pack("<III", w.raw.get("font_a", 0), w.font_size, w.raw.get("font_b", 1)),
                bytes(w.text_color or (255, 255, 255, 255)), tail[:22].ljust(22, b"\0"), struct.pack("<I", w.align)]
    return b"".join(out)


def build_int(name: str, roots: list, ver: int = 13) -> bytes:
    return b"GUI V1.%d" % (ver % 10) + _ws(name) + b"\0" + struct.pack("<I", len(roots)) + b"".join(build_widget(w, ver) for w in roots)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- relatorio
def describe(f: IntFile, stf=None, max_lines: int = 100000) -> list:
    """Arvore legivel. stf: funcao id(1-based) -> texto, opcional."""
    lines = [f"{f.name}: GUI V1.{f.version % 10}, {len(f.roots)} raiz(es), {f.count()} objetos"]
    for depth, w in f.walk():
        if len(lines) >= max_lines:
            lines.append("  ...")
            break
        x0, y0, x1, y1 = w.rect
        tex = [fr.texture for fr in w.fragments if fr.texture and not fr.texture.lower().startswith(("zz", "quickslot", "main-", "defaultinterface", "f3_green", "areamap"))]
        extra = ""
        if w.kind in (3, 4):
            txt = stf(w.text_id) if (stf and w.text_id) else ""
            extra = f" texto#{w.text_id}{(' ' + repr(txt)) if txt else ''} fonte '{w.font}' {w.font_size} cor {bytes(w.text_color).hex()} alinh {w.align}"
        if w.kind == 1 and w.sounds:
            extra += f" sons {'/'.join(s for s in w.sounds if s)}"
        if w.tip_texture or w.tip_text not in (-1, 0):
            extra += f" dica#{w.tip_text} {w.tip_texture}"
        vis = ""
        lines.append(f"{'  ' * (depth + 1)}{w.type_name} {w.name} [{x0},{y0} {x1 - x0}x{y1 - y0}] skin={w.skin}{vis}{(' img=' + ','.join(tex)) if tex else ''}{extra}")
    return lines
```

## tools/py/f3vb/inventory.py

```python
"""Inventário de uma pasta de jogo (tudo FORA dos .grp): extensões, tamanhos, hashes."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import os
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

NOTABLE = ("f3.exe", "f3.ini", "granny2.dll", "resource.rht")


def sha256_file(path: Path, block: int = 1 << 20) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as fh:
        while chunk := fh.read(block):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def inventory(root: str | os.PathLike, with_hash: bool = False) -> dict:
    root_path = Path(root)
    if not root_path.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"pasta não encontrada: {root_path}")
    files = []
    by_ext_count: Counter = Counter()
    by_ext_bytes: Counter = Counter()
    for dirpath, _dirs, names in os.walk(root_path):
        for name in names:
            p = Path(dirpath) / name
            size = p.stat().st_size
            ext = p.suffix.lower().lstrip(".") or "(sem extensão)"
            rel = p.relative_to(root_path).as_posix()
            entry = {"path": rel, "size": size, "ext": ext}
            if with_hash:
                entry["sha256"] = sha256_file(p)
            files.append(entry)
            by_ext_count[ext] += 1
            by_ext_bytes[ext] += size
    files.sort(key=lambda e: e["path"].lower())
    lower = {e["path"].lower(): e for e in files}
    notable = {n: next((e for k, e in lower.items() if k.split("/")[-1] == n), None)
               for n in NOTABLE}
    by_key: dict = {}
    for e in files:
        by_key.setdefault((e["path"].split("/")[-1].lower(), e["size"]), []).append(e["path"])
    duplicates = [v for v in by_key.values() if len(v) > 1]
    dup_bytes = sum(next(e["size"] for e in files if e["path"] == v[0]) * (len(v) - 1) for v in duplicates)
    return {
        "duplicates": duplicates,
        "duplicate_bytes": dup_bytes,
        "root": str(root_path),
        "total_files": len(files),
        "total_bytes": sum(e["size"] for e in files),
        "has_override_dir": any(p.lower().startswith("override/") for p in lower),
        "by_ext": {k: {"files": by_ext_count[k], "bytes": by_ext_bytes[k]}
                   for k in sorted(by_ext_count, key=lambda k: -by_ext_bytes[k])},
        "grp_files": [e for e in files if e["ext"] == "grp"],
        "notable": notable,
        "files": files,
    }
```

```python
"""Conhecimento de partida, extraído dos patterns do OpenJE (README, rht.pat, grp.pat).

Só nomes, ids e layouts (fatos), reescritos aqui. Os patterns não têm LICENSE visível:
não copiamos código deles. Tudo é HIPÓTESE até ser confirmado nos SEUS arquivos
(ver CLEANROOM.md e docs/specs/).
"""

# ResourceType do resource.rht: id -> nome (como nomeado nos patterns).
RESOURCE_TYPES = {
    100: "G3D_Model", 200: "TGA_Image", 300: "SMA_Script", 400: "TRE_Octree",
    500: "SKN_Skin", 600: "SKEL_Skeleton", 700: "GR2_Animation", 800: "INI_Config",
    900: "RLZ", 1000: "RTD", 1100: "WAV_Audio", 1200: "AMX", 1300: "MAP_Map",
    1400: "CRT_ENT_Critter", 1500: "VEG_Vfx", 1600: "INT_Interface", 1700: "RLE",
    1800: "ITM", 1900: "PSF", 2000: "GSF", 2100: "GLS", 2200: "SCO", 2300: "PCE",
    2400: "WEA_ENT_Weapon", 2500: "ARM_ENT_Armor", 2600: "DOR_ENT_Door",
    2700: "USE_ENT_Use", 2800: "SST", 2900: "STR", 3000: "ENC", 3100: "WMP",
    3200: "PRO", 3300: "SPL", 3400: "FNT", 3500: "AMO_ENT_Ammo", 3600: "CON_ENT",
    3700: "TOK_Tokens",
}

# Extensão provável por tipo. Os 13 primeiros nomes vêm do README dos patterns;
# os demais são palpite pelo nome do enum (INFERIDO).
RESOURCE_EXT = {
    100: "b3d", 200: "tga", 300: "sma", 400: "8", 500: "skn", 600: "skl",
    700: "gr2", 800: "ini", 900: "rlz", 1000: "rtd", 1100: "wav", 1200: "amx",
    1300: "map", 1400: "crt", 1500: "veg", 1600: "int", 1700: "rle", 1800: "itm",
    1900: "psf", 2000: "gsf", 2100: "gls", 2200: "sco", 2300: "pce", 2400: "wea",
    2500: "arm", 2600: "dor", 2700: "use", 2800: "sst", 2900: "str", 3000: "enc",
    3100: "wmp", 3200: "pro", 3300: "spl", 3400: "fnt", 3500: "amo", 3600: "con",
    3700: "tok",
}

# PackOffset do rht.pat: valor -> nome. DEPRECADO: na demo real os VALORES são deslocamentos na
# região de packs do .rht (onde ficam os nomes dos .grp: Tiles, Interface, Critters...), e os
# RÓTULOS deste dicionário (PSF, INT, RLE...) estão ERRADOS. Use RhtInfo.pack_label().
PACK_OFFSETS = {
    0: "PSF", 6: "INT", 16: "RLE", 25: "ITM", 32: "VEG", 42: "CRT", 50: "MAP",
    55: "WAV", 63: "AMX", 68: "RTD", 74: "RLZ", 81: "INI", 87: "SKL", 92: "GR2",
    97: "SKN", 102: "EIGHT", 107: "DLG", 112: "STR", 117: "SST", 122: "USE",
    127: "ARM", 132: "DOR", 137: "WEA", 142: "PCE",
}
PACK_INVALID = 0xFFFFFFFF

# Enquadramento de chunk: char[4] tag, u32 version, u32 size (inclui os 12 bytes).
CHUNK_HEADER_SIZE = 12

# Tags de chunk deduzidas dos NOMES dos patterns (não verificadas nos bytes).
CHUNK_TAGS = {
    "mapa": ["EMAP", "EME2", "EMEF", "EMEP", "EMFG", "EMNO", "EMNP", "EMSD",
             "EMTR", "EPTH", "ECAM", "2MWT"],
    "entidade": ["EEN2", "EEOV", "GENT", "GCRE", "GCHR", "GITM", "GIAR",
                 "GIAM", "GIWP", "GWAM", "GOBJ", "GDOR", "GCON"],
    # Genéricas: muito falso positivo; o filtro de plausibilidade ajuda.
    "tre": ["HEAD", "LGTD", "MATD", "VTXD", "TREE"],
}

MAGICS = {b"B3D ": "b3d (modelo)", b"8TRE": "8tre (geometria de mapa)"}

# Magic do Pawn/Small (hipótese para o tipo AMX): u16 no offset 4 do arquivo.
```
