```python
    def text(self, data: bytes, i: int) -> str:
        if not 0 <= i < self.count:
            raise StfError(f"id {i} fora de 0..{self.count - 1}")
        off, length, _ = self.entries[i]
        for width in (1, 2):                       # tenta length em bytes; se não couber, em unidades de 2 bytes
            raw = data[off:off + length * width]
            if len(raw) == length * width:
                break
        if len(raw) >= 2 and len(raw) % 2 == 0 and raw[1::2].count(0) >= len(raw) // 2 - 1 and b"\x00" in raw[1::2]:
            return raw.decode("utf-16-le", "replace").rstrip("\x00")
        return raw.decode("cp1252", "replace").rstrip("\x00")


    def text_id(self, data: bytes, text_id: int) -> str:
        """v19: id 1-based (como nos .int); "" para 0 ou fora da tabela."""
        if not 1 <= text_id <= self.count:
            return ""
        return self.text(data, text_id - 1)


def parse_stf(data: bytes) -> Stf:
    if len(data) < 12:
        raise StfError("arquivo menor que o cabeçalho (12 bytes)")
    magic = data[:8]
    count = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 8)[0]
    if 12 + ENTRY.size * count > len(data):
        raise StfError(f"{count} entradas não cabem no arquivo ({len(data)} bytes)")
    entries = [ENTRY.unpack_from(data, 12 + ENTRY.size * i) for i in range(count)]
    return Stf(magic, count, entries)
```

## tools/py/f3vb/tre.py

```python
"""Leitor de `.8tre` (recurso tipo 400 "TRE_Octree"): geometria 3D estatica de um mapa, organizada em octree.

Formato (MEDIDO em 38 arquivos reais, 106 MB; todos tokenizam ate o ultimo byte). Chunks = tag[4] + u32 tamanho do PAYLOAD (cabecalho de 8 bytes, aninhados):
  8TRE (raiz; o tamanho cobre o arquivo menos 8 menos 4 x numero de folhas)
    HEAD  4 x u32 (2, ?, ?, ?)                            versao 2; o resto sem nome
    LGTD  INFO{u32 N}  + N x LGTR (64 B: tipo, flags, cor, posicao, direcao, 2 f32, cor 2)   luzes (opcional)
    LVLD  INFO(16 B: u32 largura, u32 altura, f32, f32 = 84, 84, 0.5, 0.5 no MarkTest) + LVL0..: grade de niveis (NAO decodificada)
    MATD  INFO{u32 N} + N x MATR (196 B: u32, nome[80], RGBA, mistura[16], superficie[16], floats, flags)
    TXTD  u32, u32 + TXTR{nome\\0}...                      nomes de textura (.tga) e de lightmap (.ctx)
    VTXD  u32 N blocos + N x VTXB{u32 nv, "XYZ " (3 f32), "NRML" (3 f32), "DIFU" (RGBA8), "TXUV" (2 f32), "LMUV" (2 f32)} (cada fluxo: tag[4] + u32 bytes)
    TREE  sequencia PLANA de NODE e LEAF, na ordem de busca em profundidade (a hierarquia nao e necessaria para desenhar):
      NODE/LEAF = INFO + [IDXD{IDXS, FLGS}] (+ bytes extras so nas folhas)
        INFO NODE (64 B): caixa min/max (6 f32), u32 0, u32 mascara/contagem, 4 x u32 (ENDERECOS de memoria do jogo, lixo), zeros
        INFO LEAF (32 B): caixa min/max (6 f32), u32 BLOCO de vertices, u32 1
        IDXS: 3 x u32 (lixo/enderecos) + u16 indices; triangulos = floor(n / 3)
      O tamanho declarado de cada LEAF vem 4 bytes MENOR que o conteudo real (os 4 bytes finais pertencem a folha): a proxima ficha
      comeca em inicio + 8 + declarado + 4. Para NODE o tamanho e exato.
IDXS e um fluxo de LOTES (ver o bloco "fluxo de indices em lotes" mais abaixo): cada lote tem material, pagina de lightmap e textura difusa.
Indices: u16. Os 2 bits altos de alguns u16 NAO sao flags de indice: sao CABECALHOS DE LOTE (0x8000 = material, 0x4000 = pagina de lightmap) no meio do fluxo
(gramatica no bloco "fluxo de indices em lotes" abaixo; medido em 38 arquivos: 0 nos que nao fecham, 0 indices fora da caixa da folha). `triangles()` ainda aplica a mascara
0x3FFF como rede de seguranca quando um indice cai fora do bloco ou da caixa da folha. NAO decifrado: o significado de FLGS (so a contagem: 1 byte por triangulo), os bytes
extras das folhas, LVL0.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import struct
from dataclasses import dataclass, field


class TreError(ValueError):
    pass


def _is_tag(b: bytes) -> bool:
    return len(b) == 4 and all(65 <= c <= 90 or 48 <= c <= 57 or c == 95 for c in b)


def _chunks(d: bytes, s: int, e: int):
    out, p = [], s
    while p < e:
        if p + 8 > e or not _is_tag(d[p:p + 4]):
            raise TreError(f"chunk invalido em {p}")
        n = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, p + 4)[0]
        if p + 8 + n > e:
            raise TreError(f"chunk {d[p:p + 4]!r} em {p} ultrapassa o pai")
        out.append((d[p:p + 4].decode(), p + 8, n))
        p += 8 + n
    return out


@dataclass
class VtxBlock:
    count: int
    xyz: tuple          # 3 * count floats
    normals: tuple      # 3 * count floats (vazio se ausente)
    colors: bytes       # 4 * count (RGBA) ou b""
    uv: tuple           # 2 * count
    lightmap_uv: tuple  # 2 * count


@dataclass
class TriBatch:
    material: int       # indice em MATD (0 = lote inicial, sem cabecalho)
    page: int           # pagina de lightmap, 1-based na lista ".ctx" (0 = nenhuma)
    texture: int        # textura difusa, 1-based na lista ".tga" (0 = nenhuma)
    indices: tuple      # u16 brutos, multiplos de 3


@dataclass
class TreNode:
    kind: str           # "NODE" | "LEAF"
    bbox: tuple         # (xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax)
    block: int
    indices: tuple      # u16 brutos (sem os 12 bytes de cabecalho)
    flags: bytes
    start: int
    batches: list = field(default_factory=list)     # TriBatch (preenchido por read_tre)
    parsed: bool = True                              # False: o fluxo de indices nao fechou; so os lotes validos foram guardados
    head: tuple = ()                                 # v19: os 6 u16 dos 12 bytes iniciais do IDXS = cabecalho do 1o grupo/pagina/sublote
    full_grammar: bool = False                       # v19: True se o fluxo inteiro (cabecalho + indices) fechou pela gramatica, sem lote implicito


@dataclass
class TreFile:
    head: tuple = ()
    lights: list = field(default_factory=list)
    level_info: tuple = ()
    materials: list = field(default_factory=list)
    textures: list = field(default_factory=list)
    blocks: list = field(default_factory=list)
    nodes: list = field(default_factory=list)
    total_bytes: int = 0

    def triangles_ex(self, eps: float = 0.6):
        """Lista de (bloco, (i0, i1, i2), material, pagina, textura) com os indices corrigidos. Devolve (lista, estatisticas)."""
        stats = {"indices": 0, "outside_bbox": 0, "masked": 0, "bad": 0, "unparsed_nodes": 0, "dropped_flagged": 0}
        tris = []
        for nd in self.nodes:
            if not nd.indices:
                continue
            if not nd.parsed:
                stats["unparsed_nodes"] += 1
            if nd.block >= len(self.blocks):
                stats["bad"] += len(nd.indices)
                continue
            blk = self.blocks[nd.block]
            xyz, n = blk.xyz, blk.count
            bb = nd.bbox
            for ba in nd.batches:
                u = ba.indices
                for i in range(0, len(u) - 2, 3):
                    t = []
                    for x in u[i:i + 3]:
                        pick = None
                        for c in (x, x & 0x3FFF, x & 0x7FFF, x & 0xBFFF):
                            if c < n:
                                px, py, pz = xyz[3 * c:3 * c + 3]
                                if bb[0] - eps <= px <= bb[3] + eps and bb[1] - eps <= py <= bb[4] + eps and bb[2] - eps <= pz <= bb[5] + eps:
                                    pick = c
                                    break
                        stats["indices"] += 1
                        if pick is None:
                            stats["outside_bbox"] += 1
                            pick = x if x < n else (x & 0x3FFF)
                            if pick >= n:
                                stats["bad"] += 1
                                pick = 0
                        elif pick != x:
                            stats["masked"] += 1
                        t.append(pick)
                    tris.append((nd.block, tuple(t), ba.material, ba.page, ba.texture))
        return tris, stats

    def triangles(self, eps: float = 0.6):
        """Compatibilidade: lista de (bloco, (i0, i1, i2)) e estatisticas."""
        tris, stats = self.triangles_ex(eps)
        return [(b, t) for b, t, _m, _p, _k in tris], stats

    def batch_stats(self) -> dict:
        """Resumo dos lotes: triangulos por material / pagina de lightmap / textura difusa, nos com indices e nos que nao fecharam."""
        mats: dict = {}
        pages: dict = {}
        texs: dict = {}
        nodes = unparsed = full = 0
        for nd in self.nodes:
            if not nd.indices:
                continue
            nodes += 1
            full += 1 if nd.full_grammar else 0
            if not nd.parsed:
                unparsed += 1
            for ba in nd.batches:
                nt = len(ba.indices) // 3
                mats[ba.material] = mats.get(ba.material, 0) + nt
                pages[ba.page] = pages.get(ba.page, 0) + nt
                texs[ba.texture] = texs.get(ba.texture, 0) + nt
        return {"materials": mats, "pages": pages, "textures": texs, "nodes": nodes, "unparsed": unparsed, "full_grammar": full}

    def bounds(self):
        xs = [x for b in self.blocks for x in b.xyz[0::3]]
        ys = [x for b in self.blocks for x in b.xyz[1::3]]
        zs = [x for b in self.blocks for x in b.xyz[2::3]]
        if not xs:
            return None
        return (min(xs), min(ys), min(zs), max(xs), max(ys), max(zs))


def _cstr(b: bytes) -> str:
    return b.split(b"\0", 1)[0].decode("latin-1")


def _read_node(d: bytes, p: int) -> tuple:
    tag = d[p:p + 4].decode("latin-1")
    declared = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, p + 4)[0]
    q = p + 8
    if d[q:q + 4] != b"INFO":
        raise TreError(f"{tag} em {p} sem INFO")
    n = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, q + 4)[0]
    info = d[q + 8:q + 8 + n]
    q += 8 + n
    idx, flg, head = (), b"", ()
    if d[q:q + 4] == b"IDXD":
        n = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, q + 4)[0]
        end = q + 8 + n
        r = q + 8
        if d[r:r + 4] != b"IDXS":
            raise TreError(f"IDXD em {q} sem IDXS")
        m = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, r + 4)[0]
        body = d[r + 8:r + 8 + m]
        if len(body) < 12 or r + 8 + m > end:
            raise TreError(f"IDXS em {r} invalido")
        idx = struct.unpack_from("<%dH" % ((len(body) - 12) // 2), body, 12)
        head = struct.unpack_from("<6H", body, 0)
        r += 8 + m
        if r < end and d[r:r + 4] == b"FLGS":
            m = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, r + 4)[0]
            flg = d[r + 8:r + 8 + m]
        q = end
    if not flg and d[q:q + 4] == b"FLGS":
        m = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, q + 4)[0]
        flg = d[q + 8:q + 8 + m]
    end = p + 8 + declared + (4 if tag == "LEAF" else 0)
    if len(info) < 32:
        raise TreError(f"INFO de {tag} em {p} pequeno ({len(info)})")
    bbox = struct.unpack_from("<6f", info, 0)
    block = struct.unpack_from("<I", info, 24)[0]
    return TreNode(tag, bbox, block, idx, flg, p, head=head), end


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- fluxo de indices em lotes
# IDXS = [lote inicial sem cabecalho] [grupo]*, alinhado a 4 bytes (1 u16 de enchimento = 0 quando a posicao fica impar):
#   grupo   = [0x8000|material][A] pagina+   |   pagina+          (A = total de u16 das paginas seguintes)
#   pagina  = [0x4000|pagina][B] sublote+     (B = total de u16 dos sublotes, com enchimento)
#   sublote = [k][C] indices[C]  (+1 de enchimento se C impar)  k = textura difusa (1-based), C multiplo de 3
# Os 2 bits altos dos cabecalhos colidem com indices de vertice de blocos grandes (> 16383); por isso cada cabecalho e validado por
# intervalo (material < N materiais, pagina <= N .ctx, k <= N .tga), pelo fechamento exato das contagens e pelo total = 3 x len(FLGS).


class _Lim:
    """Limites de validacao dos cabecalhos. strict=True exige que os u16 de enchimento (alinhamento a 4 bytes) sejam 0; split_batches tenta primeiro o modo
    estrito e so cai para o frouxo se nada fechar (o frouxo era o comportamento do v16 inicial, validado nos 38 arquivos reais)."""

    def __init__(self, mats, ctx, tga):
        self.mats, self.ctx, self.tga = max(mats, 1), ctx, tga
        self.strict = False


def _sub_batches(u, q, total, lim):
    end, out = q + total, []
    while q < end:
        if q + 2 > end:
            return None
        k, c = u[q], u[q + 1]
        if (k & 0xC000) or (c & 0xC000) or c % 3 or k > lim.tga or q + 2 + c > end:
            return None
        if lim.strict and (c & 1) and (q + 2 + c >= end or u[q + 2 + c] != 0):
            return None
        out.append((k, tuple(u[q + 2:q + 2 + c])))
        q += 2 + c + (c & 1)
    return out if q == end else None


def _page_group(u, p, lim):
    if p + 2 > len(u):
        return None
    a, b = u[p], u[p + 1]
    if (a & 0xC000) != 0x4000 or (b & 0xC000) or (a & 0x3FFF) > lim.ctx or p + 2 + b > len(u):
        return None
    subs = _sub_batches(u, p + 2, b, lim)
    return None if subs is None else (a & 0x3FFF, b, subs)


def _mat_hdr(u, p, lim):
    if p + 2 > len(u):
        return None
    a, b = u[p], u[p + 1]
    if (a & 0xC000) != 0x8000 or (b & 0xC000) or (a & 0x3FFF) >= lim.mats or _page_group(u, p + 2, lim) is None:
        return None
    return a & 0x3FFF


def _parse_rest(u, p, lim, partial=None):
    """Le grupos/paginas/sublotes de p ate o fim. Devolve a lista de TriBatch ou None se nao fechar."""
    n, out, mat, page = len(u), [], 0, 0
    while n - p >= 3:
        m = _mat_hdr(u, p, lim)
        if m is not None:
            mat, p = m, p + 2
        g = _page_group(u, p, lim)
        if g is not None:
            page, b, subs = g
            out.extend(TriBatch(mat, page, k, idx) for k, idx in subs)
            p += 2 + b
        else:                                   # sublote sem cabecalho de pagina (pagina e material herdados)
            if p + 2 > n:
                break
            k, c = u[p], u[p + 1]
            if (k & 0xC000) or (c & 0xC000) or c % 3 or k > lim.tga or p + 2 + c > n:
                if partial is not None:
                    partial.extend(out)
                return None
            if lim.strict and (c & 1) and (p + 2 + c >= n or u[p + 2 + c] != 0):
                if partial is not None:
                    partial.extend(out)
                return None
            out.append(TriBatch(mat, page, k, tuple(u[p + 2:p + 2 + c])))
            p += 2 + c + (c & 1)
        if p & 1:
            if lim.strict and (p >= n or u[p] != 0):
                if partial is not None:
                    partial.extend(out)
                return None
            p += 1
    if partial is not None:
        partial.extend(out)
    return out if n - p <= 1 else None


def split_full(head, u, tri_count, lim):
    """v19: os 12 bytes iniciais do IDXS (que o v15-v18 tratava como "3 x u32 de lixo") sao 6 u16 = o cabecalho do PRIMEIRO lote:
    [0x8000|material][A] [0x4000|pagina][B] [k][C]. Medido em Mainmenu e 03_Tutorial_Junktown: C == tamanho do "lote inicial" do v16 em 100% dos nos.
    Aqui o fluxo inteiro (cabecalho + indices) e lido pela gramatica de grupos desde a posicao 0, sem lote implicito.
    Devolve a lista de TriBatch, ou None se nao fechar (o chamador cai no split_batches antigo)."""
    if len(head) != 6 or (head[0] & 0xC000) != 0x8000:
        return None
    full = tuple(head) + tuple(u)
    try:
        for strict in (True, False):
            lim.strict = strict
            out = _parse_rest(full, 0, lim)
            if out is None:
                continue
            if tri_count and sum(len(b.indices) for b in out) != 3 * tri_count:
                continue
            return out
    finally:
        lim.strict = False
    return None


def split_batches(u, tri_count, lim):
    """Divide o fluxo de indices de um no em lotes. Devolve (lista de TriBatch, ok). tri_count = len(FLGS) (0 se nao ha)."""
    n = len(u)
    total_idx = 3 * tri_count
    try:
        for strict in (True, False):                       # 1o: enchimento exigido = 0 (evita fechamentos falsos); 2o: frouxo (v16 inicial)
            lim.strict = strict
            for q in range(0, n + 1, 2):
                # lote inicial: L0 indices (multiplo de 3) + 1 de enchimento se L0 impar
                l0 = q if q % 3 == 0 else (q - 1 if (q - 1) % 3 == 0 and (q - 1) % 2 == 1 else None)
                if l0 is None:
                    continue
                if strict and l0 != q and u[q - 1] != 0:
                    continue
                if q < n and not ((u[q] & 0xC000) in (0x4000, 0x8000) or (q + 1 < n and (u[q] & 0xC000) == 0 and u[q] <= lim.tga and u[q + 1] % 3 == 0 and u[q + 1] > 0)):
                    continue
                rest = _parse_rest(u, q, lim)
                if rest is None:
                    continue
                got = sum(len(b.indices) for b in rest)
                if tri_count and l0 + got != total_idx:
                    continue
                head = [TriBatch(0, 0, 0, tuple(u[:l0]))] if l0 else []
                return head + rest, True
    finally:
        lim.strict = False
    # nao fechou: guarda o que da para aproveitar (o lote inicial ate o primeiro cabecalho plausivel)
    first = next((q for q in range(0, n, 2) if (u[q] & 0xC000) in (0x4000, 0x8000) and (_mat_hdr(u, q, lim) is not None or _page_group(u, q, lim) is not None)), n)
    first -= first % 3
    partial: list = []
    _parse_rest(u, first + (first & 1) + (0 if first % 2 == 0 else 0), lim, partial)
    return ([TriBatch(0, 0, 0, tuple(u[:first]))] if first else []) + partial, False


def read_tre(data: bytes) -> TreFile:
    if len(data) < 16 or data[:4] != b"8TRE":
        raise TreError("nao e um 8TRE")
    n = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 4)[0]
    if 8 + n > len(data):
        raise TreError("tamanho da raiz ultrapassa o arquivo")
    t = TreFile(total_bytes=len(data))
    top = {tag: (p, sz) for tag, p, sz in _chunks(data, 8, 8 + n)}
    for need in ("HEAD", "VTXD", "TREE"):
        if need not in top:
            raise TreError(f"falta o chunk {need}")
    p, sz = top["HEAD"]
    t.head = struct.unpack_from("<4I", data, p) if sz >= 16 else ()
    if "LGTD" in top:
        p, sz = top["LGTD"]
        for tag, q, m in _chunks(data, p, p + sz):
            if tag == "LGTR" and m >= 64:
                f = struct.unpack_from("<2I3f3f3f2f3f", data, q)
                t.lights.append({"type": f[0], "flags": f[1], "color": list(f[2:5]), "pos": list(f[5:8]), "dir": list(f[8:11]), "params": list(f[11:13]), "color2": list(f[13:16])})
    if "LVLD" in top:
        p, sz = top["LVLD"]
        for tag, q, m in _chunks(data, p, p + sz):
            if tag == "INFO" and m >= 16:
                t.level_info = struct.unpack_from("<2I2f", data, q)
                break
    if "MATD" in top:
        p, sz = top["MATD"]
        for tag, q, m in _chunks(data, p, p + sz):
            if tag == "MATR" and m >= 196:
                b = data[q:q + m]
                t.materials.append({"id": struct.unpack_from("<I", b, 0)[0], "name": _cstr(b[4:84]), "color": list(b[84:88]), "blend": _cstr(b[88:104]),
                                    "surface": _cstr(b[104:120]), "flags": struct.unpack_from("<I", b, m - 4)[0]})
    if "TXTD" in top:
        p, sz = top["TXTD"]
        for tag, q, m in _chunks(data, p + 8, p + sz):
            if tag == "TXTR":
                t.textures.append(_cstr(data[q:q + m]))
    p, sz = top["VTXD"]
    nb = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, p)[0]
    for tag, q, m in _chunks(data, p + 4, p + sz):
        if tag != "VTXB":
            continue
        cnt = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, q)[0]
        pos, streams = q + 4, {}
        while pos + 8 <= q + m:
            tok = data[pos:pos + 4].decode("latin-1")
            ln = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, pos + 4)[0]
            if pos + 8 + ln > q + m:
                raise TreError(f"fluxo {tok} ultrapassa o VTXB")
            streams[tok] = (pos + 8, ln)
            pos += 8 + ln
        if "XYZ " not in streams or streams["XYZ "][1] != 12 * cnt:
            raise TreError("VTXB sem XYZ coerente")

        def f32(tok, per):
            if tok not in streams or streams[tok][1] != 4 * per * cnt:
                return ()
            return struct.unpack_from("<%df" % (per * cnt), data, streams[tok][0])
        col = data[streams["DIFU"][0]:streams["DIFU"][0] + 4 * cnt] if "DIFU" in streams and streams["DIFU"][1] == 4 * cnt else b""
        t.blocks.append(VtxBlock(cnt, f32("XYZ ", 3), f32("NRML", 3), col, f32("TXUV", 2), f32("LMUV", 2)))
    if len(t.blocks) != nb:
        raise TreError(f"VTXD declara {nb} blocos, achei {len(t.blocks)}")
    p, sz = top["TREE"]
    q = p
    while q < len(data):
        if data[q:q + 4] not in (b"NODE", b"LEAF"):
            raise TreError(f"ficha inesperada em {q}: {data[q:q + 6]!r}")
        nd, q = _read_node(data, q)
        t.nodes.append(nd)
    if q != len(data):
        raise TreError(f"arvore termina em {q}, arquivo tem {len(data)}")
    lim = _Lim(len(t.materials), sum(1 for x in t.textures if x.lower().endswith(".ctx")), sum(1 for x in t.textures if x.lower().endswith(".tga")))
    for nd in t.nodes:
        if nd.indices:
            full = split_full(nd.head, nd.indices, len(nd.flags), lim)
            if full is not None:
                nd.batches, nd.parsed, nd.full_grammar = full, True, True
            else:
                nd.batches, nd.parsed = split_batches(nd.indices, len(nd.flags), lim)
    return t
```

## tools/py/f3vb/uiinfo.py

```python
"""Interface do jogo: inventario do pack Interface, arvores dos `.int` (layouts de tela, decodificados no v19: intfile.py) e imagens da UI em .f3tex.

v18: so sondava os `.int` (strings e bytes). v19: cada `.int` e lido pela gramatica completa (docs/specs/int.md) e o relatorio mostra a arvore de widgets
com retangulos, skins, imagens, fontes e textos (do .stf, se for achado). Se um `.int` nao fechar, a sonda antiga aparece no lugar.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import struct
from pathlib import Path

from .chunk import ChunkError, read_chunk
from .imagecodec import ImageError, decode_bmp, decode_tga

INT_TYPE = "INT_Interface"
IMAGE_TYPES = ("TGA_Image",)
MAX_DEPTH = 5


def _strings(data: bytes, min_len: int = 3, limit: int = 40) -> list:
    """Strings ASCII (>= min_len) e UTF-16LE plausiveis, na ordem em que aparecem."""
    out = []
    for m in re.finditer(rb"[\x20-\x7e]{%d,}" % min_len, data):
        out.append((m.start(), m.group().decode("ascii")))
    for m in re.finditer(rb"(?:[\x20-\x7e]\x00){%d,}" % min_len, data):
        out.append((m.start(), m.group().decode("utf-16le")))
    out.sort()
    return out[:limit]


def _tree(data: bytes, start: int, end: int, depth: int, lines: list) -> bool:
    """Tenta ler [start, end) como chunks consecutivos que fecham exatamente. Descreve cada chunk e desce quando o payload tambem e um container."""
    pos = start
    parsed = []
    while pos < end:
        try:
            c = read_chunk(data, pos, end)
        except ChunkError:
            return False
        parsed.append(c)
        pos += c.size
    if pos != end or not parsed:
        return False
    for c in parsed:
        ind = "  " * depth
        lines.append(f"{ind}{c.tag} v{c.version} tamanho {c.size} @{c.offset}")
        if depth < MAX_DEPTH and c.payload_size >= 12:
            sub: list = []
            if _tree(data, c.payload_offset, c.offset + c.size, depth + 1, sub):
                lines.extend(sub)
                continue
        pay = data[c.payload_offset:c.offset + c.size]
        lines.append(f"{ind}  payload {len(pay)} bytes: {pay[:24].hex(' ')}{' ...' if len(pay) > 24 else ''}")
    return True


def probe_int(data: bytes) -> list:
    lines = [f"tamanho {len(data)} bytes; primeiros 32 bytes: {data[:32].hex(' ')}"]
    tree: list = []
    if _tree(data, 0, len(data), 0, tree):
        lines.append("enquadramento tag/versao/tamanho: FECHA ate o ultimo byte")
        lines.extend(tree)
    else:
        lines.append("enquadramento tag/versao/tamanho: NAO fecha (formato diferente); estrutura abaixo e so de strings e bytes")
    st = _strings(data)
    if st:
        lines.append("strings (offset: texto): " + " | ".join(f"{o}: {t}" for o, t in st[:30]))
    return lines


def ui_report(ix, stf_lookup=None) -> str:
    """Relatorio dos recursos de interface do RETAIL. stf_lookup: funcao id 1-based -> texto (opcional)."""
    from .intfile import IntError, describe, read_int
    rows = [(pack, number, type_name, name) for t, ents in ix.entries.items() for (name, pack, number) in ents for type_name in (t,) if pack.lower() == "interface"]
    by_type: dict = {}
    for pack, number, type_name, name in rows:
        by_type.setdefault(type_name, []).append((name, pack, number))
    out = ["=== INTERFACE (pack Interface do RETAIL) ===", f"recursos: {len(rows)}"]
    for t, ents in sorted(by_type.items()):
        out.append(f"  {t}: {len(ents)}")
    for name, pack, number in sorted(by_type.get(INT_TYPE, [])):
        data = ix.read(pack, number)
        out.append("")
        out.append(f"--- {INT_TYPE} {name} ({len(data)} bytes) ---")
        try:
            out.extend("  " + ln for ln in describe(read_int(data), stf_lookup))
        except IntError as exc:
            out.append(f"  NAO DECODIFICOU ({exc}); sonda do v18:")
            out.extend("  " + ln for ln in probe_int(data))
    fnt = sorted(by_type.get("FNT", []))
    for name, pack, number in fnt[:10]:
        data = ix.read(pack, number)
        out.append("")
        out.append(f"--- FNT {name} ({len(data)} bytes): {data[:32].hex(' ')} ---")
    names = sorted(n for n, _p, _n in by_type.get("TGA_Image", []))
    out.append("")
    out.append(f"imagens (TGA_Image) da interface: {len(names)}; primeiras: {', '.join(names[:30])}")
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"


def export_ui_images(ix, conv: Path, overwrite: bool = False) -> tuple:
    """Imagens do pack Interface (TGA e BMP) -> CONVERTED/ui/<nome>.f3tex. Devolve (convertidas, falhas)."""
    from .extractor import encode_f3tex, safe_name
    udir = conv / "ui"
    n = 0
    fails: list = []
    for t in IMAGE_TYPES:
        for name, pack, number in sorted(ix.entries.get(t, [])):
            if pack.lower() != "interface":
                continue
            dest = udir / f"{safe_name(name)}.f3tex"
            if dest.exists() and not overwrite:
                n += 1
                continue
            data = ix.read(pack, number)
            try:
                w, h, rgba = decode_bmp(data) if data[:2] == b"BM" else decode_tga(data)
                udir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                dest.write_bytes(encode_f3tex(w, h, rgba))
                n += 1
            except (ImageError, ValueError, struct.error) as exc:
                fails.append(f"{name}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
    return n, fails
```

## tools/py/f3vb_extractor_gui.pyw

```python
"""F3VB Extractor: interface simples para extrair TODOS os arquivos dos .grp da demo (tamanho real).

Como usar: dê dois cliques neste arquivo (ou rode `py -3 f3vb_extractor_gui.pyw`), escolha a pasta da demo
(onde ficam os .grp e o resource.rht), escolha a pasta de destino e clique em "Extrair".
Requer apenas o Python do Windows (tkinter já vem junto). O conteúdo extraído pertence ao jogo: não publique.
"""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))

try:
    import tkinter as tk
    from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk
except Exception:                                    # tkinter ausente
    print("tkinter não encontrado. Reinstale o Python marcando 'tcl/tk and IDLE', ou use a linha de comando:\n"
          "  py -3 -m f3vb extract-all PASTA_DA_DEMO PASTA_DESTINO")
    raise SystemExit(1)

from f3vb.extractor import ExtractJob, ExtractOptions, fmt_bytes, plan
from f3vb.layout import AssetsLayout, default_assets_dir

CONFIG = Path.home() / ".f3vb_extractor.json"


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("F3VB Extractor — demo Van Buren")
        self.geometry("820x640")
        self.minsize(720, 560)
        self.job = None
        self.cfg = self._load_cfg()
        self.v_game = tk.StringVar(value=self.cfg.get("game", ""))
        self.v_out = tk.StringVar(value=self.cfg.get("assets", str(default_assets_dir())))
        self.v_raw = tk.BooleanVar(value=self.cfg.get("raw", True))
        self.v_png = tk.BooleanVar(value=self.cfg.get("png", True))
        self.v_glb = tk.BooleanVar(value=self.cfg.get("glb", False))
        self.v_f3m = tk.BooleanVar(value=self.cfg.get("f3m", True))
        self.v_anims = tk.IntVar(value=self.cfg.get("anims", 8))
        self._build()
        self.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self._close)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- interface
    def _build(self):
        pad = {"padx": 8, "pady": 4}
        f = ttk.LabelFrame(self, text="1) Pasta da demo (com os .grp e o resource.rht)")
        f.pack(fill="x", **pad)
        ttk.Entry(f, textvariable=self.v_game).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=6, pady=6)
        ttk.Button(f, text="Procurar...", command=lambda: self._pick(self.v_game)).pack(side="left", padx=6)

        f = ttk.LabelFrame(self, text="2) Pasta original_assets (RETAIL = originais extraídos, CONVERTED = convertidos)")
        f.pack(fill="x", **pad)
        ttk.Entry(f, textvariable=self.v_out).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=6, pady=6)
        ttk.Button(f, text="Procurar...", command=lambda: self._pick(self.v_out)).pack(side="left", padx=6)

        f = ttk.LabelFrame(self, text="3) O que extrair")
        f.pack(fill="x", **pad)
        ttk.Checkbutton(f, text="Extrair os originais do jogo para RETAIL (desmarque para só reconverter a partir do RETAIL já extraído)", variable=self.v_raw).pack(anchor="w", padx=6)
        ttk.Checkbutton(f, text="Texturas convertidas para PNG", variable=self.v_png).pack(anchor="w", padx=6)
        ttk.Checkbutton(f, text="Modelos para o VISUALIZADOR F3VB (.f3m) + esqueletos com animações", variable=self.v_f3m).pack(anchor="w", padx=6)
        ttk.Checkbutton(f, text="Modelos para o Blender (.glb)", variable=self.v_glb).pack(anchor="w", padx=6)
        row = ttk.Frame(f)
        row.pack(anchor="w", padx=6, pady=2)
        ttk.Label(row, text="Animações por modelo (0 = todas):").pack(side="left")
        ttk.Spinbox(row, from_=0, to=999, width=5, textvariable=self.v_anims).pack(side="left", padx=6)

        bar = ttk.Frame(self)
        bar.pack(fill="x", **pad)
        self.b_plan = ttk.Button(bar, text="Analisar (tamanho e espaço)", command=self.on_plan)
        self.b_plan.pack(side="left", padx=4)
        self.b_go = ttk.Button(bar, text="EXTRAIR", command=self.on_extract)
        self.b_go.pack(side="left", padx=4)
        self.b_cancel = ttk.Button(bar, text="Cancelar", command=self.on_cancel, state="disabled")
        self.b_cancel.pack(side="left", padx=4)
        ttk.Button(bar, text="Abrir pasta de destino", command=self.on_open_out).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        ttk.Button(bar, text="Abrir visualizador", command=self.on_viewer).pack(side="left", padx=4)

        self.progress = ttk.Progressbar(self, mode="determinate")
        self.progress.pack(fill="x", **pad)
        self.lbl = ttk.Label(self, text="Pronto.")
        self.lbl.pack(anchor="w", padx=10)
        box = ttk.Frame(self)
        box.pack(fill="both", expand=True, **pad)
        self.log = tk.Text(box, height=14, wrap="word", state="disabled")
        sb = ttk.Scrollbar(box, command=self.log.yview)
        self.log.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set)
        self.log.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
        sb.pack(side="left", fill="y")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- utilidades
    def _pick(self, var):
        d = filedialog.askdirectory(initialdir=var.get() or str(Path.home()), title="Escolha a pasta")
        if d:
            var.set(d)

    def _say(self, text):
        self.log.configure(state="normal")
        self.log.insert("end", text + "\n")
        self.log.see("end")
        self.log.configure(state="disabled")

    def _opts(self):
        try:
            anims = max(0, int(self.v_anims.get()))
        except (ValueError, tk.TclError):
            anims = 8
        return ExtractOptions(raw=self.v_raw.get(), png=self.v_png.get(), glb=self.v_glb.get(), f3m=self.v_f3m.get(),
                              anims_per_model=anims)

    def _validate(self):
        if not self.v_raw.get():                       # só reconverter: não precisa da pasta do jogo
            out = self.v_out.get().strip()
            if not out or not AssetsLayout(out).index_csv.exists():
                messagebox.showerror("Destino", "Não há RETAIL/index.csv nessa pasta. Marque a extração dos originais uma vez.")
                return None
            return Path(self.v_game.get().strip() or "."), Path(out)
        game = Path(self.v_game.get().strip())
        if not game.is_dir():
            messagebox.showerror("Pasta da demo", "Escolha a pasta da demo (a que tem os .grp e o resource.rht).")
            return None
        if not next(game.rglob("resource.rht"), None):
            messagebox.showerror("Pasta da demo", "Não encontrei o resource.rht dentro dessa pasta.")
            return None
        out = self.v_out.get().strip()
        if not out:
            messagebox.showerror("Destino", "Escolha a pasta de destino.")
            return None
        return game, Path(out)

    def _load_cfg(self):
        try:
            return json.loads(CONFIG.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            return {}

    def _save_cfg(self):
        try:
            CONFIG.write_text(json.dumps({"game": self.v_game.get(), "assets": self.v_out.get(), "raw": self.v_raw.get(),
                                          "png": self.v_png.get(), "glb": self.v_glb.get(), "f3m": self.v_f3m.get(),
                                          "anims": self.v_anims.get()}), encoding="utf-8")
        except Exception:
            pass

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- ações
    def on_plan(self):
        if not self.v_raw.get():
            self._say("Sem extração dos originais: só vou reconverter a partir do RETAIL já extraído (nada a planejar).")
            return
        v = self._validate()
        if not v:
            return
        game, out = v
        self._say("Analisando...")
        self.update_idletasks()
        try:
            p = plan(game)
            import shutil
            probe = out if out.exists() else out.parent if out.parent.exists() else Path.home()
            free = shutil.disk_usage(probe).free
            need = p["bytes"] * (1 + (0.6 if self.v_png.get() else 0) + (0.2 if (self.v_f3m.get() or self.v_glb.get()) else 0))
            self._say(f"{p['files']} arquivos, {fmt_bytes(p['bytes'])} (tamanho real). Estimativa com conversões: {fmt_bytes(need)}.")
            self._say(f"Espaço livre no destino: {fmt_bytes(free)}" + ("  >>> ESPAÇO INSUFICIENTE <<<" if free < need * 1.1 else "  (ok)"))
            top = sorted(p["by_type"].items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1][1])[:8]
            self._say("Maiores tipos: " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v[0]}x {fmt_bytes(v[1])}" for k, v in top))
        except Exception:
            self._say("ERRO ao analisar:\n" + traceback.format_exc())

    def on_extract(self):
        v = self._validate()
        if not v or (self.job and self.job.alive()):
            return
        game, out = v
        opts = self._opts()
        if not (opts.raw or opts.png or opts.glb or opts.f3m):
            messagebox.showinfo("Nada a fazer", "Marque pelo menos uma opção em '3) O que extrair'.")
            return
        self._save_cfg()
        self._say(f"Extraindo de {game} para {out} ...")
        self.b_go.configure(state="disabled")
        self.b_cancel.configure(state="normal")
        self.progress.configure(value=0, maximum=100)
        self.job = ExtractJob(game, out, opts)
        self.job.start()
        self.after(100, self._poll)

    def on_cancel(self):
        if self.job:
            self.job.cancel()
            self._say("Cancelando (termina o arquivo atual)...")

    def _poll(self):
        last = None
        try:
            while True:
                m = self.job.q.get_nowait()
                if m[0] == "progress":
                    last = m
                elif m[0] == "done":
                    self._finish()
                    return
        except Exception:
            pass
        if last:
            _, d, t, msg = last
            self.progress.configure(maximum=max(t, 1), value=d)
            self.lbl.configure(text=f"{d}/{t}  {msg}")
        self.after(100, self._poll)

    def _finish(self):
        self.b_go.configure(state="normal")
        self.b_cancel.configure(state="disabled")
        if self.job.error:
            self._say("ERRO: " + self.job.error)
            return
        r = self.job.result
        self.progress.configure(value=self.progress.cget("maximum"))
        self._say(f"{'CANCELADO' if r['cancelled'] else 'CONCLUÍDO'} em {r['seconds']} s: {r['written']} arquivos ({fmt_bytes(r['bytes'])}), "
                  f"PNG {r['png']}, F3M {r['f3m_models']} modelos / {r['f3m_skeletons']} esqueletos, GLB {r['glb']}, "
                  f"falhas {len(r['failures'])}.")
        for line in r["failures"][:10]:
            self._say("  falha: " + line)
        self._say("Detalhes em EXTRACAO_RELATORIO.txt e index.csv dentro de original_assets. Os originais ficam em RETAIL e os convertidos em CONVERTED.")

    def on_open_out(self):
        p = Path(self.v_out.get())
        if p.exists():
            os.startfile(str(p)) if hasattr(os, "startfile") else subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open", str(p)])

    def on_viewer(self):
        here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
        for cand in (here.parent.parent / "viewer" / "build" / "Release" / "F3VBViewer.exe",
                     here.parent.parent / "viewer" / "build" / "F3VBViewer.exe",
                     here.parent.parent / "viewer" / "F3VBViewer.exe"):
            if cand.exists():
                out = Path(self.v_out.get()) / "CONVERTED" / "f3m" / "models"
                args = [str(cand)]
                subprocess.Popen(args, cwd=str(out if out.exists() else cand.parent))
                return
        messagebox.showinfo("Visualizador", "F3VBViewer.exe não encontrado. Compile-o com viewer\\build.bat (veja docs\\VISUALIZADOR.md).")

    def _close(self):
        self._save_cfg()
        self.destroy()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        App().mainloop()
    except Exception:
        traceback.print_exc()
        input("Erro. Pressione Enter para fechar...")
```

## tools/py/tests/test_amxdis.py

```python
import json
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from f3vb.amxdis import OPCODES, analyze_amx, disassemble
from f3vb.cli import main as cli_main


def build_amx(ins, publics=(("main", 0),), natives=("print",), defsize=40, data=b"\0" * 16):
    """Monta um AMX file_version 6: ins = lista de células (inteiros) do código."""
    pub_tbl = b"".join(struct.pack("<I", addr * 4) + n.encode().ljust(defsize - 4, b"\0") for n, addr in publics)
    nat_tbl = b"".join(struct.pack("<I", 0) + n.encode().ljust(defsize - 4, b"\0") for n in natives)
    code = b"".join(struct.pack("<i", c) for c in ins)
    publics_off = 52
    natives_off = publics_off + len(pub_tbl)
    libs_off = natives_off + len(nat_tbl)
    cod = libs_off
    dat = cod + len(code)
    hea = dat + len(data)
    stp = hea + 4096
    hdr = struct.pack("<iHbbhh", hea, 0xF1E0, 6, 6, 0, defsize)
    hdr += struct.pack("<10i", cod, dat, hea, stp, -1, publics_off, natives_off, libs_off, libs_off, libs_off)
    return hdr + pub_tbl + nat_tbl + code + data


OP = {n: i for i, (n, _) in enumerate(OPCODES)}


class AmxDisTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_table_size_and_key_opcodes(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(OPCODES), 138)
        self.assertEqual(OP["HALT"], 120)
        self.assertEqual(OP["PROC"], 46)
        self.assertEqual(OP["SYSREQ.C"], 123)
        self.assertEqual(OP["PUSH.R"], 38)

    def program(self):
        # cel0: HALT 0 (retorno para 0) ; main: PROC, PUSH.C 5, PUSH.C 4, SYSREQ.C 0, STACK 8, ZERO.pri, RETN
        code = [OP["HALT"], 0,
                OP["PROC"], OP["PUSH.C"], 5, OP["PUSH.C"], 4, OP["SYSREQ.C"], 0, OP["STACK"], 8,
                OP["ZERO.pri"], OP["RETN"]]
        return build_amx(code, publics=(("main", 2),))

    def test_analyze_ok(self):
        r = analyze_amx(self.program())
        self.assertTrue(r["ok"], r["errors"])
        self.assertEqual(r["natives_called"], {"print": 1})
        self.assertEqual(r["publics"], ["main"])
        self.assertIn("SYSREQ.C    0  ; print", disassemble(self.program()))

    def test_analyze_errors(self):
        self.assertFalse(analyze_amx(b"\0" * 10)["ok"])
        bad_op = build_amx([OP["HALT"], 0, 999], publics=(("main", 0),))
        self.assertFalse(analyze_amx(bad_op)["ok"])
        not_proc = build_amx([OP["HALT"], 0, OP["NOP"], OP["RETN"]], publics=(("main", 2),))
        r = analyze_amx(not_proc)
        self.assertFalse(r["ok"])
        self.assertTrue(any("PROC" in e for e in r["errors"]))
        v11 = bytearray(self.program())
        v11[6] = 11
        self.assertFalse(analyze_amx(bytes(v11))["ok"])

    def test_cli(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            p = Path(t) / "x.amx"
            p.write_bytes(self.program())
            cli_main(["amxdis", str(p)])
            cli_main(["amxdis", str(p), "--check"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

## tools/py/tests/test_analyze.py

```python
import json
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from f3vb.analyze import format_resumo
from f3vb.classify import classify
from f3vb.cli import main as cli_main
from f3vb.probes import probe_amx
from tests.test_extract import make_b3d, make_gr2, make_tga
from tests.test_readers import build_grp, build_rht


def make_amx(defsize=8):
    names = b"main\0print\0random\0"
    hdr_size = 56
    publics = hdr_size
    natives = publics + defsize * 1
    libraries = natives + defsize * 2
    nametable = libraries
    base = nametable
    ofs = {"main": base, "print": base + 5, "random": base + 11}
    body = struct.pack("<II", 0, ofs["main"]) + struct.pack("<II", 0, ofs["print"]) + struct.pack("<II", 0, ofs["random"])
    total = hdr_size + len(body) + len(names)
    head = struct.pack("<iHbbhh", total, 0xF1E2, 8, 8, 0, defsize)
    head += struct.pack("<11i", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, publics, natives, libraries, libraries, libraries, nametable)
    return head + body + names


class AmxTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_probe(self):
        d = make_amx()
        self.assertTrue(classify(d[:64], len(d)).startswith("amx?"))
        p = probe_amx(d)
        self.assertEqual(p["publics"], ["main"])
        self.assertEqual(p["natives"], ["print", "random"])

    def test_head_only_needs_total_size(self):
        d = make_amx()
        self.assertFalse(classify(d[:64]).startswith("amx?"))        # sem total_size, o tamanho declarado não confere
        self.assertTrue(classify(d[:64], len(d)).startswith("amx?"))  # como o CLI usa: início + tamanho real
        ch = struct.pack("<4sII", b"EMAP", 1, 500) + b"\0" * 488
        self.assertEqual(classify(ch[:64], len(ch)), "chunk:EMAP")

    def test_invalid(self):
        self.assertIn("error", probe_amx(b"\x00" * 100))
        self.assertIn("error", probe_amx(b"\x00" * 10))


class ReportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_report_and_resumo(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            t = Path(t)
            game = t / "demo"
            game.mkdir()
            (game / "F3.exe").write_bytes(b"MZ")
            (game / "a.grp").write_bytes(build_grp([make_gr2(), make_tga(), make_b3d(), make_amx(), b"x" * 50]))
            (game / "resource.rht").write_bytes(build_rht([(1, 1, 100, 0, 0), (1, 2, 700, 1, 92), (1, 3, 5555, 2, 6)]))
            out, res = t / "r.json", t / "resumo.txt"
            cli_main(["report", str(game), "-o", str(out), "--resumo", str(res)])
            rep = json.loads(out.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            agg = rep["grps"][0]["aggregates"]
            self.assertEqual(list(agg["gr2"]["combinations"].values()), [1])
            self.assertEqual(agg["b3d"]["count"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(agg["b3d"]["texture_files"], ["body.tga"])
            self.assertEqual(agg["tga"]["plausible"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(agg["amx"]["publics"], ["main"])
            self.assertEqual(rep["rht"]["unknown_type_ids"], [5555])
            text = res.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertIn("GR2 combinações", text)
            self.assertIn("publics", text)
            self.assertIn("tipos fora da tabela: [5555]", text)
            self.assertEqual(format_resumo(rep), text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

## tools/py/tests/test_catalog.py

```python
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from f3vb.catalog import build_catalog, catalog_summary, catalog_tsv, find_grps
from f3vb.cli import main as cli_main
from f3vb.rht import parse_rht
from tests.test_analyze import make_amx
from tests.test_extract import make_b3d, make_tga
from tests.test_readers import build_grp


def build_rht_real(entries, packs, names):
    """entries: (number, type, pack_value, name). Monta um .rht com região de packs e de nomes."""
    pack_blob = b"".join(p.encode() + b"\0" for p in packs)
    name_blob, offs = b"", {}
    for *_, nm in entries:
        offs[nm] = len(name_blob)
        name_blob += nm.encode() + b"\0"
    n = len(entries)
    off_packs = 20 + 20 * n
    off_res = off_packs + len(pack_blob)
    out = struct.pack("<5I", 1, 1, n, off_packs, off_res)
    for num, typ, pack, nm in entries:
        out += struct.pack("<5I", 1, num, typ, offs[nm], pack)
    return out + pack_blob + name_blob


class CatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _setup(self, t: Path):
        game = t / "demo" / "data"
        game.mkdir(parents=True)
        (game / "Tiles.grp").write_bytes(build_grp([make_tga(), make_b3d()]))
        (game / "Scripts.grp").write_bytes(build_grp([make_amx()]))
        # duplicata aninhada, mesmo tamanho
        (game / "Demo" / "data").mkdir(parents=True)
        (game / "Demo" / "data" / "Tiles.grp").write_bytes((game / "Tiles.grp").read_bytes())
        # pack "Tiles" em 0, "Scripts" em 6
        raw = build_rht_real([(0, 200, 0, "a.tga"), (1, 100, 0, "b.b3d"), (0, 1200, 6, "s.amx")],
                             ["Tiles", "Scripts"], None)
        (t / "demo" / "resource.rht").write_bytes(raw)
        return t / "demo", raw

    def test_pack_labels_and_names(self):
        raw = build_rht_real([(0, 200, 0, "a.tga"), (0, 1200, 6, "s.amx")], ["Tiles", "Scripts"], None)
        info = parse_rht(raw)
        self.assertEqual(info.pack_label(0), "Tiles")
        self.assertEqual(info.pack_label(6), "Scripts")
        self.assertEqual(info.resource_name(info.entries[1].offset), "s.amx")
        self.assertEqual(info.summary()["by_pack"], {"Tiles": 1, "Scripts": 1})

    def test_catalog_validates_hypothesis(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            game, raw = self._setup(Path(t))
            info = parse_rht(raw)
            cat = build_catalog(game, info)
            self.assertEqual(len(cat["rows"]), 3)
            self.assertEqual(cat["agreement"]["TGA_Image"], {"tga": 1})
            self.assertEqual(cat["agreement"]["G3D_Model"], {"b3d": 1})
            self.assertEqual(cat["agreement"]["AMX"], {"amx": 1})
            self.assertTrue(all(r["count_match"] and r["numbers_are_permutation"] for r in cat["pack_report"].values()))
            self.assertEqual(cat["unreferenced_lumps"], 0)
            self.assertEqual(cat["names_present"], 3)
            self.assertEqual(cat["name_spacing"]["inconsistent"], 0)
            self.assertEqual(len(cat["duplicates_ignored"]), 1)
            self.assertIn("a.tga", catalog_tsv(cat))
            self.assertIn("concordância", catalog_summary(cat, info))

    def test_find_grps_prefers_shallow(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            game, _ = self._setup(Path(t))
            found, dups = find_grps(game)
            self.assertEqual(found["tiles"], game / "data" / "Tiles.grp")
            self.assertEqual(len(dups), 1)

    def test_cli_catalog_zipdir_inspect(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            t = Path(t)
            game, _ = self._setup(t)
            out = t / "cat"
            cli_main(["catalog", str(game), "--out", str(out)])
            self.assertTrue((out / "catalogo.txt").exists() and (out / "catalogo_resumo.txt").exists())
            cli_main(["rht", str(game / "resource.rht"), "--entries", "3"])   # regressão: --entries dava exit 1
            amx = t / "s.amx"
            amx.write_bytes(make_amx())
            cli_main(["inspect", str(amx)])
            z = t / "o.zip"
            cli_main(["zipdir", str(out), str(z)])
            with zipfile.ZipFile(z) as zf:
                self.assertTrue(all("\\" not in n for n in zf.namelist()))
                self.assertIn("catalogo.txt", zf.namelist())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


class B3dFailTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_report_groups_failures(self):
        import tempfile
        from pathlib import Path
        from f3vb.b3dfail import b3d_failures
        from tests.test_extract import make_b3d
        from tests.test_readers import build_grp
        good = make_b3d()
        bad = good[:-40]                       # truncado: não termina
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            p = Path(t) / "Props.grp"
            p.write_bytes(build_grp([good, bad, bad + b"\x00"]))
            text = b3d_failures(p)
        self.assertIn("3 arquivos, 1 decodificados por completo, 2 nao", text)
        self.assertIn("MOTIVO", text)
        self.assertIn("lump #1", text)
```

```python
"""v13: a segunda engine (engine_test/rpggl) compila e passa nos testes headless do proprio autor (sem janela, sem Windows)."""
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

RPGGL = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "engine_test" / "rpggl"


@unittest.skipUnless(shutil.which("g++"), "g++ nao encontrado")
class RpgglHeadlessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @unittest.skipIf(sys.platform == "win32", "o headless.cpp do RPGGL usa POSIX (setenv/mkdtemp): rode no Linux/WSL/macOS; no Windows o g++ do MinGW nao tem essas funcoes")
    def test_headless_suite_passes(self):
        src = RPGGL / "src"
        files = [str(RPGGL / "tests" / "headless.cpp"), str(RPGGL / "tests" / "stub_audio.cpp")] + [str(src / f) for f in
                 ("world.cpp", "ragdoll.cpp", "game.cpp", "save.cpp", "ui.cpp")]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            exe = Path(t) / "rpggl_headless"
            comp = subprocess.run(["g++", "-std=c++14", "-O1", "-pthread", f"-I{RPGGL / 'tests' / 'stubs'}", f"-I{src}", *files, "-o", str(exe)],
                                  capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertEqual(comp.returncode, 0, comp.stderr[-2000:])
            run = subprocess.run([str(exe)], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=t, timeout=300)
            self.assertEqual(run.returncode, 0, run.stdout[-2000:] + run.stderr[-500:])
            self.assertIn("TUDO OK (0 falhas)", run.stdout)

    def test_rpggl_has_no_game_assets_or_third_party(self):
        bad = [p.name for p in RPGGL.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in {".wav", ".ogg", ".mp3", ".tga", ".png", ".bmp", ".b3d", ".gr2", ".grp"}]
        self.assertEqual(bad, [])
        text = " ".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") for p in (RPGGL / "src").glob("*.[ch]*"))
        for dep in ("stb_image", "glad", "glfw", "SDL_", "miniaudio", "btBulletDynamics", "JPH/"):
            self.assertNotIn(dep, text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```python
        for ms in (1.0, DEFAULT_MESH_SCALE):                   # v12: a escala da malha multiplica a do usuário
            glb, _ = export_b3d_to_glb(make_b3d(), "t", unit_scale=2.0, mesh_scale=ms)
            js, bn = read_glb(glb)

            for (x, y, z), (rx, ry, rz) in zip(pos, raw):

        glb, rep = export_b3d_to_glb(make_b3d(is_bones=True), "m", joints=joints, clips=[clip])
        self.assertEqual(validate_glb(glb), [], rep["warnings"])
        js, _ = read_glb(glb)
        self.assertEqual(len(js["skins"][0]["joints"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(js["animations"][0]["channels"]), 2)
        self.assertIn("JOINTS_0", js["meshes"][0]["primitives"][0]["attributes"])

    def test_cli_export_with_game_dir(self):

            (t / "demo" / "resource.rht").write_bytes(raw)

            js, _ = read_glb(out.read_bytes())

        w, h, rgba = decode_tga(make_tga(4, 3, 24))
        self.assertEqual((w, h, len(rgba)), (4, 3, 48))
        w2, h2, png = image_to_png(make_tga(4, 3, 24))
        self.assertTrue(png.startswith(b"\x89PNG"))
        self.assertTrue(encode_png(2, 2, bytes([255, 0, 0, 128] * 4)).startswith(b"\x89PNG"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


class StfTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parse_and_text(self):
        from f3vb.stf import StfError, parse_stf
        texts = ["Ola, viajante.", "Bem-vindo ao Vault 13"]
        head = b"STFMAGIC" + struct.pack("<I", 2)
        base = len(head) + 2 * 16
        blob, entries = b"", b""
        for i, t in enumerate(texts):
            raw = t.encode("cp1252")
            entries += struct.pack("<II8s", base + len(blob), len(raw), b"\0" * 8)
            blob += raw
        data = head + entries + blob
        stf = parse_stf(data)
        self.assertEqual(stf.count, 2)
        self.assertEqual(stf.text(data, 1), texts[1])
        with self.assertRaises(StfError):
            stf.text(data, 5)
        with self.assertRaises(StfError):
            parse_stf(b"STFMAGIC" + struct.pack("<I", 999))

    def test_utf16(self):
        from f3vb.stf import parse_stf
        raw = "Água".encode("utf-16-le")
        head = b"STFMAGIC" + struct.pack("<I", 1)
        data = head + struct.pack("<II8s", 12 + 16, len(raw), b"\0" * 8) + raw
        self.assertEqual(parse_stf(data).text(data, 0), "Água")
```

## tools/py/tests/test_extract.py

```python
import json
import struct
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from f3vb.classify import classify
from f3vb.extract import extract, sample
from f3vb.gr2tool import _VENDOR, gr2_header, summarize_gr2
from f3vb.probes import probe_b3d, probe_bmp, probe_tga
from tests.test_readers import build_grp  # noqa: E402


def make_tga(w=4, h=3, bpp=24):
    hdr = struct.pack("<BBBHHBHHHHBB", 0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, w, h, bpp, 0)
    return hdr + b"\x10" * (w * h * (bpp // 8))


def s16(t: str) -> bytes:
    return struct.pack("<H", len(t)) + t.encode("latin-1")


def make_b3d(is_bones: bool = False, textured: bool = True):
    """B3D sintético (família de vértice de 44 bytes), no layout observado em arquivos reais."""
    d = b"B3D 1.1\x00"
    d += bytes([0x03]) + struct.pack("<f", 1.0)
    d += bytes([0x05]) + s16("Z_UP")
    d += bytes([0x07]) + s16("mtl0") + s16("Body") + struct.pack("<18f", *range(18)) + s16("OPAQUE") + s16("PHONG") + struct.pack("<ii", 1, 2)
    d += bytes([0x08]) + b"\x00" + s16("tex0") + s16("body.tga") + struct.pack("<II", 128, 64)
    d += bytes([0x0E]) + s16("Bip01") + struct.pack("<H", 0) + b"\x01" + struct.pack("<3f", 0, 1, 2)
    d += bytes([0x0A]) + bytes([0x0C]) + s16("Scene Root")
    d += bytes([0x0A]) + bytes([0x0C]) + s16("Mesh01")
    verts = [(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), (1.0, 2.0, 3.0), (1.0, 0.0, 2.0)]
    d += bytes([0x0F]) + bytes([0, 0, 1]) + struct.pack("<ii", len(verts), 44)
    for i, (x, y, z) in enumerate(verts):
        d += struct.pack("<3f3f4B2f2i", x, y, z, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 255, 255, 255, 255, float(i), 0.5, 0, 0)
    d += struct.pack("<6f", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0)                 # caixa envolvente = min/max das posicoes
    if is_bones:
        d += bytes([1]) + struct.pack("<i", 4)
        for k in range(4):                                           # pares (osso, peso) POR SLOT: slot k de todos os vertices
            for _v in verts:
                d += struct.pack("<if", 0 if k == 0 else -1, 1.0 if k == 0 else 0.0)
    else:
        d += bytes([0])
    d += struct.pack("<i", 1)                                    # numMaterials
    d += s16("Default") + s16("BASE_2X") + struct.pack("<17f", *range(17)) + s16("OPAQUE") + s16("SILENT")
    words = [257] + [0] * 14 + [1 if textured else 0]
    d += struct.pack("<16i", *words)
    if textured:
        d += s16("weaptex.tga")
    d += struct.pack("<I", 0)                                    # extra
    d += s16("Default") + struct.pack("<ii", 6, 2) + struct.pack("<6H", 0, 1, 2, 2, 1, 0)
    d += bytes([0x0B, 0x0B, 0x01])
    return d


def make_gr2():
    sys.path.insert(0, str(_VENDOR))
    from io_scene_gr2.gr2.export import ExportMesh, ExportScene, ExportVertex
    from io_scene_gr2.gr2.write import write_raw_gr2
    scene = ExportScene(meshes=(ExportMesh(
        name="Tri", vertices=(ExportVertex((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), (0, 1), ()), ExportVertex((1, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), (1, 1), ()),
                              ExportVertex((0, 1, 0), (0, 0, 1), (0, 0), ())),
        indices=(0, 1, 2), material_names=("Body",), material_indices=(0,),
        material_texture_files=("t.dds",), material_texture_sizes=((8, 8),)),), skeletons=())
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        p = write_raw_gr2(Path(d) / "t.gr2", scene)
        return Path(p).read_bytes()


class ProbeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_tga(self):
        p = probe_tga(make_tga())
        self.assertEqual((p["width"], p["height"], p["bpp"]), (4, 3, 24))
        self.assertTrue(p["plausible"] and p["size_ok"])
        self.assertFalse(probe_tga(make_tga()[:-5])["size_ok"])

    def test_bmp(self):
        d = b"BM" + struct.pack("<IHHII", 70, 0, 0, 54, 40) + struct.pack("<iiHHI", 4, 3, 1, 24, 0) + b"\0" * 40
        p = probe_bmp(d)
        self.assertEqual((p["width"], p["height"], p["bpp"]), (4, 3, 24))

    def test_b3d(self):
        p = probe_b3d(make_b3d())
        self.assertEqual(p["globals"]["coordinate_system"], "Z_UP")
        self.assertEqual(p["textures"][0]["file"], "body.tga")
        self.assertEqual(p["materials"][0]["name"], "Body")
        self.assertEqual(p["bone_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(p["node_names"], ["Scene Root", "Mesh01"])
        sf = p["surfaces"][0]
        self.assertEqual((sf["vertices"], sf["family"], sf["complete"]), (3, "44", True))
        self.assertEqual(sf["textures"], ["weaptex.tga"])
        self.assertEqual(sf["index_counts"], [6])
        self.assertIsNone(p["stopped"])
        self.assertEqual(p["ended_at"], len(make_b3d()))

    def test_b3d_variants(self):
        p = probe_b3d(make_b3d(is_bones=True, textured=False))
        sf = p["surfaces"][0]
        self.assertTrue(sf["complete"] and sf["bone_weights"] and sf["bones_per_vertex"] == 4)
        self.assertEqual(sf["textures"], [None])
        self.assertIsNone(p["stopped"])

    def test_b3d_64_family_terrain(self):
        d = make_b3d()
        i = d.index(bytes([0x0F]) + bytes([0, 0, 1]))
        nv = 4
        tail = (struct.pack("<II", 0, 0) + s16("LM_32_Floor") + struct.pack("<i", 1) + s16("Ext_Grass.tga")
                + struct.pack("<I", 0) + bytes([0xC9]) + struct.pack("<i", 6)
                + struct.pack("<6i", 0, 1, 2, 2, 1, 3) + b"\x01" * 6 + bytes([0x0B, 0x0B, 0x01]))
        d64 = d[:i] + bytes([0x0F]) + bytes([0, 0, 0]) + struct.pack("<i", nv) + b"\x00" * (nv * 64) + tail
        p = probe_b3d(d64)
        sf = p["surfaces"][0]
        self.assertEqual((sf["family"], sf["complete"], sf["vertices"]), ("64", True, nv))
        self.assertEqual((sf["lightmap"], sf["textures"], sf["index_counts"]), ("LM_32_Floor", ["Ext_Grass.tga"], [6]))
        self.assertIsNone(p["stopped"])
        self.assertEqual(p["ended_at"], len(d64))

    def test_b3d_64_family_bad_index_is_reported(self):
        d = make_b3d()
        i = d.index(bytes([0x0F]) + bytes([0, 0, 1]))
        tail = (struct.pack("<II", 0, 0) + s16("LM") + struct.pack("<i", 1) + s16("t.tga") + struct.pack("<I", 0)
                + bytes([0xC9]) + struct.pack("<i", 3) + struct.pack("<3i", 0, 1, 99) + b"\x01" * 3 + bytes([0x0B, 0x0B, 0x01]))
        d64 = d[:i] + bytes([0x0F]) + bytes([0, 0, 0]) + struct.pack("<i", 4) + b"\x00" * 256 + tail
        p = probe_b3d(d64)
        self.assertIn("fora do intervalo", p["stopped"]["reason"])

    def test_b3d_truncated_and_bad(self):
        p = probe_b3d(make_b3d()[:40])
        self.assertIsNotNone(p["stopped"])
        self.assertIn("B3D", probe_b3d(b"XXXX1234")["stopped"]["reason"])


class Gr2Tests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_header_and_summary(self):
        data = make_gr2()
        self.assertEqual(classify(data[:64]), "gr2")
        h = gr2_header(data)
        self.assertEqual(h["compressions"], ["none"])
        self.assertGreaterEqual(h["section_count"], 1)
        s = summarize_gr2(data)           # nenhuma etapa pode levantar exceção
        self.assertIn("header", s)
        self.assertIsInstance(s["errors"], list)

    def test_not_gr2(self):
        s = summarize_gr2(b"\x00" * 100)
        self.assertEqual(s["errors"][0]["stage"], "header")


class ExtractTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _grp(self, d: Path) -> Path:
        blobs = [make_gr2(), make_tga(), make_b3d(), b"hello world text" * 80, make_tga(16, 16, 32)]
        p = d / "a.grp"
        p.write_bytes(build_grp(blobs))
        return p

    def test_extract_filters(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            t = Path(t)
            grp = self._grp(t)
            m = extract(grp, t / "o", classes=["b3d", "gr2"])
            self.assertEqual(sorted(e["class"] for e in m["files"]), ["b3d", "gr2"])
            self.assertTrue((t / "o" / "manifest.json").exists())
            m2 = extract(grp, t / "o2", indices=[1])
            self.assertEqual(m2["count"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(m2["files"][0]["probe"]["width"], 4)

    def test_sample_zip(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            t = Path(t)
            grp = self._grp(t)
            m = sample(grp, t / "sample", classes=("gr2", "b3d", "tga"), per_class=1, min_bytes=16)
            self.assertEqual(m["count"], 3)
            self.assertEqual(m["not_found"], [])
            with zipfile.ZipFile(m["zip"]) as z:
                names = set(z.namelist())
                self.assertIn("manifest.json", names)
                self.assertIn("manifest.txt", names)
                self.assertIn("LEIA-ME.txt", names)
                self.assertEqual(len([n for n in names if n.startswith("hexdump_") and n.endswith(".txt")]), 3)
                self.assertEqual(len([n for n in names if n.endswith((".gr2", ".b3d", ".tga"))]), 3)
                man = json.loads(z.read("manifest.json"))
                self.assertTrue(all(len(e["sha256"]) == 64 for e in man["files"]))


class TextOnlyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_text_only_zip_has_no_binaries(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
            t = Path(t)
            blobs = [make_gr2(), make_tga(), make_b3d()]
            grp = t / "a.grp"
            grp.write_bytes(build_grp(blobs))
            m = sample(grp, t / "s", per_class=1, min_bytes=16, text_only=True)
            with zipfile.ZipFile(m["zip"]) as z:
                names = z.namelist()
                self.assertTrue(all(n.endswith(".txt") for n in names), names)
                self.assertIn("manifest.txt", names)
                txt = z.read("manifest.txt").decode("utf-8")
                self.assertIn("sha256=", txt)
                self.assertIn("body.tga", txt)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```
