## viewer/src/actor.cpp

```cpp
// v20: atores (ver actor.h).
#include "actor.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <set>

#include "b3d.h"
#include "gr2.h"
#include "model_build.h"
#include "proto.h"
#include "vfs.h"

namespace f3v {

namespace {

std::string lower(std::string s) { for (char& c : s) if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'A' + 'a'); return s; }
std::string stem(const std::string& f) { const std::size_t d = f.rfind('.'); return d == std::string::npos ? f : f.substr(0, d); }
std::string upper_ext(const std::string& f) { const std::size_t d = f.rfind('.'); std::string e = d == std::string::npos ? "" : f.substr(d + 1); for (char& c : e) if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'a' + 'A'); return e; }

std::uint32_t proto_type(const std::string& kind) {
    if (kind == "CRT") return RT_CRT;
    if (kind == "ARM") return RT_ARM;
    if (kind == "WEA") return RT_WEA;
    if (kind == "USE") return RT_USE;
    if (kind == "DOR") return RT_DOR;
    if (kind == "AMO") return RT_AMO;
    if (kind == "CON") return RT_CON;
    return 0;
}

bool read_proto(const Vfs& vfs, const std::string& file, Prototype& p) {
    const std::string kind = upper_ext(file);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> d;
    const std::uint32_t t = proto_type(kind);
    // o mapa cita "Critters00_TMCpl_Armstrong.CRT"; o .rht guarda "Critters00_TMCpl_Armstrong" com tipo CRT
    if (!vfs.read(stem(file), t, d) && !vfs.read_file(file, d)) return false;
    return parse_prototype(d.data(), d.size(), kind.empty() ? "?" : kind, p);
}

bool read_gr2_res(const Vfs& vfs, const std::string& name, std::uint32_t type, Gr2File& g) {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> d;
    if (!vfs.read(name, type, d)) return false;
    std::string err;
    return load_gr2(d.data(), d.size(), g, err);
}

bool read_b3d_res(const Vfs& vfs, const std::string& name, B3dModel& m, std::string& err) {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> d;
    if (!vfs.read(name, RT_MODEL, d)) { err = "modelo '" + name + "' nao existe na demo"; return false; }
    return load_b3d(d.data(), d.size(), m, err);
}

// regioes do corpo base cobertas por cada encaixe de parte (hipotese conferida com os prints do menu original)
const std::set<std::string>& covered_by(const std::string& slot) {
    static const std::map<std::string, std::set<std::string>> k = {
        {"Bod", {"chest", "waist", "upperarms"}},
        {"Fee", {"legs", "shins", "feet"}},
        {"Han", {"hands", "forearms"}},
    };
    static const std::set<std::string> none;
    const auto it = k.find(slot);
    return it == k.end() ? none : it->second;
}

// Os humanos da demo usam um ATLAS montado pela engine (512x512 com as texturas _LG de 256): pele no quadrante superior
// esquerdo, roupa do corpo (Bod) no inferior esquerdo e as partes pequenas (pes, maos, ombros, cabeca, costas, cabelo, barba,
// Pip-Boy) em celulas de 1/4 (medido nos B3D: HumMNor, HumMStr_*, HumFWir). Aqui desfazemos o atlas: a UV de cada malha volta
// para a sua propria textura. Os modelos que nao sao humanos (CR_Dog...) usam a textura inteira e ficam como estao.
void unatlas_human(Scene& sc) {
    for (Mesh& m : sc.meshes) {
        if (m.uv.empty() || m.material < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(m.material) >= sc.materials.size()) continue;
        const Material& mat = sc.materials[static_cast<std::size_t>(m.material)];
        std::string tex = mat.texture >= 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(mat.texture) < sc.textures.size() ? lower(sc.textures[static_cast<std::size_t>(mat.texture)].name) : std::string();
        float umin = 1e9f, umax = -1e9f, vmin = 1e9f, vmax = -1e9f;
        for (std::uint32_t i : m.idx) { const float u = m.uv[2 * i], v = m.uv[2 * i + 1]; umin = std::min(umin, u); umax = std::max(umax, u); vmin = std::min(vmin, v); vmax = std::max(vmax, v); }
        if (umin > umax) continue;
        float x0, y0, size;
        if (tex.compare(0, 5, "skin_") == 0) { x0 = 0.f; y0 = 0.f; size = 0.5f; }
        else if (tex.compare(0, 3, "bod") == 0) { x0 = 0.f; y0 = 0.5f; size = 0.5f; }
        else { size = 0.25f; x0 = std::floor(((umin + umax) * 0.5f) / size) * size; y0 = std::floor(((vmin + vmax) * 0.5f) / size) * size; }
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < m.uv.size(); i += 2) { m.uv[i] = (m.uv[i] - x0) / size; m.uv[i + 1] = (m.uv[i + 1] - y0) / size; }
    }
}

}  // namespace

const char* actor_anim_name(int a) {
    static const char* n[AN_COUNT] = {"parado", "andar", "correr", "ataque", "dano", "morte"};
    return a >= 0 && a < AN_COUNT ? n[a] : "?";
}

void Actor::play(int anim, float now, bool loop) {
    if (anim < 0 || anim >= AN_COUNT) return;
    if (anim == cur_anim && loop && anim_loop) return;
    cur_anim = anim; anim_start = now; anim_loop = loop;
}

float Actor::anim_length(int anim) const {
    if (anim < 0 || anim >= AN_COUNT || clip_index[anim] < 0 || parts.empty()) return 0;
    const Scene& sc = parts[0].scene;
    const std::size_t ci = static_cast<std::size_t>(clip_index[anim]);
    return ci < sc.clips.size() ? sc.clips[ci].duration : 0;
}

bool Actor::anim_done(float now) const { return !anim_loop && now - anim_start >= anim_length(cur_anim); }

void Actor::animate(float t) {
    // v20: a animacao repete. O Scene::evaluate segura a ULTIMA pose depois do fim do clipe (6,67 s no Idle dos humanos), e o relogio
    // do jogo ja passa disso quando o menu aparece: por isso os personagens ficavam congelados. v21: animacao por papel (andar, ataque...);
    // as sem laco (ataque, dano, morte) param no ultimo quadro.
    int role = cur_anim >= 0 && cur_anim < AN_COUNT && clip_index[cur_anim] >= 0 ? cur_anim : AN_IDLE;
    const int ci = clip_index[role];
    const bool idle = role == AN_IDLE;
    const float local = idle ? t + phase : t - anim_start;
    const bool loop = idle || anim_loop;
    for (ActorPart& p : parts) {
        if (p.scene.clips.empty() || ci < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(ci) >= p.scene.clips.size()) { p.scene.evaluate(-1, 0); continue; }
        const float d = p.scene.clips[static_cast<std::size_t>(ci)].duration;
        float tt = local;
        if (d > 1e-4f) {
            if (loop) { tt = std::fmod(tt, d); if (tt < 0) tt += d; }
            else tt = std::clamp(tt, 0.f, d - 1e-4f);
        } else tt = 0;
        p.scene.evaluate(ci, tt);
    }
    if (has_weapon) weapon.scene.evaluate(-1, 0);
}

void Actor::model_matrix(float o[16]) const {
    const float c = std::cos(yaw), s = std::sin(yaw), k = scale;
    // colunas: X, Y, Z (com o espelho do Z do F3M de volta para o Z do jogo), translacao
    o[0] = c * k;  o[1] = 0; o[2] = -s * k; o[3] = 0;
    o[4] = 0;      o[5] = k; o[6] = 0;      o[7] = 0;
    o[8] = -s * k; o[9] = 0; o[10] = -c * k; o[11] = 0;
    o[12] = pos[0]; o[13] = pos[1]; o[14] = pos[2]; o[15] = 1;
}

void Actor::weapon_matrix(float o[16]) const {
    Mat4 a;
    model_matrix(a.m);
    if (hand_joint >= 0 && !parts.empty() && static_cast<std::size_t>(hand_joint) < parts[0].scene.joint_world.size()) a = mul(a, parts[0].scene.joint_world[static_cast<std::size_t>(hand_joint)]);
    std::memcpy(o, a.m, sizeof a.m);
}

bool build_actor(const Vfs& vfs, const MapEntity& e, Actor& out, std::string& err, const ActorBuildOptions& opt) {
    out = Actor();
    out.prototype = e.prototype;
    out.pos[0] = e.pos[0]; out.pos[1] = e.pos[1]; out.pos[2] = e.pos[2];
    out.yaw = e.yaw;
    auto note = [&](const std::string& s) { if (opt.log) opt.log->push_back(s); };
    Prototype P;
    if (!read_proto(vfs, e.prototype, P)) { err = "prototipo '" + e.prototype + "' nao encontrado"; return false; }
    if (P.model.empty()) { err = "prototipo sem modelo"; return false; }
    const bool human = P.kind == "CRT" && P.model.size() >= 4 && P.model.compare(0, 3, "Hum") == 0;
    const ActorLook* look = human && opt.look && !opt.look->empty() ? opt.look : nullptr;
    if (look && P.model.size() >= 7) {                                       // HumMNor -> HumF/HumM + Nor/Fat/Str/Wir
        std::string m = P.model;
        if (look->set_sex) m[3] = look->female ? 'F' : 'M';
        if (look->body.size() == 3) m.replace(4, 3, look->body);
        if (m != P.model) {
            if (vfs.find(m, RT_MODEL)) P.model = m; else note("corpo '" + m + "' nao existe na demo");
        }
        if (!look->skin.empty()) P.skin = "Skin_Hum" + std::string(1, P.model[3]) + "_" + look->skin + "_LG";
    }
    out.model = P.model;

    // partes (humano): as do prototipo, trocadas pelas da armadura no mesmo encaixe
    std::vector<std::string> parts = human ? P.parts : std::vector<std::string>();
    std::map<std::string, std::string> part_tex = P.part_texture;
    if (human && !P.armor.empty()) {
        Prototype A;
        if (read_proto(vfs, P.armor, A)) {
            std::set<std::string> slots;
            for (const std::string& p : A.parts) slots.insert(part_slot(p));
            parts.erase(std::remove_if(parts.begin(), parts.end(), [&](const std::string& p) { return slots.count(part_slot(p)) > 0; }), parts.end());
            for (const std::string& p : A.parts) parts.push_back(p);
            for (const auto& kv : A.part_texture) part_tex[kv.first] = kv.second;
        } else note("armadura '" + P.armor + "' nao encontrada");
    }
    if (look) {
        for (const auto& kv : look->slots) {                                   // troca a parte de cada encaixe escolhido
            parts.erase(std::remove_if(parts.begin(), parts.end(), [&](const std::string& p) { return part_slot(p) == kv.first; }), parts.end());
            if (!kv.second.empty()) parts.push_back(kv.second);
        }
        if (!look->hair_color.empty())                                        // cor do cabelo: textura <Parte>_<cor>_LG das partes de pelo
            for (const std::string& p : parts) {
                const std::string sl = part_slot(p);
                if (sl == "Hai" || sl == "Pon" || sl == "Mus" || sl == "Bea") part_tex[p] = p + "_" + look->hair_color + "_LG";
            }
    }
    // arma na mao
    std::string held, weapon_class = "Una";
    if (P.kind == "CRT" && !P.weapon.empty() && opt.with_weapon) {
        Prototype W;
        if (read_proto(vfs, P.weapon, W) && !W.held_model.empty()) {
            held = W.held_model;
            const std::string l = lower(held);
            weapon_class = (l.find("minigun") != std::string::npos || l.find("rocket") != std::string::npos || l.find("flame") != std::string::npos ||
                            l.find("gatling") != std::string::npos || l.find("bozar") != std::string::npos) ? "2HH" : "1H";
        }
    }

    // esqueleto do modelo base
    std::vector<RawJoint> joints;
    {
        Gr2File g;
        if (read_gr2_res(vfs, P.model, RT_SKEL, g)) raw_skeleton(g, joints);
    }
    // animacao parada
    std::vector<RawClip> clips;
    if (!joints.empty()) {
        std::vector<std::string> cands;
        if (human) {
            const std::string fam = P.model.substr(0, 4) + "_";
            for (const char* st : {"Def_", "Com_"}) cands.push_back(fam + st + weapon_class + "_Idle_01");
            cands.push_back(fam + "Def_Una_Idle_01");
            cands.push_back(fam + "Com_Una_Idle_01");
        } else {
            cands.push_back(P.model + "_Com_Una_Idle_01");
            cands.push_back(P.model + "_Def_Una_Idle_01");
        }
        for (const std::string& c : cands) {
            Gr2File g;
            if (!read_gr2_res(vfs, c, RT_GR2, g)) continue;
            raw_clips(g, joints, c, clips);
            if (!clips.empty()) { out.clip_name = c; break; }
        }
        if (clips.empty()) {                                   // qualquer "<modelo>_*Idle*"
            const std::string pre = lower(P.model + "_");
            for (const ResEntry* r : vfs.list(RT_GR2)) {
                const std::string n = lower(r->name);
                if (n.compare(0, pre.size(), pre) == 0 && n.find("idle") != std::string::npos) {
                    Gr2File g;
                    if (read_gr2_res(vfs, r->name, RT_GR2, g)) { raw_clips(g, joints, r->name, clips); if (!clips.empty()) { out.clip_name = r->name; break; } }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // v21: os outros papeis (andar, correr, ataque, dano, morte), cada um com candidatos em ordem; o 1o que existir na demo vale
    if (!clips.empty()) {
        out.clip_index[AN_IDLE] = 0;
        out.clip_names[AN_IDLE] = out.clip_name;
        const std::string hl = lower(held);
        out.weapon_class = weapon_class;
        out.melee = held.empty() || hl.find("knife") != std::string::npos || hl.find("club") != std::string::npos || hl.find("sledge") != std::string::npos ||
                    hl.find("spear") != std::string::npos || hl.find("sword") != std::string::npos || hl.find("fist") != std::string::npos ||
                    hl.find("bat") != std::string::npos || hl.find("knuckle") != std::string::npos;
        std::vector<std::string> c[AN_COUNT];
        if (human) {
            const std::string f = P.model.substr(0, 4) + "_", w = weapon_class;
            c[AN_WALK] = {f + "Com_" + w + "_Walk_01", f + "Com_Una_Walk_01"};
            c[AN_RUN] = {f + "Com_Una_Run_01", f + "Com_" + w + "_Walk_01"};
            if (w == "Una") c[AN_ATTACK] = {f + "Com_Una_Punch_Jab_01", f + "Com_Una_Kick_Snap_01"};
            else if (w == "1H") c[AN_ATTACK] = out.melee ? std::vector<std::string>{f + "Com_1H_Melee_Slash_01", f + "Com_1H_Melee_Thrust_01"}
                                                         : std::vector<std::string>{f + "Com_1H_Gun_Shoot_01", f + "Com_1H_Gun_NoRecoil_01"};
            else c[AN_ATTACK] = {f + "Com_2HH_Gun_Burst_01", f + "Com_2HH_Gun_Shoot_01"};
            c[AN_HIT] = {f + "Com_" + w + "_DmgFr_01", f + "Com_Una_DmgFr_01"};
            c[AN_DEATH] = {f + "ProneB_Una_Death_01", f + "ProneF_Una_Death_01"};
        } else {
            const std::string m = P.model + "_";
            c[AN_WALK] = {m + "Com_Una_Walk_01", m + "Def_Una_Walk_01"};
            c[AN_RUN] = {m + "Com_Una_Run_01", m + "Com_Una_Walk_02", m + "Com_Una_Walk_01"};
            c[AN_ATTACK] = {m + "Com_Una_Attack1_01", m + "Com_Una_Attack_01", m + "Com_Una_Bite_01"};
            c[AN_HIT] = {m + "Com_Una_DmgFr_01"};
            c[AN_DEATH] = {m + "ProneB_Una_Death_01", m + "ProneF_Una_Death_01", m + "Com_Una_Death_01"};
        }
        for (int role = AN_WALK; role < AN_COUNT; ++role)
            for (const std::string& cand : c[role]) {
                Gr2File g;
                if (!read_gr2_res(vfs, cand, RT_GR2, g)) continue;
                const std::size_t before = clips.size();
                raw_clips(g, joints, cand, clips);
                if (clips.size() > before) { clips.resize(before + 1); out.clip_index[role] = static_cast<int>(before); out.clip_names[role] = cand; break; }
            }
    }

    // carregador de texturas com a troca de pele e das texturas proprias das partes
    const std::string skin = stem(P.skin);
    auto tex_loader = [&](const std::string& st) -> std::vector<std::uint8_t> {
        std::string want = st;
        const std::string l = lower(st);
        if (!skin.empty() && l.compare(0, 8, "skin_hum") == 0) want = skin;
        for (const auto& kv : part_tex) if (l.compare(0, kv.first.size() + 9, lower(kv.first) + "_default_") == 0) want = kv.second;
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> d;
        if (!vfs.read(want, RT_TGA, d) && want != st) vfs.read(st, RT_TGA, d);
        return d;
    };

    // corpo/modelo base
    B3dModel base;
    if (!read_b3d_res(vfs, P.model, base, err)) return false;
    const double ms = guess_mesh_scale(base, joints);
    ModelBuildReport rep;
    {
        ActorPart bp;
        bp.name = P.model;
        bp.scene.add(build_model(base, P.model, joints, clips, tex_loader, &rep, ms));
        if (human) unatlas_human(bp.scene);
        bp.hidden.assign(bp.scene.meshes.size(), 0);
        out.parts.push_back(std::move(bp));
    }
    // partes
    std::set<std::string> covered;
    for (const std::string& part : parts) {
        const std::string slot = part_slot(part);
        std::string mname = P.model + "_" + part;
        B3dModel pm;
        std::string e2;
        if (!read_b3d_res(vfs, mname, pm, e2)) {
            const std::string alt = P.model.substr(0, 4) + "Nor_" + part;          // ex.: HumMStr_X sem modelo -> HumMNor_X
            if (alt == mname || !read_b3d_res(vfs, alt, pm, e2)) { note("parte '" + mname + "' nao existe na demo"); continue; }
            mname = alt;
        }
        ActorPart ap;
        ap.name = mname;
        ap.scene.add(build_model(pm, mname, joints, clips, tex_loader, nullptr, ms));
        unatlas_human(ap.scene);
        ap.hidden.assign(ap.scene.meshes.size(), 0);
        for (const std::string& c : covered_by(slot)) covered.insert(c);
        for (const Mesh& m : ap.scene.meshes)                                       // a parte traz a propria pele desta regiao
            if (m.material >= 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(m.material) < ap.scene.materials.size()) covered.insert(lower(ap.scene.materials[static_cast<std::size_t>(m.material)].name));
        out.parts.push_back(std::move(ap));
    }
    {
        ActorPart& bp = out.parts[0];
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < bp.scene.meshes.size(); ++i) {
            const int mi = bp.scene.meshes[i].material;
            if (mi >= 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(mi) < bp.scene.materials.size() && covered.count(lower(bp.scene.materials[static_cast<std::size_t>(mi)].name))) bp.hidden[i] = 1;
        }
    }
    // arma
    if (!held.empty()) {
        B3dModel wm;
        std::string e3;
        if (read_b3d_res(vfs, held, wm, e3)) {
            std::vector<RawJoint> wj;
            Gr2File g;
            if (read_gr2_res(vfs, held, RT_SKEL, g)) raw_skeleton(g, wj);
            out.weapon.name = held;
            out.weapon.scene.add(build_model(wm, held, wj, {}, tex_loader, nullptr, guess_mesh_scale(wm, wj)));
            out.weapon.hidden.assign(out.weapon.scene.meshes.size(), 0);
            out.hand_joint = out.parts[0].scene.find_joint("R Handle");
            out.has_weapon = out.hand_joint >= 0;
            if (!out.has_weapon) note("sem osso 'R Handle' para a arma");
        } else note("arma '" + held + "': " + e3);
    }
    // altura (pose de bind)
    out.animate(0);
    float mn[3], mx[3];
    if (out.parts[0].scene.bounds(mn, mx)) out.height = (mx[1] - mn[1]) * out.scale;
    // fase diferente por entidade (nao ficam todos sincronizados)
    out.phase = std::fmod(std::fabs(e.pos[0] * 0.37f + e.pos[2] * 0.73f), 7.f);
    out.script = !e.script.empty() ? e.script : P.script;   // o script da instancia no mapa vale mais que o do prototipo
    out.description = P.kind + " " + P.model + " (" + std::to_string(out.parts.size()) + " parte(s)" + (out.has_weapon ? ", arma " + held : std::string()) +
                      (out.clip_name.empty() ? ", sem animacao" : ", anim " + out.clip_name) + (ms == 1.0 ? ", malha em escala 1" : "") + ")";
    return true;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/actor.h

```cpp
// v20: "atores": entidades do mapa com modelo 3D (personagens, criaturas, o vagao do menu, itens no chao), montados DIRETO da
// demo (prototipo .CRT/.USE/... -> B3D + esqueleto GR2 + animacao GR2), animados e com skinning na CPU. Portavel (sem OpenGL):
// o desenho fica em actor_gl.cpp. Regras medidas na demo (docs/JOGO.md, secao "Personagens"):
//   - Humano = corpo base (HumMNor, HumMStr...; regioes Chest/Waist/UpperArms/ForeArms/Hands/Legs/Shins/Feet/Head) + partes
//     "<base>_<Parte>" (HaiBald, BodPrisonSuit, BodPowerArmor...). A armadura equipada (.ARM) traz as proprias partes e substitui
//     as do mesmo encaixe (Bod, Fee, Han...). Regioes do corpo cobertas pelas partes ficam escondidas.
//   - Pele: as texturas "Skin_Hum*" do corpo e das partes viram a pele do prototipo (ex.: Skin_HumM_Black01_LG).
//   - Arma equipada (.WEA): modelo "na mao" (WP_*) preso ao osso "R Handle_1".
//   - Animacao parada: HumM_/HumF_ + Def_<classe>_Idle_01 (classe: Una sem arma, 1H, 2HH para armas pesadas), ou
//     <modelo>_Com_Una_Idle_01 para criaturas e objetos.
#pragma once
#include <memory>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "f3map.h"
#include "scene.h"

namespace f3v {

class Vfs;

struct ActorPart {
    std::string name;                 // nome do modelo (ex.: HumMStr_BodPowerArmor)
    Scene scene;
    std::vector<char> hidden;         // por malha: 1 = nao desenhar (regiao do corpo coberta por roupa)
};

// v21: animacoes por papel. Os nomes vem dos .gr2 da demo (HumM_Com_Una_Walk_01, HumM_Com_Una_Punch_Jab_01, CR_Dog_Com_Una_Attack1_01...).
enum ActorAnim { AN_IDLE = 0, AN_WALK, AN_RUN, AN_ATTACK, AN_HIT, AN_DEATH, AN_COUNT };
const char* actor_anim_name(int a);

struct Actor {
    std::string prototype, model, clip_name, description;
    int clip_index[AN_COUNT] = {-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1};   // indice do clipe de cada papel (-1 = nao achado na demo)
    std::string clip_names[AN_COUNT];
    int cur_anim = AN_IDLE;
    float anim_start = 0;             // relogio em que a animacao atual comecou
    bool anim_loop = true;
    std::string weapon_class = "Una"; // Una, 1H, 2HH
    std::string script;               // script do prototipo (ex.: 00_MainMenu_Train no vagao do menu)
    bool melee = true;                // ataque corpo a corpo (soco, faca) ou arma de fogo
    void play(int anim, float now, bool loop);       // troca a animacao (nao reinicia se ja for a mesma em laco)
    float anim_length(int anim) const;               // duracao do clipe (0 se nao houver)
    bool anim_done(float now) const;                 // animacao sem laco chegou ao fim
    std::vector<ActorPart> parts;     // [0] = corpo/modelo base
    bool has_weapon = false;
    ActorPart weapon;
    int hand_joint = -1;              // junta da mao no corpo
    float pos[3] = {0, 0, 0}, yaw = 0;
    float scale = 10.24f;             // esqueleto -> unidades do mapa
    float phase = 0;                  // deslocamento da animacao (cada um num ponto diferente)
    int entity = -1;                  // indice em MapData::entities
    float height = 0;                 // altura aproximada (para a fala flutuante / clique), em unidades do mapa

    void animate(float t);            // avalia a pose da animacao atual no tempo t (Idle: com fase propria; laco ou para no ultimo quadro)
    // matriz do ator (esqueleto -> mapa), coluna-major como o OpenGL: T(pos) * Ry(yaw) * S(scale) * espelho Z
    void model_matrix(float out[16]) const;
    // matriz da arma (esqueleto da arma -> mapa)
    void weapon_matrix(float out[16]) const;
};

// v20: aparencia escolhida na criacao de personagem (so humanos). Vazio = como esta no prototipo.
struct ActorLook {
    std::string body;                               // "Nor", "Fat", "Str", "Wir" (troca HumMNor -> HumM<body>)
    bool female = false, set_sex = false;           // set_sex: troca HumM <-> HumF
    std::map<std::string, std::string> slots;       // encaixe ("Hai", "Pon", "Mus", "Bea") -> parte ("HaiAfro"); "" = tirar a parte do encaixe
    std::string skin;                               // "Tan01" -> Skin_HumM_Tan01_LG
    std::string hair_color;                         // "brown", "black", "blonde", "red", "white", "brownGrey": <Parte>_<cor>_LG.tga
    bool empty() const { return body.empty() && !set_sex && slots.empty() && skin.empty() && hair_color.empty(); }
};
struct ActorBuildOptions { bool with_weapon = true; std::vector<std::string>* log = nullptr; const ActorLook* look = nullptr; };

// Monta o ator da entidade. false (com err) quando o prototipo nao tem modelo desenhavel.
bool build_actor(const Vfs& vfs, const MapEntity& e, Actor& out, std::string& err, const ActorBuildOptions& opt = {});

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/actor_gl.cpp

```cpp
// v20: desenho dos atores (ver actor_gl.h).
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#include <GL/gl.h>

#include "actor_gl.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>

#include "map_render.h"

#ifndef GL_COMBINE
#define GL_COMBINE 0x8570
#define GL_COMBINE_RGB 0x8571
#define GL_COMBINE_ALPHA 0x8572
#define GL_SOURCE0_RGB 0x8580
#define GL_SOURCE1_RGB 0x8581
#define GL_SOURCE0_ALPHA 0x8588
#define GL_SOURCE1_ALPHA 0x8589
#define GL_OPERAND0_RGB 0x8590
#define GL_OPERAND1_RGB 0x8591
#define GL_OPERAND0_ALPHA 0x8598
#define GL_OPERAND1_ALPHA 0x8599
#define GL_RGB_SCALE 0x8573
#define GL_PRIMARY_COLOR 0x8577
#endif

namespace f3v {

namespace {

void upload_scene(const Scene& s, std::vector<unsigned>& out, float aniso) {
    out.clear();
    for (const Texture& t : s.textures) {
        Image im;
        im.w = t.w; im.h = t.h; im.rgba = t.rgba;
        out.push_back(t.w && t.h ? gl_upload_texture(im, false, aniso) : 0u);
    }
}

void draw_part(const ActorPart& p, const std::vector<unsigned>& tex, const float model[16], const ActorLight& L, bool blend_pass) {
    const Scene& s = p.scene;
    // luz no espaco do modelo: inversa da rotacao (a matriz tem escala uniforme, entao a transposta da parte 3x3 normalizada)
    const float k = std::sqrt(model[0] * model[0] + model[1] * model[1] + model[2] * model[2]);
    float l[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    if (k > 1e-6f) for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) l[c] = -(model[c * 4 + 0] * L.dir[0] + model[c * 4 + 1] * L.dir[1] + model[c * 4 + 2] * L.dir[2]) / k;
    const float ll = std::sqrt(l[0] * l[0] + l[1] * l[1] + l[2] * l[2]);
    if (ll > 1e-6f) for (float& x : l) x /= ll;
    // com o espelho do Z na matriz, o determinante e negativo: o sentido dos triangulos inverte
    const float det = model[0] * (model[5] * model[10] - model[9] * model[6]) - model[4] * (model[1] * model[10] - model[9] * model[2]) + model[8] * (model[1] * model[6] - model[5] * model[2]);
    (void)det;
    glPushMatrix();
    glMultMatrixf(model);
    std::vector<float> pos, nrm, col;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.meshes.size(); ++i) {
        if (i < p.hidden.size() && p.hidden[i]) continue;
        const Mesh& m = s.meshes[i];
        const Material* mat = (m.material >= 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(m.material) < s.materials.size()) ? &s.materials[static_cast<std::size_t>(m.material)] : nullptr;
        // tipo de sombreamento pelo id do material (o mesmo esquema dos mapas): *_2X = textura x luz x 2,
        // *VERTEX_ALPHA* = transparencia pela cor de vertice (misturado), *IMAGE_ALPHA* = recorte pelo alfa da textura
        const std::string sh = mat ? mat->shader : std::string();
        const bool x2 = sh.find("_2X") != std::string::npos;
        const bool valpha = sh.find("VERTEX_ALPHA") != std::string::npos;
        const bool blend = (mat && mat->alpha_mode != 0) || valpha;
        if (blend != blend_pass) continue;
        s.skin(static_cast<int>(i), pos, nrm);
        const std::uint32_t nv = m.nv();
        col.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 4);
        const float* mc = mat ? mat->color : nullptr;
        for (std::uint32_t v = 0; v < nv; ++v) {
            const float d = std::max(0.f, nrm[v * 3] * l[0] + nrm[v * 3 + 1] * l[1] + nrm[v * 3 + 2] * l[2]);
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
                // D3D: material ambiente 0,5 x luz ambiente + material difuso x luz x N.L (medido nos B3D: difusa 1, ambiente 0,5);
                // nos materiais *_2X o resultado ainda e multiplicado por 2 (RGB_SCALE 2 abaixo)
                const float md = mc ? mc[c] : 1.f;
                col[v * 4 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(c)] = std::min(1.f, 0.5f * L.ambient[c] + md * L.diffuse[c] * d);
            }
            float a = (mc && mat->alpha_mode != 0) ? mc[3] : 1.f;
            if (valpha && m.col.size() >= static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 4) a *= m.col[v * 4 + 3];
            col[v * 4 + 3] = a;
        }
        const unsigned t = (mat && mat->texture >= 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(mat->texture) < tex.size()) ? tex[static_cast<std::size_t>(mat->texture)] : 0u;
        if (t) {
            glEnable(GL_TEXTURE_2D);
            glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, t);
            glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_TEXTURE_ENV_MODE, GL_COMBINE);
            glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_COMBINE_RGB, GL_MODULATE);
            glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_SOURCE0_RGB, GL_TEXTURE);
            glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_OPERAND0_RGB, GL_SRC_COLOR);
            glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_SOURCE1_RGB, GL_PRIMARY_COLOR);
            glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_OPERAND1_RGB, GL_SRC_COLOR);
            glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_COMBINE_ALPHA, GL_MODULATE);
            glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_SOURCE0_ALPHA, GL_TEXTURE);
            glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_OPERAND0_ALPHA, GL_SRC_ALPHA);
            glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_SOURCE1_ALPHA, GL_PRIMARY_COLOR);
            glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_OPERAND1_ALPHA, GL_SRC_ALPHA);
            glTexEnvf(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_RGB_SCALE, x2 ? 2.f : 1.f);
        } else {
            glDisable(GL_TEXTURE_2D);
            for (std::uint32_t v = 0; v < nv; ++v) for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) col[v * 4 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(c)] = std::min(1.f, col[v * 4 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(c)] * (x2 ? 2.f : 1.f));
        }
        glVertexPointer(3, GL_FLOAT, 0, pos.data());
        glColorPointer(4, GL_FLOAT, 0, col.data());
        if (!m.uv.empty()) { glEnableClientState(GL_TEXTURE_COORD_ARRAY); glTexCoordPointer(2, GL_FLOAT, 0, m.uv.data()); }
        else glDisableClientState(GL_TEXTURE_COORD_ARRAY);
        glDrawElements(GL_TRIANGLES, static_cast<GLsizei>(m.idx.size()), GL_UNSIGNED_INT, m.idx.data());
    }
    glPopMatrix();
}

}  // namespace

void actor_gl_upload(const Actor& a, ActorGL& g, float aniso) {
    actor_gl_release(g);
    g.part_tex.resize(a.parts.size());
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < a.parts.size(); ++i) upload_scene(a.parts[i].scene, g.part_tex[i], aniso);
    if (a.has_weapon) upload_scene(a.weapon.scene, g.weapon_tex, aniso);
    g.uploaded = true;
}

void actor_gl_release(ActorGL& g) {
    for (auto& v : g.part_tex) for (unsigned t : v) if (t) { GLuint id = t; glDeleteTextures(1, &id); }
    for (unsigned t : g.weapon_tex) if (t) { GLuint id = t; glDeleteTextures(1, &id); }
    g.part_tex.clear();
    g.weapon_tex.clear();
    g.uploaded = false;
}

void actor_gl_draw(const Actor& a, const ActorGL& g, const ActorLight& L, bool blend_pass) {
    if (!g.uploaded) return;
    gl_single_texture_unit();
    // v21: matriz de textura identidade (defesa: nenhum estado de outro desenho pode deslocar as UVs dos personagens)
    glMatrixMode(GL_TEXTURE); glLoadIdentity(); glMatrixMode(GL_MODELVIEW);
    glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
    glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
    glDisable(GL_CULL_FACE);                              // dupla face: cabelos/barbas sao folhas, e os espelhos (Z do modelo, X da projecao) se anulam
    glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_TEXTURE_ENV_MODE, GL_MODULATE);
    if (blend_pass) { glEnable(GL_BLEND); glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA); glDepthMask(GL_FALSE); glDisable(GL_ALPHA_TEST); }
    else { glDisable(GL_BLEND); glDepthMask(GL_TRUE); glEnable(GL_ALPHA_TEST); glAlphaFunc(GL_GREATER, 0.5f); }
    glEnableClientState(GL_VERTEX_ARRAY);
    glEnableClientState(GL_COLOR_ARRAY);
    glDisableClientState(GL_NORMAL_ARRAY);
    float m[16];
    a.model_matrix(m);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < a.parts.size() && i < g.part_tex.size(); ++i) draw_part(a.parts[i], g.part_tex[i], m, L, blend_pass);
    if (a.has_weapon) { float w[16]; a.weapon_matrix(w); draw_part(a.weapon, g.weapon_tex, w, L, blend_pass); }
    glDisableClientState(GL_COLOR_ARRAY);
    glDisableClientState(GL_TEXTURE_COORD_ARRAY);
    glDisable(GL_ALPHA_TEST);
    glDisable(GL_CULL_FACE);
    glDepthMask(GL_TRUE);
    glDisable(GL_BLEND);
    glTexEnvf(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_RGB_SCALE, 1.f);
    glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_TEXTURE_ENV_MODE, GL_MODULATE);
    glColor4f(1, 1, 1, 1);
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// v20: desenho dos atores (actor.h) com OpenGL 1.x: skinning na CPU (Scene::skin), luz difusa simples por vertice
// (a demo ilumina personagens com uma luz direcional + ambiente; os mapas ja vem com a luz pronta nos lightmaps),
// textura modulada pela luz, corte de alfa (cabelos, barba) e mistura nos materiais ALPHABLEND.
#pragma once
#include <vector>

#include "actor.h"

namespace f3v {

struct ActorGL {
    std::vector<std::vector<unsigned>> part_tex;      // por parte: textura do OpenGL de cada textura da cena
    std::vector<unsigned> weapon_tex;
    bool uploaded = false;
};

struct ActorLight {
    float dir[3] = {-0.45f, -0.8f, 0.4f};             // direcao da luz (para onde ela vai), no mundo
    float ambient[3] = {0.9f, 0.9f, 0.95f};            // luz ambiente (o material ambiente da demo e 0,5)
    float diffuse[3] = {0.75f, 0.72f, 0.65f};
};

void actor_gl_upload(const Actor& a, ActorGL& g, float aniso);
void actor_gl_release(ActorGL& g);
// desenha com a camera ja montada (matriz MODELVIEW = camera)
void actor_gl_draw(const Actor& a, const ActorGL& g, const ActorLight& light, bool blend_pass);

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/analyze.cpp

```cpp
#include "analyze.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

namespace {

struct Out {
    std::string s;
    void f(const char* fmt, ...)
#if defined(__GNUC__)
        __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)))
#endif
    {
        va_list ap;
        va_start(ap, fmt);
        va_list ap2;
        va_copy(ap2, ap);
        const int n = std::vsnprintf(nullptr, 0, fmt, ap);
        va_end(ap);
        std::vector<char> buf(static_cast<std::size_t>(n > 0 ? n : 0) + 1);
        if (n > 0) std::vsnprintf(buf.data(), buf.size(), fmt, ap2);
        va_end(ap2);
        s += buf.data();
        s += '\n';
    }
};

std::string fmt(const char* f, double a = 0, double b = 0, double c = 0) {
    char buf[160];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, f, a, b, c);
    return buf;
}

Vec3 jpos(const Mat4& m) { return Vec3{m.m[12], m.m[13], m.m[14]}; }
double dist(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) {
    const double dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y, dz = a.z - b.z;
    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
}
double dist3(const float* a, const float* b) {
    const double dx = static_cast<double>(a[0]) - b[0], dy = static_cast<double>(a[1]) - b[1], dz = static_cast<double>(a[2]) - b[2];
    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
}
double seg_dist(const double p[3], const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) {
    const double ab[3] = {double(b.x) - a.x, double(b.y) - a.y, double(b.z) - a.z};
    const double ap[3] = {p[0] - a.x, p[1] - a.y, p[2] - a.z};
    const double l2 = ab[0] * ab[0] + ab[1] * ab[1] + ab[2] * ab[2];
    double t = l2 > 1e-18 ? (ap[0] * ab[0] + ap[1] * ab[1] + ap[2] * ab[2]) / l2 : 0.0;
    t = std::max(0.0, std::min(1.0, t));
    const double c[3] = {a.x + t * ab[0], a.y + t * ab[1], a.z + t * ab[2]};
    return std::sqrt((p[0] - c[0]) * (p[0] - c[0]) + (p[1] - c[1]) * (p[1] - c[1]) + (p[2] - c[2]) * (p[2] - c[2]));
}
double pct(std::vector<double>& v, double p) {
    if (v.empty()) return 0;
    std::sort(v.begin(), v.end());
    const std::size_t i = std::min(v.size() - 1, static_cast<std::size_t>(p * static_cast<double>(v.size() - 1) + 0.5));
    return v[i];
}
void skin_all(Scene& s, std::vector<std::vector<float>>& pos) {
    pos.assign(s.meshes.size(), {});
    std::vector<float> nrm;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.meshes.size(); ++i) s.skin(static_cast<int>(i), pos[i], nrm);
}
bool pow2(std::uint32_t v) { return v && !(v & (v - 1)); }
const char* verdict(const PoseStats& p) {
    if (p.nonfinite > 0) return "ERRO: valores invalidos (NaN/inf)";
    if (p.edge_p95 > 2.0 || p.edge_p99 > 4.0) return "SUSPEITO: esticamento forte";
    return "ok";
}

}  // namespace

PoseStats measure_pose(Scene& s, int clip, float t) {
    PoseStats st;
    if (s.meshes.empty()) return st;
    s.evaluate(-1, 0.f);
    std::vector<std::vector<float>> bind;
    skin_all(s, bind);
    std::vector<Vec3> jb;
    for (const Mat4& w : s.joint_world) jb.push_back(jpos(w));
    s.evaluate(clip, t);
    std::vector<std::vector<float>> pose;
    skin_all(s, pose);

    float bmn[3] = {0, 0, 0}, bmx[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    bool any = false;
    for (std::size_t mi = 0; mi < pose.size(); ++mi)
        for (std::size_t v = 0; v + 2 < pose[mi].size(); v += 3) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
                const float x = pose[mi][v + static_cast<std::size_t>(i)], b = bind[mi][v + static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
                if (!std::isfinite(x)) { ++st.nonfinite; continue; }
                if (!any) { st.bb_min[i] = st.bb_max[i] = x; bmn[i] = bmx[i] = b; }
                else { st.bb_min[i] = std::min(st.bb_min[i], x); st.bb_max[i] = std::max(st.bb_max[i], x); bmn[i] = std::min(bmn[i], b); bmx[i] = std::max(bmx[i], b); }
            }
            any = true;
        }
    st.ok = any;
    double growth = 0, diag = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        const double sb = double(bmx[i]) - bmn[i], sp = double(st.bb_max[i]) - st.bb_min[i];
        diag += sb * sb;
        if (sb > 1e-9) growth = std::max(growth, sp / sb);
    }
    st.bbox_growth = growth;
    diag = std::sqrt(diag);

    std::size_t tris = 0;
    for (const Mesh& m : s.meshes) tris += m.idx.size() / 3;
    const std::size_t stride = std::max<std::size_t>(1, tris * 2 / 6000);
    std::vector<double> ratios;
    const double eps = 1e-9 + 1e-5 * diag;
    for (std::size_t mi = 0; mi < s.meshes.size(); ++mi) {
        const Mesh& m = s.meshes[mi];
        const std::uint32_t nv = m.nv();
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 2 < m.idx.size(); i += 3 * stride) {
            const std::uint32_t a = m.idx[i], b = m.idx[i + 1], c = m.idx[i + 2];
            if (a >= nv || b >= nv || c >= nv) continue;
            const std::uint32_t e[2][2] = {{a, b}, {b, c}};
            for (const auto& ed : e) {
                const double lb = dist3(&bind[mi][ed[0] * 3], &bind[mi][ed[1] * 3]);
                const double lp = dist3(&pose[mi][ed[0] * 3], &pose[mi][ed[1] * 3]);
                if (lb > eps && std::isfinite(lp)) ratios.push_back(lp / lb);
            }
        }
    }
    st.edges = static_cast<int>(ratios.size());
    if (!ratios.empty()) {
        std::size_t gt2 = 0;
        for (double r : ratios) if (r > 2.0) ++gt2;
        st.edge_gt2 = static_cast<double>(gt2) / static_cast<double>(ratios.size());
        st.edge_p50 = pct(ratios, 0.50);
        st.edge_p95 = pct(ratios, 0.95);
        st.edge_p99 = pct(ratios, 0.99);
    }
    for (std::size_t j = 0; j < s.joint_world.size() && j < jb.size(); ++j)
        st.max_joint_shift = std::max(st.max_joint_shift, dist(jpos(s.joint_world[j]), jb[j]));
    return st;
}

double estimate_mesh_scale(Scene& s, double* err_now, double* err_best, int* samples) {
    if (err_now) *err_now = 0;
    if (err_best) *err_best = 0;
    if (samples) *samples = 0;
    if (s.joints.empty()) return 0;
    s.evaluate(-1, 0.f);
    std::vector<Vec3> pj;
    for (const Mat4& w : s.joint_world) pj.push_back(jpos(w));
    std::vector<int> child(s.joints.size(), -1);
    for (std::size_t j = 0; j < s.joints.size(); ++j) {
        const int p = s.joints[j].parent;
        if (p >= 0 && p < static_cast<int>(s.joints.size()) && child[static_cast<std::size_t>(p)] < 0) child[static_cast<std::size_t>(p)] = static_cast<int>(j);
    }
    struct Sample { double p[3]; int joint; };
    std::vector<Sample> sm;
    std::size_t total = 0;
    for (const Mesh& m : s.meshes) if (m.has_skin) total += m.nv();
    const std::size_t stride = std::max<std::size_t>(1, total / 2000);
    std::size_t counter = 0;
    for (std::size_t mi = 0; mi < s.meshes.size(); ++mi) {
        const Mesh& m = s.meshes[mi];
        if (!m.has_skin) continue;
        for (std::uint32_t v = 0; v < m.nv(); ++v, ++counter) {
            if (counter % stride) continue;
            float wsum = 0, wbest = 0;
            int kbest = -1;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                const float w = m.weights[v * 4 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(k)];
                if (w <= 0) continue;
                wsum += w;
                if (w > wbest) { wbest = w; kbest = k; }
            }
            if (kbest < 0 || wbest < 0.9f * wsum) continue;
            const int j = s.bone_to_joint(static_cast<int>(mi), m.joints[v * 4 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(kbest)]);
            if (j < 0) continue;
            Sample x;
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) x.p[i] = static_cast<double>(m.pos[v * 3 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i)]) * s.mesh_scale;
            x.joint = j;
            sm.push_back(x);
        }
    }
    if (samples) *samples = static_cast<int>(sm.size());
    if (sm.size() < 20) return 0;
    auto err = [&](double f) {
        double tot = 0;
        for (const Sample& x : sm) {
            const double p[3] = {x.p[0] * f, x.p[1] * f, x.p[2] * f};
            const std::size_t j = static_cast<std::size_t>(x.joint);
            const Vec3& a = pj[j];
            const Vec3& b = child[j] >= 0 ? pj[static_cast<std::size_t>(child[j])] : pj[j];
            tot += seg_dist(p, a, b);
        }
        return tot / static_cast<double>(sm.size());
    };
    const double lo = std::log(0.02), hi = std::log(50.0);
    const int steps = 240;
    double best_e = 1e300, best_f = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= steps; ++i) {
        const double f = std::exp(lo + (hi - lo) * i / steps);
        const double e = err(f);
        if (e < best_e) { best_e = e; best_f = f; }
    }
    const double step = (hi - lo) / steps;
    const double c = std::log(best_f);
    for (int i = -20; i <= 20; ++i) {
        const double f = std::exp(c + step * i / 20.0);
        const double e = err(f);
        if (e < best_e) { best_e = e; best_f = f; }
    }
    if (err_now) *err_now = err(1.0);
    if (err_best) *err_best = best_e;
    return best_f;
}

std::string analyze_scene(Scene& s, const std::string& source) {
    Out hd, o;
    std::vector<std::string> warn;
    const std::size_t nj = s.joints.size();
    auto add_warn = [&warn](const std::string& w) { if (std::find(warn.begin(), warn.end(), w) == warn.end()) warn.push_back(w); };
    std::set<std::string> jnames;
    for (const Joint& j : s.joints) jnames.insert(j.name);

    // ---- texturas / materiais
    o.f("[TEXTURAS] %zu", s.textures.size());
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.textures.size(); ++i) {
        const Texture& t = s.textures[i];
        int amin = 255, amax = 0;
        const std::size_t px = t.rgba.size() / 4, st = std::max<std::size_t>(1, px / 4096);
        for (std::size_t p = 0; p < px; p += st) { const int a = t.rgba[p * 4 + 3]; amin = std::min(amin, a); amax = std::max(amax, a); }
        o.f("  #%zu %-28s %ux%u  %s  alfa %d..%d  %zu bytes%s", i, t.name.c_str(), t.w, t.h, pow2(t.w) && pow2(t.h) ? "potencia de 2" : "NAO potencia de 2 (o visualizador redimensiona)",
            px ? amin : 0, px ? amax : 0, t.rgba.size(), t.rgba.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(t.w) * t.h * 4 ? "  ERRO: tamanho dos pixels inconsistente" : "");
        if (t.rgba.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(t.w) * t.h * 4) add_warn("textura #" + std::to_string(i) + ": tamanho dos pixels inconsistente");
    }
    o.f("[MATERIAIS] %zu", s.materials.size());
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.materials.size(); ++i) {
        const Material& m = s.materials[i];
        const bool has = m.texture >= 0 && m.texture < static_cast<int>(s.textures.size());
        o.f("  #%zu %-28s textura=%s cor=(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f) alfa_modo=%d dupla_face=%d", i, m.name.c_str(), has ? s.textures[static_cast<std::size_t>(m.texture)].name.c_str() : "(nenhuma)",
            m.color[0], m.color[1], m.color[2], m.color[3], m.alpha_mode, m.double_sided);
    }

    // ---- malhas
    std::size_t total_v = 0, total_t = 0;
    o.f("[MALHAS] %zu   (escala extra aplicada pelo visualizador: x%.5f)", s.meshes.size(), static_cast<double>(s.mesh_scale));
    for (std::size_t mi = 0; mi < s.meshes.size(); ++mi) {
        const Mesh& m = s.meshes[mi];
        const std::uint32_t nv = m.nv();
        total_v += nv;
        total_t += m.idx.size() / 3;
        float mn[3] = {0, 0, 0}, mx[3] = {0, 0, 0};
        for (std::uint32_t v = 0; v < nv; ++v)
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
                const float x = m.pos[v * 3 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i)] * s.mesh_scale;
                if (v == 0) mn[i] = mx[i] = x; else { mn[i] = std::min(mn[i], x); mx[i] = std::max(mx[i], x); }
            }
        const bool has_mat = m.material >= 0 && m.material < static_cast<int>(s.materials.size());
        o.f("  #%zu %-26s material=%s  vertices=%u  triangulos=%zu  pele=%s", mi, m.name.c_str(), has_mat ? s.materials[static_cast<std::size_t>(m.material)].name.c_str() : "(nenhum)", nv, m.idx.size() / 3, m.has_skin ? "sim" : "nao");
        if (!has_mat) add_warn("malha '" + m.name + "' sem material");
        o.f("      caixa: min(%.4f, %.4f, %.4f) max(%.4f, %.4f, %.4f) tamanho(%.4f, %.4f, %.4f)", mn[0], mn[1], mn[2], mx[0], mx[1], mx[2], mx[0] - mn[0], mx[1] - mn[1], mx[2] - mn[2]);
        std::size_t bad_idx = 0, degenerate = 0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 2 < m.idx.size(); i += 3) {
            const std::uint32_t a = m.idx[i], b = m.idx[i + 1], c = m.idx[i + 2];
            if (a >= nv || b >= nv || c >= nv) { ++bad_idx; continue; }
            if (a == b || b == c || a == c) { ++degenerate; continue; }
            const float* pa = &m.pos[a * 3]; const float* pb = &m.pos[b * 3]; const float* pc = &m.pos[c * 3];
            const double u[3] = {double(pb[0]) - pa[0], double(pb[1]) - pa[1], double(pb[2]) - pa[2]}, w[3] = {double(pc[0]) - pa[0], double(pc[1]) - pa[1], double(pc[2]) - pa[2]};
            const double cx = u[1] * w[2] - u[2] * w[1], cy = u[2] * w[0] - u[0] * w[2], cz = u[0] * w[1] - u[1] * w[0];
            if (cx * cx + cy * cy + cz * cz < 1e-20) ++degenerate;
        }
        o.f("      indices: %zu fora do intervalo, %zu triangulos degenerados", bad_idx, degenerate);
        if (bad_idx) add_warn("malha '" + m.name + "': " + std::to_string(bad_idx) + " triangulos com indice invalido");
        if (m.idx.size() / 3 && degenerate * 100 > m.idx.size() / 3) add_warn("malha '" + m.name + "': mais de 1% de triangulos degenerados");
        if (m.uv.size() == static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 2 && nv) {
            float umin = m.uv[0], umax = m.uv[0], vmin = m.uv[1], vmax = m.uv[1];
            std::size_t outside = 0;
            for (std::uint32_t v = 0; v < nv; ++v) {
                const float u = m.uv[v * 2], w = m.uv[v * 2 + 1];
                umin = std::min(umin, u); umax = std::max(umax, u); vmin = std::min(vmin, w); vmax = std::max(vmax, w);
                if (u < -0.001f || u > 1.001f || w < -0.001f || w > 1.001f) ++outside;
            }
            o.f("      UV: u %.3f..%.3f  v %.3f..%.3f  fora de [0,1]: %zu vertices (repeticao de textura se > 0)", umin, umax, vmin, vmax, outside);
        } else {
            o.f("      UV: ausentes ou com tamanho inconsistente");
            add_warn("malha '" + m.name + "' sem UV valida");
        }
        if (m.nrm.size() == static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 3 && nv) {
            double lmin = 1e9, lmax = 0;
            std::size_t off = 0;
            for (std::uint32_t v = 0; v < nv; ++v) {
                const double l = std::sqrt(double(m.nrm[v * 3]) * m.nrm[v * 3] + double(m.nrm[v * 3 + 1]) * m.nrm[v * 3 + 1] + double(m.nrm[v * 3 + 2]) * m.nrm[v * 3 + 2]);
                lmin = std::min(lmin, l); lmax = std::max(lmax, l);
                if (std::fabs(l - 1.0) > 0.05) ++off;
            }
            o.f("      normais: comprimento %.3f..%.3f, fora de 1+-0.05: %zu", lmin, lmax, off);
        }
        if (m.has_skin) {
            std::size_t badsum = 0, unmapped = 0, noinfl = 0;
            double smin = 1e9, smax = 0, ssum = 0;
            int maxinfl = 0;
            std::map<int, std::size_t> dom;
            std::set<std::string> missing;
            for (std::uint32_t v = 0; v < nv; ++v) {
                double sum = 0, wbest = 0;
                int n = 0, jbest = -1;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    const float w = m.weights[v * 4 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(k)];
                    if (w <= 0) continue;
                    ++n; sum += w;
                    const std::uint16_t bi = m.joints[v * 4 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(k)];
                    const int j = s.bone_to_joint(static_cast<int>(mi), bi);
                    if (j < 0) { ++unmapped; missing.insert(bi < m.bones.size() ? m.bones[bi] : "(indice " + std::to_string(bi) + ")"); }
                    else if (w > wbest) { wbest = w; jbest = j; }
                }
                if (n == 0) ++noinfl;
                smin = std::min(smin, sum); smax = std::max(smax, sum); ssum += sum;
                if (std::fabs(sum - 1.0) > 0.01) ++badsum;
                maxinfl = std::max(maxinfl, n);
                if (jbest >= 0) ++dom[jbest];
            }
            o.f("      pesos: soma %.3f..%.3f (media %.3f), soma fora de 1+-0.01: %zu, maximo de influencias por vertice: %d, vertices sem influencia: %zu", smin, smax, nv ? ssum / nv : 0.0, badsum, maxinfl, noinfl);
            o.f("      ossos citados pela malha: %zu, influencias sem junta correspondente: %zu", m.bones.size(), unmapped);
            std::string alias;
            for (const std::string& b : m.bones) {
                const int j = s.find_joint(b);
                if (j >= 0 && s.joints[static_cast<std::size_t>(j)].name != b) alias += (alias.empty() ? "" : ", ") + b + "->" + s.joints[static_cast<std::size_t>(j)].name;
            }
            if (!alias.empty()) o.f("      ossos casados por variacao de nome (sufixo/maiusculas): %s", alias.c_str());
            if (!missing.empty()) {
                std::string l;
                for (const std::string& n : missing) l += (l.empty() ? "" : ", ") + n;
                o.f("      ossos SEM junta: %s", l.c_str());
                add_warn("malha '" + m.name + "': ossos sem junta no esqueleto: " + l);
            }
            if (noinfl) add_warn("malha '" + m.name + "': " + std::to_string(noinfl) + " vertices sem influencia (ficam parados no bind)");
            if (badsum * 50 > nv) add_warn("malha '" + m.name + "': mais de 2% dos vertices com soma de pesos diferente de 1");
            std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t, int>> top;
            for (const auto& kv : dom) top.push_back({kv.second, kv.first});
            std::sort(top.rbegin(), top.rend());
            std::string l;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < top.size() && i < 8; ++i) l += (i ? ", " : "") + s.joints[static_cast<std::size_t>(top[i].second)].name + "=" + std::to_string(top[i].first);
            o.f("      juntas dominantes (vertices): %s%s", l.c_str(), top.size() > 8 ? ", ..." : "");
        }
    }

    // ---- esqueleto
    s.evaluate(-1, 0.f);
    o.f("[ESQUELETO] %zu juntas", nj);
    std::vector<int> depth(nj, 0);
    int roots = 0, maxdepth = 0;
    std::vector<double> lens;
    std::vector<Vec3> bindpos;
    for (const Mat4& w : s.joint_world) bindpos.push_back(jpos(w));
    bool const_off = nj > 0;
    double off0[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    for (std::size_t j = 0; j < nj; ++j) {
        const Joint& jt = s.joints[j];
        if (jt.parent < 0) ++roots; else if (jt.parent < static_cast<int>(j)) { depth[j] = depth[static_cast<std::size_t>(jt.parent)] + 1; lens.push_back(dist(bindpos[j], bindpos[static_cast<std::size_t>(jt.parent)])); }
        else add_warn("junta '" + jt.name + "' tem pai com indice maior que o dela (hierarquia fora de ordem)");
        maxdepth = std::max(maxdepth, depth[j]);
        const Mat4& k = s.joint_skin[j];
        double rd = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) rd = std::max(rd, std::fabs(double(k.m[c * 4 + r]) - (c == r ? 1.0 : 0.0)));
        const double tr[3] = {k.m[12], k.m[13], k.m[14]};
        if (j == 0) { off0[0] = tr[0]; off0[1] = tr[1]; off0[2] = tr[2]; }
        if (rd > 1e-3 || std::fabs(tr[0] - off0[0]) > 1e-3 || std::fabs(tr[1] - off0[1]) > 1e-3 || std::fabs(tr[2] - off0[2]) > 1e-3) const_off = false;
        if (j < 160) {
            const double ql = std::sqrt(double(jt.q[0]) * jt.q[0] + double(jt.q[1]) * jt.q[1] + double(jt.q[2]) * jt.q[2] + double(jt.q[3]) * jt.q[3]);
            o.f("  %3zu %-26s pai=%3d t(%.4f,%.4f,%.4f) |q|=%.3f s(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f) mundo-bind(%.4f,%.4f,%.4f) mundo*ibm: rot-dev %.5f transl(%.4f,%.4f,%.4f)", j, jt.name.c_str(), jt.parent, jt.t[0], jt.t[1], jt.t[2], ql,
                jt.s[0], jt.s[1], jt.s[2], bindpos[j].x, bindpos[j].y, bindpos[j].z, rd, tr[0], tr[1], tr[2]);
            if (std::fabs(ql - 1.0) > 0.01) add_warn("junta '" + jt.name + "': quaternion de bind nao normalizado");
        }
    }
    if (nj > 160) o.f("  ... (%zu juntas nao listadas)", nj - 160);
    double lmin = 0, lmax = 0, lavg = 0;
    if (!lens.empty()) { lmin = *std::min_element(lens.begin(), lens.end()); lmax = *std::max_element(lens.begin(), lens.end()); for (double l : lens) lavg += l; lavg /= static_cast<double>(lens.size()); }
    o.f("  raizes: %d, profundidade maxima: %d, comprimento de osso (bind): min %.4f media %.4f max %.4f", roots, maxdepth, lmin, lavg, lmax);
    if (nj && const_off && (std::fabs(off0[0]) > 1e-5 || std::fabs(off0[1]) > 1e-5 || std::fabs(off0[2]) > 1e-5)) {
        o.f("  AVISO: mundo*ibm = deslocamento CONSTANTE (%.4f, %.4f, %.4f) em todas as juntas: a pose de bind skinada = malha + esse deslocamento "
            "(posicionamento inicial do GR2; o conversor v12 compensa, F3M do v11 nao).", off0[0], off0[1], off0[2]);
        add_warn(fmt("pose de bind deslocada de forma constante (%.4f, %.4f, %.4f); reconverter com o v12 corrige", off0[0], off0[1], off0[2]));
    } else if (nj) {
        double worst = 0;
        for (std::size_t j = 0; j < nj; ++j) for (int i = 12; i < 15; ++i) worst = std::max(worst, std::fabs(double(s.joint_skin[j].m[i])));
        if (worst > 1e-3) add_warn(fmt("mundo*ibm no bind difere da identidade (translacao max %.4f): esqueleto e ibm inconsistentes", worst));
    }

    // ---- escala malha x esqueleto
    if (nj && !s.meshes.empty()) {
        o.f("[ESCALA MALHA x ESQUELETO]");
        float mn[3] = {1e30f, 1e30f, 1e30f}, mx[3] = {-1e30f, -1e30f, -1e30f};
        bool any = false;
        for (const Mesh& m : s.meshes) for (std::uint32_t v = 0; v < m.nv(); ++v) { any = true; for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) { const float x = m.pos[v * 3 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i)] * s.mesh_scale; mn[i] = std::min(mn[i], x); mx[i] = std::max(mx[i], x); } }
        float jn[3] = {1e30f, 1e30f, 1e30f}, jx[3] = {-1e30f, -1e30f, -1e30f};
        for (const Vec3& p : bindpos) { const float c[3] = {p.x, p.y, p.z}; for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) { jn[i] = std::min(jn[i], c[i]); jx[i] = std::max(jx[i], c[i]); } }
        if (any) o.f("  tamanho da malha (x%.5f aplicado): (%.4f, %.4f, %.4f)   tamanho da caixa dos ossos: (%.4f, %.4f, %.4f)", static_cast<double>(s.mesh_scale), mx[0] - mn[0], mx[1] - mn[1], mx[2] - mn[2], jx[0] - jn[0], jx[1] - jn[1], jx[2] - jn[2]);
        double en = 0, eb = 0;
        int ns = 0;
        const double f = estimate_mesh_scale(s, &en, &eb, &ns);
        if (f <= 0) {
            o.f("  estimativa por ajuste: sem dados suficientes (%d vertices de peso ~1)", ns);
        } else {
            o.f("  estimativa por ajuste (%d vertices de peso dominante vs o segmento do osso dono): fator EXTRA f = %.4f  (1 = ja correto)", ns, f);
            o.f("  erro medio ate o osso: com f=1: %.4f   com f=%.4f: %.4f   (unidades do esqueleto)", en, f, eb);
            o.f("  referencia: 100/1024 = %.5f  (hipotese do conversor v12 para F3M do v11)", kMeshScaleHypothesis);
            if (f < 0.85 || f > 1.18) {
                o.f("  AVISO: a malha NAO esta na escala do esqueleto. Na pose de bind parece certa, mas qualquer animacao gira os vertices em torno de pivos errados.");
                o.f("         Teste no visualizador: tecla N (aplica f estimado), M (alterna 1/10.24) ou , . (ajuste fino); ou reconverta com o v12.");
                add_warn(fmt("malha fora da escala do esqueleto: fator extra estimado %.4f (esperado ~1.0)", f));
            } else {
                o.f("  ok: escala coerente com o esqueleto.");
            }
        }
    }

    // ---- animacoes
    o.f("[ANIMACOES] %zu", s.clips.size());
    int suspicious = 0;
    for (std::size_t ci = 0; ci < s.clips.size() && ci < 120; ++ci) {
        const Clip& c = s.clips[ci];
        int cnt[3] = {0, 0, 0};
        std::size_t keys = 0;
        std::set<std::string> with, unmatched;
        float tmax = 0;
        for (const Channel& ch : c.channels) {
            if (ch.path < 3) ++cnt[ch.path];
            keys += ch.times.size();
            if (!ch.times.empty()) tmax = std::max(tmax, ch.times.back());
            if (s.find_joint(ch.bone) >= 0) with.insert(ch.bone); else unmatched.insert(ch.bone);
        }
        o.f("  #%zu %-44s dur %.3fs (ultima chave %.3fs)  canais T%d R%d S%d  chaves %zu  ossos sem junta: %zu  juntas sem canal: %zu", ci, c.name.c_str(), static_cast<double>(c.duration), static_cast<double>(tmax), cnt[0], cnt[1], cnt[2], keys, unmatched.size(), nj - with.size());
        if (!unmatched.empty() && unmatched.size() * 2 > c.channels.size()) add_warn("animacao '" + c.name + "': a maioria dos canais nao casa com as juntas");
        if (!s.meshes.empty() && nj) {
            bool bad = false;
            for (double fr : {0.25, 0.50, 0.75}) {
                const PoseStats p = measure_pose(s, static_cast<int>(ci), c.duration * static_cast<float>(fr));
                o.f("      t=%2.0f%%: caixa x%.2f  arestas p50 %.2f p95 %.2f p99 %.2f  >2x %.1f%%  deslocamento max de junta %.4f  [%s]", fr * 100, p.bbox_growth, p.edge_p50, p.edge_p95, p.edge_p99, p.edge_gt2 * 100, p.max_joint_shift, verdict(p));
                if (std::string(verdict(p)) != "ok") bad = true;
            }
            if (bad) ++suspicious;
        }
    }
    if (s.clips.size() > 120) o.f("  ... (%zu animacoes nao listadas)", s.clips.size() - 120);
    if (suspicious) add_warn(std::to_string(suspicious) + " de " + std::to_string(s.clips.size()) + " animacoes com esticamento suspeito (arestas p95 > 2x ou p99 > 4x do comprimento no bind)");
    s.evaluate(-1, 0.f);

    // ---- cabecalho + resumo
    hd.f("=== ANALISE DO MODELO: %s%s%s ===", s.model_name.empty() ? "(sem nome)" : s.model_name.c_str(), source.empty() ? "" : "  arquivo: ", source.c_str());
    hd.f("texturas %zu | materiais %zu | malhas %zu (%zu vertices, %zu triangulos) | juntas %zu | animacoes %zu", s.textures.size(), s.materials.size(), s.meshes.size(), total_v, total_t, nj, s.clips.size());
    hd.f("[RESUMO] %zu aviso(s)%s", warn.size(), warn.empty() ? ": nenhum problema detectado pelas verificacoes automaticas" : ":");
    for (const std::string& w : warn) hd.f("  - %s", w.c_str());
    hd.s += "\n";
    return hd.s + o.s;
}

std::string analyze_pose(Scene& s, int clip, float t, bool bind_mode) {
    Out o;
    const bool use = !bind_mode && clip >= 0 && clip < static_cast<int>(s.clips.size());
    if (use) o.f("pose: animacao #%d \"%s\" t=%.3f/%.3fs", clip, s.clips[static_cast<std::size_t>(clip)].name.c_str(), static_cast<double>(t), static_cast<double>(s.clips[static_cast<std::size_t>(clip)].duration));
    else o.f("pose: BIND (sem animacao)");
    const PoseStats p = measure_pose(s, use ? clip : -1, t);
    if (!p.ok) { o.f("  sem malha para medir"); return o.s; }
    o.f("  caixa: min(%.4f, %.4f, %.4f) max(%.4f, %.4f, %.4f)  crescimento vs bind x%.2f", p.bb_min[0], p.bb_min[1], p.bb_min[2], p.bb_max[0], p.bb_max[1], p.bb_max[2], p.bbox_growth);
    o.f("  arestas (%d amostras): p50 %.2f p95 %.2f p99 %.2f  >2x %.1f%%   deslocamento max de junta %.4f   escala extra x%.5f   [%s]", p.edges, p.edge_p50, p.edge_p95, p.edge_p99, p.edge_gt2 * 100, p.max_joint_shift, static_cast<double>(s.mesh_scale), verdict(p));
    return o.s;
}

std::string dump_bones(Scene& s, int clip, float t) {
    Out o;
    const std::size_t nj = s.joints.size();
    if (!nj) { o.f("ossos: o modelo nao tem esqueleto"); return o.s; }
    s.evaluate(-1, 0.f);
    std::vector<Vec3> bind;
    for (const Mat4& w : s.joint_world) bind.push_back(jpos(w));
    const bool use = clip >= 0 && clip < static_cast<int>(s.clips.size());
    s.evaluate(use ? clip : -1, t);
    o.f("ossos (%zu), pose: %s", nj, use ? s.clips[static_cast<std::size_t>(clip)].name.c_str() : "bind");
    double worst = 0;
    std::size_t wj = 0;
    float mn[3] = {1e30f, 1e30f, 1e30f}, mx[3] = {-1e30f, -1e30f, -1e30f};
    for (std::size_t j = 0; j < nj; ++j) {
        const Vec3 p = jpos(s.joint_world[j]);
        const double sh = dist(p, bind[j]);
        if (sh > worst) { worst = sh; wj = j; }
        const float c[3] = {p.x, p.y, p.z};
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) { mn[i] = std::min(mn[i], c[i]); mx[i] = std::max(mx[i], c[i]); }
        const int par = s.joints[j].parent;
        const double len = par >= 0 && par < static_cast<int>(nj) ? dist(p, jpos(s.joint_world[static_cast<std::size_t>(par)])) : 0.0;
        o.f("  %3zu %-26s pai=%3d pos(%.4f, %.4f, %.4f)  deslocamento vs bind %.4f  comprimento ate o pai %.4f", j, s.joints[j].name.c_str(), par, p.x, p.y, p.z, sh, len);
    }
    o.f("  caixa dos ossos: min(%.4f, %.4f, %.4f) max(%.4f, %.4f, %.4f); maior deslocamento: %s (%.4f)", mn[0], mn[1], mn[2], mx[0], mx[1], mx[2], s.joints[wj].name.c_str(), worst);
    return o.s;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/analyze.h

```cpp
// Analise de modelos F3M: texto para o log do visualizador e para a ferramenta f3v_analyze.
// Tudo aqui e portatil (so C++ padrao). As funcoes REAVALIAM a pose da cena (Scene::evaluate): depois de chama-las,
// quem desenha deve avaliar a pose desejada de novo (o visualizador ja faz isso a cada quadro).
#pragma once
#include <string>

#include "scene.h"

namespace f3v {

// Hipotese de trabalho (ver docs/ACHADOS_DEMO.md): a geometria do B3D vem em unidades ~10,24x maiores que o esqueleto do GR2.
constexpr double kMeshScaleHypothesis = 100.0 / 1024.0;

struct PoseStats {
    bool ok = false;                          // havia malha para medir
    float bb_min[3] = {0, 0, 0}, bb_max[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    double bbox_growth = 0;                   // maior razao (tamanho da caixa na pose / tamanho no bind) entre os eixos
    double edge_p50 = 0, edge_p95 = 0, edge_p99 = 0, edge_gt2 = 0;   // razao comprimento da aresta pose/bind e fracao > 2x
    int edges = 0, nonfinite = 0;
    double max_joint_shift = 0;               // maior deslocamento de uma junta em relacao ao bind (unidades do esqueleto)
};

// clip < 0 = pose de bind. Se `bind_cache` != nullptr reaproveita as posicoes de bind (uma lista por malha).
PoseStats measure_pose(Scene& s, int clip, float t);

// Fator EXTRA f tal que (malha * f) encaixa melhor nos ossos que a controlam. 1 = escala ja correta; 0 = sem dados.
// err_now = erro medio com f=1, err_best = erro medio em f* (distancia ate o segmento do osso, unidades do esqueleto).
double estimate_mesh_scale(Scene& s, double* err_now = nullptr, double* err_best = nullptr, int* samples = nullptr);

std::string analyze_scene(Scene& s, const std::string& source = "");                 // relatorio completo
std::string analyze_pose(Scene& s, int clip, float t, bool bind_mode);               // resumo da pose atual (tecla P)
std::string dump_bones(Scene& s, int clip, float t);                                 // ossos na pose atual (tecla K)

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/analyze_main.cpp

```cpp
// f3v_analyze: gera o MESMO relatorio do log do visualizador, sem abrir janela.
//   f3v_analyze modelo.f3m [esqueleto_ou_animacoes.f3m ...] [--scale=X] [--out=relatorio.txt]
// Util para mandar o relatorio de um modelo sem enviar o arquivo do jogo.
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "analyze.h"
#include "f3m.h"
#include "scene.h"

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    std::vector<std::string> files;
    std::string out;
    float scale = 1.f;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (!std::strncmp(argv[i], "--scale=", 8)) scale = static_cast<float>(std::atof(argv[i] + 8));
        else if (!std::strncmp(argv[i], "--out=", 6)) out = argv[i] + 6;
        else files.push_back(argv[i]);
    }
    if (files.empty()) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "uso: f3v_analyze modelo.f3m [esqueleto_ou_animacoes.f3m ...] [--scale=X] [--out=relatorio.txt]\n");
        return 2;
    }
    f3v::Scene scene;
    for (const std::string& path : files) {
        f3v::F3MFile f;
        std::string err;
        if (!f3v::load_f3m_file(path, f, err)) { std::fprintf(stderr, "erro em %s: %s\n", path.c_str(), err.c_str()); return 1; }
        const f3v::LoadReport r = scene.add(std::move(f));
        std::fprintf(stderr, "%s: %s\n", path.c_str(), r.message.c_str());
    }
    scene.mesh_scale = scale;
    const std::string text = f3v::analyze_scene(scene, files[0]);
    std::fputs(text.c_str(), stdout);
    if (!out.empty()) {
        std::FILE* fp = std::fopen(out.c_str(), "wb");
        if (!fp) { std::fprintf(stderr, "nao consegui gravar %s\n", out.c_str()); return 1; }
        std::fwrite(text.data(), 1, text.size(), fp);
        std::fclose(fp);
    }
    return 0;
}
```

## viewer/src/audio.cpp

```cpp
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#include <mmsystem.h>

#include "audio.h"

#include <cstring>

namespace f3v {

namespace {
constexpr int kBuffers = 4;
constexpr int kFrames = 1024;        // ~23 ms por buffer: clique responde rapido, sem falhas
std::string lower(std::string s) { for (char& c : s) if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'A' + 'a'); return s; }
std::string strip_ext(const std::string& s) { const std::size_t d = s.find_last_of('.'); return (d != std::string::npos && lower(s.substr(d)) == ".wav") ? s.substr(0, d) : s; }
}  // namespace

bool Audio::init(Loader loader, Log* log) {
    shutdown();
    loader_ = std::move(loader);
    log_ = log;
    WAVEFORMATEX wf;
    std::memset(&wf, 0, sizeof wf);
    wf.wFormatTag = WAVE_FORMAT_PCM;
    wf.nChannels = 2;
    wf.nSamplesPerSec = kMixRate;
    wf.wBitsPerSample = 16;
    wf.nBlockAlign = 4;
    wf.nAvgBytesPerSec = kMixRate * 4;
    HANDLE ev = CreateEventA(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
    HWAVEOUT dev = nullptr;
    const MMRESULT r = waveOutOpen(&dev, WAVE_MAPPER, &wf, reinterpret_cast<DWORD_PTR>(ev), 0, CALLBACK_EVENT);
    if (r != MMSYSERR_NOERROR) {
        CloseHandle(ev);
        if (log_) log_->linef("som: waveOutOpen falhou (codigo %u): jogo sem som", static_cast<unsigned>(r));
        return false;
    }
    dev_ = dev;
    event_ = ev;
    stop_ = false;
    running_ = true;
    th_ = std::thread([this]() { run(); });
    if (log_) log_->line("som: mixer proprio 44100 Hz estereo (waveOut, 4 x 23 ms)");
    return true;
}

void Audio::run() {
    HWAVEOUT dev = static_cast<HWAVEOUT>(dev_);
    std::vector<std::int16_t> mem(static_cast<std::size_t>(kBuffers) * kFrames * 2, 0);
    WAVEHDR hdr[kBuffers];
    for (int i = 0; i < kBuffers; ++i) {
        std::memset(&hdr[i], 0, sizeof(WAVEHDR));
        hdr[i].lpData = reinterpret_cast<LPSTR>(mem.data() + static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * kFrames * 2);
        hdr[i].dwBufferLength = kFrames * 4;
        waveOutPrepareHeader(dev, &hdr[i], sizeof(WAVEHDR));
        mixer_.mix(reinterpret_cast<std::int16_t*>(hdr[i].lpData), kFrames);
        waveOutWrite(dev, &hdr[i], sizeof(WAVEHDR));
    }
    while (!stop_) {
        WaitForSingleObject(static_cast<HANDLE>(event_), 50);
        for (int i = 0; i < kBuffers; ++i) {
            if (!(hdr[i].dwFlags & WHDR_DONE) || stop_) continue;
            mixer_.mix(reinterpret_cast<std::int16_t*>(hdr[i].lpData), kFrames);
            waveOutWrite(dev, &hdr[i], sizeof(WAVEHDR));
        }
    }
    waveOutReset(dev);
    for (int i = 0; i < kBuffers; ++i) waveOutUnprepareHeader(dev, &hdr[i], sizeof(WAVEHDR));
}

void Audio::shutdown() {
    if (!running_) return;
    stop_ = true;
    if (event_) SetEvent(static_cast<HANDLE>(event_));
    if (th_.joinable()) th_.join();
    waveOutClose(static_cast<HWAVEOUT>(dev_));
    CloseHandle(static_cast<HANDLE>(event_));
    dev_ = event_ = nullptr;
    running_ = false;
}

std::shared_ptr<const Sound> Audio::get(const std::string& name_in) {
    const std::string name = strip_ext(name_in);
    const std::string key = lower(name);
    const auto it = cache_.find(key);
    if (it != cache_.end()) return it->second;
    std::shared_ptr<const Sound> s;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> data;
    if (loader_ && loader_(name, data)) {
        auto snd = std::make_shared<Sound>();
        std::string err;
        if (decode_wav(data.data(), data.size(), *snd, err)) s = snd;
        else if (log_) log_->linef("som %s: %s", name.c_str(), err.c_str());
    } else if (log_) log_->linef("som %s: nao existe na demo", name.c_str());
    cache_[key] = s;
    return s;
}

void Audio::sfx(const std::string& name, float volume) { if (running_) if (auto s = get(name)) mixer_.play(s, volume); }

void Audio::music(const std::vector<std::string>& intro, const std::string& loop) {
    if (!running_) return;
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const Sound>> seq;
    for (const std::string& n : intro) seq.push_back(get(n));
    mixer_.set_music(std::move(seq), get(loop));
}

void Audio::ambient(const std::string& name) { if (running_) mixer_.set_ambient(get(name)); }

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
public:
    using Loader = std::function<bool(const std::string& name, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out)>;
    ~Audio() { shutdown(); }
    bool init(Loader loader, Log* log);                 // abre a placa de som (44100 Hz estereo)
    void shutdown();
    bool ok() const { return running_; }
    void sfx(const std::string& name, float volume = 1.f);

private:

    std::thread th_;

};

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/audio_mix.cpp

```cpp
#include "audio_mix.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>

namespace f3v {

namespace {
std::uint32_t rd32(const std::uint8_t* p) { return p[0] | (p[1] << 8) | (p[2] << 16) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[3]) << 24); }
std::uint16_t rd16(const std::uint8_t* p) { return static_cast<std::uint16_t>(p[0] | (p[1] << 8)); }
}  // namespace

bool decode_wav(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t size, Sound& out, std::string& err) {
    out.pcm.clear();
    if (!d || size < 12 || std::memcmp(d, "RIFF", 4) || std::memcmp(d + 8, "WAVE", 4)) { err = "nao e RIFF/WAVE"; return false; }
    std::uint16_t fmt = 0, ch = 0, bits = 0;
    std::uint32_t rate = 0;
    const std::uint8_t* data = nullptr;
    std::size_t data_len = 0;
    std::size_t p = 12;
    while (p + 8 <= size) {
        const std::uint32_t len = rd32(d + p + 4);
        const std::size_t body = p + 8;
        const std::size_t avail = std::min<std::size_t>(len, size - body);
        if (!std::memcmp(d + p, "fmt ", 4) && avail >= 16) { fmt = rd16(d + body); ch = rd16(d + body + 2); rate = rd32(d + body + 4); bits = rd16(d + body + 14); }
        else if (!std::memcmp(d + p, "data", 4)) { data = d + body; data_len = avail; }
        p = body + len + (len & 1);
    }
    if (fmt != 1) { err = "formato " + std::to_string(fmt) + " (so PCM)"; return false; }
    if ((ch != 1 && ch != 2) || (bits != 8 && bits != 16) || rate < 4000 || rate > 192000) { err = "WAV nao suportado (" + std::to_string(ch) + " canais, " + std::to_string(bits) + " bits, " + std::to_string(rate) + " Hz)"; return false; }
    if (!data) { err = "WAV sem dados"; return false; }
    const std::size_t bps = bits / 8, in_frames = data_len / (bps * ch);
    if (in_frames == 0) { err = "WAV vazio"; return false; }
    auto sample = [&](std::size_t f, int c) -> float {
        const std::uint8_t* s = data + (f * ch + static_cast<std::size_t>(c < ch ? c : 0)) * bps;
        return bits == 16 ? static_cast<float>(static_cast<std::int16_t>(rd16(s))) : static_cast<float>((static_cast<int>(s[0]) - 128) << 8);
    };
    const double step = static_cast<double>(rate) / kMixRate;
    const std::size_t out_frames = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::floor(static_cast<double>(in_frames - 1) / step)) + 1;
    out.pcm.resize(out_frames * 2);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < out_frames; ++i) {
        const double x = static_cast<double>(i) * step;
        const std::size_t f0 = static_cast<std::size_t>(x);
        const std::size_t f1 = std::min(f0 + 1, in_frames - 1);
        const float t = static_cast<float>(x - static_cast<double>(f0));
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; ++c) {
            const float v = sample(f0, c) * (1.f - t) + sample(f1, c) * t;
            out.pcm[2 * i + static_cast<std::size_t>(c)] = static_cast<std::int16_t>(std::clamp(v, -32768.f, 32767.f));
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void Mixer::play(std::shared_ptr<const Sound> s, float volume) {
    if (!s || s->pcm.empty()) return;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    if (sfx_.size() >= 24) sfx_.erase(sfx_.begin());          // limite de vozes: descarta a mais antiga
    sfx_.push_back(Voice{std::move(s), 0, volume});
}

void Mixer::set_music(std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const Sound>> intro, std::shared_ptr<const Sound> loop) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    intro.erase(std::remove_if(intro.begin(), intro.end(), [](const std::shared_ptr<const Sound>& s) { return !s || s->pcm.empty(); }), intro.end());
    music_seq_ = std::move(intro);
    music_loop_ = (loop && !loop->pcm.empty()) ? std::move(loop) : nullptr;
    music_idx_ = music_pos_ = 0;
    music_on_ = !music_seq_.empty() || music_loop_;
}

void Mixer::stop_music() { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); music_on_ = false; music_seq_.clear(); music_loop_.reset(); }
void Mixer::set_ambient(std::shared_ptr<const Sound> s) { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); amb_ = Voice{std::move(s), 0, 1.f}; amb_on_ = amb_.s && !amb_.s->pcm.empty(); }
void Mixer::stop_ambient() { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); amb_on_ = false; amb_.s.reset(); }
void Mixer::stop_all() { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); sfx_.clear(); music_on_ = false; music_seq_.clear(); music_loop_.reset(); amb_on_ = false; amb_.s.reset(); }
void Mixer::set_volumes(float master, float music, float sfx, float ambient) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    master_ = std::clamp(master, 0.f, 1.f); vmusic_ = std::clamp(music, 0.f, 1.f); vsfx_ = std::clamp(sfx, 0.f, 1.f); vamb_ = std::clamp(ambient, 0.f, 1.f);
}
void Mixer::set_muted(bool m) { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); muted_ = m; }
bool Mixer::muted() const { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); return muted_; }
std::size_t Mixer::active_voices() const { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); return sfx_.size() + (music_on_ ? 1 : 0) + (amb_on_ ? 1 : 0); }

void Mixer::mix(std::int16_t* out, std::size_t frames) {
    std::vector<float> acc(frames * 2, 0.f);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
        // efeitos
        const float gs = master_ * vsfx_;
        for (Voice& v : sfx_) {
            const std::size_t n = std::min(frames, v.s->frames() - v.pos);
            const std::int16_t* src = v.s->pcm.data() + 2 * v.pos;
            const float g = gs * v.vol;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2 * n; ++i) acc[i] += src[i] * g;
            v.pos += n;
        }
        sfx_.erase(std::remove_if(sfx_.begin(), sfx_.end(), [](const Voice& v) { return v.pos >= v.s->frames(); }), sfx_.end());
        // musica: segmentos em sequencia, depois o loop, sem buraco entre eles
        if (music_on_) {
            const float g = master_ * vmusic_;
            std::size_t done = 0;
            int guard = 0;
            while (done < frames && music_on_ && guard++ < 16) {
                const Sound* cur = music_idx_ < music_seq_.size() ? music_seq_[music_idx_].get() : music_loop_.get();
                if (!cur) { music_on_ = false; break; }
                const std::size_t n = std::min(frames - done, cur->frames() - music_pos_);
                const std::int16_t* src = cur->pcm.data() + 2 * music_pos_;
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2 * n; ++i) acc[2 * done + i] += src[i] * g;
                done += n;
                music_pos_ += n;
                if (music_pos_ >= cur->frames()) { music_pos_ = 0; if (music_idx_ < music_seq_.size()) ++music_idx_; }
            }
        }
        // ambiente em loop
        if (amb_on_) {
            const float g = master_ * vamb_;
            std::size_t done = 0;
            while (done < frames) {
                const std::size_t n = std::min(frames - done, amb_.s->frames() - amb_.pos);
                const std::int16_t* src = amb_.s->pcm.data() + 2 * amb_.pos;
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2 * n; ++i) acc[2 * done + i] += src[i] * g;
                done += n;
                amb_.pos += n;
                if (amb_.pos >= amb_.s->frames()) amb_.pos = 0;
            }
        }
        if (muted_) std::fill(acc.begin(), acc.end(), 0.f);
    }
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < frames * 2; ++i) {
        float v = acc[i];
        if (v > 30000.f || v < -30000.f) v = 32767.f * std::tanh(v / 32767.f);     // limitador suave contra estouro quando muitos sons somam
        out[i] = static_cast<std::int16_t>(std::clamp(v, -32768.f, 32767.f));
        const int a = std::abs(static_cast<int>(out[i]));
        if (a > peak_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) peak_.store(a, std::memory_order_relaxed);   // v21: medidor de pico (log: o som sai mesmo?)
    }
}

}  // namespace f3v
```
