```cpp
// v20: mixer de audio proprio (portavel; a saida para a placa de som fica em audio.cpp, com winmm).
// Saida fixa: 44100 Hz, estereo, 16 bits. Entradas: WAV PCM 8/16 bits, mono/estereo, qualquer taxa (reamostragem linear).
// Canais logicos: efeitos (varios ao mesmo tempo), musica (segmentos em sequencia + segmento em loop, como a peca MA1_PS2.pce
// da demo: start MA1_A1, MA1_A2, loop MA1_A3) e ambiente (um som em loop, ex. AMB_WindBlowing).
#pragma once
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

constexpr int kMixRate = 44100;

struct Sound {                       // ja convertido para 44100 Hz estereo int16
    std::vector<std::int16_t> pcm;   // intercalado L, R
    std::size_t frames() const { return pcm.size() / 2; }
};

// Decodifica um .wav (RIFF/WAVE PCM) e converte para o formato do mixer. false + err se nao suportado.
bool decode_wav(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, Sound& out, std::string& err);

class Mixer {
public:
    void play(std::shared_ptr<const Sound> s, float volume = 1.f);       // efeito (one-shot)
    void set_music(std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const Sound>> intro, std::shared_ptr<const Sound> loop);
    void stop_music();
    void set_ambient(std::shared_ptr<const Sound> s);
    void stop_ambient();
    void stop_all();
    void set_volumes(float master, float music, float sfx, float ambient);
    void set_muted(bool m);
    bool muted() const;
    void mix(std::int16_t* out, std::size_t frames);                     // chamado pela thread de audio
    // v21: maior amostra (0..32767) desde a ultima leitura; zera ao ler. 0 = nada tocou nesse intervalo.
    int take_peak() { return peak_.exchange(0); }
    std::size_t active_voices() const;

private:
    struct Voice { std::shared_ptr<const Sound> s; std::size_t pos = 0; float vol = 1.f; };
    mutable std::mutex m_;
    std::vector<Voice> sfx_;
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const Sound>> music_seq_;
    std::shared_ptr<const Sound> music_loop_;
    std::size_t music_idx_ = 0, music_pos_ = 0;
    bool music_on_ = false;
    Voice amb_;
    bool amb_on_ = false;
    float master_ = 1.f, vmusic_ = 0.8f, vsfx_ = 1.f, vamb_ = 0.7f;
    std::atomic<int> peak_{0};
    bool muted_ = false;
};

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// v20: leitor de .b3d em C++ (ver b3d.h). Mesma logica do tools/py/f3vb/b3d.py, mais a variante "64 com pesos".
#include "b3d.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>

namespace f3v {

namespace {

struct R {
    const std::uint8_t* d; std::size_t n; std::size_t p = 0;
    std::string* err;
    bool bad = false;
    bool need(std::size_t k) { if (bad) return false; if (p + k > n) { bad = true; if (err && err->empty()) *err = "fim do arquivo em " + std::to_string(p) + " (precisava de " + std::to_string(k) + " bytes)"; return false; } return true; }
    void fail(const std::string& m) { if (!bad) { bad = true; if (err && err->empty()) *err = m; } }
    std::uint8_t u8() { if (!need(1)) return 0; return d[p++]; }
    std::uint16_t u16() { if (!need(2)) return 0; const std::uint16_t v = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(d[p] | (d[p + 1] << 8)); p += 2; return v; }
    std::uint32_t u32() { if (!need(4)) return 0; std::uint32_t v; std::memcpy(&v, d + p, 4); p += 4; return v; }
    std::int32_t s32() { return static_cast<std::int32_t>(u32()); }
    float f32() { if (!need(4)) return 0; float v; std::memcpy(&v, d + p, 4); p += 4; return v; }
    std::string str16(std::size_t limit = 4096) {
        const std::uint16_t k = u16();
        if (bad) return "";
        if (k > limit) { fail("string de " + std::to_string(k) + " bytes em " + std::to_string(p - 2)); return ""; }
        if (!need(k)) return "";
        std::string s(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(d + p), k);
        p += k;
        return s;
    }
    std::vector<float> floats(std::size_t k) { std::vector<float> v(k); for (auto& x : v) x = f32(); return v; }
};

float fat(const std::uint8_t* p) { float v; std::memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }
std::int32_t iat(const std::uint8_t* p) { std::int32_t v; std::memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }

B3dMaterial material_top(R& r) {
    B3dMaterial m;
    m.id = r.str16(); m.name = r.str16();
    m.floats = r.floats(18);
    m.blend = r.str16(); m.type = r.str16();
    r.s32(); r.s32();
    return m;
}

B3dMaterial material44(R& r) {
    B3dMaterial m;
    m.name = r.str16(); m.id = r.str16();
    m.floats = r.floats(17);
    m.blend = r.str16(); m.type = r.str16();
    std::int32_t words[16];
    for (auto& w : words) w = r.s32();
    const std::int32_t nt = words[15];
    if (!r.bad && (nt < 0 || nt > 8)) { r.fail("contagem de texturas absurda (" + std::to_string(nt) + ") em " + std::to_string(r.p)); return m; }
    for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < nt && !r.bad; ++i) m.textures.push_back(r.str16());
    r.u32();
    return m;
}

// familia 64 a partir de r.p == inicio dos vertices; weighted = variante com pesos
bool surface64(R& r, std::int32_t nv, bool weighted, int nbones, B3dSurface& s, const std::vector<B3dMaterial>* tops) {
    if (nv < 0 || nv > 2000000 || !r.need(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 64)) return false;
    s.family = 64;
    s.weighted64 = weighted;
    const std::uint8_t* v = r.d + r.p;
    s.pos.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 3); s.nrm.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 3); s.col.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 4);
    s.uv0.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 2);
    if (!weighted) s.uv1.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 2);
    else { s.influences.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv)); s.bones_per_vertex = 1; }
    for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < nv; ++i) {
        const std::uint8_t* q = v + static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 64;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) { s.pos[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 3 + k] = fat(q + 4 * k); s.nrm[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 3 + k] = fat(q + 12 + 4 * k); }
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) s.col[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 4 + k] = fat(q + 24 + 4 * k);
        s.uv0[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 2] = fat(q + 44); s.uv0[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 2 + 1] = fat(q + 48);
        if (!weighted) { s.uv1[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 2] = fat(q + 52); s.uv1[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 2 + 1] = fat(q + 56); }
        else {
            const std::int32_t cnt = iat(q + 52), bone = iat(q + 56);
            const float w = fat(q + 60);
            if (cnt >= 1 && bone >= 0 && bone < nbones && w > 0) s.influences[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)].push_back({bone, w});
        }
    }
    r.p += static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 64;
    r.u32(); r.u32();
    s.lightmap = r.str16();
    const std::int32_t nt = r.s32();
    if (r.bad || nt < 0 || nt > 8) return false;
    std::vector<std::string> tex;
    for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < nt && !r.bad; ++i) tex.push_back(r.str16());
    B3dMaterial m;
    m.name = s.lightmap; m.blend = "OPAQUE"; m.textures = tex;
    // v20: o tipo de sombreamento (BASE_2X...) vem do material de mesmo nome na lista do topo do arquivo (so o id: o resto fica
    // como no conversor Python, para os .f3m continuarem iguais byte a byte)
    if (tops) for (const B3dMaterial& t : *tops) if (t.name == s.lightmap || t.id == s.lightmap) { m.id = t.id; break; }
    s.materials = {m};
    r.u32(); r.u8();
    const std::int32_t kk = r.s32();
    if (r.bad || kk < 0 || kk % 3 || r.p + static_cast<std::size_t>(kk) * 5 > r.n) return false;
    B3dSurface::Prim pr;
    pr.material = 0;
    pr.idx.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(kk));
    for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < kk; ++i) {
        const std::int32_t ix = iat(r.d + r.p + 4 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i));
        if (ix < 0 || ix >= std::max(nv, 1)) return false;
        pr.idx[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ix);
    }
    r.p += static_cast<std::size_t>(kk) * 4;
    r.p += static_cast<std::size_t>(kk);
    s.prims.push_back(std::move(pr));
    return !r.bad;
}

bool surface(R& r, int nbones, B3dSurface& s, const std::vector<B3dMaterial>* tops) {
    const std::size_t start = r.p;
    r.u8(); r.u8();
    const std::uint8_t vflag = r.u8();
    if (r.bad) return false;
    if (vflag == 1) {
        const std::int32_t nv = r.s32();
        if (nv < 0 || nv > 2000000) { r.fail("numVerts absurdo (" + std::to_string(nv) + ") na superficie em " + std::to_string(start)); return false; }
        r.s32();                                       // sizeOfVerts (44)
        if (!r.need(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 44)) return false;
        s.family = 44;
        s.pos.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 3); s.nrm.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 3); s.col.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 4); s.uv0.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 2);
        for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < nv; ++i) {
            const std::uint8_t* q = r.d + r.p + static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 44;
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) { s.pos[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 3 + k] = fat(q + 4 * k); s.nrm[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 3 + k] = fat(q + 12 + 4 * k); }
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) s.col[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 4 + k] = static_cast<float>(q[24 + k]) / 255.0f;
            s.uv0[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 2] = fat(q + 28); s.uv0[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 2 + 1] = fat(q + 32);
        }
        r.p += static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 44;
        const std::vector<float> bb = r.floats(6);
        if (r.bad) return false;
        if (nv) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) {
                float mn = s.pos[static_cast<std::size_t>(k)], mx = mn;
                for (std::int32_t i = 1; i < nv; ++i) { const float x = s.pos[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 3 + k]; mn = std::min(mn, x); mx = std::max(mx, x); }
                if (std::fabs(bb[static_cast<std::size_t>(k)] - mn) > 1e-4f || std::fabs(bb[static_cast<std::size_t>(k) + 3] - mx) > 1e-4f) { r.fail("caixa envolvente nao confere com as posicoes (superficie em " + std::to_string(start) + ")"); return false; }
            }
        }
        if (r.u8() == 1) {
            const std::int32_t bpv = r.s32();
            if (bpv < 0 || bpv > 16) { r.fail("bonesPerVertex absurdo (" + std::to_string(bpv) + ")"); return false; }
            if (!r.need(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * static_cast<std::size_t>(bpv) * 8)) return false;
            s.bones_per_vertex = bpv;
            s.influences.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv));
            const std::uint8_t* pr = r.d + r.p;
            for (std::int32_t v = 0; v < nv; ++v)
                for (std::int32_t k = 0; k < bpv; ++k) {
                    const std::size_t o = 8 * (static_cast<std::size_t>(k) * static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) + static_cast<std::size_t>(v));
                    const std::int32_t bi = iat(pr + o);
                    const float bw = fat(pr + o + 4);
                    if (bi >= 0 && bw > 0) s.influences[static_cast<std::size_t>(v)].push_back({bi, bw});
                }
            r.p += static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * static_cast<std::size_t>(bpv) * 8;
        }
        const std::int32_t nm = r.s32();
        if (r.bad || nm < 0 || nm > 64) { r.fail("numMaterials absurdo (" + std::to_string(nm) + ")"); return false; }
        for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < nm && !r.bad; ++i) s.materials.push_back(material44(r));
        for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < nm && !r.bad; ++i) { const std::string n = r.str16(); (void)n; }
        std::vector<std::int32_t> ml(static_cast<std::size_t>(nm)), fc(static_cast<std::size_t>(nm));
        for (auto& x : ml) x = r.s32();
        for (auto& x : fc) x = r.s32();
        for (std::int32_t mi = 0; mi < nm && !r.bad; ++mi) {
            const std::int32_t ni = ml[static_cast<std::size_t>(mi)];
            if (ni < 0 || ni % 3) { r.fail("lista de indices invalida (" + std::to_string(ni) + ")"); return false; }
            if (!r.need(2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(ni))) return false;
            B3dSurface::Prim p;
            p.material = mi;
            p.idx.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ni));
            for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < ni; ++i) {
                const std::uint32_t ix = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(r.d[r.p + 2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] | (r.d[r.p + 2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i) + 1] << 8));
                if (ix >= static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::max(nv, 1))) { r.fail("indice de vertice fora do intervalo"); return false; }
                p.idx[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] = ix;
            }
            r.p += 2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(ni);
            s.prims.push_back(std::move(p));
        }
        return !r.bad;
    }
    // familia 64. Tentativa A (terreno, como no Python): numVerts depois do byte de tipo.
    {
        R a = r;
        std::string ea;
        a.err = &ea;
        const std::int32_t nv = a.s32();
        B3dSurface sa;
        if (!a.bad && nv >= 0 && nv <= 2000000 && surface64(a, nv, false, nbones, sa, tops)) {
            std::string* keep = r.err;
            r = a;
            r.err = keep;                              // `a` apontava para o erro local da tentativa
            s = std::move(sa);
            return true;
        }
    }
    // Tentativa B (v20, "64 com pesos"): o byte que seria o tipo ja e o 1o byte de numVerts.
    {
        r.p -= 1;
        const std::int32_t nv = r.s32();
        if (r.bad || nv < 0 || nv > 2000000) { r.fail("numVerts absurdo (" + std::to_string(nv) + ") na superficie em " + std::to_string(start)); return false; }
        // a variante com pesos: (s32 n, s32 osso, f32 peso) em todos os vertices
        bool weighted = nbones > 0 && r.p + static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 64 <= r.n;
        for (std::int32_t i = 0; weighted && i < nv; ++i) {
            const std::uint8_t* q = r.d + r.p + static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 64;
            const std::int32_t c = iat(q + 52), b = iat(q + 56);
            if (c < 0 || c > 4 || b < -1 || b >= nbones) weighted = false;
        }
        if (!surface64(r, nv, weighted, nbones, s, tops)) { r.fail("superficie de 64 bytes nao decodificou (em " + std::to_string(start) + ")"); return false; }
        return true;
    }
}

bool node(R& r, B3dNode& n, int nbones, int depth, const std::vector<B3dMaterial>* tops) {
    while (!r.bad) {
        if (r.p >= r.n) { r.fail("arquivo terminou dentro de um no"); return false; }
        const std::uint8_t t = r.u8();
        if (t == 0x0B) return true;
        if (t == 0x0C) n.name = r.str16();
        else if (t == 0x0D) {
            r.str16();
            const std::uint8_t fl = r.u8();
            if (fl & 1) { n.has_t = true; for (float& x : n.t) x = r.f32(); }
            if (fl & 2) { n.has_r = true; for (float& x : n.r) x = r.f32(); }
            if (fl & 4) { n.has_s = true; for (float& x : n.s) x = r.f32(); }
        } else if (t == 0x0F || t == 0x19) {
            B3dSurface s;
            if (!surface(r, nbones, s, tops)) return false;
            n.surfaces.push_back(std::move(s));
        } else if (t == 0x1B) {
            const std::int32_t k = r.s32();
            if (k < 0 || k > 4096) { r.fail("lista de zonas absurda"); return false; }
            for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < k && !r.bad; ++i) r.str16();
        } else if (t == 0x0A || t == 0x13) {
            if (depth > 32) { r.fail("nos aninhados demais"); return false; }
            B3dNode c;
            if (!node(r, c, nbones, depth + 1, tops)) return false;
            n.children.push_back(std::move(c));
        } else { r.fail("token de no desconhecido " + std::to_string(t) + " em " + std::to_string(r.p - 1)); return false; }
    }
    return false;
}

}  // namespace

bool load_b3d(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, B3dModel& out, std::string& err) {
    out = B3dModel();
    err.clear();
    if (!data || size < 8 || std::memcmp(data, "B3D ", 4) != 0) { err = "nao comeca com 'B3D '"; return false; }
    out.signature.assign(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), 8);
    R r{data, size, 8, &err};
    while (r.p < size && !r.bad) {
        const std::uint8_t t = r.u8();
        if (t == 0x01) return true;
        if (t == 0x03) out.global_scale = r.f32();
        else if (t == 0x04) out.coordinate_scale = r.f32();
        else if (t == 0x05) out.coordinate_system = r.str16();
        else if (t == 0x06) { r.s32(); r.s32(); r.s32(); }
        else if (t == 0x16) r.s32();
        else if (t == 0x1C || t == 0x35) r.u8();
        else if (t == 0x07 || t == 0x0F || t == 0x10) out.materials.push_back(material_top(r));
        else if (t == 0x08 || t == 0x09) { r.u8(); r.str16(); r.str16(); r.u32(); r.u32(); }
        else if (t == 0x0E || t == 0x18) {
            B3dBone b;
            b.name = r.str16(); b.unk = r.u16(); b.flag = r.u8();
            if (b.flag) for (float& x : b.t) x = r.f32();
            if (b.flag == 3) for (float& x : b.r) x = r.f32();
            if (b.flag == 2) b.extra = r.f32();
            out.bones.push_back(std::move(b));
        } else if (t == 0x0A || t == 0x13) {
            B3dNode n;
            if (!node(r, n, static_cast<int>(out.bones.size()), 0, &out.materials)) break;
            out.roots.push_back(std::move(n));
        } else { r.fail("token de topo desconhecido " + std::to_string(t) + " em " + std::to_string(r.p - 1)); break; }
    }
    if (err.empty()) err = "arquivo terminou sem o token final 0x01";
    return false;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/b3d.h

```cpp
// v20: leitor de .b3d (modelos G3D_Model da Jefferson Engine) em C++, direto da memoria (do .grp).
// Porta do tools/py/f3vb/b3d.py (layouts medidos em arquivos reais; docs/specs/b3d.md) + uma variante nova medida no v20:
//   superficie "64 com pesos" (ex.: IT_MainMenu_boxcar, o vagao do menu): o cabecalho da superficie NAO tem o byte de tipo de
//   vertice (vem u8, u8 e logo numVerts) e os ultimos 12 bytes do vertice de 64 bytes sao (s32 1, s32 osso, f32 peso) em vez da
//   UV de lightmap. O leitor Python recusava esse arquivo ("numVerts absurdo").
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

struct B3dMaterial {
    std::string name, id, blend, type;
    std::vector<float> floats;                      // difusa4, ambiente4, especular4, emissiva4, brilho
    std::vector<std::string> textures;
};

struct B3dSurface {
    int family = 44;                                // 44 ou 64
    bool weighted64 = false;                        // variante "64 com pesos" (ver acima)
    std::vector<float> pos, nrm, col, uv0, uv1;     // nv*3, nv*3, nv*4 (0..1), nv*2, nv*2 (so familia 64 sem pesos)
    int bones_per_vertex = 0;
    std::vector<std::vector<std::pair<int, float>>> influences;   // por vertice: (osso, peso) com osso >= 0 e peso > 0
    std::vector<B3dMaterial> materials;
    std::string lightmap;
    struct Prim { int material = 0; std::vector<std::uint32_t> idx; };
    std::vector<Prim> prims;
    std::uint32_t nv() const { return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(pos.size() / 3); }
};

struct B3dNode {
    std::string name;
    bool has_t = false, has_r = false, has_s = false;
    float t[3] = {0, 0, 0}, r[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0}, s[3] = {1, 1, 1};   // r = eixo-angulo (graus)
    std::vector<B3dSurface> surfaces;
    std::vector<B3dNode> children;
};

struct B3dBone { std::string name; int unk = 0, flag = 0; float t[3] = {0, 0, 0}, r[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0}; float extra = 0; };

struct B3dModel {
    std::string signature, coordinate_system;
    float global_scale = 1, coordinate_scale = 0;
    std::vector<B3dMaterial> materials;
    std::vector<B3dBone> bones;
    std::vector<B3dNode> roots;
    template <class F> void each_surface(F&& f) const { for (const auto& r : roots) walk(r, f); }
    template <class F> static void walk(const B3dNode& n, F& f) { for (const auto& s : n.surfaces) f(n, s); for (const auto& c : n.children) walk(c, f); }
};

bool load_b3d(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, B3dModel& out, std::string& err);

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/chargen.cpp

```cpp
#include "chargen.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

namespace f3v {

const char* special_code(int s) {
    static const char* c[SPECIAL_COUNT] = {"ST", "PE", "EN", "CH", "IN", "AG", "LK"};
    return s >= 0 && s < SPECIAL_COUNT ? c[s] : "?";
}

bool Character::inc(int s) {
    if (s < 0 || s >= SPECIAL_COUNT || points <= 0 || special[static_cast<std::size_t>(s)] >= kMaxStat) return false;
    ++special[static_cast<std::size_t>(s)];
    --points;
    return true;
}

bool Character::dec(int s) {
    if (s < 0 || s >= SPECIAL_COUNT || special[static_cast<std::size_t>(s)] <= kMinStat) return false;
    --special[static_cast<std::size_t>(s)];
    ++points;
    return true;
}

bool Character::toggle_tag(int k) {
    if (k < 1 || k > kSkills) return false;
    if (tags.erase(k)) return true;
    if (static_cast<int>(tags.size()) >= kTags) return false;
    tags.insert(k);
    return true;
}

bool Character::toggle_trait(int t) {
    if (traits.erase(t)) return true;
    if (static_cast<int>(traits.size()) >= kMaxTraits) return false;
    traits.insert(t);
    return true;
}

int Character::skill_base(int k) const {
    if (k < 1 || k > kSkills) return 0;
    return skill_points[static_cast<std::size_t>(k - 1)] + (tags.count(k) ? kTagBonus : 0);
}

// Bonus dos atributos. Os dois prints da tela original dao, para todos 5: Firearms/Melee +50, o resto +15;
// para ST, PE, EN, CH, IN = 6 e AG, LK = 5: Firearms/Melee +50, Unarmed..Science +18, Security/Sneak +17, Steal +16.
// Conclusao certa: Firearms e Melee nao usam ST..IN (aqui 10 x AG); as outras somam 3 atributos (as que dao 18 so usam ST..IN,
// Security/Sneak usam 1 de AG/LK, Steal usa AG e LK). QUAIS atributos exatamente e hipotese (tematica); 2 casos nao bastam para separar.
int Character::skill_bonus(int k) const {
    const int st = special[S_ST], pe = special[S_PE], en = special[S_EN], ch = special[S_CH], in = special[S_IN], ag = special[S_AG], lk = special[S_LK];
    switch (k) {
        case 1: return 10 * ag;              // Firearms
        case 2: return 10 * ag;              // Melee
        case 3: return st + en + pe;         // Unarmed
        case 4: return ch + in + pe;         // Barter
        case 5: return ch + ch + in;         // Persuasion
        case 6: return ch + in + pe;         // Deception
        case 7: return in + pe + st;         // Mechanics
        case 8: return in + pe + en;         // Medic
        case 9: return en + pe + in;         // Outdoorsman
        case 10: return in + in + pe;        // Science
        case 11: return pe + in + ag;        // Security
        case 12: return pe + en + ag;        // Sneak
        case 13: return pe + ag + lk;        // Steal
        default: return 0;
    }
}

int Character::hit_points() const { return 100; }   // 100/100 nos dois prints (EN 5 e 6): nao depende de EN no inicio

std::string Character::derived(int i) const {
    const int st = special[S_ST], pe = special[S_PE], en = special[S_EN], ag = special[S_AG], lk = special[S_LK], in = special[S_IN];
    switch (i) {
        case 1: return std::to_string(20 + ag);                    // Action Points: 25 com AG 5 (os dois prints; 20+AG e hipotese)
        case 2: return std::to_string(25 + 25 * st);               // Carry Weight: 150 (ST 5), 175 (ST 6)
        case 3: return std::to_string(2 * pe);                     // Combat Sequence: 10, 12
        case 4: return std::to_string(lk) + "%";                   // Critical Chance: 5% com LK 5
        case 5: return "0";                                        // Evasion: 0 nos dois
        case 6: return std::to_string(en);                         // Healing Rate: 5, 6
        case 7: return "+" + std::to_string(st);                   // Melee Damage: +5, +6
        case 8: return std::to_string(40 + 3 * pe);                // Perception Range: 55, 58
        case 9: return "1/3";                                      // Perk Rate
        case 10: return std::to_string(5 + 2 * in) + "/1";         // Skill Rate: 15/1, 17/1
        case 11: return std::to_string(3 * st);                    // Throwing Range: 15, 18
        case 12: return "0%";                                      // Biological
        case 13: return "0%";                                      // Flash
        case 14: return "0%";                                      // Radiation
        default: return "";
    }
}

// .CRT = chunks (tag[4], u32 versao, u32 tamanho com cabecalho). GCRE: 7 x i32 SPECIAL, i32 1, 3 x i32, i32 idade, i32, i32, i32,
// i32 N, N x {i32 pericia (0-based), i32 pontos}. v4 (protótipo) traz so as pericias diferentes de 0; v5 (ficha salva) traz as 13.
bool Character::load_crt(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t size, bool take_special) {
    auto rd = [&](std::size_t o) -> std::int32_t { std::int32_t v; std::memcpy(&v, d + o, 4); return v; };
    std::size_t p = 0;
    while (d && p + 12 <= size) {
        std::uint32_t csize;
        std::memcpy(&csize, d + p + 8, 4);
        if (csize < 12 || p + csize > size) return false;
        if (!std::memcmp(d + p, "GCRE", 4)) {
            const std::size_t g = p + 12, end = p + csize;
            if (g + 64 > end) return false;
            if (take_special) for (int s = 0; s < SPECIAL_COUNT; ++s) special[static_cast<std::size_t>(s)] = std::clamp<int>(rd(g + 4 * static_cast<std::size_t>(s)), kMinStat, kMaxStat);
            const std::int32_t a = rd(g + 44);
            if (a >= 16 && a <= 99) age = a;
            const std::int32_t n = rd(g + 60);
            if (n < 0 || n > 64 || g + 64 + 8ull * static_cast<std::size_t>(n) > end) return false;
            skill_points.fill(0);
            for (std::int32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                const std::int32_t k = rd(g + 64 + 8 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i)), v = rd(g + 68 + 8 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i));
                if (k >= 0 && k < kSkills) skill_points[static_cast<std::size_t>(k)] = std::clamp<int>(v, 0, 300);
            }
            return true;
        }
        p += csize;
    }
    return false;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/chargen.h

```cpp
// Regras da criacao de personagem (CharacterGeneration.int). v20: deixam de copiar o Fallout 2.
// Base de evidencia (docs/JOGO.md, secao "Criacao de personagem"):
//   * Default_PC.CRT da demo (chunk GCRE v4): pericias iniciais Firearms 80, Melee 80, Unarmed 80, Persuasion 75, Medic 75; idade 21.
//   * Fichas salvas pelo jogo original (Documentos\F3\Characters\*.CRT, GCRE v5): 7 SPECIAL, idade, 13 pericias (pontos-base), tracos.
//   * Dois prints da tela original (todos 5 / ST..IN 6 + AG, LK 5): marcar uma pericia soma +20 na BASE; o TOTAL = base + bonus dos atributos.
//     Os atributos derivados abaixo reproduzem os dois prints exatamente (teste em tests/test_ui.cpp).
// O que ainda e hipotese esta marcado em cada formula.
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <set>
#include <string>

namespace f3v {

enum Special { S_ST = 0, S_PE, S_EN, S_CH, S_IN, S_AG, S_LK, SPECIAL_COUNT };   // prefixo S_: o windows.h define IN e OUT como macros vazias
const char* special_code(int s);                  // "ST", "PE"...

struct Character {
    std::string name = "None";                    // o jogo original comeca com "None" (texto 7 do .stf)
    bool female = false;
    int age = 21;                                 // Default_PC.CRT
    std::array<int, SPECIAL_COUNT> special{5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5};
    int points = 5;                               // pontos livres (print: CHAR POINTS 05)
    // pontos-base das 13 pericias, na ordem do arquivo .CRT e da tela: Firearms, Melee, Unarmed, Barter, Persuasion, Deception,
    // Mechanics, Medic, Outdoorsman, Science, Security, Sneak, Steal
    std::array<int, 13> skill_points{80, 80, 80, 0, 75, 0, 0, 75, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0};
    std::set<int> tags;                           // pericias marcadas (1..13), exatamente 3 para comecar
    std::set<int> traits;                         // tracos opcionais (ids dos botoes 11..18, 21..28), ate 2
    // v20: aparencia: indice escolhido em cada coluna (1 Body Type .. 7 Hair Color) da lista da tela; -1 = como o prototipo Default_PC
    std::array<int, 8> look{-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1};
    static constexpr int kMinStat = 1, kMaxStat = 10, kTags = 3, kMaxTraits = 2, kSkills = 13, kTagBonus = 20;
    bool inc(int s);                              // +1 num atributo (gasta 1 ponto); false se nao pode
    bool dec(int s);                              // -1 (devolve 1 ponto)
    bool toggle_tag(int skill);                   // false se ja ha 3 e tentou marcar outra
    bool toggle_trait(int trait);
    bool ready() const { return points == 0 && static_cast<int>(tags.size()) == kTags; }
    static int descriptor_text_id(int value) { return 40 + (value < 1 ? 1 : (value > 10 ? 10 : value)); }
    int skill_base(int skill) const;              // coluna "Base": pontos + 20 se marcada
    int skill_bonus(int skill) const;             // vem dos atributos
    int skill_total(int skill) const { return skill_base(skill) + skill_bonus(skill); }   // coluna "Total"
    static int skill_text_id(int skill) { return 82 + skill; }
    std::string derived(int index) const;          // index 1..14 (11 derivados + 3 resistencias), ja formatado como na tela ("+6", "1/3", "17/1", "5%")
    int hit_points() const;
    // Le SPECIAL, idade e pericias de um .CRT (protótipo GCRE v4 ou ficha salva v5). false se nao reconhecer.
    bool load_crt(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, bool take_special);
};

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/check_main.cpp

```cpp
// v20: F3VBCheck - confere a leitura DIRETA da demo original (resource.rht + .grp) e o carregador de mapas em C++.
//   F3VBCheck --demo <pasta da demo>                        -> le o indice, conta recursos por tipo, le todos os lumps
//   F3VBCheck --demo <pasta> --assets <original_assets>      -> + compara byte a byte com a copia extraida (esperado: todos iguais)
//   F3VBCheck --demo <pasta> --maps [--f3map <CONVERTED/maps>] -> monta todos os mapas em memoria (e compara com os .f3map do Python)
//   F3VBCheck --demo <pasta> --tudo                         -> v21: TUDO da demo sem abrir janela: cada script na VM (todas as publics),
//                                                              cada dialogo (percorre as respostas), animacoes e chao de cada personagem
//                                                              de cada mapa, e os sons (cabecalho de cada .wav)
//   F3VBCheck --demo <pasta> --models                       -> v20: monta os personagens/objetos 3D de TODAS as entidades de todos os mapas
//                                                              (.b3d + .gr2 + prototipos, direto dos .grp) e conta quantos deram certo
// Codigo de saida 0 = tudo certo. Portavel (Windows/Linux).
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "actor.h"
#include "ground.h"
#include "script_world.h"
#include "stf.h"
#include "f3map.h"
#include "map_build.h"
#include "vfs.h"

using namespace f3v;

namespace {

std::uint64_t fnv1a(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& d) {
    std::uint64_t h = 1469598103934665603ull;
    for (std::uint8_t b : d) { h ^= b; h *= 1099511628211ull; }
    return h;
}

int check_maps(const Vfs& v, const std::string& f3map_dir) {
    int bad = 0;
    std::size_t tris_total = 0, nostate = 0, maps = 0;
    for (const ResEntry* e : v.list(RT_MAP)) {
        MapData m;
        std::string err;
        MapBuildStats st;
        if (!build_map(v, e->name, m, err, &st)) { std::printf("  MAPA %-36s FALHOU: %s\n", e->name.c_str(), err.c_str()); ++bad; continue; }
        ++maps;
        std::size_t ns = 0;
        for (const MapTriList& tl : m.tris) if (tl.material == 0 && tl.page == 0 && tl.tex == 0) ns += tl.idx.size() / 3;
        tris_total += m.triangle_count();
        nostate += ns;
        std::string cmp;
        if (!f3map_dir.empty()) {
            MapData py;
            std::string e2;
            if (load_f3map_file(path_join(f3map_dir, e->name + ".f3map"), py, e2)) {
                const bool same = py.triangle_count() == m.triangle_count() && py.tris.size() == m.tris.size() && py.entities.size() == m.entities.size() &&
                                  py.blocks.size() == m.blocks.size() && py.textures.size() == m.textures.size() && py.nav.size() == m.nav.size() &&
                                  py.triggers.size() == m.triggers.size() && py.grid.size() == m.grid.size();
                bool idx_same = same;
                for (std::size_t i = 0; idx_same && i < m.tris.size(); ++i)
                    idx_same = m.tris[i].block == py.tris[i].block && m.tris[i].material == py.tris[i].material && m.tris[i].page == py.tris[i].page &&
                               m.tris[i].tex == py.tris[i].tex && m.tris[i].idx == py.tris[i].idx;
                cmp = idx_same ? " | igual ao .f3map do Python" : " | DIFERENTE do .f3map do Python";
                if (!idx_same) {
                    ++bad;
                    cmp += " (py: " + std::to_string(py.triangle_count()) + " tri, " + std::to_string(py.tris.size()) + " listas, " + std::to_string(py.entities.size()) + " ent)";
                }
            } else cmp = " | (sem .f3map do Python para comparar)";
        }
        std::printf("  MAPA %-36s blocos %4zu  tri %7zu  listas %4zu  ent %3zu  nos %5zu/%5zu fecham  sem_estado %zu%s\n", e->name.c_str(), m.blocks.size(),
                    m.triangle_count(), m.tris.size(), m.entities.size(), st.nodes_full, st.nodes, ns, cmp.c_str());
    }
    std::printf("mapas: %zu montados, %d com problema | triangulos %zu | sem estado %zu\n", maps, bad, tris_total, nostate);
    return bad;
}

// Entidade sem modelo desenhavel (porta sem malha, gatilho...) nao e erro: so conta. Erro = prototipo com modelo que nao montou.
int check_models(const Vfs& v) {
    std::size_t ents = 0, built = 0, nomodel = 0, parts = 0, anims = 0;
    int bad = 0;
    for (const ResEntry* e : v.list(RT_MAP)) {
        MapData m;
        std::string err;
        if (!build_map(v, e->name, m, err, nullptr)) continue;
        std::size_t ok = 0;
        for (const MapEntity& ent : m.entities) {
            ++ents;
            Actor a;
            if (build_actor(v, ent, a, err)) {
                ++built; ++ok; parts += a.parts.size();
                if (!a.clip_name.empty()) ++anims;
            } else if (err.find("sem modelo") != std::string::npos || err.find("nao encontrado") != std::string::npos) ++nomodel;
            else { ++bad; if (bad <= 15) std::printf("  %-36s %-40s FALHOU: %s\n", e->name.c_str(), ent.prototype.c_str(), err.c_str()); }
        }
        std::printf("  %-36s %3zu de %3zu entidades com modelo 3D\n", e->name.c_str(), ok, m.entities.size());
    }
    std::printf("modelos: %zu entidades, %zu montadas (%zu pecas, %zu com animacao parada), %zu sem modelo, %d falhas\n", ents, built, parts, anims, nomodel, bad);
    return bad;
}


// v21: conferencia completa (scripts + dialogos + animacoes + chao + sons). Cada linha diz OK/FALHA e o motivo.
int check_all(const Vfs& v, const std::string& demo) {
    int bad = 0;
    Stf stf;
    std::string err;
    const bool have_stf = stf.load_file(demo + "/English.stf", err) || stf.load_file(demo + "\\English.stf", err);
    std::printf("textos: English.stf %s\n", have_stf ? "ok" : ("FALHA: " + err).c_str());
    // --- scripts na VM
    std::size_t n = 0, loaded = 0, pub_ok = 0, pub_fail = 0, dlg = 0, dlg_ok = 0, dlg_lines = 0, dlg_choices = 0;
    std::map<std::string, int> missing;
    std::vector<const ResEntry*> scripts = v.list(RT_AMX);
    for (const ResEntry* e : v.list(RT_SMA)) scripts.push_back(e);         // os .sma da demo tambem sao bytecode (os dialogos estao neles)
    for (const ResEntry* e : scripts) {
        ++n;
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
        if (!v.read(*e, bytes, err)) { ++bad; std::printf("  script %s: FALHA lendo: %s\n", e->name.c_str(), err.c_str()); continue; }
        auto si = ScriptInstance::from_bytes(bytes, e->name, 1, 1234, err);
        if (!si) { ++bad; std::printf("  script %s: FALHA na VM: %s\n", e->name.c_str(), err.c_str()); continue; }
        ++loaded;
        const ScriptSurvey sv = survey_script(*si);
        pub_ok += sv.ran_ok; pub_fail += sv.ran_fail;
        for (const auto& kv : sv.unimplemented) missing[kv.first] += kv.second;
        for (const std::string& u : sv.unresolved) { ++bad; std::printf("  script %s: native sem registro: %s\n", e->name.c_str(), u.c_str()); }
        for (const std::string& f : sv.failures) std::printf("  script %s: public com erro: %s\n", e->name.c_str(), f.c_str());
        if (!sv.has_dialogue) continue;
        ++dlg;
        auto di = ScriptInstance::from_bytes(bytes, e->name, 1, 1234, err);
        if (!di) continue;
        DialogSession d(*di, have_stf ? &stf : nullptr);
        bool ok = d.start();
        for (int step = 0; ok && step < 40 && !d.finished() && !d.choices().empty(); ++step) ok = d.choose(0);   // sempre a 1a resposta
        if (ok) ++dlg_ok; else { ++bad; std::printf("  dialogo %s: FALHA: %s\n", e->name.c_str(), d.error().c_str()); }
        dlg_lines += d.lines().size(); dlg_choices += d.choices().size();
    }
    std::printf("scripts (.amx + .sma): %zu na demo, %zu carregados na VM | publics: %zu rodaram, %zu com erro | dialogos: %zu de %zu percorridos sem erro (%zu falas)\n",
                n, loaded, pub_ok, pub_fail, dlg_ok, dlg, dlg_lines);
    std::string ms;
    for (const auto& kv : missing) ms += (ms.empty() ? "" : ", ") + kv.first + " x" + std::to_string(kv.second);
    std::printf("natives ainda so registradas (sem efeito no jogo): %s\n", ms.empty() ? "nenhuma" : ms.c_str());
    // --- personagens: animacoes e chao, mapa por mapa
    for (const ResEntry* e : v.list(RT_MAP)) {
        MapData m;
        if (!build_map(v, e->name, m, err, nullptr)) continue;
        Ground g;
        g.build(m);
        int crit = 0, anim_full = 0, no_ground = 0;
        float worst = 0;
        std::string worst_name, miss;
        for (const MapEntity& ent : m.entities) {
            Actor a;
            if (!build_actor(v, ent, a, err)) continue;
            if (ent.kind != "CRT" || a.anim_length(AN_IDLE) <= 0.1f || a.clip_index[AN_WALK] < 0) continue;
            ++crit;
            bool all = true;
            for (int r = 0; r < AN_COUNT; ++r) if (a.clip_index[r] < 0) { all = false; miss += " " + ent.prototype + ":" + actor_anim_name(r); }
            if (all) ++anim_full;
            float gy;
            if (!g.height(ent.pos[0], ent.pos[2], ent.pos[1] + 0.5f, gy)) { ++no_ground; continue; }
            if (std::fabs(ent.pos[1] - gy) > std::fabs(worst)) { worst = ent.pos[1] - gy; worst_name = ent.prototype; }
        }
        std::printf("  %-34s chao %6zu tri | %2d personagens, %2d com as 6 animacoes, %d sem chao | maior diferenca do .map ao chao %.2f (%s)%s%s\n",
                    e->name.c_str(), g.triangles(), crit, anim_full, no_ground, worst, worst_name.c_str(), miss.empty() ? "" : " | faltam:", miss.c_str());
        if (no_ground) bad += no_ground;
    }
    // --- sons
    std::size_t wav = 0, wav_ok = 0;
    for (const ResEntry* e : v.list(RT_WAV)) {
        ++wav;
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> b;
        if (v.read(*e, b, err) && b.size() > 44 && !std::memcmp(b.data(), "RIFF", 4) && !std::memcmp(b.data() + 8, "WAVE", 4)) ++wav_ok;
        else if (wav - wav_ok <= 5) std::printf("  som %s: cabecalho nao e RIFF/WAVE\n", e->name.c_str());
    }
    std::printf("sons: %zu de %zu com cabecalho WAVE valido\n", wav_ok, wav);
    return bad;
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    std::string demo, assets, f3map_dir;
    bool maps = false, models = false, all = false;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        const std::string a = argv[i];
        auto next = [&]() -> std::string { return i + 1 < argc ? argv[++i] : ""; };
        if (a == "--demo") demo = next();
        else if (a == "--assets") assets = next();
        else if (a == "--maps") maps = true;
        else if (a == "--models") models = true;
        else if (a == "--tudo") all = true;
        else if (a == "--f3map") f3map_dir = next();
        else if (a == "-h" || a == "--help") { std::puts("uso: F3VBCheck --demo <pasta da demo> [--assets <original_assets>] [--maps [--f3map <pasta dos .f3map>]] [--models]"); return 0; }
    }
    if (demo.empty()) { std::puts("diga a pasta da demo: F3VBCheck --demo \"<pasta>\""); return 2; }
    Vfs v;
    std::string err;
    if (!v.open_demo(demo, err)) { std::printf("demo NAO abriu: %s\n", err.c_str()); return 1; }
    std::printf("demo: %s | %zu recursos em %zu .grp\n", demo.c_str(), v.size(), v.packs().size());
    std::map<std::string, int> by_type;
    for (const ResEntry& e : v.entries()) ++by_type[res_type_name(e.type)];
    for (const auto& kv : by_type) std::printf("  %-18s %5d\n", kv.first.c_str(), kv.second);
    int fails = 0;
    std::uint64_t bytes = 0;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> a, b;
    for (const ResEntry& e : v.entries()) { if (!v.read(e, a, err)) { ++fails; std::printf("  falha ao ler %s: %s\n", v.where(e).c_str(), err.c_str()); } bytes += a.size(); }
    std::printf("leitura direta: %zu recursos, %.1f MB, %d falhas\n", v.size(), static_cast<double>(bytes) / 1048576.0, fails);
    if (!assets.empty()) {
        Vfs x;
        if (!x.open_extracted(assets, err)) { std::printf("copia extraida NAO abriu: %s\n", err.c_str()); return 1; }
        int same = 0, diff = 0, missing = 0;
        for (const ResEntry& e : v.entries()) {
            const ResEntry* o = x.find_lump(v.packs()[e.pack], e.lump);
            if (!o) { ++missing; if (missing <= 5) std::printf("  sem par na copia: %s (%s)\n", v.where(e).c_str(), e.name.c_str()); continue; }
            if (!v.read(e, a, err) || !x.read(*o, b, err)) { ++diff; continue; }
            if (a.size() == b.size() && fnv1a(a) == fnv1a(b) && a == b) ++same;
            else { ++diff; if (diff <= 5) std::printf("  DIFERENTE: %s (%s) %zu x %zu bytes\n", v.where(e).c_str(), e.name.c_str(), a.size(), b.size()); }
            if (o->name != e.name && diff + missing < 5) std::printf("  nome diferente: %s vs %s\n", e.name.c_str(), o->name.c_str());
        }
        std::printf("comparacao com a copia extraida: %d iguais, %d diferentes, %d sem par (de %zu)\n", same, diff, missing, v.size());
        fails += diff + missing;
    }
    if (maps) fails += check_maps(v, f3map_dir);
    if (models) fails += check_models(v);
    if (all) fails += check_all(v, demo);
    std::puts(fails ? "RESULTADO: HA PROBLEMAS (veja acima)" : "RESULTADO: OK");
    return fails ? 1 : 0;
}
```

```cpp
#include "f3m.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

namespace f3v {
namespace {

struct Reader {
    const std::uint8_t* d;
    std::size_t n, p = 0;
    bool ok = true;
    bool need(std::size_t k) { if (!ok || k > n - p || p > n) { ok = false; } return ok; }
    template <class T> T get() {
        T v{};
        if (need(sizeof(T))) { std::memcpy(&v, d + p, sizeof(T)); p += sizeof(T); }
        return v;
    }
    void skip(std::size_t k) { if (need(k)) p += k; }
    std::string str() {
        const auto len = get<std::uint16_t>();
        std::string s;
        if (need(len)) { s.assign(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(d + p), len); p += len; }
        return s;
    }
    template <class T> bool vec(std::vector<T>& v, std::size_t count) {
        if (!ok) return false;
        if (count > (n - p) / sizeof(T)) { ok = false; return false; }      // nao ha bytes suficientes
        v.resize(count);
        if (count) std::memcpy(v.data(), d + p, count * sizeof(T));
        p += count * sizeof(T);
        return true;
    }
};

constexpr std::uint32_t kMaxItems = 1u << 22;

}  // namespace

bool load_f3m(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, F3MFile& f, std::string& err) {
    Reader r{data, size};
    f = F3MFile{};
    if (size < 4 || std::memcmp(data, "F3M1", 4) != 0) { err = "nao e um arquivo F3M1"; return false; }
    r.p = 4;
    f.flags = r.get<std::uint32_t>();
    const auto nt = r.get<std::uint32_t>(), nm = r.get<std::uint32_t>(), nme = r.get<std::uint32_t>(),
               nj = r.get<std::uint32_t>(), nc = r.get<std::uint32_t>();
    f.name = r.str();
    if (!r.ok || nt > kMaxItems || nm > kMaxItems || nme > kMaxItems || nj > 65535 || nc > kMaxItems) { err = "cabecalho invalido"; return false; }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nt && r.ok; ++i) {
        Texture t;
        t.name = r.str(); t.w = r.get<std::uint32_t>(); t.h = r.get<std::uint32_t>();
        if (!r.ok || t.w == 0 || t.h == 0 || t.w > 16384 || t.h > 16384) { err = "textura invalida"; return false; }
        if (!r.vec(t.rgba, static_cast<std::size_t>(t.w) * t.h * 4)) break;
        f.textures.push_back(std::move(t));
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nm && r.ok; ++i) {
        Material m;
        m.name = r.str(); m.texture = r.get<std::int32_t>();
        for (float& c : m.color) c = r.get<float>();
        m.alpha_mode = r.get<std::uint8_t>(); m.double_sided = r.get<std::uint8_t>(); r.skip(2);
        if (m.texture >= static_cast<int>(f.textures.size())) m.texture = -1;
        f.materials.push_back(std::move(m));
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nme && r.ok; ++i) {
        Mesh me;
        me.name = r.str(); me.material = r.get<std::int32_t>();
        const auto nv = r.get<std::uint32_t>(), ni = r.get<std::uint32_t>(), nb = r.get<std::uint32_t>();
        if (!r.ok || nv > kMaxItems || ni > kMaxItems * 3 || nb > 65535) { err = "malha invalida"; return false; }
        for (std::uint32_t b = 0; b < nb && r.ok; ++b) me.bones.push_back(r.str());
        me.has_skin = r.get<std::uint8_t>() != 0; r.skip(3);
        if (!r.vec(me.pos, std::size_t{nv} * 3) || !r.vec(me.nrm, std::size_t{nv} * 3) || !r.vec(me.uv, std::size_t{nv} * 2) ||
            !r.vec(me.col, std::size_t{nv} * 4)) break;
        if (me.has_skin && (!r.vec(me.joints, std::size_t{nv} * 4) || !r.vec(me.weights, std::size_t{nv} * 4))) break;
        if (!r.vec(me.idx, ni)) break;
        for (std::uint32_t x : me.idx) if (x >= nv) { err = "indice de vertice fora do intervalo"; return false; }
        if (me.material >= static_cast<int>(f.materials.size())) me.material = -1;
        f.meshes.push_back(std::move(me));
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nj && r.ok; ++i) {
        Joint j;
        j.name = r.str(); j.parent = r.get<std::int32_t>();
        for (float& v : j.t) v = r.get<float>();
        for (float& v : j.q) v = r.get<float>();
        for (float& v : j.s) v = r.get<float>();
        for (float& v : j.ibm) v = r.get<float>();
        if (j.parent >= static_cast<int>(i)) j.parent = -1;       // pais sempre antes dos filhos
        f.joints.push_back(std::move(j));
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nc && r.ok; ++i) {
        Clip c;
        c.name = r.str(); c.duration = r.get<float>();
        const auto nch = r.get<std::uint32_t>();
        if (!r.ok || nch > kMaxItems) { err = "clipe invalido"; return false; }
        for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < nch && r.ok; ++k) {
            Channel ch;
            ch.bone = r.str(); ch.path = r.get<std::uint8_t>(); r.skip(3);
            const auto nk = r.get<std::uint32_t>();
            if (!r.ok || ch.path > 2 || nk > kMaxItems) { err = "canal invalido"; return false; }
            if (!r.vec(ch.times, nk) || !r.vec(ch.values, std::size_t{nk} * (ch.path == 1 ? 4 : 3))) break;
            c.channels.push_back(std::move(ch));
        }
        f.clips.push_back(std::move(c));
    }
    if (!r.ok) { err = "arquivo truncado"; return false; }
    if (r.p != size) { err = "bytes sobrando no final"; return false; }
    return true;
}

bool load_f3m_file(const std::string& path, F3MFile& out, std::string& error) {
    std::FILE* fp = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!fp) { error = "nao consegui abrir " + path; return false; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> buf;
    std::uint8_t tmp[65536];
    std::size_t k;
    while ((k = std::fread(tmp, 1, sizeof tmp, fp)) > 0) buf.insert(buf.end(), tmp, tmp + k);
    std::fclose(fp);
    return load_f3m(buf.data(), buf.size(), out, error);
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// Leitor do formato F3M (ver tools/py/f3vb/f3m.py para a especificacao). Portavel: nao depende de Windows/OpenGL.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

enum : std::uint32_t { kFlagModel = 1, kFlagSkeleton = 2, kFlagClips = 4 };

struct Texture { std::string name; std::uint32_t w = 0, h = 0; std::vector<std::uint8_t> rgba; };
struct Material { std::string name; int texture = -1; float color[4] = {1, 1, 1, 1}; std::uint8_t alpha_mode = 0, double_sided = 0;
                  std::string shader; };   // v20: id do material no B3D (BASE_2X, BASE_VERTEX_ALPHA_2X, BASE_IMAGE_ALPHA_2X...); nao vai para o arquivo
struct Mesh {
    std::string name;
    int material = -1;
    std::vector<std::string> bones;                 // nomes dos ossos citados em `joints`
    bool has_skin = false;
    std::vector<float> pos, nrm, uv, col;           // nv*3, nv*3, nv*2, nv*4
    std::vector<std::uint16_t> joints;              // nv*4 (indices em `bones`)
    std::vector<float> weights;                     // nv*4
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> idx;
    std::uint32_t nv() const { return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(pos.size() / 3); }
};
struct Joint { std::string name; int parent = -1; float t[3] = {0, 0, 0}, q[4] = {0, 0, 0, 1}, s[3] = {1, 1, 1}; float ibm[16]; };
struct Channel { std::string bone; std::uint8_t path = 0; std::vector<float> times, values; };   // 0 T, 1 R, 2 S
struct Clip { std::string name; float duration = 0; std::vector<Channel> channels; };

struct F3MFile {
    std::uint32_t flags = 0;
    std::string name;
    std::vector<Texture> textures;
    std::vector<Material> materials;
    std::vector<Mesh> meshes;
    std::vector<Joint> joints;
    std::vector<Clip> clips;
};

// Devolve false e preenche `error` em qualquer problema (nunca le fora do buffer).
bool load_f3m(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, F3MFile& out, std::string& error);
bool load_f3m_file(const std::string& path, F3MFile& out, std::string& error);

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
#include "f3map.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

namespace f3v {

namespace {

struct Rd {
    const std::uint8_t* p;
    std::size_t n, i = 0;
    bool ok = true;
    Rd(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t s) : p(d), n(s) {}
    std::size_t left() const { return n - i; }
    bool need(std::size_t k) { if (!ok || k > left()) { ok = false; return false; } return true; }
    std::uint8_t u8() { if (!need(1)) return 0; return p[i++]; }
    std::uint32_t u32() { if (!need(4)) return 0; std::uint32_t v; std::memcpy(&v, p + i, 4); i += 4; return v; }
    std::int32_t i32() { return static_cast<std::int32_t>(u32()); }
    float f32() { if (!need(4)) return 0; float v; std::memcpy(&v, p + i, 4); i += 4; return v; }
    Vec3f vec() { Vec3f v{}; for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) v[static_cast<std::size_t>(k)] = f32(); return v; }
    std::string str() {
        if (!need(2)) return {};
        const std::size_t len = static_cast<std::size_t>(p[i]) | (static_cast<std::size_t>(p[i + 1]) << 8);
        i += 2;
        if (!need(len)) return {};
        std::string s(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(p + i), len);
        i += len;
        return s;
    }
    // contagem de itens que ocupam >= min_bytes cada: rejeita contagens impossiveis antes de alocar
    std::uint32_t count(std::size_t min_bytes) {
        const std::uint32_t c = u32();
        if (!ok) return 0;
        if (min_bytes && c > left() / min_bytes) { ok = false; return 0; }
        return c;
    }
};

bool finite3(const Vec3f& v) { return std::isfinite(v[0]) && std::isfinite(v[1]) && std::isfinite(v[2]); }

}  // namespace

std::size_t MapData::triangle_count() const {
    std::size_t n = 0;
    for (const MapTriList& t : tris) n += t.idx.size() / 3;
    return n;
}

bool MapData::bounds(float mn[3], float mx[3]) const {
    bool any = false;
    auto add = [&](const Vec3f& p) {
        if (!finite3(p)) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            const std::size_t k = static_cast<std::size_t>(i);
            if (!any) { mn[i] = mx[i] = p[k]; } else { mn[i] = std::min(mn[i], p[k]); mx[i] = std::max(mx[i], p[k]); }
        }
        any = true;
    };
    for (const MapBlock& b : blocks) for (std::uint32_t v = 0; v < b.nv; ++v) add({b.xyz[v * 3], b.xyz[v * 3 + 1], b.xyz[v * 3 + 2]});
    for (const MapEntity& e : entities) add(e.pos);
    for (const MapNavNode& n : nav) add(n.pos);
    for (const MapEntry& e : entries) for (const Vec3f& p : e.pos) add(p);
    for (const MapTrigger& t : triggers) for (const Vec3f& p : t.pts) add(p);
    for (const MapPath& t : paths) for (const Vec3f& p : t.pts) add(p);
    for (const MapSound& s : sounds) add(s.pos);
    for (const MapMarker& s : markers) add(s.pos);
    for (const MapEffect& s : effects) add(s.pos);
    for (const MapWater& s : water) add(s.pos);
    return any;
}

bool MapData::cell_of(const Vec3f& p, int& col, int& row) const {
    if (grid_w == 0 || grid_rows == 0 || !(cell > 0) || !finite3(p)) return false;
    const float fc = (p[0] - origin[0]) / cell, fr = (p[2] - origin[1]) / cell;
    if (fc < 0 || fr < 0 || fc >= static_cast<float>(grid_w) || fr >= static_cast<float>(grid_rows)) return false;
    col = static_cast<int>(fc);
    row = static_cast<int>(fr);
    return true;
}

bool MapData::on_floor(const Vec3f& p) const {
    int c = 0, r = 0;
    return cell_of(p, c, r) && grid[static_cast<std::size_t>(r) * grid_w + static_cast<std::size_t>(c)] != 0x2F;
}

void MapData::floor_hits(std::size_t& hits, std::size_t& total) const {
    hits = total = 0;
    auto test = [&](const Vec3f& p) { ++total; if (on_floor(p)) ++hits; };
    for (const MapEntity& e : entities) test(e.pos);
    for (const MapNavNode& n : nav) test(n.pos);
    for (const MapEntry& e : entries) for (const Vec3f& p : e.pos) if (p[0] != 0 || p[2] != 0) test(p);
}

bool load_f3map(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, MapData& out, std::string& err) {
    out = MapData();
    if (size < 8 || std::memcmp(data, "F3MP", 4) != 0) { err = "assinatura F3MP ausente"; return false; }
    std::uint32_t ver;
    std::memcpy(&ver, data + 4, 4);
    if (ver < 1 || ver > 3) { err = "versao do .f3map nao suportada: " + std::to_string(ver); return false; }
    out.version = ver;
    std::size_t pos = 8;
    while (pos + 8 <= size) {
        char tag[5] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0};
        std::memcpy(tag, data + pos, 4);
        std::uint32_t n;
        std::memcpy(&n, data + pos + 4, 4);
        if (n > size - pos - 8) { err = std::string("chunk ") + tag + " ultrapassa o arquivo"; return false; }
        Rd r(data + pos + 8, n);
        pos += 8 + static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
        const std::string t = tag;
        if (t == "INFO") {
            out.name = r.str(); out.tre = r.str(); out.rle = r.str();
            out.origin[0] = r.f32(); out.origin[1] = r.f32(); out.cell = r.f32(); r.u32();
        } else if (t == "GRID") {
            out.grid_w = r.u32(); out.grid_rows = r.u32();
            const std::uint64_t cells = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(out.grid_w) * out.grid_rows;
            if (!r.ok || cells > r.left()) { err = "GRID inconsistente"; return false; }
            out.grid.assign(r.p + r.i, r.p + r.i + cells);
            r.i += static_cast<std::size_t>(cells);
        } else if (t == "GEOM") {
            const std::uint32_t nb = r.count(4);
            for (std::uint32_t b = 0; b < nb && r.ok; ++b) {
                MapBlock blk;
                blk.nv = r.u32();
                if (!r.ok || blk.nv > r.left() / (ver >= 3 ? 44 : 28)) { err = "bloco de vertices inconsistente"; return false; }
                blk.xyz.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(blk.nv) * 3);
                blk.nrm.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(blk.nv) * 3);
                for (float& f : blk.xyz) f = r.f32();
                for (float& f : blk.nrm) f = r.f32();
                if (!r.need(static_cast<std::size_t>(blk.nv) * 4)) break;
                blk.rgba.assign(r.p + r.i, r.p + r.i + static_cast<std::size_t>(blk.nv) * 4);
                r.i += static_cast<std::size_t>(blk.nv) * 4;
                if (ver >= 3) {
                    blk.uv.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(blk.nv) * 2);
                    blk.lmuv.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(blk.nv) * 2);
                    for (float& f : blk.uv) f = r.f32();
                    for (float& f : blk.lmuv) f = r.f32();
                }
                out.blocks.push_back(std::move(blk));
            }
            const std::uint32_t nl = r.count(ver >= 2 ? 20 : 8);
            for (std::uint32_t l = 0; l < nl && r.ok; ++l) {
                MapTriList tl;
                tl.block = r.u32();
                if (ver >= 2) { tl.material = r.u32(); tl.page = r.u32(); tl.tex = r.u32(); }
                const std::uint32_t nt = r.u32();
                if (!r.ok || tl.block >= out.blocks.size() || static_cast<std::uint64_t>(nt) * 12 > r.left()) { err = "lista de triangulos inconsistente"; return false; }
                tl.idx.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nt) * 3);
                const std::uint32_t nv = out.blocks[tl.block].nv;
                for (std::uint32_t& x : tl.idx) { x = r.u32(); if (x >= nv) { err = "indice de triangulo fora do bloco"; return false; } }
                out.tris.push_back(std::move(tl));
            }
        } else if (t == "MATL") {
            const std::uint32_t c = r.count(20);
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < c && r.ok; ++k) {
                MapMaterial m;
                m.id = r.u32(); m.name = r.str();
                for (std::uint8_t& q : m.rgba) q = r.u8();
                m.blend = r.str(); m.surface = r.str(); m.flags = r.u32();
                if (r.ok) out.materials.push_back(std::move(m));
            }
        } else if (t == "TEXN") {
            const std::uint32_t c = r.count(2);
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < c && r.ok; ++k) { std::string s = r.str(); if (r.ok) out.textures.push_back(std::move(s)); }
        } else if (t == "ENTS") {
            const std::uint32_t c = r.count(6 * 2 + 16);
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < c && r.ok; ++k) {
                MapEntity e;
                e.kind = r.str(); e.prototype = r.str(); e.instance = r.str(); e.name = r.str(); e.script = r.str(); e.skin = r.str();
                e.pos = r.vec(); e.yaw = r.f32();
                if (r.ok) out.entities.push_back(std::move(e));
            }
        } else if (t == "NAVN") {
            const std::uint32_t c = r.count(14);
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < c && r.ok; ++k) {
                MapNavNode nd;
                nd.kind = r.u8(); nd.pos = r.vec();
                const std::uint8_t nl = r.u8();
                if (!r.need(nl)) break;
                nd.links.assign(r.p + r.i, r.p + r.i + nl);
                r.i += nl;
                out.nav.push_back(std::move(nd));
            }
        } else if (t == "ENTR") {
            const std::uint32_t c = r.count(2);
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < c && r.ok; ++k) {
                MapEntry e;
                e.id = r.u8();
                const std::uint8_t np = r.u8();
                for (std::uint8_t q = 0; q < np && r.ok; ++q) e.pos.push_back(r.vec());
                for (std::uint8_t q = 0; q < np && r.ok; ++q) e.angles.push_back(r.f32());
                if (r.ok) out.entries.push_back(std::move(e));
            }
        } else if (t == "TRIG") {
            const std::uint32_t c = r.count(11);
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < c && r.ok; ++k) {
                MapTrigger g;
                g.kind = r.u8(); g.target = r.str(); g.entry = r.i32();
                const std::uint32_t np = r.count(12);
                for (std::uint32_t q = 0; q < np && r.ok; ++q) g.pts.push_back(r.vec());
                if (r.ok) out.triggers.push_back(std::move(g));
            }
        } else if (t == "PATH") {
            const std::uint32_t c = r.count(6);
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < c && r.ok; ++k) {
                MapPath pa;
                pa.name = r.str();
                const std::uint32_t np = r.count(12);
                for (std::uint32_t q = 0; q < np && r.ok; ++q) pa.pts.push_back(r.vec());
                if (r.ok) out.paths.push_back(std::move(pa));
            }
        } else if (t == "SOND") {
            const std::uint32_t c = r.count(16);
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < c && r.ok; ++k) { MapSound s; s.name = r.str(); s.pos = r.vec(); s.sound = r.str(); if (r.ok) out.sounds.push_back(std::move(s)); }
        } else if (t == "MARK") {
            const std::uint32_t c = r.count(18);
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < c && r.ok; ++k) { MapMarker s; s.pos = r.vec(); s.icon = r.str(); s.text_id = r.u32(); if (r.ok) out.markers.push_back(std::move(s)); }
        } else if (t == "EFFT") {
            const std::uint32_t c = r.count(16);
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < c && r.ok; ++k) { MapEffect s; s.name = r.str(); s.pos = r.vec(); s.effect = r.str(); if (r.ok) out.effects.push_back(std::move(s)); }
        } else if (t == "WATR") {
            const std::uint32_t c = r.count(14);
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < c && r.ok; ++k) { MapWater s; s.pos = r.vec(); s.texture = r.str(); if (r.ok) out.water.push_back(std::move(s)); }
        } else if (t == "LGHT") {
            const std::uint32_t c = r.count(40);
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < c && r.ok; ++k) { MapLight l; l.type = r.u32(); l.color = r.vec(); l.pos = r.vec(); l.dir = r.vec(); if (r.ok) out.lights.push_back(l); }
        } else if (t == "CAMR") {
            for (float& f : out.camera) f = r.f32();
            out.has_camera = r.ok;
        } else if (t == "ENVI") {
            for (auto& c : out.env_a) c = r.u8();
            for (auto& c : out.env_b) c = r.u8();
            for (float& f : out.env_f) f = r.f32();
            out.has_env = r.ok;
        }   // tags desconhecidas sao ignoradas (compatibilidade futura)
        if (!r.ok) { err = std::string("chunk ") + tag + " cortado ou inconsistente"; return false; }
    }
    if (pos != size) { err = "bytes sobrando no fim do arquivo"; return false; }
    map_split_texture_names(out);
    return true;
}

void map_split_texture_names(MapData& out) {
    out.tga_names.clear();
    out.ctx_names.clear();
    for (const std::string& s : out.textures) {         // separa difusas (.tga) e paginas de lightmap (.ctx), preservando a ordem (indices 1-based)
        std::string low = s;
        for (char& ch : low) if (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') ch = static_cast<char>(ch - 'A' + 'a');
        const std::size_t dot = s.find_last_of('.');
        const std::string stem = dot == std::string::npos ? s : s.substr(0, dot);
        if (low.size() >= 4 && low.compare(low.size() - 4, 4, ".tga") == 0) out.tga_names.push_back(stem);
        else if (low.size() >= 4 && low.compare(low.size() - 4, 4, ".ctx") == 0) out.ctx_names.push_back(stem);
    }
}

bool load_f3map_file(const std::string& path, MapData& out, std::string& err) {
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!f) { err = "nao consegui abrir " + path; return false; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> buf;
    std::uint8_t tmp[65536];
    std::size_t n;
    while ((n = std::fread(tmp, 1, sizeof tmp, f)) > 0) buf.insert(buf.end(), tmp, tmp + n);
    std::fclose(f);
    return load_f3map(buf.data(), buf.size(), out, err);
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/f3map.h

```cpp
// Leitor do formato .f3map (mapa decodificado: grade + geometria + entidades + navegacao...). Ver tools/py/f3vb/mapexport.py para o layout.
// Portatil (so C++ padrao), com checagem de limites em tudo: arquivos corrompidos sao rejeitados, nunca derrubam o programa.
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

using Vec3f = std::array<float, 3>;

// uv = coordenadas da textura difusa, lmuv = do lightmap (2 floats por vertice; so no .f3map v3, vazios nas versoes antigas)
struct MapBlock { std::uint32_t nv = 0; std::vector<float> xyz, nrm; std::vector<std::uint8_t> rgba; std::vector<float> uv, lmuv; };
// Lista de triangulos de um bloco com o MESMO material / pagina de lightmap / textura difusa (v2; no v1 os tres ficam 0).
// material = indice 0-based em MapData::materials; page = 1-based na lista ".ctx" (0 = nenhuma); tex = 1-based na lista ".tga" (0 = nenhuma).
struct MapTriList { std::uint32_t block = 0, material = 0, page = 0, tex = 0; std::vector<std::uint32_t> idx; };
struct MapMaterial { std::uint32_t id = 0; std::string name; std::uint8_t rgba[4] = {255, 255, 255, 255}; std::string blend, surface; std::uint32_t flags = 0; };
struct MapEntity { std::string kind, prototype, instance, name, script, skin; Vec3f pos{}; float yaw = 0; };
struct MapNavNode { std::uint8_t kind = 0; Vec3f pos{}; std::vector<std::uint8_t> links; };
struct MapEntry { std::uint8_t id = 0; std::vector<Vec3f> pos; std::vector<float> angles; };
struct MapTrigger { std::uint8_t kind = 0; std::string target; std::int32_t entry = -1; std::vector<Vec3f> pts; };   // 0 regiao, 1 script, 2 viagem, 3 vinculo
struct MapPath { std::string name; std::vector<Vec3f> pts; };
struct MapSound { std::string name; Vec3f pos{}; std::string sound; };
struct MapMarker { Vec3f pos{}; std::string icon; std::uint32_t text_id = 0; };
struct MapEffect { std::string name; Vec3f pos{}; std::string effect; };
struct MapWater { Vec3f pos{}; std::string texture; };
struct MapLight { std::uint32_t type = 0; Vec3f color{}, pos{}, dir{}; };

struct MapData {
    std::uint32_t version = 0;               // versao do arquivo lido (1 ou 2)
    std::string name, tre, rle;
    float origin[2] = {0, 0};
    float cell = 0.5f;                       // lado da celula da grade, em unidades do mundo
    std::uint32_t grid_w = 0, grid_rows = 0;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> grid;          // grid_w * grid_rows; 0x2F = vazio
    std::vector<MapBlock> blocks;
    std::vector<MapTriList> tris;
    std::vector<MapEntity> entities;
    std::vector<MapNavNode> nav;
    std::vector<MapEntry> entries;
    std::vector<MapTrigger> triggers;
    std::vector<MapPath> paths;
    std::vector<MapSound> sounds;
    std::vector<MapMarker> markers;
    std::vector<MapEffect> effects;
    std::vector<MapWater> water;
    std::vector<MapLight> lights;
    // v19: ECAM do .map (limites da camera: xmin, zmax, xmax, zmin; padrao 0,1000,1000,0) e cabecalho de ambiente (cor A, cor B, floats 250/500/1)
    bool has_camera = false; float camera[4] = {0, 1000, 1000, 0};
    bool has_env = false; std::uint8_t env_a[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0}, env_b[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0}; float env_f[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    std::vector<MapMaterial> materials;      // v2 (MATL)
    std::vector<std::string> textures;       // v2 (TEXN): nomes na ordem do .8tre (".tga" difusas, ".ctx" paginas de lightmap)
    std::vector<std::string> tga_names, ctx_names;   // derivadas de textures (preenchidas ao carregar)

    std::size_t triangle_count() const;
    // nomes (sem extensao) das listas de textura: k e p sao 1-based como em MapTriList; "" quando 0 ou fora da lista
    std::string diffuse_name(std::uint32_t k) const { return k >= 1 && k <= tga_names.size() ? tga_names[k - 1] : std::string(); }
    std::string lightmap_name(std::uint32_t p) const { return p >= 1 && p <= ctx_names.size() ? ctx_names[p - 1] : std::string(); }
    // Caixa de tudo que tem posicao (geometria, entidades, navegacao...). false se nao ha nada.
    bool bounds(float mn[3], float mx[3]) const;
    // Regra medida: celula = (mundo - origem) / tamanho da celula. false se cair fora da grade.
    bool cell_of(const Vec3f& p, int& col, int& row) const;
    bool on_floor(const Vec3f& p) const;     // celula valida e nao vazia
    // Quantos pontos (entidades, nos de navegacao, entradas) caem em celulas nao vazias.
    void floor_hits(std::size_t& hits, std::size_t& total) const;
};

bool load_f3map(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, MapData& out, std::string& err);
bool load_f3map_file(const std::string& path, MapData& out, std::string& err);
void map_split_texture_names(MapData& m);   // v20: preenche tga_names/ctx_names a partir de textures (usado tambem pelo map_build)

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/f3tex.cpp

```cpp
#include "f3tex.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>

namespace f3v {

bool load_f3tex(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, Image& out, std::string& err) {
    out = Image();
    if (size < 12 || std::memcmp(data, "F3TX", 4) != 0) { err = "nao e um .f3tex (magic F3TX ausente)"; return false; }
    std::uint32_t w, h;
    std::memcpy(&w, data + 4, 4);
    std::memcpy(&h, data + 8, 4);
    if (w == 0 || h == 0 || w > kMaxTexSize || h > kMaxTexSize) { err = "dimensoes absurdas: " + std::to_string(w) + "x" + std::to_string(h); return false; }
    const std::uint64_t bytes = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(w) * h * 4;
    if (bytes != size - 12) { err = "tamanho dos pixels nao bate com " + std::to_string(w) + "x" + std::to_string(h); return false; }
    out.w = w; out.h = h;
    out.rgba.assign(data + 12, data + 12 + static_cast<std::size_t>(bytes));
    return true;
}

bool load_f3tex_file(const std::string& path, Image& out, std::string& err) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) { err = "nao consegui abrir " + path; return false; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> b((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    return load_f3tex(b.data(), b.size(), out, err);
}

std::vector<Image> build_mips(const Image& base) {
    std::vector<Image> out;
    if (base.w == 0 || base.h == 0 || base.rgba.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(base.w) * base.h * 4) return out;
    out.push_back(base);
    while (out.back().w > 1 || out.back().h > 1) {
        const Image& s = out.back();
        Image d;
        d.w = std::max(1u, s.w / 2);
        d.h = std::max(1u, s.h / 2);
        d.rgba.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(d.w) * d.h * 4);
        for (std::uint32_t y = 0; y < d.h; ++y) {
            const std::uint32_t y0 = std::min(s.h - 1, y * 2), y1 = std::min(s.h - 1, y * 2 + 1);
            for (std::uint32_t x = 0; x < d.w; ++x) {
                const std::uint32_t x0 = std::min(s.w - 1, x * 2), x1 = std::min(s.w - 1, x * 2 + 1);
                for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {
                    const unsigned sum = s.rgba[(static_cast<std::size_t>(y0) * s.w + x0) * 4 + static_cast<std::size_t>(c)] + s.rgba[(static_cast<std::size_t>(y0) * s.w + x1) * 4 + static_cast<std::size_t>(c)] +
                                         s.rgba[(static_cast<std::size_t>(y1) * s.w + x0) * 4 + static_cast<std::size_t>(c)] + s.rgba[(static_cast<std::size_t>(y1) * s.w + x1) * 4 + static_cast<std::size_t>(c)];
                    d.rgba[(static_cast<std::size_t>(y) * d.w + x) * 4 + static_cast<std::size_t>(c)] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>((sum + 2) / 4);
                }
            }
        }
        out.push_back(std::move(d));
    }
    return out;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// Texturas convertidas (.f3tex) para o F3VBMapViewer (v18). Portavel: sem OpenGL (o upload fica no viewer).
// Formato: "F3TX" + u32 largura + u32 altura + RGBA8 (linhas de CIMA para BAIXO, como no TGA da demo; com v = 0 no topo o RGBA sobe direto para o GL).
// Gerado por:  py -3 -m f3vb export-textures   (ou convert-retail --maps)
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

struct Image {
    std::uint32_t w = 0, h = 0;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> rgba;
};

constexpr std::uint32_t kMaxTexSize = 8192;      // limite de sanidade (a demo usa 64..1024)

bool load_f3tex(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, Image& out, std::string& err);
bool load_f3tex_file(const std::string& path, Image& out, std::string& err);

// Cadeia de mipmaps por filtro de caixa 2x2 (nivel 0 = a propria imagem, ate 1x1). Alfa tambem e filtrado.
std::vector<Image> build_mips(const Image& base);

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// F3VB (v20): o JOGO. Reimplementacao da demo tecnica do Van Buren (Fallout 3 cancelado da Black Isle) sobre a copia do proprio jogador.
// Win32 + OpenGL, 64 bits, sem bibliotecas externas (so o Windows: opengl32, gdi32, user32, winmm, shell32, ole32).
//
// v20: le a demo ORIGINAL direto (resource.rht + data\*.grp inteiros, sem extrair nada). Na primeira vez abre o seletor de pastas do Windows;

//   (CharacterGeneration.int; valores iniciais do Default_PC.CRT) -> Loading (Loading.int) -> mapa inicial do sys.ini ([Server] Start map)

    double player_dead_at = -1;
    // v21: --autoteste (percorre o jogo sozinho e escreve logs\autoteste_<data>.txt)
    bool autotest = false; int at_step = 0; double at_t0 = 0; std::vector<std::string> at_lines; int at_fail = 0;
    std::vector<std::string> at_maps; std::size_t at_map = 0; float at_sig = 0, at_x = 0, at_z = 0; int at_target = -1;
    bool pending_cam_set = false; OrbitCam pending_cam;   // v20: camera restaurada depois de carregar um jogo salvo
    std::unique_ptr<LiveActor> cg_actor;          // v20: boneco 3D da criacao de personagem (quadro escuro a direita das estatisticas)
    std::string cg_actor_proto;          // v20: registro de mensagens da barra (canto esquerdo), como "-Welcome to Fallout" no original
    double t = 0, fps = 0, fps_acc = 0, heartbeat = 0; int frames = 0; unsigned long long total_frames = 0;
    LARGE_INTEGER freq{}, last{};
} A;

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ utilidades
// Textos fixos do F3VB estao em UTF-8 no codigo; a fonte TrueType usa cp1252 (como os .stf). Converte o que for latino.
std::string cp(const std::string& u8) {
    std::string o;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < u8.size(); ++i) {
        const unsigned char c = static_cast<unsigned char>(u8[i]);
        if (c < 0x80) o.push_back(static_cast<char>(c));
        else if ((c & 0xE0) == 0xC0 && i + 1 < u8.size()) { const unsigned v = ((c & 0x1F) << 6) | (static_cast<unsigned char>(u8[i + 1]) & 0x3F); o.push_back(v < 256 ? static_cast<char>(v) : '?'); ++i; }
        else { o.push_back('?'); while (i + 1 < u8.size() && (static_cast<unsigned char>(u8[i + 1]) & 0xC0) == 0x80) ++i; }
    }
    return o;
}

std::string stf1(std::uint32_t id) {                     // texto 1-based do .stf, sem codigos de cor
    std::int32_t col;
    return strip_color_codes(A.stf.text_cp1252(id), col);
}

void say(const std::string& u8, double secs = 3.0) { A.toast = cp(u8); A.toast_until = A.t + secs; LOGF("aviso: %s", u8.c_str()); }
int box(const std::string& u8, UINT flags) { return MessageBoxW(A.hwnd, widen(u8).c_str(), L"F3VB Engine", flags); }

GuiScreen* scr(const std::string& name) { const auto it = A.screens.find(lower_ascii(name)); return it == A.screens.end() ? nullptr : it->second.get(); }

float setting(const std::string& k, float def) { return A.cfg.getf(k, def); }
void set_setting(const std::string& k, float v) { char b[32]; std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, "%.3f", v); A.cfg.values[k] = b; }
void save_settings() {
    if (!A.cfg.save(A.config_path, "; F3VB Engine v21 - configuracao (ao lado do F3VB.exe). demo = pasta da demo original escolhida na primeira vez.\r\n"
                                   "; Apague este arquivo (ou rode F3VB.exe --escolher-pasta) para escolher outra pasta.\r\n"))
        LOGF("AVISO: nao consegui gravar %s", A.config_path.c_str());
}
```
