```cpp
#include "gui.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace f3v {

namespace {

const char* state_name(ButtonState s) {
    switch (s) {
        case ButtonState::Up: return "up";
        case ButtonState::Selected: return "selected";
        case ButtonState::Down: return "down";
        case ButtonState::Disabled: return "disabled";
    }
    return "up";
}

std::uint8_t x2(std::uint8_t v) { return static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::min(255, v * 2)); }
bool contains(const std::string& low, const char* s) { return low.find(s) != std::string::npos; }

}  // namespace

bool GuiScreen::load(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, std::string& err) {
    hover_ = pressed_ = nullptr;
    return load_gui(data, size, file_, err);
}

bool GuiScreen::load_file(const std::string& path, std::string& err) {
    hover_ = pressed_ = nullptr;
    return load_gui_file(path, file_, err);
}

void GuiScreen::set_disabled(const std::string& n, bool v) { if (v) disabled_.insert(lower_ascii(n)); else disabled_.erase(lower_ascii(n)); }
void GuiScreen::set_checked(const std::string& n, bool v) { if (v) checked_.insert(lower_ascii(n)); else checked_.erase(lower_ascii(n)); }
void GuiScreen::set_hidden(const std::string& n, bool v) { if (v) hidden_.insert(lower_ascii(n)); else hidden_.erase(lower_ascii(n)); }
void GuiScreen::set_text(const std::string& n, const std::string& t) { text_[lower_ascii(n)] = t; }
void GuiScreen::clear_text(const std::string& n) { text_.erase(lower_ascii(n)); }
void GuiScreen::set_image(const std::string& n, const std::string& t) { image_[lower_ascii(n)] = lower_ascii(t); }
void GuiScreen::clear_image(const std::string& n) { image_.erase(lower_ascii(n)); }
void GuiScreen::set_offset(const std::string& n, float dx, float dy) { woff_[lower_ascii(n)] = {dx, dy}; }
void GuiScreen::get_offset(const std::string& n, float& dx, float& dy) const {
    const auto it = woff_.find(lower_ascii(n));
    dx = it == woff_.end() ? 0.f : it->second.first;
    dy = it == woff_.end() ? 0.f : it->second.second;
}
bool GuiScreen::is_disabled(const GuiWidget* w) const { return w && disabled_.count(lower_ascii(w->name)) > 0; }
bool GuiScreen::is_checked(const GuiWidget* w) const { return w && checked_.count(lower_ascii(w->name)) > 0; }
bool GuiScreen::is_hidden(const GuiWidget* w) const { return w && hidden_.count(lower_ascii(w->name)) > 0; }

ButtonState GuiScreen::state_of(const GuiWidget* w) const {
    if (is_disabled(w)) return ButtonState::Disabled;
    if (w && w == pressed_ && w == hover_) return ButtonState::Down;
    if (w && w == hover_) return ButtonState::Selected;
    return ButtonState::Up;
}

GuiWidget* GuiScreen::hit(float x, float y) const {
    GuiWidget* best = nullptr;
    std::function<void(GuiWidget*, float, float)> rec = [&](GuiWidget* w, float ox, float oy) {
        if (is_hidden(w)) return;
        float dx, dy;
        get_offset(w->name, dx, dy);
        ox += dx; oy += dy;
        const float x0 = w->rect.x0 + ox, y0 = w->rect.y0 + oy, x1 = w->rect.x1 + ox, y1 = w->rect.y1 + oy;
        if ((w->is(WidgetKind::Button) || w->is(WidgetKind::Edit)) && !is_disabled(w) && x >= x0 && x < x1 && y >= y0 && y < y1) best = w;
        for (const auto& c : w->children) rec(c.get(), ox, oy);
    };
    for (const auto& r : file_.roots) rec(r.get(), offset_x, offset_y);
    return best;
}

void GuiScreen::build(const GuiResources& res, std::vector<GuiDraw>& out) const {
    stats_ = Stats();
    for (const auto& r : file_.roots) build_widget(*r, res, out, false, false, offset_x, offset_y);
}

void GuiScreen::build_widget(const GuiWidget& w, const GuiResources& res, std::vector<GuiDraw>& out, bool parent_down, bool parent_checked, float ox, float oy) const {
    if (is_hidden(&w)) return;
    {
        float dx, dy;
        get_offset(w.name, dx, dy);
        ox += dx; oy += dy;
    }
    // filho-imagem de um botao: escolhe pelo nome qual aparece em cada estado
    if (w.is(WidgetKind::Picture) && w.parent && w.parent->is(WidgetKind::Button)) {
        const std::string n = lower_ascii(w.name);
        bool sib_checked = false;
        for (const auto& s : w.parent->children) if (contains(lower_ascii(s->name), "checked")) sib_checked = true;
        const bool is_checked_var = contains(n, "checked"), is_down = contains(n, "down"), is_up = !is_down && contains(n, "up");
        bool show = true;
        if (is_checked_var) show = parent_checked && (is_down ? parent_down : !parent_down);
        else if (parent_checked && sib_checked && (is_down || is_up)) show = false;
        else if (is_down) show = parent_down || (parent_checked && !sib_checked);
        else if (is_up) show = !parent_down && !(parent_checked && !sib_checked);
        if (!show) return;
    }
    const SkinFragment* st[9] = {nullptr};
    build_frags(w, res, out, nullptr, false, ox, oy);
    const auto img = image_.find(lower_ascii(w.name));
    if (img != image_.end() && !img->second.empty()) {                 // imagem trocada pelo jogo (digito, loading...)
        int tw = 0, th = 0;
        if (res.texture_size && res.texture_size(img->second, tw, th)) {
            GuiDraw d;
            d.texture = img->second;
            d.x0 = w.rect.x0 + ox; d.y0 = w.rect.y0 + oy; d.x1 = w.rect.x1 + ox; d.y1 = w.rect.y1 + oy;
            d.widget = &w;
            out.push_back(d);
            ++stats_.quads;
        } else { ++stats_.missing; stats_.missing_names.insert(img->second); }
    }
    bool down = parent_down, checked = parent_checked;
    if (w.is(WidgetKind::Button)) {
        const ButtonState s = state_of(&w);
        down = s == ButtonState::Down;
        checked = is_checked(&w);
        if (s != ButtonState::Up) {
            const Skin* sk = res.skin ? res.skin(w.skin) : nullptr;
            if (sk && sk->has_state("button", state_name(s))) {
                bool differs = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < 9; ++i) {
                    st[i] = sk->get("button", state_name(s), i);
                    if (st[i] && lower_ascii(st[i]->texture) != lower_ascii(w.frag[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)].texture)) differs = true;
                }
                if (differs) build_frags(w, res, out, st, true, ox, oy);
            }
        }
    }
    if (w.is(WidgetKind::Label) || w.is(WidgetKind::Edit)) build_text(w, res, out, ox, oy);
    if (w.is(WidgetKind::Button)) {
        // v20: num botao, as imagens de estado (BtnUp/BtnDown...) sao a "cara" do botao e vao por baixo; rotulos e o resto por cima.
        // Medido: no CharacterGeneration.int o lblName vem ANTES de BtnUp/BtnDown no arquivo, e no print do original "None" e
        // "AGE 2 MALE" aparecem sobre o botao (na ordem do arquivo o texto sumia).
        for (const auto& c : w.children) if (c->is(WidgetKind::Picture)) build_widget(*c, res, out, down, checked, ox, oy);
        for (const auto& c : w.children) if (!c->is(WidgetKind::Picture)) build_widget(*c, res, out, down, checked, ox, oy);
        return;
    }
    for (const auto& c : w.children) build_widget(*c, res, out, down, checked, ox, oy);
}

void GuiScreen::build_frags(const GuiWidget& w, const GuiResources& res, std::vector<GuiDraw>& out, const SkinFragment* const* skin_state, bool additive, float ox, float oy) const {
    const float X0 = w.rect.x0 + ox, Y0 = w.rect.y0 + oy, X1 = w.rect.x1 + ox, Y1 = w.rect.y1 + oy;
    const float W = X1 - X0, H = Y1 - Y0;
    if (W <= 0 || H <= 0) return;
    auto fw = [&](int i) -> float {
        const SkinFragment* s = skin_state ? skin_state[i] : nullptr;
        return static_cast<float>(s && s->width > 0 ? s->width : w.frag[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)].width);
    };
    auto fh = [&](int i) -> float {
        const SkinFragment* s = skin_state ? skin_state[i] : nullptr;
        return static_cast<float>(s && s->height > 0 ? s->height : w.frag[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)].height);
    };
    float lw = std::max({fw(0), fw(3), fw(6), 0.f}), rw = std::max({fw(2), fw(5), fw(8), 0.f});
    float th = std::max({fh(0), fh(1), fh(2), 0.f}), bh = std::max({fh(6), fh(7), fh(8), 0.f});
    if (lw + rw > W && lw + rw > 0) { const float k = W / (lw + rw); lw *= k; rw *= k; }
    if (th + bh > H && th + bh > 0) { const float k = H / (th + bh); th *= k; bh *= k; }
    // retangulos das 9 fatias (meio = objeto inteiro, como gravado no .int)
    const float R[9][4] = {
        {X0, Y0, X0 + lw, Y0 + th}, {X0 + lw, Y0, X1 - rw, Y0 + th}, {X1 - rw, Y0, X1, Y0 + th},
        {X0, Y0 + th, X0 + lw, Y1 - bh}, {X0, Y0, X1, Y1}, {X1 - rw, Y0 + th, X1, Y1 - bh},
        {X0, Y1 - bh, X0 + lw, Y1}, {X0 + lw, Y1 - bh, X1 - rw, Y1}, {X1 - rw, Y1 - bh, X1, Y1}};
    static const int order[9] = {4, 1, 3, 5, 7, 0, 2, 6, 8};
    for (int oi = 0; oi < 9; ++oi) {
        const int i = order[oi];
        // v20 (medido nos prints do original): objeto "imagem" desenha SO o miolo (a imagem); as bordas zzmainpicture-* nao aparecem
        // (ex.: as lampadas vermelhas f3_button_up/down de DONE/CANCEL ficariam cobertas). Rotulo nao tem moldura (so o texto).
        if (w.is(WidgetKind::Picture) && i != 4) continue;
        if (w.is(WidgetKind::Label)) continue;
        const GuiFragment& f = w.frag[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
        const SkinFragment* s = skin_state ? skin_state[i] : nullptr;
        if (skin_state && !s) continue;
        const std::string tex = lower_ascii(s ? s->texture : f.texture);
        const std::uint32_t flags = s ? s->flags : f.flags;
        std::uint8_t rgba[4];
        if (s) { rgba[0] = s->rgb[0]; rgba[1] = s->rgb[1]; rgba[2] = s->rgb[2]; rgba[3] = 255; }
        else { rgba[0] = x2(f.rgba[2]); rgba[1] = x2(f.rgba[1]); rgba[2] = x2(f.rgba[0]); rgba[3] = f.rgba[3]; }   // v20: D3DCOLOR (bytes B, G, R, A), RGB x2
        if (rgba[3] == 0 || tex.empty()) continue;
        const float* r = R[i];
        const float rw2 = r[2] - r[0], rh2 = r[3] - r[1];
        if (rw2 <= 0.5f || rh2 <= 0.5f) continue;
        int tw = 0, thh = 0;
        if (!res.texture_size || !res.texture_size(tex, tw, thh)) { ++stats_.missing; stats_.missing_names.insert(tex); continue; }
        GuiDraw d;
        d.kind = GuiDraw::Quad;
        d.texture = tex;
        d.x0 = r[0]; d.y0 = r[1]; d.x1 = r[2]; d.y1 = r[3];
        const float cw = fw(i) > 0 ? fw(i) : static_cast<float>(tw), ch = fh(i) > 0 ? fh(i) : static_cast<float>(thh);
        d.u1 = (flags & 1) && cw > 0 ? rw2 / cw : 1.f;
        d.v1 = (flags & 2) && ch > 0 ? rh2 / ch : 1.f;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) d.rgba[k] = rgba[k];
        d.additive = additive;
        d.widget = &w;
        out.push_back(d);
        ++stats_.quads;
    }
}

std::vector<std::string> wrap_text(const std::string& text, float width, const std::function<float(const std::string&)>& measure) {
    std::vector<std::string> lines;
    std::string cur, word;
    auto flush_word = [&]() {
        if (word.empty()) return;
        const std::string cand = cur.empty() ? word : cur + " " + word;
        if (!cur.empty() && measure(cand) > width) { lines.push_back(cur); cur = word; }
        else cur = cand;
        word.clear();
    };
    for (char c : text) {
        if (c == '\n') { flush_word(); lines.push_back(cur); cur.clear(); }
        else if (c == ' ' || c == '\t') flush_word();
        else word.push_back(c);
    }
    flush_word();
    if (!cur.empty() || lines.empty()) lines.push_back(cur);
    return lines;
}

void GuiScreen::build_text(const GuiWidget& w, const GuiResources& res, std::vector<GuiDraw>& out, float ox, float oy) const {
    std::string txt;
    const auto it = text_.find(lower_ascii(w.name));
    if (it != text_.end()) txt = it->second;
    else if (w.text_id && res.text) txt = res.text(w.text_id);
    if (txt.empty() || w.text_rgba[3] == 0) return;
    const float px = font_px(w.font_size);
    const float X0 = w.rect.x0 + ox, Y0 = w.rect.y0 + oy, X1 = w.rect.x1 + ox, Y1 = w.rect.y1 + oy;
    const float lh = res.line_height ? res.line_height(w.font, px) : px * 1.2f;
    auto measure = [&](const std::string& s) { return res.text_width ? res.text_width(w.font, px, s) : static_cast<float>(s.size()) * px * 0.5f; };
    // v20: quebra de linha so quando cabem 2 linhas ou mais (caixas de descricao); rotulos de 1 linha sao CORTADOS no retangulo, como no
    // original ("DEFAUL", "CANCE" no print das opcoes de video)
    const bool multi = (Y1 - Y0) >= 2.f * lh - 1.f;
    const std::vector<std::string> lines = multi ? wrap_text(txt, std::max(4.f, X1 - X0 - 2.f), measure) : wrap_text(txt, 1e9f, measure);
    float top = Y0;
    const float total = lh * static_cast<float>(lines.size());
    if (total <= (Y1 - Y0) + 1.f) top = Y0 + std::floor(((Y1 - Y0) - total) * 0.5f);
    const std::size_t maxl = std::max<std::size_t>(1, static_cast<std::size_t>((Y1 - Y0) / std::max(1.f, lh)) + 1);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < lines.size() && i < maxl; ++i) {
        GuiDraw d;
        d.kind = GuiDraw::Text;
        d.font = w.font; d.text = lines[i]; d.size_px = px; d.align = w.halign();
        d.cx0 = X0; d.cy0 = Y0; d.cx1 = X1; d.cy1 = Y1 + 2.f;
        d.x0 = X0; d.x1 = X1; d.y0 = top + lh * static_cast<float>(i); d.y1 = d.y0 + lh;
        // v20: D3DCOLOR (bytes B, G, R, A) com RGB x2 (0x80 = neutro), alfa como esta. Medido no print das opcoes de video:
        // "Primary Monitor" 144e60b4 -> (192,156,40) a 70% sobre o fundo = (143,118,35); o print mede (150,123,39).
        d.rgba[0] = x2(w.text_rgba[2]); d.rgba[1] = x2(w.text_rgba[1]); d.rgba[2] = x2(w.text_rgba[0]); d.rgba[3] = w.text_rgba[3];
        d.widget = &w;
        out.push_back(d);
        ++stats_.texts;
    }
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/gui.h

```cpp
// Interface do jogo, parte PORTAVEL (v19): transforma uma tela .int (gui_int.h) + skins (.ini) + estado (mouse, botoes) numa lista de desenho.
// Quem desenha e o "backend": OpenGL no F3VB.exe (gui_gl) e CPU no F3VBUiPreview (gera PNG). Assim o layout e testavel sem placa de video.
//
// Regras (o que foi medido e o que e suposicao; ver docs/specs/int.md e docs/JOGO.md):
//  - Coordenadas: tela virtual de 1024x768 (a do .int). O backend escala para a janela.
//  - Nove fatias: o "meio" cobre o retangulo inteiro do objeto (como gravado no .int) e e desenhado primeiro; bordas e cantos por cima, por DENTRO
//    do retangulo, com o tamanho de cada fragmento (largura/altura gravadas). flags 1/2/3 repetem a textura em x/y (coordenadas de textura > 1).
//  - Textura que NAO existe nos dados nao e desenhada (medido: o Mainmenu.int pede zzmainpicture-*.bmp e a skin pede zzmainlabel-*.tga, e nenhum existe:
//    no jogo original essas molduras nao apareciam). Fragmento sem textura tambem nao.
//  - Cor do fragmento: RGB x 2 (0x80 = neutro, como o _2X dos materiais), alfa como esta (0 = invisivel). SUPOSICAO.
//  - Botoes: o .int guarda o estado "up"; selected (mouse em cima), down (apertado) e disabled vem da skin, desenhados com mistura ADITIVA
//    (a textura "selected" do zzmainmenu.ini e azul-escuro opaca: somada, vira um brilho azul sobre o desenho do botao). SUPOSICAO.
//  - Filhos-imagem de um botao com "down"/"checked" no nome so aparecem com o botao apertado/marcado; com "up", so solto (CharGen, menu ESC).
//  - Texto dos rotulos: id 1-based no .stf; fonte/tamanho/cor do .int; tamanho em pontos -> pixels x 4/3 (96 dpi); alinhamento 0/1/2 =
//    esquerda/centro/direita (como DT_LEFT/DT_CENTER/DT_RIGHT do Windows: SUPOSICAO); quebra de linha por palavras; uma linha = centro vertical.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "gui_int.h"
#include "skin.h"

namespace f3v {

struct GuiDraw {
    enum Kind { Quad, Text } kind = Quad;
    // Quad
    std::string texture;                     // nome do arquivo (minusculo), resolvido pelo backend
    float x0 = 0, y0 = 0, x1 = 0, y1 = 0;    // tela virtual 1024x768
    float u0 = 0, v0 = 0, u1 = 1, v1 = 1;    // > 1 = repetir
    std::uint8_t rgba[4] = {255, 255, 255, 255};
    bool additive = false;
    // Text (x0..y1 = caixa do rotulo)
    std::string font, text;                  // text em cp1252
    float size_px = 12;
    int align = 0;                           // 0 esquerda, 1 centro, 2 direita
    float cx0 = -1e9f, cy0 = -1e9f, cx1 = 1e9f, cy1 = 1e9f;   // v20: recorte do texto (o retangulo do rotulo): o original corta, nao quebra
    const void* widget = nullptr;
};

enum class ButtonState { Up, Selected, Down, Disabled };

// O que o backend sabe responder: tamanho de uma textura (false = nao existe) e largura de um texto numa fonte/tamanho.
struct GuiResources {
    std::function<bool(const std::string& tex, int& w, int& h)> texture_size;
    std::function<float(const std::string& font, float px, const std::string& text)> text_width;
    std::function<float(const std::string& font, float px)> line_height;
    std::function<std::string(std::uint32_t text_id)> text;           // id 1-based do .stf -> texto cp1252 ("" se nao achar)
    std::function<const Skin*(const std::string& skin_file)> skin;    // nullptr se nao houver
};

class GuiScreen {
public:
    bool load(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, std::string& err);
    bool load_file(const std::string& path, std::string& err);
    const GuiFile& file() const { return file_; }
    GuiWidget* find(const std::string& name) const { return file_.find(name); }

    // estado
    void set_hover(const GuiWidget* w) { hover_ = w; }
    void set_pressed(const GuiWidget* w) { pressed_ = w; }
    const GuiWidget* hover() const { return hover_; }
    const GuiWidget* pressed() const { return pressed_; }
    void set_disabled(const std::string& name, bool v);
    void set_checked(const std::string& name, bool v);
    void set_hidden(const std::string& name, bool v);
    void set_text(const std::string& name, const std::string& cp1252);   // troca o texto de um rotulo/campo
    void set_image(const std::string& name, const std::string& texture);  // desenha esta textura esticada sobre o widget (ex.: digito, imagem de loading)
    void clear_image(const std::string& name);
    void set_offset(const std::string& name, float dx, float dy);        // desloca o widget e os filhos (ex.: cursor de um slider)
    void get_offset(const std::string& name, float& dx, float& dy) const;
    void clear_text(const std::string& name);
    bool is_disabled(const GuiWidget* w) const;
    bool is_checked(const GuiWidget* w) const;
    bool is_hidden(const GuiWidget* w) const;
    ButtonState state_of(const GuiWidget* w) const;

    // Botao (ou campo de edicao) mais de cima sob o ponto (tela virtual). nullptr = nenhum. Ignora ocultos e desabilitados.
    GuiWidget* hit(float x, float y) const;
    // Monta a lista de desenho (ordem = ordem de pintura).
    void build(const GuiResources& res, std::vector<GuiDraw>& out) const;
    // Estatisticas do ultimo build (para o log): fragmentos desenhados, pulados por textura ausente, rotulos com texto.
    struct Stats { std::size_t quads = 0, missing = 0, texts = 0; std::set<std::string> missing_names; };
    const Stats& stats() const { return stats_; }

    // Deslocamento da tela inteira em pixels virtuais (ex.: centralizar uma MessageBox de 386x162 na tela).
    float offset_x = 0, offset_y = 0;

private:
    void build_widget(const GuiWidget& w, const GuiResources& res, std::vector<GuiDraw>& out, bool parent_down, bool parent_checked, float ox, float oy) const;
    void build_frags(const GuiWidget& w, const GuiResources& res, std::vector<GuiDraw>& out, const SkinFragment* const* skin_state, bool additive, float ox, float oy) const;
    void build_text(const GuiWidget& w, const GuiResources& res, std::vector<GuiDraw>& out, float ox, float oy) const;

    GuiFile file_;
    const GuiWidget* hover_ = nullptr;
    const GuiWidget* pressed_ = nullptr;
    std::set<std::string> disabled_, checked_, hidden_;
    std::map<std::string, std::string> text_, image_;
    std::map<std::string, std::pair<float, float>> woff_;
    mutable Stats stats_;
};

// Quebra um texto em linhas que cabem em `width` (por palavras; palavra maior que a largura fica sozinha na linha).
std::vector<std::string> wrap_text(const std::string& text, float width, const std::function<float(const std::string&)>& measure);
// Tamanho da fonte do .int (pontos) -> altura do "em" em pixels (96 dpi).
inline float font_px(std::uint32_t points) { return points ? static_cast<float>(points) * 4.f / 3.f : 12.f; }

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/gui_gl.cpp

```cpp
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#include <GL/gl.h>

#include "gui_gl.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

#ifndef GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE
#define GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE 0x812F
#endif

namespace f3v {

void GuiGL::begin(int w, int h) {
    win_w_ = std::max(1, w); win_h_ = std::max(1, h);
    s_ = std::min(static_cast<float>(win_w_) / 1024.f, static_cast<float>(win_h_) / 768.f);
    ox_ = (static_cast<float>(win_w_) - 1024.f * s_) * 0.5f;
    oy_ = (static_cast<float>(win_h_) - 768.f * s_) * 0.5f;
    glViewport(0, 0, win_w_, win_h_);
    glMatrixMode(GL_PROJECTION); glLoadIdentity();
    glOrtho(0, win_w_, win_h_, 0, -1, 1);
    glMatrixMode(GL_MODELVIEW); glLoadIdentity();
    glTranslatef(ox_, oy_, 0);
    glScalef(s_, s_, 1);
    glDisable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
    glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
    glDisable(GL_CULL_FACE);
    glEnable(GL_BLEND);
    glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
    glEnable(GL_TEXTURE_2D);
    glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_TEXTURE_ENV_MODE, GL_MODULATE);
}

void GuiGL::end() {
    glDisable(GL_BLEND);
    glDisable(GL_TEXTURE_2D);
    glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
}

void GuiGL::to_virtual(int mx, int my, float& vx, float& vy) const {
    vx = (static_cast<float>(mx) - ox_) / s_;
    vy = (static_cast<float>(my) - oy_) / s_;
}

unsigned GuiGL::texture(const std::string& name, int& w, int& h) {
    const std::string key = lower_ascii(name);
    auto it = tex_.find(key);
    if (it == tex_.end()) {
        Tex t;
        if (const Image* im = assets_.image(key)) {
            GLuint id = 0;
            glGenTextures(1, &id);
            glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, id);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, GL_REPEAT);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, GL_REPEAT);
            glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_RGBA, static_cast<GLsizei>(im->w), static_cast<GLsizei>(im->h), 0, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, im->rgba.data());
            t.id = id; t.w = static_cast<int>(im->w); t.h = static_cast<int>(im->h);
        }
        it = tex_.emplace(key, t).first;
    }
    w = it->second.w; h = it->second.h;
    return it->second.id;
}

const GuiGL::FontTex* GuiGL::font(const std::string& name, float px) {
    const FontAtlas* a = assets_.atlas(name, px);
    if (!a) return nullptr;
    auto it = fonts_.find(a);
    if (it == fonts_.end()) {
        FontTex f;
        f.atlas = a;
        GLuint id = 0;
        glGenTextures(1, &id);
        glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, id);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
        glPixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 1);
        glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_ALPHA, a->w, a->h, 0, GL_ALPHA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, a->alpha.data());
        glPixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 4);
        f.id = id;
        it = fonts_.emplace(a, f).first;
    }
    return &it->second;
}

void GuiGL::image(const std::string& tex, float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, const std::uint8_t rgba[4], bool additive) {
    int w, h;
    const unsigned id = texture(tex, w, h);
    if (!id) return;
    glEnable(GL_TEXTURE_2D);
    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, id);
    if (additive) glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);
    if (rgba) glColor4ub(rgba[0], rgba[1], rgba[2], rgba[3]); else glColor4f(1, 1, 1, 1);
    glBegin(GL_QUADS);
    glTexCoord2f(0, 0); glVertex2f(x0, y0);
    glTexCoord2f(1, 0); glVertex2f(x1, y0);
    glTexCoord2f(1, 1); glVertex2f(x1, y1);
    glTexCoord2f(0, 1); glVertex2f(x0, y1);
    glEnd();
    if (additive) glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
}

void GuiGL::rect(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float r, float g, float b, float a) {
    glDisable(GL_TEXTURE_2D);
    glColor4f(r, g, b, a);
    glBegin(GL_QUADS);
    glVertex2f(x0, y0); glVertex2f(x1, y0); glVertex2f(x1, y1); glVertex2f(x0, y1);
    glEnd();
    glEnable(GL_TEXTURE_2D);
}

float GuiGL::text_width(const std::string& f, float px, const std::string& s) {
    const FontAtlas* a = assets_.atlas(f, px * s_);
    return a ? a->measure(s) / s_ : static_cast<float>(s.size()) * px * 0.5f;
}

void GuiGL::text(const std::string& fname, float px, float x, float y, const std::string& s, const std::uint8_t rgba[4], int align) {
    // o atlas e assado no tamanho REAL em pixels de tela (px * escala) para o texto sair nitido; as medidas voltam para a tela virtual
    const FontTex* f = font(fname, px * s_);
    if (!f) return;
    const FontAtlas& a = *f->atlas;
    const float inv = 1.f / s_;
    float pen = x;
    const float tw = a.measure(s) * inv;
    if (align == 1) pen = x - tw * 0.5f; else if (align == 2) pen = x - tw;
    // alinha a linha de base a um pixel de tela
    const float base_screen = std::floor((y * s_ + oy_) + a.ascent + 0.5f);
    float pen_screen = std::floor(pen * s_ + ox_ + 0.5f);
    glEnable(GL_TEXTURE_2D);
    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, f->id);
    glColor4ub(rgba[0], rgba[1], rgba[2], rgba[3]);
    glPushMatrix();
    glLoadIdentity();                               // desenha em pixels de tela (sem a escala), para o atlas casar 1:1
    glBegin(GL_QUADS);
    const float iw = 1.f / static_cast<float>(a.w), ih = 1.f / static_cast<float>(a.h);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        const std::uint8_t ch = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(s[i]);
        const GlyphInfo& g = a.glyph[ch];
        if (g.w > 0) {
            const float gx = pen_screen + static_cast<float>(g.ox), gy = base_screen + static_cast<float>(g.oy);
            const float u0 = g.x * iw, v0 = g.y * ih, u1 = (g.x + g.w) * iw, v1 = (g.y + g.h) * ih;
            glTexCoord2f(u0, v0); glVertex2f(gx, gy);
            glTexCoord2f(u1, v0); glVertex2f(gx + g.w, gy);
            glTexCoord2f(u1, v1); glVertex2f(gx + g.w, gy + g.h);
            glTexCoord2f(u0, v1); glVertex2f(gx, gy + g.h);
        }
        pen_screen += g.advance;
        if (i + 1 < s.size()) {
            const auto it = a.kern.find((static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ch) << 8) | static_cast<std::uint8_t>(s[i + 1]));
            if (it != a.kern.end()) pen_screen += it->second;
        }
    }
    glEnd();
    glPopMatrix();
}

void GuiGL::draw(const std::vector<GuiDraw>& list) {
    for (const GuiDraw& d : list) {
        if (d.kind == GuiDraw::Quad) {
            int w, h;
            const unsigned id = texture(d.texture, w, h);
            if (!id) continue;
            glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, id);
            if (d.additive) glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);
            glColor4ub(d.rgba[0], d.rgba[1], d.rgba[2], d.rgba[3]);
            glBegin(GL_QUADS);
            glTexCoord2f(d.u0, d.v0); glVertex2f(d.x0, d.y0);
            glTexCoord2f(d.u1, d.v0); glVertex2f(d.x1, d.y0);
            glTexCoord2f(d.u1, d.v1); glVertex2f(d.x1, d.y1);
            glTexCoord2f(d.u0, d.v1); glVertex2f(d.x0, d.y1);
            glEnd();
            if (d.additive) glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
        } else {
            float x = d.x0 + 1;
            if (d.align == 1) x = (d.x0 + d.x1) * 0.5f; else if (d.align == 2) x = d.x1 - 1;
            const bool clip = d.cx1 - d.cx0 < 1e8f;
            if (clip) {                                   // v20: corta no retangulo do rotulo (como o original)
                const int sx0 = static_cast<int>(std::floor(d.cx0 * s_ + ox_)), sx1 = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(d.cx1 * s_ + ox_));
                const int sy0 = static_cast<int>(std::floor(d.cy0 * s_ + oy_)), sy1 = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(d.cy1 * s_ + oy_));
                glEnable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
                glScissor(sx0, win_h_ - sy1, std::max(0, sx1 - sx0), std::max(0, sy1 - sy0));
            }
            text(d.font, d.size_px, x, d.y0, d.text, d.rgba, d.align);
            if (clip) glDisable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
        }
    }
}

void GuiGL::release() {
    for (auto& kv : tex_) if (kv.second.id) { GLuint id = kv.second.id; glDeleteTextures(1, &id); }
    for (auto& kv : fonts_) if (kv.second.id) { GLuint id = kv.second.id; glDeleteTextures(1, &id); }
    tex_.clear(); fonts_.clear();
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// Backend OpenGL da interface (v19): desenha a lista de desenho do GuiScreen (gui.h) e textos/imagens avulsos.
// A interface e desenhada numa "tela virtual" de 1024x768 (a do .int), escalada para caber na janela mantendo 4:3 (faixas nas laterais em 16:9).
// Win32 + OpenGL 1.x. As imagens e fontes vem do UiAssets (portavel); aqui so viram texturas.
#pragma once
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "gui.h"
#include "ui_assets.h"

namespace f3v {

class GuiGL {
public:
    explicit GuiGL(UiAssets& a) : assets_(a) {}
    void begin(int win_w, int win_h);                 // ortho da tela virtual; chame antes de desenhar a UI (depois do 3D)
    void end();
    void draw(const std::vector<GuiDraw>& list);
    void image(const std::string& tex, float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, const std::uint8_t rgba[4] = nullptr, bool additive = false);
    void rect(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float r, float g, float b, float a);
    // Texto numa fonte do jogo. align 0/1/2 em relacao a x (esquerda/centro/direita). y = topo da linha.
    void text(const std::string& font, float px, float x, float y, const std::string& cp1252, const std::uint8_t rgba[4], int align = 0);
    float text_width(const std::string& font, float px, const std::string& cp1252);
    // Mouse da janela -> tela virtual
    void to_virtual(int mx, int my, float& vx, float& vy) const;
    float scale() const { return s_; }
    void release();                                   // apaga as texturas (troca de contexto / fim)
    std::size_t texture_count() const { return tex_.size(); }

private:
    unsigned texture(const std::string& name, int& w, int& h);
    struct FontTex { unsigned id = 0; const FontAtlas* atlas = nullptr; };
    const FontTex* font(const std::string& name, float px);
    UiAssets& assets_;
    struct Tex { unsigned id = 0; int w = 0, h = 0; };
    std::map<std::string, Tex> tex_;
    std::map<const FontAtlas*, FontTex> fonts_;
    float s_ = 1, ox_ = 0, oy_ = 0;
    int win_w_ = 1, win_h_ = 1;
};

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/gui_int.cpp

```cpp
#include "gui_int.h"

#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>

namespace f3v {

namespace {

constexpr std::uint32_t kMaxStr = 4096, kMaxChildren = 4096;
constexpr int kMaxDepth = 32;

struct Reader {
    const std::uint8_t* d; std::size_t n, o = 0; std::string* err; bool bad = false;
    bool fail(const std::string& m) { if (!bad) { *err = m + " (em " + std::to_string(o) + ")"; bad = true; } return false; }
    bool need(std::size_t k) { return o + k <= n ? true : fail("fim do arquivo: faltam " + std::to_string(o + k - n) + " bytes"); }
    std::uint8_t u8() { if (!need(1)) return 0; return d[o++]; }
    std::uint32_t u32() { if (!need(4)) return 0; const std::uint32_t v = d[o] | (d[o + 1] << 8) | (d[o + 2] << 16) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(d[o + 3]) << 24); o += 4; return v; }
    std::int32_t i32() { return static_cast<std::int32_t>(u32()); }
    void raw(std::uint8_t* dst, std::size_t k) { if (!need(k)) return; std::memcpy(dst, d + o, k); o += k; }
    IRect rect() { IRect r; r.x0 = i32(); r.y0 = i32(); r.x1 = i32(); r.y1 = i32(); return r; }
    std::string str() {
        const std::uint32_t k = u32();
        if (bad) return {};
        if (k > kMaxStr) { fail("string de " + std::to_string(k) + " bytes (absurda)"); return {}; }
        if (!need(k)) return {};
        std::string s(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(d + o), k);
        o += k;
        return s;
    }
};

bool read_widget(Reader& r, std::uint32_t kind, int ver, int depth, GuiWidget* parent, std::unique_ptr<GuiWidget>& out) {
    if (depth > kMaxDepth) return r.fail("arvore funda demais");
    if (kind > 4) return r.fail("tipo de objeto desconhecido " + std::to_string(kind));
    auto w = std::make_unique<GuiWidget>();
    w->kind = static_cast<WidgetKind>(kind);
    w->parent = parent;
    if (w->kind == WidgetKind::Button) {
        r.u32();
        if (ver >= 13) { r.u8(); for (auto& s : w->sounds) s = r.str(); }
    }
    w->rect = r.rect();
    w->name = r.str();
    r.u8(); r.u8(); r.u8();
    w->skin = r.str();
    r.raw(w->color, 4);
    w->rel = r.rect();
    r.u8();
    w->interactive = r.u32();
    if (ver >= 12) { r.u32(); w->tip_a = r.i32(); r.u32(); w->tip_text = r.i32(); w->tip_texture = r.str(); }
    for (GuiFragment& f : w->frag) {
        f.flags = r.u32(); f.width = r.i32(); f.height = r.i32(); r.i32(); r.i32();
        r.u32();
        f.texture = r.str();
        r.u32();                                                   // f32 sem uso conhecido
        r.raw(f.rgba, 4);
        f.rect = r.rect();
    }
    r.i32();                                                       // sempre -1 nos arquivos reais
    const std::uint32_t nch = r.u32();
    if (r.bad) return false;
    if (nch > kMaxChildren) return r.fail(std::to_string(nch) + " filhos (absurdo)");
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nch; ++i) {
        const std::uint32_t k = r.u32();
        std::unique_ptr<GuiWidget> c;
        if (r.bad || !read_widget(r, k, ver, depth + 1, w.get(), c)) return false;
        w->children.push_back(std::move(c));
    }
    if (w->kind == WidgetKind::Label || w->kind == WidgetKind::Edit) {   // sufixo DEPOIS dos filhos
        w->text_id = r.u32();
        w->font = r.str();
        r.u32();
        w->font_size = r.u32();
        r.u32();
        r.raw(w->text_rgba, 4);
        r.raw(w->text_tail, sizeof w->text_tail);
        w->align = r.u32();
    }
    if (r.bad) return false;
    out = std::move(w);
    return true;
}

}  // namespace

const char* widget_kind_name(WidgetKind k) {
    switch (k) {
        case WidgetKind::Window: return "janela";
        case WidgetKind::Button: return "botao";
        case WidgetKind::Picture: return "imagem";
        case WidgetKind::Label: return "rotulo";
        case WidgetKind::Edit: return "edicao";
    }
    return "?";
}

std::string lower_ascii(const std::string& s) {
    std::string o(s);
    for (char& c : o) if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'A' + 'a');
    return o;
}

GuiWidget* GuiFile::find(const std::string& name) const {
    const std::string low = lower_ascii(name);
    GuiWidget* hit = nullptr;
    walk([&](GuiWidget& w, int) { if (!hit && lower_ascii(w.name) == low) hit = &w; });
    return hit;
}

std::size_t GuiFile::count() const {
    std::size_t n = 0;
    walk([&](GuiWidget&, int) { ++n; });
    return n;
}

bool load_gui(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, GuiFile& out, std::string& err) {
    out = GuiFile();
    if (!data || size < 12 || std::memcmp(data, "GUI V", 5) != 0 || data[6] != '.' || data[5] < '0' || data[5] > '9' || data[7] < '0' || data[7] > '9') {
        err = "nao e um .int (assinatura 'GUI V1.x' ausente)";
        return false;
    }
    const int ver = (data[5] - '0') * 10 + (data[7] - '0');
    if (ver < 11 || ver > 13) { err = "versao GUI V" + std::string(1, static_cast<char>(data[5])) + "." + std::string(1, static_cast<char>(data[7])) + " nao suportada"; return false; }
    Reader r{data, size, 8, &err};
    out.version = ver;
    out.name = r.str();
    r.u8();
    const std::uint32_t nroots = r.u32();
    if (r.bad) return false;
    if (nroots > kMaxChildren) { err = std::to_string(nroots) + " raizes (absurdo)"; return false; }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nroots; ++i) {
        const std::uint32_t k = r.u32();
        std::unique_ptr<GuiWidget> w;
        if (r.bad || !read_widget(r, k, ver, 0, nullptr, w)) { out.roots.clear(); return false; }
        out.roots.push_back(std::move(w));
    }
    if (r.o != size) { err = "sobraram " + std::to_string(size - r.o) + " bytes depois da arvore"; out.roots.clear(); return false; }
    return true;
}

bool load_gui_file(const std::string& path, GuiFile& out, std::string& err) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) { err = "nao consegui abrir " + path; return false; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> b((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    return load_gui(b.data(), b.size(), out, err);
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/gui_int.h

```cpp
// Leitor do formato .int (layout de uma tela da interface, recurso INT_Interface) - v19. Spec: docs/specs/int.md.
// Portavel (so C++ padrao), com checagem de limites em tudo: arquivo corrompido devolve false com a mensagem em `err`.
// Mesma gramatica do leitor Python (tools/py/f3vb/intfile.py), que le os 25 arquivos reais ate o ultimo byte.
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

enum class WidgetKind : std::uint32_t { Window = 0, Button = 1, Picture = 2, Label = 3, Edit = 4 };
const char* widget_kind_name(WidgetKind k);

struct IRect { std::int32_t x0 = 0, y0 = 0, x1 = 0, y1 = 0; std::int32_t w() const { return x1 - x0; } std::int32_t h() const { return y1 - y0; } };

// Um dos 9 fragmentos (nove fatias) de um objeto. flags: 0 esticar, 1 repetir em x, 2 repetir em y, 3 repetir nos dois.
struct GuiFragment {
    std::uint32_t flags = 0;
    std::int32_t width = 0, height = 0;          // recorte da textura em pixels
    std::string texture;                          // "" = sem textura
    std::uint8_t rgba[4] = {255, 255, 255, 255};  // alfa 0 = invisivel neste estado
    IRect rect;                                   // absoluto na tela de 1024x768
};

struct GuiWidget {
    WidgetKind kind = WidgetKind::Window;
    std::string name, skin;
    IRect rect, rel;                              // rect = absoluto (1024x768); rel = relativo (nao usado para desenhar)
    std::uint8_t color[4] = {128, 128, 128, 255};
    std::uint32_t interactive = 0;                // 1 em janelas/botoes/campos (hipotese)
    std::int32_t tip_a = -1, tip_text = -1;       // V1.2+: ids da dica (tooltip)
    std::string tip_texture;
    std::array<GuiFragment, 9> frag;              // upperleft, uppermiddle, upperright, left, middle, right, lowerleft, lowermiddle, lowerright
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<GuiWidget>> children;
    // botao
    std::string sounds[3];                        // apertar, soltar, soltar (V1.3)
    // rotulo / edicao
    std::uint32_t text_id = 0;                    // 1-based no .stf (0 = sem texto)
    std::string font;
    std::uint32_t font_size = 0;
    std::uint8_t text_rgba[4] = {255, 255, 255, 255};
    std::uint32_t align = 0;                      // u32 final do sufixo: 1 ou 2 nos arquivos; v20: NAO e o alinhamento (significado desconhecido)
    std::uint8_t text_tail[22] = {0};             // v20: bytes do sufixo; text_tail[2] = alinhamento horizontal (0 esquerda, 1 direita, 2 centro), medido nos prints
    int halign() const { return text_tail[2] == 1 ? 2 : (text_tail[2] == 2 ? 1 : 0); }   // 0 esquerda, 1 centro, 2 direita (convencao do GuiDraw)
    GuiWidget* parent = nullptr;

    bool is(WidgetKind k) const { return kind == k; }
};

struct GuiFile {
    int version = 0;                              // 11, 12 ou 13
    std::string name;
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<GuiWidget>> roots;

    // Busca por nome (sem diferenciar maiusculas), em profundidade. nullptr se nao achar.
    GuiWidget* find(const std::string& name) const;
    std::size_t count() const;
    template <class F> void walk(F&& f) const { for (const auto& r : roots) walk_one(r.get(), 0, f); }

private:
    template <class F> static void walk_one(GuiWidget* w, int depth, F& f) { f(*w, depth); for (const auto& c : w->children) walk_one(c.get(), depth + 1, f); }
};

bool load_gui(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, GuiFile& out, std::string& err);
bool load_gui_file(const std::string& path, GuiFile& out, std::string& err);

std::string lower_ascii(const std::string& s);

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
#include "image.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

namespace {

std::uint16_t rd16(const std::uint8_t* p) { return static_cast<std::uint16_t>(p[0] | (p[1] << 8)); }
std::uint32_t rd32(const std::uint8_t* p) { return p[0] | (p[1] << 8) | (p[2] << 16) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[3]) << 24); }

// Converte 1 pixel cru (bb bytes) do TGA para RGBA.
void tga_pixel(const std::uint8_t* s, int bb, int base, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& pal, std::uint16_t cm_first, std::uint8_t* d) {
    if (base == 1) {                                              // paletizado (indice de 8 ou 16 bits)
        std::uint32_t idx = bb == 1 ? s[0] : rd16(s);
        idx = idx >= cm_first ? idx - cm_first : 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        if (idx < pal.size() / 4) { d[0] = pal[4 * idx]; d[1] = pal[4 * idx + 1]; d[2] = pal[4 * idx + 2]; d[3] = pal[4 * idx + 3]; }
        else { d[0] = d[1] = d[2] = 0; d[3] = 255; }
    } else if (base == 3) {                                       // cinza
        d[0] = d[1] = d[2] = s[0]; d[3] = bb >= 2 ? s[1] : 255;
    } else if (bb == 4) { d[0] = s[2]; d[1] = s[1]; d[2] = s[0]; d[3] = s[3]; }
    else if (bb == 3) { d[0] = s[2]; d[1] = s[1]; d[2] = s[0]; d[3] = 255; }
    else {                                                        // 15/16 bits: 1-5-5-5
        const unsigned v = rd16(s);
        d[0] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(((v >> 10) & 31) * 255 / 31);
        d[1] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(((v >> 5) & 31) * 255 / 31);
        d[2] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>((v & 31) * 255 / 31);
        d[3] = 255;
    }
}

}  // namespace

bool decode_tga(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, Image& out, std::string& err) {
    if (!data || size < 18) { err = "TGA menor que o cabecalho (18 bytes)"; return false; }
    const std::uint8_t idlen = data[0], cmap_type = data[1], itype = data[2];
    const std::uint16_t cm_first = rd16(data + 3), cm_len = rd16(data + 5);
    const std::uint8_t cm_bits = data[7];
    const std::uint32_t w = rd16(data + 12), h = rd16(data + 14);
    const std::uint8_t bpp = data[16], desc = data[17];
    if (w == 0 || h == 0 || w > kMaxTexSize || h > kMaxTexSize) { err = "dimensoes invalidas " + std::to_string(w) + "x" + std::to_string(h); return false; }
    const int base = itype & 7;
    const bool rle = (itype & 8) != 0;
    if (base < 1 || base > 3) { err = "tipo de TGA nao suportado: " + std::to_string(itype); return false; }
    const int bb = (bpp + 7) / 8;
    if (bb < 1 || bb > 4 || (base == 2 && bb < 2) || (base == 1 && bb > 2)) { err = "bits por pixel nao suportados: " + std::to_string(bpp); return false; }
    std::size_t pos = 18u + idlen;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> pal;
    if (cmap_type) {
        const int cb = (cm_bits + 7) / 8;
        if (cb < 2 || cb > 4) { err = "paleta TGA nao suportada (" + std::to_string(cm_bits) + " bits)"; return false; }
        if (pos + static_cast<std::size_t>(cm_len) * cb > size) { err = "paleta TGA truncada"; return false; }
        pal.resize(4u * cm_len);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < cm_len; ++i) tga_pixel(data + pos + i * cb, cb, 2, pal, 0, pal.data() + 4 * i);
        pos += static_cast<std::size_t>(cm_len) * cb;
    }
    if (base == 1 && pal.empty()) { err = "TGA paletizado sem paleta"; return false; }
    const std::size_t npx = static_cast<std::size_t>(w) * h;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> rgba(npx * 4);
    if (!rle) {
        if (pos + npx * bb > size) { err = "dados de pixel truncados"; return false; }
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < npx; ++i) tga_pixel(data + pos + i * bb, bb, base, pal, cm_first, rgba.data() + 4 * i);
    } else {
        std::size_t i = 0;
        while (i < npx) {
            if (pos >= size) { err = "RLE do TGA truncado no pixel " + std::to_string(i); return false; }
            const std::uint8_t hd = data[pos++];
            const std::size_t n = (hd & 0x7F) + 1u;
            if (i + n > npx) { err = "RLE do TGA passa do fim da imagem"; return false; }
            if (hd & 0x80) {
                if (pos + bb > size) { err = "RLE do TGA truncado"; return false; }
                std::uint8_t px[4];
                tga_pixel(data + pos, bb, base, pal, cm_first, px);
                pos += bb;
                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k, ++i) for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) rgba[4 * i + c] = px[c];
            } else {
                if (pos + n * bb > size) { err = "RLE do TGA truncado"; return false; }
                for (std::size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k, ++i, pos += bb) tga_pixel(data + pos, bb, base, pal, cm_first, rgba.data() + 4 * i);
            }
        }
    }
    // Sem alfa declarado (bits 0-3 do descritor = 0) e 32 bits com alfa todo zero: trata como opaco (TGAs antigos sem canal alfa usado).
    if (bb == 4 && (desc & 0x0F) == 0) {
        bool all0 = true;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < npx && all0; ++i) all0 = rgba[4 * i + 3] == 0;
        if (all0) for (std::size_t i = 0; i < npx; ++i) rgba[4 * i + 3] = 255;
    }
    if (desc & 0x10) {                                            // origem a direita: espelha cada linha
        for (std::uint32_t y = 0; y < h; ++y)
            for (std::uint32_t x = 0; x < w / 2; ++x)
                for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) std::swap(rgba[(static_cast<std::size_t>(y) * w + x) * 4 + c], rgba[(static_cast<std::size_t>(y) * w + (w - 1 - x)) * 4 + c]);
    }
    out.w = w; out.h = h;
    if (desc & 0x20) out.rgba.swap(rgba);                         // origem em cima: ja esta de cima para baixo
    else {                                                        // origem embaixo (o comum na demo): inverte as linhas
        out.rgba.resize(rgba.size());
        const std::size_t row = static_cast<std::size_t>(w) * 4;
        for (std::uint32_t y = 0; y < h; ++y) std::copy(rgba.begin() + (h - 1 - y) * row, rgba.begin() + (h - y) * row, out.rgba.begin() + y * row);
    }
    return true;
}

bool decode_bmp(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, Image& out, std::string& err) {
    if (!data || size < 54 || data[0] != 'B' || data[1] != 'M') { err = "nao e BMP"; return false; }
    const std::uint32_t off = rd32(data + 10), dib = rd32(data + 14);
    const std::int32_t wi = static_cast<std::int32_t>(rd32(data + 18)), hi = static_cast<std::int32_t>(rd32(data + 22));
    const std::uint16_t bpp = rd16(data + 28);
    const std::uint32_t comp = rd32(data + 30);
    if (dib < 40 || (comp != 0 && comp != 3) || (bpp != 8 && bpp != 24 && bpp != 32) || wi <= 0 || hi == 0 || hi == INT32_MIN) {
        err = "BMP nao suportado (bpp=" + std::to_string(bpp) + ", compressao=" + std::to_string(comp) + ")"; return false;
    }
    const bool top_down = hi < 0;
    const std::uint32_t w = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(wi), h = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(top_down ? -hi : hi);
    if (w > kMaxTexSize || h > kMaxTexSize) { err = "BMP grande demais"; return false; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> pal;
    if (bpp == 8) {
        std::uint32_t n = size >= 50 ? rd32(data + 46) : 0;
        if (n == 0 || n > 256) n = 256;
        const std::size_t po = 14u + dib;
        if (po + 4u * n > size) { err = "paleta do BMP truncada"; return false; }
        pal.resize(4u * n);
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { pal[4 * i] = data[po + 4 * i + 2]; pal[4 * i + 1] = data[po + 4 * i + 1]; pal[4 * i + 2] = data[po + 4 * i]; pal[4 * i + 3] = 255; }
    }
    const std::size_t stride = ((static_cast<std::size_t>(w) * bpp + 31) / 32) * 4;
    if (off > size || stride * h > size - off) { err = "BMP truncado"; return false; }
    out.w = w; out.h = h;
    out.rgba.assign(static_cast<std::size_t>(w) * h * 4, 0);
    for (std::uint32_t y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
        const std::uint32_t src_row = top_down ? y : h - 1 - y;
        const std::uint8_t* line = data + off + stride * src_row;
        std::uint8_t* d = out.rgba.data() + static_cast<std::size_t>(y) * w * 4;
        for (std::uint32_t x = 0; x < w; ++x, d += 4) {
            if (bpp == 24) { d[0] = line[3 * x + 2]; d[1] = line[3 * x + 1]; d[2] = line[3 * x]; d[3] = 255; }
            else if (bpp == 32) { d[0] = line[4 * x + 2]; d[1] = line[4 * x + 1]; d[2] = line[4 * x]; d[3] = line[4 * x + 3] ? line[4 * x + 3] : 255; }
            else {
                const std::uint32_t k = line[x];
                if (4u * k + 3 < pal.size()) { d[0] = pal[4 * k]; d[1] = pal[4 * k + 1]; d[2] = pal[4 * k + 2]; d[3] = 255; }
                else { d[3] = 255; }
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool decode_image(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, Image& out, std::string& err) {
    if (size >= 2 && data[0] == 'B' && data[1] == 'M') return decode_bmp(data, size, out, err);
    if (size >= 4 && data[0] == 'F' && data[1] == '3' && data[2] == 'T' && data[3] == 'X') return load_f3tex(data, size, out, err);
    return decode_tga(data, size, out, err);
}

bool load_image_file(const std::string& path, Image& out, std::string& err) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) { err = "nao consegui abrir " + path; return false; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> b((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    return decode_image(b.data(), b.size(), out, err);
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// Decodificadores de imagem proprios (v19): TGA (cru e RLE; 8 bits paletizado/cinza, 15/16, 24 e 32 bits) e BMP (8, 24 e 32 bits, sem compressao).
// Portavel (so C++ padrao), com checagem de limites: arquivo corrompido devolve false com a mensagem em `err`, nunca derruba o programa.
// Saida no mesmo formato do .f3tex (f3tex.h): RGBA8, linhas de CIMA para BAIXO. Assim a interface le direto do RETAIL, sem conversao.
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

#include "f3tex.h"

namespace f3v {

bool decode_tga(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, Image& out, std::string& err);
bool decode_bmp(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, Image& out, std::string& err);
// Escolhe pelo conteudo: "BM" = BMP, "F3TX" = .f3tex, senao TGA.
bool decode_image(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, Image& out, std::string& err);
bool load_image_file(const std::string& path, Image& out, std::string& err);

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/log.cpp

```cpp
#include "log.h"

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

namespace {
std::tm local_tm(std::time_t t) {
    std::tm out{};
#if defined(_WIN32)
    localtime_s(&out, &t);
#else
    localtime_r(&t, &out);
#endif
    return out;
}
bool exists(const std::string& p) {
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(p.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!f) return false;
    std::fclose(f);
    return true;
}
}  // namespace

std::string Log::stamp_name(std::time_t t) {
    const std::tm tm = local_tm(t);
    char buf[32];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%02d-%02d-%02d_%02d-%02d-%02d", tm.tm_mon + 1, tm.tm_mday, tm.tm_year % 100, tm.tm_hour, tm.tm_min, tm.tm_sec);
    return buf;
}

std::string Log::file_name(std::time_t t, const std::string& prefix) { return prefix + "_" + stamp_name(t) + ".txt"; }

bool Log::open(const std::string& dir, const std::string& prefix) {
    close();
    const std::string base = file_name(std::time(nullptr), prefix);
    const std::string folder = dir.empty() ? std::string() : dir + ((dir.back() == '/' || dir.back() == '\\') ? "" : "/");
    std::string p = folder + base;
    for (int n = 2; exists(p) && n < 1000; ++n) p = folder + base.substr(0, base.size() - 4) + "_" + std::to_string(n) + ".txt";
    f_ = std::fopen(p.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!f_) return false;
    path_ = p;
    return true;
}

void Log::close() {
    if (f_) std::fclose(f_);
    f_ = nullptr;
}

void Log::line(const std::string& s) {
    if (!f_) return;
    using namespace std::chrono;
    const auto now = system_clock::now();
    const std::time_t t = system_clock::to_time_t(now);
    const long ms = static_cast<long>(duration_cast<milliseconds>(now.time_since_epoch()).count() % 1000);
    const std::tm tm = local_tm(t);
    std::fprintf(f_, "[%02d:%02d:%02d.%03ld] %s\r\n", tm.tm_hour, tm.tm_min, tm.tm_sec, ms, s.c_str());
    std::fflush(f_);
}

void Log::linef(const char* fmt, ...) {
    if (!f_) return;
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    va_list ap2;
    va_copy(ap2, ap);
    const int n = std::vsnprintf(nullptr, 0, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    std::vector<char> buf(static_cast<std::size_t>(n > 0 ? n : 0) + 1);
    if (n > 0) std::vsnprintf(buf.data(), buf.size(), fmt, ap2);
    va_end(ap2);
    line(std::string(buf.data()));
}

void Log::block(const std::string& text) {
    if (!f_) return;
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(text.size() + text.size() / 40);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < text.size(); ++i) {          // CRLF para abrir bem no Bloco de Notas antigo tambem
        if (text[i] == '\n' && (i == 0 || text[i - 1] != '\r')) out += "\r\n";
        else if (text[i] != '\r') out += text[i];
        else out += '\r';
    }
    if (out.size() < 2 || out.compare(out.size() - 2, 2, "\r\n") != 0) out += "\r\n";
    std::fwrite(out.data(), 1, out.size(), f_);
    std::fflush(f_);
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/log.h

```cpp
// Log em arquivo de texto com carimbo de hora: f3viewer_log_MM-DD-YY_hh-mm-ss.txt (criado ao abrir o visualizador).
// Portatil (so C++ padrao), gravacao com flush a cada linha: se o programa fechar de repente, o log ate ali esta salvo.
#pragma once
#include <cstdio>
#include <ctime>
#include <string>

namespace f3v {

class Log {
public:
    Log() = default;
    Log(const Log&) = delete;
    Log& operator=(const Log&) = delete;
    ~Log() { close(); }

    // Cria <dir>/f3viewer_log_MM-DD-YY_hh-mm-ss.txt (dir vazio = pasta atual; a pasta ja deve existir).
    // Se o nome ja existir (duas execucoes no mesmo segundo), acrescenta _2, _3...
    bool open(const std::string& dir, const std::string& prefix = "f3viewer_log");   // prefixo: "f3mapviewer_log" no visualizador de mapas
    void close();
    bool is_open() const { return f_ != nullptr; }
    const std::string& path() const { return path_; }

    void line(const std::string& s);              // "[hh:mm:ss.mmm] texto"
    void linef(const char* fmt, ...)
#if defined(__GNUC__)
        __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)))
#endif
        ;
    void block(const std::string& text);          // texto cru (tabelas de analise), sem carimbo por linha

    static std::string stamp_name(std::time_t t); // "MM-DD-YY_hh-mm-ss"
    static std::string file_name(std::time_t t, const std::string& prefix = "f3viewer_log");  // "<prefixo>_MM-DD-YY_hh-mm-ss.txt"

private:
    std::FILE* f_ = nullptr;
    std::string path_;
};

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// v20: monta o mapa em memoria (veja map_build.h). Cada parse_* corresponde ao decodificador de mesmo nome do mapfile.py.
#include "map_build.h"

#include <cstring>

#include "tre.h"
#include "vfs.h"

namespace f3v {

namespace {

std::uint32_t rd32(const std::uint8_t* p) { return p[0] | (p[1] << 8) | (p[2] << 16) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[3]) << 24); }
float rdf(const std::uint8_t* p) { float f; std::uint32_t u = rd32(p); std::memcpy(&f, &u, 4); return f; }

// leitor de payload com limite: qualquer leitura fora marca 'bad' e devolve zero
struct P {
    const std::uint8_t* d;
    std::size_t n, pos = 0;
    bool bad = false;
    bool has(std::size_t k) const { return !bad && pos + k <= n; }
    std::uint8_t u8() { if (!has(1)) { bad = true; return 0; } return d[pos++]; }
    std::uint32_t u32() { if (!has(4)) { bad = true; return 0; } const std::uint32_t v = rd32(d + pos); pos += 4; return v; }
    float f32() { if (!has(4)) { bad = true; return 0; } const float v = rdf(d + pos); pos += 4; return v; }
    Vec3f vec3() { Vec3f v{}; v[0] = f32(); v[1] = f32(); v[2] = f32(); return v; }
    std::string str() {   // u16 comprimento + bytes
        if (!has(2)) { bad = true; return {}; }
        const std::size_t k = d[pos] | (d[pos + 1] << 8);
        if (pos + 2 + k > n) { bad = true; return {}; }
        std::string s(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(d + pos + 2), k);
        pos += 2 + k;
        return s;
    }
};

// _plausible_string_at: u16 n >= 3 e so ASCII imprimivel
bool plausible_string_at(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t n, std::size_t pos, std::string& s, std::size_t& end) {
    if (pos + 2 > n) return false;
    const std::size_t k = d[pos] | (d[pos + 1] << 8);
    if (k < 3 || pos + 2 + k > n) return false;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < k; ++i) { const std::uint8_t c = d[pos + 2 + i]; if (c < 32 || c >= 127) return false; }
    s.assign(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(d + pos + 2), k);
    end = pos + 2 + k;
    return true;
}

std::string lower(std::string s) { for (char& c : s) if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'A' + 'a'); return s; }
std::string upper(std::string s) { for (char& c : s) if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'a' + 'A'); return s; }

// parse_eeov: instancia, 3 flags e as strings plausiveis (classificadas pela extensao)
void parse_eeov(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t n, MapEntity& e) {
    P r{d, n};
    e.instance = r.str();
    if (r.bad) return;
    std::size_t pos = r.pos + 3;
    bool got_name = false, got_script = false, got_skin = false;
    while (pos < n) {
        std::string s;
        std::size_t end;
        if (!plausible_string_at(d, n, pos, s, end)) { ++pos; continue; }
        const std::size_t dot = s.find_last_of('.');
        const std::string ext = dot == std::string::npos ? std::string() : lower(s.substr(dot + 1));
        if (ext == "amx") { if (!got_script) { e.script = s; got_script = true; } }
        else if (ext == "dds" || ext == "tga") { if (!got_skin) { e.skin = s; got_skin = true; } }
        else if (ext == "veg" || ext == "psf" || ext == "amo" || ext == "wea" || ext == "arm" || ext == "itm" || ext == "use" || ext == "con") {}
        else if (!got_name) { e.name = s; got_name = true; }
        pos = end;
    }
}

}  // namespace

bool parse_map_file(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t size, MapData& out, std::string& tre, std::string& rle, std::string& err) {
    tre.clear(); rle.clear();
    if (!d || size < 12) { err = "arquivo .map vazio"; return false; }
    std::size_t pos = 0;
    int group = -1;            // indice do gatilho aberto pelo ultimo EMTR
    bool group_bound = false;
    while (pos + 12 <= size) {
        char tag[5] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0};
        std::memcpy(tag, d + pos, 4);
        const std::uint32_t csize = rd32(d + pos + 8);
        if (csize < 12 || pos + csize > size) { err = std::string("enquadramento de chunks invalido em ") + std::to_string(pos); return false; }
        const std::uint8_t* p = d + pos + 12;
        const std::size_t n = csize - 12;
        pos += csize;
        const std::string t(tag);
        P r{p, n};
        if (t == "EMAP") {
            r.u32();
            tre = r.str(); rle = r.str(); r.str();
            if (r.bad) continue;
            if (n - r.pos == 27) {
                const std::uint8_t* tail = p + r.pos;
                std::memcpy(out.env_a, tail + 2, 4);
                std::memcpy(out.env_b, tail + 6, 4);
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) out.env_f[k] = rdf(tail + 15 + 4 * k);
                out.has_env = true;
            }
        } else if (t == "ECAM") {
            if (n == 16) { for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) out.camera[k] = rdf(p + 4 * k); out.has_camera = true; }
        } else if (t == "EME2") {
            MapEntity e;
            e.prototype = r.str();
            if (r.bad || r.pos + 25 + 12 > n) continue;
            const std::size_t dot = e.prototype.find_last_of('.');
            e.kind = upper(dot == std::string::npos ? e.prototype : e.prototype.substr(dot + 1));
            e.pos = r.vec3();
            e.yaw = r.f32();
            r.pos += 8 + 1;                                   // 2 f32 extras + flag
            if (r.pos + 12 <= n && !std::memcmp(p + r.pos, "EEOV", 4)) {
                const std::uint32_t es = rd32(p + r.pos + 8);
                if (r.pos + es == n && es >= 12) parse_eeov(p + r.pos + 12, es - 12, e);
            }
            out.entities.push_back(std::move(e));
        } else if (t == "EMEF") {
            MapEffect e;
            e.name = r.str();
            e.pos = r.vec3();
            r.f32(); r.pos += 8 + 1;
            e.effect = r.str();
            if (!r.bad) out.effects.push_back(std::move(e));
        } else if (t == "EMEP") {
            MapEntry e;
            if (n == 17) { e.id = p[0]; P q{p, n, 1}; e.pos.push_back(q.vec3()); e.angles.push_back(q.f32()); out.entries.push_back(e); }
            else if (n == 97) {
                e.id = p[0];
                P q{p, n, 1};
                for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) e.pos.push_back(q.vec3());
                for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) e.angles.push_back(q.f32());
                out.entries.push_back(e);
            }
        } else if (t == "EMNP") {
            const std::uint32_t cnt = r.u32();
            if (!r.bad && n == 4 + 30ull * cnt) {
                for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) {
                    const std::uint8_t* o = p + 4 + 30 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i);
                    MapNavNode nd;
                    nd.kind = o[0];
                    for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) nd.pos[static_cast<std::size_t>(k)] = rdf(o + 1 + 4 * k);
                    for (int k = 25; k < 30; ++k) if (o[k] != 0xFF) nd.links.push_back(o[k]);
                    out.nav.push_back(std::move(nd));
                }
            }
        } else if (t == "EMNO") {
            MapMarker m;
            m.pos = r.vec3();
            m.icon = r.str();
            if (r.bad) continue;
            m.text_id = r.has(4) ? r.u32() : 0;
            out.markers.push_back(std::move(m));
        } else if (t == "EMTR") {
            MapTrigger g;
            g.kind = 0;
            const std::uint32_t kind = r.u32(), np = r.u32();
            (void)kind;
            if (r.bad) continue;
            if (n == 8 + 12ull * np) for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < np; ++i) g.pts.push_back(r.vec3());
            out.triggers.push_back(std::move(g));
            group = static_cast<int>(out.triggers.size()) - 1;
            group_bound = false;
        } else if ((t == "EBTR" || t == "ESTR" || t == "ETTR") && group >= 0 && !group_bound) {
            MapTrigger& g = out.triggers[static_cast<std::size_t>(group)];
            if (t == "EBTR") { const std::uint32_t id = r.u32(); if (r.bad) continue; g.kind = 3; g.entry = static_cast<std::int32_t>(id); }
            else if (t == "ESTR") { const std::string s = r.str(); if (r.bad) continue; g.kind = 1; g.target = s; }
            else { const std::string s = r.str(); if (r.bad) continue; g.kind = 2; g.target = s; g.entry = r.pos < n ? p[r.pos] : 0; }
            group_bound = true;
        } else if (t == "EPTH") {
            MapPath pa;
            pa.name = r.str();
            const std::uint32_t np = r.u32();
            if (r.bad) continue;
            if (n == r.pos + 24ull * np) for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < np; ++i) { pa.pts.push_back(r.vec3()); r.pos += 12; }
            out.paths.push_back(std::move(pa));
        } else if (t == "EMSD") {
            MapSound s;
            s.name = r.str();
            s.pos = r.vec3();
            if (r.bad) continue;
            std::string snd;
            std::size_t end;
            if (plausible_string_at(p, n, r.pos, snd, end)) s.sound = snd;
            out.sounds.push_back(std::move(s));
        } else if (t == "2MWT") {
            r.str();
            if (r.bad || r.pos + 144 > n) continue;
            r.pos += 140;
            const std::uint32_t cnt = r.u32();
            for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) {
                MapWater w;
                w.pos = r.vec3();
                w.texture = r.str();
                r.f32(); r.f32();
                if (r.bad) break;
                out.water.push_back(std::move(w));
            }
        }
    }
    if (pos != size) { err = "sobraram " + std::to_string(size - pos) + " bytes depois do ultimo chunk do .map"; return false; }
    return true;
}

bool parse_rle(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t size, MapData& out, std::string& err) {
    if (!d || size < 13) { err = ".rle menor que o cabecalho"; return false; }
    const std::uint32_t a = rd32(d), b = rd32(d + 4);
    if (a == 0 || b < 1 || a > 65536 || b > 65536) { err = ".rle com dimensoes absurdas"; return false; }
    const std::size_t rows = b - 1, total = static_cast<std::size_t>(a) * rows;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> cells;
    cells.reserve(total);
    std::size_t pos = 13;
    while (pos < size) {
        if (pos + 5 > size) { err = "run incompleto no .rle"; return false; }
        const std::uint32_t cnt = rd32(d + pos);
        const std::uint8_t v = d[pos + 4];
        if (cnt == 0 || cells.size() + cnt > total || (cells.size() % a) + cnt > a) { err = "run invalido no .rle em " + std::to_string(pos); return false; }
        cells.insert(cells.end(), cnt, v);
        pos += 5;
    }
    if (cells.size() != total) { err = ".rle com celulas faltando"; return false; }
    out.grid_w = a;
    out.grid_rows = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rows);
    out.grid = std::move(cells);
    return true;
}

bool build_map(const Vfs& vfs, const std::string& map_name, MapData& out, std::string& err, MapBuildStats* stats) {
    out = MapData();
    const ResEntry* me = vfs.find(map_name, RT_MAP);
    if (!me) { err = "mapa '" + map_name + "' nao existe na demo"; return false; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> data;
    if (!vfs.read(*me, data, err)) return false;
    std::string tre_name, rle_name;
    if (!parse_map_file(data.data(), data.size(), out, tre_name, rle_name, err)) return false;
    out.version = 3;
    out.name = me->name;
    out.tre = tre_name;
    out.rle = rle_name;
    auto stem = [](const std::string& s) { const std::size_t dot = s.find_last_of('.'); return dot == std::string::npos ? s : s.substr(0, dot); };
    if (stats) { stats->tre_name = tre_name; stats->rle_name = rle_name; }
    if (!rle_name.empty()) {
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> rd;
        std::string e2;
        if (vfs.read(stem(rle_name), RT_RLE, rd) && !parse_rle(rd.data(), rd.size(), out, e2)) { out.grid.clear(); out.grid_w = out.grid_rows = 0; }
    }
    if (!tre_name.empty()) {
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> td;
        if (vfs.read(stem(tre_name), RT_TRE, td)) {
            TreData t;
            if (!read_tre(td.data(), td.size(), t, err)) { err = "geometria (" + tre_name + "): " + err; return false; }
            float mn[3], mx[3];
            if (t.bounds(mn, mx)) { out.origin[0] = mn[0]; out.origin[1] = mn[2]; }
            if (t.has_level && t.level_f[0] > 0) out.cell = t.level_f[0];
            TreStats ts;
            tre_triangle_lists(t, out.tris, &ts);
            out.blocks = std::move(t.blocks);
            out.materials = std::move(t.materials);
            out.textures = std::move(t.textures);
            for (const TreLight& l : t.lights) {
                MapLight ml;
                ml.type = l.type;
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) { ml.color[static_cast<std::size_t>(k)] = l.color[k]; ml.pos[static_cast<std::size_t>(k)] = l.pos[k]; ml.dir[static_cast<std::size_t>(k)] = l.dir[k]; }
                out.lights.push_back(ml);
            }
            if (stats) { stats->nodes = ts.nodes; stats->nodes_full = ts.nodes_full; stats->unparsed = ts.unparsed; stats->outside_bbox = ts.outside_bbox; stats->bad = ts.bad; }
        }
    }
    map_split_texture_names(out);
    return true;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```
