```cpp
LRESULT CALLBACK wnd_proc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp) {
    switch (msg) {
        case WM_COMMAND: on_command(static_cast<int>(LOWORD(wp))); return 0;
        case WM_SIZE: A.w = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(LOWORD(lp))); A.h = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(HIWORD(lp))); return 0;
        case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: A.ldown = true; A.mx = static_cast<short>(LOWORD(lp)); A.my = static_cast<short>(HIWORD(lp)); SetCapture(hwnd); return 0;
        case WM_LBUTTONUP: A.ldown = false; ReleaseCapture(); return 0;
        case WM_RBUTTONDOWN:
        case WM_MBUTTONDOWN: A.rdown = true; A.mx = static_cast<short>(LOWORD(lp)); A.my = static_cast<short>(HIWORD(lp)); SetCapture(hwnd); return 0;
        case WM_RBUTTONUP:
        case WM_MBUTTONUP: A.rdown = false; ReleaseCapture(); return 0;
        case WM_MOUSEMOVE: {
            const int x = static_cast<short>(LOWORD(lp)), y = static_cast<short>(HIWORD(lp));
            const int dx = x - A.mx, dy = y - A.my;
            A.mx = x; A.my = y;
            if (A.ldown) { A.yaw += dx * 0.4f; A.pitch = std::max(-89.f, std::min(89.f, A.pitch + dy * 0.4f)); }
            if (A.rdown) {
                const float k = A.dist * 0.0018f, ya = A.yaw * 3.14159265f / 180.f;
                A.cx -= (std::cos(ya) * dx) * k; A.cz -= (std::sin(ya) * dx) * k;
                A.cy += dy * k;
            }
            return 0;
        }
        case WM_MOUSEWHEEL: {
            const float d = static_cast<float>(static_cast<short>(HIWORD(wp))) / 120.f;
            A.dist = std::max(A.radius * 0.02f, std::min(A.radius * 60.f, A.dist * std::pow(0.88f, d)));
            return 0;
        }
        case WM_KEYDOWN: {
            const bool shift = (GetKeyState(VK_SHIFT) & 0x8000) != 0;
            if (A.dlg_open && ((wp >= '1' && wp <= '9') || (wp >= VK_NUMPAD1 && wp <= VK_NUMPAD9))) {      // com dialogo aberto, 1-9 escolhem a resposta
                dialog_choose(static_cast<std::size_t>(wp >= VK_NUMPAD1 ? wp - VK_NUMPAD1 : wp - '1'));
                return 0;
            }
            switch (wp) {
                case VK_ESCAPE: DestroyWindow(hwnd); break;
                case 'O': on_command(ID_OPEN); break;
                case VK_NEXT: on_command(ID_NEXT); break;
                case VK_PRIOR: on_command(ID_PREV); break;
                case 'G': on_command(ID_GEOM); break;
                case 'R': on_command(ID_FLOOR); break;
                case 'E': on_command(ID_ENTS); break;
                case 'N': on_command(ID_NAV); break;
                case 'T': on_command(ID_TRIG); break;
                case 'P': on_command(ID_PATHS); break;
                case 'S': on_command(ID_MISC); break;
                case 'A': on_command(ID_WATER); break;
                case 'W': on_command(ID_WIRE); break;
                case 'L': on_command(ID_LIGHT); break;
                case 'C': on_command(ID_VCOL); break;
                case 'M': on_command(ID_CMODE); break;
                case 'X': on_command(ID_TEXMODE); break;
                case 'V': on_command(ID_DIALOG); break;
                case 'K': on_command(ID_DIALOG_NEXT); break;
                case 'B': on_command(ID_SURVEY); break;
                case VK_TAB: on_command(shift ? ID_SELPREV : ID_SELNEXT); break;
                case 'Z': on_command(ID_FOCUS); break;
                case VK_HOME: on_command(ID_HOME); break;
                case '1': A.pitch = 35.f; A.yaw = 35.f; A.status = "Vista 3D"; LOGF("comando vista 3D"); break;
                case '2': on_command(ID_TOP); break;
                case VK_F1: on_command(ID_HELP); break;
                case VK_F2: on_command(ID_REPORT); break;
                default: break;
            }
            return 0;
        }
        case WM_DESTROY:
            LOGF("janela fechada (uptime %.1f s, %llu quadros)", A.uptime, static_cast<unsigned long long>(A.total_frames));
            PostQuitMessage(0);
            return 0;
        default: break;
    }
    return DefWindowProcA(hwnd, msg, wp, lp);
}

void open_log() {
    const std::string dir = exe_dir() + "\\logs";
    CreateDirectoryA(dir.c_str(), nullptr);
    if (!A.log.open(dir, "f3mapviewer_log") && !A.log.open(exe_dir(), "f3mapviewer_log")) {
        char tmp[MAX_PATH] = {0};
        GetTempPathA(MAX_PATH, tmp);
        A.log.open(tmp, "f3mapviewer_log");
    }
}

std::string first_arg(const char* cmdline) {
    std::string s = cmdline ? cmdline : "";
    if (s.empty()) return s;
    if (s[0] == '"') { const std::size_t e = s.find('"', 1); return s.substr(1, e == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : e - 1); }
    const std::size_t e = s.find(' ');
    return s.substr(0, e);
}

}  // namespace

int WINAPI WinMain(HINSTANCE inst, HINSTANCE, LPSTR cmdline, int show) {
    open_log();
    LOGF("%s (compilado em %s %s)", kVersion, __DATE__, __TIME__);
    LOGF("executavel: %s | linha de comando: %s", exe_dir().c_str(), cmdline && *cmdline ? cmdline : "(vazia)");
    LOGF("arquivo de log: %s", A.log.is_open() ? A.log.path().c_str() : "(NAO foi possivel criar o log)");
    LOGF("pasta padrao de mapas: %s", default_maps_dir().c_str());
    WNDCLASSA wc;
    std::memset(&wc, 0, sizeof wc);
    wc.style = CS_OWNDC | CS_HREDRAW | CS_VREDRAW;
    wc.lpfnWndProc = wnd_proc;
    wc.hInstance = inst;
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursorA(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.lpszClassName = "F3VBMapViewerWnd";
    if (!RegisterClassA(&wc)) return 1;
    RECT r = {0, 0, A.w, A.h};
    AdjustWindowRect(&r, WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, TRUE);
    A.hwnd = CreateWindowExA(0, wc.lpszClassName, kVersion, WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top, nullptr, make_menu(), inst, nullptr);
    if (!A.hwnd) return 1;
    A.hdc = GetDC(A.hwnd);
    PIXELFORMATDESCRIPTOR pfd;
    std::memset(&pfd, 0, sizeof pfd);
    pfd.nSize = sizeof pfd;
    pfd.nVersion = 1;
    pfd.dwFlags = PFD_DRAW_TO_WINDOW | PFD_SUPPORT_OPENGL | PFD_DOUBLEBUFFER;
    pfd.iPixelType = PFD_TYPE_RGBA;
    pfd.cColorBits = 32;
    pfd.cDepthBits = 24;
    pfd.iLayerType = PFD_MAIN_PLANE;
    const int fmt = ChoosePixelFormat(A.hdc, &pfd);
    if (!fmt || !SetPixelFormat(A.hdc, fmt, &pfd)) { MessageBoxA(nullptr, "Nao consegui configurar o OpenGL.", kVersion, MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR); return 1; }
    A.rc = wglCreateContext(A.hdc);
    if (!A.rc || !wglMakeCurrent(A.hdc, A.rc)) { MessageBoxA(nullptr, "Nao consegui criar o contexto OpenGL.", kVersion, MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR); return 1; }
    build_font();
    {
        const auto gs = [](GLenum e) { const GLubyte* p = glGetString(e); return p ? reinterpret_cast<const char*>(p) : "?"; };
        LOGF("OpenGL: fornecedor=%s | renderizador=%s | versao=%s | janela %dx%d", gs(GL_VENDOR), gs(GL_RENDERER), gs(GL_VERSION), A.w, A.h);
    }
    init_gl_extensions();
    ShowWindow(A.hwnd, show);
    UpdateWindow(A.hwnd);
    const std::string arg = first_arg(cmdline);
    if (!arg.empty()) load_map(arg);
    else {
        A.status = "Escolha um mapa na janela que vai abrir (ou aperte O).";
        render();
        cmd_open();                                  // ao abrir sem argumento, ja pergunta qual mapa
    }
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&A.freq);
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&A.last);
    MSG msg;
    bool run = true;
    while (run) {
        while (PeekMessageA(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) {
            if (msg.message == WM_QUIT) { run = false; break; }
            TranslateMessage(&msg);
            DispatchMessageA(&msg);
        }
        if (!run) break;
        LARGE_INTEGER now;
        QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
        const double dt = static_cast<double>(now.QuadPart - A.last.QuadPart) / static_cast<double>(A.freq.QuadPart);
        A.last = now;
        A.uptime += dt; ++A.total_frames; A.heartbeat += dt;
        if (A.heartbeat >= 30.0) {
            A.heartbeat = 0;
            LOGF("estado | mapa=%s triangulos=%zu entidades=%zu selecionada=%d geometria=%d planta=%d fps=%.0f", A.map.name.c_str(), A.map.triangle_count(), A.map.entities.size(), A.sel, A.geom, A.floor_, A.fps);
        }
        A.fps_acc += dt; ++A.frames;
        if (A.fps_acc >= 0.5) { A.fps = A.frames / A.fps_acc; A.fps_acc = 0; A.frames = 0; }
        render();
        Sleep(1);
    }
    LOGF("sessao encerrada normalmente");
    wglMakeCurrent(nullptr, nullptr);
    wglDeleteContext(A.rc);
    ReleaseDC(A.hwnd, A.hdc);
    return 0;
}
```

## viewer/src/model_build.cpp

```cpp
// v20: B3D + GR2 -> F3MFile em C++ (ver model_build.h). Cada funcao indica a funcao Python de origem.
#include "model_build.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <unordered_map>

#include "image.h"

namespace f3v {

namespace {

std::string lower(std::string s) { for (char& c : s) if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'A' + 'a'); return s; }
bool ignored_group(const std::string& n) { const std::string l = lower(n); return l == "light" || l == "camera"; }

// export.py: _quat_to_mat3 / _joint_local / _mat4_mul (forma coluna, 4x4 row-major em [r][c])
using M4 = std::array<std::array<double, 4>, 4>;
M4 mul(const M4& a, const M4& b) {
    M4 r{};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) { double s = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) s += a[i][k] * b[k][j]; r[i][j] = s; }
    return r;
}
M4 joint_local(const RawJoint& j) {
    double x = j.quat[0], y = j.quat[1], z = j.quat[2], w = j.quat[3];
    double n = std::sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z + w * w);
    if (n == 0) n = 1.0;
    x /= n; y /= n; z /= n; w /= n;
    const double r[3][3] = {{1 - 2 * (y * y + z * z), 2 * (x * y - z * w), 2 * (x * z + y * w)},
                            {2 * (x * y + z * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + z * z), 2 * (y * z - x * w)},
                            {2 * (x * z - y * w), 2 * (y * z + x * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + y * y)}};
    M4 m{};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) { for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) m[i][c] = r[i][c] * j.scale[c]; m[i][3] = j.pos[i]; }
    m[3] = {0, 0, 0, 1};
    return m;
}

// export.py: detect_initial_placement
bool detect_initial_placement(const std::vector<RawJoint>& joints, double out[3], double tol = 1e-3) {
    if (joints.empty()) return false;
    std::vector<M4> world(joints.size());
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < joints.size(); ++i) {
        const M4 loc = joint_local(joints[i]);
        const int p = joints[i].parent;
        world[i] = (p < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(p) >= i) ? loc : mul(world[static_cast<std::size_t>(p)], loc);
    }
    bool have = false;
    double t0[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < joints.size(); ++i) {
        M4 ibm_col{};
        for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r) for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) ibm_col[r][c] = joints[i].inv_world[c * 4 + r];
        const M4 p = mul(world[i], ibm_col);
        double dev = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) dev = std::max(dev, std::fabs(p[r][c] - (r == c ? 1.0 : 0.0)));
        if (dev > tol) return false;
        const double t[3] = {p[0][3], p[1][3], p[2][3]};
        if (!have) { for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) t0[k] = t[k]; have = true; }
        else { double d = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) d = std::max(d, std::fabs(t[k] - t0[k])); if (d > tol) return false; }
    }
    if (!have || std::max({std::fabs(t0[0]), std::fabs(t0[1]), std::fabs(t0[2])}) < 1e-5) return false;
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) out[k] = -t0[k];
    return true;
}

// export.py: resolve_bone_aliases
std::vector<std::string> resolve_bone_aliases(const std::vector<std::string>& bones, const std::vector<RawJoint>& joints, int& aliased) {
    aliased = 0;
    if (joints.empty()) return bones;
    std::map<std::string, int> jn;
    for (const RawJoint& j : joints) jn[j.name] = 1;
    std::map<std::string, std::string> low;                       // sorted(jn): o primeiro em ordem alfabetica vence
    for (const auto& kv : jn) low.emplace(lower(kv.first), kv.first);
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    for (const std::string& b : bones) {
        std::string pick;
        if (jn.count(b)) pick = b;
        if (pick.empty()) for (int k = 1; k < 10; ++k) { const std::string c = b + "_" + std::to_string(k); if (jn.count(c)) { pick = c; break; } }
        if (pick.empty()) {
            const std::size_t u = b.rfind('_');
            if (u != std::string::npos && u + 1 < b.size() && std::all_of(b.begin() + static_cast<long>(u) + 1, b.end(), [](char c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; })) {
                const std::string base = b.substr(0, u);
                if (jn.count(base)) pick = base;
            }
        }
        if (pick.empty()) { const auto it = low.find(lower(b)); if (it != low.end()) pick = it->second; }
        if (!pick.empty() && pick != b) ++aliased;
        out.push_back(pick.empty() ? b : pick);
    }
    return out;
}

// conversoes do Exporter (k = 1, convert = True)
void cv_p(const double* v, float* o) { o[0] = static_cast<float>(v[0]); o[1] = static_cast<float>(v[1]); o[2] = static_cast<float>(-v[2]); }
void cv_q(const double* q, float* o) {
    double n = std::sqrt(q[0] * q[0] + q[1] * q[1] + q[2] * q[2] + q[3] * q[3]);
    if (n == 0) n = 1.0;
    o[0] = static_cast<float>(-(q[0] / n)); o[1] = static_cast<float>(-(q[1] / n)); o[2] = static_cast<float>(q[2] / n); o[3] = static_cast<float>(q[3] / n);
}
void cv_m4(const double* m, float* o) {
    static const double s[4] = {1, 1, -1, 1};
    for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r) for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) o[r * 4 + c] = static_cast<float>(m[r * 4 + c] * s[r] * s[c]);
}

// export.py: _fix_winding (sobre as posicoes/normais JA convertidas, em double como no Python)
void fix_winding(std::vector<std::uint32_t>& idx, const std::vector<double>& pos, const std::vector<double>& nor) {
    long agree = 0, total = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 2 < idx.size(); i += 3) {
        const double* a = &pos[3 * idx[i]]; const double* b = &pos[3 * idx[i + 1]]; const double* c = &pos[3 * idx[i + 2]];
        const double u[3] = {b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]}, v[3] = {c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1], c[2] - a[2]};
        const double cr[3] = {u[1] * v[2] - u[2] * v[1], u[2] * v[0] - u[0] * v[2], u[0] * v[1] - u[1] * v[0]};
        double nn[3] = {0, 0, 0};
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) nn[k] = (0.0 + nor[3 * idx[i] + k]) + nor[3 * idx[i + 1] + k] + nor[3 * idx[i + 2] + k];
        const double d = cr[0] * nn[0] + cr[1] * nn[1] + cr[2] * nn[2];
        if (std::fabs(d) > 1e-12) { ++total; if (d > 0) ++agree; }
    }
    if (total && static_cast<double>(agree) < static_cast<double>(total) / 2.0)
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 2 < idx.size(); i += 3) std::swap(idx[i + 1], idx[i + 2]);
}

// gr2export.py: _curve_keys
bool curve_keys(const Gr2Curve& c, double duration, double step, int dim, std::vector<double>& times, std::vector<double>& vals) {
    times.clear(); vals.clear();
    if (!c.present || c.knots.empty() || c.dim < dim) return false;
    const long n = std::max(1L, static_cast<long>(std::nearbyint(duration / step)) + 1);
    double tmp[16];
    for (long i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        const double t = std::min(duration, static_cast<double>(i) * step);
        c.eval(t, tmp);
        times.push_back(t);
        for (int k = 0; k < dim; ++k) vals.push_back(tmp[k]);
    }
    return true;
}

}  // namespace

std::vector<std::string> anim_prefixes(const std::string& name) {
    std::vector<std::string> out{name + "_"};
    if (name.size() >= 4 && name.compare(0, 3, "Hum") == 0 && (name[3] == 'M' || name[3] == 'F')) {
        const std::string f = name.substr(0, 4) + "_";
        if (f != out[0]) out.push_back(f);
    }
    return out;
}

bool raw_skeleton(const Gr2File& f, std::vector<RawJoint>& out, std::string* name) {
    out.clear();
    for (const Gr2Skeleton& s : f.skeletons) {
        if (ignored_group(s.name) || s.bones.size() <= 1) continue;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.bones.size(); ++i) {
            const Gr2Bone& b = s.bones[i];
            RawJoint j;
            j.name = b.name;
            j.parent = (b.parent >= 0 && b.parent != static_cast<int>(i)) ? b.parent : -1;
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) j.pos[k] = b.pos[k];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) j.quat[k] = b.quat[k];
            j.scale[0] = b.scale_shear[0]; j.scale[1] = b.scale_shear[4]; j.scale[2] = b.scale_shear[8];
            for (int k = 0; k < 16; ++k) j.inv_world[k] = b.inv_world[k];
            out.push_back(std::move(j));
        }
        if (name) *name = s.name;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

void raw_clips(const Gr2File& f, const std::vector<RawJoint>& joints, const std::string& clip_name, std::vector<RawClip>& out) {
    std::unordered_map<std::string, int> bones;
    for (const RawJoint& j : joints) bones[j.name] = 1;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, const Gr2TrackGroup*> groups;
    for (const Gr2TrackGroup& g : f.track_groups) groups[g.name] = &g;          // como o dict do Python: o ultimo vence
    for (const Gr2Animation& an : f.animations) {
        RawClip c;
        if (!clip_name.empty()) c.name = clip_name;
        else {
            std::string n = an.name;
            for (char& ch : n) if (ch == '\\') ch = '/';
            const std::size_t sl = n.rfind('/');
            if (sl != std::string::npos) n = n.substr(sl + 1);
            const std::size_t dot = n.rfind('.');
            if (dot != std::string::npos) n = n.substr(0, dot);
            c.name = n;
        }
        c.duration = an.duration;
        const double step = an.time_step > 0 ? static_cast<double>(an.time_step) : 1.0 / 30.0;
        std::vector<std::string> names;
        for (const std::string& n : an.track_groups) if (!ignored_group(n)) names.push_back(n);
        if (names.empty()) for (const Gr2TrackGroup& g : f.track_groups) if (!ignored_group(g.name)) names.push_back(g.name);
        std::unordered_map<std::string, std::size_t> pos;
        for (const std::string& gn : names) {
            const auto git = groups.find(gn);
            if (git == groups.end()) continue;
            for (const Gr2TransformTrack& tr : git->second->tracks) {
                if (!bones.count(tr.name)) continue;
                RawTrack t;
                t.bone = tr.name;
                t.has_r = curve_keys(tr.orientation, c.duration, step, 4, t.tr, t.vr);
                t.has_t = curve_keys(tr.position, c.duration, step, 3, t.tt, t.vt);
                if (tr.scale_shear.present) {
                    const int dim = tr.scale_shear.dim;
                    std::vector<double> tt, vv;
                    const int want = (dim == 3 || dim == 9) ? dim : 3;
                    if (curve_keys(tr.scale_shear, c.duration, step, want, tt, vv)) {
                        t.has_s = true;
                        t.ts = tt;
                        const std::size_t nk = tt.size();
                        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < nk; ++i) {
                            if (want == 9) { t.vs.push_back(vv[i * 9]); t.vs.push_back(vv[i * 9 + 4]); t.vs.push_back(vv[i * 9 + 8]); }
                            else for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) t.vs.push_back(vv[i * 3 + static_cast<std::size_t>(k)]);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!t.has_r && !t.has_t && !t.has_s) continue;
                const auto it = pos.find(t.bone);
                if (it == pos.end()) { pos[t.bone] = c.tracks.size(); c.tracks.push_back(std::move(t)); }
                else c.tracks[it->second] = std::move(t);                      // dict do Python: mantem a posicao, troca o valor
            }
        }
        out.push_back(std::move(c));
    }
}

F3MFile build_model(const B3dModel& model, const std::string& name, const std::vector<RawJoint>& joints_in, const std::vector<RawClip>& clips_in,
                    const TextureLoader& tex_loader, ModelBuildReport* rep, double mesh_scale) {
    ModelBuildReport local;
    ModelBuildReport& R = rep ? *rep : local;
    std::vector<RawJoint> joints = joints_in;
    std::vector<RawClip> clips = clips_in;
    // export.py: apply_initial_placement
    double place[3];
    if (!joints.empty() && detect_initial_placement(joints, place)) {
        R.placement_applied = true;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) R.placement[k] = place[k];
        std::unordered_map<std::string, int> roots;
        for (RawJoint& j : joints) if (j.parent < 0) { for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) j.pos[k] = j.pos[k] + place[k]; roots[j.name] = 1; }
        for (RawClip& c : clips)
            for (RawTrack& t : c.tracks)
                if (roots.count(t.bone) && t.has_t)
                    for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 2 < t.vt.size(); i += 3) for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) t.vt[i + static_cast<std::size_t>(k)] = t.vt[i + static_cast<std::size_t>(k)] + place[k];
    }
    std::vector<std::string> bone_names;
    for (const B3dBone& b : model.bones) bone_names.push_back(b.name);
    bone_names = resolve_bone_aliases(bone_names, joints, R.aliased_bones);
    if (R.aliased_bones) R.warnings.push_back(name + ": " + std::to_string(R.aliased_bones) + " ossos casados por sufixo");

    F3MFile f;
    f.name = name;
    std::map<std::string, int> tex_idx;
    auto texture = [&](const std::string& file) -> int {
        const std::string key = lower(file);
        const auto it = tex_idx.find(key);
        if (it != tex_idx.end()) return it->second;
        const std::size_t dot = file.rfind('.');
        const std::string stem = dot == std::string::npos ? file : file.substr(0, dot);
        int idx = -1;
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> raw = tex_loader ? tex_loader(stem) : std::vector<std::uint8_t>();
        if (raw.empty()) R.warnings.push_back("textura '" + file + "' nao encontrada");
        else {
            Image im; std::string e;
            if (decode_image(raw.data(), raw.size(), im, e)) {
                Texture t;
                t.name = stem; t.w = im.w; t.h = im.h; t.rgba = std::move(im.rgba);
                f.textures.push_back(std::move(t));
                idx = static_cast<int>(f.textures.size()) - 1;
            } else R.warnings.push_back("textura '" + file + "': " + e);
        }
        tex_idx[key] = idx;
        return idx;
    };
    std::map<std::string, int> mat_idx;
    auto material = [&](const B3dMaterial& m) -> int {
        char key_floats[128] = {0};
        float f4[4] = {1, 1, 1, 1};
        const bool has4 = m.floats.size() >= 4;
        if (has4) for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) f4[k] = m.floats[static_cast<std::size_t>(k)];
        std::snprintf(key_floats, sizeof key_floats, "%a|%a|%a|%a|%d", static_cast<double>(f4[0]), static_cast<double>(f4[1]), static_cast<double>(f4[2]), static_cast<double>(f4[3]), has4 ? 1 : 0);
        const std::string key = m.name + "\x01" + m.blend + "\x01" + (m.textures.empty() ? std::string("\x02") : m.textures[0]) + "\x01" + key_floats;
        const auto it = mat_idx.find(key);
        if (it != mat_idx.end()) return it->second;
        Material out;
        out.name = m.name.empty() ? "material" : m.name;
        out.texture = m.textures.empty() ? -1 : texture(m.textures[0]);
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) out.color[k] = f4[k];
        out.alpha_mode = m.blend == "ALPHABLEND" ? 1 : (m.blend == "ADD" ? 2 : 0);
        out.double_sided = 0;
        out.shader = m.id;
        f.materials.push_back(out);
        const int i = static_cast<int>(f.materials.size()) - 1;
        mat_idx[key] = i;
        return i;
    };

    const double k = mesh_scale;
    model.each_surface([&](const B3dNode& node, const B3dSurface& s) {
        const std::uint32_t nv = s.nv();
        std::vector<double> pos(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 3), nor(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 3);
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nv; ++i) {
            const std::size_t o = static_cast<std::size_t>(i) * 3;
            pos[o] = static_cast<double>(s.pos[o]) * k; pos[o + 1] = static_cast<double>(s.pos[o + 1]) * k; pos[o + 2] = -static_cast<double>(s.pos[o + 2]) * k;
            nor[o] = s.nrm[o]; nor[o + 1] = s.nrm[o + 1]; nor[o + 2] = -static_cast<double>(s.nrm[o + 2]);
        }
        const bool skinned = !s.influences.empty();
        std::vector<std::uint16_t> jj;
        std::vector<float> ww;
        if (skinned) {
            jj.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 4, 0);
            ww.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 4, 0.f);
            int missing = 0;
            for (std::uint32_t v = 0; v < nv; ++v) {
                std::vector<int> js; std::vector<double> ws;
                for (const auto& inf : s.influences[v]) {
                    if (inf.first < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(inf.first) >= bone_names.size()) { ++missing; continue; }
                    js.push_back(inf.first); ws.push_back(inf.second);
                }
                while (js.size() < 4) { js.push_back(0); ws.push_back(0.0); }
                js.resize(4); ws.resize(4);
                double tot = 0;
                for (double x : ws) tot += x;
                for (int q = 0; q < 4; ++q) {
                    jj[static_cast<std::size_t>(v) * 4 + static_cast<std::size_t>(q)] = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(js[static_cast<std::size_t>(q)]);
                    ww[static_cast<std::size_t>(v) * 4 + static_cast<std::size_t>(q)] = tot > 0 ? static_cast<float>(ws[static_cast<std::size_t>(q)] / tot) : (q == 0 ? 1.f : 0.f);
                }
            }
            if (missing) R.warnings.push_back((node.name.empty() ? name : node.name) + ": " + std::to_string(missing) + " influencias de osso sem correspondencia");
        }
        for (const B3dSurface::Prim& pr : s.prims) {
            if (pr.idx.empty()) continue;
            Mesh m;
            m.name = node.name.empty() ? name : node.name;
            m.material = (pr.material >= 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(pr.material) < s.materials.size()) ? material(s.materials[static_cast<std::size_t>(pr.material)]) : -1;
            m.pos.resize(pos.size()); m.nrm.resize(nor.size());
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < pos.size(); ++i) { m.pos[i] = static_cast<float>(pos[i]); m.nrm[i] = static_cast<float>(nor[i]); }
            m.uv = s.uv0;
            m.col = s.col.empty() ? std::vector<float>(static_cast<std::size_t>(nv) * 4, 1.f) : s.col;
            if (skinned) { m.has_skin = true; m.bones = bone_names; m.joints = jj; m.weights = ww; }
            m.idx = pr.idx;
            fix_winding(m.idx, pos, nor);
            f.meshes.push_back(std::move(m));
        }
    });

    for (const RawJoint& j : joints) {
        Joint o;
        o.name = j.name; o.parent = j.parent;
        cv_p(j.pos, o.t); cv_q(j.quat, o.q);
        for (int q = 0; q < 3; ++q) o.s[q] = static_cast<float>(j.scale[q]);
        cv_m4(j.inv_world, o.ibm);
        f.joints.push_back(o);
    }
    for (const RawClip& c : clips) {
        Clip o;
        o.name = c.name;
        o.duration = static_cast<float>(c.duration);
        for (const RawTrack& t : c.tracks) {
            if (t.has_t) {
                Channel ch; ch.bone = t.bone; ch.path = 0;
                for (double x : t.tt) ch.times.push_back(static_cast<float>(x));
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 2 < t.vt.size(); i += 3) { float v[3]; cv_p(&t.vt[i], v); ch.values.insert(ch.values.end(), v, v + 3); }
                o.channels.push_back(std::move(ch));
            }
            if (t.has_r) {
                Channel ch; ch.bone = t.bone; ch.path = 1;
                for (double x : t.tr) ch.times.push_back(static_cast<float>(x));
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 3 < t.vr.size(); i += 4) { float v[4]; cv_q(&t.vr[i], v); ch.values.insert(ch.values.end(), v, v + 4); }
                o.channels.push_back(std::move(ch));
            }
            if (t.has_s) {
                Channel ch; ch.bone = t.bone; ch.path = 2;
                for (double x : t.ts) ch.times.push_back(static_cast<float>(x));
                for (double x : t.vs) ch.values.push_back(static_cast<float>(x));
                o.channels.push_back(std::move(ch));
            }
        }
        if (!o.channels.empty()) f.clips.push_back(std::move(o));
    }
    f.flags = (f.meshes.empty() ? 0u : kFlagModel) | (f.joints.empty() ? 0u : kFlagSkeleton) | (f.clips.empty() ? 0u : kFlagClips);
    return f;
}

double guess_mesh_scale(const B3dModel& model, const std::vector<RawJoint>& joints) {
    if (joints.size() < 2) return kMeshScale;
    std::vector<M4> world(joints.size());
    double jmn[3] = {1e30, 1e30, 1e30}, jmx[3] = {-1e30, -1e30, -1e30};
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < joints.size(); ++i) {
        const M4 loc = joint_local(joints[i]);
        const int p = joints[i].parent;
        world[i] = (p < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(p) >= i) ? loc : mul(world[static_cast<std::size_t>(p)], loc);
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) { jmn[k] = std::min(jmn[k], world[i][k][3]); jmx[k] = std::max(jmx[k], world[i][k][3]); }
    }
    double mmn[3] = {1e30, 1e30, 1e30}, mmx[3] = {-1e30, -1e30, -1e30};
    bool any = false;
    model.each_surface([&](const B3dNode&, const B3dSurface& s) {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 2 < s.pos.size(); i += 3) { any = true; for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) { mmn[k] = std::min(mmn[k], static_cast<double>(s.pos[i + static_cast<std::size_t>(k)])); mmx[k] = std::max(mmx[k], static_cast<double>(s.pos[i + static_cast<std::size_t>(k)])); } }
    });
    if (!any) return kMeshScale;
    auto diag = [](const double* a, const double* b) { double s = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) s += (b[k] - a[k]) * (b[k] - a[k]); return std::sqrt(s); };
    const double jd = diag(jmn, jmx), md = diag(mmn, mmx);
    if (jd < 1e-6 || md < 1e-6) return kMeshScale;
    const double e_small = std::fabs(std::log(md * kMeshScale / jd)), e_one = std::fabs(std::log(md / jd));
    return e_one < e_small ? 1.0 : static_cast<double>(kMeshScale);
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> save_f3m(const F3MFile& f) {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> o;
    auto u8 = [&](std::uint8_t v) { o.push_back(v); };
    auto u16 = [&](std::uint16_t v) { o.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v)); o.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> 8)); };
    auto u32 = [&](std::uint32_t v) { for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) o.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> (8 * i))); };
    auto f32 = [&](float v) { std::uint32_t u; std::memcpy(&u, &v, 4); u32(u); };
    auto str = [&](const std::string& s) { const std::size_t n = std::min<std::size_t>(s.size(), 65535); u16(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(n)); o.insert(o.end(), s.begin(), s.begin() + static_cast<long>(n)); };
    o.insert(o.end(), {'F', '3', 'M', '1'});
    u32(f.flags);
    u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(f.textures.size())); u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(f.materials.size())); u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(f.meshes.size()));
    u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(f.joints.size())); u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(f.clips.size()));
    str(f.name);
    for (const Texture& t : f.textures) { str(t.name); u32(t.w); u32(t.h); o.insert(o.end(), t.rgba.begin(), t.rgba.end()); }
    for (const Material& m : f.materials) { str(m.name); u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m.texture)); for (float c : m.color) f32(c); u8(m.alpha_mode); u8(m.double_sided); u8(0); u8(0); }
    for (const Mesh& m : f.meshes) {
        str(m.name); u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m.material)); u32(m.nv()); u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m.idx.size()));
        u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m.has_skin ? m.bones.size() : 0));
        if (m.has_skin) for (const std::string& b : m.bones) str(b);
        u8(m.has_skin ? 1 : 0); u8(0); u8(0); u8(0);
        for (float x : m.pos) f32(x);
        for (float x : m.nrm) f32(x);
        for (float x : m.uv) f32(x);
        for (float x : m.col) f32(x);
        if (m.has_skin) { for (std::uint16_t x : m.joints) u16(x); for (float x : m.weights) f32(x); }
        for (std::uint32_t x : m.idx) u32(x);
    }
    for (const Joint& j : f.joints) {
        str(j.name); u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(j.parent));
        for (float x : j.t) f32(x);
        for (float x : j.q) f32(x);
        for (float x : j.s) f32(x);
        for (float x : j.ibm) f32(x);
    }
    for (const Clip& c : f.clips) {
        str(c.name); f32(c.duration); u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(c.channels.size()));
        for (const Channel& ch : c.channels) {
            str(ch.bone); u8(ch.path); u8(0); u8(0); u8(0);
            u32(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ch.times.size()));
            for (float x : ch.times) f32(x);
            for (float x : ch.values) f32(x);
        }
    }
    return o;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/model_build.h

```cpp
// v20: monta um modelo pronto para desenhar (F3MFile, o mesmo do visualizador) a partir do B3D + esqueleto GR2 + animacoes GR2,
// direto da demo, sem o conversor Python. Porta fiel de tools/py/f3vb/export.py (Exporter.scene, apply_initial_placement,
// resolve_bone_aliases, _fix_winding) e gr2export.py (read_skeleton, read_clips): o resultado e conferido byte a byte com os
// .f3m que o Python gera (tests/test_v20.cpp e a ferramenta F3VBCheck --models).
//
// Espaco de saida (igual ao Python): mao-direita, Y para cima (o Z do jogo e invertido), geometria na escala do esqueleto
// (malha x 100/1024). Para desenhar no mapa (mao-esquerda, unidades do jogo) quem chama aplica a escala 10,24 e inverte o Z.
#pragma once
#include <functional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "b3d.h"
#include "f3m.h"
#include "gr2.h"

namespace f3v {

constexpr float kMeshScale = 100.0f / 1024.0f;   // geometria do B3D -> unidades do esqueleto (MEDIDO no v12: CR_Dog, Eyebot)

// Juntas "cruas" (espaco do jogo, antes da conversao), como o gr2export.read_skeleton do Python.
struct RawJoint { std::string name; int parent = -1; double pos[3]; double quat[4]; double scale[3]; double inv_world[16]; };
// Clipe "cru" (espaco do jogo): por osso, chaves amostradas no passo do GR2.
struct RawTrack { std::string bone; bool has_t = false, has_r = false, has_s = false;
                  std::vector<double> tt, tr, ts; std::vector<double> vt, vr, vs; };   // valores: 3, 4, 3 por chave
struct RawClip { std::string name; double duration = 0; std::vector<RawTrack> tracks; };

// Primeiro esqueleto "de verdade" (ignora Light/Camera e esqueletos de 1 osso). false se nao houver.
bool raw_skeleton(const Gr2File& f, std::vector<RawJoint>& out, std::string* name = nullptr);
// Todas as animacoes do arquivo, so com trilhas de ossos que existem em `bones`. clip_name vazio = nome da animacao.
void raw_clips(const Gr2File& f, const std::vector<RawJoint>& joints, const std::string& clip_name, std::vector<RawClip>& out);

struct ModelBuildReport {
    std::vector<std::string> warnings;
    bool placement_applied = false;
    double placement[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    int aliased_bones = 0;
};

// texture_loader(nome sem extensao) -> bytes de TGA/BMP (vazio se nao achar)
using TextureLoader = std::function<std::vector<std::uint8_t>(const std::string& stem)>;

// Monta o F3MFile. joints/clips podem ser vazios (modelo estatico). Sem dependencia de janela/OpenGL.
// mesh_scale: kMeshScale (padrao, igual ao Python) ou o valor de guess_mesh_scale().
F3MFile build_model(const B3dModel& model, const std::string& name, const std::vector<RawJoint>& joints, const std::vector<RawClip>& clips,
                    const TextureLoader& tex, ModelBuildReport* report = nullptr, double mesh_scale = kMeshScale);

// v20: escala da malha em relacao ao esqueleto. Quase todos os modelos tem a malha 10,24x maior que o esqueleto (kMeshScale),
// mas os B3D antigos ("not re-converted", como avisa o log da demo; ex.: IT_MainMenu_boxcar, o vagao do menu) ja estao na
// escala do esqueleto (1.0). Escolhe o valor que deixa o tamanho da malha mais perto do tamanho do esqueleto na pose de bind.
double guess_mesh_scale(const B3dModel& model, const std::vector<RawJoint>& joints);

// Grava no formato F3M1 (o mesmo do tools/py/f3vb/f3m.py), para conferencia e cache.
std::vector<std::uint8_t> save_f3m(const F3MFile& f);

// Prefixos de busca de animacao (igual ao extractor.anim_prefixes): "<nome>_" e, para humanos, "HumM_"/"HumF_".
std::vector<std::string> anim_prefixes(const std::string& model_name);

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/proto.cpp

```cpp
// v20: prototipos de entidade (ver proto.h).
#include "proto.h"

#include <cstring>

namespace f3v {

namespace {

bool printable(std::uint8_t c) { return c >= 32 && c < 127; }
std::string lower(std::string s) { for (char& c : s) if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'A' + 'a'); return s; }
bool ends_with_ci(const std::string& s, const char* suf) { const std::size_t n = std::strlen(suf); return s.size() >= n && lower(s.substr(s.size() - n)) == lower(suf); }
bool starts_with_ci(const std::string& s, const char* pre) { const std::size_t n = std::strlen(pre); return s.size() >= n && lower(s.substr(0, n)) == lower(pre); }

std::size_t find_tag(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t n, const char* tag, std::size_t from = 0) {
    for (std::size_t i = from; i + 4 <= n; ++i) if (std::memcmp(d + i, tag, 4) == 0) return i;
    return std::string::npos;
}

}  // namespace

std::string part_slot(const std::string& p) {
    static const char* kSlots[] = {"Hai", "Pon", "Mus", "Bea", "Bod", "Fee", "Bac", "Van", "Hea", "Han", "Sho", "Eye"};
    if (p.size() < 4 || p.find('.') != std::string::npos) return "";
    for (const char* s : kSlots) if (p.compare(0, 3, s) == 0 && p[3] >= 'A' && p[3] <= 'Z') return s;
    return "";
}

bool parse_prototype(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t n, const std::string& kind, Prototype& out) {
    out = Prototype();
    out.kind = kind;
    if (!d || n < 8) return false;
    // textos: u16 tamanho (3..96) + bytes imprimiveis
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 2 < n;) {
        const std::size_t len = static_cast<std::size_t>(d[i] | (d[i + 1] << 8));
        if (len >= 3 && len <= 96 && i + 2 + len <= n) {
            bool ok = true;
            for (std::size_t k = 0; k < len && ok; ++k) ok = printable(d[i + 2 + k]);
            if (ok) { out.texts.push_back({i, std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(d + i + 2), len)}); i += 2 + len; continue; }
        }
        ++i;
    }
    const std::size_t een2 = find_tag(d, n, "EEN2"), gcre = find_tag(d, n, "GCRE"), gitm = find_tag(d, n, "GITM"), gchr = find_tag(d, n, "GCHR");
    for (const ProtoText& t : out.texts) if (een2 == std::string::npos || t.at > een2) { out.model = t.text; break; }
    std::string last_part;
    for (const ProtoText& t : out.texts) {
        const std::string& s = t.text;
        if (s == out.model) continue;
        if (starts_with_ci(s, "skin_") && ends_with_ci(s, ".dds")) { if (out.skin.empty()) out.skin = s; continue; }
        if (starts_with_ci(s, "port_")) { out.portrait = s; continue; }
        if (ends_with_ci(s, ".amx")) { out.script = s; continue; }
        if (gchr != std::string::npos && t.at > gchr) { out.character_name = s; continue; }
        const bool after_gcre = gcre != std::string::npos && t.at > gcre;
        if (ends_with_ci(s, ".arm") || ends_with_ci(s, ".wea") || ends_with_ci(s, ".amo") || ends_with_ci(s, ".itm") || ends_with_ci(s, ".use")) {
            if (after_gcre && ends_with_ci(s, ".arm") && out.armor.empty()) out.armor = s;
            else if (after_gcre && ends_with_ci(s, ".wea") && out.weapon.empty()) out.weapon = s;
            else out.inventory.push_back(s);
            continue;
        }
        const std::string slot = part_slot(s);
        if (!slot.empty() && (kind != "ARM" || gitm == std::string::npos || t.at > gitm)) { out.parts.push_back(s); last_part = s; continue; }
        if (!last_part.empty() && ends_with_ci(s, "_lg.dds") && starts_with_ci(s, last_part.c_str())) { out.part_texture[last_part] = s.substr(0, s.size() - 4); continue; }
        if (kind == "WEA" && starts_with_ci(s, "WP_") && s.find('.') == std::string::npos && out.held_model.empty()) { out.held_model = s; continue; }
        if (kind == "CRT" && out.display_name.empty() && s.find('.') == std::string::npos && s != "<No Script>" && t.at > een2 && (gcre == std::string::npos || t.at < gcre)) out.display_name = s;
    }
    return !out.model.empty();
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/proto.h

```cpp
// v20: leitura minima dos prototipos de entidade da demo (.CRT criaturas/NPCs, .ARM armaduras, .WEA armas, .USE usaveis,
// .ITM/.AMO/.CON/.DOR), o suficiente para MONTAR o modelo 3D da entidade. Medido nos arquivos da demo (docs/specs/prototipos.md):
//   - chunks com etiqueta de 4 letras SEM tamanho fixo conhecido: EEN2 (modelo), EEOV (nome exibido, script, pele, inventario),
//     GENT, GCRE (criatura: SPECIAL...), GITM (item), GIWP (arma), GIAR (armadura), GOBJ, GCHR (personagem salvo: nome);
//   - textos sao "u16 tamanho + bytes" (latin-1).
//   CRT: 1o texto = modelo base (HumMNor, HumMStr, CR_Dog...); pele "Skin_*.dds"; retrato "port_*.dds"; partes do corpo
//        (HaiBald, MusStubble, BodPrisonSuit... + textura opcional "<Parte>_NN_LG.dds"); DEPOIS do GCRE: armadura (.ARM) e arma
//        (.WEA) equipadas. Antes do GCRE: inventario.
//   ARM: modelo no chao (GD_*), icone, e as partes que ela veste (HeaArmingCap, BodPowerArmor, HanPowerArmor...).
//   WEA: modelo no chao (GD_WP_*), icones, e o modelo NA MAO (WP_*: tem esqueleto proprio).
//   USE/ITM/AMO/CON/DOR: 1o texto = modelo.
// O resto (numeros de SPECIAL, pericias, pesos...) fica para quando precisarmos; o parser guarda todos os textos em ordem.
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

struct ProtoText { std::size_t at = 0; std::string text; };

struct Prototype {
    std::string kind;                                 // "CRT", "ARM", "WEA", "USE"...
    std::string model;                                // 1o texto do EEN2
    std::string display_name, script, skin, portrait;
    std::vector<std::string> parts;                   // partes do corpo (CRT) ou que a armadura veste (ARM)
    std::map<std::string, std::string> part_texture;  // parte -> textura propria (ex.: BacPrisonSuit -> BacPrisonSuit_13_LG)
    std::vector<std::string> inventory;               // arquivos .WEA/.AMO/... carregados (CRT, antes do GCRE)
    std::string armor, weapon;                        // equipados (CRT, depois do GCRE)
    std::string held_model;                           // WEA: modelo na mao (WP_*)
    std::string character_name;                       // GCHR (personagem salvo)
    std::vector<ProtoText> texts;                     // todos os textos, em ordem
};

bool parse_prototype(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, const std::string& kind, Prototype& out);

// "HaiBald" -> "Hai"; "" se nao for nome de parte
std::string part_slot(const std::string& part);

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/scene.cpp

```cpp
#include "scene.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace f3v {

void Scene::clear_clips() {
    clips.clear();
    clip_bind_.clear();
}

LoadReport Scene::add(F3MFile&& f) {
    LoadReport rep;
    const bool has_model = !f.meshes.empty();
    if (has_model) {
        textures = std::move(f.textures);
        materials = std::move(f.materials);
        meshes = std::move(f.meshes);
        model_name = f.name;
        rep.replaced_model = true;
        if (!f.joints.empty()) {
            joints = std::move(f.joints);
            clips.clear();
            rep.replaced_skeleton = true;
        }
    } else if (!f.joints.empty() && joints.empty()) {
        joints = std::move(f.joints);
        rep.adopted_skeleton = true;
    }
    for (Clip& c : f.clips) {
        int dup = 1;
        std::string base = c.name;
        auto exists = [&](const std::string& n) { return std::any_of(clips.begin(), clips.end(), [&](const Clip& o) { return o.name == n; }); };
        while (exists(c.name)) c.name = base + " (" + std::to_string(++dup) + ")";
        clips.push_back(std::move(c));
        ++rep.clips_added;
    }
    rebuild();
    for (std::size_t i = clips.size() - static_cast<std::size_t>(rep.clips_added); i < clips.size(); ++i)
        for (const Channel& ch : clips[i].channels)
            if (find_joint(ch.bone) < 0) ++rep.channels_unmatched;
    rep.message = std::string(rep.replaced_model ? "modelo carregado" : "complemento carregado") + "; " + std::to_string(rep.clips_added) +
                  " animacoes adicionadas" + (rep.adopted_skeleton ? "; esqueleto adotado" : "") +
                  (rep.channels_unmatched ? "; " + std::to_string(rep.channels_unmatched) + " canais sem osso correspondente" : "");
    return rep;
}

void Scene::rebuild() {
    joint_index_.clear();
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < joints.size(); ++i) joint_index_.emplace(joints[i].name, static_cast<int>(i));
    mesh_map_.assign(meshes.size(), {});
    for (std::size_t m = 0; m < meshes.size(); ++m)
        for (const std::string& b : meshes[m].bones) {
            mesh_map_[m].push_back(find_joint(b));
        }
    clip_bind_.assign(clips.size(), {});
    joint_world.assign(joints.size(), Mat4());
    joint_skin.assign(joints.size(), Mat4());
}

void Scene::bind_clip(int c) {
    if (static_cast<int>(clip_bind_.size()) <= c) clip_bind_.resize(clips.size());
    auto& b = clip_bind_[static_cast<std::size_t>(c)];
    if (!b.empty()) return;
    b.assign(joints.size() * 3, -1);
    const Clip& clip = clips[static_cast<std::size_t>(c)];
    for (std::size_t k = 0; k < clip.channels.size(); ++k) {
        const int j = find_joint(clip.channels[k].bone);
        if (j >= 0) b[static_cast<std::size_t>(j) * 3 + clip.channels[k].path] = static_cast<int>(k);
    }
}

static bool sample(const Channel& ch, float t, float* out) {
    const int dim = ch.path == 1 ? 4 : 3;
    const std::size_t n = ch.times.size();
    if (n == 0 || ch.values.size() < n * static_cast<std::size_t>(dim)) return false;
    if (n == 1 || t <= ch.times[0]) { for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) out[i] = ch.values[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)]; return true; }
    if (t >= ch.times[n - 1]) { for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) out[i] = ch.values[(n - 1) * static_cast<std::size_t>(dim) + static_cast<std::size_t>(i)]; return true; }
    std::size_t hi = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::upper_bound(ch.times.begin(), ch.times.end(), t) - ch.times.begin());
    if (hi == 0) hi = 1;
    if (hi >= n) hi = n - 1;
    const std::size_t lo = hi - 1;
    const float span = ch.times[hi] - ch.times[lo];
    const float u = span > 0 ? (t - ch.times[lo]) / span : 0.f;
    const float* a = &ch.values[lo * static_cast<std::size_t>(dim)];
    const float* b = &ch.values[hi * static_cast<std::size_t>(dim)];
    if (ch.path == 1) slerp(a, b, u, out);
    else for (int i = 0; i < dim; ++i) out[i] = a[i] + u * (b[i] - a[i]);
    return true;
}

void Scene::evaluate(int clip, float t) {
    const bool use = clip >= 0 && clip < static_cast<int>(clips.size());
    if (use) bind_clip(clip);
    joint_world.resize(joints.size());
    joint_skin.resize(joints.size());
    for (std::size_t j = 0; j < joints.size(); ++j) {
        const Joint& jt = joints[j];
        float tr[3] = {jt.t[0], jt.t[1], jt.t[2]}, q[4] = {jt.q[0], jt.q[1], jt.q[2], jt.q[3]}, s[3] = {jt.s[0], jt.s[1], jt.s[2]};
        if (use) {
            const auto& b = clip_bind_[static_cast<std::size_t>(clip)];
            const Clip& c = clips[static_cast<std::size_t>(clip)];
            if (b[j * 3 + 0] >= 0) sample(c.channels[static_cast<std::size_t>(b[j * 3 + 0])], t, tr);
            if (b[j * 3 + 1] >= 0) sample(c.channels[static_cast<std::size_t>(b[j * 3 + 1])], t, q);
            if (b[j * 3 + 2] >= 0) sample(c.channels[static_cast<std::size_t>(b[j * 3 + 2])], t, s);
        }
        const Mat4 local = compose_trs(tr, q, s);
        joint_world[j] = (jt.parent >= 0 && jt.parent < static_cast<int>(j)) ? mul(joint_world[static_cast<std::size_t>(jt.parent)], local) : local;
        Mat4 ibm;
        std::memcpy(ibm.m, jt.ibm, sizeof ibm.m);
        joint_skin[j] = mul(joint_world[j], ibm);
    }
}

int Scene::find_joint(const std::string& name) const {
    auto it = joint_index_.find(name);
    if (it != joint_index_.end()) return it->second;
    for (int k = 1; k <= 9; ++k) {
        it = joint_index_.find(name + "_" + std::to_string(k));
        if (it != joint_index_.end()) return it->second;
    }
    const std::size_t p = name.rfind('_');
    if (p != std::string::npos && p + 1 < name.size() && name.find_first_not_of("0123456789", p + 1) == std::string::npos) {
        it = joint_index_.find(name.substr(0, p));
        if (it != joint_index_.end()) return it->second;
    }
    auto lower = [](std::string s) { for (char& ch : s) if (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') ch = static_cast<char>(ch - 'A' + 'a'); return s; };
    const std::string ln = lower(name);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < joints.size(); ++i)
        if (lower(joints[i].name) == ln) return static_cast<int>(i);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < joints.size(); ++i) {                    // maiusculas + sufixo "_N" da junta
        const std::string jl = lower(joints[i].name);
        const std::size_t q = jl.rfind('_');
        if (q != std::string::npos && q + 1 < jl.size() && jl.find_first_not_of("0123456789", q + 1) == std::string::npos && jl.substr(0, q) == ln) return static_cast<int>(i);
    }
    return -1;
}

int Scene::bone_to_joint(int mesh, int bone_index) const {
    if (mesh < 0 || mesh >= static_cast<int>(mesh_map_.size())) return -1;
    const auto& m = mesh_map_[static_cast<std::size_t>(mesh)];
    return (bone_index >= 0 && bone_index < static_cast<int>(m.size())) ? m[static_cast<std::size_t>(bone_index)] : -1;
}

void Scene::skin(int mi, std::vector<float>& pos, std::vector<float>& nrm) const {
    const Mesh& m = meshes[static_cast<std::size_t>(mi)];
    const float ms = mesh_scale;
    pos = m.pos;
    nrm = m.nrm;
    if (ms != 1.f) for (float& x : pos) x *= ms;
    if (!m.has_skin || joints.empty() || joint_skin.size() != joints.size()) return;
    const std::uint32_t nv = m.nv();
    for (std::uint32_t v = 0; v < nv; ++v) {
        float p[3] = {0, 0, 0}, n[3] = {0, 0, 0}, wsum = 0, wmiss = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            const float w = m.weights[v * 4 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(k)];
            if (w <= 0) continue;
            const int j = bone_to_joint(mi, m.joints[v * 4 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(k)]);
            if (j < 0) { wmiss += w; continue; }               // osso sem junta: essa parte do peso fica no bind (nao colapsa para a origem)
            const Mat4& M = joint_skin[static_cast<std::size_t>(j)];
            const Vec3 pp = transform_point(M, m.pos[v * 3] * ms, m.pos[v * 3 + 1] * ms, m.pos[v * 3 + 2] * ms);
            const Vec3 nn = transform_dir(M, m.nrm[v * 3], m.nrm[v * 3 + 1], m.nrm[v * 3 + 2]);
            p[0] += w * pp.x; p[1] += w * pp.y; p[2] += w * pp.z;
            n[0] += w * nn.x; n[1] += w * nn.y; n[2] += w * nn.z;
            wsum += w;
        }
        if (wsum <= 1e-6f) continue;                       // sem influencia valida: mantem o bind
        if (wmiss > 0) {
            p[0] += wmiss * m.pos[v * 3] * ms; p[1] += wmiss * m.pos[v * 3 + 1] * ms; p[2] += wmiss * m.pos[v * 3 + 2] * ms;
            n[0] += wmiss * m.nrm[v * 3]; n[1] += wmiss * m.nrm[v * 3 + 1]; n[2] += wmiss * m.nrm[v * 3 + 2];
        }
        const float wt = wsum + wmiss;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) p[i] /= wt;
        const float len = std::sqrt(n[0] * n[0] + n[1] * n[1] + n[2] * n[2]);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) { pos[v * 3 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i)] = p[i]; nrm[v * 3 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i)] = len > 1e-9f ? n[i] / len : 0.f; }
    }
}

bool Scene::bounds(float mn[3], float mx[3]) const {
    bool any = false;
    for (const Mesh& m : meshes)
        for (std::uint32_t v = 0; v < m.nv(); ++v)
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
                const float x = m.pos[v * 3 + static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i)] * mesh_scale;
                if (!any) { mn[i] = mx[i] = x; } else { mn[i] = std::min(mn[i], x); mx[i] = std::max(mx[i], x); }
                if (i == 2) any = true;
            }
    return any;
}

void resize_pow2(const Texture& t, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out, std::uint32_t& w, std::uint32_t& h) {
    auto nearest_pot = [](std::uint32_t v) {
        std::uint32_t p = 1;
        while (p < v && p < 2048) p <<= 1;
        if (p > 1 && p < 2048 && (p - v) > (v - p / 2)) p >>= 1;   // mais perto da potencia de baixo
        return std::min<std::uint32_t>(p, 2048);
    };
    w = nearest_pot(t.w);
    h = nearest_pot(t.h);
    if (w == t.w && h == t.h) { out = t.rgba; return; }
    out.assign(static_cast<std::size_t>(w) * h * 4, 0);
    for (std::uint32_t y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
        const float sy = (static_cast<float>(y) + 0.5f) * static_cast<float>(t.h) / static_cast<float>(h) - 0.5f;
        const int y0 = std::max(0, static_cast<int>(std::floor(sy))), y1 = std::min<int>(static_cast<int>(t.h) - 1, y0 + 1);
        const float fy = std::min(1.f, std::max(0.f, sy - static_cast<float>(y0)));
        for (std::uint32_t x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
            const float sx = (static_cast<float>(x) + 0.5f) * static_cast<float>(t.w) / static_cast<float>(w) - 0.5f;
            const int x0 = std::max(0, static_cast<int>(std::floor(sx))), x1 = std::min<int>(static_cast<int>(t.w) - 1, x0 + 1);
            const float fx = std::min(1.f, std::max(0.f, sx - static_cast<float>(x0)));
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {
                auto px = [&](int xx, int yy) { return static_cast<float>(t.rgba[(static_cast<std::size_t>(yy) * t.w + static_cast<std::size_t>(xx)) * 4 + static_cast<std::size_t>(c)]); };
                const float top = px(x0, y0) + fx * (px(x1, y0) - px(x0, y0));
                const float bot = px(x0, y1) + fx * (px(x1, y1) - px(x0, y1));
                out[(static_cast<std::size_t>(y) * w + x) * 4 + static_cast<std::size_t>(c)] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(top + fy * (bot - top) + 0.5f);
            }
        }
    }
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// Cena do visualizador: junta modelo, esqueleto e animacoes (carregados em qualquer ordem), avalia a pose e faz o skinning na CPU.
// Portavel (sem Windows/OpenGL): e a parte testada automaticamente.
#pragma once
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include "f3m.h"
#include "vmath.h"

namespace f3v {

struct LoadReport {
    bool replaced_model = false, adopted_skeleton = false, replaced_skeleton = false;
    int clips_added = 0, channels_unmatched = 0;
    std::string message;
};

class Scene {
public:
    // Regras: arquivo COM malhas substitui o modelo (se trouxer esqueleto, substitui esqueleto e animacoes);
    // arquivo SEM malhas e um "complemento": adota o esqueleto se a cena nao tiver um e sempre acrescenta animacoes.
    LoadReport add(F3MFile&& f);
    void clear_clips();

    std::vector<Texture> textures;
    std::vector<Material> materials;
    std::vector<Mesh> meshes;
    std::vector<Joint> joints;
    std::vector<Clip> clips;
    std::string model_name;

    // pose: clip < 0 -> pose de bind. Preenche joint_world e joint_skin (= mundo * ibm).
    void evaluate(int clip, float t);
    // skinning de uma malha com a pose atual (sem esqueleto/pesos: devolve a posicao original).
    void skin(int mesh, std::vector<float>& pos, std::vector<float>& nrm) const;
    bool bounds(float mn[3], float mx[3]) const;       // caixa envolvente da pose de bind

    // Escala EXTRA aplicada na geometria (vertices) antes do skinning, 1 = sem mudanca. Serve para F3M gerados pelo
    // conversor v11 (malha 10,24x maior que o esqueleto) e para experimentar valores no visualizador (teclas M , . N).
    float mesh_scale = 1.f;

    std::vector<Mat4> joint_world, joint_skin;
    // Junta pelo nome do osso. Alem do nome exato aceita variacoes que o exportador de origem introduz (medido em HumFSkl/HumMNor):
    // "L Clavicle" -> "L Clavicle_1", "X_1" -> "X", e diferenca de maiusculas. -1 se nao houver.
    int find_joint(const std::string& bone) const;
    int bone_to_joint(int mesh, int bone_index) const;

private:
    void rebuild();
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> mesh_map_;            // por malha: osso -> junta (-1 = sem correspondencia)
    std::unordered_map<std::string, int> joint_index_;
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> clip_bind_;            // por clipe: joint*3 + caminho -> canal (-1)
    void bind_clip(int clip);
};

// Reamostra para potencia de dois (OpenGL 1.x nao garante textura nao-potencia-de-dois). Maximo 2048.
void resize_pow2(const Texture& t, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out, std::uint32_t& w, std::uint32_t& h);

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// F3VBScript: roda um script .amx da demo SEM janela e imprime o dialogo (v17). Ferramenta de depuracao: mande a saida (ou o --log) para analise.
//   F3VBScript ARQ.amx [--stf TABELA.stf] [--choices 1,2,1] [--seed N] [--survey] [--log SAIDA.txt]
//     sem opcoes: inicia o dialogo (OnStartDialogue) e mostra falas e respostas; --choices responde na ordem (numeros das respostas visiveis);
//     --survey: roda TODAS as publics (como o dialog_dump) e lista erros e natives que ainda faltam implementar.
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "script_world.h"
#include "stf.h"

using namespace f3v;

static FILE* g_log = nullptr;
static void out(const char* fmt, ...) {
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    va_list ap2;
    va_copy(ap2, ap);
    std::vprintf(fmt, ap);
    if (g_log) std::vfprintf(g_log, fmt, ap2);
    va_end(ap2);
    va_end(ap);
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 2) { std::puts("uso: F3VBScript ARQ.amx [--stf TABELA.stf] [--choices 1,2,1] [--seed N] [--survey] [--log SAIDA.txt]"); return 2; }
    std::string stf_path, log_path;
    std::vector<int> choices;
    std::uint32_t seed = 1;
    bool survey = false;
    for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (!std::strcmp(argv[i], "--stf") && i + 1 < argc) stf_path = argv[++i];
        else if (!std::strcmp(argv[i], "--log") && i + 1 < argc) log_path = argv[++i];
        else if (!std::strcmp(argv[i], "--seed") && i + 1 < argc) seed = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::atoi(argv[++i]));
        else if (!std::strcmp(argv[i], "--survey")) survey = true;
        else if (!std::strcmp(argv[i], "--choices") && i + 1 < argc) {
            for (char* tok = std::strtok(argv[++i], ","); tok; tok = std::strtok(nullptr, ",")) choices.push_back(std::atoi(tok));
        }
    }
    if (!log_path.empty()) g_log = std::fopen(log_path.c_str(), "w");
    Stf stf;
    std::string err;
    if (!stf_path.empty()) {
        if (stf.load_file(stf_path, err)) out("tabela de strings: %s (%zu textos)\n", stf_path.c_str(), stf.count());
        else out("AVISO: .stf nao carregou: %s\n", err.c_str());
    }
    auto si = ScriptInstance::from_file(argv[1], argv[1], 1000, seed, err);
    if (!si) { out("ERRO ao carregar %s: %s\n", argv[1], err.c_str()); return 1; }
    out("script %s: %zu publics, %zu natives\n", argv[1], si->prog->publics().size(), si->prog->natives().size());

    int rc = 0;
    if (survey) {
        const ScriptSurvey sv = survey_script(*si);
        out("publics: %zu ok, %zu com erro | dialogo (OnStartDialogue): %s\n", sv.ran_ok, sv.ran_fail, sv.has_dialogue ? "sim" : "nao");
        for (const std::string& f : sv.failures) out("  erro: %s\n", f.c_str());
        for (const std::string& f : sv.unresolved) out("  native importada e nao registrada: %s\n", f.c_str());
        for (const auto& kv : sv.unimplemented) {
            out("  native sem implementar: %s x%d", kv.first.c_str(), kv.second);
            const auto it = sv.samples.find(kv.first);
            if (it != sv.samples.end()) for (const std::string& smp : it->second) out("  ex.: %s", smp.c_str());
            out("\n");
        }
        std::string all;
        for (const auto& kv : sv.called) all += (all.empty() ? "" : ", ") + kv.first + "x" + std::to_string(kv.second);
        out("natives chamadas (todas): %s\n", all.empty() ? "(nenhuma)" : all.c_str());
        rc = sv.ran_fail ? 1 : 0;
    } else {
        DialogSession d(*si, stf.loaded() ? &stf : nullptr);
        auto show = [&](std::size_t& shown) {
            for (; shown < d.lines().size(); ++shown) {
                const DialogLine& l = d.lines()[shown];
                out("  %s: %s\n", l.who.c_str(), l.text.empty() ? ("[texto #" + std::to_string(l.text_id) + "]").c_str() : l.text.c_str());
            }
            if (!d.error().empty()) out("  ERRO da VM: %s\n", d.error().c_str());
            if (d.finished()) out("  (fim do dialogo)\n");
            else {
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < d.choices().size(); ++i) {
                    const DialogChoice& c = d.choices()[i];
                    out("  %zu. %s   (resposta #%d, texto %d, acao '%s', destino '%s')\n", i + 1, c.text.empty() ? "[sem texto]" : c.text.c_str(), c.reply_id, c.text_id, c.action_fn.c_str(), c.link_fn.c_str());
                }
                if (d.hidden_choices()) out("  (%zu resposta(s) escondida(s) pela condicao)\n", d.hidden_choices());
            }
        };
        std::size_t shown = 0;
        out("\n== iniciar dialogo ==\n");
        if (!d.start()) { out("nao deu para iniciar: %s\n", d.error().c_str()); rc = 1; }
        show(shown);
        for (int c : choices) {
            if (d.finished()) break;
            out("\n== escolhendo %d ==\n", c);
            if (c < 1 || !d.choose(static_cast<std::size_t>(c - 1))) { out("  resposta %d nao existe\n", c); rc = 1; break; }
            show(shown);
        }
        out("\n== passos da VM ==\n");
        for (const std::string& t : d.trace) out("  %s\n", t.c_str());
        out("\n== chamadas de natives ==\n");
        for (const auto& e : si->host->events()) {
            out("  %s%s(", e.implemented ? "" : "[so-log] ", e.native.c_str());
            for (std::size_t k = 0; k < e.args.size(); ++k) out("%s%d", k ? ", " : "", e.args[k]);
            out(")\n");
        }
        for (const auto& kv : si->host->unimplemented_calls()) out("native sem implementar: %s x%d\n", kv.first.c_str(), kv.second);
    }
    if (g_log) std::fclose(g_log);
    return rc;
}
```

```cpp
#include "script_world.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>

namespace f3v {

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ biblioteca
std::string ScriptLibrary::normalize(const std::string& s) {
    std::size_t b = s.find_last_of("/\\");
    std::string t = b == std::string::npos ? s : s.substr(b + 1);
    for (char& c : t) {
        if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'A' + 'a');
        else if (c == '<' || c == '>' || c == ':' || c == '"' || c == '|' || c == '?' || c == '*' || (static_cast<unsigned char>(c) < 32)) c = '_';
    }
    while (!t.empty() && t.back() == ' ') t.pop_back();
    if (t.size() >= 4 && t.compare(t.size() - 4, 4, ".amx") == 0) t.erase(t.size() - 4);
    while (!t.empty() && (t.back() == ' ' || t.back() == '.')) t.pop_back();
    while (!t.empty() && t.front() == ' ') t.erase(t.begin());
    return t;
}

std::size_t ScriptLibrary::scan(const std::string& dir) {
    dir_ = dir;
    by_key_.clear();
    shown_.clear();
    std::error_code ec;
    if (!fs::is_directory(dir, ec)) return 0;
    for (fs::directory_iterator it(dir, ec), end; !ec && it != end; it.increment(ec)) {
        if (!it->is_regular_file(ec)) continue;
        const std::string fn = it->path().filename().string();
        std::string low = fn;
        for (char& c : low) if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'A' + 'a');
        if (low.size() < 4 || low.compare(low.size() - 4, 4, ".amx") != 0) continue;
        const std::string key = normalize(fn);
        by_key_[key] = it->path().string();
        shown_[key] = fn.substr(0, fn.size() - 4);
    }
    return by_key_.size();
}

void ScriptLibrary::add(const std::string& name, const std::string& path) {
    const std::string key = normalize(name);
    by_key_[key] = path;
    shown_[key] = name;
    dlg_cached_ = false;
}

bool ScriptLibrary::read(const std::string& path, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out) const {
    if (reader) return reader(path, out);
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) return false;
    out.assign((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    return true;
}

std::string ScriptLibrary::find(const std::string& script_name) const {
    const auto it = by_key_.find(normalize(script_name));
    return it == by_key_.end() ? std::string() : it->second;
}

std::vector<std::string> ScriptLibrary::names() const {
    std::vector<std::string> v;
    for (const auto& kv : shown_) v.push_back(kv.second);
    return v;
}

const std::vector<ScriptLibrary::Named>& ScriptLibrary::dialogue_scripts() const {
    if (dlg_cached_) return dlg_cache_;
    dlg_cached_ = true;
    dlg_cache_.clear();
    for (const auto& kv : by_key_) {
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
        if (!read(kv.second, bytes)) continue;
        std::string err;
        auto prog = f3vb::amx::Program::load(bytes, &err);
        if (prog && prog->find_public("OnStartDialogue") >= 0) {
            const auto it = shown_.find(kv.first);
            dlg_cache_.push_back(Named{it == shown_.end() ? kv.first : it->second, kv.second});
        }
    }
    return dlg_cache_;
}

static std::string lower_ascii(std::string s) { for (char& c : s) if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'A' + 'a'); return s; }

std::vector<ScriptLibrary::Named> ScriptLibrary::match_dialogue(const std::string& entity_text) const {
    const std::string hay = lower_ascii(entity_text);
    std::vector<std::pair<int, Named>> scored;
    for (const Named& n : dialogue_scripts()) {
        int score = 0;
        std::string word;
        auto flush = [&]() { if (word.size() >= 4 && hay.find(word) != std::string::npos) score += static_cast<int>(word.size()); word.clear(); };
        for (char c : lower_ascii(n.name)) { if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') word.push_back(c); else flush(); }
        flush();
        if (score > 0) scored.push_back({score, n});
    }
    std::stable_sort(scored.begin(), scored.end(), [](const std::pair<int, Named>& a, const std::pair<int, Named>& b) { return a.first > b.first; });
    std::vector<Named> out;
    for (auto& s : scored) out.push_back(s.second);
    return out;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ instancia
std::unique_ptr<ScriptInstance> ScriptInstance::from_bytes(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes, const std::string& name, std::int32_t self_id, std::uint32_t seed, std::string& err) {
    std::unique_ptr<ScriptInstance> si(new ScriptInstance());
    si->name = name;
    auto prog = f3vb::amx::Program::load(bytes, &err);
    if (!prog) return nullptr;
    si->prog.reset(new f3vb::amx::Program(std::move(*prog)));
    si->vm.reset(new f3vb::amx::Machine(*si->prog));
    si->host.reset(new f3vb::host::GameHost(*si->vm, seed));
    si->host->self_id = self_id;
    si->host->install();
    return si;
}

std::unique_ptr<ScriptInstance> ScriptInstance::from_file(const std::string& path, const std::string& name, std::int32_t self_id, std::uint32_t seed, std::string& err) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) { err = "nao consegui abrir " + path; return nullptr; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    auto si = from_bytes(bytes, name, self_id, seed, err);
    if (si) si->path = path;
    return si;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ dialogo
std::string DialogSession::node_name() const { return s_.host->nodes().empty() ? std::string() : s_.host->nodes().back().name; }

std::string strip_color_codes(const std::string& s, std::int32_t& color) {
    std::string out;
    color = -1;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == '{' && i + 2 < s.size() && (s[i + 1] == 'c' || s[i + 1] == 'C')) {
            const std::size_t e = s.find('}', i);
            if (e != std::string::npos && e > i + 2) {
                bool digits = true;
                for (std::size_t k = i + 2; k < e; ++k) digits = digits && s[k] >= '0' && s[k] <= '9';
                if (digits && e - i - 2 <= 10) { color = static_cast<std::int32_t>(std::stoll(s.substr(i + 2, e - i - 2)) & 0x00FFFFFF); i = e; continue; }
            }
        }
        out.push_back(s[i]);
    }
    return out;
}

namespace {
// v19: ids 1-based (id N = entrada N-1 do .stf); devolve o texto sem os codigos de cor
std::string stf_text_1based(const Stf* stf, std::int32_t id, std::int32_t& color) {
    color = -1;
    if (!stf || !stf->loaded() || id < 1 || !stf->has(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(id - 1))) return std::string();
    return strip_color_codes(stf->text(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(id - 1)), color);
}
}  // namespace

void DialogSession::absorb() {
    for (const f3vb::host::Speech& sp : s_.host->speeches()) {
        DialogLine l;
        l.text_id = sp.text_id;
        l.who = sp.native == "PCSpeaker" ? "Jogador" : (sp.entity == s_.host->self_id ? "NPC" : "Entidade " + std::to_string(sp.entity));
        l.text = stf_text_1based(stf_, sp.text_id, l.color);
        lines_.push_back(std::move(l));
    }
    s_.host->clear_speeches();
}

bool DialogSession::call(const std::string& fn, std::int32_t* ret) {
    if (fn.empty()) return false;
    if (s_.prog->find_public(fn) < 0) { trace.push_back("funcao '" + fn + "' nao existe no script"); return false; }
    std::int32_t r = 0;
    s_.vm->set_instruction_limit(2'000'000);
    const f3vb::amx::Err e = s_.vm->call(fn, {}, &r);
    trace.push_back("chamou " + fn + " -> " + f3vb::amx::err_name(e) + " (ret " + std::to_string(r) + ")");
    if (ret) *ret = r;
    absorb();
    if (e != f3vb::amx::Err::None) { error_ = fn + ": " + f3vb::amx::err_name(e); return false; }
    return true;
}

void DialogSession::refresh() {
    for (int guard = 0; guard < 64; ++guard) {
        choices_.clear();
        hidden_ = 0;
        auto& nodes = s_.host->nodes_rw();
        if (nodes.empty()) { trace.push_back("nenhum no de dialogo criado: fim"); finished_ = true; return; }
        const std::string fn = nodes.back().text_fn;
        if (fn.empty() || fn == "EndDialogue") { trace.push_back("funcao de texto '" + fn + "': fim do dialogo"); finished_ = true; return; }
        const std::size_t nodes_before = nodes.size();
        nodes.back().replies.clear();
        if (!call(fn, nullptr)) { finished_ = true; return; }
        auto& after = s_.host->nodes_rw();
        if (after.size() != nodes_before || after.back().text_fn != fn) continue;           // a funcao trocou de no ou de funcao: reavalia
        for (const f3vb::host::Reply& r : after.back().replies) {             // v19: as condicoes ja foram testadas pela funcao de texto (RCn)
            DialogChoice c;
            c.reply_id = r.id; c.text_id = r.text_id; c.action_fn = r.action_fn; c.link_fn = r.link_fn;
            c.text = stf_text_1based(stf_, r.text_id, c.color);
            choices_.push_back(std::move(c));
        }
        if (choices_.empty()) { trace.push_back("sem respostas disponiveis: fim do dialogo"); finished_ = true; }
        return;
    }
    error_ = "laco de nos de dialogo (64 passos sem estabilizar)";
    finished_ = true;
}

bool DialogSession::start() {
    lines_.clear(); choices_.clear(); trace.clear(); error_.clear(); finished_ = false; hidden_ = 0;
    s_.host->reset_dialog();
    s_.host->clear_events();
    s_.host->clear_speeches();
    if (s_.prog->find_public("OnStartDialogue") < 0) { error_ = "o script nao tem a public OnStartDialogue"; finished_ = true; return false; }
    if (!call("OnStartDialogue", nullptr)) { finished_ = true; return false; }
    refresh();
    return true;
}

bool DialogSession::choose(std::size_t i) {
    if (finished_ || i >= choices_.size()) return false;
    const DialogChoice c = choices_[i];
    DialogLine l;
    l.who = "Jogador"; l.text_id = c.text_id; l.text = c.text; l.color = c.color;
    lines_.push_back(l);
    const std::size_t nodes_before = s_.host->nodes().size();
    const std::string fn_before = nodes_before ? s_.host->nodes().back().text_fn : std::string();
    if (!c.action_fn.empty()) call(c.action_fn, nullptr);                     // acao (RAn)
    std::int32_t link = 0;
    if (error_.empty() && !c.link_fn.empty()) call(c.link_fn, &link);          // destino (RLn): troca de no / funcao de texto, ou EndDialogue
    if (!error_.empty()) { finished_ = true; return true; }
    // destino que nao criou no nem trocou a funcao de texto: o dialogo acaba (senao a mesma pergunta voltaria para sempre)
    if (s_.host->nodes().size() == nodes_before && (nodes_before == 0 || s_.host->nodes().back().text_fn == fn_before) && !c.link_fn.empty()) {
        trace.push_back("destino " + c.link_fn + " nao mudou de no (ret " + std::to_string(link) + "): fim do dialogo");
        finished_ = true;
        return true;
    }
    if (!error_.empty()) { finished_ = true; return true; }
    refresh();
    return true;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ levantamento
ScriptSurvey survey_script(ScriptInstance& s) {
    ScriptSurvey r;
    r.name = s.name;
    r.loaded = true;
    r.publics = s.prog->publics().size();
    r.natives = s.prog->natives().size();
    r.has_dialogue = s.prog->find_public("OnStartDialogue") >= 0;
    r.unresolved = s.vm->unresolved_natives();
    s.vm->set_instruction_limit(2'000'000);
    s.host->clear_events();
    const std::int32_t zeros[8] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0};
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.prog->publics().size(); ++i) {
        std::int32_t ret = 0;
        const f3vb::amx::Err e = s.vm->call(static_cast<int>(i), std::span<const std::int32_t>(zeros, 8), &ret);
        if (e == f3vb::amx::Err::None) ++r.ran_ok;
        else { ++r.ran_fail; r.failures.push_back(s.prog->publics()[i].name + ": " + f3vb::amx::err_name(e)); }
    }
    r.unimplemented = s.host->unimplemented_calls();
    for (const f3vb::host::Event& ev : s.host->events()) {
        ++r.called[ev.native];
        std::vector<std::string>& smp = r.samples[ev.native];
        if (ev.implemented || smp.size() >= 2) continue;
        std::string t = "(";
        for (std::size_t k = 0; k < ev.args.size(); ++k) {
            t += (k ? ", " : "") + std::to_string(ev.args[k]);
            if (k < ev.strings.size() && !ev.strings[k].empty()) t += " \"" + ev.strings[k] + "\"";
        }
        smp.push_back(t + ")");
    }
    return r;
}

std::vector<ScriptRef> map_scripts(const MapData& m, const ScriptLibrary& lib) {
    std::map<std::string, ScriptRef> by;
    for (const MapEntity& e : m.entities) {
        if (e.script.empty()) continue;
        const std::string key = ScriptLibrary::normalize(e.script);
        if (key.empty()) continue;
        ScriptRef& r = by[key];
        if (r.name.empty()) { r.name = e.script; r.path = lib.find(e.script); }
        ++r.entities;
    }
    std::vector<ScriptRef> out;
    for (auto& kv : by) out.push_back(std::move(kv.second));
    return out;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```
