```cpp
// Scripts do jogo ligados ao mapa (v17): biblioteca de .amx, instancia (Program + Machine + GameHost), sessao de dialogo e levantamento.
// Portavel: sem Windows nem OpenGL (o F3VBMapViewer so desenha o resultado).
//
// SEMANTICA PROVISORIA (observada em scripts reais, docs/DIALOGOS.md; sera refinada com os logs do usuario):
//   - Iniciar dialogo = chamar a public "OnStartDialogue" (sem argumentos).
//   - O no atual e o ultimo criado por SetCurrentNodeName; sua "funcao de texto" (SetNodeTextFunction) e chamada para (re)registrar as respostas
//     (RegisterReply). "EndDialogue" (ou vazio) como funcao de texto encerra o dialogo.
//   - v19 (medido no '00 Corporal Armstrong'): a funcao de texto ja testa as condicoes (RCn) antes de registrar cada resposta; toda resposta registrada vale.
//   - Escolher uma resposta = chamar a ACAO (3o arg do RegisterReply) e depois o DESTINO (4o arg); entao a funcao de texto do no atual roda de novo.
//   - RegisterNodeText(id) = fala do NPC no no. Ids de texto 1-based no .stf (id N = entrada N-1).
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "../../src/amx/amx_vm.hpp"
#include "../../src/host/game_host.hpp"
#include "f3map.h"
#include "stf.h"

namespace f3v {

// Biblioteca: pasta com os .amx convertidos (CONVERTED/scripts). Nomes comparados sem pasta, sem ".amx", sem maiusculas e com os caracteres
// proibidos do Windows trocados por '_' (igual a safe_name do extrator).
class ScriptLibrary {
public:
    std::size_t scan(const std::string& dir);
    // v20: biblioteca vinda da demo original (Vfs). path = qualquer chave que o leitor entenda (ex.: "vfs:CaptainArmstrong").
    void clear() { by_key_.clear(); shown_.clear(); dlg_cache_.clear(); dlg_cached_ = false; }
    void add(const std::string& name, const std::string& path);
    std::function<bool(const std::string& path, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out)> reader;   // se vazio, le do disco
    bool read(const std::string& path, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out) const;
    std::string find(const std::string& script_name) const;      // caminho do .amx ou ""
    std::size_t size() const { return by_key_.size(); }
    const std::string& dir() const { return dir_; }
    std::vector<std::string> names() const;
    static std::string normalize(const std::string& script_name);

    // v18: scripts que tem a public OnStartDialogue (os de NPC falante, ex. "10 Mormon"). Carrega cada .amx uma vez (cache).
    // O script de COMPORTAMENTO citado pela entidade do mapa (CaptainArmstrong.amx, Template_*...) normalmente NAO tem dialogo: o dialogo mora em outro script.
    struct Named { std::string name, path; };
    const std::vector<Named>& dialogue_scripts() const;
    // Candidatos de dialogo para uma entidade, por nome: palavras do nome do script (>= 4 letras) que aparecem no texto da entidade (prototipo, instancia, nome).
    // Heuristica PROVISORIA (nao sabemos ainda como a engine liga a entidade ao script de dialogo).
    std::vector<Named> match_dialogue(const std::string& entity_text) const;

private:
    mutable std::vector<Named> dlg_cache_;
    mutable bool dlg_cached_ = false;
    std::string dir_;
    std::map<std::string, std::string> by_key_;     // chave normalizada -> caminho
    std::map<std::string, std::string> shown_;      // chave -> nome do arquivo sem extensao
};

struct ScriptInstance {
    std::string name, path;
    std::unique_ptr<f3vb::amx::Program> prog;
    std::unique_ptr<f3vb::amx::Machine> vm;
    std::unique_ptr<f3vb::host::GameHost> host;
    static std::unique_ptr<ScriptInstance> from_bytes(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes, const std::string& name, std::int32_t self_id, std::uint32_t seed, std::string& err);
    static std::unique_ptr<ScriptInstance> from_file(const std::string& path, const std::string& name, std::int32_t self_id, std::uint32_t seed, std::string& err);
};

// text: sem os codigos de cor {cNNN}; color: COLORREF do ultimo {cNNN} (0x00BBGGRR; -1 = nenhum). Ids de texto 1-BASED no .stf (v19).
struct DialogLine { std::string who; std::int32_t text_id = 0; std::string text; std::int32_t color = -1; };
struct DialogChoice { std::int32_t reply_id = 0, text_id = 0; std::string text, action_fn, link_fn; std::int32_t color = -1; };
// Tira os codigos de cor "{c255}" do texto do .stf e devolve a ultima cor (COLORREF) em `color` (-1 se nao ha).
std::string strip_color_codes(const std::string& s, std::int32_t& color);

class DialogSession {
public:
    DialogSession(ScriptInstance& s, const Stf* stf) : s_(s), stf_(stf) {}
    bool start();                                    // false se nao deu para iniciar (ver error())
    bool choose(std::size_t i);                      // i = indice em choices() (so as disponiveis)
    bool finished() const { return finished_; }
    const std::vector<DialogLine>& lines() const { return lines_; }
    const std::vector<DialogChoice>& choices() const { return choices_; }
    std::size_t hidden_choices() const { return hidden_; }     // respostas cuja condicao deu 0
    const std::string& error() const { return error_; }
    std::string node_name() const;
    std::vector<std::string> trace;                  // passos executados (para o log)

private:
    bool call(const std::string& fn, std::int32_t* ret);
    void absorb();
    void refresh();
    ScriptInstance& s_;
    const Stf* stf_;
    std::vector<DialogLine> lines_;
    std::vector<DialogChoice> choices_;
    std::size_t hidden_ = 0;
    bool finished_ = false;
    std::string error_;
};

struct ScriptSurvey {
    std::string name, error;
    bool loaded = false, has_dialogue = false;
    std::size_t publics = 0, natives = 0, ran_ok = 0, ran_fail = 0;
    std::map<std::string, int> unimplemented;        // natives so-log -> chamadas
    std::map<std::string, int> called;               // TODAS as natives chamadas -> chamadas (v18: mostra o que cada script realmente usa)
    std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::string>> samples;   // ate 2 exemplos de argumentos por native sem implementar: "(1, 2, \"texto\")"
    std::vector<std::string> failures;               // "public: erro"
    std::vector<std::string> unresolved;             // natives que o script importa e nao foram registradas (deve ficar vazio)
};
// Roda TODAS as publics (com 8 argumentos zero, limite de instrucoes) como o dialog_dump e resume. Os zeros evitam falsos erros de "acesso invalido":
// quase todas as publics de objetos/criaturas leem parametros (currentGameTime, atacante...).
ScriptSurvey survey_script(ScriptInstance& s);

struct ScriptRef { std::string name; std::size_t entities = 0; std::string path; };   // path vazio = .amx nao encontrado
// Scripts citados pelas entidades do mapa (distintos pelo nome normalizado), em ordem alfabetica.
std::vector<ScriptRef> map_scripts(const MapData& m, const ScriptLibrary& lib);

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
#include "skin.h"

#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <sstream>

#include "gui_int.h"

namespace f3v {

namespace {

const char* kFrag[9] = {"upperleft", "uppermiddle", "upperright", "left", "middle", "right", "lowerleft", "lowermiddle", "lowerright"};

std::string trim(const std::string& s) {
    std::size_t a = 0, b = s.size();
    while (a < b && (s[a] == ' ' || s[a] == '\t' || s[a] == '\r' || s[a] == '\n')) ++a;
    while (b > a && (s[b - 1] == ' ' || s[b - 1] == '\t' || s[b - 1] == '\r' || s[b - 1] == '\n')) --b;
    return s.substr(a, b - a);
}

int clamp255(long v) { return v < 0 ? 0 : (v > 255 ? 255 : static_cast<int>(v)); }

}  // namespace

const char* Skin::fragment_name(int i) { return i >= 0 && i < 9 ? kFrag[i] : "?"; }

bool Skin::parse(const std::string& text) {
    sections_.clear();
    std::istringstream in(text);
    std::string line, cur;
    SkinFragment* frag = nullptr;
    while (std::getline(in, line)) {
        line = trim(line);
        if (line.empty() || line[0] == ';' || line[0] == '#') continue;
        if (line[0] == '[') {
            const std::size_t e = line.find(']');
            cur = lower_ascii(trim(line.substr(1, e == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : e - 1)));
            frag = cur.empty() ? nullptr : &sections_[cur];
            continue;
        }
        if (!frag) continue;
        const std::size_t eq = line.find('=');
        if (eq == std::string::npos) continue;
        const std::string key = lower_ascii(trim(line.substr(0, eq)));
        std::string val = trim(line.substr(eq + 1));
        const std::size_t sc = val.find(';');
        if (sc != std::string::npos) val = trim(val.substr(0, sc));
        if (key == "flags") frag->flags = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::strtoul(val.c_str(), nullptr, 10)) & 3u;
        else if (key == "texture") frag->texture = val;
        else if (key == "width") frag->width = std::atoi(val.c_str());
        else if (key == "height") frag->height = std::atoi(val.c_str());
        else if (key == "rate") frag->rate = static_cast<float>(std::atof(val.c_str()));
        else if (key == "color") {
            long c[3] = {255, 255, 255};
            const char* p = val.c_str();
            for (int i = 0; i < 3 && *p; ++i) {
                char* end = nullptr;
                c[i] = std::strtol(p, &end, 10);
                if (end == p) break;
                p = end;
                while (*p == ',' || *p == ' ' || *p == '\t') ++p;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) frag->rgb[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(clamp255(c[i]));
            frag->has_color = true;
        }
    }
    return !sections_.empty();
}

bool Skin::load_file(const std::string& path, std::string& err) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) { err = "nao consegui abrir " + path; return false; }
    const std::string text((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    if (!parse(text)) { err = "nenhuma secao [objeto.estado.fragmento] em " + path; return false; }
    return true;
}

const SkinFragment* Skin::get(const std::string& object, const std::string& state, int fragment) const {
    if (fragment < 0 || fragment > 8) return nullptr;
    const std::string key = lower_ascii(object) + (state.empty() ? "" : "." + lower_ascii(state)) + "." + kFrag[fragment];
    const auto it = sections_.find(key);
    return it == sections_.end() ? nullptr : &it->second;
}

bool Skin::has_state(const std::string& object, const std::string& state) const { return get(object, state, 4) != nullptr; }

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// Skins da interface (*.ini do pack Interface: zzmainmenu.ini, quickslot.ini, f3_green.ini, areamap.ini...) - v19.
// Formato documentado no proprio AreaMap.ini da demo: secoes [objeto.estado.fragmento] (ou [objeto.fragmento] sem estado) com os campos
//   flags = 0 esticar | 1 repetir em x | 2 repetir em y | 3 repetir nos dois;  texture = arquivo;  color = r, g, b (0-255, padrao branco);
//   width/height = tamanho do recorte (padrao: o da textura; 8 sem textura);  rate = quadros por segundo (0 = parado).
// Os botoes tem 4 estados: up, selected (mouse em cima), down (apertado), disabled. O .int guarda so o estado de repouso; os outros vem daqui.
// Portavel (so C++ padrao).
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <string>

namespace f3v {

struct SkinFragment {
    std::uint32_t flags = 0;
    std::string texture;
    std::uint8_t rgb[3] = {255, 255, 255};
    bool has_color = false;
    int width = -1, height = -1;     // -1 = padrao
    float rate = 0.f;
};

class Skin {
public:
    bool parse(const std::string& text);                 // false se nenhuma secao valida
    bool load_file(const std::string& path, std::string& err);
    // objeto: "window", "button"...; estado: "" (sem estado), "up", "selected", "down", "disabled"; fragmento: 0..8 (ordem do .int).
    const SkinFragment* get(const std::string& object, const std::string& state, int fragment) const;
    bool has_state(const std::string& object, const std::string& state) const;
    std::size_t size() const { return sections_.size(); }

    static const char* fragment_name(int i);            // "upperleft" ... "lowerright"

private:
    std::map<std::string, SkinFragment> sections_;       // chave minuscula "button.up.middle"
};

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/stf.cpp

```cpp
#include "stf.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>

namespace f3v {

static std::uint32_t rd32(const std::uint8_t* p) { return p[0] | (p[1] << 8) | (p[2] << 16) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[3]) << 24); }

bool Stf::load(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, std::string& err) {
    loaded_ = false;
    entries_.clear();
    data_.clear();
    if (size < 12) { err = "arquivo menor que o cabecalho (12 bytes)"; return false; }
    const std::uint32_t count = rd32(data + 8);
    if (count > (size - 12) / 16) { err = std::to_string(count) + " entradas nao cabem no arquivo (" + std::to_string(size) + " bytes)"; return false; }
    data_.assign(data, data + size);
    entries_.reserve(count);
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) entries_.push_back(Entry{rd32(data + 12 + 16 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i)), rd32(data + 12 + 16 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i) + 4)});
    loaded_ = true;
    return true;
}

bool Stf::load_file(const std::string& path, std::string& err) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) { err = "nao consegui abrir " + path; return false; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> b((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    return load(b.data(), b.size(), err);
}

std::string Stf::text(std::uint32_t id) const {
    if (!loaded_ || id >= entries_.size()) return std::string();
    return ascii_only(raw_entry(id));
}

std::string Stf::text_cp1252(std::uint32_t id1) const {
    if (!loaded_ || id1 == 0 || id1 > entries_.size()) return std::string();
    std::string s = raw_entry(id1 - 1);
    for (char& c : s) if (c == '\r' || c == '\t') c = ' ';
    return s;
}

std::string Stf::raw_entry(std::uint32_t id) const {
    if (!loaded_ || id >= entries_.size()) return std::string();
    const Entry& e = entries_[id];
    std::size_t width = 1;
    for (; width <= 2; ++width)                                   // tenta length em bytes; se nao couber, em unidades de 2 bytes
        if (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(e.off) + static_cast<std::uint64_t>(e.len) * width <= data_.size()) break;
    if (width > 2) return std::string();
    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(e.len) * width;
    const std::uint8_t* p = data_.data() + e.off;
    std::string out;
    bool utf16 = false;
    if (n >= 2 && n % 2 == 0) {
        std::size_t zeros = 0;
        for (std::size_t i = 1; i < n; i += 2) zeros += p[i] == 0;
        utf16 = zeros >= n / 2 - 1 && zeros > 0;
    }
    if (utf16) { for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < n; i += 2) { const unsigned c = p[i] | (p[i + 1] << 8); out.push_back(c < 256 ? static_cast<char>(c) : '?'); } }
    else for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) out.push_back(static_cast<char>(p[i]));
    while (!out.empty() && out.back() == '\0') out.pop_back();
    return out;
}

std::string ascii_only(const std::string& s) {
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(s.size());
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        const unsigned char c = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]);
        if (c >= 32 && c < 127) out.push_back(static_cast<char>(c));
        else if (c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t') out.push_back(' ');
        else if ((c == 0xC2 || c == 0xC3) && i + 1 < s.size() && (static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i + 1]) & 0xC0) == 0x80) { ++i; out.push_back('?'); }   // utf-8 de 2 bytes (acentos latinos)
        else if (c >= 0x80) out.push_back('?');
    }
    return out;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// Tabela de strings (.stf) para os dialogos (v17). Portavel: sem Windows nem OpenGL.
//
// Layout (derivado do stf.pat do OpenJE/patterns; VERIFICADO em 2026-10-28 com o English.stf real: 3281 entradas, 254.846 bytes, texto 'Single Player' na entrada 0):
//   u8 magic[8], u32 count, count x { u32 offset, u32 length, u8 constante[8] }
// Hipoteses: id do texto = indice da entrada; o texto esta em `offset` (absoluto) com `length` bytes (ou unidades de 2 bytes se nao couber);
// codificacao UTF-16LE se os bytes alternam com zeros, senao cp1252 (convertida para ASCII simples: o HUD so desenha ASCII).
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

class Stf {
public:
    bool load(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, std::string& err);
    bool load_file(const std::string& path, std::string& err);
    bool loaded() const { return loaded_; }
    std::size_t count() const { return entries_.size(); }
    // "" se o id nao existe (ou o arquivo nao foi carregado). ATENCAO: `id` aqui e o INDICE da entrada (0-based).
    std::string text(std::uint32_t id) const;
    // v19: ids 1-based, como os dos .int (rotulos): id N = entrada N-1; 0 = sem texto. Medido: rotulo de QuitBtn = 16 -> entrada 15 'Quit'.
    // Devolve o texto em cp1252 (acentos preservados para a fonte TrueType), sem trocar por '?'.
    std::string text_cp1252(std::uint32_t id_1based) const;
    bool has(std::uint32_t id) const { return id < entries_.size(); }

private:
    std::string raw_entry(std::uint32_t index) const;     // texto cru (cp1252 / latin-1) da entrada
    struct Entry { std::uint32_t off, len; };
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> data_;
    std::vector<Entry> entries_;
    bool loaded_ = false;
};

// Troca tudo que nao e ASCII imprimivel (acentos etc.) por equivalentes simples ou '?', para o HUD de bitmap.
std::string ascii_only(const std::string& utf8_or_cp1252);

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/tre.cpp

```cpp
// v20: leitor de .8tre em C++ (veja tre.h). Cada funcao corresponde a uma do tools/py/f3vb/tre.py, com o mesmo nome em comentario.
#include "tre.h"

#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <tuple>

namespace f3v {

namespace {

std::uint32_t rd32(const std::uint8_t* p) { return p[0] | (p[1] << 8) | (p[2] << 16) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[3]) << 24); }
std::uint16_t rd16(const std::uint8_t* p) { return static_cast<std::uint16_t>(p[0] | (p[1] << 8)); }
float rdf(const std::uint8_t* p) { float f; std::uint32_t u = rd32(p); std::memcpy(&f, &u, 4); return f; }

bool is_tag(const std::uint8_t* b) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) { const std::uint8_t c = b[i]; if (!((c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '_')) return false; }
    return true;
}

struct Chunk { char tag[5]; std::size_t pos, size; };

// _chunks: chunks consecutivos entre s e e
bool chunks(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t s, std::size_t e, std::vector<Chunk>& out, std::string& err) {
    out.clear();
    std::size_t p = s;
    while (p < e) {
        if (p + 8 > e || !is_tag(d + p)) { err = "chunk invalido em " + std::to_string(p); return false; }
        const std::uint32_t n = rd32(d + p + 4);
        if (p + 8 + static_cast<std::size_t>(n) > e) { err = "chunk em " + std::to_string(p) + " ultrapassa o pai"; return false; }
        Chunk c;
        std::memcpy(c.tag, d + p, 4);
        c.tag[4] = 0;
        c.pos = p + 8;
        c.size = n;
        out.push_back(c);
        p += 8 + static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
    }
    return true;
}

std::string cstr(const std::uint8_t* b, std::size_t n) {
    std::string s;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n && b[i]; ++i) s.push_back(static_cast<char>(b[i]));
    return s;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ gramatica dos lotes (identica ao Python)
struct Lim { std::uint32_t mats, ctx, tga; bool strict = false; };
using U = std::vector<std::uint16_t>;
struct Sub { std::uint32_t k; std::size_t from, count; };

// _sub_batches
bool sub_batches(const U& u, std::size_t q, std::size_t total, const Lim& lim, std::vector<Sub>& out) {
    const std::size_t end = q + total;
    out.clear();
    while (q < end) {
        if (q + 2 > end) return false;
        const std::uint16_t k = u[q], c = u[q + 1];
        if ((k & 0xC000) || (c & 0xC000) || c % 3 || k > lim.tga || q + 2 + c > end) return false;
        if (lim.strict && (c & 1) && (q + 2 + c >= end || u[q + 2 + c] != 0)) return false;
        out.push_back({k, q + 2, c});
        q += 2 + c + (c & 1);
    }
    return q == end;
}

// _page_group: devolve pagina e o B; subs preenchido
bool page_group(const U& u, std::size_t p, const Lim& lim, std::uint32_t& page, std::size_t& b, std::vector<Sub>& subs) {
    if (p + 2 > u.size()) return false;
    const std::uint16_t a = u[p];
    b = u[p + 1];
    if ((a & 0xC000) != 0x4000 || (b & 0xC000) || (a & 0x3FFFu) > lim.ctx || p + 2 + b > u.size()) return false;
    if (!sub_batches(u, p + 2, b, lim, subs)) return false;
    page = a & 0x3FFFu;
    return true;
}

// _mat_hdr: -1 = nao e cabecalho de material
long mat_hdr(const U& u, std::size_t p, const Lim& lim) {
    if (p + 2 > u.size()) return -1;
    const std::uint16_t a = u[p], b = u[p + 1];
    if ((a & 0xC000) != 0x8000 || (b & 0xC000) || (a & 0x3FFFu) >= lim.mats) return -1;
    std::uint32_t pg;
    std::size_t bb;
    std::vector<Sub> subs;
    if (!page_group(u, p + 2, lim, pg, bb, subs)) return -1;
    return a & 0x3FFF;
}

TreBatch make_batch(const U& u, std::uint32_t mat, std::uint32_t page, std::uint32_t k, std::size_t from, std::size_t count) {
    TreBatch b;
    b.material = mat; b.page = page; b.texture = k;
    b.idx.assign(u.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(from), u.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(from + count));
    return b;
}

// _parse_rest: true se fechou; partial (se nao nulo) recebe o que deu para ler mesmo sem fechar
bool parse_rest(const U& u, std::size_t p, const Lim& lim, std::vector<TreBatch>& out, std::vector<TreBatch>* partial = nullptr) {
    const std::size_t n = u.size();
    out.clear();
    std::uint32_t mat = 0, page = 0;
    auto fail = [&]() { if (partial) partial->insert(partial->end(), out.begin(), out.end()); return false; };
    while (n >= p + 3) {
        const long m = mat_hdr(u, p, lim);
        if (m >= 0) { mat = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(m); p += 2; }
        std::uint32_t pg;
        std::size_t b;
        std::vector<Sub> subs;
        if (page_group(u, p, lim, pg, b, subs)) {
            page = pg;
            for (const Sub& s : subs) out.push_back(make_batch(u, mat, page, s.k, s.from, s.count));
            p += 2 + b;
        } else {
            if (p + 2 > n) break;
            const std::uint16_t k = u[p], c = u[p + 1];
            if ((k & 0xC000) || (c & 0xC000) || c % 3 || k > lim.tga || p + 2 + c > n) return fail();
            if (lim.strict && (c & 1) && (p + 2 + c >= n || u[p + 2 + c] != 0)) return fail();
            out.push_back(make_batch(u, mat, page, k, p + 2, c));
            p += 2 + c + (c & 1);
        }
        if (p & 1) {
            if (lim.strict && (p >= n || u[p] != 0)) return fail();
            p += 1;
        }
    }
    if (partial) partial->insert(partial->end(), out.begin(), out.end());
    return n <= p + 1;
}

std::size_t total_idx(const std::vector<TreBatch>& v) { std::size_t s = 0; for (const TreBatch& b : v) s += b.idx.size(); return s; }

// split_full (v19)
bool split_full(const TreNode& nd, Lim lim, std::vector<TreBatch>& out) {
    if (!nd.has_head || (nd.head[0] & 0xC000) != 0x8000) return false;
    U full(nd.head, nd.head + 6);
    full.insert(full.end(), nd.indices.begin(), nd.indices.end());
    for (int strict = 1; strict >= 0; --strict) {
        lim.strict = strict != 0;
        if (!parse_rest(full, 0, lim, out)) continue;
        if (nd.tri_count && total_idx(out) != 3 * nd.tri_count) continue;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// split_batches (v16, reserva)
bool split_batches(const U& u, std::size_t tri_count, Lim lim, std::vector<TreBatch>& out) {
    const std::size_t n = u.size(), want = 3 * tri_count;
    for (int strict = 1; strict >= 0; --strict) {
        lim.strict = strict != 0;
        for (std::size_t q = 0; q <= n; q += 2) {
            long l0 = -1;
            if (q % 3 == 0) l0 = static_cast<long>(q);
            else if (q >= 1 && (q - 1) % 3 == 0 && (q - 1) % 2 == 1) l0 = static_cast<long>(q - 1);
            if (l0 < 0) continue;
            if (lim.strict && static_cast<std::size_t>(l0) != q && u[q - 1] != 0) continue;
            if (q < n && !((u[q] & 0xC000) == 0x4000 || (u[q] & 0xC000) == 0x8000 ||
                           (q + 1 < n && (u[q] & 0xC000) == 0 && u[q] <= lim.tga && u[q + 1] % 3 == 0 && u[q + 1] > 0)))
                continue;
            std::vector<TreBatch> rest;
            if (!parse_rest(u, q, lim, rest)) continue;
            if (tri_count && static_cast<std::size_t>(l0) + total_idx(rest) != want) continue;
            out.clear();
            if (l0) out.push_back(make_batch(u, 0, 0, 0, 0, static_cast<std::size_t>(l0)));
            out.insert(out.end(), rest.begin(), rest.end());
            return true;
        }
    }
    // nao fechou: guarda o lote inicial ate o 1o cabecalho plausivel + o que der
    lim.strict = false;
    std::size_t first = n;
    for (std::size_t q = 0; q < n; q += 2) {
        if ((u[q] & 0xC000) == 0x4000 || (u[q] & 0xC000) == 0x8000) {
            std::uint32_t pg; std::size_t b; std::vector<Sub> subs;
            if (mat_hdr(u, q, lim) >= 0 || page_group(u, q, lim, pg, b, subs)) { first = q; break; }
        }
    }
    first -= first % 3;
    std::vector<TreBatch> partial, tmp;
    parse_rest(u, first + (first & 1), lim, tmp, &partial);
    out.clear();
    if (first) out.push_back(make_batch(u, 0, 0, 0, 0, first));
    out.insert(out.end(), partial.begin(), partial.end());
    return false;
}

// _read_node
bool read_node(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t size, std::size_t p, TreNode& nd, std::size_t& next, std::string& err) {
    if (p + 16 > size) { err = "no cortado em " + std::to_string(p); return false; }
    nd.leaf = std::memcmp(d + p, "LEAF", 4) == 0;
    const std::uint32_t declared = rd32(d + p + 4);
    std::size_t q = p + 8;
    if (std::memcmp(d + q, "INFO", 4) != 0) { err = "no em " + std::to_string(p) + " sem INFO"; return false; }
    const std::uint32_t ni = rd32(d + q + 4);
    if (q + 8 + static_cast<std::size_t>(ni) > size) { err = "INFO cortado"; return false; }
    const std::uint8_t* info = d + q + 8;
    q += 8 + ni;
    if (ni < 32) { err = "INFO de no pequeno em " + std::to_string(p); return false; }
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) nd.bbox[i] = rdf(info + 4 * i);
    nd.block = rd32(info + 24);
    bool have_flg = false;
    if (q + 8 <= size && std::memcmp(d + q, "IDXD", 4) == 0) {
        const std::uint32_t n = rd32(d + q + 4);
        const std::size_t end = q + 8 + n;
        std::size_t r = q + 8;
        if (end > size || r + 8 > size || std::memcmp(d + r, "IDXS", 4) != 0) { err = "IDXD sem IDXS em " + std::to_string(q); return false; }
        const std::uint32_t m = rd32(d + r + 4);
        if (m < 12 || r + 8 + m > end) { err = "IDXS invalido em " + std::to_string(r); return false; }
        const std::uint8_t* body = d + r + 8;
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) nd.head[i] = rd16(body + 2 * i);
        nd.has_head = true;
        const std::size_t cnt = (m - 12) / 2;
        nd.indices.resize(cnt);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) nd.indices[i] = rd16(body + 12 + 2 * i);
        r += 8 + m;
        if (r + 8 <= end && std::memcmp(d + r, "FLGS", 4) == 0) { nd.tri_count = rd32(d + r + 4); have_flg = true; }
        q = end;
    }
    if (!have_flg && q + 8 <= size && std::memcmp(d + q, "FLGS", 4) == 0) nd.tri_count = rd32(d + q + 4);
    next = p + 8 + declared + (nd.leaf ? 4 : 0);
    return true;
}

}  // namespace

bool TreData::bounds(float mn[3], float mx[3]) const {
    bool any = false;
    for (const MapBlock& b : blocks)
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 2 < b.xyz.size(); i += 3)
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) {
                const float v = b.xyz[i + k];
                if (!any || v < mn[k]) mn[k] = v;
                if (!any || v > mx[k]) mx[k] = v;
                if (k == 2) any = true;
            }
    return any;
}

bool read_tre(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t size, TreData& t, std::string& err) {
    t = TreData();
    if (!d || size < 16 || std::memcmp(d, "8TRE", 4) != 0) { err = "nao e um 8TRE"; return false; }
    const std::uint32_t n = rd32(d + 4);
    if (8 + static_cast<std::size_t>(n) > size) { err = "tamanho da raiz ultrapassa o arquivo"; return false; }
    std::vector<Chunk> top, sub;
    if (!chunks(d, 8, 8 + n, top, err)) return false;
    auto find = [&](const char* tag) -> const Chunk* { const Chunk* f = nullptr; for (const Chunk& c : top) if (!std::strcmp(c.tag, tag)) f = &c; return f; };
    const Chunk *ch = find("HEAD"), *cv = find("VTXD"), *ct = find("TREE");
    if (!ch || !cv || !ct) { err = "falta HEAD, VTXD ou TREE"; return false; }
    if (ch->size >= 16) for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) t.head[i] = rd32(d + ch->pos + 4 * i);
    if (const Chunk* c = find("LGTD")) {
        if (chunks(d, c->pos, c->pos + c->size, sub, err))
            for (const Chunk& s : sub) if (!std::strcmp(s.tag, "LGTR") && s.size >= 64) {
                TreLight l;
                l.type = rd32(d + s.pos); l.flags = rd32(d + s.pos + 4);
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) { l.color[k] = rdf(d + s.pos + 8 + 4 * k); l.pos[k] = rdf(d + s.pos + 20 + 4 * k); l.dir[k] = rdf(d + s.pos + 32 + 4 * k); }
                t.lights.push_back(l);
            }
    }
    if (const Chunk* c = find("LVLD")) {
        if (chunks(d, c->pos, c->pos + c->size, sub, err))
            for (const Chunk& s : sub) if (!std::strcmp(s.tag, "INFO") && s.size >= 16) {
                t.has_level = true; t.level_w = rd32(d + s.pos); t.level_h = rd32(d + s.pos + 4); t.level_f[0] = rdf(d + s.pos + 8); t.level_f[1] = rdf(d + s.pos + 12);
                break;
            }
    }
    if (const Chunk* c = find("MATD")) {
        if (chunks(d, c->pos, c->pos + c->size, sub, err))
            for (const Chunk& s : sub) if (!std::strcmp(s.tag, "MATR") && s.size >= 196) {
                const std::uint8_t* b = d + s.pos;
                MapMaterial m;
                m.id = rd32(b);
                m.name = cstr(b + 4, 80);
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) m.rgba[k] = b[84 + k];
                m.blend = cstr(b + 88, 16);
                m.surface = cstr(b + 104, 16);
                m.flags = rd32(b + s.size - 4);
                t.materials.push_back(m);
            }
    }
    if (const Chunk* c = find("TXTD")) {
        if (c->size >= 8 && chunks(d, c->pos + 8, c->pos + c->size, sub, err))
            for (const Chunk& s : sub) if (!std::strcmp(s.tag, "TXTR")) t.textures.push_back(cstr(d + s.pos, s.size));
    }
    // VTXD
    if (cv->size < 4) { err = "VTXD vazio"; return false; }
    const std::uint32_t nb = rd32(d + cv->pos);
    if (!chunks(d, cv->pos + 4, cv->pos + cv->size, sub, err)) return false;
    for (const Chunk& s : sub) {
        if (std::strcmp(s.tag, "VTXB")) continue;
        if (s.size < 4) { err = "VTXB cortado"; return false; }
        const std::uint32_t cnt = rd32(d + s.pos);
        std::size_t pos = s.pos + 4;
        struct St { std::size_t at = 0, len = 0; bool ok = false; } xyz, nrm, dif, uv, lm;
        while (pos + 8 <= s.pos + s.size) {
            const std::uint8_t* tok = d + pos;
            const std::uint32_t ln = rd32(d + pos + 4);
            if (pos + 8 + static_cast<std::size_t>(ln) > s.pos + s.size) { err = "fluxo ultrapassa o VTXB"; return false; }
            St st{pos + 8, ln, true};
            if (!std::memcmp(tok, "XYZ ", 4)) xyz = st;
            else if (!std::memcmp(tok, "NRML", 4)) nrm = st;
            else if (!std::memcmp(tok, "DIFU", 4)) dif = st;
            else if (!std::memcmp(tok, "TXUV", 4)) uv = st;
            else if (!std::memcmp(tok, "LMUV", 4)) lm = st;
            pos += 8 + ln;
        }
        if (!xyz.ok || xyz.len != 12ull * cnt) { err = "VTXB sem XYZ coerente"; return false; }
        MapBlock b;
        b.nv = cnt;
        auto floats = [&](const St& st, int per, std::vector<float>& out) {
            out.assign(static_cast<std::size_t>(per) * cnt, 0.f);         // ausente: zeros (como o build_f3map do Python)
            if (!st.ok || st.len != 4ull * per * cnt) return;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < out.size(); ++i) out[i] = rdf(d + st.at + 4 * i);
        };
        floats(xyz, 3, b.xyz);
        floats(nrm, 3, b.nrm);
        floats(uv, 2, b.uv);
        floats(lm, 2, b.lmuv);
        b.rgba.assign(4ull * cnt, 0xFF);
        if (dif.ok && dif.len == 4ull * cnt) std::memcpy(b.rgba.data(), d + dif.at, 4ull * cnt);
        t.blocks.push_back(std::move(b));
    }
    if (t.blocks.size() != nb) { err = "VTXD declara " + std::to_string(nb) + " blocos, achei " + std::to_string(t.blocks.size()); return false; }
    // TREE (sequencia plana ate o fim do arquivo)
    std::size_t q = ct->pos;
    while (q < size) {
        if (q + 4 > size || (std::memcmp(d + q, "NODE", 4) && std::memcmp(d + q, "LEAF", 4))) { err = "ficha inesperada em " + std::to_string(q); return false; }
        TreNode nd;
        std::size_t next = 0;
        if (!read_node(d, size, q, nd, next, err)) return false;
        if (next <= q) { err = "no sem progresso em " + std::to_string(q); return false; }
        t.nodes.push_back(std::move(nd));
        q = next;
    }
    if (q != size) { err = "arvore termina em " + std::to_string(q) + ", arquivo tem " + std::to_string(size); return false; }
    Lim lim{0, 0, 0, false};
    lim.mats = t.materials.empty() ? 1u : static_cast<std::uint32_t>(t.materials.size());
    for (const std::string& x : t.textures) {
        std::string l = x;
        for (char& c : l) if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'A' + 'a');
        if (l.size() >= 4 && l.compare(l.size() - 4, 4, ".ctx") == 0) ++lim.ctx;
        if (l.size() >= 4 && l.compare(l.size() - 4, 4, ".tga") == 0) ++lim.tga;
    }
    for (TreNode& nd : t.nodes) {
        if (nd.indices.empty()) continue;
        if (split_full(nd, lim, nd.batches)) { nd.parsed = true; nd.full_grammar = true; }
        else nd.parsed = split_batches(nd.indices, nd.tri_count, lim, nd.batches);
    }
    return true;
}

void tre_triangle_lists(const TreData& t, std::vector<MapTriList>& out, TreStats* stats, float eps) {
    TreStats st;
    std::map<std::tuple<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t>, std::vector<std::uint32_t>> per;
    for (const TreNode& nd : t.nodes) {
        if (nd.indices.empty()) continue;
        ++st.nodes;
        if (nd.full_grammar) ++st.nodes_full;
        if (!nd.parsed) ++st.unparsed;
        if (nd.block >= t.blocks.size()) { st.bad += nd.indices.size(); continue; }
        const MapBlock& blk = t.blocks[nd.block];
        const std::uint32_t n = blk.nv;
        const float* bb = nd.bbox;
        for (const TreBatch& ba : nd.batches) {
            std::vector<std::uint32_t>& dst = per[{nd.block, ba.material, ba.page, ba.texture}];
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 2 < ba.idx.size(); i += 3) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
                    const std::uint32_t x = ba.idx[i + static_cast<std::size_t>(j)];
                    long pick = -1;
                    const std::uint32_t cand[4] = {x, x & 0x3FFFu, x & 0x7FFFu, x & 0xBFFFu};
                    for (std::uint32_t c : cand) {
                        if (c < n) {
                            const float px = blk.xyz[3 * c], py = blk.xyz[3 * c + 1], pz = blk.xyz[3 * c + 2];
                            if (bb[0] - eps <= px && px <= bb[3] + eps && bb[1] - eps <= py && py <= bb[4] + eps && bb[2] - eps <= pz && pz <= bb[5] + eps) { pick = c; break; }
                        }
                    }
                    ++st.indices;
                    if (pick < 0) {
                        ++st.outside_bbox;
                        pick = x < n ? x : (x & 0x3FFFu);
                        if (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(pick) >= n) { ++st.bad; pick = 0; }
                    } else if (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(pick) != x) ++st.masked;
                    dst.push_back(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(pick));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    out.clear();
    for (auto& kv : per) {
        if (kv.second.empty()) continue;
        MapTriList tl;
        tl.block = std::get<0>(kv.first); tl.material = std::get<1>(kv.first); tl.page = std::get<2>(kv.first); tl.tex = std::get<3>(kv.first);
        tl.idx = std::move(kv.second);
        out.push_back(std::move(tl));
    }
    if (stats) *stats = st;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/tre.h

```cpp
// v20: leitor de .8tre (geometria estatica do mapa) em C++, porte fiel de tools/py/f3vb/tre.py (spec: docs/specs/tre.md).
// Chunks = tag[4] + u32 tamanho do payload; raiz 8TRE com HEAD, LGTD, LVLD, MATD, TXTD, VTXD, TREE (NODE/LEAF em profundidade).
// IDXS de cada no: os 12 bytes iniciais sao o cabecalho do 1o lote ([0x8000|mat][A][0x4000|pagina][B][k][C], achado do v19) seguidos dos u16;
// o fluxo inteiro e lido pela gramatica de grupos/paginas/sublotes (split_full); se nao fechar, cai no modo antigo (split_batches, v16).
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "f3map.h"

namespace f3v {

struct TreBatch { std::uint32_t material = 0, page = 0, texture = 0; std::vector<std::uint16_t> idx; };

struct TreNode {
    bool leaf = false;
    float bbox[6] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0};       // xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax
    std::uint32_t block = 0;
    std::vector<std::uint16_t> indices;       // u16 depois dos 12 bytes do cabecalho
    std::uint16_t head[6] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0};
    bool has_head = false;
    std::size_t tri_count = 0;                // = tamanho do FLGS (1 byte por triangulo)
    std::vector<TreBatch> batches;
    bool parsed = true, full_grammar = false;
};

struct TreLight { std::uint32_t type = 0, flags = 0; float color[3] = {0, 0, 0}, pos[3] = {0, 0, 0}, dir[3] = {0, 0, 0}; };

struct TreData {
    std::uint32_t head[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    std::vector<TreLight> lights;
    bool has_level = false;
    std::uint32_t level_w = 0, level_h = 0;
    float level_f[2] = {0, 0};                // o 1o e o lado da celula da grade (0,5)
    std::vector<MapMaterial> materials;
    std::vector<std::string> textures;        // ".tga" = difusas, ".ctx" = paginas de lightmap (ordem do arquivo)
    std::vector<MapBlock> blocks;
    std::vector<TreNode> nodes;
    bool bounds(float mn[3], float mx[3]) const;
};

struct TreStats { std::size_t nodes = 0, nodes_full = 0, unparsed = 0, indices = 0, outside_bbox = 0, masked = 0, bad = 0; };

bool read_tre(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, TreData& out, std::string& err);
// triangulos agrupados por (bloco, material, pagina, textura) em ordem crescente da chave, como o build_f3map do Python
void tre_triangle_lists(const TreData& t, std::vector<MapTriList>& out, TreStats* stats = nullptr, float eps = 0.6f);

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/ttf.cpp

```cpp
#include "ttf.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>

namespace f3v {

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ leitura das tabelas
std::uint16_t TrueTypeFont::u16(std::size_t o) const { return o + 2 <= d_.size() ? static_cast<std::uint16_t>((d_[o] << 8) | d_[o + 1]) : 0; }
std::uint32_t TrueTypeFont::u32(std::size_t o) const {
    return o + 4 <= d_.size() ? (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(d_[o]) << 24) | (d_[o + 1] << 16) | (d_[o + 2] << 8) | d_[o + 3] : 0;
}

bool TrueTypeFont::load_file(const std::string& path, std::string& err) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) { err = "nao consegui abrir " + path; return false; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> b((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    return load(b.data(), b.size(), err);
}

bool TrueTypeFont::load(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, std::string& err) {
    ok_ = false;
    d_.assign(data, data + size);
    if (size < 12) { err = "arquivo pequeno demais para TrueType"; return false; }
    const std::uint32_t ver = u32(0);
    if (ver != 0x00010000u && ver != 0x74727565u /* 'true' */) { err = "nao e TrueType (versao " + std::to_string(ver) + "; OpenType/CFF nao suportado)"; return false; }
    const int ntab = u16(4);
    std::size_t head = 0, hhea = 0, maxp = 0, cmap = 0, name = 0, name_len = 0;
    std::size_t glyf_len = 0, loca_len = 0, hmtx_len = 0, cmap_len = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntab; ++i) {
        const std::size_t e = 12 + 16 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i);
        if (e + 16 > size) { err = "diretorio de tabelas truncado"; return false; }
        const std::uint32_t off = u32(e + 8), len = u32(e + 12);
        if (off > size || len > size - off) { err = "tabela fora do arquivo"; return false; }
        const char* t = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&d_[e]);
        if (!std::memcmp(t, "head", 4)) head = off;
        else if (!std::memcmp(t, "hhea", 4)) hhea = off;
        else if (!std::memcmp(t, "maxp", 4)) maxp = off;
        else if (!std::memcmp(t, "cmap", 4)) { cmap = off; cmap_len = len; }
        else if (!std::memcmp(t, "glyf", 4)) { glyf_ = off; glyf_len = len; }
        else if (!std::memcmp(t, "loca", 4)) { loca_ = off; loca_len = len; }
        else if (!std::memcmp(t, "hmtx", 4)) { hmtx_ = off; hmtx_len = len; }
        else if (!std::memcmp(t, "kern", 4)) { kern_ = off; kern_len_ = len; }
        else if (!std::memcmp(t, "name", 4)) { name = off; name_len = len; }
    }
    if (!head || !hhea || !maxp || !cmap || !glyf_ || !loca_ || !hmtx_) { err = "faltam tabelas obrigatorias (head/hhea/maxp/cmap/glyf/loca/hmtx)"; return false; }
    glyf_len_ = glyf_len;
    upem_ = u16(head + 18);
    loca_long_ = s16(head + 50);
    ascent_ = s16(hhea + 4); descent_ = s16(hhea + 6); line_gap_ = s16(hhea + 8);
    nhmetrics_ = u16(hhea + 34);
    nglyphs_ = u16(maxp + 4);
    if (upem_ < 16 || upem_ > 16384 || nglyphs_ == 0 || nhmetrics_ == 0) { err = "cabecalho da fonte invalido"; return false; }
    if (loca_len < static_cast<std::size_t>(nglyphs_ + 1) * (loca_long_ ? 4u : 2u)) { err = "loca menor que o numero de glifos"; return false; }
    if (hmtx_len < static_cast<std::size_t>(nhmetrics_) * 4u) { err = "hmtx menor que numberOfHMetrics"; return false; }
    // cmap: prefere Unicode (3,1) ou (0,x) formato 4; depois simbolo (3,0); depois Mac (1,0) formato 6/0
    const int nsub = u16(cmap + 2);
    int best = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < nsub; ++i) {
        const std::size_t r = cmap + 4 + 8 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i);
        if (r + 8 > cmap + cmap_len) break;
        const int pid = u16(r), eid = u16(r + 2);
        const std::uint32_t off = u32(r + 4);
        if (off >= cmap_len) continue;
        const int fmt = u16(cmap + off);
        int score = -1;
        if (fmt == 4 && ((pid == 3 && eid == 1) || pid == 0)) score = 4;
        else if (fmt == 4 && pid == 3 && eid == 0) score = 3;
        else if ((fmt == 6 || fmt == 0) && pid == 1) score = 2;
        else if (fmt == 4 || fmt == 6 || fmt == 0) score = 1;
        if (score > best) { best = score; cmap_sub_ = cmap + off; cmap_fmt_ = fmt; symbol_ = pid == 3 && eid == 0; }
    }
    if (best < 0) { err = "cmap sem subtabela suportada (formatos 4, 6 ou 0)"; return false; }
    // nomes (id 1 familia, id 4 nome completo)
    if (name && name_len >= 6) {
        const int cnt = u16(name + 2), so = u16(name + 4);
        for (int i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) {
            const std::size_t r = name + 6 + 12 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i);
            if (r + 12 > name + name_len) break;
            const int pid = u16(r), nid = u16(r + 6), len = u16(r + 8), off = u16(r + 10);
            if (nid != 1 && nid != 4) continue;
            const std::size_t p = name + so + off;
            if (p + len > d_.size()) continue;
            std::string s;
            if (pid == 3 || pid == 0) { for (int k = 0; k + 1 < len; k += 2) { const unsigned c = (d_[p + k] << 8) | d_[p + k + 1]; s.push_back(c < 128 ? static_cast<char>(c) : '?'); } }
            else s.assign(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&d_[p]), len);
            std::string& dst = nid == 1 ? family_ : full_;
            if (dst.empty() || pid == 3) dst = s;
        }
    }
    ok_ = true;
    return true;
}

int TrueTypeFont::glyph_index(std::uint32_t c) const {
    if (!ok_) return 0;
    const std::size_t t = cmap_sub_;
    if (cmap_fmt_ == 0) return c < 256 ? d_.size() > t + 6 + c ? d_[t + 6 + c] : 0 : 0;
    if (cmap_fmt_ == 6) {
        const std::uint32_t first = u16(t + 6), count = u16(t + 8);
        return c >= first && c < first + count ? u16(t + 10 + 2 * (c - first)) : 0;
    }
    if (cmap_fmt_ != 4) return 0;
    auto look = [&](std::uint32_t cp) -> int {
        if (cp > 0xFFFF) return 0;
        const int seg = u16(t + 6) / 2;
        const std::size_t ends = t + 14, starts = ends + 2 * seg + 2, deltas = starts + 2 * seg, ranges = deltas + 2 * seg;
        for (int i = 0; i < seg; ++i) {
            const std::uint32_t end = u16(ends + 2 * i);
            if (end < cp) continue;
            const std::uint32_t start = u16(starts + 2 * i);
            if (start > cp) return 0;
            const std::uint16_t delta = u16(deltas + 2 * i), ro = u16(ranges + 2 * i);
            if (ro == 0) return (cp + delta) & 0xFFFF;
            const std::size_t addr = ranges + 2 * i + ro + 2 * (cp - start);
            const std::uint16_t g = u16(addr);
            return g ? (g + delta) & 0xFFFF : 0;
        }
        return 0;
    };
    int g = look(c);
    if (!g && symbol_) g = look(0xF000 | (c & 0xFF));
    return g < nglyphs_ ? g : 0;
}

int TrueTypeFont::advance(int g) const {
    if (!ok_ || g < 0) return 0;
    const int i = g < nhmetrics_ ? g : nhmetrics_ - 1;
    return u16(hmtx_ + 4 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i));
}

int TrueTypeFont::left_bearing(int g) const {
    if (!ok_ || g < 0) return 0;
    if (g < nhmetrics_) return s16(hmtx_ + 4 * static_cast<std::size_t>(g) + 2);
    return s16(hmtx_ + 4 * static_cast<std::size_t>(nhmetrics_) + 2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(g - nhmetrics_));
}

int TrueTypeFont::kerning(int a, int b) const {
    if (!ok_ || !kern_ || kern_len_ < 4) return 0;
    const int ntab = u16(kern_ + 2);
    std::size_t p = kern_ + 4;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntab && p + 6 <= kern_ + kern_len_; ++i) {
        const int len = u16(p + 2), cov = u16(p + 4);
        if ((cov >> 8) == 0 && (cov & 1)) {
            const int n = u16(p + 6);
            int lo = 0, hi = n - 1;
            const std::uint32_t key = (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(a) << 16) | static_cast<std::uint32_t>(b);
            while (lo <= hi) {
                const int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
                const std::size_t e = p + 14 + 6 * static_cast<std::size_t>(mid);
                const std::uint32_t k = u32(e);
                if (k == key) return s16(e + 4);
                if (k < key) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        if (len <= 0) break;
        p += static_cast<std::size_t>(len);
    }
    return 0;
}

bool TrueTypeFont::glyph_range(int g, std::size_t& off, std::size_t& len) const {
    if (g < 0 || g >= nglyphs_) return false;
    std::size_t a, b;
    if (loca_long_) { a = u32(loca_ + 4 * static_cast<std::size_t>(g)); b = u32(loca_ + 4 * static_cast<std::size_t>(g) + 4); }
    else { a = 2u * u16(loca_ + 2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(g)); b = 2u * u16(loca_ + 2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(g) + 2); }
    if (b < a || b > glyf_len_) return false;
    off = glyf_ + a; len = b - a;
    return true;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ contornos
namespace {

void flatten_quad(std::vector<TrueTypeFont::Point>& out, TrueTypeFont::Point p0, TrueTypeFont::Point c, TrueTypeFont::Point p1, float tol) {
    const float dx = p0.x - 2 * c.x + p1.x, dy = p0.y - 2 * c.y + p1.y;
    const float dd = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    int n = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(std::sqrt(dd / (8.f * std::max(tol, 1e-3f)))));
    n = std::clamp(n, 1, 64);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        const float t = static_cast<float>(i) / n, u = 1 - t;
        out.push_back({u * u * p0.x + 2 * u * t * c.x + t * t * p1.x, u * u * p0.y + 2 * u * t * c.y + t * t * p1.y});
    }
}

}  // namespace

bool TrueTypeFont::parse_glyph(int g, std::vector<std::vector<Point>>& out, float tol, int depth, const float m[6]) const {
    if (depth > 8) return false;
    std::size_t off, len;
    if (!glyph_range(g, off, len)) return false;
    if (len == 0) return true;                                     // glifo vazio (espaco)
    if (len < 10) return false;
    const std::size_t end = off + len;
    const int nc = s16(off);
    auto tx = [&](float x, float y) { return Point{m[0] * x + m[2] * y + m[4], m[1] * x + m[3] * y + m[5]}; };
    if (nc >= 0) {
        if (off + 10 + 2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(nc) + 2 > end) return false;
        std::vector<int> ends(static_cast<std::size_t>(nc));
        for (int i = 0; i < nc; ++i) ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] = u16(off + 10 + 2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i));
        const int npts = nc ? ends.back() + 1 : 0;
        if (npts > 20000) return false;
        std::size_t p = off + 10 + 2 * static_cast<std::size_t>(nc);
        p += 2 + u16(p);                                           // instrucoes (ignoradas)
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> fl(static_cast<std::size_t>(npts));
        for (int i = 0; i < npts;) {
            if (p >= end) return false;
            const std::uint8_t f = d_[p++];
            fl[static_cast<std::size_t>(i++)] = f;
            if (f & 8) {
                if (p >= end) return false;
                int rep = d_[p++];
                while (rep-- > 0 && i < npts) fl[static_cast<std::size_t>(i++)] = f;
            }
        }
        std::vector<float> xs(static_cast<std::size_t>(npts)), ys(static_cast<std::size_t>(npts));
        int v = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < npts; ++i) {
            const std::uint8_t f = fl[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
            if (f & 2) { if (p >= end) return false; v += (f & 16) ? d_[p] : -static_cast<int>(d_[p]); ++p; }
            else if (!(f & 16)) { if (p + 2 > end) return false; v += s16(p); p += 2; }
            xs[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] = static_cast<float>(v);
        }
        v = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < npts; ++i) {
            const std::uint8_t f = fl[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
            if (f & 4) { if (p >= end) return false; v += (f & 32) ? d_[p] : -static_cast<int>(d_[p]); ++p; }
            else if (!(f & 32)) { if (p + 2 > end) return false; v += s16(p); p += 2; }
            ys[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] = static_cast<float>(v);
        }
        int s = 0;
        for (int ci = 0; ci < nc; ++ci) {
            const int e = ends[static_cast<std::size_t>(ci)];
            if (e < s || e >= npts) return false;
            const int n = e - s + 1;
            auto P = [&](int k) { const int i = s + ((k % n) + n) % n; return tx(xs[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)], ys[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)]); };
            auto on = [&](int k) { const int i = s + ((k % n) + n) % n; return (fl[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] & 1) != 0; };
            std::vector<Point> poly;
            if (n >= 2) {
                int first = -1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) if (on(k)) { first = k; break; }
                Point start, cur, ctrl{};
                bool have_ctrl = false;
                if (first < 0) {                                       // so pontos fora da curva: comeca no meio de P0 e P1
                    const Point a = P(0), b = P(1);
                    start = {(a.x + b.x) / 2, (a.y + b.y) / 2};
                    first = 0;
                } else start = P(first);
                poly.push_back(start);
                cur = start;
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {                         // k == n volta ao primeiro ponto (P(first))
                    const int idx = first + k;
                    const Point q = P(idx);
                    if (on(idx)) {
                        if (have_ctrl) flatten_quad(poly, cur, ctrl, q, tol); else poly.push_back(q);
                        cur = q; have_ctrl = false;
                    } else {
                        if (have_ctrl) { const Point mid{(ctrl.x + q.x) / 2, (ctrl.y + q.y) / 2}; flatten_quad(poly, cur, ctrl, mid, tol); cur = mid; }
                        ctrl = q; have_ctrl = true;
                    }
                }
                if (have_ctrl) flatten_quad(poly, cur, ctrl, start, tol);   // fecha no ponto inicial (caso "so fora da curva")
            }
            if (poly.size() >= 3) out.push_back(std::move(poly));
            s = e + 1;
        }
        return true;
    }
    // glifo composto
    std::size_t p = off + 10;
    for (int guard = 0; guard < 64; ++guard) {
        if (p + 4 > end) return false;
        const int flags = u16(p), gi = u16(p + 2);
        p += 4;
        float dx = 0, dy = 0;
        if (flags & 1) { if (p + 4 > end) return false; dx = s16(p); dy = s16(p + 2); p += 4; }
        else { if (p + 2 > end) return false; dx = static_cast<float>(static_cast<std::int8_t>(d_[p])); dy = static_cast<float>(static_cast<std::int8_t>(d_[p + 1])); p += 2; }
        if (!(flags & 2)) dx = dy = 0;                              // casamento por pontos: nao suportado (raro), fica sem deslocamento
        float a = 1, b = 0, c = 0, dd = 1;
        auto f2 = [&](std::size_t o) { return static_cast<float>(s16(o)) / 16384.f; };
        if (flags & 8) { if (p + 2 > end) return false; a = dd = f2(p); p += 2; }
        else if (flags & 0x40) { if (p + 4 > end) return false; a = f2(p); dd = f2(p + 2); p += 4; }
        else if (flags & 0x80) { if (p + 8 > end) return false; a = f2(p); b = f2(p + 2); c = f2(p + 4); dd = f2(p + 6); p += 8; }
        // m_filho = m_pai * local    (local: x' = a x + c y + dx; y' = b x + dd y + dy)
        const float mm[6] = {m[0] * a + m[2] * b, m[1] * a + m[3] * b, m[0] * c + m[2] * dd, m[1] * c + m[3] * dd, m[0] * dx + m[2] * dy + m[4], m[1] * dx + m[3] * dy + m[5]};
        if (!parse_glyph(gi, out, tol, depth + 1, mm)) return false;
        if (!(flags & 0x20)) break;
    }
    return true;
}

bool TrueTypeFont::outline(int g, std::vector<std::vector<Point>>& contours, float tolerance) const {
    contours.clear();
    if (!ok_) return false;
    const float id[6] = {1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0};
    return parse_glyph(g, contours, tolerance, 0, id);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ rasterizacao
bool TrueTypeFont::rasterize(int g, float scale, Bitmap& out) const {
    out = Bitmap();
    if (!ok_ || scale <= 0) return false;
    std::vector<std::vector<Point>> cs;
    if (!outline(g, cs, 0.25f / scale)) return false;              // erro de achatamento <= 1/4 de pixel
    if (cs.empty()) return true;
    float mnx = 1e30f, mny = 1e30f, mxx = -1e30f, mxy = -1e30f;
    for (auto& c : cs) for (auto& p : c) {
        p.x *= scale; p.y *= -scale;                                // pixels, y para baixo
        mnx = std::min(mnx, p.x); mxx = std::max(mxx, p.x); mny = std::min(mny, p.y); mxy = std::max(mxy, p.y);
    }
    const int x0 = static_cast<int>(std::floor(mnx)), y0 = static_cast<int>(std::floor(mny));
    const int w = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(mxx)) - x0 + 1, h = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(mxy)) - y0 + 1;
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0 || w > 2048 || h > 2048) return false;
    struct Edge { float x0, y0, x1, y1; int dir; };
    std::vector<Edge> edges;
    for (const auto& c : cs)
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < c.size(); ++i) {
            Point a = c[i], b = c[(i + 1) % c.size()];
            if (a.y == b.y) continue;
            int dir = 1;
            if (a.y > b.y) { std::swap(a, b); dir = -1; }
            edges.push_back({a.x - x0, a.y - y0, b.x - x0, b.y - y0, dir});
        }
    out.w = w; out.h = h; out.x0 = x0; out.y0 = y0;
    out.alpha.assign(static_cast<std::size_t>(w) * h, 0);
    constexpr int S = 5;
    std::vector<float> acc(static_cast<std::size_t>(w) + 2);
    std::vector<std::pair<float, int>> xs;
    auto add_span = [&](float a, float b, float wt) {
        a = std::max(a, 0.f); b = std::min(b, static_cast<float>(w));
        if (b <= a) return;
        const int ia = static_cast<int>(a), ib = static_cast<int>(b);
        if (ia == ib) { acc[static_cast<std::size_t>(ia)] += (b - a) * wt; return; }
        acc[static_cast<std::size_t>(ia)] += (static_cast<float>(ia + 1) - a) * wt;
        for (int i = ia + 1; i < ib; ++i) acc[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] += wt;
        if (ib < w) acc[static_cast<std::size_t>(ib)] += (b - static_cast<float>(ib)) * wt;
    };
    for (int row = 0; row < h; ++row) {
        std::fill(acc.begin(), acc.end(), 0.f);
        for (int s = 0; s < S; ++s) {
            const float y = static_cast<float>(row) + (static_cast<float>(s) + 0.5f) / S;
            xs.clear();
            for (const Edge& e : edges)
                if (y >= e.y0 && y < e.y1) xs.push_back({e.x0 + (y - e.y0) * (e.x1 - e.x0) / (e.y1 - e.y0), e.dir});
            if (xs.size() < 2) continue;
            std::sort(xs.begin(), xs.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.first < b.first; });
            int wind = 0;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 1 < xs.size(); ++i) {
                wind += xs[i].second;
                if (wind != 0) add_span(xs[i].first, xs[i + 1].first, 1.f / S);
            }
        }
        for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
            const float v = std::min(1.f, acc[static_cast<std::size_t>(x)]);
            out.alpha[static_cast<std::size_t>(row) * w + x] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v * 255.f + 0.5f);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ atlas
std::uint32_t cp1252_to_unicode(std::uint8_t c) {
    static const std::uint16_t hi[32] = {0x20AC, 0, 0x201A, 0x0192, 0x201E, 0x2026, 0x2020, 0x2021, 0x02C6, 0x2030, 0x0160, 0x2039, 0x0152, 0, 0x017D, 0,
                                         0, 0x2018, 0x2019, 0x201C, 0x201D, 0x2022, 0x2013, 0x2014, 0x02DC, 0x2122, 0x0161, 0x203A, 0x0153, 0, 0x017E, 0x0178};
    return (c >= 0x80 && c < 0xA0) ? hi[c - 0x80] : c;
}

float FontAtlas::measure(const std::string& s) const {
    float x = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        const std::uint8_t c = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(s[i]);
        x += glyph[c].advance;
        if (i + 1 < s.size()) {
            const auto it = kern.find((static_cast<std::uint32_t>(c) << 8) | static_cast<std::uint8_t>(s[i + 1]));
            if (it != kern.end()) x += it->second;
        }
    }
    return x;
}

bool bake_atlas(const TrueTypeFont& font, float em, FontAtlas& out) {
    out = FontAtlas();
    if (!font.ok() || em < 2 || em > 256) return false;
    const float sc = font.scale_for_em(em);
    out.em = em;
    out.ascent = font.ascent() * sc;
    out.descent = font.descent() * sc;
    out.line = (font.ascent() - font.descent() + font.line_gap()) * sc;
    std::vector<TrueTypeFont::Bitmap> bm(256);
    int gidx[256] = {0};
    int total_area = 0;
    for (int c = 32; c < 256; ++c) {
        const std::uint32_t u = cp1252_to_unicode(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(c));
        if (!u) continue;
        const int g = font.glyph_index(u);
        if (!g && c != 32) continue;
        gidx[c] = g;
        out.glyph[c].advance = font.advance(g) * sc;
        out.glyph[c].present = true;
        font.rasterize(g, sc, bm[static_cast<std::size_t>(c)]);
        total_area += (bm[static_cast<std::size_t>(c)].w + 2) * (bm[static_cast<std::size_t>(c)].h + 2);
    }
    if (!out.glyph[static_cast<int>(' ')].present) { out.glyph[static_cast<int>(' ')].present = true; out.glyph[static_cast<int>(' ')].advance = em * 0.3f; }
    int W = 128;
    while (W < 2048 && W * W < total_area * 2) W *= 2;
    int x = 1, y = 1, rowh = 0;
    for (int c = 32; c < 256; ++c) {
        const auto& b = bm[static_cast<std::size_t>(c)];
        if (b.w == 0) continue;
        if (x + b.w + 1 > W) { x = 1; y += rowh + 1; rowh = 0; }
        GlyphInfo& gi = out.glyph[c];
        gi.x = x; gi.y = y; gi.w = b.w; gi.h = b.h; gi.ox = b.x0; gi.oy = b.y0;
        x += b.w + 1;
        rowh = std::max(rowh, b.h);
    }
    int H = 16;
    while (H < y + rowh + 1) H *= 2;
    if (H > 4096) return false;
    out.w = W; out.h = H;
    out.alpha.assign(static_cast<std::size_t>(W) * H, 0);
    for (int c = 32; c < 256; ++c) {
        const auto& b = bm[static_cast<std::size_t>(c)];
        const GlyphInfo& gi = out.glyph[c];
        for (int r = 0; r < b.h; ++r)
            std::memcpy(&out.alpha[static_cast<std::size_t>(gi.y + r) * W + gi.x], &b.alpha[static_cast<std::size_t>(r) * b.w], static_cast<std::size_t>(b.w));
    }
    // kerning so entre caracteres presentes (a tabela kern so existe no Gothic 821)
    for (int a = 32; a < 256; ++a) {
        if (!out.glyph[a].present || !gidx[a]) continue;
        for (int b = 32; b < 256; ++b) {
            if (!out.glyph[b].present || !gidx[b]) continue;
            const int k = font.kerning(gidx[a], gidx[b]);
            if (k) out.kern[(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(a) << 8) | static_cast<std::uint32_t>(b)] = k * sc;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
// Leitor e rasterizador de fontes TrueType PROPRIO (v19), sem bibliotecas externas. Portavel (so C++ padrao).
// Le: cabecalho de tabelas, head, hhea, maxp, hmtx, loca, glyf (glifos simples e compostos), cmap (formatos 4, 6 e 0), kern (formato 0) e name.
// Rasteriza: curvas quadraticas -> segmentos; regra de preenchimento "nao zero"; cobertura analitica na horizontal e 5 sub-linhas na vertical.
// Uso no jogo: as fontes da demo (Fonts/r_fallouty.ttf "Fallouty", Fonts/TT0807M_.TTF "Gothic 821 Condensed BT", Fonts/JH_FALLOUT.TTF "JH_Fallout").
// Hinting (instrucoes TrueType) e ignorado: em tamanhos de interface o resultado e o de um rasterizador sem hinting (levemente mais suave).
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

class TrueTypeFont {
public:
    bool load(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size, std::string& err);   // copia os bytes
    bool load_file(const std::string& path, std::string& err);
    bool ok() const { return ok_; }

    std::string family() const { return family_; }       // nome id 1 (ex.: "Fallouty")
    std::string full_name() const { return full_; }      // nome id 4 (ex.: "Gothic 821 Condensed BT")
    int units_per_em() const { return upem_; }
    int ascent() const { return ascent_; }                 // em unidades da fonte (hhea)
    int descent() const { return descent_; }               // negativo
    int line_gap() const { return line_gap_; }
    int glyph_count() const { return nglyphs_; }

    int glyph_index(std::uint32_t codepoint) const;        // 0 = glifo "faltando"
    int advance(int glyph) const;                          // em unidades da fonte
    int left_bearing(int glyph) const;
    int kerning(int left_glyph, int right_glyph) const;    // em unidades da fonte (0 se nao ha tabela kern)

    struct Point { float x, y; };
    // Contornos do glifo ja achatados em poligonos (unidades da fonte, y para CIMA). tolerance = erro maximo do achatamento, em unidades.
    bool outline(int glyph, std::vector<std::vector<Point>>& contours, float tolerance) const;

    struct Bitmap { int w = 0, h = 0, x0 = 0, y0 = 0; std::vector<std::uint8_t> alpha; };   // x0/y0: canto superior esquerdo em relacao a origem (y para BAIXO)
    // Rasteriza com escala = pixels por unidade da fonte. Glifos vazios (espaco) devolvem w = h = 0.
    bool rasterize(int glyph, float scale, Bitmap& out) const;
    float scale_for_em(float em_pixels) const { return upem_ > 0 ? em_pixels / static_cast<float>(upem_) : 0.f; }

private:
    bool parse_glyph(int glyph, std::vector<std::vector<Point>>& out, float tol, int depth, const float m[6]) const;
    bool glyph_range(int glyph, std::size_t& off, std::size_t& len) const;
    std::uint16_t u16(std::size_t o) const;
    std::int16_t s16(std::size_t o) const { return static_cast<std::int16_t>(u16(o)); }
    std::uint32_t u32(std::size_t o) const;

    std::vector<std::uint8_t> d_;
    bool ok_ = false;
    std::size_t glyf_ = 0, glyf_len_ = 0, loca_ = 0, hmtx_ = 0, cmap_sub_ = 0, kern_ = 0, kern_len_ = 0;
    int cmap_fmt_ = -1, loca_long_ = 0, nhmetrics_ = 0, nglyphs_ = 0, upem_ = 0, ascent_ = 0, descent_ = 0, line_gap_ = 0;
    bool symbol_ = false;
    std::string family_, full_;
};

// Atlas de glifos (cp1252: 32..255) de uma fonte num tamanho em pixels, pronto para subir como textura de alfa.
struct GlyphInfo { int x = 0, y = 0, w = 0, h = 0, ox = 0, oy = 0; float advance = 0; bool present = false; };
struct FontAtlas {
    int w = 0, h = 0;                         // tamanho da textura (potencia de 2)
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> alpha;          // w*h, linha de cima primeiro
    float em = 0, ascent = 0, descent = 0, line = 0;   // em pixels
    GlyphInfo glyph[256];                     // indice = byte cp1252
    std::map<std::uint32_t, float> kern;      // (a << 8 | b) -> ajuste em pixels
    float measure(const std::string& cp1252) const;   // largura em pixels
};
bool bake_atlas(const TrueTypeFont& font, float em_pixels, FontAtlas& out);
std::uint32_t cp1252_to_unicode(std::uint8_t c);

}  // namespace f3v
```

```cpp
#include "ui_assets.h"

#include <cmath>
#include <filesystem>
#include <system_error>

#include "image.h"
#include "vfs.h"

namespace f3v {

std::vector<std::string> list_dir(const std::string& dir) {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    std::error_code ec;
    if (dir.empty() || !std::filesystem::is_directory(std::filesystem::path(dir), ec)) return out;
    for (const auto& e : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(std::filesystem::path(dir), ec)) {
        if (ec) break;
        std::error_code ec2;
        if (e.is_regular_file(ec2)) out.push_back(e.path().filename().string());
    }
    return out;
}

std::string join_path(const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
    if (a.empty()) return b;
    const char last = a.back();
#ifdef _WIN32
    return (last == '\\' || last == '/') ? a + b : a + "\\" + b;
#else
    return (last == '\\' || last == '/') ? a + b : a + "/" + b;
#endif
}

void UiAssets::add_image_dir(const std::string& dir) {
    for (const std::string& n : list_dir(dir)) {
        std::string key = lower_ascii(n);
        // CONVERTED\ui guarda "<nome original>.f3tex": registra pelo nome original tambem (sem o .f3tex)
        if (key.size() > 6 && key.compare(key.size() - 6, 6, ".f3tex") == 0) key = key.substr(0, key.size() - 6);
        if (!files_.count(key)) files_[key] = join_path(dir, n);
    }
}

void UiAssets::add_skin_dir(const std::string& dir) {
    for (const std::string& n : list_dir(dir)) {
        const std::string key = lower_ascii(n);
        if (key.size() > 4 && key.compare(key.size() - 4, 4, ".ini") == 0 && !skin_files_.count(key)) skin_files_[key] = join_path(dir, n);
    }
}

std::size_t UiAssets::add_font_dir(const std::string& dir) {
    std::size_t n = 0;
    for (const std::string& f : list_dir(dir)) {
        const std::string low = lower_ascii(f);
        if (low.size() < 4 || (low.compare(low.size() - 4, 4, ".ttf") != 0)) continue;
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> data;
        std::string err;
        if (!read_whole_file(join_path(dir, f), data)) { problems_.push_back("fonte " + f + ": nao abriu"); continue; }
        if (!add_font_memory(data, join_path(dir, f), err)) { problems_.push_back("fonte " + f + ": " + err); continue; }
        ++n;
    }
    return n;
}

bool UiAssets::load_stf(const std::string& path, std::string& err) {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> data;
    if (!read_whole_file(path, data)) { err = "nao consegui abrir " + path; return false; }
    return stf_.load(data.data(), data.size(), err);
}

bool UiAssets::add_font_memory(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& data, const std::string& label, std::string& err, bool system) {
    FontEntry e;
    e.path = label;
    e.system = system;
    e.font = std::make_unique<TrueTypeFont>();
    if (!e.font->load(data.data(), data.size(), err)) return false;
    e.family = lower_ascii(e.font->family());
    e.full = lower_ascii(e.font->full_name());
    for (const auto& o : fonts_) if (o.full == e.full && o.system == e.system) return true;      // a mesma fonte em duas pastas: fica a primeira
    fonts_.push_back(std::move(e));
    return true;
}

bool UiAssets::has_image(const std::string& name) const {
    const std::string key = lower_ascii(name);
    if (files_.count(key)) return true;
    if (mismatched_.count(key)) return false;
    return vfs_ && vfs_->find(name, RT_TGA) != nullptr;
}

const Image* UiAssets::image(const std::string& name) {
    const std::string key = lower_ascii(name);
    const auto it = images_.find(key);
    if (it != images_.end()) return it->second.get();
    std::unique_ptr<Image> img;
    const auto f = files_.find(key);
    if (f != files_.end()) {
        auto tmp = std::make_unique<Image>();
        std::string err;
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> data;
        if (read_whole_file(f->second, data) && decode_image(data.data(), data.size(), *tmp, err)) img = std::move(tmp);
        else if (load_image_file(f->second, *tmp, err)) img = std::move(tmp);          // .f3tex (CONVERTED/ui) e outros
        else problems_.push_back("imagem " + name + ": " + err);
    } else if (vfs_) {
        // v20: direto da demo. So TGA_Image (os .int citam .bmp/.tga que nao existem: esses NAO sao desenhados, como no original)
        if (const ResEntry* e = vfs_->find(name, RT_TGA)) {
            std::vector<std::uint8_t> data;
            std::string err;
            auto tmp = std::make_unique<Image>();
            // Regra do motor original (medida: os prints nao mostram as molduras zzmainpicture/zzmainlabel): o nome PEDIDO escolhe o
            // decodificador. ".tga" pedido com conteudo BMP (zzmainlabel-*) ou ".bmp" pedido com conteudo TGA (zzmainpicture-*) = nao desenha.
            const std::size_t dot = key.find_last_of('.');
            const std::string ext = dot == std::string::npos ? std::string() : key.substr(dot + 1);
            if (!vfs_->read(*e, data, err)) problems_.push_back("imagem " + name + " (" + vfs_->where(*e) + "): " + err);
            else {
                const bool is_bmp = data.size() >= 2 && data[0] == 'B' && data[1] == 'M';
                if ((ext == "tga" && is_bmp) || (ext == "bmp" && !is_bmp)) mismatched_.insert(key);
                else if (decode_image(data.data(), data.size(), *tmp, err)) img = std::move(tmp);
                else problems_.push_back("imagem " + name + " (" + vfs_->where(*e) + "): " + err);
            }
        }
    }
    const Image* p = img.get();
    images_[key] = std::move(img);
    return p;
}

const Skin* UiAssets::skin(const std::string& file) {
    const std::string key = lower_ascii(file);
    const auto it = skins_.find(key);
    if (it != skins_.end()) return it->second.get();
    std::unique_ptr<Skin> s;
    const auto f = skin_files_.find(key);
    if (f != skin_files_.end()) {
        auto tmp = std::make_unique<Skin>();
        std::string err;
        if (tmp->load_file(f->second, err)) s = std::move(tmp);
        else problems_.push_back("skin " + file + ": " + err);
    } else if (vfs_) {
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> data;
        if (vfs_->read(file, RT_INI, data)) {
            auto tmp = std::make_unique<Skin>();
            if (tmp->parse(std::string(data.begin(), data.end()))) s = std::move(tmp);
            else problems_.push_back("skin " + file + ": sem secoes validas");
        }
    }
    const Skin* p = s.get();
    skins_[key] = std::move(s);
    return p;
}

std::size_t UiAssets::add_system_fonts(const std::string& dir) {
    // so as fontes que a demo pode pedir (fontlist.ini) e a Arial, que o Windows usa no lugar das que nao estao instaladas
    static const char* files[] = {"arial.ttf", "ariblk.ttf", "times.ttf", "lucon.ttf", "LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"};
    std::size_t n = 0;
    for (const char* f : files) {
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> data;
        std::string err;
        if (read_whole_file(join_path(dir, f), data) && add_font_memory(data, join_path(dir, f), err, true)) ++n;
    }
    atlases_.clear();
    return n;
}

// Casa o nome do .int com uma fonte carregada: nome completo ou familia iguais; senao uma substituta.
// Arial/Times/Arial Black (fontes do Windows, que a demo nao traz) -> Gothic 821; Lucida Console -> Fallouty; Hellbound -> JH_Fallout.
const UiAssets::FontEntry* UiAssets::pick_font(const std::string& name) const {
    if (fonts_.empty()) return nullptr;
    const std::string low = lower_ascii(name);
    if (faithful_fonts_) {
        // como o jogo original num Windows sem as fontes da demo instaladas: fonte do sistema com o mesmo nome, senao Arial
        const FontEntry* arial = nullptr;
        for (const auto& e : fonts_) if (e.system && (e.full == low || e.family == low)) return &e;
        for (const auto& e : fonts_) if (e.system && (e.family == "arial" || e.full == "arial" || e.family == "liberation sans")) { arial = &e; break; }
        if (arial) return arial;
    }
    auto by = [&](const std::string& n) -> const FontEntry* {
        for (const auto& e : fonts_) if (e.full == n || e.family == n) return &e;
        for (const auto& e : fonts_) if (!n.empty() && (e.full.find(n) != std::string::npos || e.family.find(n) != std::string::npos)) return &e;
        return nullptr;
    };
    auto by_demo = [&](const std::string& n) -> const FontEntry* {
        for (const auto& e : fonts_) if (!e.system && (e.full == n || e.family == n)) return &e;
        for (const auto& e : fonts_) if (!e.system && !n.empty() && (e.full.find(n) != std::string::npos || e.family.find(n) != std::string::npos)) return &e;
        return nullptr;
    };
    if (const FontEntry* e = by_demo(low)) return e;
    if (const FontEntry* e = by(low)) return e;
    const char* sub = "gothic";
    if (low.find("lucida") != std::string::npos || low.find("console") != std::string::npos) sub = "fallouty";
    else if (low.find("hellbound") != std::string::npos) sub = "jh_fallout";
    if (const FontEntry* e = by(sub)) return e;
    return &fonts_.front();
}

std::string UiAssets::resolve_font(const std::string& font) const {
    const FontEntry* e = pick_font(font);
    return e ? e->font->full_name() : std::string("(nenhuma)");
}

std::vector<std::string> UiAssets::font_names() const {
    std::vector<std::string> v;
    for (const auto& e : fonts_) v.push_back(e.font->full_name());
    return v;
}

const FontAtlas* UiAssets::atlas(const std::string& font, float em_px) {
    const int px = std::max(4, static_cast<int>(std::lround(em_px)));
    const FontEntry* e = pick_font(font);
    if (!e) return nullptr;
    const std::string key = e->path + "|" + std::to_string(px);
    const auto it = atlases_.find(key);
    if (it != atlases_.end()) return it->second.get();
    auto a = std::make_unique<FontAtlas>();
    if (!bake_atlas(*e->font, static_cast<float>(px), *a)) { problems_.push_back("atlas da fonte " + font + " " + std::to_string(px) + "px falhou"); a.reset(); }
    const FontAtlas* p = a.get();
    atlases_[key] = std::move(a);
    return p;
}

GuiResources UiAssets::resources() {
    GuiResources r;
    r.texture_size = [this](const std::string& t, int& w, int& h) {
        const Image* im = image(t);
        if (!im) return false;
        w = static_cast<int>(im->w); h = static_cast<int>(im->h);
        return true;
    };
    r.text_width = [this](const std::string& f, float px, const std::string& s) {
        const FontAtlas* a = atlas(f, px);
        return a ? a->measure(s) : static_cast<float>(s.size()) * px * 0.5f;
    };
    r.line_height = [this](const std::string& f, float px) {
        const FontAtlas* a = atlas(f, px);
        return a ? std::ceil(a->ascent - a->descent) : px * 1.2f;
    };
    r.text = [this](std::uint32_t id) { return stf_.text_cp1252(id); };
    r.skin = [this](const std::string& s) { return skin(s); };
    return r;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```
