```cpp
// Recursos da interface (v19), parte PORTAVEL: acha e guarda em cache as imagens (TGA/BMP/.f3tex), skins (.ini), fontes TrueType (atlas por tamanho)
// e os textos (.stf). Monta o GuiResources que o GuiScreen usa. O backend (OpenGL ou CPU) so precisa transformar Image/FontAtlas em textura.
//
// Onde procura (todas as pastas sao opcionais; a primeira que tiver o arquivo vence; nomes sem diferenciar maiusculas):
//   imagens:  RETAIL\Interface\TGA_Image  (o original, decodificado aqui mesmo)  e  CONVERTED\ui (*.f3tex do ui-info)
//   skins:    RETAIL\Interface\INI_Config
//   fontes:   <demo>\Fonts\*.ttf  (casadas pelo nome interno da fonte, nao pelo nome do arquivo)
//   textos:   English.stf (CONVERTED\scripts, a pasta da demo ou F3VB_STF)
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "f3tex.h"
#include "gui.h"
#include "skin.h"
#include "stf.h"
#include "ttf.h"

namespace f3v {

class Vfs;

class UiAssets {
public:
    void set_vfs(const Vfs* v) { vfs_ = v; }               // v20: imagens (TGA_Image) e skins (INI_Config) direto da demo original
    void add_image_dir(const std::string& dir);          // indexa os arquivos da pasta (nao decodifica ainda)
    void add_skin_dir(const std::string& dir);
    std::size_t add_font_dir(const std::string& dir);    // carrega todos os .ttf; devolve quantos
    bool load_stf(const std::string& path, std::string& err);
    bool add_font_memory(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& data, const std::string& label, std::string& err, bool system = false);
    // v20: fontes do SISTEMA (C:\Windows\Fonts): Arial, Arial Black, Times New Roman, Lucida Console... Com faithful = true (padrao do jogo),
    // as fontes que o .int pede e o Windows nao tem instaladas (Fallouty, Gothic 821, Hellbound) caem na Arial, como no jogo original
    // (prints: textos em Arial, cortados no retangulo). faithful = false: usa as fontes da pasta Fonts da demo.
    std::size_t add_system_fonts(const std::string& fonts_dir);
    void set_faithful_fonts(bool f) { faithful_fonts_ = f; atlases_.clear(); }
    bool faithful_fonts() const { return faithful_fonts_; }

    const Image* image(const std::string& name);         // nullptr = nao existe ou nao decodificou (fica registrado em problems())
    bool has_image(const std::string& name) const;
    const Skin* skin(const std::string& file);
    // Atlas da fonte (nome como no .int: "Fallouty", "Gothic 821 Condensed BT", "Arial"...) com o "em" em pixels (arredondado).
    const FontAtlas* atlas(const std::string& font, float em_px);
    std::string resolve_font(const std::string& font) const;   // nome da fonte TrueType realmente usada (para o log)
    const Stf& stf() const { return stf_; }

    GuiResources resources();
    std::size_t image_files() const { return files_.size(); }
    std::size_t font_count() const { return fonts_.size(); }
    std::vector<std::string> font_names() const;
    const std::vector<std::string>& problems() const { return problems_; }

private:
    struct FontEntry { std::string family, full, path; std::unique_ptr<TrueTypeFont> font; bool system = false; };
    const FontEntry* pick_font(const std::string& name) const;

    std::map<std::string, std::string> files_;           // nome minusculo -> caminho
    std::map<std::string, std::string> skin_files_;
    std::map<std::string, std::unique_ptr<Image>> images_;   // nullptr = falhou
    std::map<std::string, std::unique_ptr<Skin>> skins_;
    std::vector<FontEntry> fonts_;
    std::map<std::string, std::unique_ptr<FontAtlas>> atlases_;   // "fonte|px"
    Stf stf_;
    std::vector<std::string> problems_;
    const Vfs* vfs_ = nullptr;
    std::set<std::string> mismatched_;
    bool faithful_fonts_ = true;                    // v20: pedidos cujo formato nao bate com o conteudo (o original nao desenha)
public:
    std::size_t mismatched_count() const { return mismatched_.size(); }
};

// Lista os arquivos de uma pasta (so nomes; portavel: std::filesystem). Vazio se a pasta nao existe.
std::vector<std::string> list_dir(const std::string& dir);
std::string join_path(const std::string& a, const std::string& b);

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/ui_raster.cpp

```cpp
#include "ui_raster.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>

namespace f3v {

namespace {

void sample(const Image& im, float u, float v, float out[4]) {
    // bilinear com repeticao
    const float x = u * static_cast<float>(im.w) - 0.5f, y = v * static_cast<float>(im.h) - 0.5f;
    const int xi = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x)), yi = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
    const float fx = x - static_cast<float>(xi), fy = y - static_cast<float>(yi);
    const int W = static_cast<int>(im.w), H = static_cast<int>(im.h);
    auto px = [&](int xx, int yy, int c) {
        xx = ((xx % W) + W) % W; yy = ((yy % H) + H) % H;
        return static_cast<float>(im.rgba[(static_cast<std::size_t>(yy) * W + xx) * 4 + c]);
    };
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c)
        out[c] = (px(xi, yi, c) * (1 - fx) + px(xi + 1, yi, c) * fx) * (1 - fy) + (px(xi, yi + 1, c) * (1 - fx) + px(xi + 1, yi + 1, c) * fx) * fy;
}

void blend(Canvas& c, int x, int y, const float src[4], bool additive) {
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= c.w || y >= c.h) return;
    std::uint8_t* d = &c.rgba[(static_cast<std::size_t>(y) * c.w + x) * 4];
    const float a = src[3] / 255.f;
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) {
        const float v = additive ? d[k] + src[k] * a : d[k] * (1 - a) + src[k] * a;
        d[k] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::clamp(v, 0.f, 255.f));
    }
}

std::uint32_t crc_table[256];
bool crc_ready = false;
std::uint32_t crc32(const std::uint8_t* p, std::size_t n, std::uint32_t c = 0xFFFFFFFFu) {
    if (!crc_ready) {
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < 256; ++i) { std::uint32_t v = i; for (int k = 0; k < 8; ++k) v = (v & 1) ? 0xEDB88320u ^ (v >> 1) : v >> 1; crc_table[i] = v; }
        crc_ready = true;
    }
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) c = crc_table[(c ^ p[i]) & 0xFF] ^ (c >> 8);
    return c;
}

void put32(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& o, std::uint32_t v) { o.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> 24)); o.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> 16)); o.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> 8)); o.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v)); }

void chunk(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& o, const char* tag, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& data) {
    put32(o, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(data.size()));
    const std::size_t start = o.size();
    o.insert(o.end(), tag, tag + 4);
    o.insert(o.end(), data.begin(), data.end());
    put32(o, crc32(&o[start], o.size() - start) ^ 0xFFFFFFFFu);
}

}  // namespace

void raster_background(const Image& img, Canvas& c) {
    if (img.w == 0 || img.h == 0) return;
    for (int y = 0; y < c.h; ++y)
        for (int x = 0; x < c.w; ++x) {
            float s[4];
            sample(img, (static_cast<float>(x) + 0.5f) / static_cast<float>(c.w), (static_cast<float>(y) + 0.5f) / static_cast<float>(c.h), s);
            s[3] = 255;
            blend(c, x, y, s, false);
        }
}

void raster_draws(const std::vector<GuiDraw>& draws, UiAssets& assets, Canvas& c) {
    const float sx = static_cast<float>(c.w) / 1024.f, sy = static_cast<float>(c.h) / 768.f;
    for (const GuiDraw& d : draws) {
        if (d.kind == GuiDraw::Quad) {
            const Image* im = assets.image(d.texture);
            if (!im || im->w == 0) continue;
            const int X0 = static_cast<int>(std::floor(d.x0 * sx)), X1 = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(d.x1 * sx));
            const int Y0 = static_cast<int>(std::floor(d.y0 * sy)), Y1 = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(d.y1 * sy));
            const float dw = (d.x1 - d.x0) * sx, dh = (d.y1 - d.y0) * sy;
            if (dw <= 0 || dh <= 0) continue;
            for (int y = std::max(0, Y0); y < std::min(c.h, Y1); ++y)
                for (int x = std::max(0, X0); x < std::min(c.w, X1); ++x) {
                    const float tx = ((static_cast<float>(x) + 0.5f) - d.x0 * sx) / dw, ty = ((static_cast<float>(y) + 0.5f) - d.y0 * sy) / dh;
                    if (tx < 0 || tx > 1 || ty < 0 || ty > 1) continue;
                    float s[4];
                    sample(*im, d.u0 + tx * (d.u1 - d.u0), d.v0 + ty * (d.v1 - d.v0), s);
                    for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) s[k] = s[k] * d.rgba[k] / 255.f;
                    s[3] = s[3] * d.rgba[3] / 255.f;
                    blend(c, x, y, s, d.additive);
                }
        } else {
            const FontAtlas* a = assets.atlas(d.font, d.size_px * sy);
            if (!a) continue;
            const float tw = a->measure(d.text);
            float pen = d.x0 * sx + 1;
            if (d.align == 1) pen = (d.x0 * sx + d.x1 * sx - tw) * 0.5f;
            else if (d.align == 2) pen = d.x1 * sx - tw - 1;
            const float base = std::floor(d.y0 * sy + a->ascent + 0.5f);
            pen = std::floor(pen + 0.5f);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < d.text.size(); ++i) {
                const std::uint8_t ch = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(d.text[i]);
                const GlyphInfo& g = a->glyph[ch];
                for (int r = 0; r < g.h; ++r)
                    for (int q = 0; q < g.w; ++q) {
                        const float al = a->alpha[static_cast<std::size_t>(g.y + r) * a->w + g.x + q];
                        if (al <= 0) continue;
                        const int px = static_cast<int>(pen) + g.ox + q, py = static_cast<int>(base) + g.oy + r;
                        if (px < d.cx0 * sx || px >= d.cx1 * sx || py < d.cy0 * sy || py >= d.cy1 * sy) continue;   // v20: recorte no rotulo
                        const float s[4] = {static_cast<float>(d.rgba[0]), static_cast<float>(d.rgba[1]), static_cast<float>(d.rgba[2]), al * d.rgba[3] / 255.f};
                        blend(c, px, py, s, false);
                    }
                pen += g.advance;
                if (i + 1 < d.text.size()) {
                    const auto it = a->kern.find((static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ch) << 8) | static_cast<std::uint8_t>(d.text[i + 1]));
                    if (it != a->kern.end()) pen += it->second;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

std::vector<std::uint8_t> encode_png(int w, int h, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& rgba) {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> o = {0x89, 'P', 'N', 'G', 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A};
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> ihdr;
    put32(ihdr, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(w)); put32(ihdr, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(h));
    ihdr.insert(ihdr.end(), {8, 6, 0, 0, 0});
    chunk(o, "IHDR", ihdr);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> raw;
    raw.reserve(static_cast<std::size_t>(h) * (1 + 4 * static_cast<std::size_t>(w)));
    for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) { raw.push_back(0); raw.insert(raw.end(), rgba.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(y) * w * 4, rgba.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(y + 1) * w * 4); }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> z = {0x78, 0x01};
    std::uint32_t s1 = 1, s2 = 0;
    for (std::uint8_t b : raw) { s1 = (s1 + b) % 65521; s2 = (s2 + s1) % 65521; }
    for (std::size_t p = 0; p < raw.size() || p == 0;) {
        const std::size_t n = std::min<std::size_t>(65535, raw.size() - p);
        const bool last = p + n >= raw.size();
        z.push_back(last ? 1 : 0);
        z.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(n)); z.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(n >> 8));
        z.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(~n)); z.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>((~n) >> 8));
        z.insert(z.end(), raw.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(p), raw.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(p + n));
        p += n;
        if (last) break;
    }
    put32(z, (s2 << 16) | s1);
    chunk(o, "IDAT", z);
    chunk(o, "IEND", {});
    return o;
}

bool write_png(const std::string& path, int w, int h, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& rgba) {
    const std::vector<std::uint8_t> b = encode_png(w, h, rgba);
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!f) return false;
    const bool ok = std::fwrite(b.data(), 1, b.size(), f) == b.size();
    std::fclose(f);
    return ok;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/ui_raster.h

```cpp
// Backend de CPU da interface (v19): pinta a lista de desenho do GuiScreen numa imagem RGBA, sem placa de video.
// Usado pelo F3VBUiPreview (gera PNG de qualquer tela .int) e pelos testes. Mesmas regras de mistura do backend OpenGL:
// normal = alfa; aditivo = soma; textura modulada pela cor; repeticao quando u/v > 1; amostragem bilinear.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "gui.h"
#include "ui_assets.h"

namespace f3v {

struct Canvas {
    int w = 0, h = 0;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> rgba;                      // linha de cima primeiro
    void clear(std::uint8_t r, std::uint8_t g, std::uint8_t b) { rgba.assign(static_cast<std::size_t>(w) * h * 4, 255); for (std::size_t i = 0; i < rgba.size(); i += 4) { rgba[i] = r; rgba[i + 1] = g; rgba[i + 2] = b; } }
};

// Pinta `draws` (coordenadas da tela virtual 1024x768) no canvas, escalando para w x h.
void raster_draws(const std::vector<GuiDraw>& draws, UiAssets& assets, Canvas& c);
// Cola uma imagem esticada no canvas inteiro (fundo).
void raster_background(const Image& img, Canvas& c);

// PNG sem compressao (blocos "stored" do deflate): simples e sem dependencias. true se gravou.
bool write_png(const std::string& path, int w, int h, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& rgba);
std::vector<std::uint8_t> encode_png(int w, int h, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& rgba);

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/uipreview_main.cpp

```cpp
// F3VBUiPreview (v19): desenha telas da interface original (.int) em PNG, sem janela e sem placa de video (backend de CPU).
//   F3VBUiPreview Mainmenu                      -> Mainmenu.png (tela de 1024x768)
//   F3VBUiPreview --all [--out PASTA]           -> um PNG por .int
//   F3VBUiPreview Mainmenu --hover NewGameBtn   -> com o mouse em cima de um botao (estado "selected" da skin)
//   opcoes: --assets <original_assets>  --demo <pasta da demo (Fonts, English.stf)>  --w 1024 --h 768  --down NOME  --bg imagem.tga  --out ARQ|PASTA
// Pastas padrao: F3VB_ASSETS_DIR e F3VB_DEMO_DIR (variaveis de ambiente). Imprime o que faltou (texturas, fontes) para conferir.
#include <cstdio>
#include <filesystem>
#include <system_error>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "gui.h"
#include "image.h"
#include "ui_assets.h"
#include "ui_raster.h"
#include "vfs.h"

using namespace f3v;

namespace {

std::string env(const char* n) { const char* v = std::getenv(n); return v ? v : ""; }
Vfs g_vfs;      // v20: com --demo, tudo vem da demo original (resource.rht + .grp)

void setup(UiAssets& a, const std::string& assets, const std::string& demo) {
    if (g_vfs.is_open()) {
        a.set_vfs(&g_vfs);
        const std::size_t nf = a.add_font_dir(join_path(demo, "Fonts"));
        std::string err;
        if (a.load_stf(join_path(demo, "English.stf"), err)) std::printf("textos: %s (%zu)\n", join_path(demo, "English.stf").c_str(), a.stf().count());
        std::printf("demo original: %zu recursos | fontes TrueType: %zu\n", g_vfs.size(), nf);
        return;
    }
    a.add_image_dir(join_path(assets, join_path("RETAIL", join_path("Interface", "TGA_Image"))));
    a.add_image_dir(join_path(assets, join_path("CONVERTED", "ui")));
    a.add_skin_dir(join_path(assets, join_path("RETAIL", join_path("Interface", "INI_Config"))));
    std::size_t nf = 0;
    if (!demo.empty()) nf += a.add_font_dir(join_path(demo, "Fonts"));
    nf += a.add_font_dir(join_path(assets, join_path("RETAIL", "Fonts")));
    std::string err;
    const std::string stfs[] = {env("F3VB_STF"), demo.empty() ? "" : join_path(demo, "English.stf"), join_path(assets, join_path("RETAIL", "English.stf")),
                                join_path(assets, join_path("CONVERTED", join_path("scripts", "English.stf")))};
    bool stf = false;
    for (const std::string& s : stfs) if (!s.empty() && a.load_stf(s, err)) { std::printf("textos: %s (%zu)\n", s.c_str(), a.stf().count()); stf = true; break; }
    if (!stf) std::printf("AVISO: English.stf nao encontrado (rotulos sem texto). Use --demo ou F3VB_STF.\n");
    std::printf("imagens indexadas: %zu | fontes TrueType: %zu", a.image_files(), nf);
    for (const std::string& n : a.font_names()) std::printf(" [%s]", n.c_str());
    std::printf("\n");
    if (nf == 0) std::printf("AVISO: nenhuma fonte .ttf (procure a pasta Fonts da demo: --demo ou F3VB_DEMO_DIR; ou rode: py -3 -m f3vb import-loose <demo>)\n");
}

bool render_one(UiAssets& a, const std::string& int_path, const std::string& out, int W, int H, const std::string& hover, const std::string& down, const Image* bg) {
    GuiScreen s;
    std::string err;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
    if (g_vfs.is_open() && !file_exists(int_path)) {
        if (!g_vfs.read(int_path, RT_INT, bytes) || !s.load(bytes.data(), bytes.size(), err)) { std::printf("FALHA %s: %s\n", int_path.c_str(), err.empty() ? "nao existe na demo" : err.c_str()); return false; }
    } else if (!s.load_file(int_path, err)) { std::printf("FALHA %s: %s\n", int_path.c_str(), err.c_str()); return false; }
    if (!hover.empty()) { s.set_hover(s.find(hover)); if (!s.find(hover)) std::printf("  aviso: botao '%s' nao existe nesta tela\n", hover.c_str()); }
    if (!down.empty()) { GuiWidget* w = s.find(down); s.set_hover(w); s.set_pressed(w); }
    std::vector<GuiDraw> draws;
    s.build(a.resources(), draws);
    Canvas c;
    c.w = W; c.h = H;
    c.clear(24, 22, 20);
    if (bg) raster_background(*bg, c);
    raster_draws(draws, a, c);
    const bool ok = write_png(out, W, H, c.rgba);
    const auto& st = s.stats();
    std::printf("%-28s %4zu objetos | %4zu quads, %3zu textos, %3zu fragmentos com textura ausente -> %s%s\n", s.file().name.c_str(), s.file().count(), st.quads, st.texts, st.missing,
                out.c_str(), ok ? "" : " (NAO GRAVOU)");
    if (!st.missing_names.empty()) {
        std::printf("    ausentes:");
        int k = 0;
        for (const auto& n : st.missing_names) { if (k++ == 8) { std::printf(" ..."); break; } std::printf(" %s", n.c_str()); }
        std::printf("\n");
    }
    return ok;
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    std::string assets = env("F3VB_ASSETS_DIR"), demo = env("F3VB_DEMO_DIR"), out, hover, down, bgfile, target;
    int W = 1024, H = 768;
    bool all = false, demo_fonts = false;
    std::string sysfonts;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        const std::string a = argv[i];
        auto next = [&]() -> std::string { return i + 1 < argc ? argv[++i] : ""; };
        if (a == "--assets") assets = next();
        else if (a == "--demo") demo = next();
        else if (a == "--out") out = next();
        else if (a == "--hover") hover = next();
        else if (a == "--down") down = next();
        else if (a == "--bg") bgfile = next();
        else if (a == "--w") W = std::atoi(next().c_str());
        else if (a == "--h") H = std::atoi(next().c_str());
        else if (a == "--all") all = true;
        else if (a == "--system-fonts") sysfonts = next();
        else if (a == "--demo-fonts") demo_fonts = true;
        else if (a == "-h" || a == "--help") { std::printf("uso: F3VBUiPreview <tela|arquivo.int|--all> [--assets DIR] [--demo DIR] [--out ARQ|PASTA] [--hover BOTAO] [--down BOTAO] [--bg IMG] [--w N --h N]\n"); return 0; }
        else target = a;
    }
    if (W < 64 || H < 48 || W > 8192 || H > 8192) { std::printf("tamanho invalido\n"); return 2; }
    if (!demo.empty()) {
        std::string err;
        if (!g_vfs.open_demo(demo, err) && assets.empty()) { std::printf("demo nao abriu: %s\n", err.c_str()); return 2; }
    }
    if (assets.empty() && !g_vfs.is_open()) { std::printf("use --demo <pasta da demo> (ou --assets <original_assets>)\n"); return 2; }
    UiAssets a;
    setup(a, assets, demo);
    if (!sysfonts.empty()) std::printf("fontes do sistema: %zu (%s)\n", a.add_system_fonts(sysfonts), sysfonts.c_str());
    a.set_faithful_fonts(!demo_fonts);
    Image bg;
    const Image* bgp = nullptr;
    if (!bgfile.empty()) { std::string err; if (load_image_file(bgfile, bg, err)) bgp = &bg; else std::printf("fundo: %s\n", err.c_str()); }
    const std::string int_dir = join_path(assets, join_path("RETAIL", join_path("Interface", "INT_Interface")));
    int fails = 0;
    if (all) {
        const std::string dir = out.empty() ? "ui_preview" : out;
        std::error_code mk_ec;
        std::filesystem::create_directories(std::filesystem::path(dir), mk_ec);
        if (g_vfs.is_open()) {
            for (const ResEntry* e : g_vfs.list(RT_INT)) if (!render_one(a, e->name, join_path(dir, e->name + ".png"), W, H, hover, down, bgp)) ++fails;
        } else for (const std::string& f : list_dir(int_dir)) {
            const std::string low = lower_ascii(f);
            if (low.size() < 4 || low.compare(low.size() - 4, 4, ".int") != 0) continue;
            if (!render_one(a, join_path(int_dir, f), join_path(dir, f.substr(0, f.size() - 4) + ".png"), W, H, hover, down, bgp)) ++fails;
        }
    } else {
        if (target.empty()) { std::printf("diga a tela (ex.: Mainmenu) ou --all\n"); return 2; }
        std::string path = target;
        if (lower_ascii(path).find(".int") == std::string::npos && !g_vfs.is_open()) path = join_path(int_dir, target + ".int");
        if (out.empty()) { const std::size_t k = target.find_last_of("\\/"); out = (k == std::string::npos ? target : target.substr(k + 1)); if (lower_ascii(out).find(".int") != std::string::npos) out = out.substr(0, out.size() - 4); out += ".png"; }
        if (!render_one(a, path, out, W, H, hover, down, bgp)) ++fails;
    }
    for (const std::string& p : a.problems()) std::printf("problema: %s\n", p.c_str());
    return fails ? 1 : 0;
}
```

```cpp
// v20: sistema de arquivos virtual (veja vfs.h). Caminhos sao UTF-8; no Windows os arquivos sao abertos pela versao "larga" (acentos funcionam).
#include "vfs.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <system_error>

namespace f3v {

namespace {

struct TypeInfo { std::uint32_t id; const char* name; const char* ext; };
const TypeInfo kTypes[] = {
    {100, "G3D_Model", "b3d"}, {200, "TGA_Image", "tga"}, {300, "SMA_Script", "amx"}, {400, "TRE_Octree", "8tre"},
    {500, "SKN_Skin", "skn"}, {600, "SKEL_Skeleton", "skl"}, {700, "GR2_Animation", "gr2"}, {800, "INI_Config", "ini"},
    {900, "RLZ", "rlz"}, {1000, "RTD", "rtd"}, {1100, "WAV_Audio", "wav"}, {1200, "AMX", "amx"}, {1300, "MAP_Map", "map"},
    {1400, "CRT_ENT_Critter", "crt"}, {1500, "VEG_Vfx", "veg"}, {1600, "INT_Interface", "int"}, {1700, "RLE", "rle"},
    {1800, "ITM", "itm"}, {1900, "PSF", "psf"}, {2000, "GSF", "gsf"}, {2100, "GLS", "gls"}, {2200, "SCO", "sco"},
    {2300, "PCE", "pce"}, {2400, "WEA_ENT_Weapon", "wea"}, {2500, "ARM_ENT_Armor", "arm"}, {2600, "DOR_ENT_Door", "dor"},
    {2700, "USE_ENT_Use", "use"}, {2800, "SST", "sst"}, {2900, "STR", "str"}, {3000, "ENC", "enc"}, {3100, "WMP", "wmp"},
    {3200, "PRO", "pro"}, {3300, "SPL", "spl"}, {3400, "FNT", "fnt"}, {3500, "AMO_ENT_Ammo", "amo"}, {3600, "CON_ENT", "con"},
    {3700, "TOK_Tokens", "tok"},
};

std::filesystem::path fs_path(const std::string& utf8) {
    return std::filesystem::path(std::u8string(reinterpret_cast<const char8_t*>(utf8.data()), utf8.size()));
}

std::FILE* open_file(const std::string& utf8, const char* mode) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    const std::filesystem::path p = fs_path(utf8);
    std::wstring wm;
    for (const char* c = mode; *c; ++c) wm.push_back(static_cast<wchar_t>(*c));
    return _wfopen(p.c_str(), wm.c_str());
#else
    return std::fopen(utf8.c_str(), mode);
#endif
}

bool seek64(std::FILE* f, std::uint64_t off) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    return _fseeki64(f, static_cast<__int64>(off), SEEK_SET) == 0;
#else
    return fseeko(f, static_cast<off_t>(off), SEEK_SET) == 0;
#endif
}

std::uint32_t rd32(const std::uint8_t* p) { return p[0] | (p[1] << 8) | (p[2] << 16) | (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p[3]) << 24); }

// le um campo CSV (com aspas opcionais); avanca i
std::string csv_field(const std::string& line, std::size_t& i) {
    std::string out;
    if (i < line.size() && line[i] == '"') {
        ++i;
        while (i < line.size()) {
            if (line[i] == '"') {
                if (i + 1 < line.size() && line[i + 1] == '"') { out.push_back('"'); i += 2; continue; }
                ++i;
                break;
            }
            out.push_back(line[i++]);
        }
        if (i < line.size() && line[i] == ',') ++i;
        return out;
    }
    while (i < line.size() && line[i] != ',') out.push_back(line[i++]);
    if (i < line.size()) ++i;
    return out;
}

std::uint32_t type_by_name(const std::string& n) {
    for (const TypeInfo& t : kTypes) if (n == t.name) return t.id;
    return 0;
}

}  // namespace

const char* res_type_name(std::uint32_t type) {
    for (const TypeInfo& t : kTypes) if (t.id == type) return t.name;
    return "?";
}
const char* res_type_ext(std::uint32_t type) {
    for (const TypeInfo& t : kTypes) if (t.id == type) return t.ext;
    return "";
}
std::uint32_t res_type_for_ext(const std::string& ext_in) {
    const std::string e = to_lower(ext_in);
    if (e == "tga" || e == "bmp" || e == "dds" || e == "ctx") return RT_TGA;   // os dados citam .bmp/.dds/.ctx, mas tudo e TGA_Image na demo
    if (e == "8" || e == "8tre") return RT_TRE;
    if (e == "sma") return RT_SMA;
    for (const TypeInfo& t : kTypes) if (e == t.ext) return t.id;
    return 0;
}

std::string to_lower(std::string s) {
    for (char& c : s) if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>(c - 'A' + 'a');
    return s;
}

std::string path_join(const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
    if (a.empty()) return b;
    const char last = a.back();
#ifdef _WIN32
    const char sep = '\\';
#else
    const char sep = '/';
#endif
    return (last == '\\' || last == '/') ? a + b : a + sep + b;
}

bool file_exists(const std::string& p) { std::error_code ec; return std::filesystem::is_regular_file(fs_path(p), ec); }
bool dir_exists(const std::string& p) { std::error_code ec; return std::filesystem::is_directory(fs_path(p), ec); }

bool read_whole_file(const std::string& path, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out) {
    out.clear();
    std::FILE* f = open_file(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return false;
    std::uint8_t tmp[65536];
    std::size_t n;
    while ((n = std::fread(tmp, 1, sizeof tmp, f)) > 0) out.insert(out.end(), tmp, tmp + n);
    std::fclose(f);
    return true;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Vfs
Vfs::~Vfs() { close(); }

void Vfs::close() {
    for (std::FILE*& f : files_) if (f) { std::fclose(f); f = nullptr; }
    files_.clear();
    entries_.clear();
    packs_.clear();
    pack_size_.clear();
    by_name_.clear();
    root_.clear();
    demo_ = false;
}

std::string Vfs::key(const std::string& name) {
    std::string k = to_lower(name);
    const std::size_t dot = k.find_last_of('.');
    if (dot != std::string::npos && dot + 1 < k.size() && k.size() - dot <= 5 && res_type_for_ext(k.substr(dot + 1))) k.erase(dot);
    return k;
}

bool Vfs::add_entry(ResEntry&& e) {
    by_name_.emplace(key(e.name), entries_.size());
    entries_.push_back(std::move(e));
    return true;
}

bool Vfs::open_demo(const std::string& dir, std::string& err) {
    close();
    std::string why;
    if (!is_demo_dir(dir, why)) { err = why; return false; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> rht;
    if (!read_whole_file(path_join(dir, "resource.rht"), rht)) { err = "nao consegui ler resource.rht"; return false; }
    if (rht.size() < 20) { err = "resource.rht pequeno demais"; return false; }
    const std::uint32_t n = rd32(&rht[8]), off_packs = rd32(&rht[12]), off_res = rd32(&rht[16]);
    if (n == 0 || n > 1000000 || 20ull + 20ull * n > rht.size() || off_packs > off_res || off_res > rht.size()) {
        err = "cabecalho do resource.rht incoerente (entradas=" + std::to_string(n) + ")";
        return false;
    }
    // nomes dos packs: valor de 'pack' = deslocamento na regiao de packs
    std::map<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t> pack_index;   // deslocamento -> indice em packs_
    auto cstr = [&](std::size_t start, std::size_t limit_end) -> std::string {
        std::string s;
        for (std::size_t i = start; i < limit_end && rht[i]; ++i) s.push_back(static_cast<char>(rht[i]));
        return s;
    };
    const std::string data_dir = path_join(dir, "data");
    std::vector<std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t>>> tables;   // por pack: (offset, length) de cada lump
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        const std::uint8_t* e = &rht[20 + 20 * static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
        const std::uint32_t number = rd32(e + 4), type = rd32(e + 8), noff = rd32(e + 12), pack = rd32(e + 16);
        if (pack == 0xFFFFFFFFu || off_packs + static_cast<std::size_t>(pack) >= off_res) continue;
        auto pit = pack_index.find(pack);
        if (pit == pack_index.end()) {
            const std::string pname = cstr(off_packs + pack, off_res);
            if (pname.empty()) continue;
            // abre a tabela do .grp (nome sem diferenciar maiusculas)
            std::string gpath = path_join(data_dir, pname + ".grp");
            if (!file_exists(gpath)) {
                std::error_code ec;
                for (const auto& de : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(fs_path(data_dir), ec)) {
                    const std::u8string u = de.path().filename().u8string();
                    const std::string fn(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(u.data()), u.size());
                    if (to_lower(fn) == to_lower(pname + ".grp")) { gpath = path_join(data_dir, fn); break; }
                }
            }
            std::vector<std::pair<std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t>> table;
            std::uint64_t fsize = 0;
            std::FILE* f = open_file(gpath, "rb");
            if (f) {
                std::uint8_t hdr[12];
                if (std::fread(hdr, 1, 12, f) == 12) {
                    const std::uint32_t nf = rd32(hdr + 8);
                    std::error_code ec;
                    fsize = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::filesystem::file_size(fs_path(gpath), ec));
                    if (nf < 1000000 && 12ull + 8ull * nf <= fsize) {
                        std::vector<std::uint8_t> tb(8 * static_cast<std::size_t>(nf));
                        if (nf == 0 || std::fread(tb.data(), 1, tb.size(), f) == tb.size())
                            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < nf; ++k) table.emplace_back(rd32(&tb[8 * k]), rd32(&tb[8 * k + 4]));
                    }
                }
                std::fclose(f);
            }
            pack_index[pack] = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(packs_.size());
            pit = pack_index.find(pack);
            packs_.push_back(pname);
            pack_size_.push_back(fsize);
            tables.push_back(std::move(table));
            files_.push_back(nullptr);
            root_ = dir;
            (void)gpath;
        }
        const std::uint32_t pi = pit->second;
        if (number >= tables[pi].size()) continue;                       // .grp ausente/curto: o recurso fica de fora (relatado por quem chamar)
        const auto& lm = tables[pi][number];
        if (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(lm.first) + lm.second > pack_size_[pi]) continue;
        ResEntry re;
        re.name = (off_res + static_cast<std::size_t>(noff) < rht.size()) ? cstr(off_res + noff, rht.size()) : std::string();
        if (re.name.empty()) re.name = packs_[pi] + "#" + std::to_string(number);
        re.type = type;
        re.pack = pi;
        re.lump = number;
        re.offset = lm.first;
        re.size = lm.second;
        add_entry(std::move(re));
    }
    if (entries_.empty()) { err = "nenhum recurso legivel (os .grp da pasta data estao faltando ou corrompidos?)"; close(); return false; }
    root_ = dir;
    demo_ = true;
    return true;
}

bool Vfs::open_extracted(const std::string& dir, std::string& err) {
    close();
    std::string why;
    if (!is_assets_dir(dir, why)) { err = why; return false; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> csv;
    if (!read_whole_file(path_join(dir, "index.csv"), csv)) { err = "nao consegui ler index.csv"; return false; }
    std::string text(csv.begin(), csv.end());
    std::size_t pos = 0;
    bool header = true;
    std::map<std::string, std::uint32_t> pk;
    while (pos < text.size()) {
        std::size_t e = text.find('\n', pos);
        if (e == std::string::npos) e = text.size();
        std::string line = text.substr(pos, e - pos);
        pos = e + 1;
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
        if (line.empty()) continue;
        if (header) { header = false; continue; }
        std::size_t i = 0;
        const std::string pack = csv_field(line, i), num = csv_field(line, i), tname = csv_field(line, i), name = csv_field(line, i), rel = csv_field(line, i), sz = csv_field(line, i);
        if (pack.empty() || rel.empty()) continue;
        auto it = pk.find(pack);
        if (it == pk.end()) { it = pk.emplace(pack, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(packs_.size())).first; packs_.push_back(pack); pack_size_.push_back(0); files_.push_back(nullptr); }
        ResEntry re;
        re.name = name;
        re.type = type_by_name(tname);
        re.pack = it->second;
        re.lump = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::strtoul(num.c_str(), nullptr, 10));
        re.size = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::strtoul(sz.c_str(), nullptr, 10));
        re.path = rel;
        add_entry(std::move(re));
    }
    if (entries_.empty()) { err = "index.csv vazio"; close(); return false; }
    root_ = dir;
    demo_ = false;
    return true;
}

const ResEntry* Vfs::find(const std::string& name, std::uint32_t type) const {
    const std::string k = key(name);
    const auto range = by_name_.equal_range(k);
    const ResEntry* any = nullptr;
    for (auto it = range.first; it != range.second; ++it) {
        const ResEntry& e = entries_[it->second];
        if (type == 0 || e.type == type) return &e;
        if (!any) any = &e;
    }
    if (type == 0) return any;
    // os scripts de dialogo sao SMA_Script mas citados como .amx
    if (type == RT_AMX) return find(name, RT_SMA);
    return nullptr;
}

const ResEntry* Vfs::find_file(const std::string& filename) const {
    const std::size_t dot = filename.find_last_of('.');
    const std::uint32_t t = dot == std::string::npos ? 0 : res_type_for_ext(filename.substr(dot + 1));
    const ResEntry* e = t ? find(filename, t) : nullptr;
    return e ? e : find(filename, 0);
}

const ResEntry* Vfs::find_lump(const std::string& pack, std::uint32_t lump) const {
    const std::string lp = to_lower(pack);
    for (const ResEntry& e : entries_) if (e.lump == lump && to_lower(packs_[e.pack]) == lp) return &e;
    return nullptr;
}

std::vector<const ResEntry*> Vfs::list(std::uint32_t type) const {
    std::vector<const ResEntry*> v;
    for (const ResEntry& e : entries_) if (type == 0 || e.type == type) v.push_back(&e);
    return v;
}

bool Vfs::read(const ResEntry& e, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out, std::string& err) const {
    out.clear();
    if (!demo_) {
        std::string rel = e.path;
#ifdef _WIN32
        for (char& c : rel) if (c == '/') c = '\\';
#endif
        if (!read_whole_file(path_join(path_join(root_, "RETAIL"), rel), out)) { err = "nao consegui abrir RETAIL/" + e.path; return false; }
        return true;
    }
    if (e.pack >= files_.size()) { err = "pack invalido"; return false; }
    std::FILE*& f = files_[e.pack];
    if (!f) {
        std::string gpath = path_join(path_join(root_, "data"), packs_[e.pack] + ".grp");
        if (!file_exists(gpath)) {
            std::error_code ec;
            for (const auto& de : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(fs_path(path_join(root_, "data")), ec)) {
                const std::u8string u = de.path().filename().u8string();
                const std::string fn(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(u.data()), u.size());
                if (to_lower(fn) == to_lower(packs_[e.pack] + ".grp")) { gpath = path_join(path_join(root_, "data"), fn); break; }
            }
        }
        f = open_file(gpath, "rb");
        if (!f) { err = "nao consegui abrir " + gpath; return false; }
    }
    if (!seek64(f, e.offset)) { err = "seek falhou em " + packs_[e.pack] + ".grp"; return false; }
    out.resize(e.size);
    if (e.size && std::fread(out.data(), 1, e.size, f) != e.size) { err = "leitura curta em " + packs_[e.pack] + ".grp"; out.clear(); return false; }
    return true;
}

bool Vfs::read(const std::string& name, std::uint32_t type, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out) const {
    const ResEntry* e = find(name, type);
    std::string err;
    return e && read(*e, out, err);
}

bool Vfs::read_file(const std::string& filename, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out) const {
    const ResEntry* e = find_file(filename);
    std::string err;
    return e && read(*e, out, err);
}

std::string Vfs::where(const ResEntry& e) const {
    if (demo_) return (e.pack < packs_.size() ? packs_[e.pack] : std::string("?")) + ".grp#" + std::to_string(e.lump);
    return "RETAIL/" + e.path;
}

bool is_demo_dir(const std::string& dir, std::string& why) {
    if (dir.empty()) { why = "nenhuma pasta escolhida"; return false; }
    if (!dir_exists(dir)) { why = "a pasta nao existe: " + dir; return false; }
    if (!file_exists(path_join(dir, "resource.rht"))) { why = "nao tem resource.rht (escolha a pasta da demo, a que tem F3.exe, resource.rht e a pasta data)"; return false; }
    const std::string data = path_join(dir, "data");
    if (!dir_exists(data)) { why = "nao tem a pasta data (com os arquivos .grp)"; return false; }
    int grp = 0;
    std::error_code ec;
    for (const auto& de : std::filesystem::directory_iterator(fs_path(data), ec)) {
        const std::u8string u = de.path().extension().u8string();
        if (to_lower(std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(u.data()), u.size())) == ".grp") ++grp;
    }
    if (grp == 0) { why = "a pasta data nao tem nenhum .grp"; return false; }
    why.clear();
    return true;
}

bool is_assets_dir(const std::string& dir, std::string& why) {
    if (dir.empty()) { why = "nenhuma pasta"; return false; }
    if (!dir_exists(dir)) { why = "a pasta nao existe: " + dir; return false; }
    if (!file_exists(path_join(dir, "index.csv"))) { why = "nao tem index.csv (nao e uma copia extraida pelo kit: rode extract-all)"; return false; }
    if (!dir_exists(path_join(path_join(path_join(dir, "RETAIL"), "Interface"), "INT_Interface"))) { why = "nao tem RETAIL/Interface/INT_Interface (extracao incompleta)"; return false; }
    why.clear();
    return true;
}

}  // namespace f3v
```

## viewer/src/vfs.h

```cpp
// v20: sistema de arquivos virtual. O jogo le TUDO por aqui, de uma destas origens:
//   1) a demo ORIGINAL: resource.rht + data\*.grp inteiros (nada extraido) -> Vfs::open_demo
//   2) a copia extraida pelo kit (original_assets: index.csv + RETAIL\...)   -> Vfs::open_extracted (depuracao/analise)
// Formatos (verificados na demo real; specs em docs/specs/rht.md e grp.md):
//   resource.rht: u32 vMajor, vMinor, nEntries, offsetPacks, offsetResources; nEntries x {u32 one, number, type, offset, pack};
//                 regiao de packs = nomes dos .grp (texto com NUL); regiao de recursos = nomes dos recursos (texto com NUL)
//   .grp:         u32 2, u32 1, u32 nFiles; nFiles x {u32 offset, u32 length}; dados. Sem compressao, sem nomes.
// Portavel (sem Windows): testado no Linux contra a copia extraida.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace f3v {

// ids de tipo do resource.rht (lista completa em tools/py/f3vb/knowledge.py)
enum ResType : std::uint32_t {
    RT_MODEL = 100, RT_TGA = 200, RT_SMA = 300, RT_TRE = 400, RT_SKEL = 600, RT_GR2 = 700, RT_INI = 800,
    RT_WAV = 1100, RT_AMX = 1200, RT_MAP = 1300, RT_CRT = 1400, RT_VEG = 1500, RT_INT = 1600, RT_RLE = 1700,
    RT_PSF = 1900, RT_GSF = 2000, RT_GLS = 2100, RT_SCO = 2200, RT_PCE = 2300, RT_WEA = 2400, RT_ARM = 2500,
    RT_DOR = 2600, RT_USE = 2700, RT_AMO = 3500, RT_CON = 3600, RT_TOK = 3700
};
const char* res_type_name(std::uint32_t type);     // "TGA_Image", ...
const char* res_type_ext(std::uint32_t type);      // "tga", "8", ... ("" se desconhecido)
std::uint32_t res_type_for_ext(const std::string& ext);   // "tga"/"bmp"/"dds" -> RT_TGA, "int" -> RT_INT... (0 = desconhecido)

struct ResEntry {
    std::string name;            // como esta no .rht (ex.: "Mainmenu", "f3_logo", "Int10x10_Cave1_Corner{2}Cave Corner2 (0)")
    std::uint32_t type = 0;
    std::uint32_t pack = 0;      // indice em Vfs::packs()
    std::uint32_t lump = 0;      // numero do lump dentro do .grp
    std::uint64_t offset = 0;    // no .grp (modo demo)
    std::uint32_t size = 0;
    std::string path;            // modo extraido: caminho relativo em RETAIL
};

class Vfs {
public:
    Vfs() = default;
    Vfs(const Vfs&) = delete;
    Vfs& operator=(const Vfs&) = delete;
    ~Vfs();

    bool open_demo(const std::string& demo_dir, std::string& err);            // pasta com resource.rht e data\*.grp
    bool open_extracted(const std::string& assets_dir, std::string& err);     // pasta original_assets (index.csv + RETAIL)
    void close();

    bool is_open() const { return !entries_.empty(); }
    bool demo_mode() const { return demo_; }
    const std::string& root() const { return root_; }
    std::size_t size() const { return entries_.size(); }
    const std::vector<ResEntry>& entries() const { return entries_; }
    const std::vector<std::string>& packs() const { return packs_; }

    // nome sem diferenciar maiusculas; aceita com ou sem extensao (".tga", ".int"...). type = 0: qualquer tipo
    const ResEntry* find(const std::string& name, std::uint32_t type = 0) const;
    // nome de ARQUIVO como os dados citam ("f3_logo.tga", "Mainmenu.int", "skin.dds"): o tipo vem da extensao; cai para qualquer tipo
    const ResEntry* find_file(const std::string& filename) const;
    const ResEntry* find_lump(const std::string& pack, std::uint32_t lump) const;
    std::vector<const ResEntry*> list(std::uint32_t type) const;

    bool read(const ResEntry& e, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out, std::string& err) const;
    bool read(const std::string& name, std::uint32_t type, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out) const;   // false se nao achar/ler
    bool read_file(const std::string& filename, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out) const;

    std::string where(const ResEntry& e) const;     // "Interface.grp#80" ou "RETAIL\Interface\INT_Interface\Mainmenu.int"

private:
    bool add_entry(ResEntry&& e);
    static std::string key(const std::string& name);  // minusculo, sem extensao conhecida
    std::vector<ResEntry> entries_;
    std::vector<std::string> packs_;                  // nomes dos .grp ("Interface", "Maps"...)
    std::vector<std::uint64_t> pack_size_;
    mutable std::vector<std::FILE*> files_;           // abertos sob demanda (modo demo)
    std::multimap<std::string, std::size_t> by_name_; // chave -> indice em entries_
    std::string root_;
    bool demo_ = false;
};

// Confere se uma pasta e a demo original. Explica o motivo quando nao e.
bool is_demo_dir(const std::string& dir, std::string& why);
// Confere se uma pasta e uma copia extraida pelo kit (original_assets). Explica o motivo quando nao e.

std::string path_join(const std::string& a, const std::string& b);

bool dir_exists(const std::string& p);
bool read_whole_file(const std::string& path, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out);
std::string to_lower(std::string s);
```

## viewer/src/video_helper32.cpp

```cpp
// v20: F3VBVideo32.exe — ajudante de 32 bits que toca os videos da demo (Movies\IPlogo.mve, BISlogo.mve).
//
// Por que existe: os ".mve" da demo do Van Buren sao Bink 1 (assinatura "BIKi"), codec proprietario da RAD Game Tools. Nao ha
// especificacao publica completa (faltam as tabelas do codec) e a unica implementacao aberta e LGPL, que a regra do projeto nao
// deixa copiar (CLEANROOM.md). Entao usamos o decodificador que A PROPRIA DEMO traz (binkw32.dll, 32 bits, o mesmo que o F3.exe
// usa), lido da pasta da demo do jogador: nada e distribuido com o F3VB. Como o F3VB e 64 bits e a DLL e 32, este programa
// pequeno (codigo nosso) carrega a DLL e manda os quadros pela saida padrao (pipe) para o F3VB, que desenha em resolucao moderna.
// O som do video e tocado pela propria DLL (waveOut), sincronizado por ela (BinkWait).
//
// Uso: F3VBVideo32.exe <pasta da demo> <arquivo .mve>
// Saida (stdout, binaria): "F3VBVID1" u32 largura, u32 altura, u32 quadros, u32 fps_num, u32 fps_den;
//                          depois, por quadro: u32 numero, largura*altura*4 bytes BGRA (linha de cima primeiro).
// Codigo de saida: 0 ok, 2 argumentos, 3 sem binkw32.dll, 4 funcao ausente, 5 BinkOpen falhou, 6 pipe fechado (F3VB pulou o video).
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <mmsystem.h>
#include <dsound.h>
#include <cstdarg>

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace {

typedef void* HBINK;
typedef HBINK(__stdcall* PFN_BinkOpen)(const char* name, unsigned flags);
typedef int(__stdcall* PFN_BinkDoFrame)(HBINK);
typedef void(__stdcall* PFN_BinkNextFrame)(HBINK);
typedef int(__stdcall* PFN_BinkWait)(HBINK);
typedef void(__stdcall* PFN_BinkClose)(HBINK);
typedef int(__stdcall* PFN_BinkCopyToBuffer)(HBINK, void* dest, int pitch, unsigned height, unsigned x, unsigned y, unsigned flags);
typedef void*(__stdcall* PFN_BinkOpenWaveOut)(unsigned param);
typedef void*(__stdcall* PFN_BinkOpenDirectSound)(unsigned param);
typedef int(__stdcall* PFN_BinkSetSoundSystem)(void* open_fn, unsigned param);

const unsigned kSurface32 = 3;          // BINKSURFACE32 (BGRA de 32 bits)

bool put(HANDLE out, const void* p, DWORD n) {
    const std::uint8_t* b = static_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(p);
    while (n) {
        DWORD w = 0;
        if (!WriteFile(out, b, n, &w, nullptr) || w == 0) return false;
        b += w; n -= w;
    }
    return true;
}

std::uint32_t rd32(const std::uint8_t* p) { std::uint32_t v; std::memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }

}  // namespace

FILE* g_log = nullptr;
void L(const char* fmt, ...) {
    if (!g_log) return;
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    std::vfprintf(g_log, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    std::fputc('\n', g_log);
    std::fflush(g_log);
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc < 3) { std::fprintf(stderr, "uso: F3VBVideo32 <pasta da demo> <video.mve>\n"); return 2; }
    const std::string demo = argv[1], file = argv[2];
    // cabecalho do Bink (para o tamanho e o numero de quadros, sem depender da estrutura interna da DLL)
    std::uint8_t hdr[44] = {0};
    {
        FILE* f = std::fopen(file.c_str(), "rb");
        if (!f) { std::fprintf(stderr, "nao abri %s\n", file.c_str()); return 5; }
        const std::size_t n = std::fread(hdr, 1, sizeof hdr, f);
        std::fclose(f);
        if (n < 44 || hdr[0] != 'B' || hdr[1] != 'I' || hdr[2] != 'K') { std::fprintf(stderr, "nao e Bink\n"); return 5; }
    }
    const std::uint32_t frames = rd32(hdr + 8), w = rd32(hdr + 20), h = rd32(hdr + 24), fnum = rd32(hdr + 28), fden = rd32(hdr + 32);
    if (!frames || !w || !h || w > 4096 || h > 4096) { std::fprintf(stderr, "cabecalho invalido\n"); return 5; }

    SetDllDirectoryA(demo.c_str());
    HMODULE dll = LoadLibraryA((demo + "\\binkw32.dll").c_str());
    if (!dll) { std::fprintf(stderr, "binkw32.dll nao achado em %s\n", demo.c_str()); return 3; }
    auto f_open = reinterpret_cast<PFN_BinkOpen>(GetProcAddress(dll, "_BinkOpen@8"));
    auto f_do = reinterpret_cast<PFN_BinkDoFrame>(GetProcAddress(dll, "_BinkDoFrame@4"));
    auto f_next = reinterpret_cast<PFN_BinkNextFrame>(GetProcAddress(dll, "_BinkNextFrame@4"));
    auto f_wait = reinterpret_cast<PFN_BinkWait>(GetProcAddress(dll, "_BinkWait@4"));
    auto f_close = reinterpret_cast<PFN_BinkClose>(GetProcAddress(dll, "_BinkClose@4"));
    auto f_copy = reinterpret_cast<PFN_BinkCopyToBuffer>(GetProcAddress(dll, "_BinkCopyToBuffer@28"));
    auto f_wave = reinterpret_cast<PFN_BinkOpenWaveOut>(GetProcAddress(dll, "_BinkOpenWaveOut@4"));
    auto f_sound = reinterpret_cast<PFN_BinkSetSoundSystem>(GetProcAddress(dll, "_BinkSetSoundSystem@8"));
    auto f_ds = reinterpret_cast<PFN_BinkOpenDirectSound>(GetProcAddress(dll, "_BinkOpenDirectSound@4"));
    if (!f_open || !f_do || !f_next || !f_wait || !f_close || !f_copy) { std::fprintf(stderr, "funcao ausente na binkw32.dll\n"); return 4; }
    // opcoes: --mudo | --waveout | --hwnd <janela do jogo> | --log <arquivo>
    bool mute = false, waveout = false;
    HWND game_wnd = nullptr;
    FILE* lg = nullptr;
    for (int i = 3; i < argc; ++i) {
        const std::string a = argv[i];
        if (a == "--mudo") mute = true;
        else if (a == "--waveout") waveout = true;
        else if (a == "--hwnd" && i + 1 < argc) game_wnd = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(std::strtoull(argv[++i], nullptr, 10)));
        else if (a == "--log" && i + 1 < argc) lg = std::fopen(argv[++i], "ab");
    }
    g_log = lg;
    L("== %s: %ux%u, %u quadros", file.c_str(), w, h, frames);
    // v21: som. O v20 chamava BinkOpenDirectSound(0): o Bink cria o DirectSound preso a uma janela DESTE processo (que nao tem janela).
    // No Windows o DirectSound silencia o som quando essa janela nao esta em primeiro plano, e a janela em primeiro plano e a do F3VB.
    // Por isso saia mudo no Windows (no wine nao). Agora o DirectSound e criado aqui com a janela DO JOGO (--hwnd) e entregue ao Bink.
    // Se falhar, cai para o waveOut do Bink (nao depende de foco).
    if (!mute && f_sound) {
        bool ok = false;
        if (!waveout && f_ds && game_wnd) {
            using PFN_DSC = HRESULT(WINAPI*)(LPCGUID, LPDIRECTSOUND*, LPUNKNOWN);
            HMODULE dsdll = LoadLibraryA("dsound.dll");
            auto dsc = dsdll ? reinterpret_cast<PFN_DSC>(GetProcAddress(dsdll, "DirectSoundCreate")) : nullptr;
            LPDIRECTSOUND ds = nullptr;
            const HRESULT h1 = dsc ? dsc(nullptr, &ds, nullptr) : E_FAIL;
            const HRESULT h2 = SUCCEEDED(h1) && ds ? ds->SetCooperativeLevel(game_wnd, DSSCL_PRIORITY) : E_FAIL;
            L("som: DirectSoundCreate 0x%08lx, SetCooperativeLevel(janela do jogo) 0x%08lx", static_cast<unsigned long>(h1), static_cast<unsigned long>(h2));
            if (SUCCEEDED(h2)) { ok = f_sound(reinterpret_cast<void*>(f_ds), static_cast<unsigned>(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(ds))) != 0; L("som: Bink com o DirectSound do jogo: %s", ok ? "ok" : "FALHOU"); }
            else if (ds) ds->Release();
        }
        if (!ok && f_wave) { ok = f_sound(reinterpret_cast<void*>(f_wave), 0) != 0; L("som: Bink com waveOut: %s", ok ? "ok" : "FALHOU"); }
        if (!ok && f_ds) { ok = f_sound(reinterpret_cast<void*>(f_ds), 0) != 0; L("som: Bink com DirectSound proprio: %s", ok ? "ok" : "FALHOU"); }
    } else L("som: %s", mute ? "mudo (pedido)" : "sem BinkSetSoundSystem");
    HBINK b = f_open(file.c_str(), 0);
    if (!b) { std::fprintf(stderr, "BinkOpen falhou\n"); L("BinkOpen falhou"); return 5; }

    HANDLE out = GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE);
    std::uint32_t head[5] = {w, h, frames, fnum, fden ? fden : 1};
    if (!put(out, "F3VBVID1", 8) || !put(out, head, sizeof head)) { f_close(b); return 6; }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> buf(static_cast<std::size_t>(w) * h * 4);
    int rc = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < frames; ++i) {
        while (f_wait(b)) Sleep(1);                     // o Bink espera a hora certa do quadro (e sincroniza o som)
        f_do(b);
        f_copy(b, buf.data(), static_cast<int>(w * 4), h, 0, 0, kSurface32);
        if (!put(out, &i, 4) || !put(out, buf.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(buf.size()))) { rc = 6; break; }
        if (i + 1 < frames) f_next(b);
    }
    f_close(b);
    FreeLibrary(dll);
    return rc;
}
```

## viewer/src/video_player.cpp

```cpp
// v20: tocador dos videos Bink (ver video_player.h).
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#include <GL/gl.h>

#include "video_player.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

#include "win_platform.h"

#ifndef GL_BGRA_EXT
#define GL_BGRA_EXT 0x80E1
#endif
#ifndef GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE
#define GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE 0x812F
#endif

namespace f3v {

namespace {
bool read_all(HANDLE h, void* p, DWORD n) {
    std::uint8_t* b = static_cast<std::uint8_t*>(p);
    while (n) {
        DWORD r = 0;
        if (!ReadFile(h, b, n, &r, nullptr) || r == 0) return false;
        b += r; n -= r;
    }
    return true;
}
int pow2(int v) { int p = 1; while (p < v) p <<= 1; return p; }
}  // namespace

bool VideoPlayer::start(const std::string& helper, const std::string& demo, const std::string& movie, bool mute, std::string& err, void* hwnd, const std::string& log, bool waveout) {
    stop();
    finished_ = false;
    fresh_ = false;
    w_ = h_ = 0; nframes_ = 0; cur_ = 0; shown_ = 0;
    SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES sa;
    std::memset(&sa, 0, sizeof sa);
    sa.nLength = sizeof sa;
    sa.bInheritHandle = TRUE;
    HANDLE rd = nullptr, wr = nullptr;
    if (!CreatePipe(&rd, &wr, &sa, 4 << 20)) { err = "CreatePipe falhou"; return false; }
    SetHandleInformation(rd, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0);
    STARTUPINFOW si;
    std::memset(&si, 0, sizeof si);
    si.cb = sizeof si;
    si.dwFlags = STARTF_USESTDHANDLES | STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW;
    si.wShowWindow = SW_HIDE;
    si.hStdOutput = wr;
    si.hStdError = GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE);
    si.hStdInput = GetStdHandle(STD_INPUT_HANDLE);
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    std::memset(&pi, 0, sizeof pi);
    std::wstring cmd = L"\"" + widen(helper) + L"\" \"" + widen(demo) + L"\" \"" + widen(movie) + L"\"" + (mute ? L" --mudo" : L"");
    if (hwnd) cmd += L" --hwnd " + std::to_wstring(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(hwnd));
    if (waveout) cmd += L" --waveout";
    if (!log.empty()) cmd += L" --log \"" + widen(log) + L"\"";
    std::vector<wchar_t> cbuf(cmd.begin(), cmd.end());
    cbuf.push_back(0);
    const BOOL ok = CreateProcessW(nullptr, cbuf.data(), nullptr, nullptr, TRUE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, nullptr, nullptr, &si, &pi);
    CloseHandle(wr);
    if (!ok) { CloseHandle(rd); err = "nao consegui abrir " + helper; return false; }
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    proc_ = pi.hProcess;
    pipe_ = rd;
    // cabecalho (bloqueia pouco: o ajudante escreve logo depois de abrir o video)
    char magic[8];
    std::uint32_t head[5];
    if (!read_all(rd, magic, 8) || std::memcmp(magic, "F3VBVID1", 8) != 0 || !read_all(rd, head, sizeof head)) {
        DWORD code = 0;
        WaitForSingleObject(pi.hProcess, 2000);
        GetExitCodeProcess(pi.hProcess, &code);
        err = "o ajudante de video nao abriu " + movie + " (codigo " + std::to_string(code) + (code == 3 ? ": binkw32.dll nao esta na pasta da demo" : code == 5 ? ": BinkOpen falhou" : "") + ")";
        stop();
        return false;
    }
    w_ = static_cast<int>(head[0]); h_ = static_cast<int>(head[1]); nframes_ = head[2];
    latest_.assign(static_cast<std::size_t>(w_) * static_cast<std::size_t>(h_) * 4, 0);
    tmp_ = latest_;
    running_ = true;
    th_ = std::thread([this] { reader(); });
    return true;
}

void VideoPlayer::reader() {
    HANDLE rd = static_cast<HANDLE>(pipe_);
    std::uint32_t idx = 0;
    while (running_) {
        if (!read_all(rd, &idx, 4) || !read_all(rd, tmp_.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(tmp_.size()))) break;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
            latest_.swap(tmp_);
            fresh_ = true;
        }
        ++shown_;                                   // v21: quadros que chegaram do ajudante
        cur_ = idx;
        if (nframes_ && idx + 1 >= nframes_) break;
    }
    finished_ = true;
}

void VideoPlayer::stop() {
    running_ = false;
    if (proc_) { TerminateProcess(static_cast<HANDLE>(proc_), 0); }
    if (pipe_) { CloseHandle(static_cast<HANDLE>(pipe_)); pipe_ = nullptr; }      // desbloqueia o ReadFile da thread
    if (th_.joinable()) th_.join();
    if (proc_) { WaitForSingleObject(static_cast<HANDLE>(proc_), 2000); CloseHandle(static_cast<HANDLE>(proc_)); proc_ = nullptr; }
    finished_ = true;
}

bool VideoPlayer::take_frame(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    if (!fresh_) return false;
    out = latest_;
    fresh_ = false;
    return true;
}

void VideoPlayer::draw(int win_w, int win_h) {
    if (w_ <= 0 || h_ <= 0) return;
    if (!tex_) {
        tex_w_ = pow2(w_); tex_h_ = pow2(h_);
        GLuint id = 0;
        glGenTextures(1, &id);
        tex_ = id;
        glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, tex_);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
        glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> zero(static_cast<std::size_t>(tex_w_) * static_cast<std::size_t>(tex_h_) * 4, 0);
        glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_RGBA, tex_w_, tex_h_, 0, GL_BGRA_EXT, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, zero.data());
    }
    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, tex_);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
        if (fresh_) {
            glPixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 4);
            glTexSubImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, 0, 0, w_, h_, GL_BGRA_EXT, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, latest_.data());
            fresh_ = false;
        }
    }
    // tela inteira, proporcao do video mantida (faixas pretas)
    const float sx = static_cast<float>(win_w) / static_cast<float>(w_), sy = static_cast<float>(win_h) / static_cast<float>(h_);
    const float s = std::min(sx, sy);
    const float dw = static_cast<float>(w_) * s, dh = static_cast<float>(h_) * s;
    const float x0 = (static_cast<float>(win_w) - dw) * 0.5f, y0 = (static_cast<float>(win_h) - dh) * 0.5f;
    const float u1 = static_cast<float>(w_) / static_cast<float>(tex_w_), v1 = static_cast<float>(h_) / static_cast<float>(tex_h_);
    glViewport(0, 0, win_w, win_h);
    glMatrixMode(GL_PROJECTION); glLoadIdentity(); glOrtho(0, win_w, win_h, 0, -1, 1);
    glMatrixMode(GL_MODELVIEW); glLoadIdentity();
    glDisable(GL_DEPTH_TEST); glDisable(GL_LIGHTING); glDisable(GL_BLEND); glDisable(GL_FOG); glDisable(GL_ALPHA_TEST);
    glEnable(GL_TEXTURE_2D);
    glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_TEXTURE_ENV_MODE, GL_REPLACE);
    glColor4f(1, 1, 1, 1);
    glBegin(GL_QUADS);
    glTexCoord2f(0, 0); glVertex2f(x0, y0);
    glTexCoord2f(u1, 0); glVertex2f(x0 + dw, y0);
    glTexCoord2f(u1, v1); glVertex2f(x0 + dw, y0 + dh);
    glTexCoord2f(0, v1); glVertex2f(x0, y0 + dh);
    glEnd();
    glTexEnvi(GL_TEXTURE_ENV, GL_TEXTURE_ENV_MODE, GL_MODULATE);
    glDisable(GL_TEXTURE_2D);
}

void VideoPlayer::release_gl() {
    if (tex_) { GLuint id = tex_; glDeleteTextures(1, &id); tex_ = 0; }
}

}  // namespace f3v
```
